abstract.text: Rampant overuse of health care in the US is plain to see.The traditional explanation from health economics is straightforward: bad incentives.Paying physicians too much leads to more carewhether patients need it or not.But paying physicians too little risks limiting patients' access to care.There is a similar trade-off in patient cost-sharing.This suggests that health policy, from insurance design to payment models, should calibrate payments to be high enough to discourage stinting and promote access, but low enough to avoid overuse of low-value care that threatens affordability and financial sustainability.But mounting evidence suggests this trade-off is not so simple.Across vastly different settings and incentive schemes, there is both overuse and underuse at the same time.The traditional lever of dialing payments up or down is thus likely to mitigate one problem while exacerbating the other.Instead, new tools are required to help physicians do better, rather than do more or do less across the board.Emerging research blending behavioral economics with cutting-edge data analytics paints

10.1001/jamahealthforum.2022.0428.abstractZh: 美国医疗保健的过度使用现象显而易见。健康经济学中的传统解释很直接：激励机制存在缺陷。给医生过高的报酬会导致更多的治疗，无论患者是否需要。但给医生过低的报酬则可能导致患者无法获得足够的医疗服务。在患者费用分担方面也存在类似的权衡。这表明，从保险设计到支付模式，卫生政策应该调整支付金额，使其既足以阻止过度治疗，促进患者获得医疗服务，又足够低，以避免使用低价值的医疗服务，从而保障医疗服务的可负担性和财务可持续性。然而，越来越多的证据表明，这种权衡并不简单。在不同的环境和激励机制下，过度使用和治疗不足的情况同时存在。因此，传统的调整支付金额的方法可能会加剧其中一个问题，而缓解另一个问题。因此，需要新的工具来帮助医生更好地提供医疗服务，而不是简单地增加或减少支付金额。结合行为经济学和前沿数据分析的新兴研究为我们提供了新的思路。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: The objective of the current national cohort study was to analyze the correlation between choice and competition on outcomes after cancer surgery in rectal cancer. METHODS: The analysis included all men who underwent rectal cancer surgery in the English National Health Service between March 2015 and April 2019 (n = 13,996). Multilevel logistic regression was used to assess the effect of a rectal cancer surgery center being located in a competitive environment (based on the number of centers within a threshold distance) and being a successful competitor (based on the ability to attract patients from other hospitals) on eight patient-level outcomes: 30- and 90-day emergency readmissions, 30-day re-operation rates, 90-day postoperative mortality, length of stay >14 days, circumferential resection margin status, rates of primary procedure with a permanent stoma, and rates of persistent stoma 18 months after anterior resection. RESULTS: With adjustment for patient characteristics, patients who underwent surgery in centers located in a stronger competitive environment were less likely to have an abdominoperineal excision or a Hartman's procedure (odds ratio [OR], 0.73; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.55-0.97, p = .04). Additionally, individuals who received treatment at hospitals that were successful competitors had a lower risk of a 90-day readmission following rectal cancer surgery (OR, 0.86; 95% CI, 0.76-0.97, p = .03) and were less likely to have a persistent stoma at 18 months after anterior resection (OR, 0.75; 95% CI, 0.61-0.93, p = .02). CONCLUSIONS: Hospitals located in areas of high competition are associated with better patient outcomes and improved processes of care for rectal cancer surgery.

10.1002/cncr.34504.abstractZh:
背景：本次全国队列研究的目的是分析直肠癌手术后的结果与选择及竞争之间的相关性。  
方法：研究纳入了2015年3月至2019年4月期间在英国国家卫生服务系统接受直肠癌手术的所有男性患者，共计13,996名。采用多层逻辑回归分析，评估位于竞争激烈的地区（根据一定距离内的医院数量）的直肠癌手术中心以及具有成功竞争能力（根据吸引其他医院患者的能力）的中心的效应对八个患者层面的结果的影响：30天和90天的急诊再入院率、30天的再次手术率、90天后的术后死亡率、住院时间超过14天的情况、环形切除边缘状态、采用永久性造口术的初次手术比例，以及前切术后18个月仍存在造口的情况。  
结果：在调整了患者特征后，选择在竞争更激烈的地区进行手术的患者，接受腹会阴切除术或Hartman手术的可能性较低（比值比[OR]为0.73，95%置信区间[CI]为0.55-0.97，p=0.04）。此外，在具有成功竞争能力的医院接受治疗的个体，在直肠癌手术后90天内再入院的风险较低（OR为0.86，95% CI为0.76-0.97，p=0.03），并且在前切术后18个月仍存在造口的可能性也较低（OR为0.75，95% CI为0.61-0.93，p=0.02）。  
结论：位于竞争激烈的地区的医院与更好的患者结果和更完善的直肠癌手术护理流程相关。

abstract.text: We study the relationship between macroeconomic conditions and health in the United States using data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System between 2004 and 2017. Unlike many existing studies that use state or county as the level of aggregation, our analysis uses a sample of metropolitan and micropolitan statistical areas. Our results suggest strong associations between worsening macroeconomic conditions and reduced access to care and health insurance coverage. While we do not detect any robust relationships between business cycles and health outcomes in the general population, we do find consistent evidence of worse self-reported health during economic downturns among minorities and less-educated individuals. In addition, there is some suggestive evidence of countercyclicality of healthier lifestyle choices. However, the findings for health behavior outcomes are not robust to adjusting for multiple hypothesis testing.

10.1002/hec.4420.abstractZh: 我们研究了2004年至2017年间美国宏观经济状况与健康状况之间的关系，使用了行为风险因素监测系统的数据。与许多以州或县为聚合单位的研究不同，我们的分析采用了大都市和小都市统计区域的样本。研究结果表明，宏观经济状况恶化与就医机会减少以及健康保险覆盖率降低之间存在密切关联。虽然我们没有发现商业周期与普通人群健康结果之间有显著关系，但确实发现了一些证据，表明在经济衰退期间，少数族裔和受教育程度较低的个体自我报告的健康状况较差。此外，还有一些迹象表明，更健康的生活方式选择可能具有反周期性。然而，对于健康行为结果的发现，在进行多重假设检验后仍然不够稳健。

abstract.text: While mosquito-borne diseases are currently most prevalent in mid-latitude countries, rising global temperatures could expand their range. This paper investigates whether one such disease, dengue, harms newborns. The empirical design exploits epidemiological patterns of the disease spreading. Dengue infection rates in the mother's municipality of residence which prevailed during the gestation period are instrumented with exogenous factors that determine dengue incidence in municipalities that have tight social connections to the maternal municipality. Using a large longitudinal dataset of Brazilian birth records, I find that a higher dengue rate during the third trimester of gestation has a detrimental effect on birth weight. In utero exposure to dengue also increases the probability of cesarean delivery and can lead to more serious consequences such as increased fetal and maternal mortality rates.

10.1002/hec.4436.abstractZh: 虽然蚊媒疾病目前主要出现在中纬度国家，但全球气温的上升可能会扩大其传播范围。本文研究了一种名为登革热的疾病是否会对新生儿造成伤害。研究采用了流行病学模式来探讨疾病传播的规律。在妊娠期间，母亲所在市镇的登革热感染率受到外部因素的影响，这些因素决定了与母亲所在市镇社会联系紧密的市镇的登革热发病率。通过利用巴西大量出生记录的数据集，我发现妊娠第三期的登革热感染率越高，对出生体重的影响就越不利。此外，子宫内感染登革热还会增加剖宫产的概率，并可能导致更严重的后果，如胎儿和母亲死亡率的增加。

abstract.text: This paper examines the propagation of COVID-19 across the Spanish provinces and assesses the effectiveness of the Spanish lockdown of the population implemented on March 14, 2020 in order to battle this pandemic. To achieve these objectives, a standard spatial econometric model used in economics is adapted to resemble the popular reproduction models employed in the epidemiological literature. In addition, we introduce a counterfactual exercise that allows us to examine the Gross domestic product (GDP) gains of bringing forward the date of the Spanish Lockdown. We find that the number of COVID-19 cases would have been reduced by 70.4% in the absence of spatial propagation between the Spanish provinces. We also determine that the lockdown prevented the propagation of the virus within and between provinces. As such, the Spanish lockdown reduced the number of potential COVID-19 cases by 82.8%. However, the number of coronavirus cases would have been reduced by an additional 11.6% if the lockdown had been brought forward to March 7, 2020. Finally, an earlier lockdown would have saved approximately 26,900,000,000 euros.

10.1002/hec.4437.abstractZh: 本文研究了COVID-19在西班牙各省份的传播情况，并评估了2020年3月14日实施的西班牙封锁措施在抗击疫情方面的有效性。为实现这些目标，采用了经济学中常用的标准空间计量模型，以模拟流行病学文献中常用的流行病传播模型。此外，我们还引入了一个反事实分析，以探讨如果提前实施西班牙封锁，国内生产总值（GDP）的增减情况。研究发现，如果没有西班牙省份之间的传播，COVID-19病例数量将减少70.4%。同时，封锁措施有效阻止了病毒在省内及省际间的传播，使得潜在的COVID-19病例数量减少了82.8%。然而，如果将封锁时间提前至2020年3月7日，冠状病毒病例数量将再减少11.6%。最后，提前实施封锁措施可节省约26,900,000,000欧元。

abstract.text: Nurse practitioners (NPs) are an increasingly integral part of the primary care workforce. NPs' authority to practice without physician oversight is regulated by state-level scope of practice (SOP) restrictions. To the extent that SOP restrictions prevent NPs from practicing to their full abilities and capacity, they could create inefficiencies and restrict access to health care. In this paper, I study what happens at primary care practices when states relax their SOP laws. Using a novel dataset of claims and electronic health records paired with a difference-in-differences research design, I quantify the effects of relaxing SOP laws on: (1) NPs' autonomy in their day-to-day jobs; (2) total workload and patient allocation between NPs and physicians; and (3) the provision of low-value services at primary care practices. I find some evidence that NPs practice more autonomously following SOP changes, but I find no evidence that relaxing SOP laws changes the volume nor allocation of patients to NPs, nor the provision of low-value services. Given the lower reimbursement that NPs typically receive, these findings suggest that allowing NPs to practice without physician oversight could reduce health care spending, without harming patients.

10.1002/hec.4438.abstractZh: 护士执业者已成为初级保健队伍中不可或缺的一部分。护士在没有医生监督的情况下执业的权力受到州级执业范围限制的监管。如果这些限制阻碍了护士充分发挥其能力和潜力，那么可能会导致效率低下，并限制人们获得医疗保健的机会。在本文中，我研究了当各州放宽执业范围限制时，初级保健诊所会发生什么变化。通过结合索赔数据和电子健康记录的新颖数据集，并采用差异-差异研究设计，我量化了放宽执业范围限制对以下方面的影响：（1）护士在日常工作中的自主权；（2）护士与医生之间的总工作量及患者分配情况；（3）初级保健诊所中低价值服务的提供情况。我发现，在执业范围限制放宽后，护士的自主性有所增强，但并未发现放宽执业范围限制会改变分配给护士的患者数量或比例，也不会影响低价值服务的提供。鉴于护士通常获得的报销金额较低，这些发现表明，允许护士在没有医生监督的情况下执业，可以在不损害患者利益的情况下减少医疗保健支出。

abstract.text: In 2016, the Surgeon General used longitudinal cohort studies to conclude that youth e-cigarette use is strongly associated with cigarette use. We re-evaluate data from the period of time before the writing of the Surgeon General report, using quasi-experimental methods, and reach the opposite conclusion. We study contemporaneous and intertemporal effects of e-cigarette and cigarette price and tax changes. Our price variation comes from 35,000 retailers participating in the Nielsen Retail Scanner data system. We match price and tax variation to survey data on current use of e-cigarettes and cigarettes for over 94,000 students between grades 6 and 12 in the National Youth Tobacco Survey (NYTS) for years 2011-2015. We find evidence that e-cigarettes and cigarettes are same-period economic substitutes. Coefficient estimates (while imprecisely estimated) also suggest potentially large positive effects of past e-cigarette prices on current cigarette use, indicating intertemporal economic substitution. Our findings raise doubts about the conclusion of government-sponsored reports that e-cigarettes and cigarettes are strongly positively associated. We recommend revisiting and possibly amending this conclusion.

10.1002/hec.4439.abstractZh: 2016年，美国卫生局局长通过纵向队列研究得出结论，青少年使用电子香烟与吸烟行为存在强烈关联。我们重新评估了该报告撰写前的数据，采用准实验方法，得出了相反的结论。我们研究了电子香烟和香烟价格及税收变化的同期效应和跨期效应。我们的价格数据来源于参与Nielsen零售扫描系统的35,000家零售商。我们将价格与税收的变化与2011-2015年《全国青少年烟草调查》中超过94,000名6至12年级学生的电子香烟和香烟使用情况调查数据进行了匹配。我们发现电子香烟和香烟是同一时期的经济替代品。尽管估计结果不够精确，但系数估计还表明，过去电子香烟的价格可能对当前香烟使用产生了较大的正面影响，这表明存在跨期经济替代关系。我们的研究结果对政府发布的关于电子香烟和香烟之间存在强烈正相关的结论提出了质疑。我们建议重新审视并可能修正这一结论。

abstract.text: Current regulations require that when seeking approval for new drugs, pharmaceutical companies must demonstrate their short- but not long-term safety and efficacy. Instead, post-approval, clinicians report adverse reactions to regulators, who may issue additional safety warnings. We investigate the incentives this creates for pharmaceutical companies to seek approval for new drugs with unknown long-term effects. We first construct models predicting that (1) long-run effects can be reasonably approximated from observational follow-up of short-term randomized control trials, and (2) companies will trade-off short-term sales against possible later adverse demand effects. We then test whether regulator warnings over diabetic, analgesic, analeptic, or psychoanaleptic drugs sold in the US and UK hospital and retail sectors affect the sales of individual drugs or the share prices of companies that sell them. With some exceptions, we find that pharmaceutical companies generally face no adverse market reaction in sales or share price from newly issued warnings in these four drug categories.

10.1002/hec.4440.abstractZh: 现行法规要求，在申请新药审批时，制药公司必须证明其短期而非长期的安全性和有效性。而在审批后，临床医生需向监管机构报告不良反应，监管机构可能会发布额外的安全警告。我们研究了这一机制对制药公司寻求审批具有未知长期影响的新药的激励作用。我们首先构建模型，预测：(1)长期影响可以通过对短期随机对照试验的观察性随访来合理估算；(2)公司会在短期销售与可能的后期不良反应之间做出权衡。随后，我们测试了在美国和英国医院及零售领域销售的糖尿病药物、镇痛药、催眠药或精神催眠药相关的监管机构警告，是否会影响这些药物的销售或销售这些药物的公司的股价。除少数例外情况外，我们发现制药公司在这四个药物类别中，新发布的警告通常不会对其销售或股价产生负面市场反应。

abstract.text: Same-sex marriage legalization (SSML) is a typical anti-discrimination policy to remove institutional discrimination against sexual minorities by providing them with marriage equality. We examine how this legalization in the Netherlands affected mental health. Conducting a difference-in-differences analysis with heterosexual individuals as a reference group, we find that SSML significantly improved mental health of sexual minorities and substantially reduced the sexual orientation gap of mental health. The beneficial effects were present for both married and non-married sexual minorities. This phenomenon suggests that part of the health gains were related to mechanisms beyond marriage itself.

10.1002/hec.4441.abstractZh: 同性婚姻合法化是一种典型的反歧视政策，通过为性少数群体提供婚姻平等，消除针对他们的制度性歧视。我们研究了荷兰的这一法律改革对心理健康的影响。以异性恋个体作为参考组，通过差异-差异分析发现，同性婚姻合法化显著改善了性少数群体的心理健康，并大幅缩小了心理健康方面的性取向差异。这种积极影响既存在于已婚性少数群体，也存在于未婚性少数群体。这一现象表明，部分健康改善与婚姻本身之外的机制有关。

abstract.text: In light of skilled-labor shortage, the effect of a change in the wage of nurses on their labor supply is intensely discussed in recent literature. Using extensive data of German 14- to 15-year-olds, I analyze the role of the beliefs about a nurse's wage in the decision to become one. To estimate a partial effect, I select controls and their functional form using post-double-selection, which is a data-driven selection method based on regression shrinkage. Highlighting the importance of wages at the extensive margin of labor supply, the wage beliefs play a positive and statistically significant role. Although information is publicly available, educational choices knowingly suffer from misinformation. I find that especially those who do not become a nurse understate the wage. The results lead to two important policy implications. First, increasing the wage may help to overcome the shortage observed in many countries. Second, providing more information on the (relative) wage may be a successful strategy to attract more individuals into this profession. To assess the sensitivity of the results regarding omitted variable bias, I apply a novel approach. It turns out that potential unobserved confounders would have to be strong to overrule the conclusions.

10.1002/hec.4442.abstractZh: 鉴于熟练劳动力短缺的问题，近期文献中广泛讨论了护士工资变化对其劳动力供应的影响。我利用德国14至15岁青少年的大量数据，分析了人们对护士工资的看法在决定从事该职业中的作用。为了估计部分效应，我采用了基于回归收缩的数据驱动选择方法——后双重选择法，来选择控制变量及其函数形式。强调工资在劳动力供应中的重要性，工资观念具有积极且统计上显著的效应。尽管相关信息是公开可得的，但教育选择却存在错误信息。我发现，尤其是那些不选择成为护士的人，会低估护士的工资水平。这些结果带来了两个重要的政策启示：首先，提高工资可能有助于解决许多国家面临的劳动力短缺问题；其次，提供更多关于（相对）工资的信息可能是吸引更多个体从事这一职业的有效策略。为了评估结果对遗漏变量偏差的敏感性，我采用了一种新颖的方法。结果表明，潜在的未观测混杂因素必须非常强，才能推翻这些结论。

abstract.text: In the French diagnosis-related group (DRG)-based payment system, both private and public hospitals are financed by a public single payer. Public hospitals are overcrowded and have no direct financial incentives to choose one procedure over another. If a patient has a strong preference, they can switch to a private hospital. In private hospitals, the preference does come into play, but the patient has to pay for the additional cost, for which they are reimbursed if they have supplementary private health insurance. Do financial incentives from the fees received by physicians for different procedures drive their behavior? Using French exhaustive data on delivery, we find that private hospitals perform significantly more cesarean deliveries than public hospitals. However, for patients without private health insurance, the two sectors differ much less in terms of cesareans rate. We determine the impact of the financial incentive for patients who can afford the additional cost. Affordability is mainly ensured by the reimbursement of costs by private health insurance. These findings can be interpreted as evidence that, in healthcare systems where a public single payer offers universal coverage, the presence of supplementary private insurance can contribute to creating incentives on the supply side and lead to practices and an allocation of resources that are not optimal from a social welfare perspective.

10.1002/hec.4443.abstractZh: 在基于法国疾病诊断相关分组（DRG）的支付体系中，无论是私立医院还是公立医院都由单一的公共支付者资助。公立医院人满为患，且缺乏直接的经济激励来促使医院选择某种治疗方案。如果患者有强烈的偏好，他们可以选择去私立医院。在私立医院中，患者的偏好确实起作用，但患者必须自行承担额外的费用，如果他们有补充性的私人健康保险，这些费用可以得到报销。医生因不同手术而获得的费用激励是否会影响他们的行为？通过利用法国关于手术数据的详尽数据，我们发现私立医院进行的剖宫产手术数量明显多于公立医院。然而，对于没有私人健康保险的患者来说，两类药物医院在剖宫产手术率上的差异并不明显。我们确定了对于能够承担额外费用的患者而言，经济激励的影响。能够负担得起费用主要得益于私人健康保险对费用的报销。这些发现表明，在由单一公共支付者提供全民覆盖的医疗保健体系中，补充性的私人保险的存在可能会促使供应方面的激励措施，从而导致从社会福利角度来看并不理想的资源分配和医疗实践。

abstract.text: Sugary drinks in schools have been demonized for their potential long-term contribution to rising obesity rates. Surprisingly, there is only little evidence on the immediate effects of sugary drinks in schools. This paper provides experimental evidence on the in-class effects of sugary drinks on behavior and student achievement. We randomly assigned 462 preschool children to receive sugary drinks or artificially sweetened drinks and collected data before and after consumption. Our findings suggest that the consumption of one sugary drink induces an initial "relaxing" effect for boys, before making them more restless. Girls' behavior is not significantly affected. We find a negative effect on student achievement for boys and a positive effect for girls. We show the robustness of the results across two field experiments.

10.1002/hec.4444.abstractZh: 学校中的含糖饮料因其可能长期导致肥胖率上升而受到谴责。令人惊讶的是，关于含糖饮料在学校中的即时影响，几乎没有相关研究。本文提供了关于含糖饮料在课堂上对学生行为和学业成绩影响的实验证据。我们随机将462名学龄前儿童分为两组，一组饮用含糖饮料，另一组饮用人工甜味饮料，并在饮用前后收集数据。研究发现，饮用含糖饮料后，男孩会先出现“放松”效果，随后变得更加焦躁不安。女孩的行为则没有显著变化。我们发现，含糖饮料对男孩的学业成绩有负面影响，而对女孩则有正面影响。我们的研究结果在两次实地实验中均得到了验证。

abstract.text: This paper examines the relationship between maternal exposure to violence during pregnancy and newborn birthweight. The identification strategy exploits variation in the timing of exposure and in the geographic location of expectant mothers across Colombian municipalities. Exposure to violence in early pregnancy had a large negative impact on birthweight, primarily for boys, and the effect was mitigated by their mothers' education. Girls' birthweight was affected mainly by shocks in later stages of gestation. Furthermore, their mothers were more likely to engage in potentially harmful behaviors during the pregnancy. This evidence exposes the importance of parental responses in shaping the effect of exposure to violence on newborn health.

10.1002/hec.4445.abstractZh: 本文探讨了母亲在孕期遭受暴力与新生儿出生体重之间的关系。研究采用了一种识别策略，通过分析哥伦比亚各市镇中孕妇遭受暴力的时间差异和地理位置差异来进行研究。研究发现，在孕早期遭受暴力对新生儿出生体重有显著的负面影响，尤其是对男孩的影响更为明显；而这一影响在一定程度上被母亲的教育程度所缓解。对于女孩来说，出生体重的下降主要受到妊娠后期暴力的影响。此外，这些女孩的母亲在孕期更有可能从事可能有害的行为。这些研究结果揭示了父母反应在塑造暴力对新生儿健康影响方面的重要性。

abstract.text: Mandatory access Prescription Drug Monitoring Programs (MA-PDMPs) aim to curb the epidemic at a common point of initiation of use, the prescription. However, there is recent concern about whether opioid policies have been too restrictive and reduced appropriate access to patients with the most need for opioid pharmaceuticals. We assess MA-PDMP's effect on specialty-specific opioid prescribing behavior of Medicare providers. Our findings suggest that requiring providers to query a PDMP differentially affects opioid prescribing across provider specialties. We find a three to four percent decrease in prescribing for Primary Care and Internal Medicine providers. This result is driven by healthcare providers at the lower end of the prescribing distribution. There is also suggestive evidence of an increase in opioid use disorder treatment drugs prescribed by these same providers. We also find no evidence for the hypothesis that MA-PDMPs restrict prescribing by providers who treat patients with potentially high levels of pain, few drug substitutes, or urgency for pain treatment (e.g., Oncology/Palliative care). This result is not dependent on whether a state provides exemptions for these providers. Our results indicate that MA-PDMPs may help close provider-patient informational gaps while retaining a provider's ability to supply these drugs to patients with a need for opioids.

10.1002/hec.4446.abstractZh: 强制访问处方药监测计划旨在在药物使用的起点——处方环节，遏制药物滥用现象。然而，最近有人担心阿片类药物政策过于严格，导致最需要阿片类药物的患者无法获得这些药物。我们评估了这些计划对医疗保险提供者特定领域阿片类药物处方行为的影响。研究发现，要求提供者查询处方药物监测计划对不同专业领域的阿片类药物处方产生了不同的影响。我们发现，初级保健和内科医生的阿片类药物处方减少了3%到4%。这一结果主要出现在处方分布较低端的医疗提供者中。此外，还有迹象表明，这些医生所开具的阿片类药物成瘾治疗药物的处方数量有所增加。我们没有发现任何证据支持这样的假设，即强制访问处方药物监测计划限制了那些治疗疼痛程度较高、药物替代品较少或需要紧急止痛治疗的患者（如肿瘤学/姑息治疗领域）的医生的处方行为。这一结果并不取决于该州是否对这些医生提供豁免。我们的研究结果表明，强制访问处方药物监测计划有助于缩小医疗提供者与患者之间的信息差距，同时保留医生向需要阿片类药物的患者提供这些药物的能力。

abstract.text: We study primary care physicians' prevention and monitoring technology adoption. Physicians' adoption decisions are based on benefits and costs, which depend on payment incentives, educational assistance, and market characteristics. The empirical study uses national Norwegian register and physician claims data between 2009 and 2014. In 2006, a new annual comprehensive checkup for Type 2 diabetic patients was introduced. A physician collects a fee for each checkup. In 2013, an education assistance program was introduced in two Norwegian counties. We estimate adoption decisions by fixed-effect regressions, and two-part and hazard models. We use a difference-in-difference model to estimate the education program impact. Fixed-effect estimations and separate analyses of physicians who have moved between municipalities support a peer effect. The education program has a strongly positive effect, which is positively associated with a physician's number of diabetic patients, and the fraction of physician-adopters in the same market.

10.1002/hec.4447.abstractZh: 我们研究了初级保健医生对预防和监测技术的采用情况。医生们的采用决策基于收益与成本，而这些收益与成本又受到支付激励、教育援助以及市场特征的影响。实证研究使用了2009至2014年间挪威全国登记数据和医生索赔数据。2006年，挪威为2型糖尿病患者推出了新的年度综合体检服务，医生每次体检会收取费用。2013年，挪威两个县推出了教育援助计划。我们通过固定效应回归、两部分模型以及风险模型来估计医生的采用决策。为了评估教育计划的影响，我们使用了差异-差异模型。固定效应估计以及对不同市辖区间流动的医生的单独分析支持了同行效应。教育计划具有强烈的积极影响，这种影响与医生的糖尿病患者数量以及同一市场中采用该技术的医生比例呈正相关。

abstract.text: We study the role of access to health insurance coverage as a determinant of individuals' subjective well-being (SWB) by analyzing large-scale healthcare reforms in the United States. Using data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System and Panel Study of Income Dynamics, we find that the 2006 Massachusetts reform and 2014 Affordable Care Act Medicaid expansion improved the overall life satisfaction of Massachusetts residents and low-income adults in Medicaid expansion states, respectively. The results are robust to various sensitivity and falsification tests. Our findings imply that access to health insurance plays an important role in improving SWB. Without considering psychological benefits, the actual benefits of health insurance may be underemphasized.

10.1002/hec.4448.abstractZh: 我们研究了获得医疗保险覆盖作为个体主观幸福感决定因素的作用，通过分析美国的大规模医疗改革。利用行为风险因素监测系统和收入动态面板研究的数据，我们发现2006年的马萨诸塞州改革以及2014年的《平价医疗法案》医疗补助扩展措施分别提高了马萨诸塞州居民和医疗补助扩展州低收入成年人的整体生活满意度。这些结果在多种敏感性测试和虚假测试中都得到了验证。我们的研究结果表明，获得医疗保险在提升主观幸福感方面起着重要作用。如果不考虑心理层面的好处，医疗保险的实际益处可能会被低估。

abstract.text: Prior research shows that economic downturns are associated with increases in mental illness. However, we know little about whose mental health is most negatively affected. Is it the young or old, men or women, employed or non-employed, rich or poor? Using an 18-year panel dataset of Australians, we contribute to this understanding by estimating the impact of changes in unemployment on mental health, separately by population subgroups. Our mental health measure captures psychological distress and emotional difficulties, which are often missed by infrequent event indicators such as suicides. We find that young women suffer most during economic downturns. Men and women of older ages are not significantly affected. The effects for young women are driven by those in insecure employment, and those from low socioeconomic backgrounds. Our results suggest that public health programs should emphasize the mental health of young women during economic downturns.

10.1002/hec.4449.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，经济衰退与精神疾病的增加有关。然而，我们对哪些人的心理健康受到最严重的影响知之甚少。是年轻人还是老年人，男性还是女性，就业者还是非就业者，富人还是穷人？我们利用澳大利亚18年的面板数据集，通过分别针对不同人口亚群体来估算失业变化对心理健康的影响，以增进对这一问题的理解。我们的心理健康指标涵盖了心理困扰和情绪困难，而这些往往被自杀等偶发事件指标所忽视。我们发现，在经济衰退期间，年轻女性受到的伤害最大。年龄较大的男性和女性则没有受到显著影响。年轻女性所受的影响主要来自于那些从事不稳定就业的人以及来自低社会经济背景的人。我们的研究结果表明，公共卫生项目应在经济衰退期间重点关注年轻女性的心理健康。

abstract.text: In the face of limited COVID-19 vaccine supply, governments have had to identify priority groups for vaccination. In October 2020, when it was still uncertain whether COVID-19 vaccines would be shown to work in trials, we conducted a discrete choice experiment and a best-worst ranking exercise on a representative sample of 2060 Belgians in order to elicit their views on how to set fair vaccination priorities. When asked directly, our respondents prioritized the groups that would later receive priority: essential workers, the elderly or those with pre-existing conditions. When priorities were elicited indirectly, through observing choices between individuals competing for a vaccine, different preferences emerged. The elderly were given lower priority and respondents divided within two clusters. While both clusters wanted to vaccinate the essential workers in the second place, one cluster (N = 1058) primarily wanted to target virus spreaders in order to control transmission whereas the other cluster (N = 886) wanted to prioritize those who were most at risk because of a pre-existing health condition. Other strategies to allocate a scarce resource such as using a "lottery", "first-come, first-served" approach or highest willingness-to-pay received little support.

10.1002/hec.4450.abstractZh: 在COVID-19疫苗供应有限的情况下，各国政府不得不确定疫苗接种的优先群体。2020年10月，当时还不确定COVID-19疫苗在试验中的效果如何，我们针对2060名比利时人进行了离散选择实验和最佳-最差排序调查，以了解他们对如何设定公平疫苗接种优先顺序的看法。当被直接询问时，受访者将后来获得优先权的群体列为优先对象： essential workers、老年人或患有既往疾病的人。当通过观察个体在疫苗选择上的竞争来间接获取优先顺序时，出现了不同的偏好。老年人被赋予了较低的优先级，受访者分为两个群体。虽然两个群体都希望优先为essential workers接种疫苗，但其中一个群体（N = 1058）主要希望针对病毒传播者以控制疫情传播，而另一个群体（N = 886）则希望优先考虑那些因既往健康状况而面临较高风险的人。其他分配稀缺资源的策略，如“抽签”、“先到先得”或基于支付意愿最高的策略，获得的支持较少。

abstract.text: The obesity epidemic is a significant public policy issue facing the international community, resulting in substantial costs to individuals and society. Various policies have been suggested to reduce and prevent obesity, including those informed by standard economics (a key feature of which is the assumption that individuals are rational) and behavioral economics (which identifies and harness deviations from rationality). It is not known which policy interventions taxpayers find acceptable and would prefer to fund via taxation. We provide evidence from a discrete choice experiment on an Australian sample of 996 individuals to investigate social acceptability of eight policies: mass media campaign; traffic light nutritional labeling; taxing sugar sweetened beverages; prepaid cards to purchase healthy food; financial incentives to exercise; improved built environment for physical activity; bans on advertising unhealthy food and drink to children; and improved nutritional quality of food sold in public institutions. Latent class analysis revealed three classes differing in preferences and key respondent characteristics including capacity to benefit. Social acceptability of the eight policies at realistic levels of tax increases was explored using post-estimation analysis. Overall, 78% of the sample were predicted to choose a new policy, varying from 99% in those most likely to benefit from obesity interventions to 19% of those least likely to benefit. A policy informed by standard economics, traffic light labeling was the most popular policy, followed by policies involving regulation: bans on junk food advertising to children and improvement of food quality in public institutions. The least popular policies were behaviorally informed: prepaid cards for the purchase of only healthy foods, and financial incentives to exercise.

10.1002/hec.4451.abstractZh: 肥胖问题是一个重要的公共政策问题，影响着国际社会，给个人和社会带来了巨大的成本。为了减少和预防肥胖，人们提出了各种政策，其中包括基于标准经济学的政策（其核心假设是个体具有理性）以及行为经济学中的政策（旨在识别并利用偏离理性的行为）。目前尚不清楚纳税人认为哪些政策干预是可以接受的，并且希望通过税收来资助哪些政策。我们通过对澳大利亚996名个体的离散选择实验数据进行分析，来研究八项政策的社会接受度：大众媒体宣传、交通信号灯上的营养标签、对含糖饮料征税、预付卡购买健康食品、提供运动激励、改善物理活动的建筑环境、禁止向儿童宣传不健康的食品和饮料，以及提高公共机构销售食品的营养质量。潜在类别分析显示，存在三个不同的偏好群体，这些群体的关键 respondent 特征包括受益能力。通过事后估计分析，我们探讨了在现实税收增加水平下，这八项政策的接受度。总体而言，预计有78%的样本会选择新的政策，其中从最有可能从肥胖干预中受益的人群中有99%会选择新政策，而最不可能受益的人群中仅有19%会选择新政策。基于标准经济学的政策——交通信号灯上的营养标签是最受欢迎的政策，其次是涉及监管的政策：禁止向儿童宣传垃圾食品广告以及改善公共机构中的食品质量。最不受欢迎的政策是那些基于行为学研究的：仅用于购买健康食品的预付卡，以及鼓励运动的财政激励措施。

abstract.text: Legalizing marijuana for medical purposes is a longstanding debate. However, evidence of marijuana's health effects is limited, especially for young adults. We estimate the health impacts of medical marijuana laws (MML) in the U.S. among young adults aged 18-29 years using the difference-in-differences method and data from the Behavioral Risk Factors Surveillance System. We find that having MMLs with strict regulations generate health gains, but not in states with lax regulations. Our heterogeneity analysis results indicate that individuals with lower education attainments, with lower household income and without access to health insurance coverage gain more health benefits from MML with strict regulations than from MML with lax regulations. The findings suggest greater net health gains under strict controls concerning marijuana supply and access.

10.1002/hec.4452.abstractZh: 将大麻合法化用于医疗目的一直是一个长期争论的话题。然而，关于大麻对健康影响的证据非常有限，尤其是在年轻人中。我们使用差异-差异方法，并依据行为风险因素监测系统的数据，对美国18-29岁年轻人的医疗大麻法律所带来的健康影响进行了评估。研究发现，在实行严格规定的州，医疗大麻法律能够带来健康收益，而在规定较为宽松的州则没有这种效果。我们的异质性分析结果显示，教育程度较低、家庭收入较低且无法获得健康保险覆盖的年轻人，从严格规定的医疗大麻法律中获得的健康收益比从宽松规定的法律中获得的健康收益更多。这些发现表明，在严格控制大麻供应和获取的情况下，能够获得更大的净健康收益。

abstract.text: The COVID-19 pandemic has been associated with worsening mental health but it is unclear whether this is a direct consequence of containment measures, like "Stay at Home" orders, or due to other considerations, such as fear and uncertainty about becoming infected. It is also unclear how responsive mental health is to a changing situation. Exploiting the different policy responses to COVID-19 in England and Scotland and using a difference-in-difference analysis, we show that easing lockdown measures rapidly improves mental health. The results were driven by individuals with lower socioeconomic position, in terms of education or financial situation, who benefited more from the end of the strict lockdown, whereas they suffered a larger decline in mental health where the lockdown was extended. Overall, mental health appears to be more sensitive to the imposition of containment policies than to the evolution of the pandemic itself. As lockdown measures may continue to be necessary in the future, further efforts (both financial and mental health support) are required to minimize the consequences of COVID-19 containment policies for mental health.

10.1002/hec.4453.abstractZh: COVID-19疫情与心理健康状况的恶化有关，但尚不清楚这是否是“居家令”等防控措施的直接后果，还是由于其他因素，如对感染病毒的恐惧和不确定性。此外，心理健康状况对形势变化的反应也不明确。通过对比英格兰和苏格兰在应对COVID-19时的政策差异，并利用差异分解分析，我们发现迅速放宽封锁措施能够显著改善心理健康状况。这一效果主要惠及那些教育水平或经济状况较低的人群，而在封锁时间延长的情况下，这些人的心理健康状况反而出现了更大的下降。总体而言，心理健康状况对防控政策的实施更为敏感，而非对疫情本身的演变。鉴于未来可能仍需继续实施封锁措施，因此需要进一步的努力（包括经济支持和心理健康援助），以尽量减少COVID-19防控政策对心理健康的影响。

abstract.text: Sometimes healthcare will affect the health of people living in the future, or their chance of coming into existence. Should such outcomes be valued in health-economic evaluation? Guidelines implicitly recommend their inclusion but this rule has counterintuitive implications and is not consistently applied in practice. We suggest making a distinction between "necessary" and "potential" future lives in Health Technology Assessment. Necessary lives will exist independent of our healthcare choices and should be included. Potential lives are choice-dependent and should be excluded. This rule offers intuitive solutions within the HTA framework, and it changes the cost-effectiveness of several interventions where necessary future lives are affected.

10.1002/hec.4454.abstractZh: 有时，医疗保健会影响到未来人们的健康状况，或者他们存在的机会。在健康经济评估中，是否应该重视这样的结果呢？指南隐含地建议将这类结果纳入评估，但这一规则具有反直觉的含义，并且在实践中并未得到一致的应用。我们建议在健康技术评估中区分“必要的”和“潜在的”未来生活。必要的未来生活不会因我们的医疗选择而受到影响，因此应该被纳入评估范围。而潜在的未来生活则取决于我们的选择，因此应该被排除在外。这一规则为健康技术评估框架提供了直观的解决方案，并且当涉及受影响的未来生活时，它改变了若干干预措施的成本效益。

abstract.text: Choice models in health are almost exclusively based on the neoclassical economic paradigm of utility maximization. Recently developed choice models have captured and shown empirical support for regret minimization as an alternative decision rule. In health economics, recent applications of RRM models indicate that individuals making health-based choices may exhibit regret minimization-type behavior. In this paper, we build on this research using a more flexible model that allows for heterogeneous decision rules, separately from preference heterogeneity, and comparing it to models that assume single decision rules. We use four datasets from diverse settings in which individuals make health choices: tobacco markets, genomic testing, and HIV prevention. We found that, if a one-size-fits-all rule is applied, then utility maximization was preferable to regret minimization for these datasets. However, we also find that individuals apply varying decision rules in similar proportions in these health settings, suggesting that models for heterogeneous decision rules were needed to capture these behaviors in these settings.

10.1002/hec.4455.abstractZh: 在健康领域的选择模型几乎完全基于新古典经济学中的效用最大化范式。最近开发的选择模型已经捕捉到并得到了实证支持，表明后悔最小化可以作为另一种决策规则。在健康经济学中，后悔最小化模型的应用表明，做出基于健康的选择的个体可能会表现出后悔最小化型的行为。在本文中，我们基于这一研究，采用了一种更灵活的模型，该模型允许存在异质性的决策规则，这些规则与偏好异质性分开考虑，并将其与假设单一决策规则的模型进行了比较。我们使用了来自不同情境的四个数据集，这些数据集涉及个体做出健康选择的场景：烟草市场、基因组检测以及HIV预防。我们发现，如果采用一刀切的规则，那么在这些数据集中，效用最大化比后悔最小化更为合适。然而，我们也发现，在这些健康场景中，个体以相似的比例应用不同的决策规则，这表明需要针对异质性的决策规则建立模型，以捕捉这些场景中的行为特征。

abstract.text: The interest in multivariate and higher-order risk preferences has increased. A growing body of literature has demonstrated the relevance and impact of these preferences, but for health the evidence is lacking. We measure multivariate and higher-order risk preferences for quality of life (QoL) and longevity, the two attributes of the Quality-Adjusted Life Year (QALY) model. We observe preferences for a positive correlation between these attributes and for pooling together a fixed loss in one of the attributes and a mean-zero risk in the other, and for pooling together mean-zero risks in QoL and longevity. The findings indicate that higher-order risk preferences are stronger for health than for money. Furthermore, we test if preferences for a risky treatment for a disease affecting only QoL, depend on life expectancy. We find no such a relation, but there is a positive relation between riskiness of a comorbidity affecting life expectancy and risk aversion for a QoL treatment. We therefore observe no definitive deviation from the QALY model, although the model is more robust when expected longevity is high. Our findings suggest that the current practice of cost-effectiveness analysis should be generalized to account for risk aversion in QoL and longevity, and higher-order preferences.

10.1002/hec.4456.abstractZh: 对多变量和更高阶风险偏好的兴趣日益增加。越来越多的文献证明了这些偏好的重要性和影响，但在健康领域，相关证据尚不足。我们测量了多变量和更高阶风险偏好对生活质量（QoL）和寿命的影响，这两个属性构成了质量调整生命年（QALY）模型的基础。我们发现，人们倾向于将这些属性进行正相关处理，并倾向于将其中一个属性的固定损失与另一个属性的均值零风险进行合并，以及在QoL和寿命方面将均值零风险进行合并。研究结果表明，对于健康而言，更高阶风险偏好比金钱偏好更为强烈。此外，我们测试了对于仅影响QoL的疾病，人们是否倾向于选择有风险的治疗方式，以及这种偏好是否依赖于预期寿命。我们没有发现这种关系，但发现影响预期寿命的合并症的风险性与对QoL治疗的风险厌恶之间存在正相关关系。因此，我们并未发现与QALY模型存在明显的偏差，尽管当预期寿命较高时，该模型更为稳健。我们的研究结果表明，当前的成本效益分析实践应该被推广，以考虑QoL和寿命中的风险厌恶以及更高阶偏好。

abstract.text: Discrete choice experiments (DCEs) that include health states and duration are becoming a common method for estimating quality-adjusted life year (QALY) tariffs. These DCEs need to be analyzed under the assumption that respondents treat health and duration multiplicatively. However, in the most commonly used DCE duration format there is no guarantee that respondents actually do so; in fact, respondents can easily simplify the choice tasks by considering health and duration separately. This would result in valid DCE responses but preclude subsequent QALY tariff calculations. Using a Bayesian latent class model and data from two existing valuation studies, our analyses confirm that in both datasets the majority of respondents do not appear to have used a multiplicative utility function. Moreover, a statistical correction for respondents who used an incorrect function changes the range of the QALY weights. Hence our results imply that one can neither assume that respondents use the theoretically required multiplicative utility function nor assume that the type of utility function that respondents use does not affect the estimated QALY weights. As a solution, we advise researchers to use an alternative, more constrained DCE elicitation format that avoids these behavioral problems.

10.1002/hec.4457.abstractZh: 包含健康状态和持续时间的离散选择实验（DCEs）正逐渐成为估算质量调整生命年（QALY）成本的常用方法。这些实验需要在假设受访者将健康与持续时间相乘处理的假设下进行分析。然而，在最常用的DCE持续时间格式中，并不能保证受访者确实如此；实际上，受访者可以通过分别考虑健康和持续时间来简化选择任务。这虽然能得到有效的DCE响应，但会妨碍后续的QALY成本计算。通过采用贝叶斯潜在类别模型，并结合两项现有评估研究的数据，我们的分析证实，在这两个数据集中，大多数受访者似乎并未使用相乘的效用函数。此外，对使用错误效用函数的受访者进行统计校正后，QALY权重的范围也会发生变化。因此，我们的研究结果表明，既不能假设受访者使用了理论上要求的相乘效用函数，也不能假设受访者使用的效用函数类型不会影响估计出的QALY权重。作为解决方案，我们建议研究人员使用一种更为受限的DCE elicitation格式，以避免这些行为问题。

abstract.text: Using an exogenous measure of natural disasters based on physical intensities, I examine their impact on child mortality. I find that children, mostly, in poor countries are affected - a one standard deviation increase in the natural disaster index leads to an additional 6.77 deaths per 1000 live births in the disaster year. The impact is long lasting, extending beyond the disaster year. I provide suggestive evidence of the potential mechanisms driving these effects, namely, lower GDP and vaccination rates among children, along with an increased maternal mortality and disease incidence in low-income countries due to disasters. Using an endogenous measure of disasters based on damage records from insurance data leads to severe underestimation of the disaster impact. The results are robust to the use of mortality rates from multiple sources, different functional forms, and an extensive dynamic panel specification as well as various other tests.

10.1002/hec.4458.abstractZh: 我采用基于物理强度的外生自然灾害指标，来研究其对儿童死亡率的影响。研究发现，贫困国家中的儿童是主要受影响群体——自然灾害指数每增加一个标准差，灾年每1000名活产婴儿中的死亡人数将增加6.77人。这种影响具有长期性，会延续到灾害发生之后。我提供了一些关于这些影响的潜在机制的线索，比如低收入国家中较低的GDP和儿童疫苗接种率，以及由于自然灾害导致的孕产妇死亡率和疾病发病率上升。而采用基于保险数据中的损失记录的内生自然灾害指标，则会导致对灾害影响的严重低估。这些结果在采用来自多个来源的死亡率数据、不同的函数形式、广泛的动态面板模型以及各种其他检验方法时依然保持稳定。

abstract.text: Advances in medical technology have led to a better understanding of heterogeneity of diseases and patients, and to the development of targeted medicines. This development is beneficial to society but can come at an increased cost to pharmaceutical manufacturers due to the costs associated with developing and manufacturing a diagnostic test. For such medicines, the conventional pricing structure, where a therapy is approved if it is deemed cost-effective, may not appropriately incentivize targeted drug development. We model the decision-making processes for both the healthcare provider and the pharmaceutical manufacturer, capturing their main priorities, and populate it with information from a recent appraisal by the National Institute of Health and Care Excellence. Healthcare providers prefer a stratified drug to be developed for a subgroup of the population when the drug is on average effective in the subgroup but with a detrimental effect in the complement. Whilst pharmaceutical manufacturers' preferences are similar, regions of disagreement exist. We show how preferences can be aligned by either penalizing the development of a non-stratified drug or rewarding the development of a stratified drug. The cost and position of alignment depends on the true value of health to the healthcare provider, among other parameters.

10.1002/hec.4459.abstractZh: 医学技术的进步使得人们能够更好地理解疾病的异质性和患者的差异，并推动了针对性药物的发展。这一进展对社会有益，但也会给制药公司带来更高的成本，因为开发和制造诊断测试需要投入大量资金。对于这类药物，传统的定价结构——即只有当某种疗法被认为具有成本效益时才予以批准——可能无法有效激励针对性药物的研发。我们模拟了医疗服务提供者和制药公司的决策过程，捕捉了他们的主要优先事项，并参考了美国国家卫生与护理卓越研究所的最新评估结果。医疗服务提供者更倾向于为特定人群开发分层药物，即使这种药物在目标人群中有效，但在其他人群中可能产生负面影响。而制药公司的偏好则较为一致，但仍然存在分歧。我们展示了如何通过惩罚非分层药物的研发或奖励分层药物的研发来协调这些偏好。协调的成本和效果取决于医疗服务提供者认为健康的真正价值等因素。

abstract.text: This paper provides new evidence on the link between patient outcome and physician experience. Using birth certificates data from a large hospital in Italy, I analyze whether cesarean section surgeons who have performed more procedures in the recent past observe an improvement in performance. By using data from the Italian health care system, where patients are not allowed to choose their physician, I lower concerns of potential reverse causality (selective referral). I find evidence indicating a strong learning-by-doing effect: for emergent cases, a one standard deviation increase in recent experience reduces the likelihood of neonatal intensive care unit admission by nearly 3.2 percentage points (13.8%) and of being born with a low Apgar Score by about 1.9 percentage points (13.2%), all else equal. This effect is not present for the case of elective C-sections.

10.1002/hec.4460.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于患者预后与医生经验之间联系的新证据。利用意大利一家大型医院的出生证明数据，我分析了近期进行较多剖宫产手术的医生是否表现出更好的表现。通过意大利医疗系统的数据，由于患者无法选择医生，我避免了潜在的逆向因果关系（选择性转诊）的担忧。我发现了一个显著的学习效应：对于紧急情况，近期经验增加一个标准差，可以将新生儿重症监护病房入院的可能性降低近3.2个百分点（13.8%），出生时的Apgar评分降低约1.9个百分点（13.2），在其他条件相同的情况下。然而，对于择期剖宫产手术，这种效应并不明显。

abstract.text: Two billion people globally lack access to a basic toilet. While improving sanitation reduces infectious disease, toilet users often identify privacy, safety and dignity as more important. However, these outcomes have not been incorporated in sanitation-related economic evaluations. This illustrates the general challenge of outcome measurement and valuation in the economic evaluation of public health interventions, and risks misallocating the US$ 20 billion invested in sanitation in low- and middle-income countries every year. In this study in urban Mozambique, we develop an instrument to measure sanitation-related quality of life (SanQoL). Applying methods from health economics and the capability approach, we develop a descriptive system to measure five attributes identified in prior qualitative research: disgust, health, shame, safety and privacy. Sampling individuals from the intervention and control groups of a sanitation intervention trial, we elicit attribute ranks to value a SanQoL index and assess its validity and reliability. In combination with a measure of time using a sanitation service, SanQoL can quantify incremental benefits in a sanitation-focused cost-effectiveness analysis. After monetary valuation based on willingness to pay, QoL benefits could be summed with health gains in cost-benefit analysis, the most common method in sanitation economic evaluations.

10.1002/hec.4462.abstractZh: 全球有20亿人无法获得基本的卫生设施。虽然改善卫生条件可以减少传染病，但使用卫生设施的人往往认为隐私、安全和尊严更为重要。然而，这些结果并未被纳入与卫生设施相关的经济评估中。这表明在公共卫生干预的经济评估中，对结果的测量和估值存在普遍挑战，这可能导致每年在低收入和中等收入国家投入的200亿美元被用于错误的领域。在这项针对莫桑比克城市的研究中，我们开发了一种用于衡量与卫生设施相关的生活质量的方法。运用健康经济学和能力论的方法，我们建立了一个描述性系统，用于衡量先前定性研究中确定的五个属性：厌恶、健康、羞耻、安全和隐私。通过对卫生设施干预试验中的干预组和对照组个体进行抽样，我们获取了这些属性的等级数据，以评估生活质量指数，并评估其有效性和可靠性。结合使用卫生设施服务的时间测量方法，生活质量指数可以在以卫生设施为重点的成本效益分析中量化增量效益。在基于支付意愿的货币估值之后，生活质量效益可以与健康收益一起在成本效益分析中加以汇总，这是卫生设施经济评估中最常用的方法。

abstract.text: We study whether vouchers without and with value information encourage attendance of already free follow-up appointments among low-income minority individuals referred for evaluation of possible eye disease. Between May 2017 and September 2018, 821 individuals referred from 114 screening events across Baltimore City were offered (1) standard referral for a free follow-up appointment and prescription glasses, (2) a paper voucher described as redeemable for free follow-up and prescription glasses, or (3) an otherwise identical paper voucher which also indicated the monetary value of the appointment ($250). Under all three conditions, all referred individuals received the same patient education, counseling, and appointment reminders. We find that vouchers without and with value information increase follow-up by 12.5 and 20.3 percentage points, respectively, corresponding to a 36% and 58% increase compared to the standard referral for free follow-up (i.e., without a voucher). We conclude that using vouchers is a promising, low-cost approach to increase uptake of already free health services, particularly when the vouchers also provide value information.

10.1002/hec.4463.abstractZh: 我们研究了是否带有价值信息的代金券能够鼓励低收入少数族裔个体参加原本免费的后续检查。在2017年5月至2018年9月期间，来自巴尔的摩市114次筛查活动的821名个体被提供以下三种选择：（1）标准的免费后续检查和配镜服务；（2）一种可兑换为免费后续检查和配镜服务的纸质代金券；（3）另一种同样形式的纸质代金券，同时注明了预约的货币价值（250美元）。在所有三种情况下，所有被推荐的个体都获得了相同的患者教育、咨询和预约提醒。我们发现，带有价值信息的代金券分别使后续检查的参与率增加了12.5个百分点和20.3个百分点，与仅提供免费后续检查的服务相比，分别增加了36%和58%。我们得出结论，使用代金券是一种有前景且低成本的提高原本免费健康服务利用率的方法，尤其是当代金券还提供价值信息时。

abstract.text: Using a new survey of Italian households, we study the effect of fear of COVID-19 contagion and income risk on consumption. The survey elicits individual-level indicators of fear of contagion, distinguishing between worries while working, shopping, traveling, eating out and meeting relatives or friends. We find that the probabilities of consumption drops and increased saving after the pandemics are positively associated to fear of contagion, particularly while shopping. Income uncertainty also contributes to savings increase and consumption drop. Our findings suggest that fear of contagion and income risk limits the effectiveness of policies aimed at stimulating consumption during the pandemic.

10.1002/hec.4464.abstractZh: 通过一项针对意大利家庭的调查，我们研究了COVID-19传染风险与收入风险对消费的影响。该调查收集了个人层面的传染恐惧指标，包括工作、购物、旅行、外出就餐以及与亲友会面时的担忧。我们发现，在疫情之后，消费下降和储蓄增加的概率与传染恐惧呈正相关，尤其是在购物时。收入的不确定性也促进了储蓄的增加和消费的下降。我们的研究结果表明，传染恐惧和收入风险限制了旨在在疫情期间刺激消费的政策的有效性。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the effect on mental health of consecutive terrorist attacks in France in 2015 and 2016. We compile information about the three main terrorist attacks that struck France over this period and assess whether the potential effect on mental health (i.e., depression) of a terrorist attack is smoothed once people consider terrorist attacks as "the new normality." We exploit data from the French Constances epidemiological survey and combine an event study strategy with a difference-in-difference approach to compare before-after changes in mental health the year of the attack with the same changes the year before. We show that the negative effect of a terrorist attack on mental health decreases over time from one attack to another, and disappears completely for the last attack. Socio-demographic composition of the sample, geographical or socio-demographic proximity to the victims or media exposure do not arise as factors responsible for this changing effect of terrorist attacks on mental health.

10.1002/hec.4465.abstractZh: 本文评估了2015年和2016年法国连续发生恐怖袭击对心理健康的影响。我们收集了在此期间发生的三次主要恐怖袭击的相关信息，并评估了当人们将恐怖袭击视为“新常态”时，恐怖袭击对心理健康（即抑郁）的潜在影响是否会逐渐减弱。我们利用了法国康斯坦斯流行病学调查的数据，并结合事件研究策略与差异-差异方法，比较了袭击发生当年与袭击前一年心理健康状况的变化。研究表明，恐怖袭击对心理健康的负面影响随着时间的推移而减弱，对于最后一次袭击来说，这种影响完全消失。样本的社会人口学特征、与受害者地理位置或社会人口学上的接近程度，以及媒体曝光等因素，并未成为导致恐怖袭击对心理健康影响发生变化的原因。

abstract.text: This paper explores how a diagnosis of hypertension might affect a person's health-related behaviors. The analysis uses a two-dimensional regression discontinuity design because hypertension is diagnosed when a person's systolic or diastolic blood pressure (SBP or DBP) surpasses a pre-established threshold. We find that those closely above the SBP threshold significantly adjusted their lifestyle, such as reducing daily fat intake and quitting smoking, while those just surpassing the DBP cutoff did not. Further mechanism analysis suggests that the possibility of constraints, rather than education and income gradients, does more to explain the disparate behaviors of subjects near the SBP and DBP thresholds. Those around the DBP threshold generally have tighter work schedules and undertake more competitive jobs, which hinder them from improving their lifestyle. Overall, our findings complement the existing literature by posing a new perspective for understanding people's potential reluctance to adjust their behavior.

10.1002/hec.4466.abstractZh: 本文探讨了高血压的诊断如何影响个人的健康相关行为。分析采用了二维回归不连续设计，因为高血压的诊断标准是当一个人的收缩压或舒张压超过预设的阈值时。我们发现，那些血压超过阈值的人会显著调整他们的生活方式，例如减少每日脂肪摄入量并戒烟，而仅超过舒张压阈值的个体则没有这样的调整。进一步的机制分析表明，约束因素而非教育和收入梯度更能解释血压和舒张压阈值附近个体行为的差异。接近舒张压阈值的人通常工作时间更紧凑，从事的工作竞争也更大，这阻碍了他们改善生活方式。总体而言，我们的研究结果通过提出一个新的视角，为理解人们可能不愿意调整行为的现象提供了补充。

abstract.text: 'Nudge'-based social norms messages conveying high population influenza vaccination coverage levels can encourage vaccination due to bandwagoning effects but also discourage vaccination due to free-riding effects on low risk of infection, making their impact on vaccination uptake ambiguous. We develop a theoretical framework to capture heterogeneity around vaccination behaviors, and empirically measure the causal effects of different messages about vaccination coverage rates on four self-reported and behavioral vaccination intention measures. In an online experiment, N = 1365 UK adults are randomly assigned to one of seven treatment groups with different messages about their social environment's coverage rate (varied between 10% and 95%), or a control group with no message. We find that treated groups have significantly greater vaccination intention than the control. Treatment effects increase with the coverage rate up to a 75% level, consistent with a bandwagoning effect. For coverage rates above 75%, the treatment effects, albeit still positive, stop increasing and remain flat (or even decline). Our results suggest that, at higher coverage rates, free-riding behavior may partially crowd out bandwagoning effects of coverage rate messages. We also find significant heterogeneity of these effects depending on the individual perceptions of risks of infection and of the coverage rates.

10.1002/hec.4467.abstractZh: 基于“助推”的社会规范信息，通过传达高的人群流感疫苗接种覆盖率水平，可以因“从众效应”而促进疫苗接种，但也会因低感染风险下的“搭便车效应”而抑制疫苗接种，因此其对疫苗接种接受度的影响具有不确定性。我们建立了一个理论框架来捕捉疫苗接种行为的异质性，并通过实证研究测量了不同关于疫苗接种覆盖率信息的因果效应，这些信息涉及四个自我报告的疫苗接种意愿指标。在一项在线实验中，1365名英国成年人被随机分配到七个不同的处理组，这些处理组分别传达了关于其社会环境中疫苗接种覆盖率的不同信息（范围从10%到95%），或者是一个没有信息的对照组。我们发现，接受处理的组比对照组有显著更高的疫苗接种意愿。处理效应随着覆盖率的增加而增强，直到达到75%的水平，这与“从众效应”一致。对于超过75%的覆盖率，处理效应虽然仍然积极，但不再增加，甚至趋于下降。我们的结果表明，在较高的覆盖率下，搭便车行为可能会部分抵消覆盖率信息带来的“从众效应”。我们还发现，这些效应的异质性取决于个体对感染风险和覆盖率感知的差异。

abstract.text: Using panel data from a survey conducted by the Research Center for Rural Economy, this study overcomes the selection bias associated with most health status measures by incorporating dialect proximity as an instrumental variable to evaluate the causal effects of interprovincial migration on individuals' health status in China. The results indicate that, compared to an absorbed category, which includes intraprovincial migration and non-migration, interprovincial migration worsens health (measured by the self-reported health status score) by 3%. It is also found that, compared to intraprovincial migrants, interprovincial migrants are more likely to report a lower SHS score, whereas the health effect differences between interprovincial migrants and non-migrants are insignificant. The study identifies two potential mechanisms that explain this result: (i) The increase in income following migration may improve interprovincial migrants' health, and (ii) the exposure to hazardous working environments worsens health to a significant extent. This finding is also linked to the following gender-related finding: Compared to women, men are more likely to be employed in heavy industries with hazardous working environments; the negative effects of interprovincial migration on the health status are stronger for men than for women migrants, suggesting that the industry effect dominates.

10.1002/hec.4468.abstractZh: 本研究利用农村经济研究中心进行的调查所采集的面板数据，通过引入方言距离作为工具变量，克服了大多数健康状况测量指标所存在的选择偏差，从而评估跨省迁移对中国个体健康状况的因果效应。研究结果表明，与包含省内迁移和非迁移的类别相比，跨省迁移会使健康状况恶化3%。此外，与省内迁移者相比，跨省迁移者更有可能报告较低的自我报告健康状况得分，而跨省迁移者与非迁移者之间的健康效应差异并不显著。研究提出了两种可能的机制来解释这一结果：(i) 迁移后收入的增加可能改善跨省迁移者的健康状况；(ii) 暴露于危险的工作环境会显著恶化健康状况。这一发现还与性别相关因素有关：与女性相比，男性更可能从事危险工作环境中的重工业；跨省迁移对男性健康状况的负面影响比女性迁移者更为显著，这表明行业因素起着主导作用。

abstract.text: We estimate the long-term effect of initiating smoking in adolescence on a range of health outcomes later in life. We use the second wave (1996) and the fifth wave (2016-2018) of the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent to Adult Health (Add Health) and estimate instrumental variables models with school-level fixed effects, where the instruments are the average rate of smoking among friends and the respondents' perceptions about their friends' smoking. We find that smoking in adolescence has a negative impact on 15 of the 28 self-reported, diagnosed, and self-identified health outcomes approximately 20 years later.

10.1002/hec.4469.abstractZh: 我们估计了在青少年时期开始吸烟对日后一系列健康结果的长期影响。我们使用了《青少年到成人健康全国纵向研究》的第二轮调查（1996年）和第五轮调查（2016-2018年），并建立了包含学校层面固定效应的工具变量模型。其中，工具变量包括朋友的平均吸烟率以及受访者对自己朋友吸烟行为的看法。研究发现，青少年时期的吸烟行为在大约20年后，对28种自我报告、诊断和自我认定的健康结果中的15种产生了负面影响。

abstract.text: The Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) and the National School Lunch Program (NSLP) are designed to increase food security and reduce hunger for children from low-income households. Since the cutoff age for WIC is five, and school enrollment is required for receiving free or reduced-price NSLP, some children from low-income households cannot receive both WIC and free or reduced-price NSLP. Using data from the Current Population Survey, the partial identification method developed in this paper addresses the problems of self-selection into WIC and systematic underreporting of program participation. Due to this loophole in food assistance programs for children, aging out of WIC is found to increase child food insecurity by at least 1.1 percentage points. This result indicates that the prevalence of child food insecurity would decline by 15% if WIC extended its cutoff age until children enroll in kindergarten.

10.1002/hec.4470.abstractZh: 妇女、婴儿和儿童特别补充营养计划（WIC）和国家学校午餐计划（NSLP）旨在提高低收入家庭儿童的食品安全状况并减少饥饿问题。由于WIC的截止年龄为五岁，而参加NSLP需要入学，因此一些低收入家庭的儿童无法同时享受WIC和免费或减价NSLP的福利。本文利用当前人口调查的数据，采用部分识别方法解决了WIC中的自我选择问题和项目参与情况的系统性漏报问题。由于儿童食品援助计划存在这一漏洞，退出WIC会导致儿童食品不安全状况增加至少1.1个百分点。结果表明，如果WIC的截止年龄延长至儿童进入幼儿园时，儿童食品不安全问题的发生率将下降15%。

abstract.text: Biologics accounted for roughly $145 billion in spending in 2018. They are also the fastest growing segment of the pharmaceutical industry. The Biological Price Competition and Innovation Act (BPCIA) of 2010 created an abbreviated pathway for biosimilar products to promote price competition in the market for biological drugs. There was great anticipation that the BPCIA would lead to a moderation in drug prices driven by market competition. The observed levels of competition and the accompanying savings have not reached those expected levels. We investigate the early impacts of biosimilar competition on the use and pricing of biological products. We focus especially on the ways in which altered market structures stemming from the implementation of the BPCIA have affected the prices for biological products subject to biosimilar competition. We do so by studying seven products that have recently faced biosimilar competition. We estimate fixed effects and Instrumental Variables models to estimate the impact of market competition on prices. Our results indicate that in the range of one to three entrants each additional marketed product results in a reduction in weighted average market prices of between 5.4% and 7% points. These are the result of a combination of reductions in originator prices and shifting in demand to biosimilar products.

10.1002/hec.4471.abstractZh: 2018年，生物制剂的支出约为1450亿美元。它们也是制药行业增长最快的领域。2010年颁布的《生物价格竞争与创新法案》为生物仿制药设立了一条简化的路径，以促进生物药品市场的价格竞争。人们普遍预期，该法案将通过市场竞争降低药品价格。然而，实际观察到的竞争程度以及随之而来的成本节约并未达到预期水平。我们研究了生物仿制药竞争对生物产品使用和定价的影响。我们特别关注由于《生物价格竞争与创新法案》的实施而带来的市场结构变化，这些变化对受生物仿制药竞争影响的生物产品价格的影响。我们通过研究七种最近面临生物仿制药竞争的产品来研究这一问题。我们采用固定效应和工具变量模型来估计市场竞争对价格的影响。研究结果表明，每增加一个上市产品，加权平均市场价格就会下降5.4%至7%不等。这一变化是由于原研产品价格的降低以及需求转向生物仿制药所导致的。

abstract.text: We study the financial protection provided by health insurance through two natural experiments-the Affordable Care Act's under 26 provision and Medicare eligibility. In both cases, the coverage expansion sharply reduces medical debt in collections for consumers within the affected ages but does not systematically improve credit outcomes not directly related to medical care. This is consistent with the infrequent repayment rate and lack of persistence on credit reports that we document for medical collections, which mute a key channel through which reductions in medical collections could directly affect the other financial outcomes studied here. These results help clarify the role of health insurance in broader financial health and suggest that, at least among the populations studied here, medical debts in collection may often be a symptom rather than a cause of wider financial distress as measured on credit reports.

10.1002/hec.4472.abstractZh: 我们通过两个自然实验来研究健康保险所提供的财务保护——《平价医疗法案》中针对26岁以下人群的条款以及医疗保险资格要求。在这两个案例中，保险覆盖范围的扩大显著减少了受影响年龄段消费者的医疗债务，但并未系统性地改善与医疗护理无直接关系的信用状况。这与我们记录的医疗债务催收过程中罕见的还款频率和信用报告中的持续性不足现象一致，这些现象使得医疗债务减少可能直接影响其他财务状况的渠道变得不那么明显。这些结果有助于阐明健康保险在更广泛的财务健康中的作用，并表明，至少在本研究中的人群中，医疗债务催收往往是一种症状，而非导致信用报告中所测量的更广泛财务困境的原因。

abstract.text: This study evaluates the impact of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) preexisting conditions provision on mental health. The 2014 policy ensured individuals with preexisting health conditions the right to obtain insurance coverage. Using longitudinal data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics between 2007 and 2017 and estimating difference-in-differences models, our study provides evidence that the policy reduced severe mental distress by 1.44 percentage points (baseline mean: 8.09%) among individuals with preexisting physical health conditions. Exploiting pre-ACA, state-level variation in policies providing insurance coverage options to people with preexisting conditions, we find that this improvement in mental well-being is highly associated with the presence of high-risk pools before 2014, which provided individuals with prior health conditions access to coverage. Specifically, we show that our main results are driven by individuals with preexisting health conditions living in the 16 states that did not have high-risk pools. Furthermore, gender-specific analysis shows that the reduction in mental distress is primarily observable among women. When examining potential mechanisms, our analysis provides evidence that increases in insurance coverage, reductions in healthcare expenditures, and improvements in physical health can explain the positive effects of the provision on mental well-being.

10.1002/hec.4473.abstractZh: 本研究评估了《平价医疗法案》中关于既往疾病条款对心理健康的影响。2014年的政策确保了有既往健康状况的人有权获得保险覆盖。通过利用2007至2017年间的“收入动态面板研究”纵向数据，并采用差异差异模型进行估计，我们的研究证明，该政策使有既往身体健康状况的人的严重心理健康问题减少了1.44个百分点（基线平均值：8.09%）。通过分析《平价医疗法案》实施前的各州在为既往疾病患者提供保险覆盖方面的政策差异，我们发现这种心理健康状况的改善与2014年前存在高风险保险池密切相关，这些保险池为有既往健康状况的人提供了保险覆盖。具体而言，我们的主要研究结果表明，这种改善主要出现在那些没有高风险保险池的16个州。此外，性别特定的分析显示，这种心理健康问题的减少主要出现在女性中。在探讨潜在机制时，我们的分析表明，保险覆盖的增加、医疗支出的减少以及身体健康的改善可以解释该政策对心理健康产生的积极影响。

abstract.text: Air pollution has been shown to have adverse effects on many health outcomes including respiratory effects, cardiovascular effects, and mortality. However, evidence on the effects of prenatal exposure is still limited. We investigate the causal impact of prenatal exposure to air pollution on neonatal health in Italy in the 2000s. We exploit variation in rainfall shocks to instrument for non-random air pollution exposure. Our empirical setting combines detailed information on mother's residential location from birth certificates with PM 10 concentrations from air pollution monitors. Ten additional units in the average PM 10 level (approximately one standard deviation) would decrease birth weight by about 0.5% and gestational age by 0.16%; it would increase the prevalence of low birth weight by 22% and of preterm birth by 16%. The effects are stronger in magnitude for third trimester exposure and for less educated mothers. These findings suggest that the health impacts of air pollution on newborns are unequally distributed in the population.

10.1002/hec.4474.abstractZh: 空气污染已被证明会对许多健康结果产生不利影响，包括呼吸系统、心血管系统以及死亡率。然而，关于产前暴露于空气污染的影响的证据仍然有限。本研究探讨了20世纪00年代在意大利，产前暴露于空气污染对新生儿健康的因果影响。我们通过利用降雨变化的差异来作为非随机空气污染暴露的工具变量。我们的实证分析结合了出生证明中母亲居住位置的详细信息以及空气污染监测站提供的PM10浓度数据。在平均PM10浓度水平（大约一个标准差范围内），每增加一个额外的单位，出生体重将减少约0.5%，妊娠年龄将减少0.16%；同时，低出生体重和早产的患病率将分别增加22%和16%。对于第三孕期暴露以及受教育程度较低的母亲来说，这些影响更为显著。这些发现表明，空气污染对新生儿的健康影响在人群中分布并不均匀。

abstract.text: When measuring preferences, discrete choice experiments (DCEs) typically assume that respondents consider all available information before making decisions. However, many respondents often only consider a subset of the choice characteristics, a heuristic called attribute non-attendance (ANA). Failure to account for ANA can bias DCE results, potentially leading to flawed policy recommendations. While conventional latent class logit models have most commonly been used to assess ANA in choices, these models are often not flexible enough to separate non-attendance from respondents' low valuation of certain attributes, resulting in inflated rates of ANA. In this paper, we show that semi-parametric mixtures of latent class models can be used to disentangle successfully inferred non-attendance from respondent's "weaker" taste sensitivities for certain attributes. In a DCE on the job preferences of health workers in Ethiopia, we demonstrate that such models provide more reliable estimates of inferred non-attendance than the alternative methods currently used. Moreover, since we find statistically significant variation in the rates of ANA exhibited by different health worker cadres, we highlight the need for well-defined attributes in a DCE, to ensure that ANA does not result from a weak experimental design.

10.1002/hec.4475.abstractZh: 在衡量偏好时，离散选择实验通常假设受访者在做出决策之前会考虑所有可用的信息。然而，许多受访者往往只考虑部分选择特征，这种现象被称为属性非出席性（ANA）。未能考虑ANA可能会导致DCE结果出现偏差，进而可能导致错误的政策建议。虽然传统的潜在类逻辑模型常被用来评估选择中的ANA，但这些模型往往不够灵活，无法将非出席性与受访者对某些属性的低评价区分开来，从而导致ANA的率被高估。在本文中，我们展示了半参数混合潜在类模型可以用来成功区分非出席性与受访者对某些属性的“较弱”偏好敏感性。在一项关于埃塞俄比亚卫生工作者工作偏好的离散选择实验中，我们证明这种模型能够比目前使用的其他方法提供更可靠的ANA估计。此外，由于我们发现不同卫生工作者群体在ANA率上存在统计学上的显著差异，因此强调在DCE中需要定义明确的属性，以确保ANA并非由于实验设计不足而产生。

abstract.text: Identifying individuals most at risk of HIV infection is a priority for policymakers. Apart from specific groups, however, little is known about how to identify those at high risk in the population. Research suggests that attitudes toward risk and time preferences may influence risky sexual behavior, but no studies have so far investigated the interplay between risk attitudes, time preference, and HIV infection. We collect data on risk and time preferences using hypothetical games (multiple price list method) at baseline and data on HIV status at baseline (2010) and endline (2012) allowing us to calculate incidence rate over a 2-year period among 675 participants, males and females 18-32 years old in Lesotho. We find robust evidence of a statistically significant positive associations between HIV incidence and prevalence and risk-loving attitudes, while the associations with risky behaviors and time preferences are not statistically significant. A measure of attitude toward risk, relatively easy to administer to individuals in a survey, is thus associated with future HIV status. This is an important finding for policymakers and suggests the importance of targeting HIV prevention programs to risk-loving individuals and therefore improving program efficiency.

10.1002/hec.4476.abstractZh: 识别最易感染HIV的个体是政策制定者的优先事项。然而，除了特定群体之外，关于如何识别人群中的高风险个体，目前所知甚少。研究表明，对风险的态度和时间偏好可能会影响性风险行为，但迄今为止，尚未有研究探讨风险态度、时间偏好与HIV感染之间的相互作用。我们通过假设性博弈（多重价格列表法）收集了风险和时间偏好的数据，并获取了基线时的HIV状况数据（2010年）和最终数据（2012年），从而能够计算莱索托18-32岁男女参与者在两年内的发病率。我们发现，HIV发病率和患病率与风险偏好态度之间存在统计学上的显著正相关关系，而与风险行为和时间偏好相关的关联则并不显著。因此，一种相对容易在调查中测量风险态度的指标，与未来的HIV状况有关。这一发现对政策制定者来说非常重要，表明将HIV预防计划针对风险偏好个体的重要性，从而提升项目的效率。

abstract.text: Health insurance markets with community-rated premiums typically include risk adjustment (RA) to mitigate selection problems. Over the past decades, RA systems have evolved from simple demographic models to sophisticated morbidity-based models. Even the most sophisticated models, however, tend to overcompensate people with persistently low spending and undercompensate those with persistently high spending. This paper compares three methods that exploit spending-level persistence for improving health plan payment systems: (1) implementation of spending-based risk adjustors, (2) implementation of high-risk pooling for people with multiple-year high spending, and (3) indirect use of spending persistence via constrained regression. Based on incentive measures for risk selection and cost control, we conclude that a combination of the last two options can substantially outperform the first, which is currently used in the health plan payment system in the Netherlands.

10.1002/hec.4477.abstractZh: 社区评级保费的健康保险市场通常包含风险调整机制，以缓解选择问题。过去几十年中，风险调整系统已经从简单的人口统计模型发展到基于发病率的复杂模型。然而，即使是最复杂的模型，也往往会对支出持续较低的人群过度补偿，而对支出持续较高的人群则补偿不足。本文比较了三种利用支出持续性来改进健康计划支付系统的方法：(1) 实施基于支出的风险调整器；(2) 对支出持续较高的人群实施高风险池化；(3) 通过受限回归间接利用支出持续性。基于风险选择和成本控制的激励措施，我们得出结论：结合后两种方法的组合可以显著优于目前荷兰健康计划支付系统中使用的第一种方法。

abstract.text: Health economists have written extensively on the design and implementation of coverage with evidence development (CED) schemes and have proposed theoretical frameworks based on cost-effectiveness modeling and value of information analysis. CED may aid decision-makers when there is uncertainty about the (cost-)effectiveness of a new health technology at the time of reimbursement. Medical devices are potential candidates for CED schemes, as regulatory regimes do not usually require the same level of efficacy and safety data normally needed for pharmaceuticals. The purpose of this research is to assess whether the actual practice of CED for medical devices in Europe meets the theoretical principles proposed by health economists and whether theory and practice can be more closely aligned. Based on decision-makers' perceptions of the challenges associated with CED schemes, plus examples from the schemes themselves, we discuss a series of proposals for assessing the desirability of schemes, their design, implementation, and evaluation. These proposals, while reflecting the practical challenges with developing CED programs, embody many of the principles suggested by economists and should support decision-makers in dealing with uncertainty about the real-world performance of devices.

10.1002/hec.4478.abstractZh: 健康经济学家在设计和实施基于证据的发展覆盖计划（CED）方面进行了大量研究，并提出了基于成本效益建模和信息价值分析的理论框架。在报销时，如果对新健康技术的（成本）有效性存在不确定性，CED可以为决策者提供帮助。医疗器械是CED计划的潜在候选对象，因为监管机制通常不需要像药品那样具备同样级别的有效性和安全性数据。本研究的目的是评估欧洲医疗器械的CED实际实施情况是否符合健康经济学家提出的理论原则，以及理论与实践能否更加紧密地结合。基于决策者对于CED计划相关挑战的看法，并结合这些计划本身的实例，我们提出了一系列评估计划的可取性、设计、实施和评估方法的建议。这些建议虽然反映了开发CED计划中的实际挑战，但体现了经济学家所提出的许多原则，并应有助于决策者应对设备实际性能的不确定性。

abstract.text: Diagnosis Related Group (DRG) payment systems are a common means of paying for hospital services. They reward greater activity and therefore potentially encourage more rapid treatment. This paper uses 15 years of administrative data to examine the impact of a DRG system introduced in England on hospital lengths of stay. We utilize different econometric models, exploiting within and cross jurisdiction variation, to identify policy effects, finding that the reduction of lengths of stay was greater than previously estimated and grew over time. This constitutes new and important evidence of the ability of financing reform to generate substantial and persistent change in healthcare delivery.

10.1002/hec.4479.abstractZh: 诊断相关分组（DRG）支付系统是一种常见的医院服务支付方式。它们通过奖励更高的服务效率来激励医护人员更快进行治疗。本文利用15年的行政数据，研究了英格兰引入DRG系统对医院住院时间的影响。我们采用了不同的计量经济模型，利用不同地区和司法管辖区的数据差异，来识别政策效应。研究发现，住院时间的减少幅度比先前估计的要大，并且这一趋势随着时间的推移而持续。这构成了关于融资改革能够带来显著且持久的医疗服务变革的重要证据。

abstract.text: This paper extends earlier on socioeconomic inequality in mental health, measured by the General Health Questionnaire, to include the second national lockdown up to March 2021.

10.1002/hec.4480.abstractZh: 本文扩展了之前关于心理健康领域社会经济不平等的研究，该研究以一般健康问卷为衡量标准。现在的研究范围扩展到了2021年3月前的第二次全国封锁期间。

abstract.text: Cross-border medical care, defined as care facilitated by a local health provider under pre-established regional agreements, as in the case of European Union (EU) citizens accessing care within EU countries, has been on the rise. Unlike medical tourism, typically sought by patients through their own volition and paid for out-of-pocket, cross-border medical care is often reimbursable or paid for directly by the responsible government. Yet, because nations vary in the extent of health coverage offered to their residents, these expenditures are often only partially reimbursed. The resulting financial burden for some countries can be large and not reciprocal, straining regional and country-level finances. We analyze the effectiveness of a legislative measure adopted by a Spanish region in January 2012 with the purpose of curbing cross-border medical care. Using a comprehensive administrative dataset of all medical procedures performed in the country between 2008 and 2015, we find that the measure led to a drastic drop in the number of foreigners' hospitalizations and a reduction of 4.8 million euros/trimester in costs. Finally, the decrease in hospitalizations did not disproportionally affect patients based on their gender, age, or origin, although it fostered a reduction in readmissions.

10.1002/hec.4481.abstractZh: 跨境医疗护理，指的是由当地医疗服务提供者根据预先建立的区域协议提供的医疗服务，例如欧盟公民在欧盟国家内获得的医疗服务，其需求正在增加。与通常由患者自愿寻求并自付费用的医疗旅游不同，跨境医疗护理往往可以由相关政府直接报销或支付。然而，由于各国对其居民提供的健康保险覆盖程度不同，这些支出往往只能得到部分报销。这对一些国家的财政负担可能相当沉重，且这种报销制度并不具有互惠性，从而给区域和国家层面的财政带来了压力。我们分析了西班牙一个地区在2012年1月采取的一项立法措施的有效性，该措施旨在限制跨境医疗护理。通过利用2008年至2015年间该国所有医疗程序的全面行政数据集，我们发现该措施导致外国人在该地区的住院人数大幅下降，每三个月的医疗费用减少了480万欧元。最后，住院人数的减少并没有对基于性别、年龄或出身的患者造成不成比例的负面影响，尽管它确实减少了再次住院的情况。

abstract.text: Resource-constrained delivery systems often have access issues, causing patients to wait a long time to see a provider. We develop theoretical and empirical models of wait times and apply them to primary care delivery by the U.S. Veterans Health Administration (VHA). Using instrumental variables to handle simultaneity issues, we estimate the effect of clinician supply on new patient wait times. We find that it has a sizable impact. A 10% increase in capacity reduces wait times by 2.1%. Wait times are also associated with clinician productivity, scheduling protocols, and patient access to alternative sources of care. The VHA has adopted our models to identify underserved areas as specified by the MISSION Act of 2018.

10.1002/hec.4482.abstractZh: 资源有限的医疗服务系统常常存在就医等待问题，导致患者需要长时间等待才能见到医生。我们开发了关于等待时间的理论和实证模型，并将其应用于美国退伍军人健康管理局（VHA）的初级医疗服务。通过使用工具变量来处理同时性问题，我们评估了医生供应对新患者等待时间的影响。研究发现，医生供应增加10%可以缩短2.1%的等待时间。等待时间还与医生的工作效率、排班安排以及患者能否获得其他医疗服务有关。VHA已经采用我们的模型来识别根据2018年《使命法案》确定的服务不足区域。

abstract.text: This study provides evidence of health and insurance coverage disparities between the cisgender and transgender US populations using repeated cross sections from the 2014-2020 Behavioral Risk Factors Surveillance Systems. The analysis tests whether increasing the incidence of insurance coverage among transgender people could alleviate the health disparity. The empirical approach uses a fuzzy regression discontinuity design that leverages breaks in government health assistance eligibility by age. Results indicate that, for transgender recipients only, insurance coverage meaningfully improves mental health; for cisgender recipients only, insurance coverage reduces difficulties with concentration and memory; and for both the transgender and cisgender populations, insurance coverage contributes to important improvements in physical health, overall health, and healthcare access.

10.1002/hec.4483.abstractZh: 本研究利用2014-2020年行为风险因素监测系统的重复横截面数据，提供了关于美国顺性别人群与跨性别人群在健康与保险覆盖方面的差异的证据。分析旨在探讨提高跨性别人群保险覆盖率是否有助于缓解健康方面的差异。研究采用了模糊回归不连续设计，该设计通过年龄因素来划分政府健康援助资格的变化。结果表明，对于跨性别人群而言，保险覆盖率的提高显著改善了心理健康；对于顺性别人群而言，保险覆盖率降低了注意力集中和记忆方面的困难；而对于跨性别和顺性别人群来说，保险覆盖率都促进了身体健康、整体健康状况以及医疗服务的获取方面的显著改善。

abstract.text: A key policy question is whether continued expansion of university education is beneficial for the marginally eligible student. In this paper we exploit an arbitrary university eligibility rule combined with regression discontinuity design to estimate the causal effect of university attendance on healthcare utilization amongst young adults in Sweden. We find that the eligibility rule leads to a clear jump in university attendance of between 10% and 14% points for both males and females. 2SLS estimates find that a 10% point increase in university attendance causes a roughly one percentage point increase in hospital admissions due to mental ill health for males, almost exclusively related to alcohol and narcotics. Our findings for females, however, imply the opposite, suggesting that university attendance decreases hospital admissions related to mental health. The results for males sit in contrast to results from previous studies, and suggest that the effect of university education on health for the male student at the margin of eligibility is different to that of the average student.

10.1002/hec.4484.abstractZh: 一个重要的政策问题是，持续扩大大学教育是否对边缘符合条件的学生有益。在本文中，我们采用任意的大学资格规则，并结合回归不连续设计，来估计大学入学对瑞典年轻人群体医疗利用的因果效应。我们发现，该资格规则导致男性和女性的大学入学率分别上升了10%至14个百分点。2SLS估计结果显示，大学入学率增加10个百分点，会导致男性因精神健康问题而住院的比例增加约1个百分点，而这一情况几乎完全与酒精和毒品有关。然而，对于女性而言，我们的研究结果却表明大学入学减少了与心理健康相关的住院情况。男性群体的结果与以往研究的结果相反，这表明对于处于资格边缘的男性学生来说，大学教育对健康的效应与普通学生不同。

abstract.text: Inefficient practices and lack of competition are common problems in public procurements. In this study, I examine the effects of a procurement practice reform in the Finnish rehabilitation markets where providers are acquired in a repeated manner through competitive bidding scoring auctions. Until recently, the largest public procurer did not use any systematic criteria for accepting providers, and only a few providers did not receive a contract. After the reform, providers were systematically accepted based on their capacity and the local demand. I analyze the effects of the reform on prices in physio, speech and occupational therapy services with data that covers five subsequent procurements. I use the pre-reform differences in local competition within the markets in a difference-in-differences setting. The descriptive evidence shows that the reform slowed down the rapid increase of prices in all three services. The regression analysis indicates that effects are strongest in the most competitive local physiotherapy markets. This suggests that increasing entry and competition in the less competitive services and local markets would benefit the public procurer.

10.1002/hec.4485.abstractZh: 低效的采购实践和缺乏竞争是公共采购中常见的问题。本研究探讨了芬兰康复市场中的一种采购实践改革效果，该市场中的供应商通过竞争性招标评分拍卖方式被反复采购。直到最近，最大的公共采购机构并未使用任何系统性的标准来选择供应商，只有少数供应商未能获得合同。改革后，供应商的入选基于其能力和当地需求，实现了系统的选择。本研究利用涵盖五次采购的数据，分析了该改革对物理疗法、言语治疗和职业治疗服务价格的影响。通过差异-差异模型，分析了改革前各市场内的竞争状况。描述性证据表明，改革减缓了所有三种服务价格的快速上涨。回归分析显示，改革效果在竞争最激烈的物理治疗市场中最为显著。这表明，在竞争较弱的服务和本地市场中增加进入和竞争，将有利于公共采购机构。

abstract.text: Information on attitudes to risk could increase understanding of and explain risky health behaviors. We investigate two approaches to eliciting risk preferences in the health domain, a novel "indirect" lottery elicitation approach with health states as outcomes and a "direct" approach where respondents are asked directly about their willingness to take risks. We compare the ability of the two approaches to predict health-related risky behaviors in a general adult population. We also investigate a potential framing effect in the indirect lottery elicitation approach. We find that risk preferences elicited using the direct approach can better predict health-related risky behavior than those elicited using the indirect approach. Moreover, a seemingly innocuous change to the framing of the lottery question results in significantly different risk preference estimates, and conflicting conclusions about the ability of the indicators to predict risky health behaviors.

10.1002/hec.4486.abstractZh: 关于风险态度的信息可以提高对风险性健康行为的理解并解释这些行为。我们研究了在健康领域获取风险偏好的两种方法：一种新颖的“间接”抽奖方法，以健康状态作为结果；另一种“直接”方法，直接询问受访者愿意承担风险的程度。我们比较了这两种方法预测一般成人人群中与健康相关的风险行为的能力。我们还研究了间接抽奖方法中的潜在框架效应。研究发现，使用直接方法获取的风险偏好比使用间接方法更能准确预测与健康相关的风险行为。此外，对抽奖问题框架的看似微不足道的改变会导致风险偏好估计出现显著差异，并且关于这些指标预测风险性健康行为能力的结论也相互矛盾。

abstract.text: EQ-5D is a 5-item questionnaire instrument designed to measure health-related quality of life. It is extremely important, since it is used to measure health benefits in many studies providing evidence for reimbursement decisions by the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence in England and similar policy bodies in other countries. EQ-5D has been redesigned in a more detailed form (EQ-5D-5L), but much existing cost-effectiveness evidence is based on the older version (EQ-5D-3L). Statistical mapping from one version to another is widely used, exploiting data from multi-instrument surveys incorporating both variants. However, little is known about the robustness of data from such multi-instrument surveys. We design a randomized experiment to investigate whether inclusion of both versions at different stages in a single interview gives a reliable picture of the relationship between health measures from the two instruments and embed it in individual interviews from the UK Understanding Society household panel. We find that sequencing of the two versions of EQ-5D within an interview has a significant impact not only on the resulting data but also on the estimated mapping models. We illustrate the non-negligible effects in two real-world cost-effectiveness examples and discuss the implications for future multi-instrument survey design.

10.1002/hec.4487.abstractZh: EQ-5D是一种包含5个项目的问卷工具，用于衡量与健康相关的生活质量。该工具非常重要，因为它被广泛应用于许多研究中，用于评估健康效益，为英格兰国家健康与护理卓越研究所以及其他国家的类似政策机构做出报销决策提供证据支持。EQ-5D已经重新设计成更详细的形式（EQ-5D-5L），但许多现有的成本效益研究仍然基于旧版本（EQ-5D-3L）。从一种版本到另一种版本的统计映射被广泛使用，通过结合多种调查工具的数据来实现。然而，关于这种多工具调查数据的稳健性，目前了解甚少。我们设计了一项随机实验，以研究在单次访谈中同时包含两种版本的EQ-5D是否能更可靠地反映两种工具所测量的健康指标之间的关系，并将其纳入英国Understanding Society家庭面板中的个体访谈中。研究发现，在单次访谈中按顺序使用两种版本的EQ-5D不仅对最终数据有显著影响，还对估计的映射模型产生影响。我们通过两个实际成本效益案例说明了这种非微不足道的影响，并讨论了这对未来多工具调查设计的意义。

abstract.text: In this paper, we examine how pension eligibility affects the psychological distress levels of older women in Australia by exploiting the exogenous changes in the eligibility ages of the old Age Pension (AP). The unique features of the Australian AP allow us to study the impact of the reform on the non-working, as well as on the working population. The empirical results show that pension eligibility has a modest but consistently beneficial effect on psychological stress levels. Reaching pension eligibility significantly reduces the stress levels of women who were out of the labor force, indicating the positive role of the AP for disadvantaged groups. At the same time, women with strenuous jobs experience a significant improvement in their stress levels when they transit into retirement.
