We show that an improvement in stress levels accompanies an increase in financial security and improvements in social participation and health behaviors. Our results highlight the potentially overlooked consequences of pension reforms for the well-being of vulnerable populations and for health inequalities across socio-economic groups.

10.1002/hec.4488.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们通过分析澳大利亚老年养老金资格年龄的变化，探讨养老金资格对澳大利亚老年女性心理困扰程度的影响。澳大利亚老年养老金制度的独特特征使我们能够研究该改革对非就业人群以及就业人群的影响。实证结果表明，获得养老金资格对女性的心理压力水平有适度但持续积极的影响。对于已经脱离劳动力市场的女性来说，达到养老金资格显著降低了她们的压力水平，这表明老年养老金制度对弱势群体的积极作用。同时，从事高强度工作的女性在退休后压力水平也有显著改善。我们的研究还发现，压力水平的改善伴随着经济安全感的提升，以及社会参与度和健康行为的改善。这些结果凸显了养老金改革对弱势群体的福祉以及社会经济群体间健康不平等问题的潜在影响，这些影响往往被忽视。

abstract.text: The assumption of patient-regarding physicians has been widely adopted in the health economics literature. Physicians' patient-regarding preferences are often described as the concern for the health benefits of medical treatments, and thus closely related to the norms and ethics of the medical profession. In this paper, we ask whether physicians' patient-regarding preferences include a concern for their patient's consumption opportunities alongside patient's health benefits. To identify and quantify physicians' preferences, we design and conduct an incentivized laboratory experiment where choices determine separately the health benefits and the consumption opportunities of a real patient admitted to the nearest hospital. We find strong evidence that future physicians care about their patients' consumption opportunities.

10.1002/hec.4489.abstractZh: 在健康经济学文献中，以患者为中心的医生假设已被广泛采纳。医生的以患者为中心的偏好通常被描述为对医疗治疗健康益处的关注，因此与医学职业的规范和伦理密切相关。在本文中，我们探讨了医生的以患者为中心的偏好是否包括对患者消费机会的关注。为了识别和量化医生的偏好，我们设计并实施了一项激励性实验室实验，该实验分别决定了被送往最近医院的真实患者的健康益处和消费机会。我们发现，未来的医生确实关心患者的消费机会。

abstract.text: There is a growing but mixed literature on the health effects of minimum wages. If minimum wage changes have a statistically significant impact on health, this suggests health effects should be incorporated into cost-benefit analyses to capture wider policy impacts. Whilst most existing UK based literature examines the introduction of a minimum wage, this paper exploits the 2016, 2017 and 2018 UK National Minimum Wage (NMW) increases as natural experiments using a series of difference-in-differences models. Short Form-12 (SF-12) mental and physical component summary scores are used as dependent variables. In the base case and all sensitivity analyses, the estimated impact of NMW increases on mental and physical health are insignificant. The policy implication is that health effects should not be included in cost-benefit analyses examining the NMW.

10.1002/hec.4490.abstractZh: 关于最低工资对健康影响的文献越来越多，但研究结果并不一致。如果最低工资的变化对健康有显著的统计影响，那么应该将健康影响纳入成本效益分析中，以全面评估政策的影响。虽然大多数现有的英国相关文献研究的是最低工资制度的引入，但本文利用2016年、2017年和2018年英国国家最低工资上调的实际情况，通过一系列差异-差异模型进行分析。研究以短式12项健康问卷（SF-12）的心理和生理综合得分作为因变量。在基准情景和所有敏感性分析中，发现国家最低工资上调对心理和生理健康的估计影响并不显著。因此，在评估最低工资政策的成本效益分析中，不应包含健康影响的相关内容。

abstract.text: Even when heavily subsidized, a substantial portion of people choose to forgo purchasing health insurance coverage. In this note, I introduce an explanation for this phenomenon which does not assume choice errors, incorrect beliefs, differently priced uncompensated care, or information asymmetries. When individuals are incapable of freely trading off health and wealth and the initial allocation of goods is suboptimal from their perspective, the standard result of demand for actuarially fair insurance in a single good world does not generalize to the health insurance context. Thus, people might not purchase full health insurance coverage even if it is priced at actuarially fair levels. I argue that this situation is particularly likely to occur in the low-income population, and hence it is relevant for the achievement of universal health coverage.

10.1002/hec.4491.abstractZh: 即使得到了大量补贴，仍有相当一部分人选择不购买健康保险。在这篇论文中，我提出了一个解释这一现象的理论，该理论不假设选择错误、错误信念、不同价格的无补偿护理或信息不对称性。当个体无法自由地权衡健康与财富，且初始的商品分配对他们来说是不理想的时，单一商品世界中对精算公平保险的需求标准并不适用于健康保险领域。因此，即使健康保险的价格达到了精算公平的水平，人们也可能不会购买完整的健康保险。我认为这种情况在低收入人群中尤为常见，因此对于实现全民健康覆盖具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Variation in healthcare utilization has been discussed extensively, with many studies showing that variation exists, but fewer studies investigating the underlying factors. In our study, we used a logistic multilevel-model at the patient, hospital, and regional levels to investigate (i) the levels to which variation could be attributed and (ii) the hospital and regional factors associated with treatment decisions. To do so, we used hospital discharge records for the years 2012-2016 in Germany and Italy and for 2014-2016 in the Netherlands combined with hospital and regional characteristics in nine case studies. We used a theoretical framework to categorize these case studies into effective, preference-sensitive, and supply-sensitive care. Our results suggest that most variation in the treatment decision can be attributed to the hospital level (e.g., case volume), whereas only a minor part is explained by regional characteristics. Italy had the highest share attributable to the regional level, whereas the Netherlands had the lowest. We observed less variation for procedures in the effective-care category compared to the preference- and supply-sensitive categories. Although our results were heterogeneous, we identified patterns in line with the theoretical framework for treatment categories, underlining the need to address variation differently depending on the category in question.

10.1002/hec.4492.abstractZh: 关于医疗利用的变异已有大量研究，许多研究表明确实存在变异现象，但针对其根本原因的研究相对较少。在我们的研究中，我们采用了患者在、医院和地区层面的逻辑多层次模型，来探讨（i）变异可以归因于哪些层面，以及（ii）与治疗决策相关的医院和地区因素。为此，我们使用了2012-2016年德国和意大利的数据，以及2014-2016年荷兰的数据，并结合了九个案例研究中的医院和地区特征。我们运用理论框架将这些案例研究分为有效护理、偏好敏感护理和供应敏感护理三类。研究结果表明，治疗决策中的大部分变异可以归因于医院层面（例如，病例数量），而只有小部分可以通过地区特征来解释。意大利在地区层面的变异比例最高，而荷兰则最低。与偏好敏感和供应敏感护理类别相比，有效护理类别中的变异较小。尽管我们的研究结果存在差异，但我们发现了与理论框架相符的模式，这强调了需要根据不同类别采取不同的方法来处理变异问题。

abstract.text: We analyze the causal effect of involuntary retirement on detailed indicators of healthcare use and mortality. We leverage a pension reform in Hungary which forced public sector workers above the statutory retirement age to full time retirement. Using rich administrative data, we find that on the 3-year horizon, involuntary retirement decreases the number of primary care doctor visits, the use of systemic antiinfectives and respiratory drugs, and the non-zero spending on antiinfectives, the drugs of the alimentary tract and metabolism and of the cardiovascular system. The impact on the latter two drug categories is driven by the drop in income due to involuntary retirement. We conclude that there is little evidence for health deteriorating effects of involuntary retirement and discuss the possible mechanisms behind our results.

10.1002/hec.4493.abstractZh: 我们分析了非自愿退休对医疗使用及死亡率相关指标的因果效应。研究利用了匈牙利的一项养老金改革案例，该改革迫使公共部门的工作人员在法定退休年龄之后进行全职退休。通过丰富的行政数据，我们发现，在3年的时间范围内，非自愿退休减少了初级保健医生的就诊次数、系统性抗感染药物及呼吸系统药物的用药量，以及抗感染药物、消化道及代谢系统药物以及心血管系统药物的支出。后两类药物的减少主要是由于非自愿退休导致的收入下降所致。我们得出结论，非自愿退休对健康的负面影响证据有限，并探讨了研究结果背后的可能机制。

abstract.text: An issue that has not yet been explored in the religiosity-health literature is the macro-level effect of religiosity on health-the effect of the religiosity of a society on the absolute health of the population of that society as a whole. We address this issue using two panel datasets: The first is a time-series cross-sectional panel dataset for 17 countries from 1925 to 2000. The second is a cross-sectionally dominated panel dataset of up to 92 countries for the period 1981-2016. Our main findings are as follows: first, religiosity has a significant negative causal effect on health at the macro level; second, a substantial part of this effect can be attributed to an indirect effect via public health expenditures; and third, changes in population health do not cause significant changes in societal religiosity.

10.1002/hec.4494.abstractZh: 在宗教与健康关系的文献中，尚未深入探讨的一个问题是宗教性对健康的宏观层面的影响——即一个社会的宗教性对该社会整体人口健康状况的宏观影响。我们采用两个面板数据集来研究这一问题：第一个是涵盖1925年至2000年17个国家的时间序列横截面面板数据集；第二个是涵盖1981年至2016年最多92个国家的横截面主导型面板数据集。我们的主要发现如下：首先，宗教性在宏观层面上对健康有显著的负面因果效应；其次，这种效应的一部分可以通过公共卫生支出的间接效应来解释；第三，人口健康的变化并不会导致社会宗教性的显著变化。

abstract.text: Quantitative assessments of the relationship between health and medical treatment are of great importance to policy makers. To overcome endogeneity problems we formulate and estimate a tractable dynamic factor model where observed health outcomes are driven by the individual's latent health. The dynamics of latent health reflects both exogenous health deterioration and endogenous health investments. Our model allows us to investigate the effect of medical treatment on current health, as well as on future medical treatment and health outcomes. We estimate the model by maximum simulated likelihood and minimum distance methods using a rich longitudinal data set from Italy obtained by merging a number of administrative archives. These data contain detailed information on medical drug purchase, hospitalization, and mortality for a representative sample of elderly hypertensive patients. Our findings show that the observed autocorrelation in medical treatment reflects both permanent and time-varying observed and unobserved heterogeneity. They also show that medical drug purchase significantly maintains future health levels and prevents transitions to worse health. This suggests that policies aimed at increasing the awareness and the compliance of hypertensive patients help reduce cardiovascular risks and consequent hospitalization and mortality.

10.1002/hec.4495.abstractZh: 对健康与医疗治疗之间关系的定量评估对政策制定者来说至关重要。为了克服内生性问题，我们构建并估计了一个可行的动态因子模型，其中观察到的健康结果由个体的潜在健康状态驱动。潜在健康的动态反映了外生的健康恶化和内生的健康投资。我们的模型使我们能够研究医疗治疗对当前健康状况的影响，以及对未来医疗治疗和健康结果的影响。我们通过最大模拟似然法和最小距离法来估计该模型，使用的是来自意大利的丰富纵向数据集，这些数据是通过合并多个行政档案获得的。这些数据包含了关于老年高血压患者的医疗药物购买、住院情况和死亡率的详细信息。我们的研究结果表明，医疗治疗的观察性自相关性反映了永久性和时变性的观察性和未观察到的异质性。此外，研究还表明，医疗药物的购买显著维持了未来的健康水平，并防止了健康状况的恶化。这表明，旨在提高高血压患者意识和依从性的政策有助于降低心血管风险，从而减少住院率和死亡率。

abstract.text: Compared to the fee-for-service (FFS) model, the managed care delivery system has the potential to improve health care management, increase provider accountability, and support better monitoring of health care quality. However, managed care organizations may attempt to control costs by curbing utilization among Medicaid beneficiaries or reducing reimbursement for Medicaid services. It is an empirical question whether managed care increases or decreases utilization of services. Using detailed pediatric public insurance dental claims data from 2016 through 2018, we examined whether the transition from FFS to managed care affects rates of dental care utilization. Between 2016 and 2018, Indiana, Missouri and Nebraska transitioned pediatric Medicaid beneficiaries from public dental fee-for-service programs to private managed care entities. Using an extended two-way fixed-effects estimation framework, we found that dental managed care leads to a decline in dental care utilization, especially when compared to states that maintain FFS provision of Medicaid dental services.

10.1002/hec.4496.abstractZh: 与按服务收费模式相比，管理式护理交付系统有潜力改善医疗管理、提高服务提供者的责任感，并支持对医疗质量的更好监控。然而，管理式护理组织可能会试图通过限制Medicaid受益人的使用量或降低Medicaid服务的报销金额来控制成本。管理式护理是否会增加还是减少服务使用量，这是一个实证问题。我们利用2016年至2018年的儿科公共保险牙科索赔数据，研究了从按服务收费模式向管理式护理模式的转变对牙科服务使用率的影响。在2016年至2018年间，印第安纳州、密苏里州和内布拉斯加州将儿科Medicaid受益人的牙科服务从公共按服务收费项目转移到了私人管理式护理实体。通过扩展的双向固定效应估计框架，我们发现，与保持按服务收费模式的Medicaid牙科服务相比，管理式护理导致牙科服务使用量下降。

abstract.text: Taxes on sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs) are relatively new and there is limited evidence about their impact on SSB consumption or body mass index (BMI) (as opposed to prices, purchases, or sales), their impact on youth (as opposed to adults), or their impact in non-Western nations. This paper adds to the evidence across all these dimensions by estimating the effect of an SSB tax on SSB consumption and the BMI of youth in Mauritius, an island nation in the Indian Ocean, which we compare to Maldives, another island nation which did not implement an SSB tax during the time of our data. Results of difference-in-differences models indicate that the tax in Mauritius had no detectable impact on the consumption of SSBs or the BMI of the pooled sample of boys and girls. However, models estimated separately by sex indicate that the probability that boys consumed SSBs fell by 9.4 percentage points (11%). These are among the first estimates of the effect of SSB taxes on youth consumption and contribute to the limited evidence on the impact of SSB taxes on weight, and in non-Western countries.

10.1002/hec.4497.abstractZh: 对含糖饮料征税是一项相对较新的政策，关于其对含糖饮料消费或身体质量指数（BMI）的影响、对青少年（与成人相比）的影响，以及在非西方国家的影响，现有证据较为有限。本文通过估算毛里求斯（印度洋上的一个岛国）对含糖饮料征税对含糖饮料消费和青少年BMI的影响，为这些方面的研究提供了更多证据。我们将毛里求斯的结果与马尔代夫进行比较，后者在数据收集期间并未实施含糖饮料征税。差异模型分析的结果表明，毛里求斯的征税对含糖饮料消费或男孩和女孩的BMI没有显著影响。然而，按性别分列的模型分析显示，男孩消费含糖饮料的概率下降了9.4个百分点（即11%）。这些研究是首次对含糖饮料征税对青少年消费影响的估算，也为关于含糖饮料征税对体重影响的有限证据提供了补充，尤其是在非西方国家。

abstract.text: I study the effect of rainfall shocks on child mortality at a sub-national level for a global set of developing countries. I establish that negative (positive) shocks to rainfall lead to an increase (drop) in child deaths overall. Low-income countries (LICs) and the group of countries reliant on agriculture are affected the most due to negative rainfall shocks. In LICs, the impact of negative rainfall shocks is mitigated by around 60% in districts located downstream to dams, an effect predominant among less affluent districts; in addition, the effect of rainfall fluctuations is persistent, lasting for up to three years following the shock. Results remain robust to the inclusion of relevant controls, to the consideration of relevant issues such as selective fertility and migration, and various other robustness tests.

10.1002/hec.4498.abstractZh: 我研究了降雨冲击对全球发展中国家次国家级儿童死亡率的影响。研究发现，降雨的负面冲击会导致儿童死亡人数整体增加。低收入国家和依赖农业的国家受负面降雨冲击的影响最为严重。在低收入国家，位于大坝下游的地区的降雨冲击影响被约60%的缓解，这一效应在较不富裕的地区更为明显；此外，降雨波动的影响持续长达三年。研究结果在纳入相关控制变量、考虑选择性生育和迁移等因素以及各种其他稳健性测试后仍然保持稳定。

abstract.text: This study exploits the pathway of Hurricane Laura to assess its impact on the spread of COVID-19. Using US hospital data on confirmed and suspected adult COVID-19 cases, we find average daily cases per week rose by more than 12% primarily in tropical storm-affected counties in subsequent weeks. We suspect the key mechanisms involve constraints on social distancing for two reasons. First, there is significant evidence of storm-induced mobility. Second, lower income areas endured higher growth in hospital cases during the post-hurricane period. These findings provide crucial insights for policy-makers when designing natural disaster protocols to adjust for potential respiratory viral illnesses.

10.1002/hec.4499.abstractZh: 本研究通过分析飓风劳拉的路径，评估其对COVID-19传播的影响。利用美国关于确诊和疑似成人COVID-19病例的医院数据，我们发现，在随后的几周里，受热带风暴影响的县，每日平均病例数增加了超过12%。我们认为，造成这一现象的关键机制在于社交隔离的受限。首先，有大量证据表明风暴导致了人们活动的增加。其次，在飓风过后，低收入地区的医院病例数增长更为显著。这些发现为政策制定者在制定应对自然灾害的协议时提供了重要参考，以便考虑到潜在的呼吸道病毒感染问题。

abstract.text: This study measures the increment of health care expenditure (HCE) that can be attributed to technological progress and change in medical practice by using a residual approach and microdata. We examine repeated cross-sections of individuals experiencing an initial health shock at different point in time over a 10-year window and capture the impact of unobservable technology and medical practice to which they are exposed after allowing for differences in health and socioeconomic characteristics. We decompose the residual increment in the part that is due to the effect of delaying time to death, that is, individuals surviving longer after a health shock and thus contributing longer to the demand of care, and the part that is due to increasing intensity of resource use, that is, the basket of services becoming more expensive to allow for the cost of innovation. We use data from the Danish National Health System that offers universal coverage and is free of charge at the point of access. We find that technological progress and change in medical practice can explain about 60% of the increment of HCE, in line with macroeconomic studies that traditionally investigate this subject.

10.1002/hec.4500.abstractZh: 本研究采用残差方法和微观数据，测量可归因于技术进步和医疗实践变化的医疗保健支出增长。我们研究了在10年时间内，经历初次健康冲击的个体在不同时间点的重复截面数据，并考虑了健康和社会经济特征差异后，不可观测的技术和医疗实践对其影响的分析。我们将剩余增长分解为两部分：一部分是由于延长时间至死亡，即个体在健康冲击后存活时间延长，从而增加了对护理的需求；另一部分是由于资源使用强度的增加，即服务成本上升，以反映创新的成本。我们使用了丹麦国家卫生系统的数据，该系统提供全民覆盖服务，且服务免费。研究发现，技术进步和医疗实践的变化可以解释约60%的医疗保健支出增长，这与传统上研究这一主题的宏观经济研究结果一致。

abstract.text: Using a novel method, and data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1979 (NLSY79), we estimate the cumulative, long-term, causal effect of Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) eligibility on women's physical and mental health at age 50. We find that an increase in lifetime eligible EITC benefits is associated with long-term improvements in physical health, such as reduced occurrence of activity-limiting health problems and reduced reported diagnoses of mild and severe diseases. We explore intermediate health behaviors and outcomes, and find that an increase in lifetime eligible EITC benefits increases the number of hours worked and access to employer-sponsored health insurance, and decreases body mass index in the short-term. We find no significant effects of the EITC on mental health at age 50. Finally, we find that White women benefit disproportionately from the EITC in terms of mobility-related health issues, while Black and Hispanic women benefit in terms of lung-related illnesses like asthma, as well as cancer and stroke.

10.1002/hec.4501.abstractZh: 我们采用一种新颖的方法，并利用1979年青年纵向调查的数据，估计了获得劳动收入税收抵免资格对女性在50岁时身心健康产生的累积性、长期性因果效应。研究发现， lifetime eligible EITC福利的增加与身体健康的长期改善相关，例如活动受限的健康问题的发生率降低，以及轻度及重度疾病的诊断次数减少。我们还探讨了中间的健康行为和结果，发现lifetime eligible EITC福利的增加会提高工作小时数，并增加雇主提供的健康保险覆盖率，同时短期内会降低体重指数。然而，我们发现EITC对50岁女性的心理健康没有显著影响。最后，我们发现白人女性在与行动能力相关的健康问题上从EITC中获益最多，而黑人和西班牙裔女性在哮喘等肺部疾病，以及癌症和中风方面受益更大。

abstract.text: Governments around the world have adopted unprecedented policies to deal with COVID-19. This paper zooms in on business shutdowns and investigates their effectiveness in reducing mortality. We leverage highly granular death registry data for almost 5000 Italian municipalities in a diff-in-diff approach that allows us to mitigate endogeneity concerns credibly. Our results, which are robust to controlling for a host of co-factors, offer strong evidence that business shutdowns effectively curb mortality. We calculate that they may have reduced the death toll from the first wave of COVID-19 in Italy by about 40%. Our findings also highlight that timeliness is key - by acting 1 week earlier, their effectiveness could have been increased by an additional 5%. Finally, shutdowns should be targeted. Closing service activities with a high degree of interpersonal contact saves the most lives. Shutting down production activities, while substantially reducing mobility, only has mild effects on mortality.

10.1002/hec.4502.abstractZh: 全球各国政府采取了前所未有的政策来应对COVID-19。本文重点关注企业关闭措施在降低死亡率方面的效果。我们利用了近5000个意大利市镇的详细死亡登记数据，采用差异-差异方法，从而有效解决了内生性问题。我们的研究结果表明，企业关闭措施确实有效降低了死亡率。我们计算结果显示，这些措施可能使意大利在第一次COVID-19疫情中的死亡人数减少了约40%。我们的研究还表明，及时实施这些措施至关重要——如果提前一周实施，其效果可能会进一步提升5%。最后，企业关闭措施应针对特定领域。关闭具有高度人际接触的服务活动能够挽救最多生命；而关闭生产活动虽然大幅减少了人员流动，但对死亡率的影响却较为有限。

abstract.text: Non-preference-based patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) are popular in health outcomes research. These measures, however, cannot be used to estimate health state utilities, limiting their usefulness for economic evaluations. Mapping PROMs to a multi-attribute utility instrument is one solution. While mapping is commonly conducted using econometric techniques, failing to specify the complex interactions between variables may lead to inaccurate prediction of utilities, resulting in inaccurate estimates of cost-effectiveness and suboptimal funding decisions. These issues can be addressed using machine learning. This paper evaluates the use of machine learning as a mapping tool. We adopt a comprehensive approach to compare six machine learning techniques with eight econometric techniques to map the Patient-Reported Outcomes Measurement Information System Global Health 10 (PROMIS-GH10) to the EuroQol five dimensions (EQ-5D-5L). Using data collected from 2015 Australians, we find the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) model out-performed all machine learning techniques and the adjusted limited dependent variable mixture model (ALDVMM) out-performed all econometric techniques, with the LASSO performing better than ALDVMM. The variable selection feature of LASSO was then used to enhance the performance of the ALDVMM in a hybrid model. Our analysis identifies the potential benefits and challenges of using machine learning techniques for mapping and offers important insights for future research.

10.1002/hec.4503.abstractZh: 非偏好型患者报告结果测量指标在健康结果研究中非常流行。然而，这些指标无法用于估算健康状态的效用值，这限制了它们在经济评估中的实用性。将患者报告结果测量指标映射到多属性效用工具是一种解决方案。虽然这种映射通常使用计量经济学技术进行，但未能明确变量之间的复杂交互作用可能导致效用值预测不准确，从而影响成本效益的准确评估以及最优的资金分配决策。这些问题可以通过机器学习技术来解决。本文评估了将机器学习作为映射工具的使用效果。我们采用综合方法，将六种机器学习技术与八种计量经济学技术进行比较，以将患者报告结果测量信息系统全球健康10（PROMIS-GH10）映射到EuroQol五维度（EQ-5D-5L）上。利用2015年澳大利亚人的数据，我们发现最小绝对收缩与选择算子（LASSO）模型的表现优于所有机器学习技术，而调整后的有限依赖变量混合模型（ALDVMM）则优于所有计量经济学技术，其中LASSO的表现优于ALDVMM。随后，我们利用LASSO的变量选择功能来提升ALDVMM在混合模型中的性能。我们的分析指出了使用机器学习技术进行映射的潜在优势与挑战，并为未来的研究提供了重要启示。

abstract.text: Experiences with coverage with evidence development (CED) schemes are fairly limited in Central and Eastern European (CEE) countries, which are usually late adopters of new health technologies. Our aim was to put forward recommendations on how CEE health technology assessment bodies and payer organizations can apply CED to reduce decision uncertainty on reimbursement of medical devices, with a particular focus on transferring the structure and data from CED schemes in early technology adopter countries in Western Europe. Structured interviews on the practices and feasibility of transferring CED schemes were conducted and subsequently, a draft tool for the systematic classification of decision alternatives and recommendations was developed. The decision tool was reviewed in a focus group discussion and validated within a wider group of CEE experts in a virtual workshop. Transferability assessment is needed in case of (1) joint implementation of a CED scheme; (2) transferring the structure of an existing CED scheme to a CEE country; (3) reimbursement decisions that are linked to outcomes of an ongoing CED scheme in another country and (4) real-world evidence transferred from completed CED schemes. Efficient use of available resources may be improved by adequately transferring evidence and policy tools from early technology adopter countries.

10.1002/hec.4504.abstractZh: 在中欧和东欧国家，关于证据发展覆盖计划（CED）的经验相当有限，这些国家通常是新医疗技术的较晚采用者。我们的目标是提出建议，指导这些国家的医疗技术评估机构和支付机构如何应用CED来减少关于医疗设备报销的决策不确定性，特别关注从西欧早期技术采用国的CED计划中转移其结构和数据。我们进行了关于转移CED计划实践与可行性的结构化访谈，并随后开发了一个用于系统分类决策备选方案和建议的草案工具。该决策工具在焦点小组讨论中进行了审查，并在一个虚拟研讨会上得到了更多中欧和东欧专家的验证。在以下情况下，需要进行可转移性评估：(1) 联合实施CED计划；(2) 将现有CED计划的架构转移到中欧和东欧国家；(3) 与另一国家正在进行的CED计划结果相关的报销决策；(4) 从已完成的CED计划中转移的实际证据。通过充分转移来自早期技术采用国的证据和政策工具，可以有效提高现有资源的利用效率。

abstract.text: Digital health and mobile medical apps (MMAs) have shown great promise in transforming health care, but their adoption in clinical care has been unsatisfactory, and regulatory guidance and coverage decisions have been lacking or incomplete. A multidimensional assessment framework for regulatory, policymaking, health technology assessment, and coverage purposes based on the MMA lifecycle is needed. A targeted review of relevant policy documents from international sources was conducted to map current MMA assessment frameworks, to formulate 10 recommendations, subsequently shared amongst an expert panel of key stakeholders. Recommendations go beyond economic dimensions such as cost and economic evaluation and also include MMA development and update, classification and evidentiary requirements, performance and maintenance monitoring, usability testing, clinical evidence requirements, safety and security, equity considerations, organizational assessment, and additional outcome domains (patient empowerment and environmental impact). The COVID-19 pandemic greatly expanded the use of MMAs, but temporary policies governing their use and oversight need consolidation through well-developed frameworks to support decision-makers, producers and introduction into clinical care processes, especially in light of the strong international, cross-border character of MMAs, the new EU medical device and health technology assessment regulations, and the Next Generation EU funding earmarked for health digitalization.

10.1002/hec.4505.abstractZh: 数字健康与移动医疗应用在改变医疗保健方面展现出巨大潜力，但其在临床应用中的普及程度并不令人满意，相关的监管指导与覆盖决策也往往缺乏或不够完善。因此，需要一个基于移动医疗应用生命周期的多维度评估框架，用于监管、政策制定、健康技术评估以及覆盖目的。通过对国际相关政策文件的针对性审查，我们确定了当前的移动医疗应用评估框架，并提出了10项建议，这些建议随后由关键利益相关方的专家小组共同讨论。这些建议不仅涉及成本和经济评估等经济层面，还包括移动医疗应用的发展与更新、分类与证据要求、性能与维护监控、可用性测试、临床证据要求、安全与保障、公平考量、组织评估，以及额外的成果领域，如患者赋权和环境影响。COVID-19疫情极大地促进了移动医疗应用的使用，但关于其使用和监管的相关规定需要通过完善的框架进行整合，以支持决策者、生产者和其在临床护理过程中的应用，尤其是在移动医疗应用具有强烈的国际跨境特性、新的欧盟医疗器械和健康技术评估法规，以及Next Generation EU为健康数字化提供的资金支持下。

abstract.text: In March 2021, Italian health authorities suspended the Vaxzevria vaccine (VA) for 4 days over reports of very rare blood disorders among recipients. We exploit the quasi-experimental setting arising from this break to study the drivers of vaccine hesitancy. Before the suspension, the VA vaccination trend followed the same pattern as Pfizer-Biontech (PB). After the suspension, VA and PB injections started to diverge, with VA daily decreasing by almost 60 doses per 100,000 inhabitants for the following 3 weeks. The resulting vaccination rate was 60 percent lower than the value that would have stemmed from the VA pre-suspension pattern. We show that the slowdown was weaker and less persistent in regions with higher COVID penetration and steadier and more pronounced in regions displaying greater attention to vaccine side effects as detected through Google searches. The public's interest in vaccine adverse events negatively correlates with COVID cases and deaths across regions.

10.1002/hec.4506.abstractZh: 2021年3月，意大利卫生部门因收到关于接种Vaxzevria疫苗后出现极为罕见的血液疾病的报告，暂停了该疫苗的接种4天。我们利用这一暂停期进行准实验研究，以探讨疫苗犹豫的驱动因素。在暂停之前，Vaxzevria疫苗的接种趋势与辉瑞-BioNTech疫苗的接种趋势一致。暂停后，Vaxzevria和辉瑞-BioNTech疫苗的接种量开始分化，在接下来的3周里，Vaxzevria疫苗的日接种量每10万居民减少了近60剂。因此，Vaxzevria疫苗的接种率比暂停前要低60%。我们的研究表明，在COVID-19疫苗接种率较高的地区，接种速度的放缓较为轻微且持续时间较短；而在通过谷歌搜索发现对疫苗副作用更关注的地区，接种速度的放缓则更为明显且持续时间较长。公众对于疫苗不良反应的关注程度与各地区的COVID-19病例数和死亡人数呈负相关。

abstract.text: We investigate the effect of extreme temperatures on mortality and emergency hospital admissions, and whether local social care allows to mitigate their adverse effects. We merge monthly administrative data on mortality and hospital discharge from Italian municipalities for the period 2001-2015 with daily data on local weather conditions, and yearly data on disaggregated municipal expenditure. We compare two different measures of temperature shocks, one using the conventional approach based on absolute levels (without accounting for regional heterogeneity) and the other based on deviations from local mean temperatures. The former approach shows noisy evidence of an increase in mortality due to extremely hot days while the latter approach shows a large increase in mortality and hospital admissions for cardiovascular and respiratory diseases due to both cold and hot days. These effects are mostly driven by the oldest age group and partially by young children. Then, we report evidence of a mitigating effect of social expenditure on the impact of extremely hot and cold days on both emergency hospital admission and mortality rates. A back of the envelope calculation suggests that the additional social care expenditure is fully compensated by the benefits arising from the lower impact of temperature shocks.

10.1002/hec.4507.abstractZh: 我们研究了极端温度对死亡率和急诊住院率的影响，以及当地的社会福利政策是否能够缓解这些负面影响。我们将2001-2015年间意大利各市镇的月度死亡数据和出院数据，与每日的当地天气数据以及年度各市镇的支出数据进行了整合。我们采用了两种不同的温度冲击衡量方法：一种基于绝对温度水平（不考虑地区差异），另一种则基于与当地平均温度的偏差。前者显示极端高温天气会导致死亡率上升，而后者则表明无论是寒冷还是炎热的天气都会显著增加心血管和呼吸系统疾病导致的死亡率和住院率。这些影响主要由老年人群体造成，部分则由幼儿群体造成。此外，我们还发现社会支出对极端高温和寒冷天气对急诊住院率和死亡率的影响具有缓解作用。初步计算表明，额外的社会福利支出所带来的好处足以抵消温度冲击带来的负面影响。

abstract.text: Prospective payment systems reimburse hospitals based on diagnosis-specific flat fees, which are generally based on average costs. While this encourages cost-consciousness on the part of hospitals, it introduces undesirable incentives for patient transfers. Hospitals might feel encouraged to transfer patients if the expected treatment costs exceed the diagnosis-related flat fee. A transfer fee would discourage such behavior and, therefore, could be welfare enhancing. In 2003, New Zealand introduced a fee to cover situations of patient transfers between hospitals. We investigate the effects of this fee by analyzing 4,020,796 healthcare events from 2000 to 2007 and find a significant reduction in overall transfers after the policy change. Looking at transfer types, we observe a relative reduction in transfers to non-specialist hospitals but a relative increase in transfers to specialist facilities. It suggests that the policy change created a focusing effect that encourages public health care providers to transfer patients only when necessary to specialized providers and retain those patients they can treat. We also find no evidence that the transfer fee harmed the quality of care, measured by mortality, readmission and length of stay. The broader policy recommendation of this research is the introduction or reassessment of transfer payments to improve funding efficiency.

10.1002/hec.4508.abstractZh: 前瞻性支付系统根据诊断特定的固定费用来补偿医院，这些费用通常基于平均成本。虽然这鼓励了医院的成本意识，但也引入了不希望出现的病人转院动机。如果预期治疗费用超过诊断相关的固定费用，医院可能会受到激励去转院。转院费用可以抑制这种行为，因此可能有助于提升福利。2003年，新西兰引入了覆盖医院间病人转院情况的费用。我们通过分析2000年至2007年的4,020,796个医疗事件，发现政策变更后整体转院次数显著减少。从转院类型来看，向非专科医院的转院相对减少，而向专科设施的转院相对增加。这表明政策变更产生了一种聚焦效应，促使公共医疗服务提供者仅在必要时将病人转介给专科机构，并保留他们能够治疗的病人。我们还发现，转院费用并未影响护理质量，包括死亡率、再入院率和住院时间等指标。本研究提出的更广泛政策建议是引入或重新评估转院支付，以提高资金使用的效率。

abstract.text: We evaluate the performance of two behavioral interventions aimed at reducing tobacco consumption in an ultra-poor rural region of Bangladesh, where conventional methods like taxes and warning labels are infeasible. The first intervention asked participants to daily log their tobacco consumption expenditure. The second intervention placed two graphic posters with warnings about the harmful effects of tobacco consumption on tobacco users and their children in the sleeping quarters of the participating households. While both interventions reduced household tobacco consumption expenditure, male participants who logged their expenditure substituted cigarettes with cheaper smokeless tobacco. The reduction in tobacco intake is larger among males with a non-tobacco consuming spouse. Exploratory analysis reveals that risk-averse males who spent relatively more on tobacco responded more to the logbook intervention. More educated, patient males with children below age five responded better to the poster intervention. The findings suggest that in countries with multi-tiered tobacco excise tax structures, which incentivize downward substitution, extending complementary demand-side policies that worked elsewhere to the rural poor might be unwise. Instead, policies may leverage something as universal as parental concern for their children's health to promote better health decision-making.

10.1002/hec.4509.abstractZh: 我们评估了两种旨在减少孟加拉国一个极端贫困的农村地区烟草消费的行为干预措施的效果。在该地区，传统的税收和警示标签措施难以实施。第一种干预措施要求参与者每天记录自己的烟草消费支出。第二种干预措施是在参与家庭的睡眠区域张贴两张警示海报，提醒烟草使用者及其子女烟草消费的危害。虽然这两种干预措施都减少了家庭烟草消费支出，但记录支出的男性参与者选择用价格更低的无烟烟草替代香烟。在那些配偶不吸烟的男性中，烟草摄入量的减少幅度更大。探索性分析表明，对风险较为敏感的男性，他们在烟草上的支出相对较多，因此对这些记录干预措施的反应更为积极。受教育程度较高、有五岁以下孩子的男性对海报干预措施的反应也更好。研究结果表明，在采用多层烟草消费税结构的国家，这种激励向下替代的政策可能并不适合农村贫困人口。相反，政策可以借助像父母对孩子的健康关心这样的普遍因素，来促进更好的健康决策。

abstract.text: Trial-based cost-effectiveness analyses (CEAs) are an important source of evidence in the assessment of health interventions. In these studies, cost and effectiveness outcomes are commonly measured at multiple time points, but some observations may be missing. Restricting the analysis to the participants with complete data can lead to biased and inefficient estimates. Methods, such as multiple imputation, have been recommended as they make better use of the data available and are valid under less restrictive Missing At Random (MAR) assumption. Linear mixed effects models (LMMs) offer a simple alternative to handle missing data under MAR without requiring imputations, and have not been very well explored in the CEA context. In this manuscript, we aim to familiarize readers with LMMs and demonstrate their implementation in CEA. We illustrate the approach on a randomized trial of antidepressants, and provide the implementation code in R and Stata. We hope that the more familiar statistical framework associated with LMMs, compared to other missing data approaches, will encourage their implementation and move practitioners away from inadequate methods.

10.1002/hec.4510.abstractZh: 基于试验的成本效益分析是评估健康干预措施的重要证据来源。在这些研究中，成本和效果结果通常在多个时间点进行测量，但有些观察结果可能缺失。将分析限制在拥有完整数据的参与者身上可能导致估计结果出现偏差和效率低下。诸如多重插补法这样的方法被推荐用于改善数据的利用，并且在较宽松的随机缺失假设下仍然有效。线性混合效应模型为处理随机缺失数据提供了一种简单的方法，无需进行插补，但在成本效益分析中的应用尚未得到充分探索。在本论文中，我们旨在让读者熟悉线性混合效应模型，并展示其在成本效益分析中的实际应用。我们以一项抗抑郁药的随机试验为例，提供了在R和Stata中的实现代码。我们希望，与其他缺失数据处理方法相比，线性混合效应模型这一更为熟悉的统计框架能够鼓励其应用，并帮助从业者避免使用不适当的方法。

abstract.text: Vision impairment is the most common disability worldwide and it is untreated in large parts of the developing world. We assess the willingness-to-pay (WTP) for eyeglasses among adults in a resource-poor rural setting. We elicit the WTP using the Becker-DeGroot-Marschak (BDM) method. We combine this approach with a layaway scheme and a video intervention to probe to what extent liquidity constraints and information influence the WTP. Our results show that the average WTP is close to the cost of production for corrective glasses. Nevertheless, we find evidence for information constraints. Our video intervention raises the WTP for corrective glasses by 16 percent. We do not find evidence of screening effects, that is after 6 months, use is unrelated to the initial WTP.

10.1002/hec.4511.abstractZh: 视力障碍是全球最常见的残疾问题，在发展中国家的大部分地区，这一问题并未得到治疗。我们评估了资源匮乏的农村环境中成年人购买眼镜的支付意愿。我们使用Becker-DeGroot-Marschak（BDM）方法来测定支付意愿。我们将这种方法与分期付款计划及视频干预相结合，以探究流动性限制和信息因素对支付意愿的影响。研究结果显示，平均支付意愿接近眼镜的生产成本。尽管如此，我们发现存在信息限制的情况。我们的视频干预使眼镜的支付意愿提高了16%。我们没有发现筛查效应的证据，即六个月后，使用眼镜的行为与最初的支付意愿无关。

abstract.text: The Italian National Healthcare Service relies on per capita allocation for healthcare funds, despite having a highly detailed and wide range of data to potentially build a complex risk-adjustment formula. However, heterogeneity in data availability limits the development of a national model. This paper implements and ealuates machine learning (ML) and standard risk-adjustment models on different data scenarios that a Region or Country may face, to optimize information with the most predictive model. We show that ML achieves a small but generally statistically insignificant improvement of adjusted R 2 and mean squared error with fine data granularity compared to linear regression, while in coarse granularity and poor range of variables scenario no differences were observed. The advantage of ML algorithms is greater in the coarse granularity and fair/rich range of variables set and limited with fine granularity scenarios. The inclusion of detailed morbidity- and pharmacy-based adjustors generally increases fit, although the trade-off of creating adverse economic incentives must be considered.

10.1002/hec.4512.abstractZh: 意大利国家医疗保健系统依赖人均分配的资金来提供医疗服务，尽管拥有非常详细且种类繁多的数据，这些数据可以用来构建复杂的风险调整公式。然而，数据可用性的差异限制了国家模型的开发。本文在不同数据场景下实施并评估了机器学习（ML）和标准风险调整模型，以优化最具预测性的信息模型。研究表明，与线性回归相比，机器学习在精细数据粒度下能够带来较小但总体上统计上不显著的调整R²值和均方误差改进；而在粗粒度和数据变量范围有限的情况下，则未观察到差异。机器学习算法的优势在粗粒度和数据变量范围较广的情况下更为明显，而在精细粒度场景下则受到限制。包含详细的发病率和药房相关调整因子通常会提高模型的拟合度，但必须考虑由此带来的负面经济激励问题。

abstract.text: Using 13 waves of longitudinal data from Australia, we examine the relationship between petrol prices and obesity. Applying panel data models that control for individual fixed effects and the endogeneity of petrol prices, our results suggest that petrol prices have a negative effect on obesity. Specifically, our preferred instrumental variable estimates, which instrument for petrol prices using the Arca Oil Stock price and control for individual and time fixed effects, suggest that a standard deviation increase in petrol prices generates a 0.006 standard deviation decline in body mass index, while a unit increase in petrol prices results in a 2 percentage point decrease in the probability that a survey participant is obese. These results are robust to several sensitivity checks. Back of the envelope calculations suggest that our results imply that a permanent $1 per liter increase in petrol prices would reduce the number of people who were obese by 672,000 and save $1.4 billion dollars in medical expenditure related to obesity every year. We also find that frequency of participation in physical activity and expenditure on meals eaten out are channels through which petrol prices affect obesity.

10.1002/hec.4513.abstractZh: 我们利用澳大利亚的13波纵向数据，研究了汽油价格与肥胖之间的关系。通过应用控制个体固定效应和汽油价格内生性的面板数据模型，我们的研究结果表明，汽油价格对肥胖有负面影响。具体来说，我们使用的工具变量估计方法，通过Arca Oil股票价格来代理汽油价格，并控制个体和时间固定效应，发现汽油价格标准差每增加0.006，体重指数就会下降0.006标准差；而汽油价格每增加1个单位，肥胖调查参与者的概率就会减少2个百分点。这些结果在多次敏感性检验中依然保持稳定。粗略计算表明，汽油价格每升增加1美元，每年将使肥胖人数减少672,000人，并节省14亿美元的与肥胖相关的医疗支出。我们还发现，参与体育活动的频率以及外出就餐的支出是汽油价格影响肥胖的渠道。

abstract.text: In developing countries where medical infrastructure, service delivery systems, and the markets for health insurance are underdeveloped, one important mechanism to cope with the consequences of health shocks is the intra-household substitution of labor. This paper studies the impact of short-term illness shocks on labor supply and wage earnings of prime-aged individuals using data from agricultural households in India. It also documents the compensating intra-household labor supply responses of other non-ill members of the household. We find that an illness shock reduces an individual's monthly wage earnings by 7.1% via the decline in the individual's days of employment in the labor market. Further, an illness shock to the household head causes a compensating increase in the wage labor supply of the wife. An illness shock to the wife, however, induces the household head to devote more time to domestic activities. The compensating labor supply responses are only partially able to insure the loss in total wage income of the household. Our results indicate that the gender-based specialization of labor weakens in the event of an illness shock.

10.1002/hec.4514.abstractZh: 在医疗基础设施、服务输送系统以及健康保险市场不发达的发展中国家，应对健康冲击的一个重要机制是家庭内部的劳动力替代。本文利用印度农业家庭的数据，研究了短期疾病冲击对壮年个体劳动力供给和工资收入的影响。同时，本文还记录了家庭其他非患病成员为弥补疾病冲击而提供的劳动力供给。研究发现，疾病冲击会导致个体每月的工资收入减少7.1%，原因是个体在劳动力市场的就业天数减少。此外，家庭主妇的劳动力供给会相应增加以弥补这一损失。然而，疾病冲击也会促使家庭主妇更多地参与家务活动。这些补偿性劳动力供给反应仅能部分弥补家庭总工资收入的损失。我们的研究结果表明，在疾病冲击的情况下，基于性别的劳动力分工会减弱。

abstract.text: The concentration index, including its normalization, is prominently used to assess socioeconomic inequalities in health and health care. Wagstaff's and Erreygers' normalizations or corrections of the standard concentration index are the most suggested approaches when analyzing binary health variables encountered in many health economics and health services research. In empirical applications of the corrected or normalized concentration indices, researchers interpret them similarly to the standard concentration index, which may be problematic as this ignores their underlying behaviors. This paper shows that the empirical bounds of the standard concentration index, including the corrected indices, depend not only on the sample size directly but also on the sampling weight. Notably, the paper highlights critical challenges for assessing and interpreting the popular Wagstaff's and Erreygers' corrected concentration indices with binary health variables. Specifically, it shows that it might be misleading, for example, to assess socioeconomic health inequalities using the magnitude of the "symmetric" Erreygers' corrected concentration index in the face of progressive improvements in the binary health variable. Also, Wagstaff's normalized concentration index may give a spurious "concentration" of the binary health variable among the rich or the poor in certain rare instances.

10.1002/hec.4515.abstractZh: 浓度指数及其标准化方法被广泛用于评估健康与医疗保健领域的社会经济不平等现象。Wagstaff和Erreygers提出的标准化方法，是分析许多健康经济学和卫生服务研究中遇到的二元健康变量时最推荐的方法。在应用这些经过修正或标准化的浓度指数时，研究人员通常按照标准浓度指数的方式对其进行解读，但这可能会忽略这些指数背后的实际行为。本文指出，标准浓度指数及其修正后的指数在实证分析中的界限不仅取决于样本大小，还取决于抽样权重。值得注意的是，本文强调了在评估和解读Wagstaff和Erreygers提出的修正浓度指数时面临的挑战。具体而言，例如，在二元健康变量持续改善的情况下，使用Erreygers修正后的浓度指数来衡量社会经济健康不平等可能是具有误导性的。此外，Wagstaff的标准化浓度指数在某些情况下可能会给出一种虚假的“浓度”结果，这种结果可能仅反映富人或穷人在二元健康变量上的差异。

abstract.text: Hospital-physician integration has surged in recent years. Integration may allow hospitals to share resources and management practices with their integrated physicians that increase the reported diagnostic severity of their patients. Greater diagnostic severity will increase practices' payment under risk-based arrangements. We offer the first analysis of whether hospital-physician integration affects providers' coding of patient severity. Using a two-way fixed effects model, an event study, and a stacked difference-in-differences analysis of 5 million patient-year observations from 2010 to 2015, we find that the integration of a patient's primary care doctor is associated with a robust 2%-4% increase in coded severity, the risk-score equivalent of aging a physician's patients by 4-8 months. This effect was not driven by physicians treating different patients nor by physicians seeing patients more often. Our evidence is consistent with the hypothesis that hospitals share organizational resources with acquired physician practices to increase the measured clinical severity of patients. Increases in the intensity of coding will improve vertically-integrated practices' performance in alternative payment models and pay-for-performance programs while raising overall health care spending.

10.1002/hec.4516.abstractZh: 近年来，医院与医生之间的整合现象日益普遍。这种整合使得医院能够与整合后的医生共享资源和管理经验，从而提高患者诊断的精准度。更高的诊断精准度将增加医疗机构在基于风险的支付安排下的收入。我们首次分析了医院与医生之间的整合是否会影响医疗服务提供者对患者病情程度的编码。通过双向固定效应模型、事件研究以及基于500万患者年观测数据的差异比较分析，我们发现，将患者的初级保健医生整合到医疗机构中，会导致编码的病情严重程度增加2%至4%，这相当于医生照顾患者的时间减少了4至8个月。这种效应并非由医生治疗不同患者或频繁接诊患者所驱动。我们的研究结果支持了这样一个假设：医院与医生之间的整合有助于医院与医生团队共享组织资源，从而提高患者临床病情的精准度。编码工作强度的增加将提升垂直整合医疗机构在替代支付模式和绩效付费计划中的表现，同时也会增加整体的医疗保健支出。

abstract.text: To make informed health policy decisions regarding a treatment, we must consider both its cost and its clinical effectiveness. In past work, we introduced the net benefit separation (NBS) as a novel measure of cost-effectiveness. The NBS is a probabilistic measure that characterizes the extent to which a treated patient will be more likely to experience benefit as compared to an untreated patient. Due to variation in treatment response across patients, uncovering factors that influence cost-effectiveness can assist policy makers in population-level decisions regarding resource allocation. In this paper, we introduce a regression framework for NBS in order to estimate covariate-specific NBS and find determinants of variation in NBS. Our approach is able to accommodate informative cost censoring through inverse probability weighting techniques, and addresses confounding through a semiparametric standardization procedure. Through simulations, we show that NBS regression performs well in a variety of common scenarios. We apply our proposed regression procedure to a realistic simulated data set as an illustration of how our approach could be used to investigate the association between cancer stage, comorbidities and cost-effectiveness when comparing adjuvant radiation therapy and chemotherapy in post-hysterectomy endometrial cancer patients.

10.1002/hec.4517.abstractZh: 为了做出关于某种治疗的明智健康政策决策，我们必须同时考虑其成本和临床效果。在以往的研究中，我们引入了净效益分离（NBS）这一新的成本效益衡量方法。NBS是一种概率性衡量指标，用于描述接受治疗的患者比未接受治疗的患者更有可能获得效益的程度。由于不同患者治疗反应存在差异，找出影响成本效益的因素有助于政策制定者在资源分配方面做出决策。在本文中，我们引入了一个用于NBS的回归框架，以估计特定协变量的NBS，并找出NBS变异的决定因素。我们的方法能够通过逆概率加权技术处理信息性成本截尾问题，并通过半参数标准化程序解决混杂问题。通过模拟实验，我们证明了NBS回归在多种常见情景中表现良好。我们将所提出的回归方法应用于一个真实的模拟数据集，以说明如何利用该方法研究癌症分期、合并症与成本效益之间的关系，特别是在比较子宫切除术后子宫内膜癌患者接受辅助放疗和化疗时的成本效益时。

abstract.text: We study the effect of punitive and priority treatment policies relating to illicit substance use during pregnancy on the rate of neonatal drug withdrawal syndrome, low birth weight, low gestational age, and prenatal care use. Punitive policies criminalize prenatal substance use, or define prenatal substance exposure as child maltreatment in child welfare statutes or as grounds for termination of parental rights. Priority treatment policies are supportive and grant pregnant women priority access to substance use disorder treatment programs. Our empirical strategy relies on administrative data from 2008 to 2018 and a difference-in-differences framework that exploits the staggered implementation of these policies. We find that neonatal drug withdrawal syndrome increases by 10%-18% following the implementation of a punitive policy. This growth is accompanied by modest reductions in prenatal care, which may reflect deterrence from healthcare utilization. In contrast, priority treatment policies are associated with small reductions in low gestational age (2%) and low birth weight (2%), along with increases in prenatal care use. Taken together, our findings suggest that punitive approaches may be associated with unintended adverse pregnancy outcomes, and that supportive approaches may be more effective for improving perinatal health.

10.1002/hec.4518.abstractZh: 我们研究了与孕期非法物质使用相关的惩罚性政策和优先治疗政策对新生儿药物戒断综合征、低出生体重、低胎龄以及产前护理使用率的影响。惩罚性政策将孕期物质使用定为犯罪，或将孕期物质暴露视为儿童福利法规中的儿童虐待行为，或是作为终止父母权利的理由。优先治疗政策则对孕妇提供支持性待遇，使其优先获得物质使用障碍治疗项目的服务。我们的实证研究基于2008至2018年的行政数据，并采用差异-差异框架来分析这些政策的实施时间差异所带来的影响。研究发现，在实施惩罚性政策后，新生儿药物戒断综合征的发生率增加了10%至18%。这一增长伴随着产前护理使用的适度减少，这可能反映了人们对医疗服务的回避行为。相比之下，优先治疗政策虽导致低胎龄（2%）和低出生体重（2%）的发生率略有下降，但增加了产前护理的使用。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，惩罚性措施可能与非预期的不良妊娠结果相关，而支持性措施则可能对改善围产期健康更为有效。

abstract.text: The potential substitution of cannabis for prescription medication has attracted a substantial amount of attention within the context of medical cannabis laws (MCLs). However, much less is known about the association between recreational cannabis laws (RCLs) and prescription drug use. With recent evidence supporting substitution of cannabis for prescription drugs following MCLs, it is reasonable to ask what effect RCLs may have on those outcomes. We use quarterly data for all Medicaid prescriptions from 2011 to 2019 to investigate the effect of state-level RCLs on prescription drug utilization. We estimate this effect with a series of two-way fixed effects event study models. We find significant reductions in the volume of prescriptions within the drug classes that align with the medical indications for pain, depression, anxiety, sleep, psychosis, and seizures. Our results suggest substitution away from prescription drugs and potential cost savings for state Medicaid programs.

10.1002/hec.4519.abstractZh: 在医用大麻法律背景下，用大麻替代处方药的可能性已经引起了广泛关注。然而，关于娱乐性大麻法律与处方药使用之间的关联，目前了解甚少。鉴于近期有证据表明，在医用大麻法律实施后，人们可能会用大麻替代处方药，因此有必要探讨娱乐性大麻法律对这些结果可能产生的影响。我们使用了2011年至2019年间所有Medicaid处方数据的季度数据，来研究州级娱乐性大麻法律对处方药使用的影响。我们通过一系列双向固定效应事件研究模型来估算这一影响。研究发现，与疼痛、抑郁、焦虑、睡眠、精神病和癫痫发作等医疗适应症相关的药物类别的处方数量显著减少。我们的结果表明，人们可能会选择用大麻替代处方药，同时还能为州级Medicaid计划节省成本。

abstract.text: Payers and manufacturers can disagree on the appropriate level of evidence that is required for new medical devices, resulting in high societal costs due to decisions taken with sub-optimal information. A cost-effectiveness model of a hypothetical total artificial heart was built using data from the literature and the (simulated) results of a pivotal study. The expected value of perfect information (EVPI) was calculated from both the payer and manufacturer perspectives, using net monetary benefit and the company's return on investment respectively. A function was also defined, linking effectiveness to market shares. Additional constraints such as a minimum clinical difference or maximum budget impact were introduced into the company's decisions to simulate additional barriers to adoption. The difference in the EVPI between manufacturers and payers varied greatly depending on the underlying decision rules and constraints. The manufacturer's EVPI depends on the probability of being reimbursed, the uncertainty on the (cost-)effectiveness of the technology, as well as other parameters relating to initial investments, operating costs and market dynamics. The use of Value of information for both perspectives can outline potential misalignments and can be particularly useful to inform early dialogs between manufacturers and payers, or negotiations on conditional reimbursement schemes.

10.1002/hec.4520.abstractZh: 支付方和制造商在所需的新医疗器械证据等级上存在分歧，这导致由于信息不足而做出的决策带来了高昂的社会成本。基于文献数据和一项关键研究的模拟结果，构建了一个假设性全人工心脏的成本效益模型。从支付方和制造商的视角出发，分别使用净货币收益和公司的投资回报来计算完美信息的预期价值（EVPI）。还定义了一个函数，将有效性与市场份额联系起来。为了模拟额外的采用障碍，引入了诸如最小临床差异或最大预算影响等额外约束条件。制造商和支付方之间的EVPI差异因基础决策规则和约束条件的不同而大相径庭。制造商的EVPI取决于被报销的概率、技术（成本）有效性的不确定性，以及其他与初始投资、运营成本和市场动态相关的参数。对两种视角下信息价值的运用可以揭示潜在的偏差，并特别有助于促进制造商与支付方之间的早期对话，或关于有条件报销方案的谈判。

abstract.text: While the spread of digital technologies and the growth of associated atypical forms of work are attracting increasing attention, little is known about the impact of these new forms of work on psychological well-being. This paper examines the effect of Uber diffusion on the mental health of drivers, taking advantage of the rollout of Uber across UK regions. We match individual-level information on health and sociodemographic characteristics from the UK Household Longitudinal Study (Understanding Society) between 2009 and 2019 with data on the diffusion of Uber across the country. We first show that Uber diffusion is positively associated with mental health, as measured by the General Health Questionnaire, in the population group of self-employed drivers. We argue that this positive correlation captures a selection effect (of comparatively healthier individuals into the category of self-employed drivers after Uber entry) and the omission of unobserved factors, rather than a causal effect. Indeed, we do not observe any improvement in mental health for workers who were already self-employed drivers before Uber entry. In parallel with this, among individuals who remained salaried drivers over time, our results suggest there may be a decline in mental health after Uber's introduction, probably because they feel the competition from Uber drivers.

10.1002/hec.4521.abstractZh: 随着数字技术的普及以及相关非典型工作形式的增长吸引了越来越多的关注，关于这些新工作形式对心理健康影响的研究却相对较少。本文通过考察Uber在英国各地区的推广情况，研究了Uber的普及对司机心理健康的影响。我们利用了英国家庭纵向研究（Understanding Society）在2009至2019年间收集的健康和社会人口统计信息，并与Uber在全国范围内的推广数据进行了对比。研究发现，Uber的普及与心理健康呈正相关，这一关联主要体现在自雇司机群体中。我们认为，这种正相关反映了一种选择效应——即在Uber出现后，相对健康的人更倾向于成为自雇司机，而非真正的因果关系。实际上，对于在Uber出现之前就已经是自雇司机的人员来说，并未观察到其心理健康的改善。与此同时，对于那些一直从事固定工资工作的司机来说，Uber的引入可能导致了他们心理健康的下降，可能是因为他们感受到了来自Uber司机的竞争压力。

abstract.text: Caesarean section (C-section) rates continue to rise globally. Yet, there is little consensus about the key determinants of rising C-section rates and the sources of variation in C-section rates across the world. While C-sections can save lives when medically justified, unnecessary surgical procedures can be harmful for women and babies. We show that a state-wide law passed in São Paulo (Brazil), which increased women's autonomy to choose to deliver via C-section even when not medically necessary, is associated with a 3% increase in overall C-section rates. This association was driven by a 5% increase in primary C-sections, rather than repeated C-sections. Since the law emphasizes women's autonomy, these results are consistent with mothers' demand being an important contributor to high C-section rates in this context.

10.1002/hec.4522.abstractZh: 全球剖宫产率持续上升。然而，对于导致剖宫产率上升的关键因素以及不同国家之间剖宫产率差异的来源，目前尚无共识。虽然当医学指征明确时，剖宫产可以挽救生命，但不必要的手术可能对妇女和婴儿造成伤害。我们研究发现，巴西圣保罗一项州级法律增加了妇女选择剖宫产分娩的自主权，即使在没有医学必要的情况下也是如此，这一变化导致整体剖宫产率上升了3%。这种关联主要源于初次剖宫产率的上升，而非重复剖宫产。由于该法律强调妇女的自主权，这些结果表明，在这一背景下，母亲的需求是剖宫产率较高的一个重要因素。

abstract.text: Telemedicine can expand access to health care at relatively low cost. Historically, however, demand for telemedicine has remained low. Using administrative records and a difference-in-differences methodology, we estimate the change in demand for telemedicine experienced after the onset of the COVID-19 epidemic and the imposition of mobility restrictions. We find that the number of telemedicine calls made during the pandemic increased by 230 percent compared to the pre-pandemic period. The effects were mostly driven by older individuals with preexisting conditions who used the service for internal medicine consultations. The demand for telemedicine remained relatively high even after mobility restrictions were relaxed, which is consistent with telemedicine being an "experience good." These results are a proof of concept for policy makers to use such relatively low-cost medical consultations, made possible by new technologies, to provide needed expansion of access to health care.

10.1002/hec.4523.abstractZh: 远程医疗可以以相对较低的成本扩大医疗保健的获取范围。然而，历史上对远程医疗的需求一直较低。通过利用行政记录以及差异-差异方法，我们估计了在COVID-19疫情爆发和出行限制实施之后，远程医疗需求的变化。研究发现，在疫情期间，进行远程医疗咨询的次数比疫情前增加了230%。这种需求增加主要受到有既往疾病的高龄人群的影响，他们利用远程医疗进行内科咨询。即使在出行限制放宽之后，远程医疗的需求仍然保持较高水平，这与远程医疗是一种“体验良好”的医疗方式相符。这些结果为政策制定者提供了依据，可以利用这种相对低成本的医疗咨询方式，通过新技术实现医疗保健服务的扩展。

abstract.text: In the drive toward faster patient access to treatments, health technology assessment (HTA) agencies and payers are increasingly faced with reliance on evidence based on surrogate endpoints, increasing decision uncertainty. Despite the development of a small number of evaluation frameworks, there remains no consensus on the detailed methodology for handling surrogate endpoints in HTA practice. This research overviews the methods and findings of four empirical studies undertaken as part of COMED (Pushing the Boundaries of Cost and Outcome Analysis of Medical Technologies) program work package 2 with the aim of analyzing international HTA practice of the handling and considerations around the use of surrogate endpoint evidence. We have synthesized the findings of these empirical studies, in context of wider contemporary body of methodological and policy-related literature on surrogate endpoints, to develop a web-based decision tool to support HTA agencies and payers when faced with surrogate endpoint evidence. Our decision tool is intended for use by HTA agencies and their decision-making committees together with the wider community of HTA stakeholders (including clinicians, patient groups, and healthcare manufacturers). Having developed this tool, we will monitor its use and we welcome feedback on its utility.

10.1002/hec.4524.abstractZh: 在加快患者获得治疗速度的推动下，健康技术评估机构及支付方越来越依赖基于替代终点的证据，这增加了决策的不确定性。尽管已经开发出了一些评估框架，但在处理替代终点时，关于具体方法的共识仍然缺失。本研究综述了作为COMED项目工作包2的一部分所进行的四项实证研究的方法和发现，该项目的目标是分析国际健康技术评估实践中对替代终点证据的处理和考虑方式。我们将这些实证研究的发现与更广泛的相关方法论和政策文献相结合，开发了一个基于网络的决策工具，以支持面临替代终点证据的健康技术评估机构及支付方。该决策工具旨在供健康技术评估机构及其决策委员会以及更广泛的健康技术评估利益相关者群体（包括临床医生、患者团体和医疗保健制造商）使用。在开发完成该工具后，我们将对其进行使用情况的监测，并欢迎对其实用性的反馈。

abstract.text: Health economic modeling of novel technology at the early stages of a product lifecycle has been used to identify technologies that are likely to be cost-effective. Such early assessments are challenging due to the potentially limited amount of data. Modelers typically conduct uncertainty analyses to evaluate their effect on decision-relevant outcomes. Current approaches, however, are limited in their scope of application and imposes an unverifiable assumption, that is, uncertainty can be precisely represented by a probability distribution. In the absence of reliable data, an approach that uses the fewest number of assumptions is desirable. This study introduces a generalized approach for quantifying parameter uncertainty, that is, probability bound analysis (PBA), that does not require a precise specification of a probability distribution in the context of early-stage health economic modeling. We introduce the concept of a probability box (p-box) as a measure of uncertainty without necessitating a precise probability distribution. We provide formulas for a p-box given data on summary statistics of a parameter. We describe an approach to propagate p-boxes into a model and provide step-by-step guidance on how to implement PBA. We conduct a case and examine the differences between the status-quo and PBA approaches and their potential implications on decision-making.

10.1002/hec.4525.abstractZh: 在产品生命周期的早期阶段，对健康经济模型进行建模可以识别出可能具有成本效益的技术。然而，由于数据量可能有限，这种早期评估颇具挑战性。模型构建者通常会进行不确定性分析，以评估其对决策相关结果的影响。然而，当前的方法在应用范围上有所限制，并且存在一个无法验证的假设，即不确定性可以通过概率分布来精确表示。在缺乏可靠数据的情况下，采用最少的假设数量的方法更为理想。本研究提出了一种通用的参数不确定性量化方法，即概率界限分析（PBA），该方法在早期健康经济建模的情境中，无需精确指定概率分布。我们引入了概率框的概念，作为不确定性的度量工具，而无需精确的概率分布。我们提供了基于参数汇总统计数据的概率框计算公式。我们还描述了如何将概率框引入模型中，并提供了实施PBA的逐步指导。最后，我们通过一个案例研究，探讨了现状方法与PBA方法之间的差异，以及它们对决策制定的潜在影响。

abstract.text: In this study, we find that children in Vietnam who were born in December of a given year have better health outcomes than those born in January of the following year. Children born in December are taller, heavier, and less likely to be underweight and suffer from stunted growth than those born in January of the following year, though these two groups of children differ in age by only 1 month. We argue that the effect of being born in December compared to January on children's health is translated through early preschool attendance. In Vietnam, children born in December are more likely to start preschool as well as primary school 1 year earlier than those born in January of the following year. Thus, the health benefit for a child born in December would come from earlier and longer exposure to preschool. Importantly, we find that the positive effect of preschool persists over time as children grow. A possible major reason why preschool attendance improves health is the nutrition provided for children in preschools.

10.1002/hec.4526.abstractZh: 在本研究中，我们发现越南那些在给定年份的12月出生的儿童，其健康状况优于同年1月出生的儿童。12月出生的儿童身高更高、体重更重，且体重过轻和生长迟缓的情况也较少，尽管这两组儿童之间的年龄仅相差1个月。我们认为，12月出生与1月出生对儿童健康的影响是通过更早进入幼儿园来实现的。在越南，12月出生的儿童比1月出生的儿童更早开始上幼儿园和小学。因此，12月出生的儿童的健康益处来自于更早且更长时间的幼儿园教育。值得注意的是，随着儿童年龄的增长，幼儿园教育带来的积极影响会持续存在。幼儿园教育能够改善儿童健康的一个可能原因是，幼儿园为儿童提供的营养支持。

abstract.text: Throughout the COVID-19 pandemic, policymakers have been tasked with designing and implementing policies in the face of extraordinary uncertainty (Manski, 1999) and stark trade-offs between public health and other measures of human well-being.Policies designed to "flatten the curve" through social distancing often have negative economic consequences, such as unemployment, food insecurity, and business and school closures.The downstream consequences can also extend to outcomes more directly related to health, including intimate partner violence, addiction, depression, anxiety, suicide, and delays in medical treatments.Thus, efforts to mitigate the direct public health consequences of COVID-19 may not only have negative effects along other (e.g., economic) dimensions, but can have adverse indirect public health consequences as well.By the same token, however, choosing not to aggressively address the immediate public health crisis posed by COVID-19-a choice that has often been justified as a means of avoiding calamitous economic consequences-has driven repeated waves of exponential disease spread.These waves have not only driven morbidity and mortality; they also have had negative indirect effects on the economy, necessitating prolonged shutdowns and delaying resumption of economic activity.In summary, policies designed to promote public health or to preserve the economy can have the opposite effect on both dimensions.

10.1002/hec.4527.abstractZh: 在COVID-19疫情期间，政策制定者面临着在极端不确定性下设计和实施政策的挑战（Manski, 1999），同时需要在公共健康与其他人类福祉指标之间做出权衡。通过社交距离来“平缓曲线”的政策往往会产生负面经济后果，如失业、粮食不安全以及企业和学校的关闭。这些后果还可能直接影响到健康，包括亲密伴侣暴力、成瘾、抑郁、焦虑、自杀以及医疗治疗的延误。因此，试图减轻COVID-19对公共健康的直接影响，可能会在其他领域（如经济领域）产生负面影响，同时也会带来负面的间接公共健康后果。然而，选择不积极应对COVID-19带来的即时公共健康危机——这一选择常被视为避免灾难性经济后果的手段——却导致了多次指数级疾病传播。这些疫情不仅导致了发病率和死亡率的上升，还对经济产生了负面的间接影响，使得经济活动的恢复不得不延迟。总之，旨在促进公共健康或保护经济的政策，可能会对这两个领域产生相反的影响。

abstract.text: We provide time series evidence of tort reform's impact on inputs and quality in the nursing home industry. Between 2000 and 2010, 11 state reforms capped noneconomic damages for health care services. Small chain and unaffiliated nursing homes enjoyed "judgment proof standing" and were less apt to be sued, prior to reform. We find that the managers of such homes were relatively unresponsive to the implementation of state caps on noneconomic damages. Large "deep-pocketed" chain-affiliated homes lacked judgment proof standing and implemented greater reductions in their nursing inputs in the aftermath of tort relief. However, we find little evidence of service quality erosion across four measured dimensions of care outcomes. Our findings are consistent with a "defensive care" model in which large chain homes employ unproductive inputs in an effort to meet a negligence standard of care.

10.1002/hec.4528.abstractZh: 我们提供了关于侵权改革对养老院行业投入和服务质量影响的时序证据。在2000年至2010年间，11个州实施了限制医疗服务的非经济损失赔偿上限的改革。在改革之前，小型连锁养老院和独立运营的养老院由于具备“免予审判的资格”，因此较少被起诉。我们发现，这些养老院的管理层对州政府设定的非经济损失赔偿上限实施反应相对迟缓。而大型连锁养老院则缺乏免予审判的资格，在侵权改革后，它们进一步减少了护理投入。然而，我们并未发现服务质量的下降，四个衡量护理质量的指标均无明显变化。我们的研究结果与“防御性护理”模型相符，即大型连锁养老院为了符合过失护理标准，会采用非高效的投入方式。

abstract.text: Time trade-off utilities have been suggested to be biased upwards. This bias is a result of the method being applied assuming linear utility of life duration, which is violated when individuals discount future life years or are loss averse for health. Applying a "corrective approach", that is, measuring individuals' discount function and loss aversion and correcting time trade-off utilities for these individual characteristics, may reduce this bias in utilities. Earlier work has developed this approach for time trade-off in a student sample. In this study, the corrective approach was extended to composite time trade-off (cTTO) methodology, which enabled correcting utilities for health states worse than dead. In digital interviews a sample of 150 members of the general public completed cTTO tasks for six health states, and afterward they completed measurements of loss aversion and discounting. cTTO utilities were corrected using these measurements under multiple specifications. Respondents were also asked to reflect on and adjust their cTTO utilities directly. Our results show considerable loss aversion and both positive and negative discounting were prevalent. As predicted, correction generally resulted in lower utilities. This was in accordance with the direction of adjustments made by respondents themselves.

10.1002/hec.4529.abstractZh: 时间权衡效用被指出存在向上的偏差。这种偏差是由于采用的方法假设了生命持续时间的线性效用，而当个体对未来的生命年数进行折现或表现出对健康损失的厌恶时，这一假设就被打破了。采用“修正方法”，即测量个体的折现函数和损失厌恶程度，并根据这些个体特征对时间权衡效用进行修正，可以减少效用的这种偏差。先前的研究已经将这种方法应用于学生样本的时间权衡分析。在本研究中，修正方法被扩展至复合时间权衡（cTTO）方法论，使得能够修正那些比死亡更糟糕的健康状态的效用。在数字访谈中，150名普通公众成员完成了针对六种健康状态的cTTO任务，之后他们又完成了损失厌恶和折现能力的测量。根据这些测量结果，cTTO效用在多种情况下得到了修正。受访者还被要求直接反思并调整他们的cTTO效用。我们的结果显示，存在显著的损失厌恶现象，同时正面和负面的折现行为都很普遍。正如预期的那样，修正通常会导致效用降低。这与受访者自身所做的调整方向是一致的。

abstract.text: This paper documents how substance abuse treatment (SAT) providers and services respond to increases in population-level opioid addiction. I do this by exploiting the implementation of Medicare Part D as an exogenous increase in the availability of prescription opioids. Starting in 2006, states with higher shares of the population eligible for Medicare Part D experienced increases in residential and hospital inpatient SAT facilities, beds dedicated to SAT, and SAT facilities offering medication-assisted treatment, relative to states with lower shares. These results suggest that the supply of SAT in the United States is capable of responding significantly to changes in demand.

10.1002/hec.4530.abstractZh: 本文记录了物质滥用治疗服务提供者和服务如何应对人口层面阿片类药物成瘾的增加。我通过利用Medicare Part D政策的实施作为阿片类处方药可用性的外部因素来进行分析。从2006年开始，拥有更多符合Medicare Part D资格的人口的州，其物质滥用治疗的机构数量、用于物质滥用治疗的床位数量以及提供药物辅助治疗的机构数量均有所增加，相对于那些资格人口比例较低的州而言。这些结果表明，美国的物质滥用治疗供应能够显著响应需求的变化。

abstract.text: Health care in China suffers from substantial allocative inefficiency in the delivery system and technical inefficiency within hospitals. To ameliorate this problem in rural areas, the Analysis of Provider Payment Reforms on Advancing China's Health (APPROACH) project shifted the payment method of China's rural health insurance scheme for county hospitals from fee-for-service to a novel global budget. In particular, APPROACH global budget incentivized system-level allocative efficiency by reimbursing county hospitals at higher tariffs for gatekeeping and averting out-of-county (OOC) admissions among local patients they could treat. APPROACH conducted a large-scale randomized controlled trial of the global budget in 56 counties (22 million enrollees) of Guizhou province during 2016-2017. Applying randomization inference to claims data, we find a significant shift of inpatient utilization and expenditure from OOC hospitals to county hospitals. At county hospitals, average expenditure per admission and length of stay decreased, though not significantly. Effects on readmissions show no clear sign of compromised quality. We further find limited effect heterogeneity with respect to treatment and hospital characteristics. Overall, APPROACH global budget may offer a framework for improving health care efficiency without sacrificing quality.

10.1002/hec.4531.abstractZh: 中国的医疗保健系统在服务提供体系和技术层面都存在显著的分配效率低下问题。为了改善农村地区的这一状况，“中国健康进步提供者支付改革分析”项目将中国农村医疗保险方案对县级医院的支付方式从按服务收费改为新的全球预算制。具体而言，全球预算制通过为县级医院提供更高的报销标准，激励其在系统层面提高分配效率，从而避免本地患者接受非本县医院的医疗服务。2016-2017年间，该项目在贵州省的56个县进行了大规模随机对照试验，涉及2200万参保者。通过对索赔数据应用随机化推断方法，我们发现住院利用和支出从非本县医院转移到了本县医院，这一变化显著。在县级医院，平均每次住院的支出和住院时间有所减少，但变化并不明显。对于再住院率的影响，并未显示出质量下降的迹象。此外，我们还发现，不同治疗方式和医院特征对全球预算制的效果影响有限。总体而言，全球预算制可能为提高医疗保健效率提供了一个框架，同时不牺牲服务质量。

abstract.text: Many countries limit public and private reimbursement for nursing care costs for social or financial reasons. Still, quality varies across nursing homes. We explore the causal link between case-mix adjusted nurse staffing ratios as an indicator of care quality and different price components in Swiss nursing homes. The Swiss reimbursement system limits and subsidizes the care price at the cantonal level, which implicitly limits staffing ratios, while the residents cover the nursing home-specific lodging price privately. To estimate causal effects, we exploit (i) the exogeneity of the Swiss care price regulation, (ii) nursing-home fixed effects estimations and (iii) instrumental variables for the lodging price. Our estimates show a positive impact of prices on certified staffing ratios. We find that a 10% increase in care prices increases certified staffing ratios by 3-4%. A comparable 10% increase in lodging prices raises certified staffing ratios by 1.5-10% (depending on the model). Our findings highlight that price limits for nursing care impose a limit on staffing ratios. Furthermore, our results indicate that providers circumvent price limits by increasing lodging prices that are privately covered. Thus, this cost shifting implicitly shifts the financial burden to the residents.

10.1002/hec.4532.abstractZh: 许多国家出于社会或经济原因，限制对护理费用的公共和私人报销。尽管如此，不同养老院的护理质量仍然存在差异。我们探讨了作为护理质量指标的病例组合调整后的护士人员配置比例与瑞士养老院不同价格组成部分之间的因果关系。瑞士的报销体系在州一级限制并补贴护理费用，这隐含地限制了人员配置比例，而居民则私下承担养老院特定的住宿费用。为了估计因果效应，我们利用了以下因素：(i) 瑞士护理费用监管的外生性；(ii) 养老院的固定效应估计；(iii) 住宿费用的工具变量。我们的估计结果显示，价格对认证人员配置比例有积极影响。我们发现，护理费用增加10%会使认证人员配置比例增加3-4%。类似的，住宿费用增加10%会使认证人员配置比例增加1.5-10%（取决于模型）。我们的研究结果表明，护理费用的定价限制实际上限制了人员配置比例。此外，我们的结果表明，提供者通过提高私人承担的住宿费用来规避价格限制。因此，这种成本转移实际上将财务负担转移给了居民。

abstract.text: Non-pecuniary sources of motivation are a strong feature of the health care sector and the impact of competitive incentives on behavior may be lower where pecuniary motivation is low. This paper measures the marginal utility of income (MUY) of physicians from a stated-choice experiment, and examines whether this measure influences the association between competition faced by physicians and the prices they charge. We find that physicians are more likely to exploit a lack of competition with higher prices if they have a high MUY.

10.1002/hec.4533.abstractZh: 非金钱动机是医疗保健行业的显著特征，在金钱动机较低的情况下，竞争激励对行为的影响可能较小。本文通过一项选择实验来测量医生的收入边际效用，并探讨这一指标是否会影响医生面临的竞争程度与他们收费之间的关联。研究发现，如果医生的收入边际效用较高，他们更有可能利用缺乏竞争的情况来提高收费。

abstract.text: We study whether primary care physicians (PCPs) exercise left digit bias with respect to patients' age. Relying on a comprehensive administrative visit level data from a large Israeli HMO, we measure the intensity of patients' medical examination in visits that take place around a decadal birthday-a birthday that ends with zero-within a regression discontinuity framework. We find that in standard settings with clear patient information there is no evidence that PCPs exhibit left digit bias. However, when PCPs meet unfamiliar patients seeking immediate care, they are more likely to use basic diagnostic tests just above the decadal birthday threshold, indicating that under these circumstances, PCPs do use left digit bias.

10.1002/hec.4534.abstractZh: 我们研究了初级保健医生在对待患者年龄时是否存在左手数字偏好。基于以色列一家大型健康保险公司的全面行政访问数据，我们在回归不连续框架内测量了患者在十年生日前后进行的医疗检查的强度。我们发现，在患者信息清晰的标准情况下，没有证据表明初级保健医生存在左手数字偏好。然而，当初级保健医生面对寻求即时护理的陌生患者时，他们更有可能在十年生日的临界点以上使用基本诊断测试，这表明在这些情况下，初级保健医生确实存在左手数字偏好。

abstract.text: This is the first study to comprehensively examine the impact of job losses during the Great Recession on mental health, physical health, health behavior, and risky health behavior of young adults (ages 18-27). We employ U.S. longitudinal data with individual fixed effects to control for time-invariant factors that may bias the results. We find that job losses during the recession of young adults living by themselves led to increased onset of doctor-diagnosed mental health problems and worries related to jobs. Poorer individuals suffered more from increased worries, obesity, and binge drinking. In contrast, for those living with their parents, job loss of young adults did not negatively affect their own health. Instead, fathers' job losses led to worse mental health, physical health, and health behavior for young adults. Overall, the results suggest that when living on their own, young adults were responsible for their households' livelihood, and consequently, own job losses led to stress and negative health outcomes. However, when living with parents, they were financially reliant on their parents. Therefore, own job losses did not affect health, but job losses of fathers, the primary income earners for most households, worsened the health of young adults.

10.1002/hec.4535.abstractZh: 这是第一项全面研究大衰退期间失业对18-27岁年轻人心理健康、身体健康、健康行为及风险健康行为影响的研究。我们采用了美国的纵向数据，并引入个体固定效应，以控制可能扭曲结果的时变因素。研究发现，独自生活的年轻人在大衰退期间失业后，出现医生诊断的心理健康问题以及与工作相关的担忧的频率增加。经济状况较差的人则更多地受到担忧、肥胖和酗酒的影响。相比之下，与父母同住的年青人，失业并未对其自身健康产生负面影响。相反，父亲失业会导致年轻人的心理健康、身体健康和健康行为状况恶化。总体而言，研究结果表明，独自生活的年轻人在家庭中承担生计责任，因此失业会导致压力和负面健康结果。然而，与父母同住时，他们在经济上依赖父母，因此失业并未直接影响健康，但父亲作为大多数家庭的主要收入来源，其失业反而会加重年轻人的健康问题。

abstract.text: While psychological distress is a common sequelae of job loss, how that relationship continued during the COVID-19 pandemic is unclear, for example, given higher health risk to working due to disease exposure. This paper examines changes in psychological distress depending on job loss among a cohort of randomly selected residents living in nine predominantly African American low-income neighborhoods in Pittsburgh PA across four waves between 2013 and 2020. Between 2013 and 2016, we found an increase in psychological distress after job loss in line with the literature. In contrast, between 2018 and 2020 we found change in psychological distress did not differ by employment loss. However, residents who had financial concerns and lost their jobs had the largest increases in psychological distress, while residents who did not have serious financial concerns-potentially due to public assistance-but experienced job loss had no increase in distress, a better outcome even than those that retained their jobs. Using partial identification, we find job loss during the pandemic decreased psychological distress for those without serious financial concerns. This has important policy implications for how high-risk persons within low-income communities are identified and supported, as well as what type of public assistance may help.

10.1002/hec.4536.abstractZh: 虽然心理困扰是失业的常见后遗症，但在COVID-19疫情期间，这种关系如何持续尚不清楚，因为工作人群面临更高的疾病风险。本文研究了2013年至2020年间，在宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡九个以非洲裔居民为主的低收入社区中，随机选取的居民群体在失业后心理困扰的变化情况。研究发现，在2013年至2016年间，失业后心理困扰确实有所增加，这与现有文献一致。相比之下，在2018年至2020年间，心理困扰的变化并不因失业而不同。然而，那些面临财务问题并失业的居民心理困扰的增加最为明显，而那些没有严重财务问题（可能是由于公共援助）但遭遇失业的居民则没有心理困扰的增加，甚至比那些继续工作的人情况更好。通过部分识别分析，我们发现疫情期间失业对于没有严重财务问题的人来说，心理困扰有所减少。这一发现对于如何识别和支持低收入社区中的高风险人群，以及何种类型的公共援助可能有所帮助，具有重要的政策意义。

abstract.text: Driving under the influence of alcohol is a major cause of fatalities worldwide. There have been a range of legislative and policy interventions aiming to address this. Bar closing hours is one policy with clear implications for drink driving. Existing evidence, largely drawn from one-off policy changes in urban settings, reports mixed evidence that is difficult to generalize. We return to this issue using a setting, Norway, that is advantageous due to large temporal and regional variation in closing times, frequent changes, and a lack of confounding policy changes. We demonstrate an average zero effect of closing hours on traffic accidents that masks large variations in effects: in terms of population density; accident severity; and direction of change in closing hours. Extensions in closing hours in populous municipalities decrease accidents, whereas the opposite is true for rural municipalities. Our findings suggest that estimates from single policy changes may be difficult to generalize, while demonstrating that closing hours can generate large effects on traffic accidents.

10.1002/hec.4550.abstractZh: 在酒精影响下驾驶是全球交通事故的主要原因之一。为了应对这一问题，已经采取了一系列立法和政策干预措施。酒吧营业时间限制是一项对酒驾有明确影响的政策。现有的证据主要来自城市环境中的一次性政策变化，但结果并不一致，难以进行推广。我们选择了挪威作为研究案例，因为该国的营业时间限制存在较大的时间和地区差异，且政策变化频繁，同时没有其他政策因素的干扰。我们发现，营业时间限制对交通事故的影响平均为零，但实际上在不同人口密度、事故严重程度以及时间限制变化方向上存在较大差异。在人口密集的市镇，延长营业时间限制可以减少事故，而在农村市镇则会产生相反的效果。我们的研究结果表明，单一政策变化的评估结果难以推广，同时也证明了时间限制对交通事故有显著的影响。

abstract.text: We investigate the impact of the Great Recession in Italy on the incidence of chronic diseases using new individual longitudinal data from Electronic Health Records. We exploit the exogenous shock in the economic conditions occurred in 2008 to estimate heterogeneous effects of an unprecedented rise in local unemployment rates in an individual fixed-effects model. Our results document that harsh economic downturns have a negative long-lasting effect on cardiovascular disease and a temporary effect on depression. This effect is heterogeneous across gender, increases with age and is stronger right before the retirement age. An important policy recommendation emerging from this study is that prolonged economic downturns constitute an additional external risk for individual health and not a temporary benefit.

10.1002/hec.4551.abstractZh: 我们利用电子健康记录中的新个体纵向数据，研究了意大利大衰退对慢性疾病发病率的影响。我们利用2008年发生的经济状况外生冲击，在一个个体固定效应模型中估算了当地失业率空前上升所带来的异质性效应。我们的研究结果表明，严重的经济衰退对心血管疾病有长期的负面影响，对抑郁症则具有暂时的负面影响。这种影响在不同性别之间存在差异，随着年龄的增长而增强，并且在退休年龄之前更为明显。本研究提出的一个重要政策建议是，长期的经济衰退对个人健康构成了额外的外部风险，而非暂时的益处。

abstract.text: There is substantial variation in drug spending across regions in Sweden, which can be justified if caused by differences in health need, but an indication of inefficiencies if primarily caused by differences in place-specific supply-side factors. This paper aims to estimate the relative effect of individual demand-side factors and place-specific supply-side factors as drivers of geographical variation in drug spending in Sweden. We use individual-level register data on purchases of prescription drugs matched with demographic and socioeconomic data of a random sample of about 900,000 individuals over 2007-2016. The primary empirical approach is a two-way fixed effect model and an event study where we identify demand- and supply-side effects based on how regional and local migrants change drug spending when moving across regional and municipal borders. As an alternative approach in robustness checks, we also use a decomposition analysis. The results show that the place-specific supply-side effect accounts for only about 5%-10% of variation in drug spending and remaining variation is due to individual demand-side effects. These results imply that health policies to reduce regional variation in drug spending would have limited impact if targeted at place-specific characteristics.

10.1002/hec.4552.abstractZh: 瑞典各地区的药物支出存在显著差异，如果这种差异是由健康需求的差异造成的，那么是可以理解的；但如果这种差异主要是由地方特定的供应因素造成的，则表明存在效率低下的情况。本文旨在估计个体需求因素和地方特定供应因素对瑞典药物支出地理差异的驱动作用。我们使用了2007-2016年间约900,000人的随机样本的人口统计和社会经济数据，并结合了个人层面的处方药购买记录数据。主要的实证方法是一种双向固定效应模型和一个事件研究，通过研究区域和本地移民在跨越地区和市政边界时药物支出的变化，来识别需求和供应方面的效应。作为稳健性检验的替代方法，我们还采用了分解分析。研究结果表明，地方特定的供应因素仅解释了药物支出差异的5%-10%，其余差异则归因于个体需求因素。这些结果表明，如果卫生政策旨在减少地区间的药物支出差异，那么针对地方特定特征的干预措施将产生有限的效果。

abstract.text: While many states have legalized medical cannabis, many unintended consequences remain under-studied. We focus on one potential detriment-the effect of cannabis legalization on automobile safety. We examine this relationship through auto insurance premiums. Employing a modern difference-in-differences framework and zip code-level premium data from 2014 to 2019, we find that premiums declined, on average, by $22 per year following medical cannabis legalization. The effect is more substantial in areas near a dispensary and in areas with a higher prevalence of drunk driving before legalization. We estimate that existing legalization has reduced health expenditures related to auto accidents by almost $820 million per year with the potential for a further $350 million reduction if legalized nationally.

10.1002/hec.4553.abstractZh: 虽然许多州已经将医用大麻合法化，但许多意想不到的后果仍未被充分研究。我们重点关注一个潜在的负面影响——大麻合法化对汽车安全的影响。我们通过汽车保险费用来研究这一关系。利用现代的差异-差异框架以及2014至2019年的邮政编码级保险费用数据，我们发现，在医用大麻合法化后，保险费用平均每年减少了22美元。这一影响在靠近药房的地区以及合法化前酒后驾车现象较为严重的地区更为显著。我们估计，现有的合法化措施每年减少了约8.2亿美元的与汽车事故相关的健康支出；如果全国范围内实现合法化，这一数字还有可能进一步减少3.5亿美元。

abstract.text: Governments often encourage health service providers to improve quality of care and reduce prices through competition. The efficacy of competition hinges on the assumption that consumers demand high quality care at low prices for any given health condition. In this paper, we examine this assumption by investigating the role of perceived price and quality on consumer choice for four different health conditions across public and private providers. We use a nationally representative survey in Malaysia to elicit respondents' perception on prices and quality, and their preferred choice of provider. We estimate a mixed logit model and show that consumers value different dimensions of quality depending on the health condition. Furthermore, increasing perceived prices for private providers reduces demand for minor, more frequent health conditions such as flu fever or cough, but increases demand for more complex, severe conditions such as coronary artery bypass graft. These findings provide empirical support for price regulation which differentiates the severity of underlying health conditions.

10.1002/hec.4554.abstractZh: 政府通常会鼓励医疗服务提供者通过竞争来提高护理质量并降低价格。竞争的有效性取决于这样一个假设：消费者对于任何特定的健康状况，都愿意以较低的价格获得高质量的护理。在本文中，我们通过调查感知到的价格和质量对消费者选择四种不同健康状况的医疗服务提供者的影响，来检验这一假设。我们采用了马来西亚的一项具有全国代表性的调查，以了解受访者对价格和质量的看法，以及他们更倾向选择的医疗服务提供者。我们运用混合逻辑模型进行估计，发现消费者根据健康状况的不同，对质量的各个维度有不同的评价。此外，认为私立医疗服务提供者价格较高的现象，会降低人们对一些较为常见、轻微的健康状况（如流感、发烧或咳嗽）的需求，但会增加人们对一些较为复杂、严重的健康状况（如冠状动脉旁路移植术）的需求。这些发现为根据健康状况的严重程度进行价格调控提供了实证支持。
