I implement a regression discontinuity design and find that coverage expansion increases recipients' LTC utilization considerably irrespective of their health status. When more generous insurance coverage is available, recipients with low care needs increase day care and rehabilitation services, whereas those with high care needs increase home care services. Moreover, using more LTC has little effect on health outcomes such as the health score and the entry into nursing homes. Together, these results suggest that generous LTCI coverage can induce excessive LTC utilization without having health benefits.

10.1007/s10198-022-01550-x.abstractZh: 社会保险覆盖的慷慨程度如何影响老年人的医疗需求和健康状况？本文利用日本公共长期护理保险系统的行政数据，研究了保险覆盖对长期护理利用及其健康后果的影响。在长期护理保险体系中，受保人的健康评分决定了他们的保险覆盖额度，而评分的阈值会导致覆盖额度的不连续变化。通过回归不连续设计，我们发现，无论健康状况如何，更慷慨的保险覆盖都会显著增加受保人的长期护理利用。当提供更慷慨的保险覆盖时，需求较低护理需求的受保人会增加日间护理和康复服务的使用，而需求较高护理需求的受保人则会增加家庭护理服务的使用。此外，更多的长期护理对诸如健康评分和入住养老院等健康结果的影响较小。综上所述，这些结果表明，慷慨的长期护理保险覆盖可能会引发过度的长期护理利用，而并未带来健康上的益处。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effects of health-care spending on mortality rates of patients who experienced a heart attack. We relate in-hospital deaths to in-hospital spending and post-discharge deaths to post-discharge health-care spending. In our analysis, we use detailed administrative data on individual personal characteristics including comorbidities, information about the type of medical treatment and information about health-care expenses at the regional level. To account for potential selectivity in the region of health-care treatment we compare local patients with visitors and stayers with recent movers from a different region. We find that in regions with higher health-care spending mortality after heart attacks is substantially lower. From this we conclude that there are long-term returns to local health-care spending.

10.1007/s10198-024-01695-x.abstractZh: 本文研究了医疗保健支出对心脏病患者死亡率的影响。我们将住院期间的死亡与住院期间的支出联系起来，将出院后的死亡与出院后的医疗保健支出联系起来。在分析中，我们使用了详细的行政数据，包括个人特征、医疗类型以及地区层面的医疗保健费用等信息。为了考虑医疗保健治疗区域可能存在的选择性问题，我们比较了本地患者与外地患者，以及长期居住者与近期从其他地区迁移来的患者。研究发现，在医疗保健支出较高的地区，心脏病发作后的死亡率明显较低。由此得出结论，本地医疗保健支出具有长期效益。

abstract.text: This paper studies the effect of increased competition from imports on the productivity of firms. It proposes an empirical model that estimates productivity from sales revenue. The model addresses concerns associated with unobserved prices and demand conditions in revenue productivity. Unlike De Loecker (Econometrica 79(5):1407–1451, 2011), the model builds on recent evidence on the effect of exporting on firm-level prices by distinguishing between the export and domestic demand markets and integrating both in the supply function of firms. It applies this framework to study the effect that tariffs reduction on EU imports had on the efficiency of manufacturing firms in Hungary during the period 1996–2003, and finds that a 10-percentage point reduction in import tariffs on similar products manufactured by a firm raises the firm’s productivity by 1.40%. This is in contrast to 2.35% when revenue productivity is used. The proposed model provides a simple framework that improves productivity estimates from sales data.

10.1007/s10290-022-00472-3.abstractZh: 本文研究了进口竞争加剧对企业生产率的影响。文章提出了一个实证模型，该模型通过销售收入来估算生产率。该模型解决了与未观测价格和需求条件相关的收入生产率问题。与De Loecker（Econometrica 79(5):1407–1451, 2011）的研究不同，该模型基于近期关于出口对企业价格影响的证据，通过区分出口市场和国内需求市场，并将两者整合到企业的供给函数中。该模型应用于研究1996至2003年间欧盟进口关税降低对匈牙利制造企业效率的影响，发现对类似产品进口关税降低10个百分点，企业的生产率可提高1.40%。这一结果与使用收入生产率模型得出的2.35%的结果形成对比。该模型提供了一个简单的框架，能够从销售数据中更精确地估算生产率。

abstract.text: Exploiting a rich data set on the Dutch market for home help services, we find that larger providers obtain a higher price than do small providers. However, compared to other studies on market power in care markets this price difference is considered small to moderate. Our identification strategy relies on the exogenous variation in market shares in January'07, the very first month after home help was decentralized to municipalities. Zooming in on our main outcome, we obtain that the small but significant effect of market size on price is merely driven by the pricing behavior of for-profit providers.

10.1007/s10754-022-09334-9.abstractZh: 通过利用荷兰家庭护理服务市场的丰富数据，我们发现规模较大的提供者能够获得比小型提供者更高的价格。然而，与其他关于护理市场市场力量的研究相比，这种价格差异被认为是较小到中等程度的。我们的分析策略依赖于2007年1月这一市场分割开始的月份的外生市场份额变化。聚焦我们的主要结果，我们发现市场规模对价格的影响虽然较小，但却是显著的，这一影响仅仅是由营利性提供者的定价行为所驱动的。

abstract.text: We investigate whether increased competition among inspection firms leads to an increase in the inspection pass rate in the Swedish car inspection market, which is heavily regulated and consciously designed to mitigate incentives to violate government regulations. We use a panel dataset that represent 22.5 million car roadworthiness tests that were conducted during the period 2010–2015. Fixed effects and instrumental variable estimations, which are used to account for the endogeneity of competition, show that inspection stations that operate in highly competitive markets are more lenient toward their customers than are stations that operate in less competitive markets.

10.1007/s11151-022-09864-z.abstractZh: 我们研究的是，在瑞典汽车检查市场中，检查公司之间的竞争加剧是否会导致检查通过率的提高。该市场受到严格监管，并且设计上旨在减少违反政府规定的动机。我们使用了一个包含2250万次汽车检测数据的面板数据集，这些数据来自2010至2015年期间。通过固定效应和工具变量估计方法，我们分析了竞争的内生性，结果表明，在竞争激烈的市场中运营的检查站对客户的检查要求比在竞争较小的市场中运营的检查站更为宽松。

abstract.text: Background Asthma is common, resulting in 53 million emergency department (ED) visits annually. Little is known about variation in cost and quality of ED asthma care. Study objective We sought to describe variation in costs and 7-day ED revisit rates for asthma care across EDs. Our primary objective was to test for an association between ED costs and the likelihood of a 7-day revisit for another asthma exacerbation. Methods We used the 2014 Florida State Emergency Department Database to perform an observational study of ED visits by patients ≥18 years old with a primary diagnosis of asthma that were discharged home. We compared patient and hospital characteristics of index ED discharges with and without 7-day revisits, then tested the association between ED revisits and index ED costs. Multilevel regression was performed to account for hospital-level clustering. Results In 2014, there were 54,060 adult ED visits for asthma resulting in discharge, and 1667 (3%) were associated with an asthma-related ED revisit within 7 days. Median cost for an episode of ED asthma care was $597 with an interquartile range of $371-980. After adjusting for both patient and hospital characteristics, lack of insurance was associated with higher odds of revisit (OR 1.42, 95% CI 1.18-1.71), while private insurance, female gender, and older age were associated with lower odds of revisit. Hospital costs were not associated with ED revisits (OR = 1.00; 95% CI 1.00-1.00). Conclusion Hospital costs associated with ED asthma visits vary but are not associated with odds of ED revisit.

10.1016/j.ajem.2022.09.021.abstractZh: 背景：哮喘非常常见，每年导致5300万次急诊就诊。关于急诊哮喘护理的成本和质量的差异，目前了解甚少。研究目的：我们旨在描述不同急诊中心在哮喘护理方面的成本差异以及7天内再次就诊的概率。我们的主要目标是检验急诊费用与7天内再次就诊的可能性之间的关联。方法：我们使用2014年佛罗里达州急诊数据库，对18岁以上、主要诊断为哮喘且出院后回家的患者进行了观察性研究。我们比较了有和没有7天内再次就诊的患者及其医院特征，然后检验了急诊就诊次数与首次急诊费用之间的关联。通过多层回归分析，考虑了医院级别的聚类效应。结果：2014年，有54,060名成人因哮喘到急诊就诊并出院，其中1667例（3%）与7天内的哮喘相关急诊就诊有关。一次急诊哮喘护理的平均费用为597美元，四分位范围为371-980美元。在调整了患者和医院特征后，没有保险与更高的再次就诊几率相关（OR 1.42，95% CI 1.18-1.71），而私人保险、女性及年龄较大则与较低的再次就诊几率相关。医院费用与急诊就诊次数无关（OR = 1.00；95% CI 1.00-1.00）。结论：与急诊哮喘就诊相关的医院费用存在差异，但并未与再次就诊的几率相关。

abstract.text: Reflection on three major levers for rebuilding the healthcare system: governance, integration of health and social care and digitalization. Spain has worrying levels of quality of democracy and public confidence in its politicians, and major changes are required in public administration to achieve a better state. Healthcare suffers from a deficient institutional architecture that prevents adequate macrogovernance. There is also a lack of autonomy in the management of public health centers, which hinders competition by comparison, care integration and coordination within and between levels of care. The pandemic has highlighted the value of professionalism and has shown that agile healthcare management is possible, but the challenge is to maintain this flexibility outside state of alarm. Care integration is more necessary as the population ages (albeit healthily), and per capita financing is a powerful tool to achieve it. Digitization concerns practically all areas of healthcare and population health, and will bring with it far-reaching organizational changes, requiring new methods of evaluation that differ according to the degree of intrusiveness in individual health. Telemedicine, sponsored during the pandemic with a view to permanence, induces changes in labor relations, among others. It is necessary to measure the value of digital tools and technologies. Spain has a unique opportunity for its digital transformation, thanks to European funds.

10.1016/j.gaceta.2022.02.010.abstractZh: 关于重建医疗体系的三个主要手段的反思：治理、健康与社会关怀的整合以及数字化。西班牙的民主质量和公众对政治家的信任水平令人担忧，需要重大的公共行政改革以实现更好的状态。医疗体系存在制度架构缺陷，阻碍了有效的宏观治理。此外，公共卫生中心的管理缺乏自主权，这阻碍了竞争、护理的整合以及不同层级之间的协调。疫情凸显了专业性的重要性，并表明灵活的医疗管理是可能的，但挑战在于在非紧急状态下保持这种灵活性。随着人口老龄化（尽管健康状况良好），护理整合变得更加必要，而人均资金是实现这一目标的有力工具。数字化几乎涉及医疗和人口健康的所有领域，并将带来深远的组织变革，需要根据对个人健康的干预程度采用新的评估方法。远程医疗在疫情期间得到了推广，有望成为长期解决方案，这引发了劳动关系等方面的变化。有必要衡量数字工具和技术的重要性。西班牙凭借欧洲的资金支持，拥有进行数字化转型的独特机会。

abstract.text: Patients choice is at the core of competition in hospital care. In spite of a flourishing literature, little is known about the true process leading patients to choose a specific provider. Most models in this literature assume - without testing - that hospitals are perceived to be homogeneous providers. In this article we take a different direction. We assume that patients have a bias towards some types of hospitals, we test this hypothesis and show which attributes determine this bias. We exploit the characteristic of Italian health care organization, where devolution has allowed regional systems to choose the level of competition and the private-public hospitals mix. We estimate conditional logit models for hip replacement admissions in three regions (Lombardy, Veneto, and Emilia-Romagna) over the period 2014- 2016. We show that, depending on the competition framework (peculiar to each region) patients are aware that some hospitals are best performers in their area and are willing to travel more to be admitted there. This is particularly true for regional health care systems where competition between public and private providers is well developed. Our model provides interesting policy implications: a) the idea that hospitals are different in patients perception should be kept in mind in the architecture of the market for hospital care; b) clinical quality as a driver to patients choice seems to work better in a less regulated competition settings.

10.1016/j.healthpol.2022.04.009.abstractZh: 患者选择是医院护理竞争的核心。尽管相关文献丰富，但关于患者选择特定医疗服务提供者的真实过程仍知之甚少。大多数相关模型都假设——未经验证——医院被视为同质的提供者。在本文中，我们采取了不同的视角。我们假设患者对某些类型的医院存在偏好，我们对此假设进行了测试，并揭示了哪些属性决定了这种偏好。我们利用了意大利医疗保健组织的特性，即分权制度使得各地区能够自行决定竞争水平以及公私医院的比例。我们针对2014年至2016年期间意大利三个地区（伦巴第、威尼托和艾米利亚-罗马涅）髋关节置换手术的入院情况，建立了条件Logit模型。研究表明，根据各地区特有的竞争框架，患者意识到某些医院在其所在地区表现最佳，因此愿意长途跋涉前往这些医院就医。这一点在公私医疗服务提供者竞争较为激烈的地区尤为明显。我们的模型提供了一些有趣的政策启示：a) 在构建医院护理市场时，应考虑到患者认为医院存在差异这一观点；b) 在竞争较少受监管的环境中，临床质量作为患者选择的驱动因素似乎更为有效。

abstract.text: Public policies fostering the freedom of choice of provider in the healthcare sector are increasingly common in many countries and regions, where policymakers wish to empower patients and improve health service performance. However, in the literature there is not clear consensus about the impact of expanded patient choice on healthcare quality yet. This study investigates whether increasing patients' freedom of choice influences health system outcomes in terms of various non-clinical aspects of care, a dimension often overlooked by researchers in this field. Our study considers a "natural experiment" that took place within the Spanish National Health System in 2009 under which citizens of the Community (region) of Madrid were allowed to freely choose among any GP and/or specialist in their region. The empirical analysis was conducted by using Spanish microdata for the period 2002-2016 and used synthetic control estimation techniques. The key findings show the reform had a strong and long-lasting impact, reducing average waiting times and increasing patients' satisfaction with the specialist attention received. We did not detect any statistically significant impact of the reform on the other responsiveness domains analysed. Our analysis shows that freedom of choice policies could improve health system performance if they are combined with appropriate economic incentives for health providers.

10.1016/j.healthpol.2022.11.001.abstractZh: 在许多国家和地区，促进医疗服务提供者选择自由的公共政策越来越普遍，政策制定者希望增强患者的选择权并提升医疗服务质量。然而，关于扩大患者选择权对医疗质量的影响，学术界尚未形成明确共识。本研究探讨了患者选择自由的扩大是否会影响医疗系统的各种非临床方面的表现，这一维度往往被该领域的研究人员忽视。我们的研究采用了2009年西班牙国家卫生系统内的“自然实验”作为研究对象，当时马德里地区的公民可以自由选择区域内的全科医生或专科医生。实证分析使用了2002至2016年的西班牙微观数据，并采用了合成控制估计技术。主要发现表明，这一改革产生了强烈且持久的影响，平均等待时间缩短，患者对所接受的专科医疗服务满意度提高。我们并未发现该改革对其他分析领域的响应性产生统计学上显著的影响。我们的分析表明，如果选择自由政策与适当的经济激励措施相结合，能够提升医疗系统的绩效。

abstract.text: In Australia, the US and Europe, policy makers use markets to incentivise aged care providers to produce greater quality care. The Australian Government announced in 2021 that it would further increase market forces in residential aged care to improve quality. The proposals respond to poor quality found within residential aged care, with overuse of psychotropic medications and physical constraints, social isolation and neglect. This paper outlines the market-orientated reforms the Government seeks to implement, including the policy development pathway over the last two decades. It refers to a theoretical model of provider behaviour under administered prices, and empirical research on the impact of similar market-orientated reforms delivered elsewhere, to highlight the reforms' strengths, weaknesses, and potential market outcomes. This paper concludes by identifying additional reforms that could better incentivise care quality and offers lessons to countries that have sought to marketise their nursing home care sectors.

10.1016/j.healthpol.2022.11.005.abstractZh: 在澳大利亚、美国和欧洲，政策制定者利用市场机制来激励老年护理服务提供者提供更高质量的护理服务。澳大利亚政府在2021年宣布将进一步增强老年护理领域的市场力量，以提高护理质量。这些改革措施旨在应对老年护理中存在的质量问题，如精神药物滥用、物理限制、社会隔离和忽视等问题。本文概述了政府计划实施的市场导向改革，包括过去二十年来的政策发展过程。文中还引用了一个关于在管理价格下的服务提供者行为的理论模型，并参考了其他地区实施类似市场导向改革后的实证研究，以揭示这些改革的优势、劣势以及潜在的市场效果。最后，本文提出了可以进一步激励护理质量提升的额外改革措施，并为那些试图将养老院护理服务市场化的发展中国家提供了借鉴。

abstract.text: Measuring performance in healthcare remains a challenge. The use of health outcomes rather than structure and process indicators is considered as the way forward, but outcome-based results risk being biased by selection. Accounting for such selection bias is more difficult in settings with small-sized providers and low chances of resident health improvement, like in the case of nursing homes. In this paper we (i) measure the health outcomes of Dutch nursing homes in terms of mortality and avoidable hospitalizations among residents, (ii) we adopt a novel approach to test for selection bias and (iii) we examine the relationship between outcomes and other nursing home quality indicators and characteristics. Using administrative data from more than 110,000 residents, we estimate the performance of the 849 largest nursing homes in the Netherlands in the period 2015–2019. Controlling for an extensive set of observable case-mix variables, we first test for the presence of selection bias using a distance-based instrumental variable. We do not find any evidence for such a structural bias. While the wide confidence intervals of the estimates display considerable imprecision, our results do reveal substantial differences between top and bottom performing nursing homes. Because the outcome-based estimates turn out to be only weakly correlated with other quality indicators, we conclude that our mortality and avoidable hospitalization-based indicators provide important complementary information. When small sample issues and case-mix differences are adequately accounted for, outcome-based indicators can provide useful policy guidance for quality improvement in nursing homes.

10.1016/j.jebo.2022.08.028.abstractZh: 衡量医疗保健绩效仍然是一个挑战。目前，人们倾向于使用健康结果而非结构和流程指标来进行评估，但基于结果的评估可能会受到选择偏差的影响。在小型服务提供者数量较少且居民健康改善机会较低的情况下，比如养老院，要消除这种选择偏差更为困难。在本文中，我们（i）以死亡率和可避免住院率来衡量荷兰养老院的健康结果；（ii）采用了一种新颖的方法来检测选择偏差；（iii）研究了结果与其他养老院质量指标及特征之间的关系。我们利用超过110,000名居民的管理数据，估算了2015年至2019年间荷兰849家最大养老院的表现。在控制了大量可观测的病例混合变量后，我们首先使用基于距离的工具变量来检测选择偏差的存在。我们没有发现任何结构性偏差的证据。尽管估计值的置信区间较宽，显示出相当大的不精确性，但我们的结果确实揭示了表现优异的养老院与表现较差的养老院之间存在显著差异。由于基于结果的估计与其他质量指标之间的相关性较弱，我们得出结论：以死亡率和可避免住院率为指标的评估提供了重要的补充信息。当充分考虑到小样本问题和病例混合差异时，基于结果的指标可以为养老院的质量改进提供有用的政策指导。

abstract.text: We use a quasi difference-in-difference approach to examine whether the 2006 relaxation of constraints on patient choice of hospital in the English National Health Service (NHS) affected waiting times inequalities for three common elective treatments (coronary bypass, hip replacement and knee replacement) in hospitals which faced more potential competition (number of rivals) before the choice reform was introduced relative to those which faced less competition. After the 2006 choice reform hospitals which had more rivals before 2006 had longer waits for hip and knee replacement, with one additional rival increasing the median waiting time by 2.5% and 4.0%, and the 75th quantile waiting time by 4.2% and 7.1%. There was no effect on waiting times for coronary bypass patients up to the 75th quantile of the wait distribution. The choice reform and market structure had no effect on the standard deviation of waiting times within hospitals but did increase waiting time variation within small geographical areas. Older hip replacement patients had shorter waits pre-choice reform but the gradient disappeared after it and was not affected by market structure. Before the choice reform, more deprived patients had longer waits but post-reform there was no deprivation gradient in waiting times, and the reduction in the gradient was not affected by pre-reform market structure. Overall, the results suggest that the choice reform led to longer and more dispersed waiting times in more competitive areas but deprivation related inequity was smaller in the post-choice period.

10.1016/j.jebo.2022.10.040.abstractZh: 我们采用准差异分解方法，来研究2006年英国国家卫生服务系统对医院患者选择限制的松绑是否影响了三种常见选择性治疗（冠状动脉搭桥、髋关节置换和膝关节置换）在竞争更激烈的医院中的等待时间差异。与竞争较少的医院相比，2006年选择改革后，竞争更激烈的医院在髋关节和膝关节置换手术中的等待时间更长。每增加一个竞争对手，等待时间的中位数分别增加了2.5%和4.0%，第75百分位的等待时间分别增加了4.2%和7.1%。对于冠状动脉搭桥手术患者，直到等待时间的第75百分位数，选择改革和市场结构对等待时间的标准差没有影响，但增加了小地理区域内等待时间的变异。在选择改革前，年龄较大的髋关节置换患者的等待时间较短，但改革后这种差异消失了，且不受市场结构的影响。在选择改革前，贫困患者等待时间更长，但改革后，等待时间上的贫困梯度消失，这种梯度的减少也不受改革前市场结构的影响。总体而言，结果表明，选择改革导致竞争更激烈的地区等待时间更长且分布更广，但在改革后与贫困相关的不平等现象有所减少。

abstract.text: In developing countries, public sector health facilities frequently run out of essential medicines ("stockouts"). I test whether anti-malarial drug stockouts affect prices, quality, and overall access to anti-malarial drugs in private sector outlets in Uganda. I combine data from four sources: 1) standardized patient drug purchases; 2) vendor surveys; 3) real customer surveys; 4) public sector supply delivery dates. Using a difference-in-differences approach, I find that stockouts increase private-sector antimalarial drug prices by $0.68, or 35 percent. I find few changes in quality. Real customer characteristics change, suggesting that stockouts lead less educated and poorer customers to drop out of the market. Analysis using the 2016 Demographic and Health Survey additionally shows stockouts reduce treatment at public sector facilities and reduce the likelihood that children receive medicine. My results suggest that stockouts increase prices in the private sector and lead to less equitable health outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102544.abstractZh: 在发展中国家，公共部门的卫生设施经常出现基本药品短缺的情况。我研究了抗疟疾药物短缺是否会影响乌干达私营部门抗疟疾药物的价格、质量以及整体获取情况。我结合了来自四个来源的数据：1）标准化患者药品购买数据；2）供应商调查；3）真实客户调查；4）公共部门供应交付日期。通过差异-差异分析法，我发现药品短缺使私营部门的抗疟疾药物价格上涨了0.68美元，即35%。我发现药品质量几乎没有变化。真实客户的特征发生了变化，这表明药品短缺导致受教育程度较低和较贫困的客户退出市场。2016年人口与健康调查的分析进一步显示，药品短缺减少了在公共部门设施中的治疗机会，并降低了儿童获得药物的可能性。我的研究结果表明，药品短缺导致私营部门的价格上升，并使得健康结果更加不公平。

abstract.text: This paper explores the economic incentives for medical procedure innovation. Using a proprietary dataset on billing code applications for emerging medical procedures, we highlight two mechanisms that could hinder innovation. First, the administrative hurdle of securing permanent, reimbursable billing codes substantially delays innovation diffusion. We find that Medicare utilization of innovative procedures increases nearly nine-fold after the billing codes are promoted to permanent (reimbursable) from provisional (non-reimbursable). However, only 29 percent of the provisional codes are promoted within the five-year probation period. Second, medical procedures lack intellectual property rights, especially those without patented devices. When appropriability is limited, specialty medical societies lead the applications for billing codes. We indicate that the ad hoc process for securing billing codes for procedure innovations creates uncertainty about both the development process and the allocation and enforceability of property rights. This stands in stark contrast to the more deliberate regulatory oversight for pharmaceutical innovations.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102549.abstractZh: 本文探讨了医疗程序创新的经济激励因素。通过一项关于新兴医疗程序计费代码应用的专有数据集，我们指出了两种可能阻碍创新的机制。首先，获得永久性的、可报销的计费代码的行政障碍大大延迟了创新的扩散。我们发现，在计费代码从临时状态转变为永久状态后，医疗保险对创新程序的利用增加了近九倍。然而，在五年的试用期内，只有29%的临时计费代码被转为永久状态。其次，医疗程序缺乏知识产权，尤其是那些没有专利设备的程序。当专有权限有限时，专业医学协会会主导计费代码的申请。我们认为，为程序创新获得计费代码的临时流程，使得开发过程以及财产权的分配和执行都充满了不确定性。这与对药品创新的更为明确的监管措施形成了鲜明对比。

abstract.text: Noninvasive prenatal screening tests help identify genetic disorders in a fetus, but their take-up remains low in several countries. Using a regression discontinuity design, we test the causal effect of a policy that eliminated co-payments for noninvasive screening tests in Italy. We identify the treatment effects by a discontinuity in women's eligibility for a free test based on their conception date. We find that the policy increases the probability of women's undergoing noninvasive screening tests by 5.5 percentage points, and the effect varies by socioeconomic status. We do not find evidence of substitution effects with more expensive and riskier invasive diagnostic tests. In addition, the increase in take-up does not affect pregnancy termination or newborn health. We find some evidence of positive effects on mothers' health behaviors during pregnancy as measured by reductions in mothers' weight gain and hospital admissions during pregnancy, but these are statistically significant only at the 10 percent level.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102553.abstractZh: 非侵入性产前筛查测试有助于识别胎儿的基因疾病，但在一些国家，这种筛查的普及率仍然较低。我们使用回归不连续设计来测试在意大利实施取消非侵入性筛查测试共同付费政策的因果效应。我们通过女性根据受孕日期获得免费筛查资格的不连续性来识别治疗效果。我们发现，该政策使女性接受非侵入性筛查测试的概率增加了5.5个百分点，且这种效应因社会经济地位而异。我们没有发现使用更昂贵、风险更高的侵入性诊断测试会产生替代效应的证据。此外，筛查率的提高并未影响妊娠终止或新生儿健康。我们发现，该政策对母亲在妊娠期间的健康行为产生了一些积极影响，表现为母亲体重增加的减少和妊娠期间住院次数的减少，但这些影响在10%的水平上才具有统计学意义。

abstract.text: We analyze data from the Minnesota Twin Registry (MTR), combined with the Socioeconomic Survey of Twins (SST), and new mortality data, and contribute to two bodies of literature. First, we demonstrate a beneficial causal effect of education on health and longevity in contrast to other twin-based studies of the US population, which show little or no effect of education on health. Second, we present evidence that is consistent with parental compensation through education for differences in their children's endowments that predict health, but find no evidence that parents reinforce differences in endowments that predict earnings. We argue that there is a bias towards detecting reinforcement both in this paper and in the literature. Despite this bias, we still find statistical evidence of compensating behavior. We account for observed and unobserved confounding factors, sample selection bias, and measurement error in education.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102554.abstractZh: 我们分析了来自明尼苏达双胞胎登记处的数据，结合双胞胎社会经济调查以及新的死亡数据，为两篇文献做出了贡献。首先，我们证明了教育对健康和寿命具有积极的因果效应，这与其他针对美国人口的双胞胎研究形成了对比，后者显示教育对健康的效应很小或根本没有。其次，我们发现了与通过教育补偿父母子女之间差异相关的证据，这些差异与健康状况有关，但我们没有发现证据表明父母会强化与收入相关的差异。我们认为，在这篇论文和现有文献中，都存在检测强化行为的偏差。尽管存在这种偏差，我们仍然发现了补偿行为的统计证据。我们考虑了观察到的和未观察到的混杂因素、样本选择偏差以及教育测量误差。

abstract.text: Does underage access to alcohol increase teenage drinking and crime? To address this question, I leverage a discontinuity in legal access to alcohol at age 16 in Germany, a country with high consumption levels and a particularly early access regulation. Using detailed survey data and administrative crime records from 2005 to 2015, I detect considerable increases in drinking participation, frequency, and intensity at the legal cutoff along the middle and lower end of the distribution. These increases coincide with discrete jumps in criminal engagement under the influence of alcohol, mostly due to violent and property crimes. My findings suggest that changes in drinking intensity induce these crimes, implying a drinking-crime elasticity of 0.4 at age 16.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102555.abstractZh: 未成年人接触酒精是否会增加青少年的饮酒和犯罪行为？为了回答这个问题，我利用了德国在16岁时对酒精的合法获取存在断点这一特点。德国是酒精消费水平较高的国家，且酒精获取的法规实施时间相对较早。通过2005至2015年的详细调查数据和行政犯罪记录，我发现，在法定饮酒年龄这一分界点附近，饮酒参与率、频率以及饮酒强度都有显著上升。这些上升与酒精影响下犯罪行为的显著增加相吻合，尤其是暴力犯罪和财产犯罪。我的研究结果表明，饮酒强度的变化导致了这些犯罪行为的增加，表明在16岁时，饮酒与犯罪之间的弹性为0.4。

abstract.text: Genetic tests that predict the lifetime risk of common medical conditions are fast becoming more accurate and affordable. The life insurance industry is interested in using predictive genetic tests in the underwriting process, but more research is needed to establish whether this nascent form of genetic testing can refine the process over conventional underwriting factors. Here, we perform Cox regression of survival on a battery of genetic risk scores for common medical conditions and mortality risks in the Health and Retirement Study, without returning results to participants. Adjusted for covariates in a relevant insurance scenario, the scores could improve mortality risk classification by identifying 2.6 years shorter median lifespan in the highest decile of total genetic liability. We conclude that existing genetic risk scores can already improve life insurance underwriting, which stresses the urgency of policymakers to balance competing interests between stakeholders as this technology develops.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102556.abstractZh: 能够预测常见疾病终生风险的基因检测正变得越来越准确和实惠。人寿保险行业对在承保过程中使用预测性基因检测感兴趣，但还需要更多的研究来确定这种新兴的基因检测形式是否能够超越传统的承保因素，进一步完善承保流程。本研究采用Cox回归模型，对《健康与退休研究》中常见疾病和死亡风险的基因风险评分进行了分析，且未将结果反馈给参与者。在考虑相关保险场景中的协变量后，这些评分能够改善死亡风险分类，在总基因风险最高的群体中，中位寿命缩短了2.6年。我们得出结论，现有的基因风险评分已经能够改善人寿保险的承保工作，这凸显了政策制定者在技术发展的过程中需要平衡各利益相关方的利益。

abstract.text: We study how pharmaceutical firm marketing responds to a regulatory decision that represents a positive information shock about drug safety. In the context of the smoking cessation drug Chantix, we estimate the effects of a Food and Drug Administration (FDA) decision to remove the drug's black box warning on two forms of marketing: monetary and in-kind payments to physicians (detailing) and direct-to-consumer advertising. Using identification strategies that leverage geographic variation in latent demand for smoking cessation therapy and the targeted nature of the information shock, we find that the removal of the warning significantly increased Chantix-related detailing payments and increased expenditures on national television advertising of Chantix. Understanding these firm-level strategic promotion responses is important, as they have implications for the dissemination of new drug information and the behaviors of physicians and consumers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102557.abstractZh: 我们研究了制药公司营销如何对一项关于药品安全的正面信息冲击的监管决定作出反应。以戒烟药物Chantix为例，我们评估了美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）决定删除该药物黑框警告对两种营销形式的影响：向医生提供的货币和实物支付，以及直接面向消费者的广告。通过利用潜在戒烟治疗需求的地理差异以及信息冲击的针对性，我们发现删除警告显著增加了与Chantix相关的支付行为，并增加了Chantix在全国电视广告上的支出。理解这些公司层面的战略促销反应非常重要，因为它们对新药品信息的传播以及医生和消费者的行为都有影响。

abstract.text: This paper addresses how the educational gradient in the mortality rate is influenced by the educational difference in hospitalisation for Cardiovascular diseases. We account for possible selective hospitalisation, by using 'Timing-of-events'- model and for selection into education, by using an inverse propensity weighting method. Based on the estimated model we simulate the educational gains of improving education and decompose these educational gains into an indirect effect, running through changes in the hospitalisation process, and a direct effect due to other factors. We use Swedish Military Conscription Data (1951-1960), for males only, linked to administrative Swedish registers. Our empirical results show that the implied educational gains in the survival probability till age 63 are 2% to 5.5%-point, with the largest effect for the low educated. These gains are mainly due educational difference in hospitalisation for the high educated (1.3%-point) and mainly due to other factors (4.9%-point) for the low educated. However, for the (significant) educational gain in implied months lost due premature mortality before age 63 (2 to 9 months) we do not find a significant impact of the educational difference in hospitalisation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102565.abstractZh: 本文探讨了教育梯度对心血管疾病住院率的影响。我们通过使用“事件时间模型”来考虑可能的选择性住院现象，并通过逆概率加权法来考虑教育选择的影响。基于估算的模型，我们模拟了提高教育水平所带来的收益，并将这些收益分解为间接效应（通过住院过程的变化体现）和直接效应（由其他因素引起）。我们使用了1951-1960年瑞典男性军事征兵数据，这些数据与行政登记数据相关联。实证结果显示，到63岁为止，教育水平提高所带来的生存概率增益为2%至5.5个百分点，其中受教育程度较低的人群受益最大。这些收益主要源于教育差异对高教育水平人群住院率的影响（1.3个百分点），而受教育程度较低的人群则主要受益于其他因素（4.9个百分点）。然而，对于因早死而导致的63岁前损失月份（2至9个月）的显著教育收益，我们发现教育差异对住院率的影响并不显著。

abstract.text: Hospital ownership of physician practices has grown across the US, and these strategic decisions seem to drive higher prices and spending. Using detailed physician ownership information and a universe of Florida discharge records, we show novel evidence of hospital-physician integration foreclosure effects within outpatient procedure markets. Following hospital acquisition, physicians shift nearly 10% of their Medicare and commercially insured cases away from ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) to hospitals and are up to 18% less likely to use an ASC at all. Altering physician choices over treatment setting can be in conflict with patient and payer cost, convenience, and quality preferences.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102569.abstractZh: 在美国，医院对医生诊所的掌控日益增强，这些战略决策似乎导致了更高的价格和支出。通过详细的医生所有权信息以及佛罗里达州的出院记录，我们发现了医院与医生整合对门诊手术市场产生的影响。在医院收购之后，医生会将近10%的医疗保险和商业保险病例从门诊手术中心转移到医院，并且他们使用门诊手术中心的可能性降低了18%。改变医生治疗地点的选择可能会与患者的成本、支付方的便利性以及质量偏好产生冲突。

abstract.text: Low minimum legal drinking ages (MLDAs), as prevalent in many European countries, are severely understudied. We use rich survey and administrative data to estimate the impact of the Austrian MLDA of 16 on teenage drinking behavior and morbidity. Regression discontinuity estimates show that legal access to alcohol increases the frequency and intensity of drinking, which results in more hospital admissions due to alcohol intoxication. The effects are stronger for boys and teenagers with low socioeconomic background. Evidence suggests that the policy's impact cannot be fully explained by access. Data from an annual large-scale field study show that about 25 percent of retailers sell even hard liquor to underage customers. More generally, perceived access to alcohol is very high and hardly changes at the MLDA. However, teenagers consider binge drinking at weekends to be less harmful after gaining legal access.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102571.abstractZh: 许多欧洲国家普遍实行较低的最低法定饮酒年龄，但关于这一政策的研究却严重不足。我们利用丰富的调查和行政数据，来估算奥地利将法定饮酒年龄设定为16岁的政策对青少年饮酒行为和疾病发病率的影响。回归连续性分析表明，合法饮酒的便利性会增加饮酒的频率和强度，从而导致因酒精中毒而住院的人数增加。这种影响在男孩和来自低社会经济背景的青少年中更为明显。证据表明，该政策的影响不能完全由饮酒的便利性来解释。一项年度大规模实地研究的数据表明，大约25%的零售商甚至向未成年人出售烈酒。总体而言，人们对酒精的获取性感知非常高，且在法定饮酒年龄不变的情况下几乎不会发生变化。然而，青少年在获得合法饮酒权后，认为周末酗酒的危害性降低。

abstract.text: This paper investigates how economic activity impacted Covid-19 infections and all-cause mortality. To this purpose, we exploit the distribution of essential sectors, which were exempted from a national lockdown enacted in Italy during the first wave of the pandemic, across provinces and rich administrative data in a difference-in-differences framework. We find that a standard deviation increase in essential workers per built square kilometre leads to 1.1 additional daily cases and 0.32 additional daily deaths per 100,000 inhabitants. Back of the envelope calculations suggest that about one third (47,000) of the Covid-19 cases and about 13% (13,000) of deaths between March and May of 2020 can be attributed to the less stringent lockdown for these sectors. The effect is heterogeneous across sectors. Finally, we find that the local health system played a relevant role in reducing fatalities with a higher number of general practitioners and hospital beds per capita being associated with a lower mortality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102572.abstractZh: 本文研究了经济活动对新冠感染和全因死亡率的影响。为此，我们利用了意大利在疫情第一波期间实施全国封锁时未被封锁的重要行业分布，并通过差异-差异框架，结合丰富的行政数据进行了分析。研究发现，每平方公里重要行业工作者数量每增加一个标准差，每日新增病例数将增加1.1例，每日新增死亡人数将增加0.32人。初步计算表明，2020年3月至5月期间，约三分之一（47,000例）的新冠病例和约13%（13,000例）的死亡病例可归因于对这些行业的较宽松封锁措施。不同行业之间的影响存在差异。最后，我们发现当地卫生系统在减少死亡人数方面发挥了重要作用，人均全科医生和医院床位数量较多与较低的死亡率相关。

abstract.text: This paper studies how a severe parental health shock affects children's school achievements using a rich longitudinal dataset of Danish children. We use coarsened exact matching to control for potential endogeneity between parental health and children's school outcomes and employ cancer specific survival rates to measure the size of the health shock. We find robust negative (albeit small) effects of a parental health shock on children's basic school grades as well as their likelihood of starting and finishing secondary education, especially for poor prognosis cancers. We observe different outcomes across children's gender and age and gender of the ill parent, but no effects of family-related resilience factors such as parental education level. The effects appear to be driven by non-pecuniary costs rather than by pecuniary costs. Moreover, we find that the negative effects on school performance increase in the size of the health shock for both survivors and non-survivors.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102573.abstractZh: 本文研究了严重的父母健康冲击如何影响儿童的学习成绩，使用了丹麦儿童的丰富纵向数据集。我们通过粗略的精确匹配来控制父母健康与儿童学业成绩之间的潜在内生性，并使用癌症特异性生存率来衡量健康冲击的严重程度。我们发现，父母健康冲击对儿童的基础学校成绩以及他们开始和完成中等教育的可能性有显著的负面影响，尤其是在预后较差的癌症情况下。我们观察到，儿童性别和年龄以及患病父母的性别对结果有不同的影响，但家庭相关的韧性因素，如父母的教育水平，并未产生显著影响。这些影响似乎是由非经济成本而非经济成本所驱动的。此外，我们发现，无论幸存者还是非幸存者，健康冲击的严重程度都会增加其对学业成绩的负面影响。

abstract.text: The patient-provider relationship is considered a cornerstone to delivering high-value healthcare. However, in Medicaid managed care settings, disruptions to this relationship are disproportionately common. In this paper, I evaluate the impact of a primary provider's exit from a Medicaid managed care plan on adult beneficiary healthcare utilization and outcomes. Using an event study approach, I estimate a 5% decrease in the number of beneficiaries with primary care visits in the year following the exit, with slightly larger effects in terms of percentage points for patients with chronic conditions. Additionally, I observe a nearly 50% increase in the number of beneficiaries with a chronic condition who are hospitalized following a disruption.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102574.abstractZh: 患者与医疗服务提供者之间的关系被认为是提供高质量医疗服务的基石。然而，在医疗补助管理式医疗体系中，这种关系的中断尤为常见。本文评估了主要医疗服务提供者退出医疗补助管理式医疗计划对成人患者医疗使用情况和结果的影响。通过事件研究法，我估计在主要医疗服务提供者退出后的一年内，有主要医疗服务的患者的数量减少了5%，对于患有慢性疾病的患者来说，这一影响更为显著，百分比减少了更多。此外，我还观察到，在关系中断后，患有慢性疾病的患者的住院人数增加了近50%。

abstract.text: We measure the benefit to society created by preventing COVID-19 deaths through a marginal increase in early social distancing. We exploit county-level rainfall on the last weekend before statewide lockdown in the early phase of the pandemic. After controlling for historical rainfall, temperature, and state fixed-effects, current rainfall is a plausibly exogenous instrument for social distancing. A one percent decrease in the population leaving home on the weekend before lockdown creates an average of 132 dollars of benefit per county resident within 2 weeks. The impacts of earlier distancing compound over time and mainly arise from lowering the risk of a major outbreak, yielding large but unevenly distributed social benefit.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102575.abstractZh: 我们通过早期社交距离措施的增加来衡量预防COVID-19死亡对社会的益处。我们利用了疫情早期阶段，在全州封锁前的最后一个周末，各县的降雨量作为工具变量。在控制了历史降雨量、温度和州固定效应后，当前的降雨量是社交距离的一个合理的外生工具变量。在封锁前的那个周末，如果人们离开家的人数减少1%，那么在2周内，每个县居民将获得平均132美元的益处。早期采取社交距离措施的影响会随着时间的推移而累积，主要降低重大疫情爆发的风险，从而带来巨大但分布不均的社会效益。

abstract.text: Health insurance systems in many countries reimburse hospitals through fixed prices based on the diagnosis-related groups (DRGs) of patients. We quantify the effects of price and income changes for the full spectrum of hospital services as average and heterogeneous elasticities of quantities (number of admissions) and quality-related outcomes. For our empirical analysis, we use data on over 160 million hospital admissions, constituting the universe of hospital admissions in Germany between 2005 and 2016. Our identification strategy is based on instruments exploiting a two-year lag in regulatory price setting. The strategy lends itself to a placebo test demonstrating that our instruments do not have substantive anticipatory direct effects. We find that the compensated own-price elasticity of quantity is positive (0.2), while the income elasticity is negative (-0.15). On net, increasing all prices increases costs due to a behavioral response of larger quantities in addition to the mechanical increase.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102576.abstractZh: 许多国家的健康保险系统通过基于患者诊断相关组的固定价格来向医院进行报销。我们量化了价格和收入变化对医院服务全谱的影响，包括数量（入院次数）的平均和异质弹性以及与质量相关的结果。在实证分析中，我们使用了超过1.6亿次入院的数据，这些数据涵盖了2005年至2016年间德国的所有入院情况。我们的识别策略基于利用两年滞后时间的监管价格设定工具。该策略适合进行安慰剂测试，以证明我们的工具没有实质性的预期直接效应。我们发现，数量的补偿自身价格弹性为正（0.2），而收入弹性为负（-0.15）。总体而言，提高所有价格会增加成本，因为除了机械性增加之外，还会产生更大数量的行为反应。

abstract.text: This paper studies the impact of a daycare reform on children's mental and physical health development in Sweden. The reform effectively reduced daycare fees by a significant amount and went along with an expansion of supply. We draw on a unique set of comprehensive individual-level healthcare register data over the period 1999-2008. By exploiting variation in reform exposure by birth cohort, we estimate short and medium-run effects on child health at different ages. We find a significant reduction in mental disorders in the medium-run for children affected by the reform. The reform leads to strong and immediate increases in probabilities of diagnosis with physical health conditions that fade out as children get older. Sub-sample analyses indicate that the reform effects are strongly associated with children from disadvantaged backgrounds. An analysis of healthcare utilization shows that affected children have more overall medical visits at younger ages but fewer sickness-related visits in primary school than non-affected children.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102577.abstractZh: 本文研究了瑞典一项托儿改革对儿童身心健康发展影响的探讨。该改革显著降低了托儿费用，并同时扩大了托儿服务供给。我们利用了1999至2008年间一套独特的个人级医疗保健登记数据。通过分析不同出生队列在改革中的暴露情况，我们估算了改革在不同年龄阶段对儿童健康的短期和中期影响。研究发现，受改革影响的儿童在中期出现精神障碍的情况显著减少。改革还使儿童被诊断出身体健康问题的概率在短期内显著增加，但这一影响随着儿童年龄的增长而逐渐减弱。子样本分析表明，改革效果与来自弱势背景的儿童密切相关。对医疗利用情况的分析显示，受改革影响的儿童在较年轻时期总体就诊次数更多，但在小学阶段因疾病就诊的次数却少于未受影响的儿童。

abstract.text: Conditional cash lotteries (CCLs) provide people with opportunities to win monetary prizes only if they make specific behavioral changes. We conduct a case study of Ohio's Vax-A-Million initiative, the first CCL targeting COVID-19 vaccinations. Forming a synthetic control from other states, we find that Ohios incentive scheme increases the vaccinated share of state population by 1.5 percent (0.7 pp), costing sixty-eight dollars per person persuaded to vaccinate. We show this causes significant reductions in COVID-19, preventing at least one infection for every six vaccinations that the lottery had successfully encouraged. These findings are promising for similar CCL public health initiatives.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102578.abstractZh: 条件性现金彩票为人们提供了只有在他们做出特定行为改变的情况下才能赢得金钱奖励的机会。我们对俄亥俄州的“Vax-A-Million”计划进行了案例研究，这是首个针对COVID-19疫苗接种的条件性现金彩票项目。通过与其他州的数据进行合成控制分析，我们发现俄亥俄州的激励方案使该州人口中接种疫苗的比例增加了1.5%（0.7个百分点），而每说服一个人接种疫苗的成本为68美元。我们的研究表明，这一方案显著减少了COVID-19的病例数，在彩票成功鼓励的每六次疫苗接种中，至少可以预防一次感染。这些发现对于类似的条件性现金彩票公共卫生项目具有积极的指导意义。

abstract.text: The continuing drug overdose crisis in the U.S. has highlighted the urgent need for greater access to treatment. This paper examines the impact of openings and closings of substance use disorder treatment facilities in New Jersey on emergency room visits for substance use disorder issues among nearby residents. We find that drug-related ER visits increase by 7.4% after a facility closure and decrease by 6.5% after an opening. The effects are smaller for the middle aged than for either younger or older people, and are also somewhat larger for Black residents, and for those on Medicaid. The results suggest that expanding access to treatment results in significant reductions in morbidity related to drugs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102579.abstractZh: 美国持续存在的药物过量危机凸显了增加治疗机会的紧迫性。本文研究了新泽西州物质使用障碍治疗设施的开业与关闭对附近居民因物质使用障碍而前往急诊室的情况的影响。研究发现，在设施关闭后，与药物相关的急诊就诊次数增加了7.4%，而在设施开业后则减少了6.5%。对于中年人来说，这种影响较小，而年轻人和老年人受影响更为明显。此外，黑人和享受医疗补助的人群受影响更为显著。结果表明，扩大治疗机会可以显著减少与药物相关的发病率。

abstract.text: Temporary incentives are offered in anticipation of persistent effects that are seldom estimated. We use a nationwide randomized experiment in the Philippines to estimate effects of two incentives for health insurance three years after their withdrawal. We find that both temporary incentives had persistent effects on enrollment. A premium subsidy had a small but highly persistent effect. Application assistance offered to those initially unresponsive to the subsidy had a much larger but less persistent effect. The subsidy persuaded those with higher initial stated willingness to pay to enroll and keep enrolling. The offer of application assistance to initial non-compliers with the subsidy achieved a larger immediate effect by drawing in those who stated they valued insurance less and were less likely to re-enroll when the incentives were withdrawn.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2021.102580.abstractZh: 为了预测那些很少被估计的持续性影响，我们提供了临时性的激励措施。我们在菲律宾进行了一项全国性的随机实验，以评估这两种激励措施在取消后三年对健康保险注册情况的影响。研究发现，这两种临时激励措施都产生了持续的注册效果。保费补贴虽然效果较小，但具有高度持续性。而为最初对补贴不响应的用户提供的申请协助则效果更大，但持续性较低。补贴成功说服了那些最初表示愿意支付较高费用的用户继续注册。而为最初不配合补贴的用户提供申请协助则能立即产生更大的效果，因为这种方式吸引了那些认为保险价值较低且不太可能重新注册的用户。

abstract.text: The COVID-19 pandemic has forced federal, state, and local policymakers to respond by legislating, enacting, and enforcing social distancing policies. However, the impact of these policies on healthcare utilization in the United States has been largely unexplored. We examine the impact of county-level shelter in place ordinances on healthcare utilization using two unique datasets-employer-sponsored insurance for over 6 million people in the US and cell phone location data. We find that introduction of these policies was associated with reductions in the use of preventive care, elective care, and the number of weekly visits to physician offices, hospitals and other health care-related industries. However, controlling for county-level exposure to the COVID-19 pandemic as a way to account for the endogenous nature of policy implementation reduces the impact of these policies. Our results imply that while social distancing policies do lead to reductions in healthcare utilization, much of these reductions would have occurred even in the absence of these policies.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102581.abstractZh: COVID-19疫情迫使联邦、州和地方政府决策者通过立法、制定并执行社交距离政策来应对。然而，这些政策对美国医疗服务的利用影响尚未得到充分研究。我们利用两个独特的数据集来研究县级居家令对医疗服务利用的影响——一个是涵盖美国超过600万人的雇主赞助保险数据，另一个是手机位置数据。研究发现，这些政策的实施与预防性护理、选择性护理以及每周前往医生诊所、医院和其他医疗相关行业的次数减少有关。然而，通过控制县级地区对COVID-19疫情的暴露情况，以反映政策实施的内生性，这些政策的影响得到了减弱。我们的结果表明，虽然社交距离政策确实导致了医疗服务利用的减少，但其中大部分减少现象即便在没有这些政策的情况下也会发生。

abstract.text: We study the strategic relationship between hospital investment and provision of service quality. We use a spatial competition framework and allow investment and quality to be complements or substitutes in patient benefit and provider cost. We assume that each hospital commits to a certain investment before deciding on service quality, and that investment is observable and contractible while quality is observable but not contractible. We show that, under a fixed DRG-pricing system, providers' lack of ability to commit to quality leads to under- or overinvestment, relative to the first-best solution. Underinvestment arises when the price-cost margin is positive, and quality and investments are strategic complements, which has implications for optimal contracting. Differently from the simultaneous-move case, the regulator must complement the payment with one more instrument to address under/overinvestment. We also analyse the welfare effects of different policy options (separate payment for investment, higher per-treatment prices, or DRG-refinement policies).

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102588.abstractZh: 我们研究了医院投资与服务质量提供之间的战略关系。我们采用空间竞争框架，并假设投资与服务质量在患者收益和提供者成本方面是互补或替代关系。我们假设每家医院在决定服务质量之前会做出一定的投资决策，且投资是可观察且可协商的，而服务质量则是可观察但不可协商的。我们指出，在固定的DRG定价体系下，提供者无法承诺服务质量会导致相对于最优解的投资不足或过度投资。当价格成本边际为正时，就会出现投资不足的情况，此时服务质量与投资是战略互补关系，这对最优契约安排有重要影响。与同时移动的情况不同，监管机构必须通过另一种工具来补充支付方式，以解决投资不足或过度投资的问题。我们还分析了不同政策选项对福利的影响（如单独支付投资费用、提高每次治疗的费用，或改进DRG定价政策）。

abstract.text: Given limited supply of approved vaccines and constrained medical resources, design of a vaccination strategy to control a pandemic is an economic problem. We use time-series and panel methods with real-world country-level data to estimate effects on COVID-19 cases and deaths of two key elements of mass vaccination - time between doses and vaccine type. We find that new infections and deaths are both significantly negatively associated with the fraction of the population vaccinated with at least one dose. Conditional on first-dose coverage, an increased fraction with two doses appears to offer no further reductions in new cases and deaths. For vaccines from China, however, we find significant effects on both health outcomes only after two doses. Our results support a policy of extending the interval between first and second doses of vaccines developed in Europe and the US. As vaccination progresses, population mobility increases, which partially offsets the direct effects of vaccination. This suggests that non-pharmaceutical interventions remain important to contain transmission as vaccination is rolled out.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102589.abstractZh: 鉴于获批疫苗的供应有限且医疗资源有限，制定控制大流行的疫苗接种策略是一个经济问题。我们利用时间序列和面板方法，结合实际国家层面的数据，来估算大规模疫苗接种中两个关键要素对COVID-19病例和死亡人数的影响——接种间隔时间和疫苗类型。我们发现，新感染病例和死亡人数与至少接种了一剂疫苗的人口比例之间存在显著的负相关关系。在首次接种覆盖率既定的情况下，增加接种两剂疫苗的比例似乎并不会进一步减少新病例和死亡人数。然而，对于来自中国的疫苗，我们发现只有在接种两剂后，它们对健康结果才产生显著影响。我们的研究结果支持延长欧洲和美国开发的疫苗首次接种与第二次接种间隔时间的政策。随着疫苗接种的推进，人口的流动性增加，这在一定程度上抵消了疫苗接种的直接效果。这表明，在疫苗接种过程中，非药物干预措施仍然非常重要，有助于控制疫情传播。

abstract.text: We propose a novel son preference measure that relates the preference to a specific child. We find child-specific son preference to be more common among later born children and in families with fewer sons. Using the novel measure and an interaction instrumental variables approach, we estimate a penalty in early mental functions for unwanted girls of 0.7 standard deviations. This penalty appears to be partially driven by discrimination against girls and partially by pampering of boys. Children's health and parental inputs do not mediate the effect from son preference to mental development. Our findings highlight the relevance of parents' attitudes for a nurturing home environment and healthy brain development.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102590.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新颖的性别偏好衡量方法，该方法将偏好与特定子女联系起来。我们发现，特定子女的性别偏好在晚出生子女以及儿子较少的家庭中更为常见。利用这种新颖的衡量方法以及交互式工具变量方法，我们估计出对不想要的女孩在早期心智发展上存在0.7标准差的惩罚效应。这种惩罚效应部分是由对女孩的歧视所驱动，部分则是由对男孩的溺爱所导致。儿童的健康状况以及父母的投入并未能调节性别偏好对心智发展的影响。我们的研究结果强调了父母态度对于营造养育型家庭环境和促进儿童健康心智发展的重要性。

abstract.text: This paper studies the global R&D effort to fight the deadliest diseases. We find: (1) the elasticity of R&D effort with respect to market size is about 1/2 in the cross-section of diseases; (2) given this elasticity, the R&D response to COVID-19 has been 4 to 26 times greater than that implied by its market size; (3) the aggregate short-term elasticity of science and innovation can be very large, as demonstrated by the aggregate flow of clinical trials increasing by 38% in 2020, with limited crowding out of trials for non-COVID diseases; and (4) public institutions and government-led incentives were a key driver of the COVID-19 R&D effort-with public research institutions accounting for 70 percent of all COVID-19 clinical trials globally. Overall, our work suggests that leveraging early-stage incentives, non-monetary incentives, and public institutions may be important for scaling up global innovation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102591.abstractZh: 本文研究了全球为对抗最致命疾病而进行的研发努力。我们发现：(1)在各类疾病中，研发努力对市场规模的弹性约为1/2；(2)鉴于这一弹性，针对COVID-19的研发响应是市场规模所预期值的4到26倍；(3)科学和创新的整体短期弹性可能非常大，例如2020年临床试验的总数量增加了38%，且对非COVID疾病的临床试验的挤出效应有限；(4)公共机构和政府主导的激励措施是推动COVID-19研发努力的关键因素——全球70%的COVID-19临床试验由公共研究机构承担。总体而言，我们的研究表明，利用早期激励措施、非货币激励以及公共机构可能对于推动全球创新的发展具有重要意义。

abstract.text: The COVID-19 pandemic in the US has been particularly devastating for nursing home residents. A key question is how have some nursing homes been able to effectively protect their residents, while others have not? Using data on the universe of US nursing homes, we examine whether establishment quality is predictive of COVID-19 mortality. Higher-quality nursing homes, as measured by CMS overall five-star rating, have substantially lower COVID-19 mortality through September of 2020. Quality does not predict the ability to prevent any COVID-19 resident or staff cases, but higher-quality establishments prevent the spread of resident infections conditional on having one. Preventing COVID-19 cases and deaths may come at some cost, as high-quality homes have substantially higher non-COVID deaths. The positive correlation between establishment quality and non-COVID mortality is strong enough that high-quality homes also have more total deaths than their low-quality counterparts and this relationship has grown with time. As of late April 2021, five-star homes have experienced 8.4 percent more total deaths than one-star homes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102592.abstractZh: 美国的新冠疫情对养老院居民造成了特别严重的伤害。一个关键问题是，为什么有些养老院能够有效保护居民，而另一些养老院却做不到？通过对比美国所有养老院的统计数据，我们研究了养老院的质量是否能够预测新冠死亡率。根据美国医疗补助服务中心的整体五星评级，质量较高的养老院在2020年9月之前的新冠死亡率明显较低。质量并不能预测养老院能否完全防止任何居民或工作人员感染新冠，但质量较高的养老院能够在出现感染时有效防止其传播。然而，预防新冠病例和死亡可能会带来一些代价，因为质量较高的养老院的非新冠死亡人数也明显更多。养老院质量与非新冠死亡率之间的正相关关系非常显著，高质量养老院的总死亡人数也高于低质量养老院，而且这种关系随着时间的推移而加剧。截至2021年4月底，五星评级的养老院的总死亡人数比一星评级的养老院多出8.4%。

abstract.text: While a large share of Disability Insurance recipients in OECD countries are expected to recover, outflow rates from temporary disability schemes are typically negligible. We estimate the disincentive effects of disability benefits on the response to a (mental) health improvement using administrative data on all Dutch disability benefit applicants. We compare those below the DI eligibility threshold with those above and find that disincentives significantly reduce work resumption after health improves. Approximately half of the response to recovery is offset by benefits. Estimates from a structural labor supply model suggest that disincentives are substantially larger when the worker's earnings capacity is fully restored.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102593.abstractZh: 在经合组织国家中，大部分残疾保险受益人预计会恢复劳动能力，而临时残疾保险计划中的资金流出通常可以忽略不计。我们利用荷兰所有残疾保险申请者的行政数据，估算了残疾福利对改善（心理健康）反应的不利影响。我们将那些未达到残疾保险资格门槛的申请人与达到该门槛的申请人进行比较，发现不利因素显著降低了健康改善后的工作恢复意愿。大约一半的恢复反应被残疾福利所抵消。结构性劳动力供应模型的估计表明，当工人的收入能力完全恢复时，不利因素的影响会更大。

abstract.text: The cost-effectiveness of policies providing subsidized health goods is often compromised by limited use of the goods provided. Through a randomized trial involving 251 primary schools in western China, we tested two approaches to improve the cost-effectiveness of a program distributing free eyeglasses to myopic children. Relative to delivery of free eyeglasses to schools, we find that providing vouchers redeemable in local optical shops modestly improved the targeting of eyeglasses to those who would use them without reducing effective coverage. Information provided through a health education campaign increased eyeglass use when eyeglasses were delivered to schools, but had no effect when requiring voucher redemption or when families were only given a prescription for eyeglasses to be purchased on the market. Though most expensive, free delivery to schools with a health education campaign was the most socially cost-effective approach tested and increased effective coverage of eyeglasses by 18.5 percentage points after seven months.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102594.abstractZh: 提供补贴性健康产品的政策，其成本效益往往因这些产品使用范围的有限而受到影响。通过一项涉及中国西部251所小学的随机试验，我们测试了两种提高向近视儿童免费分发眼镜项目的成本效益的方法。与向学校免费分发眼镜相比，提供可在当地眼镜店兑换的代金券，能够适度提高眼镜的使用率，同时不会减少实际覆盖人数。通过健康教育活动提供的信息，在眼镜被分发到学校时能够增加眼镜的使用率，但在要求兑换代金券或仅向家庭提供购买眼镜的处方时，则没有效果。尽管成本最高，但使用健康教育活动向学校免费分发眼镜的方法在测试中被证明是最具有社会成本效益的，七个月后，眼镜的实际覆盖率提高了18.5个百分点。

abstract.text: This study assesses the health risks associated with drinking water contamination using variation in the timing and location of shale gas development (SGD). Our novel dataset, linking health and drinking water outcomes to shale gas activity through water sources, enables us to provide new estimates of the causal effects of water pollution on health and to isolate drinking water as a specific mechanism of exposure for SGD. We find consistent and robust evidence that drilling shale gas wells negatively impacts both drinking water quality and infant health. These results indicate large social costs of water pollution and provide impetus for re-visiting the regulation of public drinking water.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102595.abstractZh: 本研究通过评估页岩气开发的时间和地点变化对饮用水污染带来的健康风险，来研究这一问题。我们拥有新颖的数据集，能够将健康与饮用水状况与页岩气活动通过水源联系起来，从而能够给出关于水污染对健康影响的新的估计值，并明确饮用水是页岩气暴露的一个具体途径。我们发现，钻探页岩气井对饮用水质量和婴儿健康都有负面影响。这些结果表明水污染带来了巨大的社会成本，并促使我们重新考虑公共饮用水的监管问题。

abstract.text: We study the role of relative task-specific skill in explaining the heterogeneity in physicians' technology abandonment decisions in response to negative information shocks. We show that after an unexpected FDA safety warning on the use of minimally invasive hysterectomies, physicians alter their procedural mix towards open procedures and away from the minimally invasive procedures. This effect is less pronounced for physicians more skilled in performing minimally invasive procedures relative to open procedures, highlighting relative skill as an explanation for differential technology abandonment. Since physicians with higher relative skill are more likely to use minimally invasive procedures before the FDA safety communication, we find that the FDA intervention led to a substantial increase in practice variation across physicians with different relative skill levels. These findings are consistent with a theoretical model that predicts physicians' response to new information regarding the effectiveness of medical technology.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102596.abstractZh: 我们研究了相对特定任务技能在解释医生对负面信息冲击下的技术放弃决策异质性中的作用。我们发现，在收到关于微创手术使用的意外FDA安全警告后，医生会改变他们的手术方式，更倾向于采用开放手术，而减少使用微创手术。对于那些在执行微创手术方面相对更熟练的医生来说，这种效应并不明显，这凸显了相对技能作为解释不同医生技术放弃行为的因素。由于具有更高相对技能的医生在FDA安全通报之前更可能使用微创手术，我们发现FDA的干预显著增加了不同技能水平的医生之间的实践差异。这些发现与一种理论模型一致，该模型预测医生会对有关医疗技术有效性的新信息作出反应。

abstract.text: Missed clinic appointments or no-shows burden health care systems through inefficient use of staff time and resources. Scheduling software with automatic appointment reminders shows promise to improve clinics' management through timely cancellations and re-scheduling, but at-scale evidence is missing. We study a nationwide text message appointment reminder program in Chile implemented at primary care clinics for patients with chronic disease. Using longitudinal clinic-level data, we find that the program did not change the number of visits by chronic patients eligible to receive the reminder but visits from other patients ineligible to receive reminders increased by 5.0% in the first year and 7.4% in the second. Clinics treating more chronic patients and those with a relatively younger patient population benefited more from the program. Scheduling systems with automatic appointment reminders were effective in increasing clinics' ability to care for more patients, likely due to timely cancellations and re-scheduling.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102598.abstractZh: 错过诊所预约或无故缺席会给医疗系统带来负担，因为会导致人员时间和资源的低效使用。带有自动预约提醒功能的预约软件在及时取消和重新安排预约方面显示出改善诊所管理的潜力，但大规模应用的证据尚缺。我们研究了智利一项针对慢性病患者的初级保健诊所实施的全国性的短信预约提醒计划。通过利用诊所层面的纵向数据，我们发现该计划并未改变有资格接收提醒的慢性病患者的就诊次数，但其他没有资格接收提醒的患者的就诊次数在第一年增加了5.0%，在第二年增加了7.4%。治疗更多慢性病患者以及拥有相对年轻患者群体的诊所从该计划中获益更多。带有自动预约提醒功能的预约系统确实有效提高了诊所照顾更多患者的能力，这可能是由于及时取消和重新安排预约的作用。

abstract.text: In this paper, I propose a life cycle model of occupational choice with endogenous health behavior, aging, and longevity. Health-demanding work leads to a faster accumulation of health deficits and is remunerated with a hazard markup on wages. Health deficit accumulation is also influenced by unhealthy consumption and health care expenditure. I calibrate the model for a 20 year old average American in 2010 and show the following results, among others. Health-demanding work is ceteris paribus preferred by male, young, and healthy individuals with a relatively low level of education. Health demanding work has a negligible effect on health behavior because income and health investment effects largely offset each other, implying that health effects can be attributed almost fully to the direct health burden of work. Better medical technology induces low-skilled individuals to spend a greater part of their life in health-demanding work and thus increases the health gradient of education. High wealth endowments protect against unhealthy occupational choices. I show robustness of the results in an extension of the model with regard to endogenous retirement.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102599.abstractZh: 在本文中，我提出了一个包含内生健康行为、老龄化与寿命延长因素的职业选择生命周期模型。对健康要求较高的工作会导致健康缺陷的更快积累，并且其报酬以工资上的风险加成形式体现。健康缺陷的积累还受到不健康消费和医疗保健支出的影响。我对该模型进行了校准，以2010年平均年龄为20岁的美国人为基础，并得出了以下结果：在“其他条件不变”的情况下，对健康要求较高的工作更受男性、年轻且健康、教育水平相对较低的人群青睐。由于收入和健康投资的影响在很大程度上相互抵消，对健康行为的影响微乎其微，这意味着健康效应几乎完全归因于工作的直接健康负担。更先进的医疗技术促使低技能人群在健康要求较高的工作中花费更多时间，从而加剧了教育水平与健康状况之间的梯度差异。较高的财富禀赋能够保护人们免受不健康职业选择的影响。我还展示了该模型在包含内生退休因素的情况下的稳健性。

abstract.text: There is a widely held perception that staff shortages in low and middle-income countries (LMICs) lead to excessive workloads, which in turn worsen the quality of healthcare. Yet there is little evidence supporting these claims. We use data from standardised patient visits in Senegal and determine the effect of workload on the quality of primary care by exploiting quasi-random variation in workload. We find that despite a lack of staff, average levels of workload are low. Even at times when workload is high, there is no evidence that provider effort or quality of care are significantly reduced. Our data indicate that providers operate below their production possibility frontier and have sufficient capacity to attend more patients without compromising quality. This contradicts the prevailing discourse that staff shortages are a key reason for poor quality primary care in LMICs and suggests that the origins likely lie elsewhere.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102600.abstractZh: 普遍认为，低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的人员短缺导致工作量过大，进而降低了医疗服务的质量。然而，几乎没有证据支持这一说法。我们利用了塞内加尔的标准化患者访问数据，通过研究工作量的准随机变化，来探讨工作量对初级医疗服务质量的影响。研究发现，尽管人员不足，平均工作量仍然较低。即使在工作量较大的时候，也没有证据表明提供者的努力或护理质量显著下降。我们的数据表明，提供者在其生产可能性边界之下工作，但他们有足够的能力在不影响质量的情况下接待更多的患者。这与普遍的观点相矛盾，即人员短缺是低收入和中等收入国家初级医疗服务质量不佳的主要原因，这表明问题的根源可能在于其他方面。

abstract.text: We study in-utero exposure to economic fluctuations on birth outcomes by exploiting geographical variation in the unemployment rate across local areas in England, and by comparing siblings born to the same mother. Using rich individual data from hospital administrative records for 2003-2012, babies' health is found to be strongly pro-cyclical. This overall result masks marked differences between babies born in the most affluent areas whose health at birth improves in a recession, and babies born in the average-to-lowest income deprived areas whose health deteriorates. Maternal alcohol consumption, smoking, and delay in the first antenatal care assessment - combined with parental income loss, are found to drive the results. While differences in maternal risky behaviours can explain the heterogenous effects.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102601.abstractZh: 我们通过利用英格兰各地失业率之间的地理差异，并比较同一母亲所生的兄弟姐妹，来研究子宫内经济波动对出生结果的影响。利用2003-2012年医院行政记录中的丰富个人数据，我们发现婴儿的健康状况表现出明显的顺周期性。这一总体结果掩盖了两个方面的显著差异：出生在最富裕地区的婴儿在经济衰退时健康状况有所改善，而出生在平均或最低收入贫困地区的婴儿健康状况则恶化。研究发现，母亲饮酒、吸烟以及初次产前护理评估的延迟，再加上父母收入减少等因素，都导致了这种结果。虽然母亲的风险行为差异可以解释这些异质性效应。

abstract.text: We investigate the effects of incentivizing early prenatal care utilization on infant health by exploiting a reform that required expectant mothers to initiate prenatal care during the first ten weeks of gestation to obtain a one-time monetary transfer paid after childbirth. Applying a difference-in-differences design to individual-level data on the population of births and fetal deaths, we identify modest but statistically significant positive effects of the policy on neonatal health. We further provide suggestive evidence that improved maternal health-related knowledge and behaviors during pregnancy are plausible channels through which the reform might have affected fetal health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102612.abstractZh: 我们研究了激励早期产前护理使用对婴儿健康的影响，通过一项改革措施来探讨这一影响。该改革要求孕妇在妊娠的前十周内开始产前护理，以便在分娩后获得一次性现金奖励。利用关于出生和胎儿死亡个体层面的数据，我们发现了该政策对新生儿健康有适度但统计上显著的积极影响。此外，我们还提供了一些有启发性的证据，表明在怀孕期间提高孕妇的健康相关知识和行为可能是该改革影响胎儿健康的合理途径。

abstract.text: Two-part pricing (the Netflix model) has recently been proposed instead of uniform pricing for pharmaceuticals. Under two-part pricing the health plan pays a fixed fee for access to a drug at unit prices equal to marginal costs. Despite two-part pricing being socially efficient, we show that the health plan is worse off when the drug producer is a monopolist, as all surplus is extracted. This result is reversed with competition, as two-part pricing yields higher patient utility and lower drug costs for the health plan. However, if we allow for exclusive contracts, uniform pricing is preferred by the health plan. The choice of payment scheme is also shown to influence on the incentives to spend resources on drastic innovations relative to incremental, me-too innovations.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102613.abstractZh: 最近，人们提出了采用双部分定价模式（即Netflix模式）来替代药品的统一定价方式。在双部分定价模式下，健康计划以等于边际成本的单价支付药品使用费用。尽管双部分定价在 socially 层面是高效的，但我们发现，当药品生产商处于垄断地位时，健康计划的状况会变得更糟，因为所有超额收益都被垄断者攫取。而在竞争环境下，双部分定价能够提升患者的效用，并降低健康计划的药品成本。然而，如果允许独家合同，健康计划更倾向于采用统一定价方式。此外，支付方案的选择也会影响资源在重大创新与渐进式创新之间的分配动机。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the effect of a national salt iodization program on the cognition of school-aged children in China. We focus on the role of gender preferences. Linking pre-eradication iodine deficiency rates with household survey data, we find a strong positive impact of prenatal exposure to the program on cognition and schooling for girls. For boys, we find no effect. Child preferences play an important role in parental investment decisions and impact program effects. We find that parents invest more in girls with a high initial endowment. For boys, this is different. Parents invest in boys, irrespective of their initial endowment. The nationally implemented program may therefore primarily benefit low endowment girls. We then exploit village-level variation in gender attitudes and find that gender attitudes are related to parental investment behavior and that the program's impact is stronger for girls born to parents with strong preferences for boys.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102614.abstractZh: 本文评估了全国食盐碘化计划对中国学龄儿童认知能力的影响。我们重点关注性别偏好在其中的作用。通过将碘缺乏率与家庭调查数据联系起来，我们发现女性在计划实施前的碘摄入情况对她们的认知能力和教育程度有显著的积极影响。而对于男孩来说，则未发现这种影响。儿童偏好在父母的投资决策中起着重要作用，并影响计划的实施效果。我们发现，父母会更多地投资于初始禀赋较高的女孩，而对于男孩则不同，父母会投资于男孩，而不考虑他们的初始禀赋。因此，全国实施的这项计划可能主要惠及初始禀赋较低的女孩。接下来，我们进一步分析了村级性别态度的差异，发现性别态度与父母的投资行为相关，且对于由偏好男孩的父母所生的女孩来说，计划的影响更为显著。

abstract.text: Sickness absence entails large individual and societal costs. Dialogue Meetings (DMs) where the absentee, the employer, and the physician discuss arrangements for full or partial work resumption have been in place in Norway since 2007. In collaboration with the Labour and Welfare Administration, we conducted a large-scale, pre-registered, randomized field experiment to evaluate aspects of the Norwegian DMs policy. We do not find statistically significant effects of summoning to a meeting and we can reject even small threat (notification) effects of sending out letters. We also conduct an extensive search for heterogeneous treatment effects but find no evidence of these.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102615.abstractZh: 因病缺勤会给个人和社会带来巨大成本。自2007年以来，挪威就实施了“对话会议”制度，即缺勤者、雇主和医生共同讨论完全或部分恢复工作的安排。我们与劳动与福利管理部门合作，开展了一项大规模的、预先注册的随机实地实验，以评估挪威“对话会议”政策的各个方面。我们发现，召集会议并没有产生统计学上的显著效果，甚至无法排除发送通知所带来的微小影响。此外，我们进行了广泛的异质处理效应研究，但并未发现相关证据。

abstract.text: Unlike demand studies in other industries, models of provider demand in health care often must omit a price, or any other factor that equilibrates the market such as a waiting time. Estimates of the consumer response to quality may consequently be attenuated, if the limited capacity of individual physicians prevents some consumers from obtaining higher quality. We propose a tractable method to address this problem by adding a congestion effect to standard discrete-choice models. We show analytically how this can improve forecasts of the consumer response to quality. We then apply this method to the market for heart surgery, and find that the attenuation bias in estimated quality effects can be important empirically.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102616.abstractZh: 与其他行业的需求研究不同，医疗保健领域提供方需求的模型通常必须忽略价格或任何其他平衡市场的因素，例如等待时间。如果个别医生的服务能力有限，导致一些消费者无法获得更高质量的服务，那么对质量反应的估计可能会减弱。我们提出了一种可行的方法，通过向标准离散选择模型中添加拥堵效应来解决这一问题。我们从理论上证明了这种方法如何改善对质量反应的预测。然后，我们将这种方法应用于心脏手术市场，发现估计的质量效应中的衰减偏差在实证上可能非常重要。

abstract.text: In 2007, Australia introduced its most radical welfare reform in recent history, targeting Aboriginal communities with the aim of protecting children from harm. The 'income management' policy forced Aboriginal welfare recipients to spend at least half of their government transfers on essentials (e.g. food, housing), and less on non-essentials (e.g. alcohol, tobacco). By exploiting its staggered rollout, we estimate the impact of in utero exposure to the policy rollout on birthweight. We find that exposure to the income management policy reduced average birthweight robustly by 85 g and increased the risk of low birth weight by 3 percentage points. This finding is not explained by behavioral change (fertility, maternal risk behavior, access to care), or survival probabilities of at-risk fetuses. More likely, a lack of policy implementation planning and infrastructure led to acute income insecurity and stress during the rollout period, exacerbating the existing health inequalities it sought to address.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102618.abstractZh: 2007年，澳大利亚实施了近史上最为激进的福利改革，该改革针对原住民社区，旨在保护儿童免受伤害。所谓的“收入管理”政策要求原住民福利领取者将至少一半的政府转移支付用于必需品（如食品、住房），而用于非必需品（如酒精、烟草）的资金则减少。通过分析政策的逐步实施过程，我们评估了政策实施期间胎儿暴露于该政策对出生体重的影响。研究发现，暴露于“收入管理”政策使得平均出生体重减少了85克，同时低出生体重的风险增加了3个百分点。这一结果无法用行为变化（如生育率、母亲的风险行为、医疗保健获取情况）或高风险胎儿的预期生存概率来解释。更有可能的是，由于政策实施规划和基础设施的不足，导致在政策实施期间出现了严重的收入不稳定和压力，从而加剧了原本试图解决的现有健康不平等问题。

abstract.text: Do better material conditions improve well-being and mental health? Or does any positive relationship merely reflect that well-being promotes economic success? We compare winners and losers from a large Ethiopian housing lottery in a preregistered analysis. Winners gain access to better housing, experience a substantial increase in wealth, and report higher levels of overall life satisfaction and lower levels of financial distress. However, we find no average effects of winning on psychological distress. Our results suggest that not all aspects of well-being and mental health are equally sensitive to economic conditions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102619.abstractZh: 更好的物质条件是否能提升幸福感和心理健康？还是说，任何积极的关系都仅仅反映了幸福感能够促进经济成功？我们通过预注册分析，比较了埃塞俄比亚一项大型住房抽奖活动中的中奖者和落选者。中奖者获得了更好的住房，财富显著增加，并且报告称整体生活满意度更高，财务压力也更低。然而，我们发现中奖对心理压力没有平均效应。我们的结果表明，幸福感和心理健康的各个方面并非都同样受经济条件的影响。

abstract.text: We provide evidence on the effectiveness of a school-based program that uses a non-monetary penalty and regular monitoring to prevent risky behavior among adolescents in Indonesia. The field experiment invited students to sign a pledge to abstain from tobacco use and a similar pledge for parents to monitor their children. To test group incentives, a subset of treated schools also competed against each other for the highest tobacco abstinence rates. We find that the individual pledge increases biochemically verified tobacco abstinence by 5 percentage points. This effect is sustained 3 months after the program ended. School competition has no additional impact on tobacco abstinence. Our findings highlight the effectiveness of non-monetary incentives to curb risky behaviors among adolescents who face limited self-control and peer pressure.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102620.abstractZh: 我们提供了关于一种基于学校的项目的有效性证据，该项目采用非金钱惩罚和定期监督的方式，旨在预防印度尼西亚青少年的危险行为。实地实验要求学生签署承诺不吸烟的协议，同时要求家长监督子女的行为。为了测试群体激励的效果，部分受干预的学校还相互竞争，以争取最高的烟草戒除率。我们发现，个人承诺使生物化学验证的烟草戒除率提高了5个百分点。这一效果在项目结束后持续了3个月。学校间的竞争对烟草戒除率没有额外的影响。我们的研究结果凸显了非金钱激励在遏制那些面临有限自我控制和同伴压力的青少年危险行为方面的有效性。

abstract.text: Disability onset and major health shocks can affect the labor supply of those experiencing the event and their family members, who face a tradeoff between time spent earning income and providing care. This decision could be affected by the availability of paid family leave. We examine the role of paid leave mandates in caregiving and labor supply decisions after a spouse's disability or health shock. Using data from the Survey of Income and Program Participation, we show that paid leave mandates reduce the likelihood that potential caregivers report decreasing their paid work hours to provide caregiving after a spouse's health shock. However, if caregivers are unlikely to have access to job protection, paid leave mandates also increase the likelihood of leaving the labor market to provide caregiving and working fewer weeks. There is limited evidence of an effect of paid leave on other employment outcomes. Our findings demonstrate that paid leave has some influence on household labor supply decisions after spousal health shocks, but its role should be considered together with the availability of job protection.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102621.abstractZh: 残疾的发生以及重大的健康冲击都可能影响经历这些事件的人及其家庭成员的劳动力供应，这些人需要在赚取收入和提供照顾之间做出权衡。这一决策可能会受到带薪家庭假期的可用性影响。我们研究了在配偶遭遇残疾或健康冲击后，带薪休假规定对照顾工作和劳动力供应决策的影响。通过《收入与计划参与调查》的数据分析，我们发现带薪休假规定降低了潜在照顾者在配偶健康冲击后减少带薪工作时间以进行照顾的可能性。然而，如果照顾者不太可能获得工作保护，带薪休假规定还会增加他们离开劳动力市场以进行照顾工作以及减少工作周数的可能性。关于带薪休假对其他就业结果影响的证据有限。我们的研究结果表明，带薪休假确实对家庭在配偶健康冲击后的劳动力供应决策有一定影响，但其作用应结合工作保护的可用性来综合考虑。

abstract.text: We estimate the impact of a cash transfer targeting new mothers on their subsequent children's health outcomes at birth. We exploit the unexpected introduction of a generous, universal child benefit in Spain in 2007. Using population-wide, individual-level, high-quality administrative data from birth records and a regression discontinuity approach, we find that women who received the benefit were much less likely to have low-birth-weight children in the future (while their subsequent fertility was unaffected). The overall effect is driven by poor women, unmarried women, and women with low education, and by births taking place relatively soon after the benefit receipt. The €2500 transfer led to a 0.7 percentage-point decline in the fraction of children born under 1500 g in poorer households in the following five years, an 83% reduction. We explore the underlying channels, and find evidence supporting faster intrauterine growth, possibly driven by better maternal health, nutrition, and behaviors. Gestation length, family structure, and parental employment do not seem to play a role. Recent research suggests that targeting pregnant women may be more effective than later interventions (such as cash transfers to families with children), given the strong persistence of fetal health effects. Our results suggest that the impact may be stronger if women are targeted even earlier, before conception.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102622.abstractZh: 我们估计了针对新母亲的现金转移对她们后续子女出生健康结果的影响。我们利用了2007年西班牙意外引入的慷慨且普遍的儿童福利政策这一契机。通过利用出生记录中的全国范围、个体层面的高质量行政数据，并采用回归 discontinuity 方法，我们发现获得该福利的女性未来生育低体重婴儿的可能性显著降低（而她们的后续生育能力并未受到影响）。这一效应主要出现在贫困女性、未婚女性以及教育水平较低的女性身上，且这些福利的领取时间通常在出生后不久。2500欧元的现金转移使得贫困家庭在随后五年内出生体重低于1500克的儿童比例下降了0.7个百分点，即减少了83%。我们进一步探讨了背后的机制，发现证据表明宫内生长速度加快，这可能是由于母亲的健康状况、营养状况以及行为方面的改善所致。妊娠时长、家庭结构以及父母就业情况似乎并未起到作用。最近的研究表明，与后期干预措施（如向有子女的家庭提供现金转移）相比，针对孕妇进行干预可能更为有效，因为胎儿健康的影响具有强烈的持久性。我们的研究结果表明，如果女性在受孕前就进行干预，效果可能会更加显著。

abstract.text: We document the effect of violent media on crime. Specifically, we evaluate the effects of The Ultimate Fighter, a hit TV show that features fighters competing in violent mixed martial arts and which brought Ultimate Fighting Championship into the mainstream. We estimate the effect of exposure to the show's earliest episodes using panel data from police agencies across the United States and a strategy that uses network ratings prior to the show's premier as an instrumental variable. We show that this exposure significantly reduced crime: these effects are particularly evident for assault, began in the month the show premiered, and persisted for many years. These estimates do not reflect systematic differences across geographic areas in their trends in crime rates prior to 2005. To complement our main results, we also investigate the effects of "UFC Main Events," which air in bars and on Pay-Per-View. This analysis additionally suggests reductions in violence caused by viewership.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102623.abstractZh: 我们研究了暴力媒体对犯罪的影响。具体来说，我们评估了《终极格斗冠军赛》这一热门电视节目对犯罪的影响。该节目以格斗选手参加激烈的混合武术比赛为特色，使《终极格斗冠军赛》走进了主流视野。我们通过来自美国各地警察机构的面板数据，并利用节目首播前的新闻报道作为工具变量，来估算观众接触该节目早期剧集的影响。结果显示，这种接触显著降低了犯罪率：这些影响在节目首播当月尤为明显，并且持续了多年。这些估计结果并未反映出2005年之前不同地理区域犯罪率趋势的系统性差异。为了补充我们的主要研究结果，我们还研究了在酒吧和付费观看平台上播放的《终极格斗冠军赛》对犯罪的影响。这项分析还表明，观众观看该节目有助于减少暴力行为。

abstract.text: Medicare pricing is known to indirectly influence provider prices and care provision for non-Medicare patients; however, Medicare's regulatory externalities beyond fee-setting are less well understood. We study how physicians' outpatient surgery choices for non-Medicare patients responded to Medicare removing a ban on ambulatory surgery center (ASC) use for a specific procedure. Following the rule change, surgeons began reallocating both Medicare and commercially insured patients to ASCs. Specifically, physicians became 70% more likely to use ASCs for the policy-targeted procedure among their non-Medicare patients. These novel findings demonstrate that Medicare rulemaking affects physician behavior beyond the program's statutory scope.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102624.abstractZh: 众所周知，医疗保险的定价会间接影响非医疗保险患者的医疗服务提供价格；然而，医疗保险在费用设定之外的监管影响则较为模糊。本研究探讨了医生在非医疗保险患者中的门诊手术选择如何受到医疗保险取消对特定手术使用门诊手术中心禁令的影响。随着规则的变更，外科医生开始将医疗保险和商业保险患者的手术转至门诊手术中心。具体而言，医生在非医疗保险患者中，使用门诊手术中心进行政策目标手术的可能性增加了70%。这些新发现表明，医疗保险的法规制定对医生的行为产生了超出该计划法定范围的影响。

abstract.text: Many countries use uniform cost-effectiveness criteria to determine whether to adopt a new medical technology for the entire population. This approach assumes homogeneous preferences for expected health benefits and side effects. We examine whether new prescription drugs generate welfare gains when accounting for heterogeneous preferences by constructing quality-adjusted price indices in the market for colorectal cancer drug treatments. We find that while the efficacy gains from newer drugs do not justify high prices for the population as a whole, innovation improves the welfare of sicker, late-stage cancer patients. A uniform evaluation criterion would not permit these innovations despite welfare gains to a subpopulation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102625.abstractZh: 许多国家采用统一的成本效益标准来决定是否将新的医疗技术应用于全体人口。这种方法假设人们对预期的健康益处和副作用有着相同的偏好。我们通过构建结直肠癌药物治疗市场的质量调整价格指数，来研究在考虑异质偏好的情况下，新处方药是否仍能带来福利收益。研究发现，尽管新药物的有效性提升并不足以使整体人群承受高昂的价格，但创新确实改善了病情较重的晚期癌症患者的福祉。然而，统一的评估标准并不允许这些创新，即使这些创新对某个子群体而言能带来福利收益。

abstract.text: We study preferences for different types of home care insurance using a discrete choice experiment. We consider domestic, personal, and social care, a home care annuity, and a lump-sum for home adaptations. To understand variation in preferences, we relate willingness to pay to personal circumstances, preferences, and expectations. We find that the majority value in-kind and in-cash insurance above the actuarial premium. While most respondents value coverage for basic levels of support, we find diminishing marginal utility for higher levels of support. For in-kind care, willingness to pay is positively associated with respondent characteristics: being single, household income, home ownership, risk aversion, low bequest motives, expected length of home care use, expected expenditures when in need of care, and low expected availability of informal care. In contrast, in-cash support is valued regardless of respondent characteristics, possibly because its inherent flexibility. These results contribute to the design of insurance schemes for home care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102626.abstractZh: 我们通过离散选择实验研究了不同类型的家庭护理保险偏好。我们考虑了家庭、个人和社会护理、家庭护理年金以及家庭改造的一次性支付方案。为了理解偏好差异，我们将支付意愿与个人状况、偏好和预期联系起来。研究发现，大多数人认为实物和现金保险的价值高于精算费用。虽然大多数受访者重视基本水平的支持，但我们发现对更高水平支持的边际效用逐渐降低。对于实物护理，支付意愿与受访者的一些特征呈正相关：单身状态、家庭收入、房屋所有权、风险厌恶、较低的遗产动机、预期的家庭护理使用时间、需要护理时的预期支出，以及非正式护理的预期可获得性较低。相比之下，现金支持则不受受访者特征的影响，可能是因为其固有的灵活性。这些结果有助于设计家庭护理保险方案。

abstract.text: Many stated-preference studies that seek to estimate the marginal willingness-to-pay (WTP) for reductions in mortality or morbidity risk suffer from inadequate scope sensitivity. One possible reason is that the risk reductions presented to respondents are too small to be meaningful. Survey responses may thus not accurately reflect respondents preferences for health and safety. In this paper we propose a novel approach to estimating the value per statistical life (VSL) or the value per statistical case (VSC) based on larger risk reductions measurable as percent changes. While such non-marginal risk reductions are easier to understand, they introduce well known biases. We propose a methodology to de-bias VSL and VSC estimates derived from the evaluation of non-marginal risk reductions and present a proof of concept using simulated stated preference data.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102627.abstractZh: 许多旨在估算减少死亡或疾病风险所需支付意愿的研究都存在范围敏感性不足的问题。一个可能的原因是，提供给受访者的风险减少幅度太小，无法产生有意义的反馈。因此，调查结果可能无法准确反映受访者对健康与安全的偏好。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于更大风险减少幅度（以百分比变化表示）来估算每统计生命价值（VSL）或每统计案例价值（VSC）的新方法。虽然这种非边际风险减少更容易理解，但它们会引入众所周知的偏差。我们提出了一种方法来消除从非边际风险减少评估中得出的VSL和VSC估算的偏差，并使用模拟的声明偏好数据展示了这一概念的实现。

abstract.text: High and increasing hospital prices could reflect market imperfections, including provider concentration. Yet high prices could also reflect increased willingness to pay by privately insured consumers for clinical and non-clinical quality. In this paper, we explore strategic quality choices where hospitals make quality investments to increase private revenue.
