We then measure the relationship between potential prices and numerous quality measures including patient satisfaction, hospital processes, risk-adjusted mortality, the revealed preferences of current Medicare patients, technology adoption, physician quality, and ED wait times. We show that across a range of measures quality is correlated with the profitability of the payer mix: hospitals with more potential privately insured patients are of higher quality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102636.abstractZh: 不断上升的医院价格可能反映了市场的不完善性，包括医疗服务提供者的集中现象。然而，高昂的价格也可能反映出私人保险消费者对于临床和非临床服务的支付意愿增加。在本文中，我们探讨了医院通过质量投资来增加私人收入时的战略选择。随后，我们测量了潜在价格与多种质量指标之间的关系，包括患者满意度、医院流程、风险调整后的死亡率、当前医疗保险患者的偏好信息、技术采用率、医生质量以及急诊室的等待时间。研究表明，在多种指标中，质量与支付方组合的盈利能力呈正相关：拥有更多潜在私人保险患者的医院质量更高。

abstract.text: This paper analyses the effects of maternal age at birth on children's short and long-term outcomes using Finnish register data. We exploit a school starting age rule for identification. Mothers who are born after the school entry cut-off give birth at higher age, but total fertility and earnings are unaffected. Being born after the cut-off reduces gestation and, hence, child birth weight. The effects on birth weight and gestation are rather small, however, suggesting that the long-run impacts may be limited. Accordingly, we find no impacts on longer-term child outcomes, such as educational attainment and adolescent crime rates. Thus, using this source of variation, we find no favorable average effects of maternal age at birth on child outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102637.abstractZh: 本文利用芬兰的登记数据，分析了母亲出生时的年龄对儿童短期和长期结果的影响。我们采用了学校入学年龄作为识别标准。在入学截止日期之后出生的母亲生育年龄较大，但总生育率和收入并未受到影响。出生时间晚于截止日期会导致妊娠期缩短，进而降低婴儿出生体重。然而，对出生体重和妊娠期的影响相对较小，这表明长期影响可能有限。因此，我们发现母亲出生时的年龄对儿童长期结果，如教育成就和青少年犯罪率，没有显著影响。综上所述，利用这一变量来源，我们并未发现母亲出生时的年龄对儿童结果有积极的平均影响。

abstract.text: We examine whether caps on noneconomic damages in medical malpractice cases affect in-hospital patient safety. We use Patient Safety Indicators - measures of adverse events - as proxies for safety. In difference-in-differences ("DiD") analyses of five states that adopt caps during 2003-2005, we find that multiple measures of non-fatal patient safety events worsen after cap adoption relative to control states. DiD inference can be unreliable with a small number of treated units. We therefore develop a randomization inference-based test for inference with few treated units but multiple correlated outcomes and confirm the robustness of our results with this nonparametric approach. We also provide evidence that the decline in patient safety is unlikely to be driven by patient selection.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102638.abstractZh: 我们研究医疗过失案件中对非经济损失上限的设定是否会影响医院内的患者安全。我们使用患者安全指标——即不良事件的衡量标准——作为安全性的替代指标。通过对2003-2005年间五个采用上限政策的州的差异-差异分析（“DiD”）研究，我们发现，与对照组相比，多个非致命性患者安全事件的指标在采用上限政策后恶化。当处理单位数量较少时，DiD推断可能不可靠。因此，我们开发了一种基于随机化的推断方法，适用于处理单位较少但存在多个相关结果的情况，并通过这种非参数方法确认了我们结果的稳健性。我们还提供了证据，表明患者安全的下降不太可能是由患者选择导致的。

abstract.text: We study whether caregiving and intergenerational transfer decisions are sensitive to changes in economic incentives following the inception of a new unconditional and universal system of allowances and supports, after the introduction of the 2006 Promotion of Personal Autonomy and Care for Dependent Persons Act (SAAD in Spanish), and the ensuing effects of its austerity cuts after 2012. We find that whilst the introduction of a caregiving allowance (of a maximum value of €530 in 2011) increased the supply of informal caregiving by 20-22 percentual points (pp), the inception of a companion system of publicly subsidised homecare supports did not modify the supply of care. Consistent with an exchange motive for intergenerational transfers, we estimate an average 17 pp (8.2-8.7pp) increase (decrease) in downstream (upstream) transfers among those receiving caregiving allowances. Our estimates resulting from the reduction in the allowances and supports after the austerity cuts in 2012 are consistent with our main estimates, and suggest stronguer effects among lower-income families.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102639.abstractZh: 我们研究了在2006年《促进个人自主与照顾依赖者法案》实施后，以及2012年之后的紧缩政策影响下，经济激励因素发生变化时，照料服务和代际转移决策是否受到影响。研究发现，虽然引入照料津贴（2011年最高金额为530欧元）使非正式照料服务的供应增加了20-22个百分点，但引入公共补贴的家庭护理支持系统并未改变照料服务的供应。与代际转移的经济交换动机一致，我们估计接受照料津贴的群体之间的向下游（上游）转移量平均增加了17个百分点（8.2-8.7个百分点）。2012年紧缩政策后津贴和服务的减少所带来的估计结果与我们的主要估计一致，并表明低收入家庭受到的影响更为显著。

abstract.text: Excessive length of hospital stay is among the leading sources of inefficiency in healthcare. When a patient is clinically fit to be discharged but requires support outside the hospital, which is not readily available, they remain hospitalized until a safe discharge is possible -a phenomenon called bed-blocking. I study whether the availability of subsidized nursing homes and home care teams reduces hospital bed-blocking. Using individual data on the universe of inpatient admissions at Portuguese hospitals during 2000-2015, I find that the entry of home care teams in a region reduces bed-blocking by 4 days per episode, on average. Nursing home entry only reduces bed-blocking among patients with high care needs or when the intensity of entry is high. Reductions in bed-blocking do not harm patients' health. The beds freed up by reducing bed-blocking are used to admit additional elective patients.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102640.abstractZh: 住院时间过长是导致医疗效率低下的主要原因之一。当患者临床状况允许出院，但需要在医院外获得支持时，他们仍会继续住院，直到能够安全出院——这种现象被称为床位占用。我研究的是，是否有补贴的养老院和家庭护理团队能够减少床位占用现象。通过利用2000至2015年间葡萄牙医院住院患者的个人数据，我发现，当一个地区引入家庭护理团队后，平均每次床位占用时间会减少4天。而养老院介入仅能在需要高度护理的患者或护理介入强度较高的患者中减少床位占用。减少床位占用并不会对患者的健康造成危害。通过减少床位占用而释放出的床位，会被用于接收更多的择期手术患者。

abstract.text: The COVID-19 pandemic led to significant changes in people's budgets, the opportunity cost of their time, and where they can purchase and consume food. We use novel data on food and non-alcoholic drink purchases from stores, takeaways, restaurants and other outlets to estimate the impact of the pandemic on the diets of a large, representative panel of British households. We find that a substantial and persistent increase in calories consumed at home more than offset reductions in calories eaten out. Households increased total calories relative to pre-pandemic by 280 per adult per day from March to July 2020, and by 150 from July to the end of 2020. Although quantity increased, there was little change in diet quality over the pandemic. All socioeconomic groups increased their calorie intake, with the largest rises for the highest SES households and the smallest for retired ones. We estimate that the changes could increase the proportion of adults who are overweight by at least five percentage points, two years after the pandemic onset.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102641.abstractZh: COVID-19疫情导致人们的预算、时间的机会成本以及食品购买和消费地点发生了显著变化。我们利用关于食品和非酒精饮料购买情况的新数据，这些数据来自商店、外卖服务、餐馆及其他销售点，来估算疫情对英国大量代表性家庭饮食方式的影响。研究发现，家庭在家中摄入的卡路里显著增加，这一增长幅度超过了外出就餐时卡路里的减少。从2020年3月到7月，每个成年人的总卡路里摄入量比疫情前增加了280卡路里/天，而7月至2020年底这一数字又增加了150卡路里/天。尽管卡路里摄入量增加，但疫情期间的饮食质量变化不大。所有社会经济群体都增加了卡路里摄入量，其中最高社会经济地位家庭的增幅最大，退休人员的增幅最小。我们估计，疫情结束后两年，这些变化可能导致至少五分之一的成年人出现超重问题。

abstract.text: This paper studies a market for a medical product in which there is perfect competition among health insurers, while the good is sold by a monopolist. Individuals differ in their severity of illness and there is ex postmoral hazard. We consider two regimes: one in which insurers use coinsurance rates (ad valorem reimbursements) and one in which insurers use co-payments (specific reimbursements). We show that the induced equilibrium with co-payments involves a lower producer price and a higher level of welfare for consumers even though it may imply a larger consumer price. This result provides strong support for a reference price based reimbursement policy.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102642.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个医疗产品的市场，该市场中健康保险公司之间存在完全竞争，而该产品则由一家垄断企业销售。不同个体之间的疾病严重程度各不相同，同时存在事后道德风险。我们考虑了两种制度：一种是由保险公司采用共同保险费率（按价值报销），另一种是由保险公司采用共同支付费用（按具体金额报销）。研究表明，采用共同支付费用所引导的均衡状态虽然可能导致消费者价格上升，但生产者价格较低，消费者的福利水平也更高。这一结果为基于参考价格的报销政策提供了有力支持。

abstract.text: The social value of decreasing health risks can be evaluated using benefit-cost analysis (BCA), cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA), or a social-welfare function (SWF). These frameworks can produce different social preference rankings of interventions depending on how their health effects and costs are distributed in a population. This paper derives social values of marginal decreases in the probability of illness, its severity (decrease in health status), lethality (conditional mortality risk), and cost under BCA, CEA, and three benchmark SWFs: utilitarian, ex ante prioritarian, and ex post prioritarian. The sensitivity of the social values of improvements in health and decreases in cost to individual circumstances are diverse. In contrast, the conditions under which a decrease in risk, severity, or lethality is socially preferred to a decrease in another of these dimensions are identical for BCA, CEA, the utilitarian and ex ante prioritarian SWFs, but can differ for the ex post prioritarian SWF.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102643.abstractZh: 降低健康风险的社会价值可以通过效益成本分析（BCA）、成本效益分析（CEA）或社会福利函数（SWF）来评估。这些框架可以根据干预措施对人群的健康影响和成本的分配方式，得出不同的社会偏好排序。本文基于BCA、CEA以及三种基准社会福利函数（功利主义、事前优先主义、事后优先主义）计算了疾病发生概率、疾病严重程度、致死风险以及成本下降所带来的社会价值。健康改善和成本降低的社会价值对个体情况的敏感性各不相同。相比之下，降低风险、严重程度或致死风险而优于降低其他维度的条件，在BCA、CEA、功利主义及事前优先主义社会福利函数中是相同的，但在事后优先主义社会福利函数中可能会有所不同。

abstract.text: The recent lead-in-water crisis in Newark has renewed concerns about the crisis being a widespread problem in the nation. Using data on the exact home addresses of pregnant women residing in the city combined with information on the spatial boundary separating areas within the city serviced by two water treatment plants, we exploit an exogenous change in water chemistry that resulted in lead leaching into the tap water of one plant's service area, but not the other's, to identify a causal effect of prenatal lead exposure on fetal health. We find robust evidence of adverse health impacts, which has important policy implications in light of the substantial number of lead water pipes that remain in use as part of our aging infrastructure and the cost-benefit calculus of lead abatement interventions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102644.abstractZh: 纽瓦克最近发生的自来水铅污染危机再次引发了人们对这一问题是否在全国范围内普遍存在的担忧。通过收集该市孕妇的确切家庭住址数据，并结合两个水处理厂服务区域之间的空间边界信息，我们发现一个水处理厂服务区的自来水中含有铅，而另一个水处理厂服务区则没有。这一外部因素的变化揭示了产前铅暴露对胎儿健康的负面影响。我们的研究发现了强有力的证据，表明铅污染对健康有严重的危害。考虑到我国老化基础设施中仍有大量使用铅制水管的现状，以及减少铅污染的成本效益问题，这一发现对政策制定具有重要意义。

abstract.text: This paper estimates effects of long-term care (LTC) benefits on utilization of primary and secondary healthcare in Catalonia (Spain). Identification comes from plausibly exogenous variation in the leniency of LTC needs assessment. We estimate that receiving LTC benefits worth 365 euros per month, on average, reduces the probability of avoidable hospital admissions by 66%, and has no significant effect on planned hospitalisations nor on hospitalisation for any reason. Receiving LTC benefits is estimated to reduce unscheduled primary care visits by 44% and has no significant effect on scheduled visits. These findings have important policy implications suggesting that allocating resources to LTC may not only increase the welfare of LTC beneficiaries but also reduce avoidable and unscheduled utilisation of healthcare.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102645.abstractZh: 本文估计了长期护理福利对加泰罗尼亚（西班牙）初级和二级医疗保健利用的影响。研究通过假设性的外部因素来识别这种影响，即长期护理需求评估的宽松程度存在差异。我们估计，每月获得365欧元的长期护理福利，可使可避免的住院概率降低66%，但对计划中的住院情况或因任何原因发生的住院没有显著影响。此外，获得长期护理福利还预计可减少44%的初级医疗就诊次数，但对计划中的就诊次数没有显著影响。这些发现具有重要的政策意义，表明将资源分配给长期护理不仅可以提高长期护理受益人的福利，还可以减少可避免和未计划的医疗保健利用。

abstract.text: We find access to universal free school meals through the Community Eligibility Provision (CEP) had a meaningful impact on grocery spending for households with children, with monthly food purchases declining by about $11, or 5 percent. For households in zip codes with higher exposure, the decline is as high as $39 per month, or 19 percent. The composition of food purchases also changes after CEP, with low income households experiencing a 3 percent improvement in dietary quality. Finally, CEP exposure is associated with an almost 5 percent decline in households classified as food insecure. Our results on the heterogeneous effects of CEP exposure by prior free/reduced price lunch eligibility reveal benefits in terms of both spending, dietary composition, and food insecurity for previously eligible low-income families, suggesting that the stigma of free school meals may be declining after universal access.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102646.abstractZh: 我们发现，通过社区资格条款获得免费学校餐服务对有孩子的家庭的食品支出产生了显著影响，每月的食品购买金额减少了约11美元，即5%。对于所在邮政编码区域曝光度较高的家庭，这一减少幅度高达每月39美元，即19%。在获得社区资格条款后，食品购买的构成也发生了变化，低收入家庭的饮食质量提高了3%。最后，获得社区资格条款的家庭中，被归类为食品不安全的情况减少了近5%。我们的研究结果表明，对于之前有资格享受免费/减价午餐的低收入家庭来说，无论是支出、饮食构成还是食品不安全状况，都获得了积极的影响。这表明，在实现普遍免费学校餐服务后，免费学校餐的负面影响可能正在减少。

abstract.text: Working-age individuals are under growing pressure to contribute unpaid time to the care of elderly family members and friends. Existing work has generally found informal care to negatively impact labor market outcomes, an effect that varies considerably by caregiving intensity, as defined by average hours of care or co-residence with the care receiver. I construct a new measure of caregiving intensity based on the length of caregiving spells. To do so, I use the Longitudinal and International Study of Adults, which provides data on the monthly caregiving status of respondents over a six-year period. I investigate how this dimension of caregiving intensity intersects with better-known measures, and show that results relying on the latter conceal substantial heterogeneity in the impact of caregiving on employment. These differences are particularly important to understand disparities in the impact of caregiving on female and male employment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102647.abstractZh: 劳动年龄人口面临着越来越大的压力，不得不无偿为年老的家庭成员和朋友提供照料服务。现有的研究通常认为，非正式照料会对劳动力市场结果产生负面影响，但这种影响会因照料强度的不同而变化，而照料强度可以通过平均照料时间或与照料对象同住的时间来衡量。我基于照料时间的长短，构建了一个新的照料强度衡量指标。为此，我使用了“纵向与国际成人研究”的数据，该数据记录了受访者在六年间每月的照料状况。我研究了这一照料强度维度与更为人熟知的衡量指标之间的关联，并发现，依赖后者的研究结果掩盖了照料对就业影响的巨大差异。这些差异对于理解照料对男女就业影响的差异尤为重要。

abstract.text: How malleable is alcohol consumption? Specifically, how much is alcohol consumption driven by the current environment versus individual characteristics? To answer this question, we analyze changes in alcohol purchases when consumers move from one state to another in the United States. We find that if a household moves to a state with a higher (lower) average alcohol purchases than the origin state, the household is likely to increase (decrease) its alcohol purchases right after the move. The current environment explains about two-thirds of the differences in alcohol purchases. The adjustment takes place both on the extensive and intensive margins.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102648.abstractZh: 酒精消费的可塑性如何？具体来说，酒精消费是由当前环境还是个人特征所驱动的？为了回答这个问题，我们分析了消费者在美国从一个州迁移到另一个州时酒精购买量的变化。我们发现，如果一家人在迁移到平均酒精购买量高于（或低于）原州的州，他们很可能会在迁移后立即增加（或减少）酒精购买量。当前环境解释了酒精购买量差异的约三分之二。这种调整既发生在广度方面，也发生在强度方面。

abstract.text: We combine individual data from the 1940 full-count census with death records and other information available on the Family Tree at familysearch.org to create the largest individual dataset to date (17 million) to study the association between years of schooling and age at death. Conditional on surviving to age 35, one additional year of education is associated with roughly 0.4 more years of life for both men and women for cohorts born 1906-1915 and smaller for earlier cohorts. Focusing on the 1906-1915 cohort we find that this association is identical when we use sibling or twin fixed effects. This association varies substantially by place of birth. For men, the association is stronger in places with greater incomes, higher quality of school, and larger investments in public health. Women also exhibit great heterogeneity in the association, but our measures of the childhood environment do not explain it.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102649.abstractZh: 我们将1940年人口普查的个人信息与死亡记录以及Familytree网站上的其他信息相结合，创建了迄今为止最大的个人数据集（1700万条记录），以研究受教育年限与死亡年龄之间的关联。在存活至35岁的前提下，对于1906-1915年出生的群体而言，每增加一年的教育程度，男女的寿命分别会增加约0.4年；而对于更早出生的群体，这种关联则较小。针对1906-1915年出生的群体进行研究时发现，无论是否使用兄弟姐妹或双胞胎的固定效应，这种关联都是相同的。这种关联在不同出生地之间存在显著差异。对于男性来说，在收入更高、学校质量更好以及公共卫生投入更大的地区，这种关联更为明显。女性在这方面也表现出很大的异质性，但我们对童年环境的测量并不能解释这一现象。

abstract.text: A recent development of immunosuppressive protocols (or simply, suppressants) offers a new option to patients suffering from end-stage renal disease: transplants from biologically incompatible donors. Suppressants are currently being used for direct transplants within patient-donor pairs, but they can be utilized more efficiently when combined with kidney exchanges. To assess the welfare gains from doing so, we introduce the "minimum chains algorithms" for different sizes of feasible exchanges. Using these algorithms, we calculate the minimal number of suppressants needed for transplants for a group of patient-donor pairs. Our simulation results show that (i) a significant reduction of suppressants can be achieved by implementing this proposal, (ii) it suffices to arrange 2-way exchanges for the best use of suppressants, and (iii) the welfare gain varies with the ABO blood-type distribution, and the gain in Korea appears to be larger than that in the United States. Finally, we assess the value (or cost) of each patient-donor pair by comparing the outcomes of the pools with and without the pair.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102650.abstractZh: 最近，免疫抑制方案的发展为患有终末期肾病的患者提供了新的选择：从生物学上不兼容的捐赠者那里进行移植。目前，免疫抑制方案主要用于患者与捐赠者之间的直接移植，但将其与肾脏交换结合使用时，可以更有效地发挥作用。为了评估这种做法带来的福利收益，我们引入了“最小链算法”来应对不同规模的交换情况。利用这些算法，我们计算了患者与捐赠者组合进行移植所需的最小免疫抑制剂数量。我们的模拟结果显示：(i) 通过实施这一方案，可以显著减少免疫抑制剂的使用量；(ii) 为了最大限度地利用免疫抑制剂，只需进行双向交换即可；(iii) 福利收益随ABO血型分布的不同而有所差异，韩国的收益似乎比美国更高。最后，我们通过比较有无该组合的情况下，评估了每个患者与捐赠者组合的价值（或成本）。

abstract.text: Healthcare providers may game when faced with targets. We examine how family doctors responded to a temporary but substantial increase in the stringency of targets determining payments for controlling blood pressure amongst younger hypertensive patients. We apply difference-in-differences and bunching techniques to data from electronic health records of 107,148 individuals. Doctors did not alter the volume or composition of lists of their hypertension patients. They did increase treatment intensity, including a 1.2 percentage point increase in prescribing antihypertensive medicines. They also undertook more blood pressure measurements. Multiple testing increased by 1.9 percentage points overall and by 8.8 percentage points when first readings failed more stringent target. Exemption of patients from reported performance increased by 0.8 percentage points. Moreover, the proportion of patients recorded as exactly achieving the more stringent target increased by 3.1 percentage points to 16.6%. Family doctors responded as intended and gamed when set more stringent pay-for-performance targets.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102651.abstractZh: 在面临目标设定时，医疗服务提供者可能会进行操纵行为。我们研究了家庭医生如何应对旨在控制年轻高血压患者血压支付标准的临时但显著的增加。我们采用差异-差异分析和捆绑技术，对107,148名个体的电子健康记录数据进行了分析。医生并未改变其高血压患者名单的数量或构成，但确实增加了治疗强度，包括将处方降压药物的百分比提高了1.2个百分点。他们还增加了血压测量次数。当首次测量未能达到更严格的目标时，多重测试的整体比例增加了1.9个百分点，而首次测量未能达到严格目标时则增加了8.8个百分点。患者免于报告绩效情况的比例增加了0.8个百分点。此外，被记录为完全达到更严格目标的患者比例增加了3.1个百分点，达到了16.6%。家庭医生在面临更严格的绩效支付目标时，确实如预期那样进行了操纵行为。

abstract.text: Distracted driving is one of the leading causes of fatal motor vehicle accidents in the United States. Policymakers in several states have responded to this phenomenon by implementing laws that restrict the use of handheld devices while operating a vehicle. In this paper, we utilize various quasi-experimental designs to estimate the impact of state-level handheld mandates on traffic fatalities. We find robust evidence that restricting the use of handheld devices while driving reduces daily traffic fatalities by 0.63 individuals in the short term. The results further indicate that while the magnitude of the impact is smaller in the long term, this policy is still effective at curbing traffic fatalities, saving more than 69 lives per state each year.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102659.abstractZh: 分心驾驶是美国致命机动车事故的主要原因之一。多个州的政策制定者针对这一现象实施了限制驾驶时使用手持设备的法律。在本文中，我们采用多种准实验设计来估算州级手持设备限制政策对交通事故死亡人数的影响。研究发现，短期内限制驾驶时使用手持设备可以将每日交通事故死亡人数减少0.63人。研究结果还表明，虽然长期影响较小，但这一政策在减少交通事故死亡方面仍然有效，每年为每个州节省超过69条生命。

abstract.text: Islamic law lays down detailed rules regulating children's upbringing. This study examines the effect of such rules on investments in children by analysing the introduction of Sharia law in northern Nigeria. Triple-differences estimates using temporal, geographical and religious variation together with large, representative survey data show decreases in infant mortality. Official government statistics further confirm improvements in survival. Findings also show that Sharia increased vaccination rates, duration of breastfeeding and prenatal health care. Evidence suggests that Sharia improved survival by specifying strict child protection laws and by formalising children's duty to maintain their parents in old age or in sickness.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102660.abstractZh: 伊斯兰法律对儿童的抚养制定了详细的规定。本研究通过分析尼日利亚北部引入伊斯兰教法对儿童投资的影响，探讨了这些规定的作用。利用时间、地理和宗教差异以及大规模代表性调查数据进行的三重差异估计显示，婴儿死亡率有所下降。官方政府统计数据进一步证实了生存率的改善。研究还发现，伊斯兰教法提高了疫苗接种率、母乳喂养的持续时间以及产前保健服务的质量。证据表明，伊斯兰教法通过制定严格的儿童保护法律，并明确儿童在父母年老或生病时的责任，从而提高了生存率。

abstract.text: We investigate alternative methods for constructing quality-adjusted medical price indexes both theoretically and empirically using medical claims data. The methodology and assumptions applied in the formation of the index have substantive effects on the magnitude of the quality-adjusted price changes. A method based on utility theory produces the most robust and accurate results, while alternative methods used in recent work overstate inflation. Based on Medicare claims data for three medical conditions, we find declining prices across each condition when properly adjusted for quality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102662.abstractZh: 我们从理论上和实证上研究了构建质量调整医疗价格指数的替代方法，使用的是医疗索赔数据。在构建指数时所采用的方法论和假设对质量调整价格变化的幅度有着实质性的影响。基于效用理论的方法能够产生最稳健且准确的结果，而近期研究中使用的其他方法则高估了通货膨胀程度。基于医疗保险索赔数据对三种医疗状况的研究发现，当适当调整质量因素后，这些状况的价格会下降。

abstract.text: In this paper, I study tiered cost sharing, an innovative incentive structure designed to steer patients toward low-cost providers using large out-of-pocket price differentials. Using administrative data from New Hampshire, where two large insurers utilize tiered pricing programs, I estimate the effects of tiering on choices and spending for common gastrointestinal endoscopic procedures. I first conduct a difference-in-differences analysis using the rollout of one insurer's tiered option. I then develop and estimate a demand model to explicitly compare the tiered design with other common plans. Both the reduced form and structural models imply that the tiered plans are associated with 4.5%-6.3% less in mean per-episode spending than high-deductible and coinsurance-based plans, and do not affect the likelihood of seeking care. I find evidence that the savings is in part due to a salience or "simple pricing" effect whereby patients respond to tiered out-of-pocket prices but not to traditional deductibles or coinsurance rates.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102663.abstractZh: 在本文中，我研究了分层成本分担机制，这是一种创新的激励结构，旨在通过较大的自付费用差异来引导患者选择低成本的服务提供者。我使用了新罕布什尔州的行政数据，该州有两家大型保险公司采用分层定价计划。我估计了分层定价对常见胃肠内镜检查项目的选择和支出的影响。首先，我使用了一家保险公司分层定价方案的推出数据进行了差异-差异分析。然后，我开发并估计了一个需求模型，以明确比较分层设计与其他常见计划之间的差异。无论是简化形式还是结构模型都表明，分层计划与高免赔额和共同保险计划相比，平均每次就诊的支出减少了4.5%至6.3%，并且不会影响寻求医疗服务的意愿。我发现，这种节省部分是由于“简单定价”效应造成的，即患者对分层自付费用有反应，而对传统的免赔额或共同保险费率则没有反应。

abstract.text: Health workers have to balance their own welfare vs. that of their patients particularly when patients have a readily transmissible disease. These risks become more consequential during an outbreak, and especially so when the chance of severe illness or mortality is non-negligible. One way to reduce risk is by reducing contact with patients. Such changes could be along the intensive or extensive margins. Using data on primary care outpatient encounters during the early months of the Covid-19 pandemic, I document important changes in the intensity of provider-patient interactions. Significantly, I find that adherence to clinical guidelines, the probability that routine procedures such as physical examinations were completed, and even the quality of information given by health providers, all declined sharply. I present evidence that these effects likely reflect risk mitigation behavior by health providers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102665.abstractZh: 卫生工作者在平衡自身福利与患者福利时面临挑战，尤其是在患者患有易传播疾病的情况下。在疫情爆发期间，这些风险变得更加严重，尤其是当严重疾病或死亡的风险不可忽略时。降低风险的一种方法是减少与患者的接触。这种改变可以体现在密集或广泛的层面。通过研究新冠疫情初期初级护理门诊就诊数据，我发现了医疗服务提供者与患者互动强度的显著变化。值得注意的是，我发现遵循临床指南、完成常规体检等程序的可能性，以及医疗服务提供者提供的信息质量，都出现了显著下降。我有证据表明，这些影响可能反映了医疗服务提供者的风险缓解行为。

abstract.text: This paper explores whether breaks from surgical practice impact surgeons' performance. Using a large panel of orthopaedic surgeons in England, I estimate the effect of surgeons' breaks, measured by the number of days since their last surgery, on the health outcomes of emergency patients admitted after a hip fracture. To identify a causal effect, I implement a surgeon fixed effects model and exploit the quasi-exogenous variation in breaks from unanticipated emergency hip fracture admissions. Results show that short breaks of four to six days reduce 30-day mortality rates by around six percent relative to no breaks. Notably, short breaks also affect the type of surgery carried out, holding patient characteristics fixed. Overall, these findings show that the organisation of surgeons' activity is a possible determinant of the quality of care provided.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102667.abstractZh: 本文探讨了暂停手术实践是否会影响外科医生的绩效。通过对英格兰众多骨科医生进行的大规模研究，我估计了医生暂停手术的时间（以距离上次手术的天数衡量）对髋部骨折急诊患者健康结果的影响。为了确定因果关系，我采用了外科医生固定效应模型，并利用因意外急诊髋部骨折而暂停手术这一准外生变量来进行分析。研究结果显示，短暂暂停手术4至6天可使30天死亡率降低约6%。值得注意的是，短暂暂停手术还会影响所进行的手术类型，而患者特征保持不变。总体而言，这些发现表明，外科医生活动的组织安排可能是影响医疗服务质量的一个因素。

abstract.text: In publicly-funded healthcare systems, waiting times for care should be based on need rather than ability to pay. Studies have shown that individuals with lower socioeconomic status face longer waits for planned inpatient care, but there is little evidence on inequalities in waiting times for emergency care. We study waiting times in emergency departments (EDs) following arrival by ambulance, where health consequences of extended waits may be severe. Using data from all major EDs in England during the 2016/17 financial year, we find patients from more deprived areas face longer waits during some parts of the ED care pathway. Inequalities in waits are small, but more deprived individuals also receive less complex ED care, are less likely to be admitted for inpatient care, and are more likely to re-attend ED or die shortly after attendance. Patient-physician interactions and unconscious bias towards more deprived patients may be important sources of inequalities.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102668.abstractZh: 在公共资助的医疗保健系统中，医疗服务的等待时间应基于需求而非支付能力来分配。研究表明，社会经济地位较低的人群在计划性住院治疗的等待时间更长，但关于急诊服务等待时间的不平等现象，目前缺乏足够的证据。本研究针对救护车送达后的急诊科等待时间进行了分析，因为长时间等待可能对健康造成严重影响。通过对比2016/17财政年度英格兰所有主要急诊科的数据，我们发现来自贫困地区的患者在急诊治疗过程中的某些阶段面临更长的等待时间。虽然等待时间的不平等程度较小，但贫困患者往往接受的治疗更为简单，被收治为住院患者的可能性较低，且更有可能再次前往急诊室或在治疗后不久死亡。患者与医生之间的互动以及对贫困患者的无意识偏见，可能是导致这种不平等现象的重要因素。

abstract.text: The Internet has significantly changed people's daily lives, including their health status. In this paper, we study the health implications of Internet access with a specific focus on body weight. We exploit an Internet speed upgrading project in China and conduct a difference-in-differences analysis, where the treatment intensity depends on cities' pre-existing Internet infrastructure conditions. We find consistent and robust evidence that increased Internet access reduces the incidence of being overweight. Regarding the mechanisms behind this result, we provide indirect evidence for the information channel, evidenced by improved health behaviors after the project: less engagement in risky health behaviors and increased participation in preventive health services and exercise. Internet diffusion also increases income, supporting the income channel through which the Internet can affect body weight.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102670.abstractZh: 互联网显著改变了人们的日常生活，包括他们的健康状况。在本文中，我们研究了互联网接入对健康的影响，特别关注体重问题。我们利用中国一项互联网速度升级项目，进行了差异-差异分析，其中处理强度取决于各城市现有的互联网基础设施状况。我们发现，互联网接入的增加确实降低了超重的发生率，这一结论具有一致性和可靠性。关于这一结果背后的机制，我们提供了间接证据，表明该项目后健康行为有所改善：参与风险较高的健康行为的程度降低，而参与预防性健康服务和锻炼活动的程度增加。互联网的传播还增加了收入，这进一步支持了互联网可以通过收入渠道影响体重的观点。

abstract.text: This paper studies the impact of the first joint licensing platform for patented drugs, the Medicines Patent Pool, on global drug diffusion and innovation. The pool allows generic firms worldwide to license drug bundles cheaply and conveniently for sales in a set of developing countries. I construct a novel dataset from licensing contracts, public procurement, clinical trials, and drug approvals. Using difference-in-differences methods, I find that the pool leads to substantial increases in the generic supply of drugs purchased, particularly in countries with stronger patent protection. In addition, there are some positive increases in clinical trials and drug product approvals after a compound enters the pool, mostly by firms outside the pool.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102671.abstractZh: 本文研究了专利药品首个联合许可平台——药品专利池对全球药品传播和创新的影响。该平台使全球仿制药企业能够廉价且便捷地获得药品组合许可，以便在一系列发展中国家进行销售。我基于许可合同、公共采购、临床试验和药品审批数据构建了一个新的数据集。通过差异-差异方法分析发现，该平台显著增加了仿制药的供应，尤其是在专利保护较强的国家。此外，当一种化合物进入专利池后，临床试验和药品审批的数量也有所增加，这些增加主要由专利池外的企业推动。

abstract.text: The adoption of health care technology is central to improving productivity in this sector. To provide new evidence on how technology affects health care markets, we focus on one area where adoption has been particularly rapid: surgery for prostate cancer. Within just eight years, robotic surgery grew to become the dominant intensive prostate cancer treatment method. Using a difference-in-differences design, we show that adopting a robot drives prostate cancer patients to the hospital. To test whether this result reflects market expansion or business stealing, we also consider market-level effects of adoption and find effects that are significant but smaller, suggesting that adoption expands the market while also reallocating some patients across hospitals. Marginal patients are relatively young and healthy, inconsistent with the concern that adoption broadens the criteria for intervention to patients who would gain little from it. We conclude by discussing implications for the social value of technology diffusion in health care markets.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102672.abstractZh: 采用医疗技术是提高该行业生产力的关键。为了提供关于技术如何影响医疗市场的新的证据，我们重点关注一个采用速度特别快的领域：前列腺癌手术。在短短八年内，机器人手术已成为治疗前列腺癌的主要手段。通过差异-差异设计，我们发现采用机器人手术能够促使前列腺癌患者前往医院接受治疗。为了检验这一结果是否反映了市场扩张或商业掠夺，我们还考虑了采用行为对市场的整体影响，发现其影响虽然显著，但幅度较小，这表明采用行为不仅扩大了市场，还导致部分患者在不同医院之间流动。这些患者通常年龄较轻且健康状况良好，这与采用行为会扩大干预标准、导致原本不会从中受益的患者也受到干预的观点不符。最后，我们讨论了这种技术在医疗市场中的扩散对社会价值的影响。

abstract.text: A large body of evidence shows that individuals with poor mental health have lower income over the lifespan but a dearth of evidence exists on how poor mental health affects savings behaviour. In this paper, we provide novel evidence of a mental health gap in pension participation in the UK using nationally representative longitudinal data from Understanding Society (UKHLS). Beginning in 2012, the UK government introduced automatic enrolment enabling us to assess the impact of one of the largest pension policy reforms in the world on this mental health gap. We measure mental health using the General Health Questionnaire (GHQ-12) which is a commonly used tool for measuring psychological distress. Prior to automatic enrolment, we find that male private sector employees with poor mental health are 3.7 percentage points less likely to participate in a workplace pension scheme while female private sector employees with poor mental health are 2.9 percentage points less likely to participate after controlling for key observables including age, education, race, marital status, number of children, occupation type, industry type, presence of a physical health condition and cognitive ability. The implementation of automatic enrolment removes the mental health gap in pension participation, equalising the pension participation rates of individuals with and without poor mental health in the private sector.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102673.abstractZh: 大量证据表明，心理健康状况不佳的人在生命过程中收入较低，但关于心理健康状况不佳如何影响储蓄行为的研究却很少。本文利用《理解社会》组织提供的具有全国代表性的纵向数据，提供了关于英国养老金参与率中存在的心理健康差异的新证据。自2012年起，英国政府实施了自动参保制度，使我们能够评估这一全球规模最大的养老金政策改革对这一心理健康差异的影响。我们使用通用健康问卷（GHQ-12）来衡量心理健康状况，该问卷是一种常用的心理困扰测量工具。在自动参保制度实施之前，我们发现，心理健康状况不佳的男性私营部门员工参与工作场所养老金计划的可能性降低了3.7个百分点，而心理健康状况不佳的女性私营部门员工参与的可能性则降低了2.9个百分点。在控制年龄、教育水平、种族、婚姻状况、子女数量、职业类型、行业类型、是否存在身体健康问题以及认知能力等关键变量后，这一差异仍然存在。自动参保制度的实施消除了心理健康状况不佳与未出现该问题的人群在养老金参与率上的差异，使得私营部门中心理健康状况不佳与未出现该问题的人群在养老金参与率上趋于平等。

abstract.text: The rational microeconomic decision model is hard-coded into usual econometric specifications such as the Multinomial Logit and Probit models, inter alia. There is a very tight link between utility maximization and the apparatus of welfare theory that underlies economic policy analysis, which creates a tension around the possibility of representing other decision rules. We propose a less restrictive model of choice, built on the concept of gist-based categorization judgments that are assumed to precede (thus, condition) the maximization-driven selection process in decision making. This categorization facilitates decision making by allowing adoption of certain simpler decision rules under appropriate conditions, the drivers of which are endogenously determined. We demonstrate that the proposed model provides better fit than traditional choice models, using cancer screening and treatment choice data from two discrete choice experiments. In addition, we show that the model provides a deeper, more nuanced and insightful perspective on (healthcare) decision making.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102674.abstractZh: 理性微观经济决策模型被硬编码到常见的计量经济学模型中，例如多项Logit模型和Probit模型等。效用最大化与支撑经济政策分析的福利理论体系之间存在着非常紧密的联系，这导致在表示其他决策规则的可能性上产生了矛盾。我们提出了一种较为宽松的选择模型，该模型基于“基于主旨的类别判断”这一概念，这些判断被假设在决策过程中的最大化驱动选择之前就已经存在。这种类别判断通过允许在适当条件下采用某些更简单的决策规则来促进决策过程，而这些条件的驱动因素是由内生因素决定的。我们证明，所提出的模型比传统选择模型更能适应癌症筛查和治疗选择数据，这些数据来自两个离散选择实验。此外，我们还表明，该模型为（医疗）决策提供了更深入、更细致且更有洞察力的视角。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of the state-level full parity mental illness law implementation on mental illness among college-aged individuals and human capital accumulation in college. We utilize administrative data on completed suicides and grade point average (GPA) and survey data on reported mental illness days and decisions to disenroll from college between 1998 and 2008 in a difference-in-differences (DD) analysis to uncover the causal effects of state-level parity laws. We find that state-level parity law reduces youth suicide rate and propensity to report any poor mental health day, increases college GPA, and does not change the propensity to disenroll from college.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102675.abstractZh: 我们研究了州级完全平等心理健康法实施对大学生心理健康以及人力资本积累的影响。我们利用1998年至2008年间完成的自杀事件数据、平均绩点数据，以及关于报告心理健康问题天数和退学决定的调查数据，通过差异-差异分析来揭示州级平等法律的因果效应。研究发现，州级平等法律降低了青少年自杀率及报告任何不良心理健康日的情况，提高了大学的平均绩点，并未改变退学的倾向。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of e-cigarette tax rates on e-cigarette prices, e-cigarette sales, and sales of other tobacco products using NielsenIQ Retail Scanner data from 2013 to 2019. We find that 90% of e-cigarette taxes are passed on to consumer retail prices. We then estimate reduced form and instrumental variables regressions to examine the effects of e-cigarette and cigarette taxes and prices on sales. We calculate an e-cigarette own-price elasticity of -2.2 and particularly large elasticity of demand for flavored e-cigarettes. Further, we document a cigarette own-price elasticity of -0.4 and positive cross-price elasticities of demand between e-cigarettes and cigarettes, suggesting economic substitution.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102676.abstractZh: 我们使用NielsenIQ零售扫描仪的数据，从2013年到2019年，对电子烟税税率对电子烟价格、电子烟销售以及其他烟草产品销售的影响进行了估算。研究发现，90%的电子烟税被转嫁到了消费者零售价格上。随后，我们通过减少形式和工具变量回归来研究电子烟和香烟的税税率对销售的影响。我们计算出电子烟的自身价格弹性为-2.2，而调味电子烟的需求弹性尤其大。此外，我们还发现香烟的自身价格弹性为-0.4，并且电子烟和香烟之间存在正向的替代关系，这表明存在经济上的替代现象。

abstract.text: We study whether bonus payments for information provision can improve the information flow between physicians. A primary care physician (PCP) decides on the provision of information of varying qualities to a specialist while referring a patient. Our theoretical model, which includes altruism and loss aversion, predicts that bonus payments increase the provision of both high- and low-quality information. Running a controlled laboratory experiment we find support for this prediction. If the beneficiary of information provision receives a higher payoff than the PCP, we observe that PCPs more often pass on high-quality information when the beneficiary is a patient. If the beneficiary receives a lower payoff than the PCP, the type of the beneficiary (specialist or patient) does not affect the provision of high-quality information.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102677.abstractZh: 我们研究了对信息提供进行奖励是否可以提高医生之间的信息交流。初级保健医生在转诊患者时，会决定向专科医生提供不同质量的信息。我们的理论模型考虑了利他主义和损失厌恶因素，预测奖励会增加高质量和低质量信息的提供。通过进行一项受控实验室实验，我们发现这一预测得到了支持。如果信息提供者的收益高于初级保健医生，我们会观察到初级保健医生在信息提供者为患者时，更常提供高质量的信息。如果信息提供者的收益低于初级保健医生，那么信息提供者的类型（专科医生或患者）并不会影响高质量信息的提供。

abstract.text: This study examines the effect on time preferences and the purchase of insurance by persons closely acquainted with someone who was in danger of physical injury (trauma) during Israel's military operation in the Gaza Strip in 2014. To this end, I use panel data to track the same individuals before and after the trauma. My results reveal that experiencing trauma increases individuals' purchases of insurance, and in particular supplementary health and long-term care insurance. Investigating the mechanisms behind the results, I find that people become more future-oriented after someone close to them was in danger of physical injury during that military operation. However, I cannot completely rule out other causes such as an increase in risk aversion or changes in individuals' beliefs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102678.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了在2014年以色列在加沙地带的军事行动期间，那些与面临身体伤害风险的人关系密切的人，其时间偏好以及保险购买行为所受到的影响。为此，我使用面板数据来追踪这些人在创伤发生前后的保险购买情况。研究结果表明，经历创伤会促使人们增加保险购买，尤其是补充健康和长期护理保险。在探究这些结果背后的机制时，我发现，当与关系密切的人在该军事行动期间面临身体伤害风险时，人们会变得更加关注未来。然而，我无法完全排除其他原因，如风险厌恶感的增加或个人信念的变化。

abstract.text: Employing a clustered RCT this paper examines the short-term impact of a 12-month mHealth BCC campaign on health practices & outcomes among CCT beneficiaries in Indonesia. Our analysis reveals that the intervention led to substantial improvements in maternal health behavior (postnatal care, child vaccinations, hygiene practices) & outcomes (anemia rates). Adopting a heterogeneous treatment effect framework, we further show that improvements in maternal hygiene practices and anemia rates are closely linked to health knowledge gained by mothers through the sms campaign. In contrast, we provide suggestive evidence that improvements in other health indicators are more likely to be related to the reminder and nudge components of the intervention.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102687.abstractZh: 本文采用集群随机对照试验的方法，研究了为期12个月的移动健康宣传活动的短期影响，这些活动针对印度尼西亚的社区发展项目受益人，旨在改善他们的健康行为及健康结果。分析结果显示，该干预措施显著改善了孕产妇的健康行为（如产后护理、儿童疫苗接种、卫生习惯）以及健康结果（如贫血率）。通过采用异质性治疗效果框架，我们进一步发现，孕产妇卫生习惯的改善和贫血率的降低与母亲通过短信宣传活动获得的健康知识密切相关。相反，其他健康指标的改善则更可能与干预措施中的提醒和激励成分有关。

abstract.text: Whether policies that change health care consumption affect health depends on the marginal benefit of the affected health care. I use variation in access to hospitals caused by nearly 1,300 hospital entries and exits to show that hospital entries cause sharp increases and exits cause sharp decreases in the quantity of inpatient care and emergency department visits with no short-term effect on the mortality rate. Thus, preventing hospital exit is not a cost effective way to save lives on average. However, exits of some hospitals with larger impacts on access to care increase the mortality rate and produce lower cost per life saved estimates.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102688.abstractZh: 是否改变医疗保健消费的政策会影响健康，这取决于相关医疗保健服务的边际效益。我通过近1,300家医院的人员进出情况来展示，医院人员的进出会导致住院治疗和急诊就诊量的急剧增加或减少，但短期内对死亡率的影响并不明显。因此，阻止医院人员离职并不是一种具有成本效益的方式来挽救生命。然而，一些对医疗服务获取影响较大的医院离职会导致死亡率上升，但每挽救一条生命所花费的成本却相对较低。

abstract.text: We study the effect of unemployment on cognitive abilities among individuals aged between 50 and 65 in Europe. To this end, we exploit plant closures and use flexible event-study estimations together with an experimentally elicited measure of fluid intelligence, namely word recall. We find that, within a time period of around eight years after the event of unemployment, cognitive abilities only deteriorate marginally - the effects are insignificant both in statistical and economic terms. We do, however, find significant effects of late-career unemployment on the likelihood to leave the labor force, and short-term effects on mental health problems such as depression and sleep problems.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102689.abstractZh: 我们研究了失业对欧洲50至65岁人群认知能力的影响。为此，我们利用了工厂关闭这一事件，并结合了灵活的事件研究方法和实验性测定的流体智力指标——即单词回忆能力。研究发现，在失业事件发生后的大约八年间，认知能力的下降幅度非常有限，无论是在统计上还是经济上，这些影响都并不显著。不过，我们确实发现了职业后期失业对离职意愿的显著影响，以及短期内对心理健康问题如抑郁和睡眠问题的负面影响。

abstract.text: A growing body of research explores the long-run effects of social programs and welfare spending. However, evidence linking welfare support in early life with longevity is limited. We add to this literature by evaluating the effect of in-utero and early-life exposure to the largest increases in welfare spending in the US history under the New Deal programs. Using Social Security Administration death records linked with the 1940-census and spending data for 115 major cities, we show that the spending is correlated with improvements in old-age longevity. A treatment-on-treated calculation focused on a period when spending rose by approximately 1900 percent finds that a 100 percent rise in municipal spending in the year of birth is associated with roughly 3.5 months higher longevity. We show that these effects are not driven by endogenous selection of births, selective fertility, endogenous migration, and sample selection caused by endogenous data linking. Additional analysis suggests that rises in education and socioeconomic status are likely channels of impact.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102690.abstractZh: 越来越多的研究探索了社会项目和福利支出对长期影响的效应。然而，将早期生活中的福利支持与寿命长短联系起来的证据却十分有限。我们通过评估在罗斯福新政时期美国历史上福利支出大幅增加期间，孕妇和儿童在子宫内及早期生活中的福利状况，为这一领域的研究提供了补充。利用与1940年人口普查相关的社会保障管理局死亡记录以及115个主要城市的支出数据，我们发现这些支出增加与老年人寿命的延长之间存在关联。一项针对支出增加约1900%时期的分析表明，出生当年市政支出增加100%，与寿命延长约3.5个月相关。我们的研究还表明，这些效应并非由出生选择、选择性生育、内生迁移以及由内生数据链接引起的样本选择所驱动。进一步的分析表明，教育和社会经济地位的提升可能是这些效应的潜在渠道。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the power of time preference to predict illness and premature mortality in adulthood. Using a unique Swedish cohort of 12,956 individuals born in 1953, interviewed in 1966, and followed with register data up to 2018, the paper reports that more patient adolescents are 17-21% less likely to die before the age of 65 years. More patient adolescents have fewer hospitalizations and diagnoses in their adult life and are less likely to be diagnosed with conditions associated with lifestyle risk factors. The investigated channels for the relationship between time preference and future health include lifestyle, education attainment, and future income. Controlling for education and income reduces the coefficient for time preference on premature mortality by one-fourth.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102692.abstractZh: 本文研究了时间偏好对成年期疾病和早死预测的作用。研究采用了瑞典一项独特的队列研究，涉及1953年出生的12,956名个体，他们在1966年接受了访谈，并持续通过登记数据进行了追踪，直至2018年。研究结果表明，患有疾病的青少年在65岁之前死亡的可能性降低17-21%。此外，这些青少年在成年后的住院率和疾病诊断次数较少，且被诊断出与生活方式风险因素相关的疾病的可能性也较低。时间偏好与未来健康之间的关系涉及生活方式、教育水平以及未来收入等多个因素。通过控制教育和收入因素后，时间偏好对早死的影响系数减少了四分之一。

abstract.text: We compare the educational effects of two medical protocols that mitigate long-term consequences of prematurity or low birth weight. The two protocols are Traditional Care (TC), which uses incubators, and Kangaroo Mother Care (KMC) which replaces incubators for 24-hour skin-to-skin contact between newborns and caregivers. We concentrate on educational outcomes addressing contradictory results in previous contributions. We use a randomized controlled trial implemented in 1993 that randomly assigned children to either TC or KMC. OLS results suggest that KMC children spent more time in preschool, had fewer temporary school absences, and showed lower math test scores. Both groups observed similar effects on high-school graduation and language test scores. We correct for attrition, small sample, and multiple outcomes. Effects on preschool attendance and school absenteeism are robust, particularly for more vulnerable infants (birth weight ≤ 1,800 g). The other effects lose statistical significance due to multiple outcome testing or attrition corrections.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102693.abstractZh: 我们比较了两种医疗方案对减轻早产或低出生体重长期影响的教育效果。这两种方案分别是传统护理（TC），该方案使用保温箱；以及袋鼠式护理（KMC），该方案采用24小时新生儿与护理人员肌肤接触的方式替代保温箱。我们重点关注教育成果，以解释之前研究中的矛盾结果。我们采用了1993年实施的一项随机对照试验，该试验将儿童随机分配到传统护理组或袋鼠式护理组。OLS分析结果显示，袋鼠式护理组儿童在学龄前的时间更长，临时缺课次数更少，数学测试成绩也较低。两组在高中毕业率和语言测试成绩方面表现出相似的效果。我们修正了流失、样本小以及多重结果的影响。对于更脆弱的婴儿（出生体重≤1,800克），学龄前出勤率和学校缺勤率的影响较为显著。而其他影响由于多重结果测试或流失修正而失去了统计显著性。

abstract.text: This paper measures the effects of disruptions to healthcare quality at birth on early child health outcomes in Kenya. To identify impacts, we exploit variation in the timing and location of health-worker strikes at individual hospitals across the country between 1999 and 2014. Using data from Demographic Health Surveys, we find that children born during strikes are more likely to suffer a neonatal death. We find similar results using separate data collected in two informal settlements in Nairobi located near hospitals with frequent strikes. These results show that interruptions to healthcare quality can have large immediate health impacts, and suggests that status quo hospital care provides positive benefits. We also find suggestive evidence of reductions in later health investments, measured by vaccine take-up, among those who survive. This study provides the first rigorous evidence on the consequences of health-worker strikes, a frequent but understudied phenomenon in Sub-Saharan Africa.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102694.abstractZh: 本文研究了肯尼亚出生时的医疗质量中断对儿童早期健康结果的影响。为了识别这些影响，我们分析了1999年至2014年间全国各医院卫生工作者罢工的时间和地点变化。通过人口健康调查的数据，我们发现罢工期间出生的儿童更容易出现新生儿死亡。在奈洛比两个靠近频繁罢工医院的非正式居住区收集的数据也显示了类似的结果。这些结果表明，医疗质量的中断会对健康产生即时影响，并表明现状下的医院护理具有积极效益。我们还发现了一些迹象，表明那些在罢工中幸存下来的儿童，其后期健康投资（如疫苗接种率）有所下降。这项研究首次提供了关于卫生工作者罢工后果的确凿证据，这一现象在撒哈拉以南非洲地区较为常见，但研究较少。

abstract.text: The Internal Revenue Service (IRS) requires nonprofit hospitals to report community benefit spending to justify their nonprofit tax exemption. We examined whether nonprofit hospital acquisitions influence the amount and type community benefit spending. We analyzed 2011-2018 data on urban, nonprofit hospitals. The analysis dataset included 57 hospitals that were acquired and a matched control group. We estimated difference-in-differences specifications to measure the effect of acquisitions on total community benefit spending, and three subcategories - clinical, population health, and other spending types. We found that acquisitions led to decreased population health spending (-$0.32 million, p < 0.01) and other spending categories (-$1.5 million, p < 0.05), but no significant change in total or clinical spending. If the acquirer was located out-of-state, total community benefit spending declined by $2.4 million (p < 0.10). Our findings support the need for community benefit spending to be considered, along with quality, efficiency, and prices, when evaluating the welfare impact of acquisitions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102696.abstractZh: 美国国税局要求非营利医院报告社区公益支出，以证明其非营利组织的免税资格。我们研究了非营利医院收购是否会影响社区公益支出的金额和类型。我们分析了2011年至2018年城市非营利医院的数据。分析数据集包括57家被收购的医院和一个匹配的对照组。我们通过差异估计模型来测量收购对社区公益支出总额的影响，以及临床、人口健康和其他支出类别的影响。我们发现，收购导致人口健康支出减少（-32万美元，p < 0.01）和其他支出类别减少（-150万美元，p < 0.05），但总支出和临床支出没有显著变化。如果收购方位于州外，社区公益支出总额则减少了240万美元（p < 0.10）。我们的研究结果支持在评估收购对福利影响时，需要考虑社区公益支出，以及其质量、效率和价格等因素。

abstract.text: Objective A number of publicly available rating algorithms are used to assess hospital performance in coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG). However, concerns remain that these algorithms fail to correlate with each other and inadequately capture the case complexity of individual center practices. Methods Composite star ratings for isolated CABG from the Society of Thoracic Surgeons public reporting database were extracted for 2018-2019. U.S. News & World Report Best Hospitals was used to extract CABG ratings as well as overall cardiology and heart surgery ranking, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services Hospital Compare was used to extract CABG volume and 30-day mortality. Spearman correlation coefficients were used to assess possible relationships. Expert opinion on risk adjustment and program evaluation was incorporated. Results Correlations between Society of Thoracic Surgeons star rating and U.S. News & World Report overall ranking in cardiology and heart surgery (r = 0.15) and Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services 30-day mortality (r = -0.27) were poor. Society of Thoracic Surgeons star rating correlated weakly with U.S. News & World Report CABG ratings (r = 0.33) and with Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services CABG volume (r = 0.32), whereas the latter 2 correlated moderately (r = 0.52) with each other. Of the 75 centers with accredited cardiac surgery training programs, 13 (17%) did not participate in Society of Thoracic Surgeons public reporting. Important gaps were identified in risk assessment, and potential solutions are proposed. Conclusions Correlations between current CABG public reporting systems are weak. Further work is needed to refine and standardize CABG rating systems to more adequately capture the scope and complexity of an individual center's clinical practice and to better inform patients.

10.1016/j.jtcvs.2022.01.051.abstractZh:
目的 许多公开可用的评级算法被用于评估医院在冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）方面的表现。然而，仍然存在这些算法之间缺乏关联性的问题，且未能充分反映各个医院实践的复杂性。  
方法 从胸外科医师协会的公开报告数据库中提取了2018-2019年度单独进行CABG手术的医院综合星级评级。同时，利用《美国新闻与世界报道》的最佳医院排名来提取CABG手术的相关评级以及整体心脏病学和心脏外科排名；利用医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心的医院比较工具来提取CABG手术的数量和30天死亡率。通过Spearman相关系数来评估这些指标之间的可能关系。同时，也考虑了专家对于风险调整和项目评估的意见。  
结果 胸外科医师协会的星级评级与《美国新闻与世界报道》在心脏病学和心脏外科方面的整体排名之间的相关性较弱（r = 0.15），与医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心的30天死亡率之间的相关性则较弱（r = -0.27）。胸外科医师协会的星级评级与《美国新闻与世界报道》的CABG手术评级之间的相关性较弱（r = 0.33），与医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心的CABG手术数量之间的相关性较弱（r = 0.32）。而后两者之间的相关性则较为中等（r = 0.52）。在拥有认证心脏外科培训项目的75家医院中，有13家（占17%）没有参与胸外科医师协会的公开报告。在风险评估方面存在重要差距，并提出了潜在的解决方案。  
结论 当前CABG手术公开报告系统之间的相关性较弱。需要进一步的工作来完善和标准化冠状动脉旁路移植术评级系统，以更充分地反映单个中心临床实践的范围和复杂性，并更好地为患者提供信息。

abstract.text: Objective Disposable instrument use during video-assisted thoracoscopic lobectomy is a significant driver of cost. The purpose of the study was to measure the effect of increasing surgeon cost awareness via successive "value improvement initiatives" on instrument costs. Methods We prospectively collected disposable instrument use data for all video-assisted thoracoscopic lobectomies performed by 5 Board-certified thoracic surgeons over 4 successive time periods: Period 1: control group of consecutive video-assisted thoracoscopic lobectomies before interventions; Period 2: video-assisted thoracoscopic lobectomies after displaying disposables price list in operating room; Period 3: video-assisted thoracoscopic lobectomies after educational presentation outlining disposable instrument price differences; Period 4: video-assisted thoracoscopic lobectomies after surgeon self-assessment with peer comparison of cost data from Period 3 and positive deviance seminar identifying the lowest-cost surgeon to lead discussion of optimal cost-reduction strategies. Instrument use and costs were compared among the 4 groups using the Kruskal-Wallis test. Results A total of 373 lobectomy cases were analyzed. Compared with Period 1, median stapler-related and total disposable costs for video-assisted thoracoscopic lobectomy cases decreased after successive value improvement initiatives, with lowest costs in Period 4 (P < .0001). Multiple linear regression analysis demonstrated per lobectomy disposables cost reduction of $397.53 in Period 4, after controlling for surgeon and lobe (P < .0001). Operating room time was reduced after successive value improvement initiatives (P < .0001). Conclusions Cost awareness and surgeon engagement activities were associated with sustained cost reduction for video-assisted thoracoscopic lobectomies. Surgeon self-assessment, peer comparison, and positive deviance seminar were associated with the largest cost reduction. Significant hospital cost-savings may be realized with surgeon-led value improvement initiatives.

10.1016/j.jtcvs.2022.09.015.abstractZh:
目的：在视频辅助胸腔镜下肺叶切除术中，一次性器械的使用是成本增加的一个重要因素。本研究旨在通过连续的“价值提升措施”来提高外科医生对成本的意识，从而评估其对器械成本的影响。  
方法：我们前瞻性收集了5名获得胸腔外科认证的外科医生在连续4个时间段内进行的所有视频辅助胸腔镜下肺叶切除术中的一次性器械使用数据：第1期：在手术前进行的连续视频辅助胸腔镜下肺叶切除术；第2期：在手术室中展示一次性器械价格清单后的视频辅助胸腔镜下肺叶切除术；第3期：通过教育性讲解一次性器械价格差异后的视频辅助胸腔镜下肺叶切除术；第4期：外科医生自我评估后，与同行比较第3期的数据，并通过积极偏差研讨会确定成本最低的外科医生来讨论最佳的成本降低策略。使用Kruskal-Wallis检验比较了4组之间的器械使用情况和成本。  
结果：共分析了373例肺叶切除术。与第1期相比，经过连续的“价值提升措施”后，视频辅助胸腔镜下肺叶切除术的剪刀相关成本和总一次性成本均有所下降，第4期的成本最低（P < .0001）。多元线性回归分析显示，在控制外科医生和肺叶因素后，第4期的每次肺叶切除术一次性器械成本降低了397.53美元（P < .0001）。经过连续的“价值提升措施”后，手术室时间也有所减少（P < .0001）。  
结论：成本意识和外科医生参与活动与视频辅助胸腔镜下肺叶切除术的持续成本降低有关。外科医生自我评估、同行比较以及积极偏差研讨会与最大的成本降低相关。通过由外科医生主导的价值提升举措，可以实现显著的医院成本节约。

abstract.text: In the large literature on the spatial-level correlates of COVID-19, the association between quality of hospital care and outcomes has received little attention to date. To examine whether county-level mortality is correlated with measures of hospital performance, we assess daily cumulative deaths and pre-crisis measures of hospital quality, accounting for state fixed-effects and potential confounders. As a measure of quality, we use the pre-pandemic adjusted five-year penalty rates for excess 30-day readmissions following pneumonia admissions for the hospitals accessible to county residents based on ambulance travel patterns. Our adjustment corrects for socio-economic status and down-weighs observations based on small samples. We find that a one-standard-deviation increase in the quality of local hospitals is associated with a 2% lower death rate (relative to the mean of 20 deaths per 10,000 people) one and a half years after the first recorded death.

10.1016/j.jue.2022.103472.abstractZh: 在关于COVID-19的空间层面相关因素的大量文献中，医院护理质量与治疗效果之间的关联至今尚未受到足够关注。为了研究县级死亡率是否与医院绩效指标相关，我们评估了每日累积死亡人数以及疫情前的医院质量指标，同时考虑了州级固定效应和潜在混杂因素。作为质量衡量指标，我们采用了基于救护车出行模式，针对县级居民可访问的医院，在疫情前五年的30天再入院率调整值。我们的调整措施纠正了社会经济状况的影响，并减少了基于小样本数据的观测结果的影响。我们发现，当地医院质量每增加一个标准差，死亡率就会降低2%（相对于每10,000人中有20例死亡的平均值），这一结论是在首次记录死亡事件后一年半得出的。

abstract.text: In this paper, we study the effects of non-monetary symbolic awards on winners, losers, and their peers. Using a regression discontinuity design, we examine post-award performance differences between those who barely won a symbolic performance award and those who came just short of winning the award in a large insurance company (Study 1). Our findings show that awarded workers performed worse than their non-awarded counterparts, and worse performance was more severe in more competitive teams. Building on these findings, we explore potential mechanisms using an incentivized real-effort experiment (Study 2). The experiment reveals that award winners’ worse post-award performance relative to unawarded workers was driven by social undermining in the form of deliberate sabotage by coworkers, rather than award winners’ own behavioral changes due to negative motivational effects.

10.1016/j.obhdp.2022.104184.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了非货币象征性奖励对获奖者、落选者及其同伴的影响。通过回归 discontinuity 设计，我们考察了在大型保险公司中，那些勉强获得象征性奖励的人与那些差一点就获得奖励的人之间的表现差异（研究1）。我们的研究发现，获得奖励的工人表现不如未获得奖励的同事，且在竞争更激烈的团队中，表现下降更为明显。基于这些发现，我们通过一项激励性实际努力实验来探索潜在的机制（研究2）。实验表明，与未获得奖励的工人相比，获得奖励的工人表现下降主要是由于同事故意进行的破坏行为，而非由于负面动机效应导致的自身行为改变。

abstract.text: Private doctors and hospitals face incentives to intervene in the process of childbirth because they are employed and paid differently from their public counterparts. While private obstetric care has been associated with higher rates of caesarean birth, it is unclear to what extent this is attributable to unobserved selection effects related to clinical need or patient preferences. Using administrative birth data on over 280,000 births in Australia between 2007 and 2012, we implement an instrumental variables framework to account for the endogeneity of choice of care. We also exploit Australia's institutional framework to examine the differences in doctor-level and hospital-level incentives. We find that giving birth in a private hospital leads to a 4 percentage point increase in the probability of having an unplanned caesarean birth. Over our study period, this equates to an additional 3241 caesarean births.

10.1016/j.socscimed.2022.114729.abstractZh: 私人医生和医院在分娩过程中有干预的动机，因为他们与公共医疗机构相比，就业方式和薪酬有所不同。虽然私人产科护理与较高的剖宫产率相关，但尚不清楚这种差异在多大程度上是由于临床需求或患者偏好导致的未观察到的选择效应。我们利用2007年至2012年间澳大利亚超过280,000例分娩的行政数据，采用工具变量框架来解释选择护理方式的内生性。同时，我们利用澳大利亚的制度框架来研究医生级别和医院级别之间的激励差异。研究发现，在私人医院分娩会导致计划外剖宫产的概率增加4个百分点。在我们的研究期间，这相当于额外增加了3241例剖宫产。

abstract.text: Universal HIV testing is now recommended in generalised HIV epidemic settings. Although home-based HIV counselling and testing (HB-HCT) has been shown to be effective in achieving high levels of HIV status awareness, little is still known about the cost implications of universal and repeated HB-HCT. We estimated the costs of repeated HB-HCT and the scale economies that can be obtained when increasing the population coverage of the intervention. We used primary data from the ANRS 12249 Treatment as Prevention (TasP) trial in rural South Africa (2012-2016), whose testing component included six-monthly repeated HB-HCT. We relied on the dynamic system generalised method of moments (GMM) approach to produce unbiased short- and long-run estimates of economies of scale, using the number of contacts made by HIV counsellors for HB-HCT as the scale variable. We also estimated the mediating effect of the contact quality - measured as the proportion of HIV tests performed among all contacts eligible for an HIV test - on scale economies. The mean cost (standard deviation) of universal and repeated HB-HCT was $24.2 (13.7) per contact, $1694.3 (1527.8) per new HIV diagnosis, and $269.2 (279.0) per appropriate referral to HIV care. The GMM estimations revealed the presence of economies of scale, with a 1% increase in the number of contacts for HB-HCT leading to a 0.27% decrease in the mean cost. Our results also suggested a significant long-run relationship between mean cost and scale, with a 1% increase in the scale leading to a 0.36% decrease in mean cost in the long run. Overall, we showed that significant cost savings can be made from increasing population coverage. Nevertheless, there is a risk that this gain is made at the expense of quality: the higher the quality of HB-HCT activities, the lower the economies of scale.

10.1016/j.socscimed.2022.115068.abstractZh: 在普遍性的HIV流行情况下，现在建议进行全面的HIV检测。尽管基于家庭环境的HIV咨询和检测已被证明能够显著提高人们对HIV状况的认识，但关于全面和重复进行的家庭式HIV咨询和检测的成本影响，我们仍然知之甚少。我们估算了重复进行的家庭式HIV咨询和检测的成本，以及增加干预措施覆盖人群所能获得的规模经济效应。我们参考了南非农村地区的ANRS 12249治疗作为预防（TasP）试验的初步数据（2012-2016年），该试验的检测部分包括每六个月一次的重复家庭式HIV咨询和检测。我们采用动态系统广义矩估计方法，以HIV咨询师进行家庭式HIV咨询和检测的次数作为规模变量，得出无偏的短期和长期规模经济效应估计。我们还估算了接触质量对规模经济效应的中介作用——接触质量是指所有符合HIV检测条件的接触者中实际进行了HIV检测的比例。全面和重复进行的家庭式HIV咨询和检测的平均成本（标准差）分别为每次接触24.2美元（13.7美元）、每次新HIV诊断1694.3美元（1527.8美元）以及每次适当的HIV护理转诊269.2美元（279.0美元）。广义矩估计显示存在规模经济效应，家庭式HIV咨询和检测的接触次数增加1%，平均成本下降0.27%。我们的研究结果还表明，平均成本与规模之间存在显著的长期关系，规模增加1%，长期平均成本下降0.36%。总体而言，我们表明通过增加人群覆盖范围可以显著节省成本。然而，这种节省可能会以牺牲质量为代价：家庭式HIV咨询和检测活动的质量越高，规模经济效应就越低。

abstract.text: European health reforms during the last decades have strengthened patient rights and introduced choice, competition and financial incentives in a sector that has typically been state-directed and centrally controlled. The marketisation of health care has also drawn out profit and introduced private provision. The main argument behind this trend is that market competition will improve service quality and deliver health services more efficiently. Such reforms often fall under the umbrella of New Public Management (NPM), and there is a lack of empirical research on their effects. The purpose of this paper is to investigate the association between healthcare marketisation and health system outcomes across European nations. In order to measure a country's degree of healthcare marketisation we employed indicators of healthcare decommodification. The concept refers to the extent to which an individual's access to healthcare is dependent upon their market position and the extent to which a country's provision of health is independent from the market. These indicators are three measures that assess the financing, provision and coverage of the private sector, and thus reflects the varied role of the market in a health care system: private health care expenditure as amount of GDP, private hospital beds as amount of total hospital bed stock, and public healthcare coverage. As indicator of health system outcome, we employed a measure that has not previously been investigated in the context of healthcare marketisation: satisfaction with health care system. We used multilevel analyses on five waves (2009-2017) of the biannual European Social Survey (ESS), with our final models including more than 120,000 individuals from 21 countries. Our methodological approach allowed us to study both cross-sectional and longitudinal relationships. The strongest substantial associations were between coverage and satisfaction, with high public healthcare coverage being associated with higher satisfaction.

10.1016/j.socscimed.2022.115083.abstractZh: 过去几十年中，欧洲的医疗改革加强了患者的权利，并在一个通常由国家主导和中央控制的领域引入了选择、竞争和财务激励机制。医疗服务的市场化也促进了利润增长，并引入了私人供给。这一趋势的主要论点是，市场竞争将提高服务质量，并使医疗服务更加高效。这类改革通常属于新公共管理理论范畴，但关于其效果的研究却相对不足。本文旨在探讨医疗市场化与欧洲各国医疗系统结果之间的关联。为了衡量一个国家的医疗市场化程度，我们采用了医疗去商品化的指标。这一概念指的是个人获得医疗服务的程度是否依赖于其市场地位，以及一个国家的医疗服务是否独立于市场。这些指标分别衡量了私营部门的融资、供给和覆盖情况，从而反映了市场在医疗系统中的不同作用：私营医疗支出占GDP的比例、私营医院床位占医院床位总数的比例，以及公共医疗的覆盖程度。作为医疗系统结果的指标，我们采用了一种在医疗市场化背景下尚未被研究的衡量标准：对医疗系统的满意度。我们对欧洲社会调查的五波数据（2009-2017年）进行了多层分析，最终模型包含了来自21个国家的12万多名参与者的数据。我们的研究方法使我们能够同时研究横断面和纵向关系。最显著的相关性在于覆盖率和满意度之间的关系，即较高的公共医疗保健覆盖率与更高的满意度相关。

abstract.text: Recent decades' hospital closures and consolidations have been rationalized with reference to arguments of efficiency and quality returns to scale and scope. However, closures are met with public outcry from patients living in areas affected by such closures if accompanying increases in travel time are not offset by a higher quality of care. It is broadly established that increases in patients' travel time to acute care lower the probability of survival, but in non-acute and scheduled care we lack knowledge about the quality of care that patients living in closure-affected areas receive. In the non-acute setting of scheduled breast cancer surgery, this study examines how hospital clinic closures affect the quality of care that closure-affected patients receive. The effects are identified using closures of breast cancer clinics in Denmark from 2000 to 2011, during which time the number of clinics was more than halved. Using event study designs on population-wide Danish register data from 1996 to 2014, this study examine changes in surgical outcomes for 9790 patients living in municipalities where the nearest clinic has been closed. The results show that closures have reduced the number of hospitalization days and shifted surgical procedures to state-of-the-art breast-conserving techniques without generating adverse health effects and without causing crowding in non-closing clinics. An examination of the mechanisms suggests that added volume returns at non-closing clinics were of less importance than simply reallocating patients to higher-quality clinics. Closures of clinics performing scheduled surgery may be an effective policy instrument if the goal is to reduce variation in the delivery of hospital care. Increased access to state-of-the-art care may counterbalance patients' concerns of losing their local clinic. However, if the clinics to be closed are small compared to non-closing clinics then there is no potential for added economies of scale or scope in non-closing clinics.

10.1016/j.socscimed.2022.115484.abstractZh: 近几十年来，医院的关闭和合并通常以效率和规模及范围带来的质量提升为理由进行合理化。然而，当这些关闭伴随着旅行时间的增加，而护理质量却没有相应提高时，受影响的地区患者会强烈反对这一举措。已有研究表明，患者前往急性护理机构的旅行时间延长会降低生存几率，但在非急性护理和定期护理方面，我们缺乏关于受关闭影响地区患者所接受护理质量的信息。本研究针对定期乳腺癌手术这一非急性护理领域，探讨了医院诊所关闭对受影响患者护理质量的影响。研究以2000至2011年间丹麦乳腺癌诊所的关闭为样本，期间诊所数量减少了一半以上。通过1996至2014年丹麦全国登记数据的事件研究设计，本研究分析了在最近诊所关闭的市镇中，9790名患者的手术结果变化。结果显示，关闭诊所减少了住院天数，并将手术改为了更先进的保乳技术，且并未导致不良健康后果，也没有导致未关闭诊所的拥挤现象。机制分析表明，非关闭诊所的额外服务量的重要性不如将患者重新分配到质量更高的诊所。如果目标是减少医院护理服务的差异，那么关闭定期手术诊所可能是一种有效的政策工具。增加对先进护理服务的获取，可能有助于缓解患者因失去当地诊所而产生的担忧。然而，如果待关闭的诊所规模较小，与非关闭的诊所相比，这些诊所就没有增加规模经济或业务范围的潜力了。

abstract.text: Zusammenfassung Ziel der Studie Im Beitrag werden die Auswirkungen der Krankenhauskonzentration auf die durchschnittliche Verweildauer und die stationäre Sterblichkeit in Deutschland im Zeitablauf untersucht. Methodik Auf regionalen Paneldaten basierende Regressionsanalyse unter Berücksichtigung der (unbeobachteten) individuellen Heterogenität und des Trends in der Modellierung. Um Hinweise auf die Beziehungsrichtung zu erhalten, wird außerdem der Instrumentalvariablenansatz angewandt und auf Granger-Kausalität getestet. Ergebnisse Die zunehmende Krankenhauskonzentration in Deutschland ist mit einem negativen und statistisch signifikanten Effekt auf die durchschnittliche Verweildauer verbunden. Je höher die Konzentration der Krankenhäuser in einer Region, desto geringer ist (ceteris paribus) die Verweildauer auf den Stationen. Die Anzahl der Krankenhäuser hat zugleich keinen statistisch signifikanten Einfluss auf die Patientensterblichkeit. Der Zusammenhang zwischen Krankenhauskonzentration und Verweildauer lässt sich somit als positiver Qualitätseffekt interpretieren.

10.1055/a-1751-6431.abstractZh: 研究目的：本文旨在探讨医院集中化现象随时间推移对德国患者平均住院时间和住院死亡率的影响。研究方法：基于地区性面板数据，采用回归分析，同时考虑个体异质性和模型建模中的趋势。为了了解因果关系，还采用了工具变量方法，并进行了格兰杰因果关系检验。研究结果：德国医院集中化程度的增加与平均住院时间的减少存在统计学上显著的负相关关系。某一地区医院集中化程度越高，在其他条件不变的情况下，患者在住院期间的停留时间就越短。同时，医院数量对患者死亡率没有统计学上的显著影响。因此，医院集中化与住院时间之间的关系可以被解释为一种正向的质量效应。

abstract.text: It is widely agreed that health information sharing holds enormous potential to improve health care productivity. Although the adoption of electronic health records in the United States over the past 15 years has been impressive, the use of data - and subsequent improvements in health care productivity - has been disappointing. This article considers the role that state policy plays in the adoption and use of health information exchange (HIE) across providers. The authors built a novel database of state laws from 2000 through 2019 that tracks 12 dimensions of policies that may facilitate HIE usage. The dimensions fall along four categories: clarifying HIE governance, strengthening financial stability, specifying the uses and users of an HIE, and protecting the underlying data. The authors find that regulations related to privacy protections and HIE financial viability have substantial effects on information sharing. The category that has the strongest relationship with health information sharing is related to data protection. In states that add a dimension making the protection of data less costly, HIE usage increases by 18%. Within the category of data-protection measures, one stands out: enacting legislation that has patients participate by default leads to a 16% increase in usage. Adding a dimension for each of the other three categories leads to a 4% increase in HIE usage, although only the relationship with financial sustainability is measured precisely enough to be statistically significant. In particular, states that set up the ability to charge participant fees and authorize the HIE to request state, federal, and private funding achieve greater HIE. These results point to policy levers that can catalyze the use of digital tools to improve health and lower health care costs.

10.1056/cat.22.0302.abstractZh: 普遍认为，健康信息共享具有巨大的潜力，可以提高医疗保健的效率。尽管过去15年美国在电子健康记录方面的采用情况令人印象深刻，但数据的使用以及随之而来的医疗保健效率的提升却令人失望。本文探讨了州政策在促进医疗服务提供者之间健康信息交换中的作用。作者构建了一个包含2000年至2019年各州法律信息的数据库，该数据库涵盖了12个可能影响健康信息交换使用的政策维度。这些维度分为四个类别：明确健康信息交换的治理机制、加强财务稳定性、规定健康信息交换的使用者和用户，以及保护基础数据。研究发现，与隐私保护和健康信息交换的财务可持续性相关的法规对信息共享有着显著的影响。其中，与数据保护相关的维度对信息共享的影响最为显著。在那些通过降低数据保护成本来增加相关维度的州，健康信息交换的使用率增加了18%。在数据保护措施这一类别中，特别值得关注的是：通过立法让患者默认参与，使得健康信息交换的使用率增加了16%。对于其他三个维度，健康信息交换的使用率分别增加了4%，不过只有与财务可持续性相关的维度达到了统计学上的显著水平。具体而言，那些能够设定参与者费用并授权健康信息交换机构申请州级、联邦级和私人资金支持的州，其健康信息交换的使用率更高。这些结果表明，政策手段可以推动数字工具的使用，从而改善健康状况并降低医疗保健成本。

abstract.text: Drawing on peer review and professionalism, some quality-improvement efforts tap into physicians’ intrinsic motivations for giving their patients the best possible care. How can we scale up such promising approaches and create and sustain a spirit of inquiry?

10.1056/nejmms2200978.abstractZh: 通过同行评审和职业精神，一些质量改进措施能够激发医生为患者提供最佳护理的内在动力。我们如何扩大这些有前景的方法的应用范围，并培养并维持一种探索精神呢？

abstract.text: We identify and value four categories of benefits of not living in a nursing home (NH). The four categories relate to the two components of a Quality Adjusted Life Year (QALY), which is the outcome effect for this evaluation. For each QALY component, the quality of a life year foregone and the loss of a life, NHs have a direct effect and an indirect effect as NHs increase dementia symptoms. Estimates of the QALY components are obtained from two fixed effects regression equations applied to a large national data set with quality of life and dementia symptoms as dependent variables. Valuation of the QALY effects is based on the value of a statistical life year literature. Because every category of QALY effect produces negative benefits, a fifth category of foregone benefits is the savings from not incurring expenses for a NH. The total losses are large, equal to $1.93 trillion.

10.1080/00036846.2021.1983141.abstractZh: 我们识别出并评估了不居住在养老院所带来的四种益处。这四种益处与质量调整生命年（QALY）的两个组成部分相关，后者是本次评估的结果指标。对于每一个QALY组成部分，未居住的养老院能够直接减少一个生命年，同时由于养老院中痴呆症状的增加，还会产生间接影响。QALY组成部分的估算是通过两个固定效应回归方程得出的，这些方程基于一个包含生活质量与痴呆症状的大规模全国数据集进行建模。对QALY效应的评估基于统计生命年价值的文献。由于每一个QALY效应类别都带来负面效益，因此还有第五类益处，即避免因养老院运营而产生的费用节省。总体损失巨大，相当于1.93万亿美元。

abstract.text: This study analyses whether the efficiency of Ecuadorian public hospitals experiences spatial dependence. We investigate whether demand variations have affected public hospitals’ efficiency performance through direct and spillover effects since the adoption of the current constitution in 2008. Our analysis exploits an innovative two-stage approach to estimate hospital efficiency in the first stage and then applies a spatial econometric framework to disentangle direct and spillover effects in the second. The results confirm positive spatial interactions among public hospitals’ efficiency, as well as positive direct and spillover effects coming from demand increases, which have been reinforced since 2008.

10.1080/00343404.2022.2106361.abstractZh: 本研究分析厄瓜多尔公立医院的效率是否存在空间依赖性。我们调查了自2008年现行宪法实施以来，需求变化是否通过直接和溢出效应影响了公立医院的效率表现。我们的分析采用了一种创新的两阶段方法，首先估算医院效率，然后运用空间计量经济学框架来分离直接和溢出效应。研究结果证实，公立医院的效率之间存在积极的空间互动，同时需求增加也带来了积极的直接和溢出效应，这些效应自2008年以来得到了加强。

abstract.text: This article describes three methods for carrying out nonasymptotic inference on partially identified parameters that are solutions to a class of optimization problems. Applications in which the optimization problems arise include estimation under shape restrictions, estimation of models of discrete games, and estimation based on grouped data. The partially identified parameters are characterized by restrictions that involve the unknown population means of observed random variables in addition to structural parameters. Inference consists of finding confidence intervals for functions of the structural parameters. Our theory provides finite-sample lower bounds on the coverage probabilities of the confidence intervals under three sets of assumptions of increasing strength. With the moderate sample sizes found in most economics applications, the bounds become tighter as the assumptions strengthen. We discuss estimation of population parameters that the bounds depend on and contrast our methods with alternative methods for obtaining confidence intervals for partially identified parameters. The results of Monte Carlo experiments and empirical examples illustrate the usefulness of our method.

10.1080/07350015.2022.2093883.abstractZh: 本文描述了三种用于对部分识别参数进行非渐近推断的方法，这些参数是一类优化问题的解。这些优化问题在估计形状受限的参数、离散博弈模型以及基于分组数据的估计中有所应用。部分识别参数的特点在于，除了结构参数之外，还涉及到观测随机变量的未知总体均值。推断过程包括为结构参数的函数找到置信区间。我们的理论在三种假设条件下提供了有限样本下置信区间覆盖概率的下界，这些假设条件的强度逐渐增加。在大多数经济学应用中，样本量适中，随着假设条件的加强，这些下界会变得更加精确。我们讨论了这些下界所依赖的总体参数估计问题，并将我们的方法与获取部分识别参数置信区间的其他方法进行了比较。蒙特卡洛实验的结果和实证例子证明了我们方法的实用性。

abstract.text: Although significant strides have been made in improving maternal and child health outcomes following the millennium development goals, India's progress has been slow, as reflected by its relatively high maternal and child mortality rates. This calls for investigation into the quality of care (QOC) offered to women during pregnancy and childbirth. This study uses primary data to evaluate women's experience of the postnatal care they receive in order to understand maternal perceptions about QOC in Uttarakhand, India. Specifically, we try to measure women's satisfaction with postnatal care and construct a maternal satisfaction index. We also attempt to understand the demographic, socio-economic and obstetric factors that affect them. Results show that a sufficient number of postnatal checks for both the mother and baby were done, while they felt the length of stay in health facilities had been adequate and they had adequate privacy during these processes. These emerged as the most important components of maternal satisfaction. Factors such as women's working status, place of residence, number of children born, pregnancy and delivery related complications, and planned place of delivery were important for their satisfaction. This study may have policy implications to help bridge the supply-demand gaps in the QOC framework.

10.1080/12259276.2021.2023282.abstractZh: 尽管在实现千年发展目标后，改善孕产妇和儿童健康状况方面取得了显著进展，但印度的进展却较为缓慢，这从其相对较高的孕产妇和儿童死亡率中可以看出。因此，有必要调查女性在怀孕和分娩期间所接受的护理质量。本研究利用原始数据来评估女性在产后护理中的体验，以了解印度乌塔拉坎德地区孕产妇对护理质量的看法。具体来说，我们试图衡量女性对产后护理的满意度，并构建一个孕产妇满意度指数。同时，我们还试图了解影响她们满意度的人口统计、社会经济和产科因素。研究结果显示，母亲和婴儿都接受了足够的产后检查，她们认为在医疗机构中的停留时间足够，并且在这些过程中享有足够的隐私。这些因素被认为是影响孕产妇满意度的最重要因素。此外，女性的工作状况、居住地、生育子女的数量、怀孕和分娩相关的并发症以及计划中的分娩地点等因素也对她们的满意度有重要影响。本研究可能有助于制定政策，以弥补护理服务供需之间的差距。

abstract.text: We examine how management quality is related to product market competition when firms are managed by their founders instead of hired managers. While the relationship between competition and managerial incentives is mostly found to be ambiguous in theory, testing it empirically has been challenged by the lack of robust quantitative data. Using a survey on Small and Medium-sized Enterprises from Burkina Faso, we measure management quality, building on the Management and Organizational Practices Survey, and find suggestive evidence that management quality increases with competition. Although the results are robust across a range of measures of competition and sub-indicators of management quality, no significant association is observed in larger firms.

10.1080/13571516.2022.2088987.abstractZh: 我们研究了在企业由创始人管理而非雇佣管理者时，管理质量与产品市场竞争之间的关系。虽然理论上竞争与管理激励之间的关系大多被认为是模糊的，但由于缺乏可靠的定量数据，这一关系的实证检验一直受到挑战。通过对布基纳法索的中小型企业进行的调查，我们基于《管理和组织实践调查》的数据来衡量管理质量，并发现管理质量随市场竞争程度的增加而提升。尽管在多种市场竞争指标和管理质量子指标上，研究结果具有可靠性，但在较大的企业中并未观察到显著的关联。

abstract.text: This study examines how changes to patients' financial responsibility affect physicians' behavior. This is achieved by examining a health insurance reform that changes patients' relative financial responsibilities for a medical service that can be received at one of two locations. In particular, this study examines how physicians' treatment location decisions change after the reform. This study finds that physicians who previously work across the two locations are increasingly observed working at the location that becomes cheaper for patients. Thus, physicians' responsiveness to new policies may be an important lever by which certain demand-side health insurance reforms successfully operate.

10.1080/15140326.2022.2041158.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了患者财务责任的变化如何影响医生的行为。通过一项健康保险改革来考察这一影响，该改革改变了患者对于可以在两个地点之一获得的医疗服务的相对财务责任。具体而言，本研究关注改革后医生治疗地点选择的变化。研究发现，那些之前在两个地点工作的医生，越来越多地选择对患者来说成本更低的地点进行治疗。因此，医生对新政策的响应可能是某些需求端健康保险改革成功实施的重要因素。

abstract.text: Individuals typically differ in their identities—the behaviors they deem ideal for themselves and for the members of their network—and in their tolerance for behaviors that deviate from their ideals. This paper studies compromise—that is, departures from one’s ideal point, to be accepted by others. I show that an individual’s compromise in equilibrium is bounded by the difference between her tolerance level and the lowest tolerance level in society. Relatively intolerant individuals, who serve as “bridges,” are critical for reciprocated compromise. When individuals with extreme identities are systematically less tolerant, societies polarize. In contrast, intolerance among moderates encourages cohesion.

10.1086/717041.abstractZh: 个体在身份上存在差异——他们认为对自己和所在网络中的其他成员理想的行为方式——以及他们对偏离理想行为的容忍度也各不相同。本文研究的是妥协——即偏离个人理想行为，并被他人接受的情况。我指出，个体在均衡状态下的妥协程度受到其容忍水平与社会最低容忍水平之间差异的限制。相对不宽容的个体，作为“桥梁”，对于实现互惠的妥协至关重要。当具有极端身份特征的个体表现出较低的容忍度时，社会就会两极分化；相反，温和派的不宽容则有助于促进社会的凝聚力。

abstract.text: In cooperative property rights systems, workers jointly own and manage production, whereas in outside-ownership systems, an owner contracts workers. Despite a rich literature on how the allocation of property rights matters for specialization, efficiency, and equity, little causal evidence exists. During a land reform in El Salvador in 1980, the military government reorganized properties owned by individuals with cumulative landholdings over 500 hectares into cooperatives; properties below this threshold remained as outside-owned properties. Using the discontinuous probability of cooperative formation, I provide evidence on the effects of cooperative property rights relative to outside ownership on specialization, productivity, and worker equity.

10.1086/717042.abstractZh: 在合作产权制度下，工人共同拥有并管理生产活动；而在非合作产权制度下，所有者则雇佣工人。尽管有大量文献探讨了产权分配对专业化、效率和公平性的影响，但关于这种影响的因果证据却很少。1980年萨尔瓦多进行土地改革时，军政府将个人拥有超过500公顷土地的财产改组为合作社；低于这一标准的财产则仍属于非合作产权。利用合作形成的不连续概率，我提供了关于合作产权相对于非合作产权对专业化、生产效率和工人公平性的影响的证据。

abstract.text: We study the interest rates of privately securitized residential mortgages during the credit boom of the early 2000s. They reveal a sharp and persistent drop in the spread between mortgage and Treasury rates starting in the summer of 2003. The emergence of this mortgage rate conundrum immediately followed the collapse of an unprecedented refinancing wave, and it was more pronounced in the regions where that wave had grown faster. These same areas also experienced more originations of the nonconforming mortgages that boosted private label securitization after 2003. Mortgages originated after this shift are the first to show signs of deteriorating quality.

10.1086/717043.abstractZh: 我们研究了21世纪初信贷繁荣时期私人证券化住宅抵押贷款的利率情况。研究发现，从2003年夏季开始，抵押贷款利率与国债利率之间的利差出现了急剧且持续的下降。这一抵押贷款利率难题的出现，紧随前所未有的再融资浪潮的崩溃之后，并且在那些再融资浪潮发展较快的地区更为明显。同样，这些地区在2003年之后也出现了更多非合规抵押贷款的发行，这促进了私人标签证券化的发展。在这一转变之后发行的抵押贷款，首次显示出质量下降的迹象。
