abstract.text: Many small firms lack the finance and marketing skills needed for growth. A standard approach is to train the entrepreneur in these skills. However, rather than requiring entrepreneurs to learn everything, an alternative is to move beyond the boundary of the entrepreneur and link firms to these skills in a marketplace through insourcing workers or outsourcing tasks to professionals. We conducted a randomized experiment in Nigeria to test the relative effectiveness of these different approaches in improving business practices. Insourcing and outsourcing both dominate business training and do at least as well as business consulting at half the cost.

10.1086/717044.abstractZh: 许多小型企业缺乏促进增长所需的财务和营销技能。一种常见的做法是培训企业家掌握这些技能。然而，与其要求企业家学习所有技能，另一种方法是超越企业家的传统角色，通过将员工内部化或外包给专业人士，将企业与这些技能联系起来。我们在尼日利亚进行了一项随机实验，以测试这两种不同方法在改善企业实践方面的相对有效性。无论是内部化还是外包，都能主导企业培训，并且其成本至少相当于企业咨询的一半。

abstract.text: Common resources may be managed with inefficient policies for the sake of equity. We study how rationing the commons shapes the efficiency and equity of resource use in the context of agricultural groundwater use in Rajasthan, India. We find that rationing binds on input use, such that farmers, despite trivial prices for water extraction, use roughly the socially optimal amount of water on average. The rationing regime is still grossly inefficient, because it misallocates water across farmers, lowering productivity. Pigouvian reform would increase agricultural surplus by 12% of household income yet fall well short of a Pareto improvement over rationing.

10.1086/717045.abstractZh: 为了公平起见，对公共资源的管理可能会采用低效的政策。我们研究了在印度拉贾斯坦邦的农业地下水使用背景下，对公共资源进行配给如何影响资源使用的效率和公平性。研究发现，配给制度限制了资源的投入，尽管取水的成本很低，但农民平均使用的水量仍接近社会最优水平。然而，这种配给制度仍然极其低效，因为它导致水资源在农民之间的分配不均，从而降低了生产效率。实施庇古式改革可以将农业剩余增加12%的家庭收入，但这一措施仍远远无法改善配给制度带来的问题。

abstract.text: We study how managers mitigate the negative impacts of environmental shocks. Pairing productivity data from a garment firm with granular measures of air pollution, we show that productivity suffers as a result of pollution shocks but that managers respond by reallocating particularly sensitive workers to improve worker-to-task matches, thus mitigating team productivity losses. Responses are smaller for more inattentive managers; these same managers are also least able to mitigate productivity declines. These patterns are confirmed by leveraging variation in opportunities for reallocation and comparing how close managers of differing attentiveness can get to the simulated production frontier by reallocating workers.

10.1086/717046.abstractZh: 我们研究了管理者如何减轻环境冲击的负面影响。通过将一家服装公司的生产率数据与详细的空气污染数据相结合，我们发现生产率因污染冲击而下降，但管理者通过重新分配特别敏感的工人来改善工人与任务的匹配度，从而减轻团队生产率的损失。对于不够注意的管理者来说，这种反应较小；这些管理者也最难以减轻生产率的下降。这些现象通过利用重新分配的机会差异，并比较不同注意力水平的管理者通过重新分配工人所能达到的模拟生产前沿来加以验证。

abstract.text: Intermediaries in decentralized markets can affect buyer welfare both directly, by reducing expenses for buyers with high search cost, and indirectly, through a search externality that affects the prices paid by buyers who do not use intermediaries. I investigate the magnitude of these effects in New York City’s trade-waste market, where buyers can search either by themselves or through a waste broker. Combining elements from the empirical search and procurement auction literatures, I construct and estimate a model for a decentralized market. Results from the model show that intermediaries improve welfare and benefit buyers in both the broker and the search markets.

10.1086/717349.abstractZh: 在去中心化的市场中，中间商可以通过两种方式影响买方的福利：直接降低高搜索成本的买方的支出，以及通过搜索外部性间接影响不使用中间商的买方的支付价格。我研究了这些效应在纽约市贸易废料市场中的影响程度，在该市场中，买家可以选择自行搜索或通过废料经纪人进行搜索。结合实证搜索和采购拍卖领域的理论，我构建并估计了一个去中心化市场的模型。模型的结果表明，中间商能够提升福利，并在经纪市场和搜索市场中为买家带来利益。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes a bilateral trade model in which the buyer’s valuation for the object is uncertain and she can privately purchase any signal about her valuation. The seller makes a take-it-or-leave-it offer to the buyer. The cost of a signal is smooth and increasing in informativeness. We characterize the set of equilibria when learning is free and show that they are strongly Pareto ranked. Our main result is that when learning is costly but the cost of information goes to zero, equilibria converge to the worst free-learning equilibrium.

10.1086/717350.abstractZh: 本文分析了一个双边贸易模型，其中买方的物品估值是不确定的，她可以私下购买任何关于自己估值的信号。卖方向买方提出一个接受或放弃的报价。信号的成本是平滑的，并且随着信息量的增加而增加。我们描述了在学习是免费的情况下均衡集合的特征，并表明这些均衡在帕累托意义上具有强烈的排序性。我们的主要结论是，当学习成本较高，但信息成本趋于零时，均衡会收敛到最差的免费学习均衡。

abstract.text: We examine the nature of consumer demand for government-controlled online news outlets in Russia, testing whether such demand reflects a preference for progovernment ideological coverage or other factors unrelated to outlets’ ideological positions. We detect government-sensitive topics and measure outlets’ news-reporting decisions from news article texts, and we estimate a structural model of demand for news, using detailed browsing data that traces individual-level consumption. The average consumer has a distaste for progovernment ideology but a strong, persistent taste for state-owned outlets, primarily driven by third-party referrals and nonsensitive news content. We discuss implications for online media control and media power.

10.1086/717351.abstractZh: 我们研究了俄罗斯消费者对于政府控制的在线新闻媒体的需求性质，探讨这种需求是否反映了对亲政府意识形态报道的偏好，还是与其他因素相关。我们通过检测政府敏感话题，并从新闻文章文本中衡量媒体对新闻报道的决策，并利用详细的浏览数据来估计对新闻的需求结构模型，这些数据能够追踪个体层面的消费行为。平均而言，消费者对亲政府意识形态持反感态度，但对国有媒体的需求却非常强烈且持久，这一需求主要由第三方推荐和非敏感新闻内容所驱动。我们讨论了这对在线媒体控制与媒体权力的影响。

abstract.text: How does banking competition affect credit provision and growth? How does it affect financial stability? In order to identify the causal effects of banking competition, we exploit a discontinuity in bank capital requirements during the nineteenth-century National Banking Era. We show that banks operating in markets with lower entry barriers extend more credit. The resulting credit expansion, in turn, is associated with additional real economic activity. However, banks in markets with lower entry barriers also take more risk and are more likely to default. Thus, we provide causal evidence that banking competition can cause both growth and financial instability.

10.1086/717453.abstractZh: 银行竞争如何影响信贷提供和经济增长？它又如何影响金融稳定？为了识别银行竞争的因果效应，我们利用了19世纪国家银行时代银行资本要求的不连续性。我们发现，在进入壁垒较低的市场中运营的银行会提供更多的信贷。这种信贷扩张反过来又促进了实际经济活动的增加。然而，在进入壁垒较低的市场中运营的银行也承担更多的风险，违约的可能性也更高。因此，我们有证据表明，银行竞争既可以促进经济增长，也可能导致金融不稳定。

abstract.text: If bidding in a pure common-value auction is costly and bidders do not know how many others are also bidding, all equilibria are in mixed strategies. Participation is probabilistic, and bid prices are dispersed. The symmetric equilibrium is unique and yields simple analytic expressions. We use them to, for example, show that bid prices exhibit negative skewness. The expressions are further used to estimate the model based on bidding on a Standard & Poor’s 500 security. We find that the number of bidders declined over time, making liquidity supply fragile.

10.1086/717454.abstractZh: 如果在纯共同价值拍卖中出价成本较高，且竞买者不清楚还有多少其他竞买者参与，那么所有均衡都将采用混合策略。参与行为具有概率性，出价价格也呈现分散状态。对称均衡是唯一的，并且可以推导出简单的解析表达式。我们利用这些表达式来证明出价价格具有负偏度。这些表达式还被用于基于标准普尔500指数证券的竞买情况来估算模型。我们发现，随着时间的推移，竞买者的数量减少，导致流动性供应变得脆弱。

abstract.text: Do elites capture foreign aid? This paper documents that aid disbursements to highly aid-dependent countries coincide with sharp increases in bank deposits in offshore financial centers known for bank secrecy and private wealth management but not in other financial centers. The estimates are not confounded by contemporaneous shocks—such as civil conflicts, natural disasters, and financial crises—and are robust to instrumenting using predetermined aid commitments. The implied leakage rate is around 7.5% at the sample mean and tends to increase with the ratio of aid to GDP. The findings are consistent with aid capture in the most aid-dependent countries.

10.1086/717455.abstractZh: 精英是否攫取了外国援助？本文指出，对高度依赖援助的国家进行的援助分配与离岸金融中心银行存款的急剧增加同时发生，这些金融中心以银行保密和私人财富管理而闻名，而其他金融中心则没有这种现象。这些估计结果并未受到诸如内战、自然灾害和金融危机等同期冲击的影响，并且在使用预设的援助承诺作为工具变量时依然保持稳定。样本平均的泄漏率约为7.5%，并且随着援助与GDP的比例增加而上升。这些发现与最依赖援助的国家中援助被攫取的情况一致。

abstract.text: We show that labor market transaction costs explain why the smallest farms are more efficient than slightly larger farms in most low-income countries and that increases in machine capacity with operational scale result in the globally observed rising upper tail of productivity. We find evidence consistent with these mechanisms using Indian data, and we show that if all Indian farms were at the minimum scale required to maximize the return on land, the number of farms would be reduced by 82% and income per farm worker would rise by 68%.

10.1086/717890.abstractZh: 我们指出，劳动力市场的交易成本解释了为什么在大多数低收入国家中，规模最小的农场比稍大一些的农场更高效，并且随着机器产能随运营规模的增加，全球范围内生产率的较高水平也会随之上升。我们使用印度数据发现了与这些机制一致的证据，并表明如果所有印度农场都达到最大化土地回报所需的最小规模，那么农场数量将减少82%，每个农场工人的收入将增加68%。

abstract.text: The vast majority of the pay inequality in organizations comes from differences in pay between employees and their bosses. But are employees aware of these pay disparities? Are employees demotivated by this inequality? To address these questions, we conducted a natural field experiment with a sample of 2,060 employees from a multibillion-dollar corporation in Southeast Asia. We document large misperceptions among employees about the salaries of their managers and smaller but still significant misperceptions of the salaries of their peers, and we show that these perceptions have a significant causal effect on the employees’ own behavior.

10.1086/717891.abstractZh: 组织中绝大多数薪酬不平等源于员工与上级之间的薪酬差异。但员工是否意识到这些薪酬差距呢？这种不平等是否会导致员工失去动力呢？为了解答这些问题，我们在东南亚一家价值数十亿美元的公司中，对2,060名员工进行了实地实验。我们发现，员工对管理层的薪酬存在严重的误解，对同事的薪酬也存在一些误解，而这些误解对员工自身的行为有着显著的因果影响。

abstract.text: We provide a method to estimate resource shares—the fraction of total household expenditure allocated to each household member—using linear (e.g., ordinary least squares) estimation of Engel curves. The method is a linear reframing of the 2013 nonlinear model of Dunbar, Lewbel, and Pendakur, extended to allow single-parent and other complex households, scale economies in assignable goods, and complementarities between nonassignable goods and supplemented with a linear identification test. We apply the model to data from 12 countries and investigate resource shares, gender gaps, and poverty at the individual level. We reject equal sharing and find large gender gaps in resource shares, and consequently in poverty rates, in some countries.

10.1086/717892.abstractZh: 我们提供了一种方法，用于估算资源分配比例——即总家庭支出中分配给每个家庭成员的份额——该方法采用线性估计方法（例如普通最小二乘法）来推导恩格尔曲线。该方法是对Dunbar、Lewbel和Pendakur在2013年提出的非线性模型的线性重构，并扩展以涵盖单亲家庭及其他复杂家庭情况、可分配商品的规模经济效应，以及不可分配商品之间的互补性。我们将该模型应用于12个国家的数据，研究个体层面的资源分配比例、性别差异以及贫困状况。我们否定了平均分配的观点，并发现某些国家中存在较大的性别资源分配差异，从而导致贫困率的差异。

abstract.text: We investigate the effect of welfare reform on intergenerational welfare participation, using mother-daughter pairs in the Panel Study of Income Dynamics. We find that a mother’s Aid to Families with Dependent Children/Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (AFDC/TANF) participation increased her daughter’s odds of adult participation in that program by roughly 25 percentage points or more, but that welfare reform attenuated this transmission by at least 50%. However, there is no diminution of transmission after welfare reform when we consider the wider safety net or other outcomes. Daughters who grew up with mothers on AFDC/TANF were no better off after reform, with substitution toward other welfare programs over generations.

10.1086/717893.abstractZh: 我们研究了福利改革对代际福利参与的影响，采用了“收入动态面板研究”中的母女配对样本。研究发现，母亲参与“援助有子女家庭/临时援助贫困家庭”计划后，其女儿成年后参与该计划的概率大约增加了25个百分点以上，但福利改革至少使这种影响减弱了50%。然而，当我们考虑更广泛的社会保障网络或其他指标时，福利改革并未导致这种影响的减弱。那些在母亲参与AFDC/TANF计划期间长大的女儿，在改革后并没有变得更幸运，她们代际间更倾向于替代其他福利项目。

abstract.text: We provide a parsimonious and unified explanation for randomized selling mechanisms widely used in practice yet commonly perceived as puzzling. Optimality of randomization in the form of conflation and rationing implies that revenue under market-clearing pricing is nonconcave. Randomization is implementable via opaque pricing and underpricing. Relative to market-clearing pricing, randomization increases the equilibrium quantity and quality of goods sold and, consequently, may increase consumer surplus. For fixed quantities, resale increases consumer surplus. However, resale can decrease the equilibrium quantity and quality of goods sold. Thus, resale prohibition, which always benefits the seller, may also increase consumer surplus.

10.1086/717894.abstractZh: 我们为实践中广泛使用的随机销售机制提供了一个简洁且统一的解释。随机化的最优性表现为合并和分配，这意味着市场清算定价下的收入是非凹的。随机化可以通过不透明的定价和低价策略来实现。与市场清算定价相比，随机化能够增加商品销售的均衡数量和质量，从而可能增加消费者剩余。对于固定数量的商品，转售可以增加消费者剩余。然而，转售可能会降低商品销售的均衡数量和质量。因此，禁止转售虽然总是对卖方有利，但也可能增加消费者剩余。

abstract.text: We provide a unifying empirical framework to study why crime reductions occurred due to a sequence of state-level dropout age reforms enacted between 1980 and 2010 in the United States. Because the reforms changed the shape of crime-age profiles, they generate both a short-term incapacitation effect and a more sustained crime-reducing effect. In contrast to previous research looking at earlier US education reforms, we find that reform-induced crime reduction does not arise primarily from education improvements. Decomposing short- and long-run effects, the observed longer-run effect for the post-1980 education reforms is primarily attributed to dynamic incapacitation.

10.1086/717895.abstractZh: 我们提供了一个统一的实证框架，用于研究为什么在1980年至2010年间美国实施的一系列州级辍学年龄改革导致了犯罪率的下降。由于这些改革改变了犯罪年龄分布的特征，它们既产生了短期的抑制效应，也产生了更为持久的犯罪减少效应。与之前研究美国早期教育改革相比，我们发现改革引发的犯罪减少主要并非源于教育的改善。通过对短期和长期效应的分解，我们发现1980年后教育改革所观察到的长期效应主要归因于动态抑制效应。

abstract.text: This paper studies the extent to which centrality measures share a common structure. In contrast with prior work, I take an ordinal approach, defining centrality measures as preorders that satisfy an axiom called recursive monotonicity. From this axiom, I derive two fundamental measures, strong and weak centrality, and I relate these to the equilibria of network games. Any equilibrium in a game of strategic complements implicitly orders the players by their actions. Strong centrality captures comparisons shared across all equilibria in all such games. Weak centrality captures comparisons shared across minimal and maximal equilibria in all such games.

10.1086/718191.abstractZh: 本文研究了中心性度量在多大程度上具有共同的结构。与以往的研究不同，我采用了一种序贯的方法，将中心性度量定义为满足一种称为递归单调性的公理的预序。基于这一公理，我推导出两种基本的中心性度量：强中心性和弱中心性，并将它们与网络博弈的均衡联系起来。在任何战略互补博弈的均衡中，玩家的行动都隐含着一定的排序。强中心性捕捉了所有此类博弈中所有均衡之间共享的比较关系；而弱中心性则捕捉了所有此类博弈中最小均衡和最大均衡之间共享的比较关系。

abstract.text: Polarization is both a description of the current state of politics and a dynamic path that has rippled across the political domain over decades. We provide a simple model that explains why polarization appears incrementally and why it was elites who polarized first and more dramatically, whereas mass polarization came later and has been less pronounced. We incorporate an ostensibly unrelated finding about how voters form preferences into a dynamic model of elections. This change, when combined with the response of strategic candidates, creates a feedback loop that can replicate many features of the data. We explore the model’s implications for other aspects of politics and trace what it predicts for the future of polarization.

10.1086/718200.abstractZh: 两极分化既描述了当前的政治状况，也是一种在数十年间在政治领域不断扩散的动态趋势。我们提出了一个简单的模型，用以解释为何两极分化是逐步出现的，以及为何是精英阶层首先且更为显著地导致了两极分化，而大众层面的两极分化则出现得较晚且程度较轻。我们将关于选民如何形成偏好的一个看似不相关的发现纳入选举动态模型中。这一变化，结合策略性候选人的反应，形成了一个反馈循环，能够复制许多数据特征。我们探讨了该模型对政治其他方面的启示，并预测了两极分化未来的走向。

abstract.text: Teachers and mentors in creative fields shape their students’ skills and views of the craft and thus the work they produce. How significant and persistent is this influence? Are there consequences for the variety and quality of students’ inventive output? We study these questions in the context of Western music composition over five centuries, during which musical lineages are well documented, the content of composers’ work can be directly compared, and its lasting value can be measured. We find strong evidence of influence, document when it arises and persists, and evaluate its consequences. The results provide insight into where creative ideas come from, why certain ideas get produced as opposed to others, and what the ramifications might be.

10.1086/718370.abstractZh: 在创意领域，教师和导师能够塑造学生的技能以及对艺术形式的理解，从而影响他们创作的作品。这种影响有多重要且持久？它是否会对学生的创意成果的种类和质量产生影响？我们在五个世纪的西方音乐创作背景下研究了这些问题。在这段时间里，音乐流派得到了充分的记录，作曲家作品的内容可以直接进行比较，其持久价值也可以被衡量。我们发现这种影响是显著的，能够确定其出现的时间和持续的时间，并评估其后果。研究结果有助于我们了解创意的来源，为什么某些创意会被产生而另一些则不会，以及这些创意可能带来的影响。

abstract.text: Economic models are evaluated by testing the correctness of their predictions. We suggest an additional measure, “completeness”: the fraction of the predictable variation in the data that the model captures. We calculate the completeness of prominent models in three problems from experimental economics: assigning certainty equivalents to lotteries, predicting initial play in games, and predicting human generation of random sequences. The completeness measure reveals new insights about these models, including how much room there is for improving their predictions.

10.1086/718371.abstractZh: 经济模型通过测试其预测的准确性来评估。我们提出了一种额外的衡量标准：“完整性”，即模型能够捕捉到数据中可预测变化的程度。我们针对实验经济学中的三个问题计算了主要模型的完整性：为彩票分配确定性等价、预测游戏中的初始参与行为，以及预测人类生成随机序列的行为。完整性指标揭示了这些模型的一些新见解，包括改进其预测能力还有多大的空间。

abstract.text: The conventional theory about the origin of the state is that the adoption of farming increased land productivity, which led to the production of food surplus. This surplus was a prerequisite for the emergence of tax-levying elites and, eventually, states. We challenge this theory and propose that hierarchy arose as a result of the shift to dependence on appropriable cereal grains. Our empirical investigation, utilizing multiple data sets spanning several millennia, demonstrates a causal effect of the cultivation of cereals on hierarchy, without finding a similar effect for land productivity. We further support our claims with several case studies.

10.1086/718372.abstractZh: 关于国家起源的传统理论认为，农业的采用提高了土地的生产力，从而产生了食物盈余。这种盈余是征税精英阶层以及最终形成国家的先决条件。我们对此理论提出质疑，认为等级制度的出现是由于人们开始依赖可获取的谷物。我们的实证研究利用了跨越数千年的一系列数据，证明了谷物种植对等级制度的影响，而土地生产力则没有类似的效应。我们还通过几个案例研究进一步支持了我们的观点。

abstract.text: An individual’s decision to reason about a problem may involve a trade-off between cognitive costs and a notion of value. This paper analyzes the primitive properties that must hold for the decision to stop thinking to be represented by a cost-benefit analysis. We then provide additional properties that give more structure to the value of reasoning function. We show how our model applies to a variety of settings, including contexts involving R&D applications, response time, and strategic reasoning. Our model can also be used to understand patterns of behavior for which the cost-benefit approach does not seem to hold.

10.1086/718378.abstractZh: 个人对问题的推理决策可能涉及认知成本与价值观念之间的权衡。本文分析了决策停止思考所必须满足的初步属性，这些属性可以通过成本效益分析来体现。随后，我们提出了一些额外的属性，以进一步构建推理功能的价值结构。我们展示了该模型如何适用于多种情境，包括研发应用、响应时间以及战略推理等领域。此外，该模型还可以用于理解那些成本效益分析方法似乎不适用的行为模式。

abstract.text: We document evidence of widespread collusion among construction firms in Japan using a novel data set covering most of the construction projects procured by the Japanese national government. Our data set contains information on about 42,000 auctions whose award amount sums to about $40 billion. We identify collusion by focusing on rebids that occur for auctions in which all (initial) bids fail to meet the secret reserve price. We identify more than 1,000 firms whose conduct is inconsistent with competitive behavior. These bidders were awarded about 15,000 projects, or about 37% of the total number of projects in our sample.

10.1086/718913.abstractZh: 我们通过一种新颖的数据集记录了日本建筑公司之间广泛存在的勾结行为，该数据集涵盖了日本政府采购的大部分建筑项目。我们的数据集包含了约42,000次拍卖的信息，这些拍卖的总金额约为400亿美元。我们通过关注那些在初始投标均未能达到秘密保留价的情况下重新进行的拍卖来识别勾结行为。我们发现了1,000多家行为不符合竞争规则的公司，这些公司获得了约15,000个项目，占我们样本中所有项目的约37%。

abstract.text: We provide new theory and evidence on the role of external and internal integration in structural transformation and economic development, using Argentina’s integration into the world economy in the late nineteenth century. Our theoretical model provides microfoundations for a spatial Balassa-Samuelson effect, in which locations closer to world markets have higher population densities, urban population shares, relative prices of nontraded goods, and land prices relative to wages, as well as specializing in traded goods that are transport-cost sensitive. We estimate the model’s parameters, provide evidence in support of this spatial Balassa-Samuelson mechanism, and find substantial effects of both external and internal integration on economic development.

10.1086/718915.abstractZh: 我们基于19世纪末阿根廷融入世界经济的案例，提出了关于外部与内部整合在结构转型和经济发展中作用的新理论和证据。我们的理论模型为“巴拉萨-萨缪尔森效应”提供了微观基础，该效应表明：靠近世界市场的地区具有更高的人口密度、城市人口比例、非贸易商品的相对价格，以及相对于工资的土地价格，同时这些地区还会专门从事受运输成本影响的贸易商品。我们估算了模型的参数，为这一空间上的巴拉萨-萨缪尔森机制提供了证据支持，并发现外部与内部整合对经济发展具有显著的影响。

abstract.text: Auctions are often used to sell assets whose future cash flows require the winner to make postauction investments. When winners’ payments are contingent on these cash flows, auction design can influence both bidding and incentives to exert effort after the auction. We propose a model of contingent payment auctions that links auction design to postauction economic activity. In the context of oil leases in the Permian Basin, we show that moral hazard affects the relative revenue ranking of different auction designs. Among a large class of alternatives, the observed design cannot be changed to increase both revenues and drilling rates.

10.1086/718916.abstractZh: 拍卖常被用于出售那些未来现金流需要中标者在拍卖后进行投资资产。当中标者的支付取决于这些现金流时，拍卖设计会影响竞拍行为和努力付出的动机。我们提出了一个关于条件支付拍卖的模型，将拍卖设计与拍卖后的经济活动联系起来。在二叠纪盆地的石油租赁案例中，我们发现道德风险影响了不同拍卖设计的相对收入排名。在众多替代方案中，观察到的设计无法被改变以同时提高收入和钻探率。

abstract.text: Lack of commitment at the time of auction to repayment of imminently maturing debt can generate a run on debt and immediate default. We show that the same lack of commitment leads to other possible self-fulfilling crises, including issuance of more debt at depressed prices, or a “sudden stop” (forced austerity) in which debt issuance is sharply curtailed. Both outcomes stem from the government's incentive to eliminate uncertainty about imminent payments at the time of auction by altering the level of debt issuance. These outcomes generate a large increase in spread volatility in both a 1-period and a multiperiod quantitative debt model.

10.1086/718934.abstractZh: 在拍卖时缺乏偿还即将到期债务的承诺，可能会导致债务挤兑和立即违约。我们发现，同样的缺乏承诺还会引发其他可能的自我实现危机，包括以低价发行更多债务，或者采取“突然停止”措施（强制紧缩政策），从而大幅减少债务发行。这两种结果都源于政府试图通过改变债务发行水平来消除拍卖时关于即将付款的不确定性。这些结果在1期和多期定量债务模型中都会显著增加利率波动。

abstract.text: We examine gender differences in misconduct punishment in the financial advisory industry. There is a “gender punishment gap”: following an incident of misconduct, female advisers are 20% more likely to lose their jobs and 30% less likely to find new jobs, relative to male advisers. The gender punishment gap is not driven by gender differences in occupation, productivity, nature of misconduct, or recidivism. The gap in hiring and firing dissipates at firms with a greater percentage of female managers and executives. We also explore the differential treatment of ethnic minority men and find similar patterns of “in-group” tolerance.

10.1086/718964.abstractZh: 我们研究了金融咨询行业中对不当行为惩罚的性别差异。存在“性别惩罚差距”：在发生不当行为后，女性顾问失业的可能性比男性顾问高出20%，找到新工作的可能性则低30%。这种性别惩罚差距并非由职业、生产力、不当行为的性质或再犯率等性别差异所导致。在女性管理者和高管比例较高的企业中，这种招聘和解雇的差距会有所缩小。我们还探讨了少数民族男性受到的差异化待遇，发现其“同族”容忍度也存在类似模式。

abstract.text: We study how different forms of communication influence inflation expectations in a randomized controlled trial using nearly 20,000 US individuals. We elicit individuals’ inflation expectations and then provide eight different forms of information regarding inflation. Reading the actual Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) statement has about the same average effect on expectations as simply being told about the Federal Reserve’s inflation target. Reading news articles about the most recent FOMC meetings results in a forecast revision that is smaller by half. This exogenous variation in inflation expectations has subsequent effects on household spending reported in scanner and survey data.

10.1086/718982.abstractZh: 我们通过一项随机对照试验，研究了不同形式的沟通如何影响通胀预期。该试验涉及近20,000名美国个体。我们首先收集了个体的通胀预期，然后提供了八种关于通胀的不同形式的信息。阅读联邦公开市场委员会的实际声明对通胀预期的影响，与仅被告知美联储的通胀目标相比，平均效果相当。而阅读关于最近一次联邦公开市场委员会会议的新闻报道，则会导致通胀预期预测出现较小的修正，修正幅度约为一半。这种通胀预期的外生变化，随后会对家庭支出产生影响，这一点在扫描数据和调查数据中都有体现。

abstract.text: We document quasi-experimental evidence against the common assumption in the matching literature that agents have full information on their own preferences. In Germany’s university admissions, the first stages of the Gale-Shapley algorithm are implemented in real time, allowing for multiple offers per student. We demonstrate that nonexploding early offers are accepted more often than later offers, despite not being more desirable. These results, together with survey evidence and a theoretical model, are consistent with students’ costly discovery of preferences. A novel dynamic multioffer mechanism that batches early offers improves matching efficiency by informing students of offer availability before preference discovery.

10.1086/718983.abstractZh: 我们提供了准实验性证据，反驳了匹配文献中常见的假设，即个体对其自身偏好有完全的信息。在德国大学招生过程中，Gale-Shapley算法的第一阶段是实时实施的，这意味着每个学生可以同时收到多个录取通知。我们的研究表明，不破灭的早期录取通知被接受的频率更高，尽管这些通知并不更受欢迎。这些结果，加上调查数据和理论模型，与学生对自身偏好的昂贵发现过程相一致。一种新颖的动态多通知机制通过提前告知学生录取通知的可用性，从而提高了匹配效率。

abstract.text: We study how signaling affects equilibrium outcomes and welfare in an online credit market, using detailed data on loan characteristics and borrower repayment. We build and estimate an equilibrium model in which a borrower may signal her default risk through the reserve interest rate. Comparing markets with and without signaling relative to the benchmark with no asymmetric information, we find that adverse selection destroys as much as 34% of total surplus, up to 78% of which can be restored with signaling. We also estimate backward-bending supply curves for some markets, consistent with the prediction made by Stiglitz and Weiss in 1981.

10.1086/718984.abstractZh: 我们研究了信号传递如何影响在线信贷市场的均衡结果和福利状况，使用了关于贷款特征和借款人还款情况的详细数据。我们构建并估计了一个均衡模型，在该模型中，借款人可以通过储备利率来传递其违约风险。通过比较有信号传递的市场与没有信号传递的市场，以及没有信息不对称的情况，我们发现逆向选择会破坏高达34%的总剩余，而其中高达78%的剩余可以通过信号传递得到恢复。我们还估计了某些市场的供给曲线向后弯曲的现象，这与Stiglitz和Weiss在1981年所做的预测是一致的。

abstract.text: We argue that economists have studied the role of management from three perspectives: contingency theory (CT), an organization-centric empirical approach (OC), and a leader-centric empirical approach (LC). To reconcile these three perspectives, we augment a standard dynamic firm model with organizational capital, an intangible, slow-moving, productive asset that can be produced only with the direct input of the firm’s leadership and that is subject to an agency problem. We characterize the steady state of an economy with imperfect governance and show that it rationalizes key findings of CT, OC, and LC as well as generates a number of new predictions on performance, management practices, chief executive officer behavior and compensation, and governance.

10.1086/718985.abstractZh: 我们认为，经济学家从三个角度研究了管理的作用：权变理论、以组织为中心的实证方法以及以领导者为中心的实证方法。为了调和这三个视角，我们在一个标准的动态企业模型中加入了组织资本这一概念，组织资本是一种无形的、发展缓慢的、具有生产力的资产，其形成需要企业领导层的直接参与，并且存在代理问题。我们描述了治理不完善的经济的稳态状态，并表明这种状态能够解释权变理论、以组织为中心的实证方法以及以领导者为中心的实证方法的关键发现，同时还能提出许多关于绩效、管理实践、首席执行官行为、薪酬以及治理的新预测。

abstract.text: We introduce three new classes of attention cost functions: posterior separable, uniformly posterior separable, and invariant posterior separable. As with the Shannon cost function, all can be solved using Lagrangian methods. Uniformly posterior-separable cost functions capture many forms of sequential learning and hence play a key role in many applications. Invariant posterior-separable cost functions make learning strategies depend exclusively on payoff uncertainty. We introduce two behavioral axioms, Locally Invariant Posteriors and Only Payoffs Matter, which identify posterior-separable functions as uniformly and invariant posterior separable, respectively. In combination, they pinpoint the Shannon cost function.

10.1086/719276.abstractZh: 我们引入了三类新的注意力成本函数：后验可分离型、均匀后验可分离型以及不变后验可分离型。与香农成本函数类似，这些函数都可以用拉格朗日方法求解。均匀后验可分离型成本函数能够捕捉多种序列学习形式，因此在许多应用中发挥着关键作用。不变后验可分离型成本函数则使学习策略完全依赖于收益的不确定性。我们提出了两个行为公理：局部不变后验以及收益至上，这些公理分别将后验可分离型函数定义为均匀后验可分离型以及不变后验可分离型。综合这些公理，我们确定了香农成本函数的本质。

abstract.text: This paper examines the long-term and spillover effects of management interventions on firm performance. Under the Training Within Industry (TWI) program, the U.S. government provided management training to firms involved in war production between 1940 and 1945. Using a newly collected panel dataset on all 11,575 U.S. firms that applied to the program, we find that the TWI training had positive and long-lasting effects on firm performance and the adoption of beneficial managerial practices. Moreover, it generated complementarities among different types of training and had positive spillover effects on the supply chain of trained firms.

10.1086/719277.abstractZh: 本文探讨了管理干预对企业绩效的长期影响及溢出效应。在“行业内部培训”计划下，美国政府在1940至1945年间为参与战争生产的企业提供了管理培训。通过新收集的数据面板数据集，我们对所有11,575家申请该计划的美资企业进行了分析，发现“行业内部培训”对企业的绩效以及有益管理实践的采纳产生了积极且持久的影响。此外，该计划还促进了不同类型培训之间的互补性，并对受训企业的供应链产生了积极的溢出效应。

abstract.text: This paper endogenizes intervention in financial crises as the strategic negotiation between a regulator and creditors of distressed banks. Incentives for banks to contribute to a voluntary bail-in arise from their exposure to financial contagion. In equilibrium, a bail-in is possible only if the regulator’s threat to not bail out insolvent banks is credible. Contrary to models without intervention or with government bailouts only, sparse networks enhance welfare for two main reasons: they improve the credibility of the regulator’s no-bailout threat for large shocks, and they reduce free-riding incentives among bail-in contributors when the threat is credible.

10.1086/719758.abstractZh: 本文将金融危机中的干预行为视为监管机构与陷入困境的银行债权人之间的战略谈判。银行参与自愿减资的动机源于其面临金融传染的风险。在均衡状态下，只有当监管机构不救助无力偿还的银行的威胁具有可信性时，减资才成为可能。与没有干预或仅依赖政府救助的模型不同，稀疏网络能够提升福利，主要有两个原因：一是它提高了监管机构在重大冲击下不救助威胁的可信度；二是当这种威胁具有可信性时，它减少了减资参与者之间的搭便车行为。

abstract.text: We explore firm size heterogeneity in production networks. In comprehensive data for Belgium, firms with more customers have higher total sales but lower sales and lower market shares per customer. Downstream factors, especially the number of customers, explain the vast majority of firm size dispersion. We rationalize these facts with a model of network formation and two-dimensional firm heterogeneity. Higher productivity generates more matches and larger market shares among customers. Higher relationship capability generates more customers and higher sales. Model estimates suggest a strong negative correlation between productivity and relationship capability and potentially large welfare gains from improving relationship capability.

10.1086/719759.abstractZh: 我们探讨了生产网络中企业规模的不一致性。通过对比利时的综合数据分析，我们发现拥有更多客户的企业总销售额较高，但每客户的销售额和市场份额却较低。下游因素，尤其是客户数量，解释了企业规模差异的绝大部分。我们用一个网络形成模型和二维企业异质性模型来解释这些现象。更高的生产力能够带来更多的客户匹配，并使得企业在客户中的市场份额更大。更强的关系能力能够吸引更多客户并带来更高的销售额。模型估计表明，生产力与关系能力之间存在强烈的负相关关系，而提升关系能力可能会带来巨大的福利收益。

abstract.text: The quality of the match between students and schools affects learning, but little is known about the magnitude of these effects or how they respond to changes in market structure. I develop a quantitative equilibrium model of school competition with horizontal competition in match quality. I estimate the model using data from Pakistan, a country with high private enrollment, and (1) quantify the importance of good matches, (2) show that profit-maximizing private schools' choices of quality advantage wealthier students, increasing inequality and reducing welfare and learning, and (3) provide intuition for when interventions in the market are valuable.

10.1086/719760.abstractZh: 学生与学校之间的匹配质量会影响学习效果，但关于这些影响的程度以及它们如何响应市场结构的变化，我们知之甚少。我开发了一个定量均衡模型，用于研究学校竞争在匹配质量方面的水平竞争。我使用巴基斯坦的数据对该模型进行了估计，巴基斯坦是一个私人教育入学率较高的国家。该模型有助于量化良好匹配的重要性，表明以利润最大化为目标的私立学校选择为富裕学生提供高质量的教育，这会增加不平等，降低福利和学习效果。此外，该模型还为干预市场行为的时机提供了依据。

abstract.text: This paper measures impacts of removing children from families investigated for abuse or neglect. We use removal tendencies of child protection investigators as an instrument. Our analysis focuses on young children investigated before age 6 and finds that removal significantly increases test scores and reduces grade repetition for girls. There are no detectable impacts for boys. This pattern of results does not appear to be driven by heterogeneity in preremoval characteristics, foster placements, or types of schools attended after removal. The results are consistent with the hypothesis that development of abused and neglected girls is more responsive to home removal.

10.1086/719856.abstractZh: 本文研究了将儿童从遭受虐待或忽视的家庭中带走的影响。我们采用儿童保护调查员带走儿童的倾向作为研究工具。我们的分析重点关注6岁之前的儿童，发现带走儿童的行为显著提高了儿童的测试成绩，并减少了女孩的留级情况。而男孩则没有显示出明显的影响。这些结果似乎并不受带走前儿童的特征、寄养情况或带走后就读学校类型等因素的影响。这些结果与“受虐待和忽视的女孩对家庭带走的反应更为敏感”的假设一致。

abstract.text: The canonical approach to measuring private and social returns to R&D assumes diffusion through spillovers. We develop a general framework that allows R&D to diffuse through both spillovers and voluntary technology transfers. To operationalize the framework, we create a data set of interactions in the market for technology between publicly held US firms. We use changes in tax incentives for R&D to identify causal effects. Taking market channels into account decreases the observed difference between social and private returns to R&D as compared with the canonical approach. The analysis suggests significant gains from trade in markets for technology.

10.1086/719908.abstractZh: 衡量研发对私人和社会回报的规范方法假设研发通过溢出效应传播。我们提出了一个通用框架，使得研发可以通过溢出效应和自愿的技术转让来传播。为了实施这一框架，我们创建了一个包含美国上市公司之间技术市场互动的数据集。我们通过改变研发税收激励措施来识别因果效应。考虑到市场渠道的影响，与规范方法相比，观察到的研发对社会和私人回报的差异有所减少。分析表明，在技术市场中，贸易能够带来显著的收益。

abstract.text: A principal (e.g., the US government) contracts with a researcher with unknown costs (e.g., a vaccine developer) to conduct a costly experiment. This contracting problem has a novel feature that captures the difference between the form of an experiment and the strength of its results: researchers face a problem of information design rather than optimal effort. Using a novel comparative static for Bayesian persuasion settings, I characterize the optimal contract and show how experimentation is distorted by the need to screen researchers. Moreover, I show that there is no loss from contracting on the experiment’s result rather than the experiment itself.

10.1086/720072.abstractZh: 一个主体（例如美国政府）与一位成本未知的研究人员（例如疫苗开发者）签订合同，以进行一项成本高昂的实验。这一合同问题具有一个独特的特点，即它揭示了实验形式与其结果质量之间的区别：研究人员面临的是信息设计的问题，而非最优努力的问题。我采用一种新颖的比较静态方法，针对贝叶斯说服场景进行了分析，从而描述了最优合同的形式，并说明了实验过程如何因需要筛选研究人员而受到扭曲。此外，我还表明，将合同签订在实验结果上而非实验本身上，并不会造成任何损失。

abstract.text: Using bid-level data from discriminatory auctions for Mexican government bonds, we demonstrate that asymmetric information about default risk is a key friction in sovereign bond markets. We document that large bidders achieve higher bid-acceptance rates than other bidders despite paying no more for executed bids. We then propose a new model of primary markets in which investors may differ in wealth, risk aversion, market power, and information. Only asymmetric information can qualitatively account for our empirical finding, and asymmetric information about rare disasters can quantitatively match bidding and yield moments. Counterfactuals reveal substantial effects of asymmetric information on yields.

10.1086/720139.abstractZh: 通过对比墨西哥政府债券歧视性拍卖的投标数据，我们发现关于违约风险的不对称信息是主权债券市场中的一个关键障碍。我们发现，尽管大型投标者支付的报价并不高于其他投标者，但他们能够获得更高的投标接受率。随后，我们提出了一个新的初级市场模型，在该模型中，投资者在财富、风险厌恶、市场力量和信息方面可能存在差异。只有不对称信息才能定性地解释我们的实证发现，而关于罕见灾难的不对称信息则可以在定量上匹配投标和收益概率。反事实分析揭示了不对称信息对收益产生的显著影响。

abstract.text: Growing evidence indicates that neighborhoods affect human capital accumulation, raising concern that the exclusionary effects of housing discrimination could contribute to persistent inequality in the United States. Using data from HUD’s most recent Housing Discrimination Study and microlevel data on neighborhood attributes in 28 US cities, we find that minorities are steered toward neighborhoods with less economic opportunity and greater exposures to crime and pollution. Holding preferences and income constant, discriminatory steering alone can explain a disproportionate number of minority households found in high-poverty neighborhoods in the United States and the higher exposure of African American mothers to toxic pollutants.

10.1086/720140.abstractZh: 越来越多的证据表明，社区环境会影响人力资本积累，这引发了人们对住房歧视导致的排斥效应可能加剧美国持续不平等现象的担忧。通过利用美国住房管理局最新发布的住房歧视研究数据，以及28个美国城市微观层面的社区属性数据，我们发现少数族裔往往被引导到经济机会较少、犯罪和污染更为严重的社区。在偏好和收入不变的情况下，单纯的歧视性引导就可以解释为什么在美国贫困程度较高的社区中，少数族裔家庭的数量较多，以及为什么非裔美国母亲更容易接触有毒污染物。

abstract.text: Macroeconomists increasingly use external sources of exogenous variation for causal inference. However, unless such external instruments (proxies) capture the underlying shock without measurement error, existing methods are silent on the importance of that shock for macroeconomic fluctuations. We show that, in a general moving-average model with external instruments, variance decompositions for the instrumented shock are interval-identified, with informative bounds. Various additional restrictions guarantee point identification of both variance and historical decompositions. Unlike structural vector autoregression analysis, our methods do not require invertibility. Applied to US data, they give a tight upper bound on the importance of monetary shocks for inflation dynamics.

10.1086/720141.abstractZh: 宏观经济学家越来越多地利用外部来源的外生变异来进行因果推断。然而，除非这些外部工具（代理变量）能够准确捕捉潜在冲击而不产生测量误差，否则现有方法并未充分考虑该冲击对宏观经济波动的影响。我们的研究表明，在一个包含外部工具的广义移动平均模型中，工具变量的方差分解可以通过区间识别法得到，并且具有信息性边界。各种额外的限制条件保证了方差和历史分解的精确识别。与结构向量自回归分析不同，我们的方法不需要逆变换性。将该方法应用于美国数据后，我们发现货币冲击对通货膨胀动态的重要性得到了严格的限定。

abstract.text: Feeding America allocates donated food to over 200 food banks. In 2005, it transitioned from a queueing mechanism to one where food banks use a specialized currency to bid for food. Food banks chose very different food than they received before. Small food banks acquired 72% more pounds per client than large food banks at little nutritional cost. This reallocation of food is estimated to have increased its value by 21%, or $115 million per annum. Food banks also sourced food much closer, saving an additional $16 million per annum. Finally, donations of food rose by over 100 million pounds.

10.1086/720332.abstractZh: Feeding America将捐赠的食物分配给超过200个食品银行。2005年，该机构从传统的排队机制转变为采用专门货币进行食品竞价的模式。与以往相比，食品银行选择的食物种类发生了显著变化。小型食品银行每位客户所采购的食物总量比大型食品银行多出72%，且成本更低。这种食物重新分配方式使得食品银行的食品价值增加了21%，每年可带来1.15亿美元的收益。此外，食品银行的采购距离也大大缩短，每年额外节省1600万美元。最后，捐赠的食物总量也增加了1亿多磅。

abstract.text: Recent studies consistently find important economic effects of year-to-year weather fluctuations. I study the economic effects of long-term and gradual climate change over 250 years in the Little Ice Age (1600–1850), during which people and economies had time to adapt. Results show significant negative economic effects of long-term climate change. Temperature impacted the economy through its effect on agricultural productivity and mortality. To adapt to the Little Ice Age, economies increased trade and changed land use. I discuss the relevance of these results for understanding the impact of today’s climate change, especially in developing countries.

10.1086/720393.abstractZh: 最近的研究一致发现，年际天气波动对经济有着重要的影响。我研究了小冰期（1600-1850年）250年间长期且渐进的气候变化对经济的影响，这一时期人们和经济体有时间进行适应。研究结果表明，长期气候变化对经济有显著的负面影响。温度通过影响农业生产力和死亡率来影响经济。为了适应小冰期，经济体增加了贸易活动并改变了土地使用方式。我讨论了这些结果对于理解当前气候变化的影响的重要性，尤其是在发展中国家。

abstract.text: This paper considers top income taxation when (i) new ideas drive economic growth, (ii) the reward for successful innovation is a top income, and (iii) innovation cannot be perfectly targeted by a research subsidy—think about the business methods of Walmart, the creation of Uber, or the “idea” of Amazon. These conditions lead to a new force affecting the optimal top tax rate: by slowing the creation of new ideas that drive aggregate GDP, top income taxation reduces everyone’s income, not just income at the top. This force sharply constrains both revenue-maximizing and welfare-maximizing top tax rates.

10.1086/720394.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在以下情况下对高收入者征收最高税率的合理性：(i) 新想法推动经济增长；(ii) 对成功创新的奖励是最高水平的收入；(iii) 创新无法通过研究补贴来完全实现——以沃尔玛的商业模式、Uber的创立，或是亚马逊的“创意”为例。这些条件导致了一种新的力量影响最优最高税率：通过减缓推动总GDP增长的新想法的产生，最高税率降低了所有人的收入，而不仅仅是高收入者。这种力量显著限制了既能最大化税收收入又能提升福利水平的最高税率。

abstract.text: Our large-scale experiment with 542 families from rural Bangladesh finds substantial intergenerational persistence of economic preferences. Both mothers’ and fathers’ risk, time, and social preferences are significantly (and largely to the same degree) positively correlated with their children’s economic preferences, even when controlling for personality traits and socioeconomic background. We discuss possible transmission channels and are the first to classify all families into one of two clusters, with either relatively patient, risk-tolerant, and prosocial members or relatively impatient, risk averse, and spiteful members. Classifications correlate with socioeconomic background variables. We find that our results differ from evidence for rich countries.

10.1086/720395.abstractZh: 我们针对孟加拉国农村地区的542户家庭进行的大规模实验发现，经济偏好在代际间存在显著的持续性。无论控制人格特质和社会经济背景如何，母亲和父亲的风险偏好、时间偏好以及社会偏好都与子女的经济偏好呈显著的正相关关系，且程度大致相同。我们探讨了这种偏好传递的可能途径，并首次将所有家庭分为两类：一类是相对耐心、风险容忍且具有亲社会行为的成员，另一类则是相对急躁、风险规避且带有恶意的成员。这些分类结果与社会经济背景变量相关。我们发现，我们的研究结果与富裕国家的证据有所不同。

abstract.text: We use option prices and realized returns to decompose risk premia into different parts of the return state space. In the data, 8/10 of the average equity premium is attributable to monthly returns below −10%, but returns below −30% matter very little. In contrast, prominent asset pricing models based on habits, long-run risks, rare disasters, undiversifiable idiosyncratic risk, and constrained intermediaries attribute the premium predominantly to returns above −10% or to the extreme left tail. We show that the discrepancy arises from an unrealistically small price of risk for stock market tail events in the models.

10.1086/720396.abstractZh: 我们利用期权价格和实现收益来将风险溢价分解为回报状态空间的各个部分。在数据中，平均股权溢价有8/10归因于每月低于-10%的回报，但低于-30%的回报则几乎无关紧要。相比之下，一些基于习惯、长期风险、罕见灾难、不可分散的特异性风险以及受限中介的著名资产定价模型，将溢价主要归因于高于-10%或极端左侧的回报。我们发现，这种差异源于模型中对股市尾部事件的风险定价过于低估。

abstract.text: We study workers who are employed by a large US retailer, work in many store locations, and are paid based on performance. By means of a border-discontinuity analysis, we document that workers become more productive and are terminated less often after a minimum wage increase. These effects are stronger among workers whose pay is more often supported by the minimum wage. However, when workers are monitored less intensely, the minimum wage depresses productivity. We interpret these findings through an efficiency wage model. After a minimum wage increase, profits decrease, and a calibration exercise suggests that worker welfare increases.

10.1086/720397.abstractZh: 我们研究的是一家美国大型零售商雇佣的工人，这些工人分布在多个店铺，其薪酬取决于工作表现。通过边界不连续性分析，我们发现随着最低工资的提高，工人的生产效率提升，被解雇的频率也降低。对于那些薪酬更经常受到最低工资保障的工人来说，这种效应更为明显。然而，当对工人的监控力度减弱时，最低工资反而会降低生产效率。我们通过效率工资模型来解释这些发现：在最低工资提高之后，利润会下降，而校准实验表明，工人的福利有所提升。

abstract.text: I present a model of child development that highlights the effect of parent-child interactions on the formation of skills. Through the parent’s affection, the child learns and builds mental representations of the self as loved and competent. These mental representations shape the child’s noncognitive skills and foster learning. I show that this model provides a unifying explanation for well-established evidence on child development. The model also sheds light on how early exposure to media devices can negatively impact skill acquisition. I discuss implications for the design of policies to reduce inequalities in child development.

10.1086/720398.abstractZh: 我提出了一个儿童发展模型，该模型强调了亲子互动对技能形成的影响。通过父母的关爱，儿童能够学习并构建自我作为被爱且有能力个体的心理表征。这些心理表征塑造了儿童的非认知技能，并促进其学习。我表明，这一模型为关于儿童发展的已有证据提供了统一的解释。该模型还揭示了早期接触媒体设备如何对技能习得产生负面影响。我讨论了针对减少儿童发展不平等的政策设计的相关意义。

abstract.text: We provide the first behavioral characterization of nested logit, a foundational and widely applied discrete-choice model, through the introduction of a nonparametric version of nested logit that we call “nested stochastic choice” (NSC). NSC is characterized by a single axiom that weakens independence of irrelevant alternatives on the basis of revealed similarity to allow for the similarity effect. Nested logit is characterized by an additional menu-independence axiom. Our axiomatic characterization leads to a practical, data-driven algorithm that identifies the true nest structure from choice data. We also discuss limitations of generalizing nested logit by studying the testable implications of cross-nested logit.

10.1086/720399.abstractZh: 我们首次对嵌套逻辑模型进行了行为特征描述。嵌套逻辑模型是一种基础性的、被广泛应用的离散选择模型。我们通过引入一种非参数版本的嵌套逻辑模型来对其进行描述，我们将其称为“嵌套随机选择”模型。该模型的一个基本公理是弱化无关选项之间的独立性，通过揭示选项之间的相似性来实现这种弱化，从而允许相似性效应发挥作用。嵌套逻辑模型还包含一个额外的菜单独立性公理。我们的公理描述引导我们提出一种实用的、基于数据的算法，该算法能够从选择数据中识别出真正的嵌套结构。我们还讨论了通过研究交叉嵌套逻辑模型的可检验含义来推广嵌套逻辑模型的局限性。

abstract.text: A model of banking and means of payment is constructed to analyze the effects of the introduction of central bank digital currency (CBDC). That CBDC is interest bearing is not an advantage, as replacement of physical currency with CBDC does not expand the attainable set of equilibrium allocations. CBDC can increase welfare by competing with private means of payment and shifting safe assets from the private banking sector to what is effectively a narrow banking facility. This uses the aggregate stock of safe collateral more efficiently, given incentive problems in private banking.

10.1086/720457.abstractZh: 构建了一个银行与支付方式的模型，以分析中央银行数字货币（CBDC）引入所带来的影响。CBDC具有利息属性这一特性并非优势，因为用CBDC替代实物货币并不会扩大可实现的均衡分配方案。CBDC通过与私人支付方式竞争，并将安全资产从私人银行业转移到实际上较为有限的银行设施中，从而提高福利水平。鉴于私人银行业的激励问题，这种方式能更高效地利用安全抵押品的总量。

abstract.text: I study the overstatement of economic growth in autocracies by comparing self-reported GDP figures to night-time light recorded by satellites from outer space. I show that the night-time-light elasticity of GDP is larger in authoritarian regimes, even accounting for differences in multiple country characteristics. This autocracy gradient in the elasticity is greater when the incentive to exaggerate economic growth is stronger or when the constraints on exaggeration are weaker. The results suggest that autocracies overstate yearly GDP growth by approximately 35%. Adjusting the data for manipulation leads to a more nuanced view on the recent economic success of autocracies.

10.1086/720458.abstractZh: 我通过比较自我报告的GDP数据与来自外太空的卫星记录的夜间灯光情况，研究独裁政权对经济增长的夸大行为。研究表明，即使在考虑多种国家特征差异的情况下，独裁政权的夜间灯光与GDP的弹性仍然更大。这种弹性差异在夸大经济增长动机较强或限制夸大的因素较弱时更为明显。研究结果表明，独裁政权每年对GDP增长的夸大幅度约为35%。通过对数据进行调整以排除操纵因素后，我们对独裁政权近期的经济成就有了更细致的了解。

abstract.text: Many firms claim that “social impact” influences their strategies. This paper develops a structural model that quantifies social impact as the sum of surpluses to a firm and its stakeholders. With data from a for-profit firm whose prosocial expenditures are measurable and salient to consumers, the analysis shows that the firm spends prosocially beyond profit maximization, thereby increasing welfare substantially. Incentivizing a standard profit-maximizing firm to behave similarly would require subsidies amounting to 58% of its prosocial expenditures, because consumers’ willingness to pay is relatively inelastic to prosocial expenses. Therefore, social impact resembles a self-imposed welfare-enhancing tax with limited pass-through.

10.1086/720459.abstractZh: 许多公司声称“社会影响”对其战略有深远影响。本文构建了一个结构模型，将社会影响量化为公司及其利益相关者之间的盈余总和。通过对一家盈利性公司的数据进行分析，该公司的公益支出对消费者来说是可测量且显著的。研究表明，该公司在追求利润最大化之外还进行了更多的公益活动，从而显著提升了社会福利。要激励一家以利润最大化为目标的公司采取类似的行为，需要对其公益支出进行补贴，补贴金额需达到其公益支出的58%，因为消费者对于公益支出的支付意愿相对缺乏弹性。因此，社会影响更像是一种自我施加的、旨在提升福利的“税收”，但其传递效果有限。

abstract.text: We investigate how childhood cognitive skills affect strategic sophistication and adult outcomes, and we emphasize the importance of childhood theory of mind. Experimental data show that (i) theory-of-mind ability and cognitive ability both predict level k behavior, (ii) older children respond to information about the cognitive ability of their opponent, and (iii) theory of mind (but not cognitive ability) predicts whether children respond to intentions. Using longitudinal data, we find that childhood theory of mind and cognitive ability are both associated with enhanced adult social skills, higher educational participation, better educational attainment, and lower fertility in young adulthood. Finally, we provide evidence that school spending improves theory of mind.

10.1086/720460.abstractZh: 我们研究了儿童期认知技能如何影响战略复杂性以及成年后的表现，并强调了儿童期心智理论能力的重要性。实验数据表明：(i) 心智理论能力和认知能力都能预测行为水平；(ii) 年龄较大的儿童会对对手的认知能力信息作出反应；(iii) 心智理论能力（而非认知能力）能够预测儿童是否会对他人的意图作出反应。通过纵向数据分析发现，儿童期的心智理论能力和认知能力都与成年后社交能力的提升、更高的教育参与度、更好的教育成就以及更低的年轻成年期生育率有关。最后，我们有证据表明，学校支出能够提升儿童的心智理论能力。

abstract.text: This paper studies the cyclical dynamics of skill mismatch and quantifies its impact on labor productivity. We build a tractable directed search model, in which workers differ in skills along multiple dimensions and sort into jobs with heterogeneous skill requirements. Skill mismatch arises because of information frictions and is prolonged by search frictions. Estimated to the United States, the model replicates salient business cycle properties of mismatch. Job transitions in and out of bottom job rungs, combined with career mobility, are key to account for the empirical fit. The model provides a novel narrative for the scarring effect of unemployment.

10.1086/720461.abstractZh: 本文研究了技能不匹配的周期性动态，并量化了其对劳动生产率的影响。我们构建了一个可行的有向搜索模型，其中劳动者在多个维度上具备不同的技能，并分配到具有不同技能要求的岗位上。技能不匹配是由于信息摩擦造成的，而搜索摩擦则进一步延长了这一现象。该模型在美国的应用表明，它能够再现技能不匹配在商业周期中的显著特征。职位在底层岗位之间的转换，以及职业流动性，是解释这一现象的关键。该模型为失业的“疤痕效应”提供了新的解释。

abstract.text: A sender commissions a study to persuade a receiver but influences the report with some probability. We show that increasing this probability can benefit the receiver and can lead to a discontinuous drop in the sender’s payoffs. To derive our results, we geometrically characterize the sender’s highest equilibrium payoff, which is based on the concavification of a capped value function.

10.1086/720462.abstractZh: 发件人委托进行一项研究，旨在说服收件人，但发件人有可能对报告内容施加影响。我们指出，增加这种影响的概率对收件人有利，并且可能导致发件人的收益出现突然下降。为了得出我们的结论，我们通过几何方法描述了发件人最高均衡收益的情况，这一收益是基于一个上限值函数的凹性特征而得出的。

abstract.text: We introduce a computationally tractable dynamic equilibrium model of automobile markets with heterogeneous consumers, focused on stationary flow equilibria. We introduce a fast, robust algorithm for computing equilibria and use it to estimate a model using nearly 39 million observations on car ownership transitions from Denmark. The estimated model fits the data well, and counterfactual simulations show that Denmark could raise total tax revenue by reducing the new-car registration tax rate. We show that reducing this tax rate while raising the tax rate on fuel increases aggregate welfare, tax revenue, and car ownership, while reducing car ages, driving, and CO2 emissions.

10.1086/720463.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个计算上可行的动态均衡模型，用于研究具有异质消费者的汽车市场，重点关注静态流动均衡。我们提出了一种快速且稳健的算法来计算均衡状态，并利用该算法基于丹麦近3900万份汽车所有权转换数据估算模型。估算出的模型与数据非常吻合，反事实模拟表明，丹麦可以通过降低新车注册税来增加总税收收入。我们指出，在提高燃油税的同时降低新车注册税，可以增加整体福利、税收收入以及汽车拥有量，同时减少汽车使用年限、驾驶次数以及二氧化碳排放。

abstract.text: Following Kamenica and Gentzkow, this paper studies persuasion as an information design problem. We investigate how mistakes in probabilistic inference impact optimal persuasion. The concavification method is shown to extend naturally to a large class of belief updating rules, which we identify and characterize. This class comprises many non-Bayesian models discussed in the literature. We apply this new technique to gain insight into the revelation principle, the ranking of updating rules, when persuasion is beneficial to the sender, and when it is detrimental to the receiver. Our key result also extends to shed light on the question of robust persuasion.

10.1086/720464.abstractZh: 根据Kamenica和Gentzkow的研究，本文将说服行为视为一个信息设计问题来进行研究。我们探讨了概率推断中的错误如何影响最优说服效果。研究表明，凹化方法可以自然地应用于大量信念更新规则，我们对这些规则进行了识别和描述。这类规则包括文献中讨论的许多非贝叶斯模型。我们运用这一新技术来深入了解启示原则、更新规则的排序，以及何时说服行为对发送者有利，何时对接收者不利。我们的关键成果还揭示了关于稳健说服的问题。

abstract.text: This paper develops a flexible recipe for identifying unobserved input allocations, as well as quantity- and revenue-based total factor productivity (TFP) across product lines, for multiproduct producers, using demand- and supply-side information. Applying variants of this recipe to a panel of plants manufacturing machinery in India from 2000–2007 yields sizable within-plant TFP differences. Removing an average plant’s lowest-performing product increases the unweighted average of plant-level revenue-based productivity by 10%–65%. A 1 standard deviation decline in product-level revenue-based TFP generates around a 6 percentage point increase in the probability of dropping that product.

10.1086/720465.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种灵活的方法，用于识别未观察到的投入分配情况，以及多产品生产者在不同产品线中基于数量和收入的全要素生产率（TFP）。通过结合需求和供应方面的信息，对印度2000至2007年间制造机械的工厂样本应用该方法，可以发现工厂内部存在显著的TFP差异。移除工厂中表现最差的产品后，工厂层面基于收入的生产率平均值会提高10%至65%。产品层面基于收入的TFP下降1个标准差，会导致该产品被淘汰的概率增加约6个百分点。

abstract.text: We investigate the link between poverty and decision-making in a sample of farmers in Zambia, who were given the opportunity to exchange randomly assigned household items for alternative items of similar value. Analyzing a total of 5,842 trading decisions and leveraging multiple sources of variation in financial constraints, we show that exchange asymmetries decrease in magnitude when participants are more constrained. This result is robust to experimental procedures and is not mediated by changes in cognitive performance. Consistent with the interpretation that scarcity leads to more rational decisions by increasing the utility loss from forgone trading, we show that trading probabilities go up when the market value of the items is exogenously increased.

10.1086/720466.abstractZh: 我们研究了赞比亚部分农民中贫困与决策行为之间的联系。这些农民有机会用随机分配的家用物品交换价值相近的其他物品。通过对5,842次交易决策的分析，并利用多种财务限制因素，我们发现当参与者面临更严格的限制时，交易中的不对称现象会减弱。这一结果不受实验程序的影响，且并未因认知表现的变化而受到影响。与“稀缺性会导致更理性的决策，因为人们会减少因放弃交易而造成的损失”这一解释一致，我们发现当物品的市场价值被外生增加时，交易概率也会上升。

abstract.text: We compare winning and losing firms in lotteries for H-1B visas, matching administrative data on these lotteries to administrative tax data on US firms and to approved US patents. Winning one additional H-1B visa crowds out about 1.5 other workers at the firm. Additional H-1Bs have insignificant and at most modest effects on firm innovation. More general evidence from the universe of US firms and the universe of H-1B visas using alternative estimation strategies is consistent with these results. Firms that hire H-1Bs grow faster and innovate more because they are different in other ways from firms that do not.

10.1086/720467.abstractZh: 我们对比了彩票中签和未中签的H-1B签证持有者，将彩票的行政数据与美国公司的税务数据以及已批准的美国专利数据进行了匹配。中签一个额外的H-1B签证会导致公司内约1.5名其他员工被挤出市场。额外的H-1B签证对公司的创新几乎没有影响，最多只有轻微的影响。从美国公司和H-1B签证持有者的整体情况来看，使用不同的估计方法得出的结论与这些结果一致。雇佣H-1B签证持有者的公司因为其在其他方面的差异，所以发展速度更快，创新能力也更强。

abstract.text: We consider a dynamic game of electoral competition with adverse selection, moral hazard, and imperfect monitoring. We show that this dynamic game can be estimated using a flexible maximum likelihood estimator. We implement the estimator using data from recent mayoral elections in large US cities with binding two-term limits. Our empirical findings suggest that there are large differences in performance among different types of mayors. We find an economically important degree of policy responsiveness, with effort accounting for a larger fraction of the total effect than selection. Finally, we evaluate several institutional reforms that promise to increase policy responsiveness.

10.1086/720514.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个包含逆向选择、道德风险以及监控不完善的动态选举竞争博弈。我们证明，这种动态博弈可以通过一种灵活的最大似然估计方法进行估计。我们采用来自美国大城市的近期市长选举数据来实施这一估计方法，这些城市实行两届任期限制。我们的实证结果发现，不同类型市长的表现存在显著差异。我们发现，政策响应程度在经济学上具有重要意义，其中努力因素对总效应的贡献比重高于选择因素。最后，我们评估了几种有望提高政策响应能力的制度改革方案。

abstract.text: We model asset management as a continuum between active and passive: managers can deviate from benchmark indices to exploit noise trader–induced distortions, but agency frictions constrain these deviations. Because constraints force managers to buy assets that they underweight when these assets appreciate, overvalued assets have high volatility, and the risk-return relationship becomes inverted. Distortions are more severe for overvalued assets than for undervalued ones because trading against the former entails more risk and tighter constraints. We provide empirical evidence supporting our model’s main mechanisms. Using the data, we infer the constraints’ tightness and compute a measure of effective arbitrage capital.

10.1086/720515.abstractZh: 我们将资产管理模型视为活跃与被动之间的连续体：管理者可以偏离基准指数以利用噪声交易者引发的扭曲，但代理摩擦限制了这些偏离行为。由于这些限制迫使管理者购买那些在资产升值时他们未充分配置的资产，因此被高估的资产具有较高的波动性，风险与回报的关系变得相反。与被低估资产相比，高估资产受到的扭曲更为严重，因为针对前者进行交易会带来更大的风险，且限制更为严格。我们提供了支持模型主要机制的实证证据。通过数据分析，我们确定了这些限制的严格程度，并计算出了有效套利资本的度量指标。

abstract.text: We study the relative effectiveness of exit (divestment and boycott) and voice (engagement) strategies in a world where companies generate externalities and some agents care about the social impact of their decisions. We show that if the majority of investors are even slightly socially responsible, voice achieves the socially optimal outcome. In contrast, exit does not unless everybody is significantly socially responsible. If the majority of investors are purely selfish, exit is a more effective strategy, but neither strategy generally achieves the first best. We also show that exit can sometimes reduce social welfare.

10.1086/720516.abstractZh: 我们研究了在公司产生外部性且某些主体关心其决策的社会影响的情况下，退出（撤资和抵制）策略与发声（参与）策略的相对有效性。研究表明，如果大多数投资者至少具有轻微的社会责任感，发声策略能够实现社会最优结果。相反，除非所有投资者都具备显著的社会责任感，否则退出策略并不有效。如果大多数投资者纯粹是自私的，那么退出策略更为有效，但两种策略通常都无法达到最优结果。我们还发现，退出策略有时可能会降低社会福利。

abstract.text: Resource-based theories propose that firms grow by diversifying into products that use common capabilities. We provide evidence for common-input capabilities, using a policy that removed entry barriers in input markets to show that the similarity of a firm’s and an industry’s input mix determines firm production choices. We model industry choice and economies of scope from input capabilities. When the model is estimated for Indian manufacturing, input complementarities make firms 5% more likely to produce in an industry and are quantitatively as important as time-invariant drivers of coproduction rates. Upstream entry barriers were equivalent to a 9.5% tariff on inputs.

10.1086/720630.abstractZh: 资源基础理论认为，企业通过多元化进入使用共同能力的产品来实现增长。我们提供了关于共同投入能力的证据，通过实施消除投入市场进入壁垒的政策，证明了企业与其所在行业的投入组合相似性决定了企业的生产选择。我们从投入能力的角度对行业选择及范围经济进行了建模。当该模型应用于印度制造业时，投入互补性使得企业进入该行业的可能性增加5%，其重要性与决定共同生产率的时间不变因素相当。上游进入壁垒相当于对投入征收9.5%的关税。

abstract.text: Producers frequently provide retailers with financial incentives to secure product distribution. These payments often take the form of vendor allowances: lump-sum transfers to retailers that do not directly depend on quantity sold. I introduce an estimation strategy that uses observed product selections to inform unobserved allowances. I use retailers’ replacement threats, which may allow them to capture both vendor transfers and lower wholesale prices. A counterfactual restricts firms to contract on only wholesale prices. Results show that vendor allowances may have not only (negative) product distortion effects but also (potentially positive) pricing effects.

10.1086/720631.abstractZh: 生产者经常向零售商提供财务激励，以确保产品的分销。这些支付通常以供应商津贴的形式出现，即向零售商提供的固定金额转移支付，这种支付并不直接依赖于销售数量。我提出了一种估算策略，该策略利用观察到的产品选择来指导未观察到的津贴分配。通过研究零售商的替代威胁，可以发现他们可能同时获得供应商的转移支付和更低的批发价格。一个反事实假设限制企业仅在批发价格上进行谈判。结果表明，供应商津贴不仅可能产生（负面的）产品扭曲效应，还可能产生（潜在的）定价效应。

abstract.text: We describe how capital accumulation and the network structure of US production interact to amplify the effects of sectoral trend growth rates in total factor productivity and labor on trend GDP (gross domestic product) growth. We derive expressions that conveniently summarize this long-run amplification effect by way of sectoral multipliers. We estimate that sector-specific factors have historically accounted for approximately three-fourths of long-run changes in GDP growth. Trend GDP growth fell by nearly 3 percentage points over the postwar period, with especially significant contributions from the Construction sector in 1950–80 and the Durable Goods sector in 2000–2018. No sector has contributed any steady significant increase to the trend growth rate of GDP in the past 70 years.

10.1086/720763.abstractZh: 我们描述了资本积累与美国生产网络结构如何相互作用，从而放大了部门趋势增长率对全要素生产力和劳动力对趋势GDP增长的影响。我们推导出能够方便地用部门乘数来概括这种长期放大效应的表达式。估计历史上，部门特定的因素大约占长期GDP增长变化的四分之三。战后期间，趋势GDP增长率下降了近3个百分点，其中1950-80年间建筑行业以及2000-2018年间耐用消费品行业贡献尤为显著。在过去70年中，没有任何一个部门对GDP的趋势增长率产生了持续且显著的贡献。

abstract.text: Despite substantial evidence that resources and outcomes are transmitted across generations, there has been limited inquiry into the extent to which antipoverty programs actually disrupt the cycle of bad outcomes. We leverage the rollout of the United States’s largest early-childhood program, Head Start, to estimate the effect of early-childhood exposure among mothers on their children’s long-term outcomes. We find evidence of intergenerational transmission of effects in the form of increased educational attainment, reduced teen pregnancy, and reduced criminal engagement in the second generation. These effects correspond to an estimated increase in discounted second-generation wages of 6%–11%, depending on specification. Exploration of earlier outcomes suggests an important role for changes in parenting behavior and potential noncognitive channels.

10.1086/720764.abstractZh: 尽管有大量证据表明资源和成果会跨代传递，但关于反贫困计划在多大程度上能够打破不良结果的循环，相关研究却很少。我们利用美国规模最大的早期儿童发展项目“Head Start”的推广数据，来估算母亲在儿童早期接触该计划对其长期成果的影响。研究发现，这种影响以代际传递的形式体现，表现为教育水平的提升、青少年怀孕率的降低以及第二代犯罪行为的减少。这些影响对应的第二代工资增长幅度估计为6%至11%，具体数值取决于模型参数设置。对更早阶段成果的分析表明，育儿行为的改变以及潜在的非认知因素在其中的作用非常重要。

abstract.text: Need fluctuates over the business cycle. We conduct a survey revealing a desire for nonprofit activities to countercyclically expand during downturns. We then demonstrate, using comprehensive US nonprofit data drawn from millions of tax returns, that the public’s hopes are disappointed. Nonprofit expenditure, revenue, and balance sheets fluctuate procyclically: contracting during national and local downturns. This finding is evident even for a narrow group of nonprofits that the public most wishes would expand during downturns, for example, those providing critical needs such as food or housing. Our new facts contribute to the charitable giving, nonprofit, and business cycle literatures.

10.1086/721805.abstractZh: 非营利组织的需求会在经济周期中波动。我们进行了一项调查，发现人们希望非营利组织能够在经济衰退期间进行逆周期扩张。随后，我们利用来自数百万税务申报表的全面美国非营利组织数据，证明公众的期望并未实现。非营利组织的支出、收入和资产负债表在经济衰退期间会出现顺周期波动：在经济衰退期间，这些组织的规模会缩小。这一发现对于那些公众最希望在经济衰退期间扩张的非营利组织来说尤为明显，例如那些提供基本需求如食品或住房服务的组织。我们的新发现为慈善捐赠、非营利组织和经济周期的研究提供了新的视角。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Despite mergers have increasingly affected hospitals in the recent decades, literature on the impact of hospitals mergers on healthcare quality measures (HQM) is still lacking. Our research aimed to systematically review evidence regarding the impact of hospital mergers on HQM focusing especially on process indicators and clinical outcomes. METHODS: The search was carried out until January 2020 using the Population, Intervention, Comparison and Outcome model, querying electronic databases (MEDLINE, Scopus, Web Of Science) and refining the search with hand search. Studies that assessed HQM of hospitals that have undergone a merger were included. HQMs were analyzed through a narrative synthesis and a strength of the evidence analysis based on the quality of the studies and the consistency of the findings. RESULTS: The 16 articles, included in the narrative synthesis, reported inconsistent findings and few statistically significant results. All indicators analyzed showed an insufficient strength of evidence to achieve conclusive results. However, a tendency in the decrease of the number of beds, hospital staff and inpatient admissions and an increase in both mortality and readmission rate for acute myocardial infarction and stroke emerged in our analysis. CONCLUSIONS: In our study, there is no strong evidence of improvement or worsening of HQM in hospital mergers. Since a limited amount of studies currently exists, additional studies are needed. In the meanwhile, hospital managers involved in mergers should adopt a clear evaluation framework with indicators that help to periodically and systematically assess HQM ascertaining that mergers ensure and primarily do not reduce the quality of care.

10.1093/eurpub/ckac002.abstractZh:
背景：尽管近年来合并事件对医院产生了越来越大的影响，但关于医院合并对医疗质量指标影响的文献仍然较为匮乏。我们的研究旨在系统性地回顾医院合并对医疗质量指标的影响，特别关注过程指标和临床结果。  
方法：研究范围截至2020年1月，采用“人群、干预、比较和结果”模型，查询电子数据库（MEDLINE、Scopus、Web Of Science），并通过人工检索进一步筛选数据。纳入的研究均为评估已合并医院医疗质量指标的研究。通过叙述性综合分析和基于研究质量及结果一致性的证据强度分析，对医疗质量指标进行了分析。  
结果：纳入叙述性综合分析的16篇文章中，发现的结果不一致，仅有少数具有统计学意义的结论。所有分析指标的证据强度均不足以得出明确的结论。然而，我们的分析显示，医院床位数量、员工数量以及住院患者数量有所下降，而急性心肌梗塞和中风的死亡率及再入院率则有所上升。  
结论：我们的研究并未发现医院合并对医疗质量指标有显著改善或恶化的现象。由于目前相关研究数量有限，需要进一步开展研究。同时，参与合并的医院管理者应制定明确的评估框架，使用有助于定期、系统评估医疗质量指标的指标，以确保合并不会降低医疗质量。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Nursing homes (NHs) are serving a large number of residents with serious mental illness (SMI). We analyze the highest ("High SMI") quartile of NHs based on the proportion of residents with SMI and compare NHs on health deficiencies and the incidence of deficiencies given for resident abuse, neglect, and involuntary seclusion. RESEARCH DESIGN AND METHODS: We used national Certification and Survey Provider Enhanced Reports data for all freestanding certified NHs in the continental United States from 2014 to 2017 (14,698 NHs; 41,717 recertification inspections; 246,528 deficiencies). Differences in the number of deficiencies, a weighted deficiency score, the deficiency grade, and the facility characteristics associated with deficiencies for abuse, neglect, and involuntary seclusion were examined in High SMI. Incidence rate ratios (IRRs) and odds ratios (ORs) were reported with 95% confidence intervals. RESULTS: High-SMI NHs did not receive more deficiencies or a greater weighted deficiency score per recertification inspection. Deficiencies given to High-SMI NHs were associated with a wider scope, especially Pattern (IRR: 1.03 [1.00, 1.07]) and Widespread (IRR: 1.07 [1.02, 1.11]). High-SMI NHs were more likely to be cited for resident abuse and neglect (OR: 1.49 [1.23, 1.81]) and the policies to prohibit and monitor for abuse and neglect (OR: 1.18 [1.08, 1.30]) in comparison to all other NHs. DISCUSSION AND IMPLICATIONS: Although resident abuse, neglect, and involuntary seclusion are rarely cited, these deficiencies are disproportionately found in High-SMI NHs. Further work is needed to disentangle the antecedents to potential resident abuse and neglect in those with mental health care needs.

10.1093/geront/gnab183.abstractZh: 背景与目的：养老院正在为大量患有严重精神疾病的患者提供护理服务。我们分析了按患有严重精神疾病的居民比例划分的养老院中的最高等级（“高严重精神疾病”等级），并比较了这些养老院在健康缺陷方面的差异以及因虐待、忽视和非自愿隔离导致的缺陷发生率。研究设计与方法：我们使用了2014年至2017年间美国大陆所有独立认证养老院的国家认证和调查提供者增强报告数据（14,698家养老院；41,717次重新认证检查；246,528项缺陷）。我们研究了高严重精神疾病等级养老院在缺陷数量、加权缺陷评分、缺陷等级以及与虐待、忽视和非自愿隔离相关的设施特征方面的差异。报告了发生率比（IRR）和优势比（OR），并给出了95%的置信区间。结果：高严重精神疾病等级养老院在每次重新认证检查中并未出现更多的缺陷或更高的加权缺陷评分。这些养老院出现的缺陷与更广泛的范围相关，尤其是“模式性”缺陷（IRR：1.03 [1.00, 1.07]）和“广泛性”缺陷（IRR：1.07 [1.02, 1.11]）。与所有其他养老院相比，高严重精神疾病等级养老院更有可能因虐待和忽视问题被举报（OR：1.49 [1.23, 1.81]），并且这些养老院在禁止和监控虐待和忽视方面的政策也更为严格（OR：1.18 [1.08, 1.30]）。讨论与启示：尽管虐待、忽视和非自愿隔离问题很少被提及，但这些缺陷在高严重精神疾病等级养老院中尤为普遍。需要进一步的研究来揭示这些养老院中潜在虐待和忽视问题的原因。

abstract.text: Telemedicine and telehealth hold promise for reducing access barriers, improving quality and containing medical costs. As Internet companies enter the healthcare market, a rising number of online healthcare platforms have emerged worldwide. In some countries like China, public hospital doctors are providing direct-to-consumer telemedicine services on these commercial platforms as independent providers. Such online service provision creates a new form of dual practice, which we refer to as 'online dual practice' in this study. Using a mixed-methods design, this study aims to investigate the prevalence of online dual practice, doctors' time allocation and motivations for engaging in it and its potential impacts on the health system in China. We use the web-crawled data from four leading online health platforms to examine the prevalence of online dual practice in China. Then we conduct in-depth interviews with 38 active doctors on these platforms to investigate their time allocation, motivations and perception regarding online service provision. We find that the nationwide prevalence of online dual practice in China reaches at least 16.5% in 2020 and that it is more common among senior public hospital doctors. Public hospital doctors mainly use small pockets of time during working hours and after-hours to render services on the platforms The five most commonly cited motivations for their engagement in online dual practice are efficiency improvement, personal control, career development, financial rewards and serving the patients. Interviewed doctors believe that their online service provision is conducive to increasing healthcare access and improving efficiency, but some also express their concerns about the quality of care. Further analysis shows that the impact of online dual practice on health system performance remains an open question and regulatory policies on it should be health-system specific.

10.1093/heapol/czac017.abstractZh: 远程医疗和远程健康服务在减少获取障碍、提高医疗质量以及控制医疗成本方面具有巨大潜力。随着互联网公司进入医疗市场，全球出现了越来越多的在线医疗平台。在中国等某些国家，公立医院医生在这些商业平台上作为独立提供者，直接向消费者提供远程医疗服务。这种在线服务提供方式形成了一种新的双重执业形式，我们在研究中将其称为“在线双重执业”。本研究采用混合方法设计，旨在调查在线双重执业的普及程度、医生的时间分配及参与动机，以及其对中国医疗系统的潜在影响。我们通过从四个主要在线健康平台获取的网络爬取数据，来考察中国在线双重执业的普及情况。随后，我们对这些平台上的38名活跃医生进行了深入访谈，以了解他们的时间分配、参与动机以及对于在线服务提供的看法。研究发现，2020年中国在线双重执业的普及率至少为16.5%，且这种形式在资深公立医院医生中更为常见。公立医院医生主要在工作时间及下班后利用少量时间在这些平台上提供服务。他们参与在线双重执业的五个最常见动机包括提高效率、个人控制、职业发展、经济回报以及为患者服务。接受访谈的医生认为，他们的在线服务提供有助于增加医疗服务的可及性和提高效率，但也有一些人表达了对医疗服务质量的担忧。进一步分析表明，在线双重实践对卫生系统绩效的影响仍是一个未解决的问题，相关的监管政策应针对不同的卫生系统而制定。

abstract.text: During traffic stops, police search black and Hispanic motorists more than twice as often as white motorists, yet those searches are no more likely to yield contraband. We ask whether equalizing search rates by motorist race would reduce contraband yield. We use unique administrative data from Texas to isolate variation in search behavior across and within highway patrol troopers and find that search rates are unrelated to the proportion of searches that yield contraband. We find that troopers can equalize search rates across racial groups, maintain the status quo search rate, and increase contraband yield. Troopers appear to be limited in their ability to discern between motorists who are more or less likely to carry contraband.

10.1093/qje/qjab018.abstractZh: 在交通检查中，警察对黑人和西班牙裔驾驶员的搜查频率是白人驾驶员的两倍多，然而这些搜查并不更有可能发现违禁品。我们探讨通过不同种族的驾驶员来均衡搜查频率是否可以减少违禁品的发现。我们利用德克萨斯州的独特行政数据，分析了公路巡逻警察在搜查行为上的差异，发现搜查频率与搜查结果中是否发现违禁品无关。我们发现，警察可以在不同种族群体中均衡搜查频率，同时保持现有的搜查频率，同时增加违禁品的发现率。警察在区分哪些驾驶员更有可能携带违禁品方面似乎能力有限。

abstract.text: We argue that the network of investment production and purchases across sectors is an important propagation mechanism for understanding business cycles. Empirically, we show that the majority of investment goods are produced by a few “investment hubs,” which are more cyclical than other sectors. We embed this investment network into a multisector business cycle model and show that sector-specific shocks to the investment hubs and their key suppliers have large effects on aggregate employment and drive down labor productivity. Quantitatively, we find that sector-specific shocks to hubs and their suppliers account for an increasing share of aggregate fluctuations over time, generating the declining cyclicality of labor productivity and other changes in business cycle patterns since the 1980s.

10.1093/qje/qjab020.abstractZh: 我们认为，跨部门的投资、生产和采购网络是理解商业周期的重要机制。从经验上看，我们发现大多数投资产品是由少数“投资中心”生产的，这些中心比其他部门更具周期性特征。我们将这一投资网络纳入一个多部门商业周期模型中，发现对投资中心及其关键供应商的部门特定冲击会对总体就业产生巨大影响，并降低劳动生产率。从数量上看，我们发现随着时间的推移，对投资中心及其供应商的部门特定冲击在总体波动中所占的比例越来越大，这导致了自20世纪80年代以来劳动生产率周期性的下降以及其他商业周期模式的变化。

abstract.text: This article studies the effect of corporate and personal taxes on innovation in the United States over the twentieth century. We build a panel of the universe of inventors who patented since 1920, and a historical state-level corporate tax database with corporate tax rates and tax base information, which we link to existing data on state-level personal income taxes and other economic outcomes. Our analysis focuses on the effect of personal and corporate income taxes on individual inventors (the micro level) and on states (the macro level), considering the quantity and quality of innovation, its location, and the share produced by the corporate rather than the noncorporate sector. We propose several identification strategies, all of which yield consistent results. We find that higher taxes negatively affect the quantity and the location of innovation, but not average innovation quality. The state-level elasticities to taxes are large and consistent with the aggregation of the individual-level responses of innovation produced and cross-state mobility. Corporate taxes tend to especially affect corporate inventors’ innovation production and cross-state mobility. Personal income taxes significantly affect the quantity of innovation overall and the mobility of inventors.

10.1093/qje/qjab022.abstractZh: 本文研究了20世纪以来美国企业税和个人税对创新的影响。我们构建了一个包含1920年以来获得专利的发明人的数据库，并拥有一个包含企业税率和税基信息的州级企业税数据库，这些数据与现有的州级个人所得税数据及其他经济成果数据进行了关联。我们的分析重点关注个人税和企业税对个体发明人（微观层面）以及各州（宏观层面）的影响，考虑了创新的数量和质量、创新地点，以及由企业而非非企业部门产生的创新份额。我们提出了几种识别策略，所有这些策略都得到了一致的结果。我们发现，较高的税收会负面影响创新的数量和地点，但不会影响创新的平均质量。各州对税收的弹性较大，这与个体层面创新产生的聚合效应以及跨州流动性相一致。企业税尤其会影响企业发明人的创新产出和跨州流动性。个人所得税则显著影响了整体创新数量以及发明人的流动性。

abstract.text: The seller of an asset has the option to buy hard information about the value of the asset from an intermediary. The seller can then disclose this information before selling the asset in a competitive market. We study how the intermediary designs and sells hard information to robustly maximize the intermediary's revenue across all equilibria. Even though the intermediary could use an accurate test that reveals the asset’s value, we show that robust revenue maximization leads to a noisy test with a continuum of possible scores. In addition, the intermediary always charges the seller for disclosing the test score to the market, but not necessarily for running the test. This enables the intermediary to robustly appropriate a significant share of the surplus resulting from the asset sale.

10.1093/qje/qjab024.abstractZh: 资产的卖方有权从中介处获取关于该资产价值的详细信息。卖方可以在竞争市场中出售资产之前披露这些信息。我们研究了中介如何设计和出售这些详细信息，以在所有均衡情况下稳健地最大化其收入。尽管中介可以使用能够准确揭示资产价值的测试，但我们发现，稳健的收入最大化会导致测试结果存在噪声，且存在连续的可能性评分。此外，中介总是向卖方收取披露测试结果的费用，但不一定收取进行测试的费用。这使得中介能够稳健地获取资产出售所产生的剩余收益中的大部分。

abstract.text: This article shows that the inability to use monetary policy for macroeconomic stabilization leaves a government more vulnerable to a rollover crisis. We study a sovereign default model with self-fulfilling rollover crises, foreign currency debt, and nominal rigidities. When the government lacks monetary independence, lenders anticipate that the government would face a severe recession in the event of a liquidity crisis and are therefore more prone to run on government bonds. In a quantitative application to the Eurozone debt crisis, we find that the lack of monetary autonomy played a central role in making Spain vulnerable to a rollover crisis. Finally, we argue that a lender of last resort can go a long way toward reducing the costs of giving up monetary independence.

10.1093/qje/qjab025.abstractZh: 本文指出，无法运用货币政策实现宏观经济稳定会使政府更容易陷入滚动危机。我们研究了一个包含自我实现滚动危机、外币债务以及名义刚性问题的主权违约模型。当政府缺乏货币独立性时，债权人预期政府会在流动性危机时面临严重的经济衰退，因此更倾向于投资政府债券。通过对欧元区债务危机的量化分析，我们发现缺乏货币自主性在使西班牙面临滚动危机方面起到了关键作用。最后，我们认为，作为最后贷款人，可以在很大程度上降低放弃货币独立性的成本。

abstract.text: Does flexible pay increase the gender wage gap? To answer this question, we analyze the wages of public school teachers in Wisconsin, where a 2011 reform allowed school districts to set teachers’ pay more flexibly and engage in individual negotiations. Using quasi-exogenous variation in the timing of the introduction of flexible pay, driven by the expiration of preexisting collective-bargaining agreements, we show that flexible pay lowered the salaries of women compared with men with the same credentials. This gap is larger for younger teachers and smaller for teachers working under a female principal or superintendent. Survey evidence suggests that the gap is partly driven by women engaging less frequently in negotiations over pay, especially when the counterpart is a man. The gap is unlikely to be driven by observable gender differences in job mobility or teacher ability, although the threat of moving and a high demand for male teachers could exacerbate it. Our results suggest that pay discretion and wage bargaining are important determinants of the gender wage gap and that institutions, such as unions, might help narrow this gap.

10.1093/qje/qjab026.abstractZh: 灵活的薪酬是否会增加性别工资差距？为了回答这个问题，我们分析了威斯康星州公立学校教师的薪酬情况。2011年的改革允许学区更灵活地设定教师的薪酬，并允许教师进行个人谈判。我们利用因集体谈判协议到期而引发的薪酬灵活性的时间变化，发现灵活的薪酬使得具有相同资历的女性教师的薪酬低于男性教师。这种差距在年轻教师中更为明显，而在由女性校长或教育局局长管理的学校中则较小。调查数据显示，这种差距部分是由于女性较少参与薪酬谈判，尤其是在谈判对象为男性的情况下。虽然工作流动性和教师能力方面的性别差异可能是导致这种差距的原因之一，但转岗的威胁和对男性教师的高度需求可能会加剧这种差距。我们的研究结果表明，薪酬的自主权和工资谈判是性别工资差距的重要决定因素，而工会等机构或许有助于缩小这一差距。

abstract.text: Proposition 209 banned race-based affirmative action at California public universities in 1998. Using a difference-in-differences research design and a newly constructed longitudinal database linking all 1994–2002 University of California applicants to their educational experiences and wages, I show that ending affirmative action caused underrepresented minority (URM) freshman applicants to cascade into lower-quality colleges. The “mismatch hypothesis” implies that this cascade would provide net educational benefits to URM applicants, but their degree attainment declined overall and in STEM fields, especially among less academically qualified applicants. URM applicants’ average wages in their twenties and thirties subsequently declined, driven by declines among Hispanic applicants. These declines are not explained by URM students' performance or persistence in STEM course sequences, which were unchanged after Prop 209. Ending affirmative action also deterred thousands of qualified URM students from applying to any UC campus. Complementary regression discontinuity and institutional value-added analyses suggest that affirmative action’s net educational and wage benefits for URM applicants exceed its net costs for on-the-margin white and Asian applicants.

10.1093/qje/qjab027.abstractZh: 1998年，第209号提案禁止了加州公立大学的基于种族的平权行动。通过差异-差异研究设计，并利用一个新构建的纵向数据库，将1994至2002年所有加州大学申请者与他们的教育经历和工资联系起来，我发现取消平权行动导致代表性不足的少数族裔新生申请者纷纷选择质量较低的大学。“不匹配假说”认为这种选择会带来净教育收益，但实际上，这些少数族裔申请者的学位获得率整体下降，尤其是在STEM领域，那些学术资质较低的申请者更是如此。这些少数族裔申请者在二十多岁和三十多岁的平均工资随后下降，这主要是由于西班牙裔申请者的表现下降所致。这些下降并不由少数族裔学生在STEM课程中的表现或坚持度所解释，这些因素在取消平权行动后并未发生变化。取消平权行动还阻止了数千名有资格的少数族裔学生申请任何加州大学校园。补充性的回归 discontinuity 和机构增值分析表明，平权行动对少数族裔申请者的净教育和工资收益超过了其对白人和亚洲人申请者的净成本。

abstract.text: We investigate the wage, employment, and reallocation effects of the introduction of a nationwide minimum wage in Germany that affected 15% of all employees.
