Based on identification designs that exploit variation in exposure across individuals and local areas, we find that the minimum wage raised wages but did not lower employment. It also led to the reallocation of low-wage workers from smaller to larger, from lower- to higher-paying, and from less to more productive establishments. This worker upgrading accounts for up to 17% of the wage increase induced by the minimum wage. Moreover, at the regional level, average establishment quality increased in more affected areas in the years following the introduction of the minimum wage.

10.1093/qje/qjab028.abstractZh: 我们研究了在德国实施全国最低工资对工资、就业以及劳动力再分配的影响。该政策影响了15%的雇员。通过利用个体和地区间差异的识别设计，我们发现最低工资确实提高了工资，但并未降低就业率。此外，最低工资还导致低薪工人从规模较小的单位转移到了规模较大的单位，从低薪岗位转移到了高薪岗位，以及从效率较低的机构转移到了效率更高的机构。这种劳动力升级现象占最低工资带来的工资增长总额的17%。此外，在区域层面，实施最低工资后的几年里，受影响较大的地区的机构平均质量有所提升。

abstract.text: We experimentally test a theory of risky choice in which the perception of a lottery payoff is noisy due to information processing constraints in the brain. We model perception using the principle of efficient coding, which implies that perception is most accurate for those payoffs that occur most frequently. Across two preregistered laboratory experiments, we manipulate the distribution from which payoffs in the choice set are drawn. In our first experiment, we find that risk taking is more sensitive to payoffs that are presented more frequently. In a follow-up task, we incentivize subjects to classify which of two symbolic numbers is larger. Subjects exhibit higher accuracy and faster response times for numbers they have observed more frequently. In our second experiment, we manipulate the payoff distribution so that efficient coding modulates the strength of valuation biases. As we experimentally increase the frequency of large payoffs, we find that subjects perceive the upside of a risky lottery more accurately and take greater risk. Together, our experimental results suggest that risk taking depends systematically on the payoff distribution to which the decision maker’s perceptual system has recently adapted. More broadly, our findings highlight the importance of imprecise and efficient coding in economic decision making.

10.1093/qje/qjab031.abstractZh: 我们通过实验测试了一种关于风险选择的理论，该理论认为由于大脑中的信息处理限制，对彩票收益的感知存在噪声。我们采用有效编码原则来模拟感知过程，这意味着对于那些出现频率最高的收益，感知更为准确。在两项预先注册的实验室实验中，我们改变了选择集中收益的分布方式。在第一个实验中，我们发现冒险行为对出现频率较高的收益更为敏感。在后续任务中，我们激励受试者对两个符号数字中哪个更大进行分类。受试者对更常观察到的数字表现出更高的准确性和更快的反应速度。在第二个实验中，我们改变了收益分布，使得有效编码影响了估值偏差的强度。随着我们实验性地增加大额收益的频率，我们发现受试者对风险彩票的潜在收益感知更为准确，并且愿意承担更大的风险。总的来说，我们的实验结果表明，冒险行为系统性地取决于决策者的感知系统最近适应的收益分布。更广泛地说，我们的发现强调了在经济决策中，不精确但高效的编码方式的重要性。

abstract.text: We use stock exchange message data to quantify the negative aspect of high-frequency trading, known as “latency arbitrage.” The key difference between message data and widely familiar limit order book data is that message data contain attempts to trade or cancel that fail. This allows the researcher to observe both winners and losers in a race, whereas in limit order book data you cannot see the losers, so you cannot directly see the races. We find that latency arbitrage races are very frequent (about one per minute per symbol for FTSE 100 stocks), extremely fast (the modal race lasts 5–10 millionths of a second), and account for a remarkably large portion of overall trading volume (about 20%). Race participation is concentrated, with the top six firms accounting for over 80% of all race wins and losses. The average race is worth just a small amount (about half a price tick), but because of the large volumes the stakes add up. Our main estimates suggest that races constitute roughly one-third of price impact and the effective spread (key microstructure measures of the cost of liquidity), that latency arbitrage imposes a roughly 0.5 basis point tax on trading, that market designs that eliminate latency arbitrage would reduce the market’s cost of liquidity by 17%, and that the total sums at stake are on the order of $5 billion per year in global equity markets alone.

10.1093/qje/qjab032.abstractZh: 我们利用股票交易所的消息数据来量化高频交易的负面影响，这种效应被称为“延迟套利”。消息数据与人们熟知的限价单簿数据的主要区别在于，消息数据包含了那些未能成功交易的尝试。这使得研究人员能够观察到在竞争中的胜者和败者，而在限价单簿数据中，则无法看到败者，因此无法直接了解竞争的情况。我们发现，延迟套利竞争非常频繁（对于富时100指数的股票，大约每分钟发生一次），速度极快（平均竞争持续时间为5到100万分之一秒），并且占整体交易量的很大比例（约20%）。竞争参与者较为集中，前六家公司就占据了超过80%的胜负。平均一次竞争带来的影响微乎其微（大约相当于半个价格点），但由于交易量巨大，其影响却相当可观。我们的主要估计表明，竞争大约占价格影响的三分之一，以及有效差价的一定比例（这是衡量流动性成本的关键微观结构指标）。延迟套利对交易造成了大约0.5基点的税收。那些能够消除延迟套利的市场设计，可以将市场的流动性成本降低17%。仅全球股票市场，每年涉及的总金额就达到了约50亿美元。

abstract.text: Government programs are often offered on an optional basis to market participants. We explore the economics of such voluntary regulation in the context of a Medicare payment reform, in which one medical provider receives a single, predetermined payment for a sequence of related healthcare services, instead of separate service-specific payments. This "bundled payment" program was originally implemented as a 5-year randomized trial, with mandatory participation by hospitals assigned to the new payment model; however, after two years, participation was made voluntary for half of these hospitals. Using detailed claim-level data, we document that voluntary participation is more likely for hospitals that can increase revenue without changing behavior ("selection on levels") and for hospitals that had large changes in behavior when participation was mandatory ("selection on slopes"). To assess outcomes under counterfactual regimes, we estimate a stylized model of responsiveness to and selection into the program. We find that the current voluntary regime generates inefficient transfers to hospitals, and that alternative (feasible) designs could reduce these inefficient transfers and raise welfare. Our analysis highlights key design elements to consider under voluntary regulation.

10.1093/qje/qjab035.abstractZh: 政府项目通常是以自愿性的方式提供给市场参与者。我们探讨了在医疗保险支付改革背景下这种自愿性监管的经济学效应。在这种改革中，一个医疗服务提供者会获得一系列相关医疗服务的单一、预先确定的支付，而不是针对每项服务的单独支付。这种“捆绑支付”计划最初是通过为期5年的随机试验来实施的，医院必须参与新的支付模式；然而，在两年后，有一半的医院选择将参与变为自愿性。通过详细的索赔数据，我们发现，那些能够在不改变行为的情况下增加收入的医院，以及那些在强制参与时行为发生显著变化的医院，更有可能选择自愿参与。为了评估在替代制度下的结果，我们建立了一个模型来模拟对项目的响应和选择行为。我们发现，目前的自愿性制度会导致医院之间的转移效率低下，而其他可行的设计方案则能够减少这些低效的转移，并提高福利水平。我们的分析强调了在自愿性监管下需要考虑的关键设计要素。

abstract.text: This article sheds new light on the long-run evolution of political cleavages in 21 Western democracies. We exploit a new database on the socioeconomic determinants of the vote, covering more than 300 elections held between 1948 and 2020. In the 1950s and 1960s, the vote for social democratic, socialist, and affiliated parties was associated with lower-educated and low-income voters. It has gradually become associated with higher-educated voters, giving rise in the 2010s to a disconnection between the effects of income and education on the vote: higher-educated voters now vote for the “left,” while high-income voters continue to vote for the “right.” This transition has been accelerated by the rise of green and anti-immigration movements, whose distinctive feature is to concentrate the votes of the higher-educated and lower-educated electorates. Combining our database with historical data on political parties’ programs, we provide evidence that the reversal of the education cleavage is strongly linked to the emergence of a new “sociocultural” axis of political conflict.

10.1093/qje/qjab036.abstractZh: 本文对21个西方民主国家的政治分裂的长期演变提供了新的见解。我们利用了一个新的数据库，该数据库涵盖了1948年至2020年间超过300次选举的社会经济因素。在20世纪50年代和60年代，社会民主党、社会主义党及相关政党获得的选票与受教育程度较低、收入较低的选民相关。随着时间的推移，这些政党逐渐与受教育程度较高的选民联系在一起，从而在2010年代出现了收入和教育对投票影响之间的脱节：受教育程度较高的选民现在倾向于支持“左翼”政党，而高收入选民则继续支持“右翼”政党。这一转变因绿色运动和反移民运动的兴起而加速，这些运动的独特之处在于能够集中吸引受教育程度较高和较低选民的选票。结合我们的数据库与有关政党纲领的历史数据，我们发现教育分裂的逆转与新的“社会文化”政治冲突轴线的出现密切相关。

abstract.text: The job-finding rate of unemployment insurance (UI) recipients declines in the initial months of unemployment and then exhibits a spike at the benefit exhaustion point. A range of theoretical explanations have been proposed, but those are hard to disentangle using data on job finding alone. To better understand the underlying mechanisms, we conducted a large text-message-based survey of unemployed workers in Germany. We surveyed 6,349 UI recipients twice a week for four months about their job search effort. The panel structure allows us to observe how search effort evolves in individuals over the unemployment spell. We provide three key facts: (i) search effort is flat early on in the UI spell, (ii) search effort exhibits an increase up to UI exhaustion and a decrease thereafter, (iii) UI recipients do not appear to time job start dates to coincide with the UI exhaustion point. A standard search model with unobserved heterogeneity struggles to explain the second fact, and a model of storable offers is not consistent with the third fact. The patterns are well captured by a model of reference-dependent job search or by a model with duration dependence in search cost.

10.1093/qje/qjab039.abstractZh: 失业救济金的领取者在失业初期寻找工作的效率会下降，随后在福利耗尽时会出现一个高峰。虽然提出了多种理论解释，但仅依靠寻找工作的数据很难将这些解释区分开来。为了更好地理解其背后的机制，我们对德国失业工人进行了大规模的短信调查。我们每周两次对6,349名领取失业救济金的工人进行了为期四个月的调查，了解他们的求职努力情况。通过小组结构，我们可以观察到失业期间个人求职努力的变化情况。我们发现了三个关键事实：(i) 在失业初期，求职努力是稳定的；(ii) 求职努力在福利耗尽前有所上升，之后则下降；(iii) 领取失业救济金的工人似乎不会将工作开始时间安排在福利耗尽之时。标准的求职模型难以解释第二个事实，而假设有可储存的职位信息的模型则无法解释第三个事实。这些模式可以通过参考依赖型求职模型或具有搜索成本持续时间依赖性的模型来很好地解释。

abstract.text: We link newly digitized personnel records of the U.S. government for 1907–1921 to census data to study the segregation of the civil service by race under President Woodrow Wilson. Using a difference-in-differences design around Wilson’s inauguration, we find that the introduction of employment segregation increased the black-white earnings gap by 3.4–6.9 percentage points. This increasing gap is driven by a reallocation of existing black civil servants to lower-paid positions, lowering their returns to education. Importantly, the negative effects extend beyond Wilson’s presidency. Using census data for 1900–1940, we show that segregation caused a relative decline in the home ownership rate of black civil servants. Moreover, by comparing children of black and white civil servants in adulthood, we provide suggestive evidence that descendants of black civil servants who were exposed to Wilson’s presidency exhibit lower levels of education, earnings, and social mobility. Our combined results thus document significant short- and long-run costs borne by minorities during a unique episode of state-sanctioned discrimination.

10.1093/qje/qjab040.abstractZh: 我们将1907至1921年间美国政府新数字化的人事记录与人口普查数据相结合，研究伍德罗·威尔逊总统执政期间公务员按种族划分的隔离现象。通过以威尔逊就职日为分界点的差异比较设计，我们发现就业隔离的引入使黑人与白人的收入差距增加了3.4至6.9个百分点。这一扩大的差距是由于现有黑人公务员被重新分配到低薪职位，从而降低了他们的教育回报。重要的是，这种负面影响不仅限于威尔逊总统任期内。通过1900至1940年的人口普查数据，我们发现隔离现象导致黑人公务员的家庭拥有率相对下降。此外，通过比较成年后的黑人和白人公务员子女，我们有理由认为，在威尔逊总统任期内工作的黑人公务员的后代在教育水平、收入和社会流动性方面表现较差。我们的综合研究结果表明，在这一特殊的国家认可的歧视时期，少数族裔承受了显著的短期和长期成本。

abstract.text: I offer an axiomatization of risk models where the choices of the decision maker are correlation sensitive. By extending the techniques of conjoint measurement to the nondeterministic case, I show that transitivity is the von Neumann-Morgenstern axiom that has to be relaxed to allow for these richer patterns of behavior. To illustrate the advantages of the modeling choice, we provide a simple axiomatization for the salience theory model in our general framework. This approach leads to clear comparison to popular preexisting models, such as regret and reference dependence, and allows one to single out the ordering property as the feature that brings salience theory outside the prospect theory realm.

10.1093/qje/qjab041.abstractZh: 我提出了一种风险模型的公理化描述，其中决策者的选择对相关性敏感。通过将联合测度的技术扩展到非确定性情况，我证明了传递性是一个必须被放宽的冯·诺伊曼-莫根斯特恩公理，以容纳这些更为复杂的行为模式。为了说明这种建模选择的优势，我们在通用框架中为显著性理论模型提供了一个简单的公理化描述。这种方法使得与现有的流行模型（如遗憾理论和参考依赖性理论）进行清晰对比成为可能，并使得排序属性成为将显著性理论引入前景理论领域之外的关键特征。

abstract.text: We give a full analytic characterization of a large class of sticky-price models where the firm’s price-setting behavior is described by a generalized hazard function. Such a function allows for a vast variety of empirical hazards to be fitted. This setup is microfounded by random adjustment costs, as in Caballero and Engel (1999), or by information frictions, as in Woodford (2009). We establish two main results. First, we show how to identify all the primitives of the model, including the distribution of the fundamental adjustment costs and the implied generalized hazard function, using the distribution of price changes. Second, we derive a sufficient statistic for the aggregate effect of a monetary shock: given an arbitrary generalized hazard function, the cumulative impulse response of output to a once-and-for-all monetary shock is proportional to the ratio of the kurtosis of the steady-state distribution of price changes over the frequency of price adjustment. We prove that Calvo’s model yields the upper bound and Golosov and Lucas’s model the lower bound on this measure in the class of random menu cost models.

10.1093/qje/qjab042.abstractZh: 我们对一类粘性价格模型进行了全面的分析性描述，其中企业的定价行为由广义风险函数来描述。这样的函数能够适应多种多样的实证风险特征。这种模型的基础是随机调整成本，如Caballero和Engel在1999年提出的模型，或者是信息摩擦，如Woodford在2009年提出的模型。我们得出了两个主要结果。首先，我们展示了如何利用价格变化的分布来识别模型的所有基本要素，包括基本调整成本的分布以及隐含的广义风险函数。其次，我们推导出了一个衡量货币冲击总效应的充分统计量：给定任意的广义风险函数，对一次性货币冲击的产出累积脉冲响应与价格变化稳态分布的峰度与价格调整频率之比成正比。我们证明了在随机菜单成本模型中，Calvo模型提供了这一测度的上界，而Golosov和Lucas模型则提供了下界。

abstract.text: Overdose deaths involving opioids have increased dramatically since the 1990s, leading to the worst drug overdose epidemic in U.S. history, but there is limited empirical evidence about the initial causes. In this article, we examine the role of the 1996 introduction and marketing of OxyContin as a potential leading cause of the opioid crisis. We leverage cross-state variation in exposure to OxyContin's introduction due to a state policy that substantially limited the drug's early entry and marketing in select states. Recently unsealed court documents involving Purdue Pharma show that state-based triplicate prescription programs posed a major obstacle to sales of OxyContin and suggest that less marketing was targeted to states with these programs. We find that OxyContin distribution was more than 50% lower in "triplicate states" in the years after the drug's launch. Although triplicate states had higher rates of overdose deaths prior to 1996, this relationship flipped shortly after the launch and triplicate states saw substantially slower growth in overdose deaths, continuing even 20 years after OxyContin's introduction. Our results show that the introduction and marketing of OxyContin explain a substantial share of overdose deaths over the past two decades.

10.1093/qje/qjab043.abstractZh: 自20世纪90年代以来，涉及阿片类药物的过量死亡事件急剧增加，导致美国历史上最严重的药物过量流行病。然而，关于其初始原因的相关实证证据非常有限。在本文中，我们探讨了1996年奥施康定作为阿片类药物危机的潜在诱因所起的作用。由于某些州的政策限制了该药物的早期上市，各州在奥施康定的接触情况存在显著差异。最近公布的涉及普渡制药的法庭文件显示，基于州的重复处方计划严重阻碍了奥施康定的销售，这表明针对这些州的营销活动较少。我们发现，在药物上市后的几年里，重复处方计划实施地区的奥施康定分发量比未实施该计划的地区低50%以上。尽管在1996年之前，重复处方计划实施地区的过量死亡率较高，但在药物上市后这一关系发生了逆转，重复处方计划实施地区的过量死亡率显著下降，这一趋势持续了20年之久。我们的研究结果表明，奥施康定的引入和营销在过去二十年里对过量死亡事件产生了重要影响。

abstract.text: There are two broad views as to why people stay poor. One emphasizes differences in fundamentals, such as ability, talent, or motivation. The poverty traps view emphasizes differences in opportunities that stem from access to wealth. To test these views, we exploit a large-scale, randomized asset transfer and an 11-year panel of 6,000 households who begin in extreme poverty. The setting is rural Bangladesh, and the assets are cows. The data support the poverty traps view—we identify a threshold level of initial assets above which households accumulate assets, take on better occupations (from casual labor in agriculture or domestic services to running small livestock businesses), and grow out of poverty. The reverse happens for those below the threshold. Structural estimation of an occupational choice model reveals that almost all beneficiaries are misallocated in the work they do at baseline and that the gains arising from eliminating misallocation would far exceed the program costs. Our findings imply that large transfers, which create better jobs for the poor, are an effective means of getting people out of poverty traps and reducing global poverty.

10.1093/qje/qjab045.abstractZh: 关于人们为何保持贫困，存在两种主要的观点。一种强调基本因素的差异，如能力、天赋或动机。另一种观点则强调机会的差异，这些机会源于对财富的获取能力。为了验证这些观点，我们采用了一项大规模的随机资产转移实验，并追踪了6000户家庭11年的发展情况，这些家庭最初都处于极度贫困状态。实验的地点是孟加拉国的农村地区，而资产则是牛。数据支持“贫困陷阱”观点——我们发现，当初始资产达到某个阈值后，这些家庭会积累资产，从事更好的职业（从农业或家政服务中的临时劳动转变为经营小型畜牧业），从而摆脱贫困。而对于低于这个阈值的家庭来说，情况则相反。通过结构估计的职业选择模型分析表明，几乎所有受益者在初始阶段从事的职业选择存在错配，而消除这种错配所带来的收益将远远超过项目的成本。我们的研究结果表明，通过大规模资产转移为贫困人口创造更好的就业机会，是一种有效的方式，可以帮助人们摆脱贫困陷阱，减少全球贫困问题。

abstract.text: How effective are physicians at diagnosing heart attacks? To answer this question, we contrast physician testing decisions with a machine learning model of risk. When the two deviate, we use actual health outcome data to judge whether the algorithm or the physician was right. We find physicians over-test: tests that are predictably useless are still performed. At the same time, physicians also under-test: many predicted high-risk patients are untested and then suffer adverse health events (including death) at high rates. A natural experiment using shift-to-shift testing variation confirms these findings: increasing testing improves health and reduces mortality, but only for patients flagged as high-risk by the algorithm. The simultaneous existence of over- and under-testing cannot easily be explained by incentives alone, and instead suggests errors. We provide suggestive evidence on the psychology behind these errors:(i) physicians use too simple a model of risk, suggesting bounded rationality; (ii) they over-weight salient information; and (iii) they over-weight symptoms that are representative or stereotypical of heart attack. Together, these results suggest the need for health care models and policies to incorporate not just physician incentives, but also physician mistakes.

10.1093/qje/qjab046.abstractZh: 医生在诊断心脏病方面有多有效？为了回答这个问题，我们将医生的检测决策与机器学习模型的风险评估进行比较。当两者存在差异时，我们使用实际的健康结果数据来判断是算法还是医生判断正确。我们发现医生过度检测：那些可以预测无用的检测仍然被执行。同时，医生也过度遗漏检测：许多被预测为高风险的患者未被检测，从而遭受了高比例的不良健康事件（包括死亡）。一项使用连续检测变化的自然实验证实了这些发现：增加检测可以改善健康状况并降低死亡率，但仅限于被算法标记为高风险的患者。过度检测与过度遗漏检测同时存在的现象很难仅用激励因素来解释，反而暗示了存在错误。我们提供了一些关于这些错误背后的心理因素的线索：(i) 医生使用过于简单的风险模型，表明他们的决策存在有限理性；(ii) 他们过分重视显著的信息；(iii) 他们过分重视那些代表或具有心脏病典型症状的症状。综合这些结果，表明医疗保健模型和政策的制定需要考虑到医生的激励因素以及他们的错误。

abstract.text: This article studies how exclusive social groups shape upward mobility and whether interactions between low- and high-status peers can integrate the top rungs of the economic and social ladders. Our setting is Harvard University in the 1920s and 1930s, where new groups of students arriving on campus encountered a social system centered on exclusive old boys’ clubs. Combining archival and census records, we first show that students from prestigious private feeder schools are overrepresented in old boys’ clubs, while academic high achievers and ethnic minorities are almost completely absent. Club members earn $32\%$ more than other students and are more likely to work in finance and join country clubs, both characteristic of the era’s elite. We use random variation in room assignment to show that exposure to high-status peers expands gaps in college club membership, adult social club membership, and finance careers by high school type, with large positive effects for private school students and zero or negative effects for others. To conclude, we turn to more recent cohorts. We show that the link between exclusive college clubs and finance careers persists across the twentieth century even as Harvard diversifies, and that elite university students from the highest-income families continue to outearn their peers.

10.1093/qje/qjab047.abstractZh: 本文研究了排他性社会群体如何塑造向上流动的机会，以及低地位与高地位同龄人之间的互动是否有助于将人们整合到经济和社会阶梯的顶端。我们的研究背景是20世纪20至30年代的哈佛大学，当时新入学的学生面临着以排他性老校友俱乐部为中心的社会体系。通过结合档案记录和人口普查数据，我们首先发现来自知名私立学校的学生在老校友俱乐部中占比较高，而学术成绩优异的学生和少数民族学生则几乎完全缺席。俱乐部成员比其他学生的收入高出32%，并且更有可能从事金融工作或加入国家俱乐部，这些都是当时精英阶层的特征。我们通过随机分配宿舍的方式发现，接触高地位同龄人能够扩大大学俱乐部会员资格、成人社交俱乐部会员资格以及金融职业机会的差距，其中私立学校学生的影响尤为显著，而其他类型的学生则几乎没有或仅有负面影响。最后，我们转向更近期的群体，发现即使哈佛大学实现了多元化，排他性大学俱乐部与金融职业之间的联系仍然持续存在，来自最高收入家庭的高中精英学生仍然比同龄人拥有更高的收入。

abstract.text: Physicians, judges, teachers, and agents in many other settings differ systematically in the decisions they make when faced with similar cases. Standard approaches to interpreting and exploiting such differences assume they arise solely from variation in preferences. We develop an alternative framework that allows variation in preferences and diagnostic skill and show that both dimensions may be partially identified in standard settings under quasi-random assignment. We apply this framework to study pneumonia diagnoses by radiologists. Diagnosis rates vary widely among radiologists, and descriptive evidence suggests that a large component of this variation is due to differences in diagnostic skill. Our estimated model suggests that radiologists view failing to diagnose a patient with pneumonia as more costly than incorrectly diagnosing one without, and that this leads less skilled radiologists to optimally choose lower diagnostic thresholds. Variation in skill can explain 39% of the variation in diagnostic decisions, and policies that improve skill perform better than uniform decision guidelines. Failing to account for skill variation can lead to highly misleading results in research designs that use agent assignments as instruments.

10.1093/qje/qjab048.abstractZh: 在许多其他领域，医生、法官、教师以及代理人在面对类似案例时做出的决策存在系统性差异。传统上，人们认为这种差异仅源于偏好上的差异。我们提出了一种替代框架，该框架允许偏好和诊断技能上的差异存在，并表明在准随机分配的情况下，这两个维度都可能被部分识别。我们将这一框架应用于放射科医生对肺炎的诊断研究。不同放射科医生之间的诊断率存在很大差异，描述性证据表明，这种差异在很大程度上是由于诊断技能的差异造成的。我们的模型估计表明，放射科医生认为未能诊断出肺炎的患者比错误诊断一个患者要代价更高，这使得技能较低的放射科医生选择较低的诊断阈值。技能差异可以解释诊断决策差异的39%，而改善技能的政策比统一的决策指南表现得更好。如果未能考虑技能差异，那么在使用代理人分配作为工具的研究设计中，可能会导致高度误导性的结果。

abstract.text: We show theoretically and empirically that the managerial organization of multiestablishment firms is interdependent across establishments. To derive our result, we study the effect of geographic frictions on firm organization. In our model, we assume that a CEO’s time is a resource in limited supply, shared across headquarters and establishments. Geographic frictions increase the costs of accessing the CEO. Hiring middle managers at one establishment substitutes for CEO time, which is reallocated across all establishments. Consequently, geographic frictions between the headquarters and one establishment affect the organization of all establishments of a firm. Our model is consistent with novel facts about multiestablishment firm organization that we document using administrative data from Germany. We exploit the opening of high-speed railway routes to show that not only the establishments directly affected by faster travel times but also the other establishments of the firm adjust their organization. Our findings imply that local conditions propagate across space through firm organization.

10.1093/qje/qjab049.abstractZh: 我们从理论上和实证上证明了多机构企业的管理组织在不同机构之间是相互依赖的。为了得出我们的结论，我们研究了地理障碍对企业组织的影响。在我们的模型中，我们假设首席执行官的时间是一种有限的资源，由总部和各个机构共同使用。地理障碍增加了获取首席执行官时间的成本。在一个机构中雇佣中层管理者可以替代首席执行官的时间，这些时间会被重新分配到所有机构中。因此，总部与一个机构之间的地理障碍会影响企业所有机构的组织结构。我们的模型与我们使用德国行政数据记录的多机构企业组织的新发现一致。我们通过高速铁路线路的开通来表明，不仅直接受到更快旅行时间影响的机构会调整其组织结构，企业中的其他机构也会进行相应的调整。我们的发现表明，当地条件通过企业组织在空间中传播。

abstract.text: Financial aid from the Susan Thompson Buffett Foundation (STBF) provides comprehensive support to a student population similar to that served by a host of state aid programs. In conjunction with STBF, we randomly assigned aid awards to thousands of Nebraska high school graduates from low-income, minority, and first-generation college households. Randomly assigned STBF awards boost bachelor’s (BA) degree completion for students targeting four-year schools by about 8 points. Degree gains are concentrated among four-year college applicants who would otherwise have been unlikely to pursue a four-year program. Degree effects are mediated by award-induced increases in credits earned toward a BA in the first year of college. The extent of initial four-year college engagement explains differences in impact by target campus and across covariate subgroups. The projected lifetime earnings effect of awards exceeds marginal educational spending for all of the subgroups examined in the study. Projected earnings gains exceed funder costs for urban students and for students with relatively weak academic preparation.

10.1093/qje/qjab050.abstractZh: 苏珊·汤普森·巴菲特基金会提供的经济援助为学生群体提供了全面的支持，其服务范围与许多州级援助项目相当。我们与巴菲特基金会合作，向内布拉斯加州数千名来自低收入家庭、少数族裔以及第一代大学生家庭的高中毕业生随机分配了援助资金。这些随机分配的援助资金使目标学生完成四年制大学学位的可能性提高了约8个百分点。这些收益主要集中在对四年制大学申请者身上，这些学生原本不太可能选择四年制教育。学位提升的效果是通过援助资金促使学生在大学第一年获得的学分增加来实现的。初始对四年制大学教育的投入程度解释了不同校区和不同子群体之间效果的差异。援助资金带来的预期终身收入收益超过了所有被研究子群体在教育上的边际支出。对于城市学生以及学术准备相对薄弱的学生来说，预期的收入增长超过了资助成本。

abstract.text: The recent ascent of right-wing populist movements in several countries has rekindled interest in understanding the causes of the rise of fascism in the interwar years. In this article, we argue that there was a strong link between the surge of support for the Socialist Party after World War I and the subsequent emergence of fascism in Italy. We first develop a source of variation in socialist support across Italian municipalities in the 1919 election based on war casualties from the area. We show that these casualties are unrelated to a battery of political, economic, and social variables before the war and had a major effect on socialist support (partly because the socialists were the main antiwar political movement). Our main result is that this boost to socialist support (that is “exogenous” to the prior political leaning of the municipality) led to greater local fascist activity as measured by local party branches and fascist political violence, and to significantly larger vote share of the Fascist Party in the 1921 and 1924 elections. We provide evidence that landowner associations and greater presence of local elites played an important role in the rise of fascism. Finally, we find greater likelihood of Jewish deportations in 1943–45 and lower vote share for Christian Democrats after World War II in areas with greater early fascist activity.

10.1093/qje/qjac001.abstractZh: 近年来，一些国家中右翼民粹主义运动的兴起，重新引发了人们对一战期间法西斯主义崛起原因的探讨。本文认为，第一次世界大战后社会党的支持率上升与随后意大利法西斯主义的出现之间存在密切关联。我们首先分析了1919年意大利各市镇社会党支持率的变化情况，这些变化与当地战争伤亡人数有关。我们发现，这些伤亡人数与战前的政治、经济和社会变量无关，但对社会党的支持率产生了重大影响（部分原因是社会党是主要的反战政治力量）。我们的主要结论是，这种对社会党支持率的提升（属于“外生因素”）导致了当地法西斯组织的活动增加，以及1921年和1924年选举中法西斯党的得票率显著上升。我们还发现，在法西斯主义早期活动较为活跃的地区，1943-1945年间犹太人被驱逐的可能性更高，而基督教民主党的得票率则较低。

abstract.text: We study the scope for international cooperation in macroprudential policies. Multinational banks contribute to and are affected by fire sales in countries they operate in. National governments setting quantity regulations noncooperatively fail to achieve the globally efficient outcome, underregulating domestic banks and overregulating foreign banks. Surprisingly, noncooperative national governments using revenue-generating Pigouvian taxation can achieve the global optimum. Intuitively, this occurs because governments internalize the business value of foreign banks through the tax revenue collected. Our theory provides a unified framework to think about international bank regulations and yields concrete insights with the potential to improve on the current policy stance.

10.1093/qje/qjac002.abstractZh: 我们研究了国际宏观审慎政策合作的可能性。跨国银行在所在国家进行抛售行为，既会对这些行为产生积极影响，也会受到负面影响。国家政府若不合作地设定数量性监管措施，将无法实现全球范围内的有效监管，这会导致对本国银行监管不足，而对外国银行监管过度。令人惊讶的是，不合作的国家政府通过征收能够产生收入的庇古式税收，仍可以实现全球最优的监管效果。从直观上讲，这是因为政府通过税收收入将外国银行的商业价值内部化。我们的理论为思考国际银行监管提供了一个统一的框架，并提供了一些具体的见解，这些见解有可能改善当前的政策立场。

abstract.text: We run a series of experiments involving over 4,000 online participants and over 10,000 school-aged youth. When individuals are asked to subjectively describe their performance on a male-typed task relating to math and science, we find a large gender gap in self-evaluations. This gap arises when self-evaluations are provided to potential employers, and thus measure self-promotion, and when self-evaluations are not driven by incentives to promote. The gender gap in self-evaluations proves to be persistent and arises as early as the sixth grade. No gender gap arises if individuals are asked about their performance on a more female-typed task.

10.1093/qje/qjac003.abstractZh: 我们开展了一系列实验，涉及超过4,000名在线参与者和10,000多名学龄儿童。当要求参与者主观描述他们在与数学和科学相关的男性主导任务中的表现时，我们发现自我评估中存在明显的性别差异。这种差异出现在向潜在雇主提供自我评估时，此时评估用于衡量自我推广能力；而当自我评估并非出于推广动机时，性别差异则不会出现。自我评估中的性别差异具有持久性，甚至早在六年级时就已经出现。如果要求参与者描述他们在更偏向女性主导的任务中的表现，则不会出现性别差异。

abstract.text: We analyze how firms choose the currency of invoicing and the implications of this choice for exchange rate pass-through into export prices and quantities. Using a new data set for Belgian firms, we find currency invoicing to be an active firm-level decision, shaped by the firm’s size, exposure to imported inputs, and the currency choices of its competitors. Our results show that a firm’s currency choice, in turn, has a direct causal effect on the exchange rate pass-through into prices and quantities. Moreover, the differential price response of similar firms that invoice in different currencies is large, persists beyond a one-year horizon, and gradually wanes in the long run. This results in allocative expenditure-switching effects on export quantities, which build up over time, suggesting a role for quantity adjustment frictions in addition to price stickiness. Our findings shed light on the mechanisms that make or break a dominant currency and the consequences it has for the international transmission of shocks.

10.1093/qje/qjac004.abstractZh: 我们分析了企业如何选择结算货币，以及这一选择对汇率传递到出口价格和数量的影响。利用比利时企业的新数据集，我们发现选择结算货币是企业的主动决策，这一决策受到企业规模、对进口投入的依赖程度以及竞争对手的货币选择的影响。我们的研究结果表明，企业的货币选择反过来直接影响汇率传递到价格和数量的过程。此外，使用不同货币进行结算的类似企业之间的价格反应差异较大，这种差异在一年以上的时间范围内仍然存在，并且长期来看会逐渐减弱。这导致了出口数量的分配性支出转换效应，这种效应随着时间逐渐累积，表明除了价格粘性之外，数量调整摩擦也起到了重要作用。我们的研究结果揭示了决定主导货币地位的机制，以及这种货币选择对国际冲击传递的影响。

abstract.text: We document two robust features of the cross-sectional distribution of usual weekly hours and hourly wages. First, usual weekly hours are heavily concentrated around 40 hours, while at the same time a substantial share of total hours come from individuals who work more than 50 hours. Second, mean hourly wages are nonmonotonic across the usual hours distribution, with a peak at 50 hours. We develop and estimate a model of labor supply to account for these features. The novel feature of our model is that earnings are nonlinear in hours, with the extent of nonlinearity varying over the hours distribution. Our estimates imply significant wage penalties for people who deviate from 40 hours in either direction, leading to a large mass of people who work 40 hours and are not very responsive to shocks. This has important implications for the role of labor supply as a mechanism for self-insurance in a standard heterogeneous-agent incomplete-markets model and for empirical strategies designed to estimate labor supply parameters.

10.1093/qje/qjac005.abstractZh: 我们记录了通常每周工作时间和每小时工资横截面分布的两个显著特征。首先，通常每周工作时间主要集中在40小时左右，同时，有相当一部分工作时间来自那些工作超过50小时的人。其次，平均每小时工资在通常的工作时间分布上呈现非单调趋势，在50小时时达到峰值。我们开发并估计了一个劳动供给模型来解释这些特征。我们模型的一个新颖之处在于，收入与工作时间呈非线性关系，非线性程度随工作时间分布而变化。我们的估计结果显示，对于那些偏离40小时工作时间的人，会面临显著的工资惩罚，导致大量人选择工作40小时，并且对冲击的响应较低。这对劳动供给作为标准异质代理人不完全市场模型中自我保险机制的作用，以及用于估计劳动供给参数的实证策略，都具有重要的意义。

abstract.text: We study the effects of becoming a supplier to multinational corporations (MNCs) using tax data tracking firm-to-firm transactions in Costa Rica. Event study estimates reveal that domestic firms experience strong and persistent gains in performance after supplying to a first MNC buyer. Four years after, domestic firms employ 26% more workers and have a 4% to 9% higher total factor productivity (TFP). These effects are unlikely to be explained by demand effects or changes in tax compliance. Moreover, suppliers experience a large drop in their sales to all other buyers except the first MNC buyer in the year of the event, followed by a gradual recovery. The dynamics of adjustment in sales to others suggests that firms face short-run capacity constraints that relax over time. Four years later, the sales to others grow by 20%. Most of this growth comes from the acquisition of new buyers, which tend to be “better buyers” (e.g., larger and with more stable supplier relationships). Finally, we collected survey data from domestic firms and MNCs to provide further insights into the wide-ranging benefits of supplying to MNCs. According to our surveys, these benefits range from better managerial practices to a better reputation.

10.1093/qje/qjac006.abstractZh: 我们研究了成为跨国企业供应商所带来的影响，通过追踪哥斯达黎加企业之间的交易数据来进行研究。事件研究结果显示，国内企业在首次为跨国企业供货后，其业绩会获得显著且持续性的提升。四年后，这些企业的员工数量增加了26%，总要素生产率也提高了4%至9%。这些效应不太可能由需求效应或税收合规性的变化来解释。此外，供应商在事件发生的当年，除首次跨国企业买家外，与其他买家的交易额大幅下降，随后逐渐恢复。对其他买家的销售调整动态表明，企业面临的是短期产能限制，但这些限制会随着时间而缓解。四年后，对其他买家的销售增长了20%，其中大部分增长来自新买家的获取，这些新买家往往“更优秀”（例如，规模更大且与供应商的关系更稳定）。最后，我们收集了国内企业和跨国企业的调查数据，以进一步了解为跨国企业供货所带来的广泛好处。根据我们的调查，这些好处包括更好的管理实践以及更好的声誉。

abstract.text: This article studies external sovereign bonds as an asset class. We compile a new database of 266,000 monthly prices of foreign-currency government bonds traded in London and New York between 1815 (the Battle of Waterloo) and 2016, covering up to 91 countries. Our main insight is that, as in equity markets, the returns on external sovereign bonds have been sufficiently high to compensate for risk. Real ex post returns average more than 6% annually across two centuries, including default episodes, major wars, and global crises. This represents an excess return of 3%–4% above US or UK government bonds, which is comparable to stocks and outperforms corporate bonds. Central to this finding are the high average coupons offered on external sovereign bonds. The observed returns are hard to reconcile with canonical theoretical models and the degree of credit risk in this market, as measured by historical default and recovery rates. Based on our archive of more than 300 sovereign debt restructurings since 1815, we show that full repudiation is rare; the median creditor loss (haircut) is below 50%.

10.1093/qje/qjac007.abstractZh: 本文研究了外部主权债券这一资产类别。我们编制了一个包含266,000条数据的数据库，记录了1815年（滑铁卢战役）至2016年间在伦敦和纽约交易的外币政府债券的月度价格，涵盖91个国家。我们的主要发现是，与股票市场类似，外部主权债券的回报率足够高，足以弥补风险。在两个世纪的时间里，包括违约事件、重大战争和全球危机期间，实际回报率年均超过6%。这一回报率比美国或英国政府债券的回报率高出3%至4%，与股票相当，且优于企业债券。这一发现的核心在于外部主权债券提供的高平均票息。观察到的回报率难以与经典理论模型以及该市场中的信用风险程度相吻合，后者通过历史违约率和恢复率来衡量。基于我们自1815年以来超过300次主权债务重组的档案数据，我们发现完全拒付的情况非常罕见；债权人损失的中位数低于50%。

abstract.text: We use three quasi-natural experiments in Mexico and one in Panama to estimate the effects of having the option to pay with cash on Uber rides. The ability to pay in cash affects the demand for rides, which is reflected in large changes in the total number of trips, fares, miles, and number of users after Uber introduced cash payments, particularly in lower-income city blocks. On the other hand, the effects on prices, estimated times of arrival, and competitor pricing are negligible, consistent with the supply of trips being very elastic. Although cash payments naturally increase the fraction of users that pay exclusively with cash, more than half of the users have access to both cards and cash, and alternate between payment methods. We find evidence consistent with cash and card payments being imperfectly substitutable at both the intensive and extensive margins, which magnifies the effect of policies that restrict the availability of payment methods.

10.1093/qje/qjac008.abstractZh: 我们在墨西哥进行了三项准自然实验，在巴拿马进行了一项实验，以评估在优步乘车时可以选择现金支付的影响。能够使用现金支付会影响对乘车服务的需求，这表现为优步引入现金支付后，出行次数、费用、里程以及用户数量发生了显著变化，尤其是在低收入社区。另一方面，对价格、预计到达时间以及竞争对手定价的影响微乎其微，这与出行供应具有高度弹性是一致的。尽管现金支付自然会增加仅使用现金支付的用户比例，但超过一半的用户同时可以使用卡片和现金，并会在两种支付方式之间切换。我们发现，现金和卡片支付在集约性和扩展性市场上都存在不完全替代性，这放大了限制支付方式可用性的政策效果。

abstract.text: We document a nationwide “assessment gap” that leads local governments to place a disproportionate fiscal burden on racial and ethnic minorities. We show that holding taxing jurisdictions and property tax rates fixed, Black and Hispanic residents face a 10%–13% higher tax burden for the same bundle of public services. We decompose this disparity into between- and within-neighborhood components and find that just over half of it arises between neighborhoods. We then present evidence on mechanisms. Property assessments are less sensitive to neighborhood attributes than market prices are. This generates spatial variation in tax burden within jurisdiction and leads to overtaxation of communities with a high share of minority residents. We also find appeals behavior and appeals outcomes differ by race within neighborhood. Inequality does not arise from (i) racial differences in transaction prices or (ii) differences in features of the housing stock.

10.1093/qje/qjac009.abstractZh: 我们记录了全国范围内的“评估差距”，导致地方政府对种族和族裔少数群体施加了不成比例的财政负担。我们发现，在税收管辖区和财产税率保持不变的情况下，黑人和西班牙裔居民在享受相同公共服务时，所承担的税收负担高出10%至13%。我们将这种差异分解为邻里间和邻里内的成分，发现其中超过一半的差异存在于邻里之间。随后，我们提出了相关机制方面的证据。财产评估对邻里属性的敏感度低于市场价格的敏感度。这导致同一管辖区内税收负担出现空间差异，从而使得拥有较多少数族裔居民的社区面临过度征税的问题。我们还发现，在邻里内，不同种族的申诉行为和结果存在差异。这种不平等并非源于（i）种族间交易价格的差异，也不是源于（ii）住房库存特征的差异。

abstract.text: We estimate the slope of the Phillips curve in the cross section of U.S. states using newly constructed state-level price indices for nontradeable goods back to 1978. Our estimates indicate that the slope of the Phillips curve is small and was small even during the early 1980s. We estimate only a modest decline in the slope of the Phillips curve since the 1980s. We use a multiregion model to infer the slope of the aggregate Phillips curve from our regional estimates. Applying our estimates to recent unemployment dynamics yields essentially no missing disinflation or missing reinflation over the past few business cycles. Our results imply that the sharp drop in core inflation in the early 1980s was mostly due to shifting expectations about long-run monetary policy as opposed to a steep Phillips curve, and the greater stability of inflation between 1990 and 2020 is mostly due to long-run inflation expectations becoming more firmly anchored.

10.1093/qje/qjac010.abstractZh: 我们使用新构建的州级非贸易商品价格指数，对1978年以来的美国各州菲利普斯曲线的斜率进行了估计。我们的估计表明，菲利普斯曲线的斜率较小，在20世纪80年代初也一直保持较低水平。自20世纪80年代以来，菲利普斯曲线的斜率仅出现了适度的下降。我们采用多区域模型，从区域估计中推断出总体菲利普斯曲线的斜率。将我们的估计结果应用于近期的失业动态，发现过去几个经济周期中几乎没有出现通货紧缩或通货膨胀的缺失现象。我们的结果表明，20世纪80年代初核心通货膨胀的急剧下降主要是由于对长期货币政策的预期发生变化，而非菲利普斯曲线斜率的急剧变化所致；而1990年至2020年间通货膨胀的更稳定，则主要是由于长期通货膨胀预期变得更加稳定。

abstract.text: The earnings of individuals depend on the demand for the factor services they supply. International trade may therefore affect earnings inequality because either (i) foreign consumers and firms demand domestic factor services in different proportions than domestic consumers and firms do, an export channel; or (ii) domestic consumers and firms change their demand for domestic factor services in response to the availability of foreign goods, an import channel. Building on this idea, we develop new measures of export and import exposure at the individual level and provide estimates of their incidence across the earnings distribution. The key input fed into our empirical analysis is a unique administrative data set from Ecuador that merges firm-to-firm transaction data, employer-employee matched data, owner-firm matched data, and firm-level customs transaction records. We find that export exposure is pro-middle class, import exposure is pro-rich, and in terms of overall incidence, the import channel is the dominant force. As a result, earnings inequality in Ecuador is higher than it would be in the absence of trade.

10.1093/qje/qjac012.abstractZh: 个人的收入取决于他们对所提供生产要素服务的需求。因此，国际贸易可能会影响收入不平等，原因可能是：(i) 外国消费者和企业在不同程度上需求国内生产要素服务，即出口渠道；或者(ii) 国内消费者和企业在面对外国商品时改变对国内生产要素服务的需求，即进口渠道。基于这一理念，我们提出了新的个人层面出口和进口敞口度量方法，并估算了这些敞口在收入分布中的分布情况。我们实证分析的关键输入数据来自厄瓜多尔的一个独特行政数据集，该数据集整合了企业间交易数据、雇主与雇员匹配数据、企业所有者与员工匹配数据以及企业层面的海关交易记录。我们发现，出口敞口有利于中产阶级，而进口敞口则有利于富人。总体而言，进口渠道是主导因素。因此，厄瓜多尔的收入不平等程度高于没有贸易的情况下。

abstract.text: Many school districts with centralized school choice adopt strategy-proof assignment mechanisms to relieve applicants from needing to strategize based on beliefs about their own admissions chances. This article shows that beliefs about admissions chances shape choice outcomes even when the assignment mechanism is strategy-proof by influencing how applicants search for schools and that “smart matching platforms” that provide live feedback on admissions chances help applicants search more effectively. Motivated by a model in which applicants engage in costly search for schools and overoptimism can lead to undersearch, we use data from a large-scale survey of choice participants in Chile to show that learning about schools is hard, beliefs about admissions chances guide the decision to stop searching, and applicants systematically underestimate nonplacement risk. We use RCT and RD research designs to evaluate scaled live feedback policies in the Chilean and New Haven choice systems. Twenty-two percent of applicants submitting applications where risks of nonplacement are high respond to warnings by adding schools to their lists, reducing nonplacement risk by 58% and increasing test score value added at the schools where they enroll by 0.10 standard deviations. Reducing the burden of school choice requires not just strategy-proofness inside the centralized system but also choice supports for the strategic decisions that inevitably remain outside of it.

10.1093/qje/qjac013.abstractZh: 许多实行集中式学校选择的学区采用策略性强的分配机制，以减轻申请者需要根据自己对录取机会的预估来制定策略的负担。本文指出，即使分配机制具有策略性，对录取机会的预估仍然会影响申请者的选择结果，从而影响他们寻找学校的方式。而那些能够提供实时录取机会反馈的“智能匹配平台”则有助于申请者更有效地进行搜索。基于一个模型，该模型表明申请者会进行昂贵的学校搜索，而过度乐观可能导致搜索不足，我们利用智利一项大规模调查的数据表明，了解学校信息非常困难，对录取机会的预估会指导决策，而申请者通常会低估未被录取的风险。我们通过随机对照试验和实验设计来评估智利和新哈文选择系统中实时反馈政策的效果。在申请中，有22%的申请者会在面临高被录取风险时，通过添加学校来应对警告，这使得被录取的风险降低了58%，同时他们在所就读学校的测试成绩增值了0.10个标准差。减轻学校选择的负担不仅需要集中式系统内部的策略性，还需要为那些不可避免地需要做出战略决策的选择提供支持。

abstract.text: Economic theory predicts that outsourcing public services to private firms reduces costs, but the effect on quality is ambiguous. We explore quality differences between publicly and privately owned ambulances in Stockholm County, Sweden, a setting where patients are as good as randomly assigned to ambulances with different ownership status. We find that private ambulances reduce costs and perform better on contracted measures such as response time, but perform worse on noncontracted measures such as mortality. In fact, a patient has a 1.4% higher risk of death within three years if a private ambulance is dispatched (in aggregate, 420 more deaths each year). We also present evidence of the mechanism at work, suggesting that private firms cut costs at the expense of ambulance staff quality.

10.1093/qje/qjac014.abstractZh: 经济理论预测，将公共服务外包给私人企业可以降低成本，但其对服务质量的影响并不明确。我们研究了瑞典斯德哥尔摩县公共和私人拥有的救护车之间的服务质量差异。在这种情况下，患者被随机分配到不同所有权属性的救护车中，服务质量相当。我们发现，私人救护车能够降低成本，并在响应时间等合同指标上表现更好，但在非合同指标上表现较差，例如死亡率。事实上，如果派遣私人救护车，患者在三年内死亡的风险会高出1.4%（每年总共多出420例死亡）。我们还提供了相关机制的证据，表明私人企业通过牺牲救护车工作人员的质量来降低成本。

abstract.text: Different agents need to make a prediction. They observe identical data, but have different models: they predict using different explanatory variables. We study which agent believes they have the best predictive ability—as measured by the smallest subjective posterior mean squared prediction error—and show how it depends on the sample size. With small samples, we present results suggesting it is an agent using a low-dimensional model. With large samples, it is generally an agent with a high-dimensional model, possibly including irrelevant variables, but never excluding relevant ones. We apply our results to characterize the winning model in an auction of productive assets, to argue that entrepreneurs and investors with simple models will be overrepresented in new sectors, and to understand the proliferation of “factors” that explain the cross-sectional variation of expected stock returns in the asset-pricing literature.

10.1093/qje/qjac015.abstractZh: 不同的代理人需要做出预测。他们观察到相同的数据，但使用不同的模型：他们利用不同的解释变量进行预测。我们研究哪个代理人认为自己的预测能力最强——以主观后验均方预测误差最小来衡量——并展示了这一结果如何依赖于样本大小。在样本较小的情况下，我们的结果表明是使用了低维模型的代理人。而在样本较大的情况下，通常是使用了高维模型的代理人，这些模型可能包含不相关的变量，但从不排除相关的变量。我们将这些结果应用于描述生产性资产拍卖中的获胜模型，以说明使用简单模型的创业者和投资者会在新行业中占据主导地位，并理解在资产定价文献中解释预期股票回报的“因素”的激增现象。

abstract.text: I show that a disruption to the financial sector can reshape the patterns of global trade for decades. I study the first modern global banking crisis originating in London in 1866 and collect archival loan records that link multinational banks headquartered there to their lending abroad. Countries exposed to bank failures in London immediately exported significantly less and did not recover their lost growth relative to unexposed places. Their market shares within each destination also remained significantly lower for four decades. Decomposing the persistent market-share losses shows that they primarily stem from lack of extensive-margin growth, as the financing shock caused importers to source more from new trade partnerships. Exporters producing more substitutable goods, those with little access to alternative forms of credit, and those trading with more distant partners experienced more persistent losses, consistent with the existence of sunk costs and the importance of finance for intermediating trade.

10.1093/qje/qjac016.abstractZh: 我指出，金融领域的动荡可能会重塑全球贸易模式数十年。我研究了1866年起源于伦敦的第一次现代全球银行危机，并收集了相关档案记录，这些记录将总部位于伦敦的跨国银行与其海外贷款活动联系起来。遭受伦敦银行倒闭影响的国家，其出口量立即显著减少，且相对于未受影响的地区，其经济增长也未能恢复。这些国家在各个目的地的市场份额在四十年内都保持在较低水平。深入分析这些持续的市场份额损失后发现，其主要源于缺乏广泛的利润增长，因为融资冲击迫使进口商更多地从新的贸易伙伴那里获取资金。生产可替代商品的出口商、那些难以获得其他形式信贷的出口商，以及与距离较远的合作伙伴进行贸易的出口商，所经历的损失更为严重，这与沉没成本的存在以及金融在贸易中介中的重要性是一致的。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of losing Supplemental Security Income (SSI) benefits at age 18 on criminal justice and employment outcomes over the next two decades. To estimate this effect, we use a regression discontinuity design in the likelihood of being reviewed for SSI eligibility at age 18 created by the 1996 welfare reform law. We evaluate this natural experiment with Social Security Administration data linked to records from the Criminal Justice Administrative Records System. We find that SSI removal increases the number of criminal charges by a statistically significant 20% over the next two decades. The increase in charges is concentrated in offenses for which income generation is a primary motivation (60% increase), especially theft, burglary, fraud/forgery, and prostitution. The effect of SSI removal on criminal justice involvement persists more than two decades later, even as the effect of removal on contemporaneous SSI receipt diminishes. In response to SSI removal, youth are twice as likely to be charged with an illicit income-generating offense than they are to maintain steady employment at ${\$}$15,000/year in the labor market. As a result of these charges, the annual likelihood of incarceration increases by a statistically significant 60% in the two decades following SSI removal. The costs to taxpayers of enforcement and incarceration from SSI removal are so high that they nearly eliminate the savings to taxpayers from reduced SSI benefits.

10.1093/qje/qjac017.abstractZh: 我们估计了在18岁时失去补充社会保障金对未来二十年内刑事司法和就业结果的影响。为了评估这一影响，我们采用了1996年福利改革法所建立的回归不连续设计，该设计基于18岁时被审查是否获得补充社会保障金资格的可能性。我们通过与刑事司法行政记录系统相关的社会保障管理局数据来检验这一自然实验。研究发现，失去补充社会保障金会使未来二十年内刑事指控的数量显著增加20%。这种指控的增加主要集中在那些以创收为主要动机的犯罪上（增加了60%），尤其是盗窃、入室盗窃、欺诈/伪造和卖淫等犯罪。即使失去补充社会保障金对当时获得该福利的影响逐渐减弱，其对刑事司法参与的影响仍持续了二十多年。失去补充社会保障金后，年轻人被指控犯有非法创收罪的可能性是保持稳定年薪15,000美元就业的两倍。由于这些指控，在失去补充社会保障金后的二十年里，每年被监禁的可能性增加了60%。由于执行和监禁相关费用高昂，这些费用几乎抵消了减少补充社会保障金对纳税人的节省效果。

abstract.text: We describe how sexual harassment contributes to sex segregation and pay inequality in the labor market. Combining nationally representative survey data and administrative data, we show that both harassment and wages vary strongly and systematically across workplaces. Women self-report more harassment from colleagues and managers in male-dominated workplaces where wages are relatively high, and men self-report more harassment in female-dominated workplaces where wages are low. These patterns imply two ways that harassment may contribute to gender inequality. First, harassment deters women and men from applying for jobs in workplaces where they are the gender minority. A survey experiment with hypothetical job choices supports this mechanism. Respondents are highly averse to accepting jobs in workplaces with a higher harassment risk for their own gender, but less averse when people of the opposite sex are at higher risk. A second way that harassment contributes to inequality is by making workplace gender minorities leave their workplaces for new jobs. An analysis of workplace transitions supports this mechanism. Women who self-report harassment are more likely to switch to new workplaces with more female colleagues and lower pay.

10.1093/qje/qjac018.abstractZh: 我们描述了性骚扰如何导致劳动力市场的性别隔离和薪酬不平等。通过结合全国代表性调查数据和行政数据，我们发现骚扰和工资在不同工作场所之间存在强烈且系统的差异。在男性主导且工资较高的工作场所，女性报告自己遭受同事和经理的骚扰较多；而在女性主导且工资较低的工作场所，男性报告自己遭受骚扰较多。这些模式表明，骚扰可能通过两种方式加剧性别不平等。首先，骚扰会阻止女性和男性申请那些以性别少数群体为主的职场工作。一项关于假设性选择的调查实验支持了这一机制：受访者对接受自身性别面临更高骚扰风险的工作场所持强烈反感，但对异性面临更高风险的工作场所的反感则较低。骚扰导致性别少数群体离开现有工作场所去寻求新工作的另一种方式，通过分析职场转型现象可以验证这一机制。报告遭受骚扰的女性更有可能转向那些女性同事较多且工资较低的新工作场所。

abstract.text: Using a randomized experiment with an automobile manufacturing firm in China, we measure the effects of letting workers evaluate their managers on worker and firm outcomes. In the treatment teams, workers evaluate their managers monthly. We find that providing feedback leads to significant reductions in worker turnover and increases in team-level productivity. In addition, workers report higher levels of happiness and well-being. The evidence suggests that these results are driven by learning by managers, leading to changes in their behavior and an overall better relationship between managers and workers.

10.1093/qje/qjac019.abstractZh: 我们在中国的一家汽车制造公司进行了一项随机实验，研究让员工对管理者进行评价对员工和企业绩效的影响。在实验组中，员工每月都会对管理者进行评价。我们发现，提供反馈显著降低了员工流动率，并提高了团队层面的生产力。此外，员工报告的幸福感和满意度也有所提升。这些结果表明，这种评价机制促使管理者进行自我反思，从而改变其行为方式，并改善了管理者与员工之间的关系。

abstract.text: Using 40 countries’ subnational data, we estimate age-specific mortality-temperature relationships and extrapolate them to countries without data today and into a future with climate change. We uncover a U-shaped relationship where extre6me cold and hot temperatures increase mortality rates, especially for the elderly. Critically, this relationship is flattened by higher incomes and adaptation to local climate. Using a revealed-preference approach to recover unobserved adaptation costs, we estimate that the mean global increase in mortality risk due to climate change, accounting for adaptation benefits and costs, is valued at roughly 3.2% of global GDP in 2100 under a high-emissions scenario. Notably, today’s cold locations are projected to benefit, while today’s poor and hot locations have large projected damages. Finally, our central estimates indicate that the release of an additional ton of CO2 today will cause mortality-related damages of $36.6 under a high-emissions scenario, with an interquartile range accounting for both econometric and climate uncertainty of [−$7.8, $73.0]. These empirically grounded estimates exceed the previous literature’s estimates by an order of magnitude.

10.1093/qje/qjac020.abstractZh: 我们利用40个国家的次国家级数据，估计了不同年龄段的死亡率与温度之间的关系，并将这些关系外推到目前没有数据收集的国家，以及未来可能发生气候变化的情景中。我们发现，极端寒冷和炎热的温度都会增加死亡率，尤其是对老年人而言。值得注意的是，较高的收入和对当地气候的适应作用可以缓和这种关系。通过揭示偏好法来估算未观察到的适应成本，我们估计，在高排放情景下，由于气候变化导致的全球平均死亡率增加，考虑到适应带来的收益和成本，其价值约为2100年全球GDP的3.2%。值得注意的是，今天气候寒冷的地区预计会受益，而今天气候恶劣的地区则面临较大的损失。最后，我们的核心估计表明，在高排放情景下，今天额外排放一吨二氧化碳将导致36.6美元的死亡率相关损失，其四分位数范围涵盖了经济计量学和气候不确定性，介于[-7.8, 73.0]美元之间。这些基于实证的估计值比以往文献的估计值高出一个数量级。

abstract.text: We use a field experiment to study price discrimination in a market with price posting and negotiation. Motivated by concerns that low-income consumers do poorly in markets with privately negotiated prices, we built a call center staffed with actors armed with bargaining scripts to reveal negotiated prices and their determinants. Our actors implement sequential bargaining games under incomplete information in the field. By experimentally manipulating how information is revealed, we generate sequences of price offers that allow us to identify price discrimination in negotiations based on retailer perceptions of consumers’ search and switching costs. We also document differences in price distributions between entrants and incumbents, reflecting differences in captivity of their respective consumer bases. Finally, we show that higher prices paid by lower-income subsidy recipients in our market is not due to discriminatory targeting; they can be explained by variation in consumer willingness and ability to search and bargain.

10.1093/qje/qjac021.abstractZh: 我们通过一项实地实验来研究具有价格公布和协商机制的市场中的价格歧视现象。鉴于低收入消费者在私下协商定价的市场中表现不佳的担忧，我们建立了一个呼叫中心，配备有携带协商脚本的演员，以揭示协商价格及其决定因素。我们的演员在实地环境中在不完全信息的情况下实施序列协商博弈。通过实验性地操控信息的披露方式，我们生成了一系列价格提议，从而能够基于零售商对消费者搜索和转换成本的感知，识别出协商中的价格歧视行为。我们还记录了新进入者与现有企业之间价格分布的差异，这反映了它们各自所拥有的消费者基础的差异。最后，我们发现，我们市场中低收入补贴接受者支付更高的价格并非由于歧视性定位；这一现象可以通过消费者愿意支付的价格差异以及搜索和协商能力的变化来解释。

abstract.text: A large literature in cognitive science studies the puzzling “Flynn effect” of rising fluid intelligence (reasoning skill) in rich countries. We develop an economic model in which a cohort’s mix of skills is determined by different skills’ relative returns in the labor market and by the technology for producing skills. We estimate the model using administrative data from Sweden. Combining data from exams taken at military enlistment with earnings records from the tax register, we document an increase in the relative labor market return to logical reasoning skill as compared to vocabulary knowledge. The estimated model implies that changes in labor market returns explain 37% of the measured increase in reasoning skill, and can also explain the decline in knowledge. An original survey of parents, an analysis of trends in school curricula, and an analysis of occupational characteristics show evidence of increasing emphasis on reasoning as compared to knowledge.

10.1093/qje/qjac022.abstractZh: 在认知科学领域，有大量研究关注一个令人困惑的现象——富国中流体智力（推理能力）的上升，即所谓的“弗林效应”。我们开发了一个经济模型，该模型认为一个群体的技能组合是由劳动力市场不同技能的相对回报以及技能培养技术所决定的。我们使用瑞典的行政数据对模型进行了估计。通过结合军事征兵时的考试成绩和税务登记中的收入记录，我们发现与词汇知识相比，逻辑推理能力的相对劳动力市场回报有所提高。估计的模型表明，劳动力市场回报的变化解释了推理能力提升的37%，并且也可以解释知识水平的下降。对家长进行的调查、对学校课程趋势的分析以及对职业特征的分析都表明，与知识相比，对推理能力的重视程度正在增加。

abstract.text: We provide new evidence that cash transfers following the birth of a first child can have large and long-lasting effects on that child’s outcomes. We take advantage of the January 1 birthdate cutoff for U.S. child-related tax benefits, which results in families of otherwise similar children receiving substantially different refunds during the first year of life. For the average low-income single-child family in our sample, this difference amounts to roughly ${\$}$1,300, or 10% of income. Using the universe of administrative federal tax data in selected years, we show that this transfer in infancy increases young adult earnings by at least 1%–2%, with larger effects for males. These effects show up at earlier ages in terms of improved math and reading test scores and a higher likelihood of high-school graduation. The observed effects on shorter-run parental outcomes suggest that additional liquidity during the critical window following the birth of a first child leads to persistent increases in family income that likely contribute to the downstream effects on children’s outcomes. The longer-term effects on child earnings alone are large enough that the transfer pays for itself through subsequent increases in federal income tax revenue.

10.1093/qje/qjac023.abstractZh: 我们提供了新的证据，表明新生儿出生后的现金转移对该孩子的成长结果具有显著且持久的影响。我们利用了美国儿童相关税收福利的出生日期截止日为研究依据，结果发现，在其他方面相似的家庭中，新生儿在生命的第一年所获得的退税金额存在显著差异。对于我们样本中的平均低收入单孩家庭来说，这种差异大约为1300美元，相当于收入的10%。通过选取特定年份的联邦税务数据，我们发现这种婴儿期现金转移至少能使年轻人的收入增加1%至2%，且对男性影响更为显著。这些影响在更早的年龄就能显现出来，表现为数学和阅读测试成绩的提高，以及高中毕业率的提升。观察到的对父母短期结果的影响表明，新生儿出生后的关键时期获得额外的流动性，能够持续增加家庭收入，这很可能有助于后续对孩子成长结果的影响。仅就儿童收入而言，这种长期影响足够显著，使得现金转移所带来的收益能够通过后续增加的联邦所得税收入得到补偿。

abstract.text: We study the results of a massive nationwide correspondence experiment sending more than 83,000 fictitious applications with randomized characteristics to geographically dispersed jobs posted by 108 of the largest U.S. employers. Distinctively Black names reduce the probability of employer contact by 2.1 percentage points relative to distinctively white names. The magnitude of this racial gap in contact rates differs substantially across firms, exhibiting a between-company standard deviation of 1.9 percentage points. Despite an insignificant average gap in contact rates between male and female applicants, we find a between-company standard deviation in gender contact gaps of 2.7 percentage points, revealing that some firms favor male applicants and others favor women. Company-specific racial contact gaps are temporally and spatially persistent, and negatively correlated with firm profitability, federal contractor status, and a measure of recruiting centralization. Discrimination exhibits little geographical dispersion, but two-digit industry explains roughly half of the cross-firm variation in both racial and gender contact gaps. Contact gaps are highly concentrated in particular companies, with firms in the top quintile of racial discrimination responsible for nearly half of lost contacts to Black applicants in the experiment. Controlling false discovery rates to the 5% level, 23 companies are found to discriminate against Black applicants. Our findings establish that discrimination against distinctively Black names is concentrated among a select set of large employers, many of which can be identified with high confidence using large-scale inference methods.

10.1093/qje/qjac024.abstractZh: 我们研究了一项大规模的全国性通信实验的结果，该实验向108家美国最大雇主发布的职位发送了超过83,000份具有随机特征的虚构申请。与纯白人名字相比，具有黑人名字的申请者与雇主联系的概率降低了2.1个百分点。这种种族间联系率的差异在不同公司之间存在显著差异，公司间的标准差达到了1.9个百分点。尽管男性和女性申请者在联系率上的平均差异并不显著，但我们发现性别间的联系率差异在2.7个百分点，这表明有些公司更倾向于招收男性申请者，而另一些公司则更倾向于招收女性申请者。公司特定的种族联系差异在时间和空间上都是持续的，并且与公司的盈利能力、联邦承包商身份以及招聘中心化程度呈负相关。歧视现象在地理上的分散程度较低，但两位数行业分类可以解释大约一半的公司间种族和性别联系差异。联系差异在特定公司中高度集中，在种族歧视最严重的公司中，近一半的黑人申请者联系被丢失。在控制假发现率至5%的水平后，有23家公司被发现存在对黑人申请者的歧视。我们的研究发现表明，对黑人名字的歧视集中在一些大型雇主中，其中许多雇主可以通过大规模推断方法被高度准确地识别出来。

abstract.text: Bottom-up stimulus-driven visual salience is largely automatic, effortless, and independent of a person’s “top-down” perceptual goals; it depends only on features of a visual stimulus. Algorithms have been carefully trained to predict stimulus-driven salience values for each pixel in any image. The economic question we address is whether these salience values help explain economic decisions. Our first experimental analysis shows that when people pick between sets of fruits that have artificially induced value, predicted salience (which is uncorrelated with value by design) leads to mistakes. Our second analysis uses evidence from games in which choices are locations in images. When players are trying to cooperatively match locations, predicted salience is highly correlated with the success of matching (r = .57). In competitive hider-seeker location games, players choose salient locations more often than predicted by the unique Nash equilibrium. This tendency creates a disequilibrium “seeker’s advantage” (seekers win more often than predicted in equilibrium). The result can be explained by level-k models in which predicted stimulus-driven salience influences level-0 choices and thereby influences overall perceptions, beliefs, and choices of higher-level players. The third analysis shows that there is an effect of visual salience in matrix games, but it is small and statistically weak. Applications to behavioral IO, price and tax salience, nudges and design, and visually influenced beliefs are suggested.

10.1093/qje/qjac025.abstractZh: 自下而上的刺激驱动的视觉显著性通常是自动的、无需努力的，并且独立于个人的“自上而下”的感知目标；它仅依赖于视觉刺激的特征。算法被精心训练，能够预测任何图像中每个像素的刺激驱动显著性值。我们探讨的经济学问题是，这些显著性值是否有助于解释经济决策。我们的首次实验分析表明，当人们需要在人工诱导价值的水果集合之间进行选择时，预测的显著性（按设计与价值无关）会导致错误。我们的第二次分析使用了游戏中的证据，其中选择是图像中的位置。当玩家试图合作匹配位置时，预测的显著性与匹配的成功率高度相关（r = 0.57）。在竞争性的隐藏-寻找位置游戏中，玩家选择显著位置的频率高于唯一纳什均衡所预测的频率。这种趋势产生了一种非均衡的“寻找者优势”（寻找者比均衡状态下预测的更常获胜）。这一结果可以通过层次k模型来解释，即预测的刺激驱动显著性影响层次0的选择，从而影响更高层次玩家的整体感知、信念和选择。第三项分析表明，在矩阵游戏中视觉显著性确实存在影响，但这种影响很小且统计上较弱。研究还提出了将这一发现应用于行为式信息交互、价格和税收显著性、劝导与设计以及视觉影响的信念等方面。

abstract.text: Since the beginning of the all-volunteer era, millions of young Americans have chosen to enlist in the military. These volunteers disproportionately come from disadvantaged backgrounds, and while some aspects of military service are likely to be beneficial, exposure to violence and other elements of service could worsen outcomes. This article links the universe of army applicants between 1990 and 2011 to their federal tax records and other administrative data and uses two eligibility thresholds in the Armed Forces Qualification Test (AFQT) in a regression discontinuity design to estimate the effects of army enlistment on earnings and related outcomes. In the 19 years following application, army service increases average annual earnings by over ${\$}$4,000 at both cutoffs. However, whether service increases long-run earnings varies significantly by race. Black servicemembers experience annual gains of ${\$}$5,500 to ${\$}$15,000 11–19 years after applying while white servicemembers do not experience significant changes. By providing Black servicemembers a stable and well-paying army job and by opening doors to higher-paid postservice employment, the army significantly closes the Black-white earnings gap in our sample.

10.1093/qje/qjac026.abstractZh: 自全自愿兵役制度开始以来，数百万美国年轻人选择参军。这些志愿者大多来自弱势背景，虽然军旅生活在某些方面可能有益，但接触暴力和其他军事活动可能会恶化他们的状况。本文将1990年至2011年间申请参军的人群与他们的联邦税务记录及其他行政数据进行了关联，并利用武装部队资格测试中的两个资格门槛，通过回归 discontinuity 设计来估算参军对收入及相关结果的影响。在申请后的19年里，参军在这两个门槛上都使平均年收入增加了超过4000美元。然而，参军是否会增加长期收入因种族而异。黑人军人申请参军后11至19年的年收入增加了5500美元至15000美元，而白人军人则没有显著变化。通过为黑人军人提供稳定且高薪的军队工作，并为他们开启更高薪的退役后就业机会，军队显著缩小了我们样本中的黑人与白人之间的收入差距。

abstract.text: We recast the Aiyagari–Bewley–Huggett model of income and wealth distribution in continuous time. This workhorse model—as well as heterogeneous agent models more generally—then boils down to a system of partial differential equations, a fact we take advantage of to make two types of contributions. First, a number of new theoretical results: (1) an analytic characterization of the consumption and saving behaviour of the poor, particularly their marginal propensities to consume; (2) a closed-form solution for the wealth distribution in a special case with two income types; (3) a proof that there is a unique stationary equilibrium if the intertemporal elasticity of substitution is weakly greater than one. Second, we develop a simple, efficient and portable algorithm for numerically solving for equilibria in a wide class of heterogeneous agent models, including—but not limited to—the Aiyagari–Bewley–Huggett model.

10.1093/restud/rdab002.abstractZh: 我们将Aiyagari–Bewley–Huggett的收入和财富分配模型重新构建为连续时间模型。这一核心模型以及更一般的异质代理人模型最终都可以归结为一组偏微分方程，我们利用这一特性提出了两项贡献。首先，我们得到了一些新的理论成果：(1)对贫困群体的消费和储蓄行为进行了分析性描述，特别是他们对消费的边际倾向；(2)在一种特殊的情况下，给出了财富分配的封闭形式解，该情况涉及两种收入类型；(3)证明了如果跨期替代弹性弱于一，则存在唯一的稳定均衡。其次，我们开发了一种简单、高效且可移植的算法，用于数值求解各类异质代理人模型中的均衡问题，包括但不限于Aiyagari–Bewley–Huggett模型。

abstract.text: Differences in management quality are an important contributor to productivity differences across countries. A key question is how to best improve poor management in developing countries. We test two different approaches to improving management in Colombian auto parts firms. The first uses intensive and expensive one-on-one consulting, while the second draws on agricultural extension approaches to provide consulting to small groups of firms at approximately one-third the cost of the individual approach. Both approaches lead to improvements in management practices of a similar magnitude (8–10 percentage points). The group-based intervention leads to significant increases in firm sales, profits, and labour productivity, while the impacts on firm performance are smaller in magnitude and less robust from the individual consulting. The results point to the potential of group-based approaches as a pathway to scaling up management improvements.

10.1093/restud/rdab005.abstractZh: 管理质量的差异是各国生产力差异的重要成因。一个关键问题是，如何最好地改善发展中国家的管理问题。我们测试了两种改善哥伦比亚汽车零部件企业管理的不同方法。第一种方法是采用密集且昂贵的一对一咨询，而第二种方法则采用农业推广的方法，以大约三分之一的成本为少量企业提供咨询。这两种方法都带来了类似程度的管理实践改进（8-10个百分点）。基于小组的干预措施显著提高了企业的销售额、利润和劳动生产率，而对企业绩效的影响则较小，且不如一对一咨询那样稳定。这些结果表明，基于小组的方法有可能成为扩大管理改进规模的途径。

abstract.text: Time series methods for identifying structural economic disturbances often require disturbances to satisfy technical conditions that can be inconsistent with economic theory. We propose replacing these conditions with a less restrictive condition called recoverability, which only requires that the disturbances can be inferred from the observable variables. As an application, we show how shifting attention to recoverability makes it possible to construct new identifying restrictions for technological and expectational disturbances. In a vector autoregressive example using post-war U.S. data, these restrictions imply that independent disturbances to expectations about future technology are a major driver of business cycles.

10.1093/restud/rdab010.abstractZh: 用于识别结构性经济干扰的时间序列方法通常需要干扰满足一些技术条件，而这些条件可能与经济理论不符。我们提出用一种较为宽松的条件来替代这些条件，即“可恢复性”，该条件仅要求可以从可观测变量中推断出这些干扰。作为一个应用实例，我们展示了将注意力转向可恢复性如何使得我们能够为技术和预期干扰构建新的识别限制条件。在一个使用战后美国数据的向量自回归示例中，这些限制条件表明，对未来技术的独立预期干扰是商业周期的主要驱动因素。

abstract.text: We propose and axiomatize the categorical thinking model (CTM) in which the framing of the decision problem affects how agents categorize alternatives, that in turn affects their evaluation of it. Prominent models of salience, status quo bias, loss-aversion, inequality aversion, and present bias all fit under the umbrella of CTM. This suggests categorization is an underlying mechanism of key departures from the neoclassical model of choice. We specialize CTM to provide a behavioural foundation for the salient thinking model of Bordalo et al. (2013, Journal of Political Economy, 121, 803–843) that highlights its strong predictions and distinctions from other models.

10.1093/restud/rdab011.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种分类思维模型（CTM），该模型认为决策问题的框架会影响代理人对备选方案的分类，而这一分类又会影响他们对备选方案的评估。关于显著性、现状偏好、损失厌恶、不平等厌恶以及当前偏好等模型，都可以归入CTM的框架之下。这表明分类是区别于新古典选择模型的关键机制之一。我们进一步将CTM应用于Bordalo等人（2013年，《政治经济学杂志》，121卷，803-843页）提出的显著性思维模型，为这一模型提供了行为学基础，并凸显了该模型与其他模型的显著预测和区别。

abstract.text: Using a quantitative model that features technical progress in automation and endogenous skill choice, we show that, given the current U.S. tax system, a sustained fall in automation costs can lead to a massive rise in income inequality. We characterize the optimal tax system in this model. We find that it is optimal to tax robots while the current generations of routine workers, who can no longer move to non-routine occupations, are active in the labour force. Once these workers retire, optimal robot taxes are zero.

10.1093/restud/rdab019.abstractZh: 我们采用一个定量模型，该模型以自动化技术进步和内生技能选择为特点，研究表明，在当前的美国税收体系下，自动化成本的持续下降会导致收入不平等的显著加剧。我们对该模型中的最优税收体系进行了分析。研究发现，在当前的常规工人无法转向非常规职业的情况下，对机器人征税是最优的。一旦这些工人退休，对机器人的最优税收为零。

abstract.text: We study a class of permutation tests of the randomness of a collection of Bernoulli sequences and their application to analyses of the human tendency to perceive streaks of consecutive successes as overly representative of positive dependence—the hot hand fallacy. In particular, we study permutation tests of the null hypothesis of randomness (i.e. that trials are i.i.d.) based on test statistics that compare the proportion of successes that directly follow $k$ consecutive successes with either the overall proportion of successes or the proportion of successes that directly follow $k$ consecutive failures. We characterize the asymptotic distributions of these test statistics and their permutation distributions under randomness, under a set of general stationary processes, and under a class of Markov chain alternatives, which allow us to derive their local asymptotic power. The results are applied to evaluate the empirical support for the hot hand fallacy provided by four controlled basketball shooting experiments. We establish that substantially larger data sets are required to derive an informative measurement of the deviation from randomness in basketball shooting. In one experiment, for which we were able to obtain data, multiple testing procedures reveal that one shooter exhibits a shooting pattern significantly inconsistent with randomness—supplying strong evidence that basketball shooting is not random for all shooters all of the time. However, we find that the evidence against randomness in this experiment is limited to this shooter. Our results provide a mathematical and statistical foundation for the design and validation of experiments that directly compare deviations from randomness with human beliefs about deviations from randomness and thereby constitute a direct test of the hot hand fallacy.

10.1093/restud/rdab020.abstractZh: 我们研究了一类用于检验一组伯努利序列的随机性的排列检验方法，以及这些方法在分析人们将连续成功事件视为正面依赖现象倾向中的应用。具体来说，我们研究了基于检验统计量的排列检验方法，这些统计量比较了在连续成功$k$次之后直接出现的成功次数与整体成功比例或连续失败$k$次之后直接出现的成功次数。我们描述了这些检验统计量在随机性假设下的渐近分布，以及在一组一般平稳过程下的排列分布，并在一类马尔可夫链替代假设下得到了局部渐近功效的推导。这些结果被应用于评估四个受控篮球投篮实验所提供的关于“热手谬误”的经验支持。我们发现，要准确测量篮球投篮中偏离随机性的程度，需要更大的数据集。在一个实验中，我们能够获取数据，多重检验程序显示有一位投篮者的投篮模式与随机性明显不符，这提供了强有力的证据，表明并非所有投篮者的投篮行为都是随机的。然而，我们发现，在这个实验中，反对随机性的证据仅限于这位投篮者。我们的研究结果为设计和验证直接比较随机性偏差与人类对随机性偏差认知的实验提供了数学和统计基础，从而直接检验了“热手谬误”。

abstract.text: We document that an experimental intervention offering transport subsidies for poor rural households to migrate seasonally in Bangladesh improved risk sharing. A theoretical model of endogenous migration and risk sharing shows that the effect of subsidizing migration depends on the underlying economic environment. If migration is risky, a temporary subsidy can induce an improvement in risk sharing and enable profitable migration. We estimate the model and find that the migration experiment increased welfare by 12.9%. Counterfactual analysis suggests that a permanent, rather than temporary, decline in migration costs in the same environment would result in a reduction in risk sharing.

10.1093/restud/rdab021.abstractZh: 我们记录了一种实验性干预措施，即为贫困农村家庭提供交通补贴，以促使他们季节性迁移到孟加拉国，从而改善了风险分担。一个关于内生迁移与风险分担的理论模型表明，补贴迁移的效果取决于潜在的经济环境。如果迁移存在风险，临时性的补贴可以提升风险分担，并促进盈利性迁移。我们对该模型进行了估算，发现迁移实验使福利增加了12.9%。反事实分析表明，如果在同一环境下迁移成本永久性地下降，而非暂时性地下降，那么风险分担将会减少。

abstract.text: We study a coordination game among agents in a network. The agents choose whether to take action (e.g. adopting a new technology) in an uncertain environment that yields increasing value in the actions of neighbours. We develop an algorithm that fully partitions the network into communities (coordination sets) within which agents have the same propensity to adopt. Our main finding is that a novel measure of network connectedness, which we term “social connectedness,” determines the propensity to adopt for each agent. Social connectedness captures both the number of links each agent has within her community (interconnectedness) as well as the number of links she has with members of other communities who have a higher propensity to adopt (embeddedness). There is a single coordination set if and only if the network is balanced—that is, the average degree of each subnetwork is no larger than the average degree of the network. Finally, we demonstrate that contagion is localized within coordination sets, such that a shock to an agent uniformly affects this agent and all members of her coordination set but has no impact on the other agents in the network.

10.1093/restud/rdab022.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个网络中代理之间的协调博弈。代理们在不确定的环境中选择是否采取行动（例如采用新技术），而邻居的行动会带来递增的价值。我们开发了一种算法，可以将网络完全划分为多个社区（协调集），在这些社区中，代理们具有相同的采纳倾向。我们的主要发现是，一种新颖的网络连通性度量方法，我们称之为“社会连通性”，决定了每个代理的采纳倾向。社会连通性既反映了每个代理在其社区内的链接数量（相互连通性），也反映了她与其他具有更高采纳倾向的社区成员之间的链接数量（嵌入性）。只有当网络是平衡的时，才存在一个协调集——即每个子网络的平均度都不大于网络的平均度。最后，我们证明了传染效应是局限在协调集内的，即一个代理受到冲击时，会均匀影响该代理及其所有协调集的成员，而不会影响网络中的其他代理。

abstract.text: This article generalizes central results from the theory of (endogenously) directed technical change to settings where technology does not take a labour-augmenting form and with arbitrarily many levels of skill. Building on simple notions of complementarity, the results remain intuitive despite their generality. The developed theory allows to study the endogenous determination of labour-replacing, that is, automation technology through the lens of directed technical change theory. In an assignment model with a continuum of differentially skilled workers and capital, where capital perfectly substitutes for labour in the production of tasks, any increase in the relative supply of skilled workers stimulates investment into improving the productivity of capital, potentially leading skill premia to increase in relative skill supply. Relatedly, trade with a skill-scarce country discourages improvements in capital productivity, potentially reversing the standard Heckscher–Ohlin effects.

10.1093/restud/rdab025.abstractZh: 本文将关于（内生性）技术变革理论的核心成果推广到技术不以劳动增强形式存在的情况，并且可以适用于任意多层次的技能水平。基于互补性的简单概念，这些结果尽管具有普遍性，但仍然易于理解。所发展的理论允许我们通过技术变革理论来研究替代劳动的自动化技术的内生决定机制。在一个包含连续多个不同技能水平的工人和资本的模型中，当资本在任务生产中完全替代劳动力时，任何熟练工人相对供应的增加都会刺激对资本生产力的改进投资，从而可能导致熟练劳动力的相对供应增加。与此相关的是，与技能稀缺国家的贸易会抑制资本生产力的提升，从而可能逆转标准的赫克歇尔-俄林效应。

abstract.text: Unemployment insurance (UI) programs traditionally take the form of a single insurance contract offered to job seekers. In this work, we show that offering a menu of contracts can be welfare improving in the presence of adverse selection and moral hazard. When insurance contracts are composed of (1) a UI payment and (2) a severance payment paid at the onset of unemployment, offering contracts with different ratios of UI benefits to severance payment is optimal under the equivalent of a single-crossing condition: job seekers in higher need of unemployment insurance should be less prone to moral hazard. In that setting, a menu allows the planner to attract job seekers with a high need for insurance in a contract with generous UI benefits, and to attract job seekers most prone to moral hazard in a separate contract with a large severance payment but little unemployment insurance. We propose a simple sufficient statistics approach to test the single-crossing condition in the data.

10.1093/restud/rdab026.abstractZh: 失业保险（UI）计划传统上采取向求职者提供单一保险合同的形式。本研究表明，在存在逆向选择和道德风险的情况下，提供多种合同方案可以提高福利水平。当保险合同包含（1）失业保险金和（2）失业时支付的补偿金时，在“单一交叉条件”下，提供不同比例的失业保险金与补偿金组合的合同是最优的：即对更需要失业保险的求职者来说，道德风险要小。在这种环境下，多种合同方案允许规划者吸引那些需要高额失业保险金的求职者签订包含丰厚失业保险金的合同，同时吸引那些容易面临道德风险的求职者签订包含高额补偿金但失业保险金较少的合同。我们提出了一种简单的充分统计量方法，用于数据验证“单一交叉条件”。

abstract.text: We study rules based on instruments versus targets. Our application is a New Keynesian economy where the central bank has non-contractible information about aggregate demand shocks and cannot commit to policy. Incentives are provided to the central bank via punishment which is socially costly. Instrument-based rules condition incentives on the central bank’s observable choice of policy, whereas target-based rules condition incentives on the outcomes of policy, such as inflation, which depend on both the policy choice and realized shocks. We show that the optimal rule within each class takes a threshold form, imposing the worst punishment upon violation. Target-based rules dominate instrument-based rules if and only if the central bank’s information is sufficiently precise, and they are relatively more attractive the less severe the central bank’s commitment problem. The optimal unconstrained rule relaxes the instrument threshold whenever the target threshold is satisfied.

10.1093/restud/rdab027.abstractZh: 我们研究了基于工具而非目标的规则。我们的研究对象是新凯恩斯主义经济模型，在这种模型中，中央银行拥有关于总需求冲击的非契约性信息，因此无法做出明确的政策承诺。通过社会成本较高的惩罚措施，为中央银行提供激励。基于工具的规则将激励条件与中央银行可观察到的政策选择挂钩，而基于目标的规则则将激励条件与政策结果（如通货膨胀）挂钩，这些结果既取决于政策选择，也取决于实际发生的冲击。我们表明，每一类最优规则都采用阈值形式，对违规行为施加最严厉的惩罚。如果中央银行的信息足够精确，基于目标的规则就会优于基于工具的规则；而且，当中央银行的承诺问题较为轻微时，基于目标的规则相对更具吸引力。当满足目标阈值时，最优的无约束规则会放宽工具阈值的限制。

abstract.text: We study the long-term impact of a policy-driven change in childhood nutrition. For this purpose, we evaluate a program that rolled out nutritious school lunches free of charge to all pupils in Swedish primary schools between 1959 and 1969. We estimate the impact of the program on children’s economic, educational, and health outcomes throughout life. Our results show that the school lunch program generated substantial long-term benefits, where pupils exposed to the program during their entire primary school period have 3% higher lifetime income. The effect was greater for pupils that were exposed at earlier ages and for pupils from poor households, suggesting that the program reduced socioeconomic inequalities in adulthood. Exposure to the program also had substantial effects on educational attainment and health, which can explain a large part of the effect of the program on lifetime income.

10.1093/restud/rdab028.abstractZh: 我们研究了政策驱动的儿童营养改革对长期影响的研究。为此，我们评估了一项在1959年至1969年间向瑞典所有小学生免费提供营养餐的计划。我们估算了该计划对儿童经济、教育和健康结果的影响。研究结果表明，这项学校午餐计划带来了显著的长期效益，参与该计划的小学生在整个小学阶段，其终身收入高出3%。对于在更早年龄开始参与该计划的学生以及来自贫困家庭的学生来说，这种效应更为明显，这表明该计划减少了成年后的社会经济不平等。参与该计划还对教育成就和健康产生了显著影响，这些影响可以解释该计划对终身收入影响的大部分原因。

abstract.text: This article argues that an important, yet overlooked, determinant of the government spending multiplier is the direction of the fiscal intervention. Regardless of whether we identify government spending shocks from (1) a narrative approach or (2) a timing restriction, we find that the contractionary multiplier—the multiplier associated with a negative shock to government spending—is above 1 and largest in times of economic slack. In contrast, the expansionary multiplier—the multiplier associated with a positive shock—is substantially below 1 regardless of the state of the cycle. These results help understand seemingly conflicting results in the literature. A simple theoretical model with incomplete financial markets and downward nominal wage rigidities can rationalize our findings.

10.1093/restud/rdab029.abstractZh: 本文认为，政府支出乘数的一个重要但被忽视的决定因素是财政干预的方向。无论我们是从（1）叙事方法还是（2）时间限制来识别政府支出冲击，我们发现，与政府支出负面冲击相关的收缩性乘数大于1，并且在经济疲软时期最大。相比之下，与正面冲击相关的扩张性乘数则明显低于1，无论经济周期处于何种状态。这些结果有助于解释文献中看似矛盾的结果。一个简单理论模型，该模型假设金融市场不完善且名义工资具有向下刚性，可以合理解释我们的发现。

abstract.text: Many studies use shift-share (or "Bartik") instruments, which average a set of shocks with exposure share weights. We provide a new econometric framework for shift-share instrumental variable (SSIV) regressions in which identification follows from the quasi-random assignment of shocks, while exposure shares are allowed to be endogenous. The framework is motivated by an equivalence result: the orthogonality between a shift-share instrument and an unobserved residual can be represented as the orthogonality between the underlying shocks and a shock-level unobservable. SSIV regression coefficients can similarly be obtained from an equivalent shock-level regression, motivating shock-level conditions for their consistency. We discuss and illustrate several practical insights of this framework in the setting of Autor et al. (2013), estimating the effect of Chinese import competition on manufacturing employment across U.S. commuting zones.

10.1093/restud/rdab030.abstractZh: 许多研究使用移位-分享（或“Bartik”）工具，该工具通过暴露份额权重对一系列冲击进行平均处理。我们提出了一种新的计量经济学框架，用于移位-分享工具变量回归，其中识别性源于冲击的准随机分配，而暴露份额则被允许是内生的。该框架的动机源于一个等价性结果：移位-分享工具与未观测残差之间的正交性，可以表示为基础冲击与某一冲击水平上的不可观测变量之间的正交性。移位-分享工具变量回归系数也可以从等效的冲击水平回归中得出，这为它们的连贯性提供了冲击水平条件。我们讨论了并在Autor等人（2013年）的案例中展示了该框架的几个实际应用见解，该案例研究了中国进口竞争对美国各通勤区域制造业就业的影响。

abstract.text: We argue theoretically and document empirically that aging leads to greater (industrial) automation, because it creates a shortage of middle-aged workers specializing in manual production tasks.
