We show that demographic change is associated with greater adoption of robots and other automation technologies across countries and with more robotics-related activities across U.S. commuting zones. We also document more automation innovation in countries undergoing faster aging. Our directed technological change model predicts that the response of automation technologies to aging should be more pronounced in industries that rely more on middle-aged workers and those that present greater opportunities for automation and that productivity should improve and the labor share should decline relatively in industries that are more amenable to automation. The evidence supports all four of these predictions.

10.1093/restud/rdab031.abstractZh: 我们从理论上进行了论证，并通过实证数据证明了老龄化会导致更高的工业自动化水平，因为这一现象会导致从事手工生产任务的中年工人短缺。我们发现，人口结构的变化与各国对机器人及其他自动化技术的更大采用率相关，同时与美国各通勤区域与机器人相关的活动增加有关。我们还发现，在老龄化进程较快的国家，自动化技术创新更为活跃。我们的技术变革模型预测，自动化技术对老龄化的响应在那些更依赖中年工人的行业以及那些为自动化提供更大机会的行业中更为显著，而在那些更适合自动化的行业中，生产力应有所提高，而劳动力份额则相对下降。这些证据支持了上述所有预测。

abstract.text: This article develops a heterogeneous firm-dynamics model to jointly study firms’ currency debt composition and investment choices. In our model, foreign currency borrowing arises from a dynamic trade-off between exposure to currency risk and growth. The model endogenously generates selection of productive firms into foreign currency borrowing. Among them, firms with high marginal product of capital use foreign loans more intensively. We assess econometrically the model’s predicted pattern of foreign currency borrowing using firm-level census data from the deregulation of these loans in Hungary, calibrate the model, and quantify the aggregate impact of this financing. Our counterfactual exercises show that understanding the characteristics of firms borrowing in foreign currency is critical to assess the aggregate consequences of this financing.

10.1093/restud/rdab032.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个异质企业动态模型，用于共同研究企业的货币债务构成和投资决策。在我们的模型中，外币借款源于对货币风险敞口与增长之间的动态权衡。该模型内生地决定了哪些生产性企业会选择外币借款。其中，资本边际产出较高的企业会更多地使用外币贷款。我们通过匈牙利外币贷款放松管制期间的企业级普查数据，对模型预测的外币借款模式进行了经济计量学评估，并对模型进行了校准，同时量化了这种融资方式的总体影响。我们的反事实分析表明，了解企业外币借款的特点对于评估这种融资方式的总体后果至关重要。

abstract.text: We develop a model where risk-averse workers can costly invest in their skills before matching with heterogenous firms. At the investment stage, workers face multiple sources of risk. They are uncertain about how skilled they will turn out and also about their income shock realizations at the time of employment. We analyse the equilibria of two versions of the model that depend on when uncertainty resolves, which determines the available risk-sharing possibilities between workers and firms. We provide a thorough analysis of equilibrium comparative statics regarding changes in risk, worker and firm heterogeneity, and technology. We derive conditions on the match output function and risk attitudes under which these shifts lead to more investment and show how this affects matching and wages. To illustrate the applied relevance of our theory, we provide a stylized quantitative assessment of the model and analyse the sources (risk, heterogeneity, or technology) of rising U.S. wage inequality. We find that changes in risk were the most important driver behind the surge in inequality, followed by technological change. We show that these conclusions are significantly altered if one neglects the key feature of our model, which is that educational investment is endogenous.

10.1093/restud/rdab033.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个模型，在这个模型中，风险厌恶的劳动者可以在与不同企业匹配之前，花费成本提升自身技能。在投资阶段，劳动者面临多种风险。他们对自身的技能水平以及就业时的收入冲击结果都持不确定性态度。我们分析了该模型两个版本的平衡态，这些版本取决于不确定性何时解决，这决定了劳动者与企业之间可用的风险分担可能性。我们对平衡态的静态比较分析进行了深入研究，涉及风险变化、劳动者与企业的异质性以及技术因素。我们推导出了匹配产出函数和风险态度的一些条件，这些条件决定了这些变化如何促进投资，并分析了这对匹配过程和工资的影响。为了说明我们理论的应用价值，我们对该模型进行了一种定性的定量评估，并分析了导致美国工资不平等加剧的原因（风险、异质性或技术因素）。我们发现，风险变化是导致不平等加剧的最重要因素，其次是技术变革。我们指出，如果忽略我们模型的一个关键特征——教育投资是内生性的，那么这些结论将会发生显著变化。

abstract.text: The proportion of U.K. people with university degrees tripled between 1993 and 2015. However, over the same period the time trend in the college wage premium has been extraordinarily flat. We show that these patterns cannot be explained by composition changes. Instead, we present a model in which firms choose between centralized and decentralized organizational forms and demonstrate that it can explain the main patterns. We also show the model has implications that differentiate it from both the exogenous skill-biased technological change model and the endogenous invention model, and that U.K. data fit with those implications. The result is a consistent picture of the transformation of the U.K. labour market in the last two decades.

10.1093/restud/rdab034.abstractZh: 在1993年至2015年间，拥有大学学位的英国人的比例增加了两倍。然而，在同一时期，大学工资溢价的时间趋势却异常平稳。我们发现，这些现象无法用结构变化来解释。相反，我们提出了一个模型，该模型描述了企业在集中式与分散式组织形式之间的选择，并证明该模型能够解释主要现象。我们还指出，该模型具有一些特性，使其区别于外生性技能偏向性技术变革模型和内生性创新模型，而英国的数据也符合这些特性。这一结果描绘了过去二十年英国劳动力市场转型的连贯图景。

abstract.text: Using a broad panel of advanced economies, we document that increases in GDP per capita are associated with a systematic shift in the composition of value added to sectors that are intensive in high-skill labour, a process we label as skill-biased structural change. It follows that further development in these economies leads to an increase in the relative demand for skilled labour. We develop a quantitative two-sector model of this process as a laboratory to assess the sources of the rise of the skill premium in the U.S. and a set of ten other advanced economies, over the period 1977 to 2005. For the U.S., we find that the sector-specific skill neutral component of technical change accounts for 18–24% of the overall increase of the skill premium due to technical change, and that the mechanism through which this component of technical change affects the skill premium is via skill-biased structural change.

10.1093/restud/rdab035.abstractZh: 通过广泛选取多个发达经济体进行研究，我们发现人均GDP的增加与附加值构成向那些需要高技能劳动力的部门的系统性转变相关，我们将这一过程称为“技能偏向性结构变化”。因此，这些经济体的进一步发展会导致对熟练劳动力的相对需求增加。我们建立了一个两部门定量模型来研究这一过程，以评估1977年至2005年间美国及其他十个发达经济体中技能溢价上升的成因。对于美国而言，我们发现技术变革中特定于行业的技能中性成分占技术变革导致的技能溢价总体增长的18%至24%，而这一技术变革成分影响技能溢价的方式是通过技能偏向性结构变化。

abstract.text: We show that the creation of the first integrated multi-modal pan-European transport network during Roman times influences economic integration over two millennia. Drawing on spatially highly disaggregated data on excavated Roman ceramics, we document that contemporary interregional trade was influenced by connectivity within the network. Today, these connectivity differentials continue to influence integration as approximated by cross-regional firm investment behaviour. Continuity is partly explained by selective infrastructure routing and cultural integration due to bilateral convergence in preferences and values. We show that our results are Roman-connectivity specific and do not reflect pre-existing patterns of exchange using pre-Roman trade data.

10.1093/restud/rdab036.abstractZh: 我们表明，罗马时代首个整合性的多模态泛欧运输网络的建立，对两千多年的经济一体化产生了影响。通过研究挖掘出的罗马陶瓷制品的空间分布数据，我们发现当时的区域间贸易受到网络内部连通性的影响。如今，这种连通性的差异仍然影响着一体化进程，这一点可以通过跨区域的公司投资行为来体现。这种连续性部分可以通过选择性的基础设施布局以及由于偏好和价值观的双向趋同而实现的文化融合来解释。我们的研究结果仅适用于罗马时代的连通性特征，并不反映使用罗马前贸易数据所揭示的现有交换模式。

abstract.text: How does the arrival of a new minority group affect the social acceptance and outcomes of existing minorities? We study this question in the context of the First Great Migration. Between 1915 and 1930, 1.5 million African Americans moved from the U.S. South to Northern urban centres, which were home to millions of European immigrants arrived in previous decades. We formalize and empirically test the hypothesis that the inflows of Black Americans changed perceptions of outgroup distance among native-born whites, reducing the barriers to the social integration of European immigrants. Predicting Black in-migration with a version of the shift-share instrument, we find that immigrants living in areas that received more Black migrants experienced higher assimilation along a range of outcomes, such as naturalization rates and intermarriages with native-born spouses. Evidence from the historical press and patterns of heterogeneity across immigrant nationalities provide additional support to the role of shifting perceptions of the white majority.

10.1093/restud/rdab038.abstractZh: 新来的少数群体如何影响现有少数群体的社会接纳度和生活状况？我们在第一次大规模迁移的背景下研究了这个问题。在1915年至1930年间，有150万非裔美国人从美国南部迁移到北方城市中心，这些地区之前已经接纳了数百万欧洲移民。我们提出了这样一个假设：非裔美国人的涌入改变了当地白人对于外来群体的认知，从而降低了欧洲移民融入社会的障碍。通过运用转移分享工具模型来预测非裔移民的迁移情况，我们发现居住在接收更多非裔移民地区的白人，在归化率以及与本地白人配偶通婚等方面，其社会融合程度更高。历史文献的记录和不同移民国籍之间的差异性也进一步支持了这种认知转变对白人主流群体影响的观点。

abstract.text: This article proposes a test for the conditional superior predictive ability (CSPA) of a family of forecasting methods with respect to a benchmark. The test is functional in nature: under the null hypothesis, the benchmark’s conditional expected loss is no more than those of the competitors, uniformly across all conditioning states. By inverting the CSPA tests for a set of benchmarks, we obtain confidence sets for the uniformly most superior method. The econometric inference pertains to testing conditional moment inequalities for time series data with general serial dependence, and we justify its asymptotic validity using a uniform non-parametric inference method based on a new strong approximation theory for mixingales. The usefulness of the method is demonstrated in empirical applications on volatility and inflation forecasting.

10.1093/restud/rdab039.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种针对一组预测方法的条件 Superior 预测能力（CSPA）的测试，以评估其相对于一个基准方法的优越性。该测试具有功能性：在零假设下，基准方法的条件期望损失不会超过竞争对手的方法，且这一结论在所有条件状态下都是一致的。通过对一组基准方法进行 CSPA 测试的逆运算，我们可以获得最优越方法的置信区间。该计量经济学推断方法用于检验具有一般序列依赖性的时间序列数据的条件矩不等式，并且我们使用基于混合序数新强逼近理论的统一非参数推断方法证明了其渐近有效性。该方法在波动性和通货膨胀预测的实际应用中的有效性得到了验证。

abstract.text: We estimate the causal real economic effects of a randomized anti-corruption crackdown on local governments in Brazil using rich micro-data on corruption and firms. After anti-corruption audits, municipalities experience an increase in the number of firms concentrated in sectors most dependent on government relationships and public procurement. Through the estimation of geographic spillovers and additional tests, we show that audits operate via both a direct detection effect as well as through indirect deterrence channels. Politically connected firms suffer after the audits. Our estimates indicate the anti-corruption program generates significant local multipliers which are consistent with the presence of a large corruption tax on government-dependent firms.

10.1093/restud/rdab040.abstractZh: 我们利用关于腐败和企业的丰富微观数据，估算了巴西地方政府在随机反腐败行动中的实际经济效应。在反腐败审计之后，市政当局发现，更多企业集中在那些最依赖政府关系及公共采购的行业中。通过估算地理溢出效应并进行额外测试，我们发现审计通过直接检测效应以及间接威慑渠道发挥作用。与政治关系密切的企业在审计后受到负面影响。我们的估算表明，反腐败计划产生了显著的局部乘数效应，这与政府对依赖政府的企业征收高额腐败税的情况一致。

abstract.text: About half of the change in U.S. non-durable consumption expenditure is due to changes in the products entering households’ consumption basket (the extensive margin). Changes in the basket are driven by fluctuations in the rate at which households add products; removals fluctuate little. These patterns reflect that, in response to income increases, households adopt consumer products already available in the market. Household adoption amplifies the effects of fiscal transfers on consumption by more than 30%. Cyclical household adoption of products also implies that inflation measures based on a representative household consuming all varieties available in the market underestimate true household-level inflation by as much as 1% per year over the Great Recession in the consumption categories covered by our data.

10.1093/restud/rdab041.abstractZh: 美国非耐用消费支出的变化中，约有一半是由于家庭消费篮子中商品的变化所导致的（即广度边际）。消费篮子的变化是由家庭增加商品的速度波动所驱动的；而商品移除的波动则较小。这些模式反映出，在收入增加的情况下，家庭会采用市场上已有的消费品。家庭对产品的采用使财政转移对消费的影响放大了30%以上。周期性家庭对产品的采用还意味着，基于一个消费市场上所有种类商品的代表性家庭所计算的通胀指标，在大衰退期间，对于我们所研究的数据范围内的消费类别而言，每年会低估真实家庭层面的通胀水平达1%。

abstract.text: The discovery of massive deposits of precious metals in America during the early modern period caused an exogenous monetary injection to Europe’s money supply. I use this episode to identify the causal effects of money. Using a panel of six European countries, I find that monetary expansions had a material impact on real economic activity. The magnitudes are substantial and persist for a long time: an exogenous 10% increase in the production of precious metals in America measured relative to the European stock leads to a front-loaded response of output and, to a lesser extent, inflation. There was a positive hump-shaped response of real GDP, with a cumulative increase up to 0.9% six to nine years later. The evidence suggests that this is because prices responded to monetary injections with considerable lags.

10.1093/restud/rdab042.abstractZh: 在近代早期，美洲发现了大量贵金属矿藏，这导致欧洲货币供应量出现了外源性注入。我利用这一事件来研究货币的因果效应。通过对六个欧洲国家的分析，我发现货币扩张对实际经济活动产生了实质性影响。这种影响非常显著，并且持续了很长时间：相对于欧洲整体水平，美洲贵金属产量的外源性增加10%会导致产出出现先升后降的反应，通货膨胀的影响则相对较小。实际GDP出现了积极的驼峰状反应，在六到九年后累计增长了0.9%。证据表明，这是因为价格对货币注入的反应存在相当大的滞后现象。

abstract.text: Many intertemporal trade-offs are unbalanced: while the advantages of options are concentrated in a few periods, the disadvantages are dispersed over numerous periods. We provide novel experimental evidence for “concentration bias,” the tendency to overweight advantages that are concentrated in time. Subjects commit to too much overtime work that is dispersed over multiple days in exchange for a bonus that is concentrated in time: concentration bias increases subjects’ willingness to work by 22.4% beyond what standard discounting models could account for. In additional conditions and a complementary experiment involving monetary payments, we study the mechanisms behind concentration bias and demonstrate the robustness of our findings.

10.1093/restud/rdab043.abstractZh: 许多跨时间期的权衡是不平衡的：虽然期权的优势集中在少数时期，但劣势则分散在多个时期。我们提供了关于“集中偏差”的新实验证据，即倾向于高估那些在时间上集中的优势。实验对象为了获得集中在某一时期的奖金，不得不承担在多个日子里分散的加班工作：集中偏差使实验对象的工作意愿增加了22.4%，这一增加超出了标准折现模型所能解释的范围。在额外的条件下，并通过涉及货币支付的补充实验，我们研究了集中偏差背后的机制，并证明了我们发现的稳健性。

abstract.text: This article studies the transmission of the Global Financial Cycle (GFC) to domestic credit market conditions in a large emerging market, Turkey, over 2003–13. We use administrative data covering the universe of corporate credit transactions matched to bank balance sheets to document four facts: (1) an easing in global financial conditions leads to lower borrowing costs and an increase in local lending; (2) domestic banks more exposed to international capital markets transmit the GFC locally; (3) the fall in local currency borrowing costs is larger than foreign currency borrowing costs due to the co-movement of the uncovered interest rate parity (UIP) premium with the GFC over time; (4) data on posted collateral for new loan issuances show that collateral constraints do not relax during the boom phase of the GFC.

10.1093/restud/rdab044.abstractZh: 本文研究了全球金融周期对土耳其这一大型新兴市场经济体国内信贷市场状况的影响，研究时间跨度为2003年至2013年。我们利用了涵盖企业信贷交易数据的行政数据，并结合银行资产负债表进行验证，得出了四个结论：(1)全球金融状况的缓和导致借贷成本降低，同时本地信贷活动增加；(2)更依赖国际资本市场的国内银行更容易受到全球金融周期的影响；(3)由于未覆盖的利率平价溢价与全球金融周期同步变动，本地货币借贷成本的下降幅度大于外币借贷成本；(4)关于新贷款发放时抵押品情况的数据表明，在全球金融周期繁荣阶段，抵押品限制并未放松。

abstract.text: We study the effects of parameter uncertainty prompted by structural breaks. In our model, agents respond differently to uncertainty prompted by regime shifts in shock processes than they react to comparable perceived increases in shock volatility. The magnitude of the response to an increase in uncertainty about TFP associated with a structural break is greater than that of a response to a comparable perceived rise in volatility. This is because lifetime utility varies more when shocks shift beliefs and perceived wealth.

10.1093/restud/rdab045.abstractZh: 我们研究了由结构突变引发的参数不确定性所带来的影响。在我们的模型中，代理人对由冲击过程中的制度变化引发的不确定性反应与他们对可感知的冲击波动性的增加所做出的反应不同。对于与结构突变相关的全要素生产率不确定性增加的响应幅度，大于对可感知的波动性上升的响应幅度。这是因为当冲击改变信念和感知的财富时，终身效用会发生变化。

abstract.text: We develop a new theory of information production during credit booms. Entrepreneurs need credit to undertake investment projects, some of which enable them to divert resources. Lenders can protect themselves from such diversion in two ways: collateralization, and costly screening that generates durable information about projects. In equilibrium, the collateralization-screening mix depends on the value of aggregate collateral. High collateral values make it possible to reallocate resources towards productive projects, but they also crowd out screening. This has important dynamic implications. During credit booms driven by high collateral values (e.g. real estate booms), economic activity expands but the economy’s stock of information on existing projects gets depleted. As a result, collateral-driven booms end in deep crises and slow recoveries: when booms end, investment is constrained both by the lack of collateral and by the lack of information on existing projects, which takes time to rebuild. We provide empirical support for the mechanism using US firm-level data.

10.1093/restud/rdab046.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于信贷繁荣时期信息产生的新理论。企业家需要信贷来开展投资项目，其中一些项目能够使他们转移资源。贷款方可以通过两种方式来防范这种资源转移：一种是抵押，另一种则是成本高昂的筛选过程，后者能够生成关于项目的持久性信息。在均衡状态下，抵押与筛选的结合方式取决于总抵押品的价值。高抵押品价值使得资源可以重新分配到生产性项目中，但同时也抑制了筛选行为。这一机制具有重要的动态影响。在由高抵押品价值驱动的信贷繁荣时期（例如房地产繁荣期），经济活动会扩张，但关于现有项目的经济信息会枯竭。因此，以抵押品驱动的繁荣最终会导致严重的危机和缓慢的复苏：当繁荣结束时，投资会受到缺乏抵押品和缺乏关于现有项目的信息的限制，这些信息需要时间才能重建。我们通过美国企业层面的数据为这一机制提供了实证支持。

abstract.text: We study the strategic impact of players’ higher-order uncertainty over the observability of actions in general two-player games. More specifically, we consider the space of all belief hierarchies generated by the uncertainty over whether the game will be played as a static game or with perfect information. Over this space, we characterize the correspondence of a solution concept which captures the behavioural implications of Rationality and Common Belief in Rationality (RCBR), where “rationality” is understood as sequential whenever the game is dynamic. We show that such a correspondence is generically single-valued, and that its structure supports a robust refinement of rationalizability, which often has very sharp implications. For instance, (1) in a class of games which includes both zero-sum games with a pure equilibrium and coordination games with a unique efficient equilibrium, RCBR generically ensures efficient equilibrium outcomes (eductive coordination); (2) in a class of games which also includes other well-known families of coordination games, RCBR generically selects components of the Stackelberg profiles (Stackelberg selection); (3) if it is commonly known that player $2$’s action is not observable (e.g. because $1$ is commonly known to move earlier, etc.), in a class of games which includes all of the above RCBR generically selects the equilibrium of the static game most favourable to player $1$ (pervasiveness of first-mover advantage).

10.1093/restud/rdab047.abstractZh: 我们研究了玩家的高阶不确定性对一般双玩家游戏中行动可观测性的战略影响。更具体地说，我们考虑了由对游戏是作为静态游戏还是具有完美信息进行的不确定性所生成的全部信念层次结构空间。在这个空间上，我们描述了一个解决概念的对应关系，该概念能够捕捉到理性与理性下的共同信念（RCBR）的行为含义，其中“理性”被理解为当游戏是动态时才是序列的。我们表明，这种对应关系通常是单值的，并且其结构支持对合理性进行稳健的细化，这通常具有非常明确的影响。例如，（1）在包括具有纯均衡的零和游戏和具有唯一有效均衡的协调游戏的一类游戏中，RCBR通常能够确保有效的均衡结果（启发式协调）；（2）在还包括其他众所周知的协调游戏家族的一类游戏中，RCBR通常选择斯塔克伯格配置的成分（斯塔克伯格选择）；（3）如果众所周知玩家2的行动是不可观测的（例如，因为1通常提前行动等），在包括上述所有游戏的类别中，RCBR通常选择对玩家1最有利的静态游戏的均衡结果（先动优势的普遍性）。

abstract.text: Allocating resources without monetary payments is expected to yield inefficient allocations. Theory suggests that introducing rationing when resources are allocated repeatedly over time can mitigate this issue, while the magnitude of the resulting efficiency gains is an empirical question in most settings. We study a dynamic assignment mechanism used by the Michigan Department of Natural Resources to allocate bear hunting licenses and find that it yields a more efficient allocation than static mechanisms, allocating participants to types of resources for which they have a higher value without crowding out participants with a high overall value for hunting. Our empirical analysis also highlights the importance of heterogeneity across participants and across allocated resources for determining the efficiency of a dynamic allocation mechanism.

10.1093/restud/rdab048.abstractZh: 在不进行货币支付的情况下分配资源，预计会导致低效的分配结果。理论表明，在资源随时间反复分配时引入配给机制可以缓解这一问题，而由此带来的效率提升程度在大多数情况下仍是一个实证问题。我们研究了密歇根州自然资源部使用的动态分配机制，该机制用于分配猎熊许可证，发现与静态机制相比，它能实现更高效的分配，将参与者分配到对他们来说更有价值的资源上，同时不会排斥那些在狩猎方面具有较高总价值的参与者。我们的实证分析还强调了参与者之间以及分配到的资源之间的异质性对于确定动态分配机制的效率的重要性。

abstract.text: We develop a simple flexible-price model of business cycles driven by spikes in risk premiums. Aggregate shocks increase firms’ uninsurable idiosyncratic risk and raise risk premiums. We show that risk shocks can create quantitatively plausible recessions, with contractions in employment, consumption, and investment. Business cycles are inefficient—output, employment, and consumption fall too much during recessions, compared to the constrained-efficient allocation. Optimal policy involves stimulating employment and consumption during recessions.

10.1093/restud/rdab049.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个简单的灵活价格模型，用于描述由风险溢价飙升驱动的商业周期。总体冲击会增加企业无法投保的特有风险，并提升风险溢价。研究表明，风险冲击能够引发具有定量合理性的经济衰退，导致就业、消费和投资下降。商业周期效率低下——与受限的、高效的经济状态相比，经济衰退期间产出、就业和消费下降幅度过大。最优政策应在经济衰退期间刺激就业和消费。

abstract.text: This article analyses the dynamic spatial equilibrium of taxicabs and shows how common taxi regulations lead to substantial inefficiencies as a result of search frictions and mis-allocation. To analyse the role of regulation on frictions and efficiency, I pose a dynamic model of spatial search and matching between taxis and passengers. Using a comprehensive dataset of New York City yellow medallion taxis, I use this model to compute the equilibrium spatial distribution of vacant taxis and estimate intraday demand given price and medallion regulations. My estimates show that the weekday New York market achieves about $\$$5.7 million in daily welfare or about $\$$27 per trip, but an additional 53 thousand customers fail to find cabs due to search frictions. Counterfactual analysis shows that implementing simple tariff pricing changes can enhance allocative efficiency and expand the market, offering daily consumer surplus gains of up to $\$$227 thousand and up to 49 thousand additional daily taxi-passenger matches, a similar magnitude to the gain in matches generated by adopting a perfect static matching technology.

10.1093/restud/rdab050.abstractZh: 本文分析了出租车在动态空间均衡中的表现，并揭示了常见的出租车监管机制如何导致因搜索摩擦和资源配置不当而产生的显著效率低下。为了研究监管对摩擦和效率的影响，我构建了一个动态模型，模拟出租车与乘客之间的空间搜索与匹配过程。利用纽约市黄色勋章出租车的综合数据集，该模型用于计算空置出租车的均衡空间分布，并估算在价格与勋章监管制度下的日需求。我的估计结果显示，纽约市在工作日市场，每天可带来约570万美元的福利收益，即每次行程约27美元，但另有5.3万名乘客因搜索摩擦而无法找到出租车。反事实分析表明，实施简单的票价改革可以提高资源配置效率，扩大市场规模，使每日消费者剩余增加至22.7万美元，并增加4.9万次出租车与乘客的匹配机会，这一数量与采用完美静态匹配技术所产生的匹配机会相当。

abstract.text: Government procurement contracts rarely have many bids, often only one. Motivated by the institutional features of federal procurement, this article develops a principal-agent model where a buyer seeks sellers at a cost and negotiates contract terms with them. The model is identified and estimated with data on IT and telecommunications contracts. We find the benefits of drawing additional sellers are significantly reduced because the procurement agency can extract informational rents from sellers. Another factor explaining the small number of bids is that sellers are relatively homogeneous, conditional on observed project attributes. Administrative hurdles and corruption appear to play very limited roles.

10.1093/restud/rdab051.abstractZh: 政府采购合同通常很少会有多个投标者，往往只有一份投标。基于联邦采购的制度特点，本文构建了一个委托-代理模型，其中采购方以一定成本寻找供应商，并与他们协商合同条款。该模型通过信息技术和电信合同的数据进行了识别和估计。我们发现，由于采购机构能够从供应商那里获取信息租金，因此引入更多供应商所带来的好处显著减少。另一个导致投标数量较少的因素是，在观察到的项目属性条件下，供应商相对同质化。行政障碍和腐败似乎起到了非常有限的作用。

abstract.text: Do mergers help or hinder collusion? This article studies the stability of the vitamin cartels in the 1990s and presents a repeated-games approach to quantify “coordinated effects” of a merger. We use data and direct evidence from American courts and European agencies to show the collusive incentive of the short-lived vitamin C cartel was likely to be negative when it actually collapsed in 1995, whereas the incentives of the long-lived cartels (vitamins A and E, and beta carotene) were unambiguously positive until the prosecution in 1999. Simulations suggest some mergers could have prolonged the vitamin C cartel, but others could have further destabilized it, because both the direction and magnitude of coordinated effects depend not only on the number of firms but also on their cost asymmetry.

10.1093/restud/rdab052.abstractZh: 合并是有助于还是阻碍勾结？本文研究了20世纪90年代维生素卡特尔的稳定性，并采用重复博弈的方法来量化合并带来的“协同效应”。我们通过美国法院和欧洲机构的直接证据，表明那些短暂存在的维生素C卡特尔在1995年实际瓦解时，其勾结动机很可能是负面的；而那些长期存在的卡特尔（维生素A、维生素E和β-胡萝卜素）的勾结动机则一直为正，直到1999年受到起诉。模拟结果表明，某些合并可能会延长维生素C卡特尔的存续时间，而另一些合并则可能进一步破坏其稳定性，因为协同效应的方向和幅度不仅取决于企业的数量，还取决于企业的成本不对称程度。

abstract.text: In many centralized matching markets, agents’ property rights over objects are derived from a coarse transformation of an underlying score. Prominent examples include the distance-based system employed by Boston Public Schools, where students who lived within a certain radius of each school were prioritized over all others, and the income-based system used in New York public housing allocation, where eligibility is determined by a sharp income cutoff. Motivated by this, we study how to optimally coarsen an underlying score. Our main result is that, for any continuous objective function and under stable matching mechanisms, the optimal design can be attained by splitting agents into at most three indifference classes for each object. We provide insights into this design problem in three applications: distance-based scores in Boston Public Schools, test-based scores for Chicago exam schools, and income-based scores in New York public housing allocation.

10.1093/restud/rdab053.abstractZh: 在许多集中式匹配市场中，代理人对对象的产权来源于一个粗略的评分转换。典型的例子包括波士顿公立学校采用的距离基础系统，该系统优先考虑居住在每所学校一定半径内的学生；以及纽约公共住房分配中使用的基于收入的系统，其资格评定依据的是明确的收入门槛。基于这些现象，我们研究了如何对基础评分进行最优的粗略处理。我们的主要结论是：对于任何连续的目标函数，并且在稳定匹配机制下，通过将代理人划分为最多三个无差异类别，可以实现最优设计。我们在三个应用中提供了对这一设计问题的见解：波士顿公立学校的距离基础评分、芝加哥考试学校的基于测试评分，以及纽约公共住房分配中的基于收入的评分。

abstract.text: We devise a tractable model of firm dynamics with on-the-job search. The model admits analytical solutions for equilibrium outcomes, including quit, layoff, hiring, and vacancy-filling rates, as well as the distributions of job values, a fundamental challenge posed by the environment. Optimal labor demand takes a novel form whereby hiring firms allow their marginal product to diffuse over an interval. The evolution of the marginal product over this interval endogenously exhibits gradual mean reversion, evoking a notion of imperfect labor market competition. This in turn contributes to dispersion in marginal products, giving rise to endogenous misallocation. Quantitatively, the model provides a parsimonious reconciliation of leading estimates of rent sharing, the negative association between wages and quits, the link between job and worker flows, and the cyclicality of labor market quantities and prices.

10.1093/restud/rdab054.abstractZh: 我们设计了一个具有在职搜索机制的企业动态模型。该模型能够解析地得出均衡结果，包括辞职、裁员、招聘和职位空缺填补率，以及职位价值分布等，这些都是环境所提出的基本挑战。最优劳动力需求呈现出一种新颖的形式，即招聘企业允许其边际产品在一个区间内扩散。边际产品在这一区间内的演变表现出渐进的平均回归特性，这暗示了不完美的劳动力市场竞争现象。这反过来又导致了边际产品的分散性，进而引发了内生性的资源错配。从数量上看，该模型为关于租金共享的主要估计、工资与辞职之间的负相关关系、职位流动与工人流动之间的联系，以及劳动力市场数量和价格的周期性变化等问题，提供了一个简洁的整合方案。

abstract.text: This article explores a natural connection between fiscal multipliers and foreign holdings of public debt. Although fiscal expansions can raise domestic economic activity through various channels, they can also have crowding-out effects if the resources used to acquire public debt reduce domestic consumption and investment. These crowding-out effects are likely to be weaker when governments have access to foreign savings when selling their debt, leading to larger fiscal multipliers. We test this hypothesis for the U.S. in the post-war period and for a panel of 17 advanced economies from the 1980s to the present. To do so, we assemble a novel database of public debt holdings by domestic and foreign creditors for these countries. We combine these data with standard measures of fiscal policy shocks and show that, indeed, the size of fiscal multipliers is increasing in the share of public debt held by foreigners. In particular, the fiscal multiplier is smaller than one when the foreign share is low, such as in the U.S. in the 1950s and 1960s and Japan today, and larger than one when the foreign share is high, such as in the U.S. and several European countries today.

10.1093/restud/rdab055.abstractZh: 本文探讨了财政乘数与外国持有公共债务之间的自然联系。虽然财政扩张可以通过多种渠道促进国内经济活动，但如果用于获取公共债务的资源减少了国内消费和投资，则可能会产生挤出效应。当政府在出售债务时能够获得外国储蓄时，这些挤出效应可能会减弱，从而导致更大的财政乘数。我们对战后时期的美国以及从1980年代至今的17个发达经济体的数据进行了检验。为此，我们建立了一个包含这些国家国内外债权人持有的公共债务数据的新型数据库。我们将这些数据与标准的财政政策冲击指标相结合，发现外国持有的公共债务比例越高，财政乘数的大小就越大。特别是当外国持有比例较低时，如1950年代和1960年代的美国以及今天的日本，财政乘数小于1；而当外国持有比例较高时，如今天的美国和一些欧洲国家，财政乘数则大于1。

abstract.text: This article investigates whether offers of commitment contracts, in the form of self-imposed choice-set restrictions and penalties with no financial upside, are well-targeted tools for addressing self-control problems. In an experiment on gym attendance (N$=1{,}248$), we examine take-up of commitment contracts and also introduce a separate elicitation task to identify actual and perceived time inconsistency. There is high take-up of commitment contracts for greater gym attendance, resulting in significant increases in exercise. However, this take-up is influenced both by noisy valuation and incorrect beliefs about one’s time inconsistency. Approximately half of the people who take up commitment contracts for higher gym attendance also take up commitment contracts for lower gym attendance. There is little association between commitment contract take-up and reduced-form and structural estimates of actual or perceived time inconsistency. A novel information treatment providing an exogenous shock to awareness of time inconsistency reduces demand for commitment contracts. Structural estimates of a model of quasi-hyperbolic discounting and gym attendance imply that offering our commitment contracts lowers consumer surplus and is less socially efficient than utilizing linear exercise subsidies that achieve the same average change in behaviour.

10.1093/restud/rdab056.abstractZh: 本文探讨了以自我施加的选择限制和惩罚形式出现的承诺合同，是否是一种有效的工具，用于解决自我控制问题。在一项关于健身房出勤率的实验中（样本量N=1,248），我们调查了人们接受承诺合同的情况，并引入了一项单独的调查任务来识别实际和感知的时间不一致性。对于更高的健身房出勤率，承诺合同的接受率很高，这导致锻炼量显著增加。然而，这种接受率受到噪声估值和对时间不一致性的错误认知的影响。大约一半接受更高健身房出勤率承诺合同的人，也会接受更低健身房出勤率的承诺合同。承诺合同的接受率与实际或感知的时间不一致性之间的减少形式和结构估计几乎没有关联。一种新颖的信息处理方法，通过提供外生冲击来影响对时间不一致性的认知，可以减少对承诺合同的需求。关于准超线性折扣和健身房出勤率的模型结构估计表明，提供我们的承诺合同会降低消费者剩余，并且不如使用线性锻炼补贴那样在社交效率上更优，后者能够实现相同的行为变化。

abstract.text: Since the creation of the euro, capital flows among member countries have been large and volatile. Motivated by this fact, I provide a theory connecting the exchange rate regime to financial integration. The key feature of the model is that monetary policy affects the value of collateral that creditors seize upon default. Under flexible exchange rates, national governments can expropriate foreign creditors by depreciating the exchange rate, which induces investors to impose tight constraints on international borrowing. Creating a monetary union, by eliminating this source of currency risk, increases financial integration among member countries. This process, however, does not necessarily lead to higher welfare. The reason is that a high degree of capital mobility can generate multiple equilibria, with bad equilibria characterized by inefficient capital flights. Capital controls or fiscal transfers can eliminate bad equilibria, but their implementation requires international cooperation.

10.1093/restud/rdab057.abstractZh: 自欧元诞生以来，成员国之间的资本流动一直十分频繁且波动较大。基于这一事实，我提出了一个将汇率制度与金融一体化联系起来的理论。该模型的核心特征是货币政策会影响债权人因违约而没收的抵押品价值。在灵活汇率制度下，各国政府可以通过贬值汇率来剥夺外国债权人的资产，这促使投资者对国际借贷施加更严格的限制。通过建立货币联盟，可以消除这种货币风险来源，从而提高成员国之间的金融一体化程度。然而，这一过程并不一定能带来更高的福利。原因在于，高度的资本流动性可能导致多种均衡状态，其中不良均衡表现为资本流动效率低下。资本管制或财政转移支付可以消除不良均衡，但其实施需要国际合作。

abstract.text: We present a model of endogenous network formation to recover unobserved social networks using only observable outcomes. We propose a novel equilibrium concept that allows for a sharp characterization of equilibrium behaviour and that yields a unique prediction under testable conditions. While the equilibrium is characterized by a large number of non-linear equations, we show that it can be efficiently employed to recover the networks by an appropriately designed approximate Bayesian computation method. We apply the model to recover the network of social links between lawmakers in the U.S. Congress using data from the 109th to 113th legislatures. We show that social connections are important for legislators’ productivities, and we identify some of the key determinants of network centralities in the U.S. Congress.

10.1093/restud/rdab058.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个内生网络形成模型，仅通过可观测的结果来恢复未被观察到的社会网络。我们提出了一种新颖的均衡概念，能够清晰地描述均衡行为，并在可检验的条件下给出唯一预测结果。尽管均衡状态由大量非线性方程来描述，但我们证明可以通过适当设计的近似贝叶斯计算方法高效地恢复这些网络。我们应用该模型来恢复美国国会立法者之间的社会联系网络，使用的是第109届至第113届立法期间的数据。我们发现社会联系对立法者的工作效率非常重要，并且我们确定了美国国会网络中心性的一些关键决定因素。

abstract.text: We quantify the role of geography and land quality for agricultural productivity differences across countries using high-resolution micro-geography data and a spatial accounting framework. The rich spatial data provide for each cell of land covering the entire globe, the potential yield for 18 crops, which measures the maximum attainable crop output given soil quality, climate conditions, terrain topography, and a given level of cultivation inputs. While there is considerable heterogeneity in land quality across space, even within narrow geographic regions, we find that low agricultural land productivity is not due to unfavourable geographic endowments. If countries produced current crops in each cell according to potential yields, the rich-poor agricultural yield gap would virtually disappear, from 214% to 5%. We also find evidence of additional aggregate productivity gains attainable through spatial reallocation and changes in crop production.

10.1093/restud/rdab059.abstractZh: 我们利用高分辨率微观地理数据和一个空间核算框架，来量化地理和土地质量对各国农业生产力差异的影响。这些丰富的空间数据涵盖了全球每一块土地，以及18种作物的潜在产量，这反映了在给定土壤质量、气候条件、地形特征以及一定的耕作投入水平下，作物的最大产量。尽管不同地区的土地质量存在显著差异，即使是在狭窄的地理区域内也是如此，我们发现，低农业土地生产力并非由于不利的地理条件所致。如果各国按照潜在产量来种植每一块土地上的作物，那么贫富之间的农业产量差距将几乎消失，从214%降至5%。我们还发现，通过空间重新分配和作物生产方式的改变，可以实现额外的总体生产力提升。

abstract.text: We develop a model of fragile self-esteem—self-esteem that is vulnerable to objectively unjustified swings—and study its implications for choices that depend on, or are aimed at enhancing or protecting, one’s self-view. In our framework, a person’s self-esteem is determined by sampling his memories of ego-relevant outcomes in a fashion that in turn depends on how he feels about himself, potentially creating multiple fragile “self-esteem personal equilibria.” Self-esteem is especially likely to be fragile, as well as unrealistic in either the positive or the negative direction, if being successful is important to the agent. A person with a low self-view might exert less effort when success is more important. An individual with a high self-view, in contrast, might distort his choices to prevent a collapse in self-esteem, with the distortion being greater if his true ability is lower. We discuss the implications of our results for mental well-being, education, job search, workaholism, and aggression.

10.1093/restud/rdab060.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个脆弱自尊的模型——一种容易受到客观不合理波动影响的自尊状态——并研究了其对那些依赖于提升或保护自我认知的选择的影响。在我们的框架中，一个人的自尊水平是通过抽样其关于自我相关结果的记忆来确定的，而这一抽样方式又取决于他对自己的感受。因此，可能存在多个脆弱的“自尊个人均衡”。如果成功对个体来说非常重要，那么自尊就更容易变得脆弱，并且无论是正面还是负面的方面都可能不切实际。一个自我认知较低的人，在成功更为重要的情境下，可能会付出较少的努力。相反，一个自我认知较高的人，可能会扭曲自己的选择以防止自尊的崩溃，而且如果他的真实能力较低，这种扭曲可能会更加严重。我们讨论了这些结果对心理健康、教育、求职、工作狂以及攻击性行为的影响。

abstract.text: A growing literature has documented the role of firm heterogeneity within sectors for nominal income inequality. This article explores the implications for household price indices across the income distribution. Using detailed matched U.S. home and store scanner microdata, we present evidence that rich and poor households source their consumption differently across the firm size distribution within disaggregated product groups. We use the data to examine alternative explanations, propose a tractable quantitative model with two-sided heterogeneity that rationalizes the observed moments, and calibrate it to explore general equilibrium counterfactuals. We find that larger, more productive firms sort into catering to the taste of richer households, and that this gives rise to asymmetric effects on household price indices. We quantify these effects in the context of policy counterfactuals that affect the distribution of disposable incomes on the demand side or profits across firms on the supply side.

10.1093/restud/rdab061.abstractZh: 越来越多的文献记录了企业异质性在行业内部对名义收入不平等的影响。本文探讨了这一因素对家庭价格指数的影响。通过详细的美国家庭与商店扫描数据，我们发现富裕家庭和贫困家庭在各类企业规模下的消费方式存在差异。我们利用这些数据来检验其他可能的解释，提出了一个具有双向异质性的可计算模型，以解释观察到的统计现象，并对其进行校准以探讨一般均衡条件下的反事实情况。研究发现，规模较大、生产效率较高的企业更倾向于满足富裕家庭的消费需求，这导致了家庭价格指数出现不对称效应。我们在影响需求端可支配收入分布或供给端企业利润的政策反事实情境下，对这些效应进行了量化分析。

abstract.text: We exploit a volcanic “experiment” to study the costs and benefits of geographic mobility. In our experiment, a third of the houses in a town were covered by lava. People living in these houses were much more likely to move away permanently. For the dependents in a household (children), our estimates suggest that being induced to move by the “lava shock” dramatically raised lifetime earnings and education. While large, these estimates come with a substantial amount of statistical uncertainty. The benefits of moving were very unequally distributed across generations: the household heads (parents) were made slightly worse off by the shock. These results suggest large barriers to moving for the children, which imply that labour does not flow to locations where it earns the highest returns. The large gains from moving for the young are surprising in light of the fact that the town affected by our volcanic experiment was (and is) a relatively high income town. We interpret our findings as evidence of the importance of comparative advantage: the gains to moving may be very large for those badly matched to the location they happened to be born in, even if differences in average income are small.

10.1093/restud/rdab062.abstractZh: 我们利用一个火山“实验”来研究地理流动的成本与收益。在我们的实验中，城镇中有三分之一的房屋被熔岩覆盖。居住在这些房屋中的人们更有可能永久迁移。对于家庭中的依赖成员（子女），我们的估计表明，由于“熔岩冲击”而引发的迁移行为显著提高了他们的终身收入和教育水平。尽管这些估计值较高，但存在相当大的统计不确定性。迁移带来的好处在不同世代之间分布极不均匀：家庭负责人（父母）因这一冲击而处境略有恶化。这些结果表明，对于子女来说，迁移存在很大的障碍，这意味着劳动力不会流向那些能带来最高收益的地方。考虑到受我们火山实验影响的城镇是一个（并且仍然是）收入相对较高的城镇，年轻一代因迁移而获得的巨大收益令人惊讶。我们将这些发现解释为比较优势重要性的证据：对于那些与出生地不匹配的人来说，迁移带来的收益可能非常大，即使平均收入差异很小。

abstract.text: We study the severity of liquidity constraints in the U.S. housing market using a life-cycle model with uninsurable idiosyncratic risks in which houses are illiquid, but agents can extract home equity by refinancing their mortgages. The model implies that four-fifths of homeowners are liquidity constrained and willing to pay an average of 13 cents to extract an additional dollar of liquidity from their home. Most homeowners value liquidity for precautionary reasons, anticipating the possibility of income declines and the need to make mortgage payments. The model reproduces well the observed response of consumption to tax rebates and mortgage relief programs and predicts large welfare gains from policies aimed at providing temporary liquidity relief to homeowners.

10.1093/restud/rdab063.abstractZh: 我们运用一个包含不可保险的特殊风险的生命周期模型，研究美国住房市场中的流动性约束严重程度。该模型假设房屋具有流动性不足的特点，但购房者可以通过重新融资来提取房屋净值。模型表明，五分之四的房主面临流动性约束，并且愿意支付平均13美分来额外获得1美元的流动性。大多数房主出于预防性的考虑重视流动性，因为他们预期收入可能会下降，需要支付抵押贷款。该模型很好地再现了消费对税收减免和抵押贷款救济计划的反应，并预测了针对房主提供临时流动性救济的政策将带来巨大的福利收益。

abstract.text: We revisit the question of why shifts in aggregate demand drive business cycles. Our theory combines intertemporal substitution in production with rational confusion, or bounded rationality, in consumption and investment. The first element allows aggregate supply to respond to shifts in aggregate demand without nominal rigidity. The second introduces a “confidence multiplier,” that is, a positive feedback loop between real economic activity, consumer expectations of permanent income, and investor expectations of returns. This mechanism amplifies the business-cycle fluctuations triggered by demand shocks (but not necessarily those triggered by supply shocks); it helps investment to comove with consumption; and it allows front-loaded fiscal stimuli to crowd in private spending.

10.1093/restud/rdab064.abstractZh: 我们重新审视了为什么总需求的变化会引发商业周期的问题。我们的理论将生产的跨期替代与消费和投资的理性模糊或有限理性相结合。第一个要素使得总供给能够在不产生名义刚性的情况下应对总需求的变化。第二个要素引入了一个“信心乘数”，即实际经济活动、消费者对永久收入的预期以及投资者对回报的预期之间存在正反馈循环。这一机制放大了由需求冲击引发的商业周期波动（但不一定是由供给冲击引发的）；它有助于投资与消费同步变动；并且它使得前期集中的财政刺激能够推动私人支出的增加。

abstract.text: Banks in low-income countries face severe liquidity risk due to volatile deposits, which destabilize their funding, and dysfunctional liquidity markets, which induce expensive interbank and central bank lending. Such liquidity risk dissuades the transformation of short-term deposits into long-term loans and deters long-term investment. To validate this mechanism, we exploit a Sharia-compliant levy in Pakistan, which generates unintended and quasi-experimental variation in liquidity risk, with data from the credit registry and firm imports. We find that banks with a stronger exposure to liquidity risk lower their supply of long-term finance, which reduces the long-term investment of connected firms.

10.1093/restud/rdab065.abstractZh: 低收入国家的银行面临严重的流动性风险，因为存款波动会破坏其资金稳定性，而流动性市场的不完善则导致银行间的借贷和中央银行借贷成本过高。这种流动性风险会阻碍将短期存款转化为长期贷款，并抑制长期投资。为了验证这一机制，我们研究了巴基斯坦一项符合伊斯兰教法的税收措施，该措施产生了流动性风险的意外和准实验性变化，我们利用了信用登记册和企业进口数据来进行分析。研究发现，面临更高流动性风险的银行会减少长期融资的供应，从而降低了相关企业的长期投资。

abstract.text: It is often argued that people might take on too much high-cost debt because they are present focused and/or over-optimistic about how soon they will repay. We measure borrowers’ present focus and over-optimism using an experiment with a large payday lender. Although the most inexperienced quartile of borrowers under-estimate their likelihood of future borrowing, the more experienced three quartiles predict correctly on average. This finding contrasts sharply with priors we elicited from 103 payday lending and behavioural economics experts, who believed that the average borrower would be highly overoptimistic about getting out of debt. Borrowers are willing to pay a significant premium for an experimental incentive to avoid future borrowing, which we show implies that they perceive themselves to be time inconsistent. We use borrowers’ predicted behaviour and valuation of the experimental incentive to estimate a model of present focus and naivete. We then use the model to study common payday lending regulations. In our model, banning payday loans reduces welfare relative to existing regulation, while limits on repeat borrowing might increase welfare by inducing faster repayment that is more consistent with long-run preferences.

10.1093/restud/rdab066.abstractZh: 人们常常认为，一些人可能会承担过多的高成本债务，因为他们过于专注于当前状况，或者对偿还债务的时机过于乐观。我们通过一项针对大型发薪日贷款机构的实验来测量借款人的当前专注程度和过度乐观态度。尽管最缺乏经验的借款人低估了自己未来借款的可能性，但经验更丰富的三个四分位数则平均而言能够做出正确的预测。这一发现与我们从103位发薪日贷款和行为经济学专家那里获得的先前观点形成了鲜明对比，这些专家认为平均每个借款人都会对摆脱债务抱有过度乐观的态度。借款人愿意为实验激励支付较高的费用，以避免未来的借款行为，这表明他们认为自己在时间上的安排并不一致。我们利用借款人对实验激励的预测行为和估值，来构建一个关于当前专注程度和天真态度的模型。然后，我们利用该模型来研究常见的发薪日贷款监管措施。在我们的模型中，禁止发薪日贷款会相对于现有监管措施降低福利，而限制重复借款则可能会通过促使借款人更及时地偿还债务来提高福利，从而更符合长期偏好。

abstract.text: We study the co-evolution of religion, science, and politics. We first uncover, in international and U.S. data, a robust negative relationship between religiosity and patents per capita. The model then combines: (1) scientific discoveries that raise productivity but sometimes erode religious beliefs; (2) a government that allows innovations to diffuse, or blocks them; (3) religious institutions that can invest in doctrinal reform. Three long-term outcomes emerge. The “Western-European Secularization” regime has declining religiosity, unimpeded science, and high taxes and transfers. The “Theocratic” regime involves knowledge stagnation, unquestioned dogma, and high religious-public-goods spending. The “American” regime combines scientific progress and stable religiosity through doctrinal adaptations, with low taxes and some fiscal-legal advantages for religious activities. Rising income inequality can, however, empower a Religious-Right alliance that starts blocking belief-eroding ideas.

10.1093/restud/rdab069.abstractZh: 我们研究了宗教、科学与政治的共进化现象。首先，通过国际和美国的数据发现，宗教性与人均专利数量之间存在显著的负相关关系。随后，我们构建了一个模型，该模型结合了以下因素：(1)能够提升生产力的科学发现，但这些发现有时会侵蚀宗教信仰；(2)政府对于创新扩散的放任态度或对其的阻碍；(3)能够投资于教义改革的宗教机构。最终得出三个长期结果：“西欧世俗化”体制表现为宗教性下降、科学发展不受阻碍以及高额的税收和转移支付；“神权”体制则表现为知识停滞、教条主义盛行以及高额的宗教公共支出；“美国”体制则通过教义调整实现了科学进步与稳定的宗教性，同时税收较低，且宗教活动享有一定的财政法律优势。然而，不断加剧的收入不平等可能会促使宗教权利联盟形成，从而开始阻止那些侵蚀信仰的观念的传播。

abstract.text: This article shows that entrepreneurial human capital is a key driver of firm dynamics using administrative panel data on the universe of firms and workers in Portugal. Firms started by more educated entrepreneurs are larger at entry and exhibit higher life cycle growth. Consistent with an effect on growth, the thickness of the right tail of the size distribution increases with entrepreneur schooling. The evidence points to several underlying mechanisms, with technology adoption playing the most important part. I develop and estimate a model of firm dynamics that can parsimoniously account for these findings and use it to draw aggregate implications. Accounting for the effect of entrepreneurial human capital on firm dynamics can substantially increase aggregate returns to schooling and the fraction of cross-country income differences explained by human and physical capital.

10.1093/restud/rdab070.abstractZh: 本文通过葡萄牙企业和工人的行政面板数据表明，企业家人力资本是驱动企业动态发展的关键因素。由受教育程度较高的企业家创办的企业在成立时规模更大，并且其生命周期增长能力更强。与增长效应一致的是，企业规模分布的右尾厚度随着企业家教育水平的提高而增加。这些证据揭示了几个潜在机制，其中技术采纳起着最为重要的作用。我开发并估计了一个企业动态模型，该模型能够简洁地解释这些发现，并用于得出总体性结论。考虑到企业家人力资本对企业动态发展的影响，可以显著提高教育投资的整体回报，并解释跨国收入差异中由人力资本和物质资本所解释的部分。

abstract.text: This article develops a quantitative open economy framework with dynamics, firm heterogeneity and financial frictions to study the impact of corporate tax reforms targeted at multinationals. The model quantifies their impact on firm selection, production and welfare. Firms draw idiosyncratic shocks, invest in capital, choose optimal financing and select endogenously into selling abroad, through exporting or FDI. I apply this framework to the removal of the U.S. repatriation tax as in the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act. The reform’s impact trades-off two selection effects—more offshoring versus greater U.S. business dynamism. The reform leads to higher U.S. welfare at little cost to the Treasury. A series of exercises illustrate that the novel features of this framework have significant quantitative implications. The reform gives starkly different cross-sectional predictions and lower welfare gains when financial frictions are removed and it is welfare reducing in a static counterpart of the model.

10.1093/restud/rdab071.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个包含动态性、企业异质性和金融摩擦的定量开放经济框架，以研究针对跨国企业的企业税改政策的影响。该模型量化了这些政策对企业选择、生产和福利的影响。企业受到特有冲击的影响，进行资本投资，选择最优融资方式，并通过出口或直接投资选择海外销售。我将这一框架应用于美国《减税与就业法案》中取消回流税的情况。该改革在两种选择效应之间进行了权衡——更多的海外业务与更强的美国商业活力。该改革在给财政部带来较小成本的情况下，提升了美国的福利水平。一系列实验表明，这一框架的新特性具有显著的定量意义。当金融摩擦被消除时，改革带来了截然不同的横截面预测结果，并且福利收益降低；而在模型的静态对应模型中，该改革则会导致福利下降。

abstract.text: We propose a model in which the emergence of a single dominant currency is driven by the need to finance international trade. The model generates multiple stable steady states, each characterized by a different dominant asset, consistent with the historical durability of real-world currency regimes. The persistence of regimes is caused by a positive interaction between the returns to saving in an asset and the use of that asset for financing trade. A calibrated version of the model shows that the welfare gains of dominance are substantial, but accrue primarily during the transition to dominance. We perform several counterfactual experiments to assess potential threats to the dollar’s continued dominance.

10.1093/restud/rdab072.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，该模型认为单一主导货币的出现是由国际贸易融资的需求所驱动的。该模型产生了多个稳定的稳态，每个稳态都有不同的主导资产，这与现实世界中货币制度的长期稳定性相一致。货币制度的持久性是由资产储蓄回报与该资产用于贸易融资之间的正向互动所导致的。经过校准的模型显示，主导地位的福利收益是显著的，但这些收益主要出现在向主导地位过渡的过程中。我们进行了几项反事实实验，以评估美元持续主导地位的潜在威胁。

abstract.text: Critics claim that patent screening is ineffective, granting low-quality patents that impose unnecessary social costs. We develop an integrated framework, involving patent office examination, fees, and endogenous validity challenges in the courts, to study patent screening both theoretically and quantitatively. In our model, some inventions require the patent incentive while others do not, and asymmetric information creates a need for screening. We show that the endogeneity of challenges implies that courts, even if perfect, cannot solve the screening problem. Simulations of the model, calibrated on U.S. data, indicate that screening is highly imperfect, with almost half of all patents issued on inventions that do not require the patent incentive. While we find that the current patent system generates positive social value, intensifying examination would yield large welfare gains. The social value of the patent system would also be larger if complemented by antitrust limits on licensing.

10.1093/restud/rdab073.abstractZh: 批评者声称，专利筛选机制无效，导致颁发了低质量专利，从而带来了不必要的社会成本。我们构建了一个综合框架，包括专利局的审查、费用以及法院对专利有效性的质疑，从理论和定量角度对专利筛选机制进行研究。在我们的模型中，某些发明需要专利激励，而另一些则不需要；信息不对称也导致了筛选的必要性。我们发现，即使法院是完美的，也无法解决筛选问题。基于美国数据的模型模拟表明，筛选机制存在严重缺陷，几乎一半的专利都是针对那些不需要专利激励的发明颁发的。虽然我们发现当前的专利制度能够产生积极的社会价值，但加强审查力度将带来更大的福利收益。如果专利制度能够结合反垄断限制条款，其社会价值将会进一步提升。

abstract.text: Theory predicts that central-bank lending programs put ceilings on private domestic lending rates, reduce ex post financing risk, and encourage ex ante investment. This article shows that with global banks and integrated financial markets, but domestic central banks, then lending of last resort can be achieved using swap lines. Through them, a source central bank provides source-currency credit to recipient-country banks using the recipient central bank as the monitor and as the bearer of the credit risk. In theory, the swap lines should put a ceiling on deviations from covered interest parity, lower average ex post bank borrowing costs, and increase ex ante inflows from recipient-country banks into privately issued assets denominated in the source-country’s currency. Empirically, these three predictions are tested using variation in the terms of the swap line over time, variation in the central banks that have access to the swap line, variation in the days of the week in which the swap line is open, variation in the exposure of different securities to foreign investment, and variation in banks’ exposure to dollar funding risk. The evidence suggests that the international lender of last resort is very effective.

10.1093/restud/rdab074.abstractZh: 理论预测，中央银行的贷款计划会设定国内私人贷款利率的上限，降低事后融资风险，并鼓励事前投资。本文指出，在全球银行与一体化金融市场的背景下，由国内中央银行实施的最后贷款人贷款可以通过互换协议实现。通过这种协议，来源国的中央银行向接收国的银行提供本币信贷，而接收国的中央银行则担任监控者和信贷风险的承担者。理论上，互换协议应能够限制偏离覆盖利息平价的情况，降低银行的平均事后借贷成本，并增加接收国银行对以来源国货币计价的私人发行资产的投入。从实证角度来看，这三个预测通过以下因素进行了检验：互换协议条款随时间的变化、参与互换协议的中央银行的变化、互换协议开放时间在不同星期的情况、不同证券对外国投资的敞口变化，以及银行对美元融资风险的敞口变化。证据表明，国际最后贷款人机制非常有效。

abstract.text: Informal care provided by adult children substitutes for formal long-term care services. However, information about children is not used in pricing long-term care insurance which pays only for formal care. I start by providing descriptive evidence that private information about children’s informal care likelihood results in adverse selection: the market attracts a disproportionate number of individuals who face higher formal care utilization risk due to a lower probability of receiving care from their children. To quantify the welfare consequence of adverse selection, I develop and estimate a dynamic intergenerational model featuring long-term care insurance, savings, informal care provision, and employment choices. Based on the estimated equilibrium insurance market framework, I show that using information about children in pricing insurance contracts reduces adverse selection and results in the average welfare gain of $6,200 per family. Using the non-cooperative feature of the model, I also quantify to what extent parents forgo long-term care insurance to avoid diminishing children’s informal care incentive.

10.1093/restud/rdab075.abstractZh: 成年子女提供的非正式照顾可以替代正式的长期照顾服务。然而，关于子女的信息并未被用于定价长期护理保险，因为保险仅支付正式的照顾服务。首先，我提供了描述性证据，表明私人掌握的子女非正式照顾可能性的信息会导致逆向选择：市场吸引了大量面临更高正式照顾使用风险的个体，因为他们从子女那里获得照顾的可能性较低。为了量化逆向选择的福利后果，我开发并估计了一个包含长期护理保险、储蓄、非正式照顾提供和就业选择在内的动态代际模型。基于估计的均衡保险市场框架，我表明在保险合同中使用有关子女的信息可以减少逆向选择，并使每个家庭的平均福利增益达到6,200美元。利用模型的非合作特性，我还量化了父母为避免减少子女非正式照顾激励而放弃长期护理保险的程度。

abstract.text: We construct and calibrate a monetary model of corporate finance with endogenous formation of lending relationships. The equilibrium features money demands by firms that depend on their access to credit and a pecking order of financing means. We describe the mechanism through which monetary policy affects the creation of relationships and firms’ incentives to use internal or external finance. We study optimal monetary policy following an unanticipated destruction of relationships under different commitment assumptions. The Ramsey solution uses forward guidance to expedite creation of new relationships by committing to raise the user cost of cash gradually above its long-run value. Absent commitment, the user cost is kept low, delaying recovery.

10.1093/restud/rdab077.abstractZh: 我们构建并校准了一个企业金融的货币模型，该模型包含内生性的借贷关系形成机制。均衡状态下，企业的货币需求取决于其获得信贷的能力，以及融资手段的优先级。我们描述了货币政策如何影响关系的建立以及企业使用内部或外部融资的动机。我们研究了在不同承诺假设下，面对关系意外破坏时的最优货币政策。Ramsey解决方案通过前瞻性指导来加速新关系的建立，即逐步提高现金使用成本，使其高于长期价值。如果没有承诺机制，现金使用成本将保持较低水平，从而延迟关系的恢复。

abstract.text: This article considers a class of experimentation games with Lévy bandits encompassing those of Bolton and Harris (1999, Econometrica, 67, 349–374) and Keller, Rady, and Cripps (2005, Econometrica, 73, 39–68). Its main result is that efficient (perfect Bayesian) equilibria exist whenever players’ payoffs have a diffusion component. Hence, the trade-offs emphasized in the literature do not rely on the intrinsic nature of bandit models but on the commonly adopted solution concept (Markov perfect equilibrium). This is not an artefact of continuous time: we prove that efficient equilibria arise as limits of equilibria in the discrete-time game. Furthermore, it suffices to relax the solution concept to strongly symmetric equilibrium.

10.1093/restud/rdab078.abstractZh: 本文研究了一类包含Lévy强盗问题的实验博弈，这类博弈涵盖了Bolton和Harris在1999年发表于《Econometrica》第67卷第349-374页的研究，以及Keller、Rady和Cripps在2005年发表于《Econometrica》第73卷第39-68页的研究。其主要结论是：只要玩家的收益具有扩散成分，就存在有效的（完美贝叶斯）均衡。因此，文献中强调的权衡并不依赖于强盗模型的内在特性，而是依赖于通常采用的解决概念——马尔可夫完美均衡。这一结论并非连续时间下的特例：我们证明了有效均衡实际上是离散时间博弈中均衡的极限。此外，只需将解决概念放宽到强对称均衡，即可得到有效的均衡。

abstract.text: We show that the folk theorem holds generically for the repeated two-player game with private monitoring if the support of each player’s signal distribution is sufficiently large. Neither cheap talk communication nor public randomization is necessary.

10.1093/restud/rdab079.abstractZh: 我们证明，在具有私人监控的重复双人游戏中，如果每位玩家的信号分布的覆盖范围足够大，那么民间定理通常都是成立的。不需要使用廉价谈话通信或公开随机化手段。

abstract.text: We study a noisy rational expectations equilibrium in a multi-asset economy populated by informed and uninformed investors and noise traders. The assets can include state contingent claims such as Arrow–Debreu securities, assets with only positive payoffs, options or other derivative securities. The probabilities of states depend on an aggregate shock, which is observed only by the informed investor. We derive a three-factor CAPM with asymmetric information, establish conditions under which asset prices reveal information about the shock, and show that information asymmetry amplifies the effects of payoff skewness on asset returns. We also find that volatility derivatives make incomplete markets effectively complete, and their prices quantify market illiquidity and shadow value of information to uninformed investors.

10.1093/restud/rdab081.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个由知情和不知情投资者以及噪声交易者组成的多资产经济中的噪声理性预期均衡。这些资产可以包括状态相关的索赔，如Arrow-Debreu证券、仅具有正收益的资产、期权或其他衍生证券。状态的概率取决于一个总冲击，这个冲击只有知情投资者能够观察到。我们推导出了一个具有信息不对称的三因素CAPM模型，确定了资产价格揭示有关冲击信息的条件，并表明信息不对称会放大收益偏斜对资产回报的影响。我们还发现，波动率衍生品使得不完全市场实际上变得完整，其价格能够量化市场流动性不足以及信息对不知情投资者的影子价值。

abstract.text: Players receive a return to investment that is increasing in the proportion of others who invest and the state and incur a small cost for acquiring information about the state. Their information is reflected in a stochastic choice rule, specifying the probability of a signal leading to investment. If discontinuous stochastic choice rules are infinitely costly, there is a unique equilibrium as costs become small, in which actions are a best response to a uniform (Laplacian) belief over the proportion of others investing. Infeasibility of discontinuous stochastic choice rules captures the idea that it is impossible to perfectly distinguish states that are arbitrarily close together and is both empirically documented and satisfied by many natural micro-founded cost functionals on information. Our results generalize global game selection results and establish that they do not depend on the specific additive noise information structure.

10.1093/restud/rdab082.abstractZh: 参与者获得的投资回报随着其他投资者的数量以及国家层面的投资增加而增长，而获取有关国家状况的信息则会产生较小的成本。他们的信息反映在随机选择规则中，该规则指定了信号导致投资的概率。如果不连续的随机选择规则的成本无限大，那么当成本变得很小时，会存在一个唯一的均衡状态，在这种状态下，行为是对其他投资者投资比例的统一（拉普拉斯）信念的最佳响应。不连续的随机选择规则的不可行性体现了这样一个观点：无法完美区分那些彼此距离很近的状态，这一点既得到了实证数据的支持，也被许多基于信息的自然微观成本函数所验证。我们的研究结果推广了全局博弈选择的结果，并表明这些结果并不依赖于特定的加性噪声信息结构。

abstract.text: This article studies the relationship between patience and comparative development through a combination of reduced-form analyses and model estimations. Based on a globally representative dataset on time preference in 76 countries, we document two sets of stylized facts. First, patience is strongly correlated with per capita income and the accumulation of physical capital, human capital, and productivity. These correlations hold across countries, sub-national regions, and individuals. Second, the magnitude of the patience elasticity strongly increases in the level of aggregation. To provide an interpretive lens for these patterns, we analyse an overlapping generations model in which savings and education decisions are endogenous to patience, aggregate production is characterized by capital-skill complementarities, and productivity implicitly depends on patience through a human capital externality. In our model estimations, general equilibrium effects alone account for a non-trivial share of the observed amplification effects, and an extension to human capital externalities can quantitatively match the empirical evidence.

10.1093/restud/rdab084.abstractZh: 本文通过结合简化形式分析和模型估算，研究了耐心与比较发展之间的关系。基于一个涵盖76个国家的时间偏好数据的全球代表性数据集，我们发现了两组典型现象。首先，耐心与人均收入以及物质资本、人力资本和生产力的积累之间存在强烈相关性。这些相关性在各国、次国家级地区和个人之间都存在。其次，耐心弹性的大小在聚合程度较高时显著增强。为了对这些现象进行解释，我们分析了一个重叠世代模型，在该模型中，储蓄和教育决策是受耐心影响的内生变量，总体生产特征表现为资本与技能的互补性，而生产力则通过人力资本的外生效应间接依赖于耐心。在我们的模型估算中，仅一般均衡效应就占到了观察到的放大效应的相当一部分，而扩展至人力资本外生效应后，可以定量匹配实证证据。

abstract.text: Using newly collected data on death rates and aerial victories of more than 5,000 German fighter pilots during World War II, we examine the effects of public recognition on performance and risk-taking. When a particular pilot is honoured publicly, both the victory rate and the death rate of his former peers increase. Fellow pilots react more if they come from the same region of Germany, or if they worked closely with him. Our results suggest that personal rivalry can be a prime motivating force, and that non-financial rewards can lead to a crowd-in of both effort and risk-taking via social connections.

10.1093/restud/rdab085.abstractZh: 我们利用二战期间收集到的超过5,000名德国战斗机飞行员死亡率和空战胜利数据，研究公众认可对表现和冒险行为的影响。当某位飞行员获得公开表彰时，他之前的同伴们的胜利率和死亡率都会上升。如果飞行员来自同一地区，或者与他们有过密切合作，他们的反应会更加积极。我们的研究结果表明，个人竞争可以成为主要的激励因素，而非金钱奖励也能通过社交联系促进努力和冒险行为的增加。

abstract.text: We use a revealed-preference approach to estimate investor expectations of stock market returns. Using data on demand for index funds that follow the S&P 500, we develop and estimate a model of investor choice to flexibly recover the time-varying distribution of expected future returns across investors. Our analysis is facilitated by the prevalence of leveraged funds that track the same underlying asset: by choosing between higher and lower leverage, investors trade off higher return against less risk. Our estimates indicate that investor expectations are heterogeneous, extrapolative, and persistent. Following a downturn, investors become more pessimistic on average, but there is also an increase in disagreement among participating investors due to the presence of contrarian investors.

10.1093/restud/rdab086.abstractZh: 我们采用揭示偏好方法来估计投资者对股市回报的预期。利用追踪标准普尔500指数的指数基金需求数据，我们开发并估计了一个投资者选择模型，以灵活地恢复投资者对未来回报的时变分布预期。由于杠杆基金普遍追踪相同的 underlying asset，我们的分析得以顺利进行：投资者在较高和较低的杠杆之间做出选择，从而在更高的回报与较低的风险之间权衡。我们的估计表明，投资者预期具有异质性、可推断性且持久性。在市场下跌之后，投资者普遍变得更加悲观，但由于存在逆向投资者，参与投资者的分歧也有所增加。

abstract.text: This article investigates how incentives and behavioural policy interventions affect individuals’ allocation of scarce cognitive resources. Based on experimental evidence, we demonstrate that incentives systematically influence individuals’ allocation of cognitive resources, and their propensity to actively engage with a decision or to stay passive. Policies that steer individuals’ attention to a specific decision lead to more active decision-making and better choices in the targeted choice domain, but induce negative cognitive spillovers on the quality of choices in other domains. In our setting, these two countervailing effects offset each other, such that the overall payoff consequences of the interventions are essentially zero. We further document that cognitive spillovers are especially pronounced for complex choices and for subgroups of the population with a smaller stock of cognitive resources. We discuss implications for the design and evaluation of behavioural policy interventions.

10.1093/restud/rdab087.abstractZh: 本文探讨了激励措施和行为政策干预如何影响个体对稀缺认知资源的分配。基于实验证据，我们证明激励措施会系统性地影响个体对认知资源的分配，以及他们主动参与决策或保持被动状态的倾向。将个体的注意力引导至特定决策的政策会促进更积极的决策行为，并在目标选择领域带来更好的选择结果，但会在其他领域产生负面的认知溢出效应。在我们的研究环境中，这两种相互抵消的效应使得干预措施的整体效果基本为零。我们还发现，对于复杂决策以及认知资源较少的人群来说，认知溢出效应尤为明显。我们讨论了这些行为政策干预的设计与评估意义。

abstract.text: How does the shadow banking system respond to changes in capital regulation of commercial banks? We propose a quantitative general equilibrium model with regulated and unregulated banks to study the unintended consequences of regulation. Tighter capital requirements for regulated banks cause higher convenience yield on debt of all banks, leading to higher shadow bank leverage and a larger shadow banking sector. At the same time, tighter regulation eliminates the subsidies to commercial banks from deposit insurance, reducing the competitive pressures on shadow banks to take risks. The net effect is a safer financial system with more shadow banking. Calibrating the model to data on financial institutions in the US, the optimal capital requirement is around 16$\%$.

10.1093/restud/rdab088.abstractZh: 影子银行体系如何应对商业银行资本监管的变化？我们提出了一个包含受监管和不受监管银行的定量一般均衡模型，以研究监管带来的意外后果。对受监管银行实施更严格的资本要求会导致所有银行债务的便利收益增加，从而导致影子银行的杠杆率上升和影子银行领域的规模扩大。同时，更严格的监管消除了存款保险对商业银行的补贴，减少了影子银行承担风险的竞争压力。其净效应是金融系统更加安全，但影子银行的数量却有所增加。通过对美国金融机构的数据进行模型校准，得出最优资本要求约为16%。

abstract.text: What happens when immigrant girls are given increased opportunities to integrate into the workplace and society, but their parents value more traditional cultural outcomes? We answer this question in the context of a reform which granted automatic birthright citizenship to eligible immigrant children born in Germany after 1 January 2000. Using survey data, we collected from students in 57 schools and comparing those born in the months before vs. after the reform, we find the introduction of birthright citizenship lowers measures of life satisfaction and self-esteem for immigrant girls by 0.32 and 0.25 standard deviations, respectively. This is especially true for Muslims, where parents are likely to prefer more traditional cultural outcomes than their daughters. Moreover, we find that Muslim girls granted birthright citizenship are less integrated into German society: they are both more socially isolated and less likely to self-identify as German. Exploring mechanisms for these unintended drops in well-being and assimilation, we find that immigrant Muslim parents invest less in their daughters’ schooling and that these daughters receive worse grades in school if they are born after the reform. Parents are also less likely to speak German with these daughters. Consistent with a rise in intra-family conflict, birthright citizenship results in disillusionment where immigrant Muslim girls believe their chances of achieving their educational goals are lower and the perceived odds of having to forgo a career for a family rise. In contrast, immigrant boys experience, if anything, an improvement in well-being, integration, and schooling outcomes. Taken together, the findings point towards immigrant girls being pushed by parents to conform to a role within traditional culture, whereas boys are allowed to take advantage of the opportunities that come with citizenship. To explain these findings, we construct a simple game-theoretic model which builds on Akerlof and Kranton (2000), where identity-concerned parents constrain their daughter’s choices, and hence lower their daughter’s well-being, when faced with the threat of integration. Alternative models can explain some of the findings in isolation.

10.1093/restud/rdab089.abstractZh: 当移民女孩获得更多的融入职场和社会的机会时，但如果她们的父母更重视传统文化成果，会发生什么？我们在一个改革背景下回答了这个问题。该改革规定，2000年1月1日之后在德国出生的符合条件的移民儿童将自动获得公民身份。通过调查数据，我们收集了57所学校的学生信息，并比较了改革前后出生的学生情况，发现赋予公民身份使移民女孩的生活满意度和自尊心分别降低了0.32和0.25个标准差。这种情况在穆斯林女孩中尤为明显，因为父母可能更重视传统文化成果而非女儿。此外，我们发现获得公民身份的穆斯林女孩在融入德国社会方面表现较差：她们在社交上更加孤立，并且不太可能自认为是德国人。通过探究这些非预期福祉下降的机制，我们发现移民穆斯林父母对女儿的教育投入较少，而且这些女孩在改革后出生的话，在学校成绩也会较差。父母也更少与这些女儿使用德语交流。与家庭内部冲突的增加相一致，公民身份的赋予导致移民穆斯林女孩感到幻灭，她们认为实现教育目标的机会降低，并且为了家庭而放弃职业的可能性也增加了。相比之下，移民男孩的福祉、融入社会和学业表现反而有所改善。综合来看，研究结果表明，移民女孩受到父母的压力，被迫遵循传统文化中的角色定位，而男孩则被允许利用公民身份带来的机会。为了解释这些发现，我们构建了一个简单的博弈论模型，该模型基于Akerlof和Kranton（2000）的研究，其中与身份相关的父母会限制女儿的选择，从而在面临融入社会的威胁时降低女儿的福祉。其他模型也可以单独解释其中的一些发现。

abstract.text: We investigate a model of one-to-one matching with transferable utility and general unobserved heterogeneity. Under a separability assumption that generalizes Choo and Siow (2006, Journal of Political Economy, 114, 175–201), we first show that the equilibrium matching maximizes a social gain function that trades off exploiting complementarities in observable characteristics and matching on unobserved characteristics. We use this result to derive simple closed-form formulae that identify the joint matching surplus and the equilibrium utilities of all participants, given any known distribution of unobserved heterogeneity. We provide efficient algorithms to compute the stable matching and to estimate parametric versions of the model. Finally, we revisit Choo and Siow’s empirical application to illustrate the potential of our more general approach.

10.1093/restud/rdab090.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个具有可转移效用和普遍未观测异质性的一对一匹配模型。在推广Choo和Siow（2006年，《政治经济学杂志》，114卷，175-201页）的分离性假设下，我们首先证明了均衡匹配能够最大化一个社会收益函数，该函数权衡了利用可观测特征的互补性以及基于未观测特征的匹配。我们利用这一结果推导出简单的封闭形式公式，这些公式可以确定所有参与者的联合匹配收益和均衡效用，前提是已知未观测异质性的分布。我们提供了高效的算法来计算稳定匹配，并估计模型的参数版本。最后，我们重新审视了Choo和Siow的实证应用，以说明我们更通用方法的潜力。

abstract.text: This article considers the effect of contracting limitations in risk-sharing networks, arising for example from observability, verifiability, complexity, or cultural constraints. We derive necessary and sufficient conditions for Pareto efficiency under these constraints in a general setting, and we provide an explicit characterization of Pareto efficient bilateral transfer profiles under CARA utility and normally distributed endowments. Our model predicts that network centrality is positively correlated with consumption volatility, as more central agents become quasi-insurance providers to more peripheral agents. The proposed framework has important implications for the empirical specification of risk-sharing tests, allowing for local risk-sharing groups that overlap within the village network.

10.1093/restud/rdab091.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在风险共享网络中，由于可观测性、可验证性、复杂性或文化限制等因素导致的契约限制所带来的影响。我们在一般情境下推导了在这些限制条件下实现帕累托效率的必要充分条件，并给出了在CARA效用和正态分布的禀赋条件下，帕累托效率双边转移配置的具体描述。我们的模型预测，网络中心性与消费波动性呈正相关，因为越中心的代理人会成为越边缘代理人的准保险提供者。该框架对风险共享测试的经验性规范具有重要意义，因为它允许在村庄网络内部存在重叠的局部风险共享群体。

abstract.text: We build a theory of financial intermediation based on the premise that some investors are better able to figure out the trade motives of their counterparties in bilateral meetings—screening experts. We solve for the equilibrium market structure and study how information asymmetries stemming from heterogeneity in screening expertise shape up the core–periphery trade structure. In particular, the core of the market is populated by screening experts: they have the largest share of trade volume, they are actively engaged in middleman activity, and trade with the most counterparties. Using transaction-level micro-data and information disclosure requirements, we provide extensive evidence consistent only with our theory of financial intermediation.

10.1093/restud/rdab092.abstractZh: 我们基于这样一个前提构建了一个金融中介理论：某些投资者更能够了解双边交易中交易对手的动机——即筛选专家。我们求解了市场均衡结构，并研究了由于筛选专业知识差异导致的信息不对称如何塑造核心-边缘交易结构。具体而言，市场的核心由筛选专家构成：他们占据了最大的交易量份额，积极参与中介活动，并与最多的交易对手进行交易。通过利用交易层面的微观数据和信息披露要求，我们获得了与我们的金融中介理论一致的广泛证据。

abstract.text: We study the interaction between the currency choice of private domestic contracts and optimal monetary policy. The optimal currency choice depends on the price risk of each currency, as well as on the covariance of its price and the relative consumption needs of the agents signing the contract. When a larger share of contracts is denominated in local currency, the government can use inflation more effectively to either redistribute resources or reduce default costs, which makes local currency more attractive for private contracts. When governments lack commitment, competitive equilibria can be constrained inefficient, thus providing a reason to regulate the currency choice of private contracts. We show that both the equilibrium use of local currency and the implications for regulation depend on the level of domestic policy risk. Our model can explain the wide use of the US dollar in international trade contracts and the observed hysteresis in dollarization.

10.1093/restud/rdab093.abstractZh: 我们研究了私人国内合同中的货币选择与最优货币政策之间的相互作用。最优货币选择取决于每种货币的价格风险，以及其价格与签订合同的代理人的相对消费需求的协方差。当更大比例的合同以本地货币计价时，政府可以更有效地利用通货膨胀来重新分配资源或降低违约成本，这使得本地货币对私人合同更具吸引力。当政府缺乏承诺时，竞争均衡可能会变得低效，因此有必要对私人合同的货币选择进行监管。我们表明，本地货币在均衡使用中的表现以及对监管的影响取决于国内政策风险的水平。我们的模型可以解释为什么在国际贸易合同中广泛使用美元，以及美元化现象中观察到的滞后效应。

abstract.text: We propose a new approach to estimating central bank preferences, including the implicit inflation target, that requires no priors on the underlying macroeconomic structure nor observation of monetary policy actions. Our approach entails directly estimating the central bank’s objective function from the sentiment expressed by policymakers in their internal meetings. We apply the approach to the objective function of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC). The results challenge two key aspects of conventional wisdom regarding FOMC preferences. First, the FOMC had an implicit inflation target of approximately $1\frac{1}{2}$$\%$ on average over our baseline 2000–11 sample period, significantly below the commonly assumed value of 2. Second, the FOMC’s loss depends strongly on output growth and stock market performance and less so on their perception of current economic slack.

10.1093/restud/rdab094.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种估算中央银行偏好新方法，该方法包含隐性通胀目标，无需对 underlying 宏观经济结构进行先验假设，也无需观察货币政策行动。我们的方法直接从政策制定者在内部会议中表达的情绪中估算出中央银行的目标函数。我们将该方法应用于美国联邦公开市场委员会的目标函数。研究结果挑战了关于FOMC偏好传统观点的两个关键方面。首先，在我们的2000-11年样本期间，FOMC的隐性通胀目标平均约为1.5%，远低于通常假设的2%。其次，FOMC的损失在很大程度上取决于产出增长和股市表现，而对其当前经济疲软程度的感知影响较小。

abstract.text: We study how strategic interaction and cooperation are affected by the heterogeneity of cognitive skills of groups of players, over consecutive plays of repeated games with randomly matched opponents using Prisoner’s Dilemma as stage game. We observe overall higher cooperation rates and average final payoffs in integrated treatment groups—where subjects of different IQ levels interact together—than in separated treatment groups. Lower IQ subjects are better off and higher IQ subjects are worse off in integrated groups than in separated groups. Higher IQ subjects adopt harsher strategies when they are pooled with lower IQ subjects than when they play separately. We demonstrate that this outcome should be expected in learning and evolutionary models where higher intelligence subjects exhibit lower frequency of errors in the implementation of strategies. Estimations of errors and strategies in our experimental data are consistent with the model’s assumptions and predictions.

10.1093/restud/rdab095.abstractZh: 我们研究了在随机匹配的对手参与重复博弈的连续阶段中，玩家群体认知技能的异质性如何影响战略互动与合作。研究发现，在整合处理组中——即不同智商水平的参与者相互交流的情况下——合作率总体更高，最终收益也更为理想。与分离处理组相比，低智商参与者在整合组中表现更好，而高智商参与者则表现更差。当高智商参与者与低智商参与者组合在一起时，他们采用的策略更为严厉。我们的研究表明，这种结果在学习和进化模型中是可以预期的，因为高智商参与者在实施策略时犯错的频率更低。我们实验数据中关于错误和策略的估计结果与模型的假设和预测一致。

abstract.text: We study auction design for bidders equipped with non-expected utility preferences that exhibit constant risk aversion (CRA). The CRA class is large and includes loss-averse, disappointment-averse, mean-dispersion, and Yaari’s dual preferences as well as coherent and convex risk measures. Any preference in this class displays first-order risk aversion, contrasting the standard expected utility case which displays second-order risk aversion. The optimal mechanism offers “ full-insurance” in the sense that each agent’s utility is independent of other agents’ reports. The seller excludes less types than under risk neutrality and awards the object randomly to intermediate types. Subjecting intermediate types to a risky allocation while compensating them when losing allows the seller to collect larger payments from higher types. Relatively high types are willing to pay more, and their allocation is efficient.

10.1093/restud/rdab096.abstractZh: 我们研究了针对具有非期望效用偏好且表现出恒定风险厌恶的投标者的拍卖设计。恒定风险厌恶类非常庞大，包括厌恶损失、厌恶失望、均值分散以及Yaari双重偏好，以及一致性和凸风险度量。这类偏好中的任何偏好都表现出一阶风险厌恶，这与表现出二阶风险厌恶的标准期望效用情况形成对比。最优机制提供了“全额保险”，即每个代理人的效用独立于其他代理人报告的信息。卖方排除的风险类型少于风险中性情况下的类型，并随机将物品分配给中间类型。通过让中间类型在面临风险时获得补偿，卖方可以从较高类型的投标者那里获得更高的支付。相对较高的类型愿意支付更多的费用，其分配也是高效的。

abstract.text: We develop a concept of weak identification in linear instrumental variable models in which the number of instruments can grow at the same rate or slower than the sample size. We propose a jackknifed version of the classical weak identification-robust Anderson–Rubin (AR) test statistic. Large-sample inference based on the jackknifed AR is valid under heteroscedasticity and weak identification. The feasible version of this statistic uses a novel variance estimator. The test has uniformly correct size and good power properties. We also develop a pre-test for weak identification that is related to the size property of a Wald test based on the Jackknife Instrumental Variable Estimator. This new pre-test is valid under heteroscedasticity and with many instruments.

10.1093/restud/rdab097.abstractZh: 我们提出了线性工具变量模型中弱识别的概念，其中工具变量的数量可以以与样本量相同的速率或更慢的速度增长。我们提出了一种经典弱识别稳健型Anderson–Rubin检验统计量的杰克刀法版本。基于杰克刀法的AR检验在异方差性和弱识别条件下仍然具有大样本推断的有效性。该统计量的可行版本采用了一种新颖的方差估计方法。该检验具有均匀正确的检验功效和良好的统计性质。我们还开发了一种与基于杰克刀工具变量估计器的Wald检验的检验功效性质相关的弱识别预检验。这种新的预检验在异方差性和存在大量工具变量的情况下仍然有效。

abstract.text: China’s economic model involves regular and intensive government interventions in financial markets, while Western policymakers often refrain from substantial interventions outside crisis periods. We develop a theoretical framework to rationalize the approaches of both China and the West to managing the financial system as being optimal given the differences in their respective economies. In this framework, a government leans against trading of noise traders but at the expense of introducing policy noise to the market. Our welfare analysis shows that under certain underlying economic conditions, the optimal government policy induces a government-centric equilibrium, in which government intervention is so intensive that all investors choose to acquire private information about policy noise rather than fundamentals. This policy regime characterizes China’s approach with financial stability prioritized over other policy objectives.

10.1093/restud/rdab098.abstractZh: 中国的经济模式涉及政府定期且密集地干预金融市场，而西方的政策制定者通常在非危机时期不会进行大规模干预。我们建立了一个理论框架，以解释中国和西方在管理金融系统方面的做法为何被认为是最优的，这得益于两国经济结构的差异。在该框架中，政府的干预会抵消噪声交易者的交易行为，但代价是向市场引入政策噪声。我们的福利分析表明，在某些基本经济条件下，最优的政府政策会引导出一个以政府为中心的均衡状态，在这种状态下，政府的干预程度如此之高，以至于所有投资者都选择获取关于政策噪声的私人信息，而非基本面的信息。这种政策体制体现了中国在追求金融稳定方面所采取的做法，将其置于其他政策目标之上。

abstract.text: Can we reduce the damage from climate change by investing in seawalls, stilts, or other forms of adaptation? Focusing on the case of severe storms in the US, I develop a macro heterogeneous-agent model to quantify the interactions between adaptation, federal disaster policy, and climate change. The model departs from the standard climate damage function and incorporates the damage from storms as the realization of idiosyncratic shocks. Using the calibrated model, I infer that adaptation capital comprises approximately 1$\%$ of the US capital stock. I find that while the moral hazard effects from disaster aid reduce adaptation in the US economy, federal subsidies for investment in adaptation more than correct for the moral hazard. I introduce climate change into the model as a permanent increase in either or both the severity or probability of storms. Adaptation reduces the damage from this climate change by approximately one-third. Finally, I show that modelling the idiosyncratic risk component of climate damage has quantitatively important implications for adaptation and for the welfare cost of climate change.

10.1093/restud/rdab099.abstractZh: 我们能否通过投资海堤、高台或其他形式的适应措施来减少气候变化造成的损害？以美国严重风暴为例，我开发了一个宏观异质代理模型，以量化适应措施、联邦灾害政策与气候变化之间的相互作用。该模型基于标准的气候损害函数，并将风暴造成的损害视为特殊冲击的实现。通过校准模型，我发现适应措施资本约占美国资本存量的1%。我发现，虽然灾害援助带来的道德风险效应降低了美国经济的适应能力，但联邦对适应措施投资的补贴足以抵消这种道德风险。我将气候变化引入模型，作为风暴的严重程度或概率的永久性增加因素。适应措施可将这种气候变化造成的损害减少约三分之一。最后，我表明，对气候损害中的特殊风险成分进行建模，对适应措施以及气候变化的福利成本具有重要的定量意义。

abstract.text: We investigate the allegation that legacy US airlines communicated via earnings calls to coordinate with other legacy airlines in offering fewer seats on competitive routes. To this end, we first use text analytics to build a novel dataset on communication among airlines about their capacity choices. Estimates from our preferred specification show that the number of offered seats is 2$\%$ lower when all legacy airlines in a market discuss the concept of “capacity discipline.” We verify that this reduction materializes only when legacy airlines communicate concurrently, and that it cannot be explained by other possibilities, including that airlines are simply announcing to investors their unilateral plans to reduce capacity, and then following through on those announcements.

10.1093/restud/rdab100.abstractZh: 我们调查了这样一种说法，即美国的传统航空公司通过收益电话进行沟通，以协调其他传统航空公司减少竞争航线上的座位数量。为此，我们首先使用文本分析技术，构建了一个关于航空公司之间关于容量选择的沟通的新数据集。我们的模型估计显示，当一个市场中的所有传统航空公司都讨论“容量纪律”概念时，提供的座位数量会减少2%。我们验证了这种减少只有在传统航空公司同时沟通时才会发生，并且无法用其他可能性来解释，包括航空公司只是向投资者宣布单方面减少容量的计划，然后才执行这些公告。
