abstract.text: Empirical evidence on distributional preferences shows that people do not judge inequality as problematic per se but that they take into account the fairness or unfairness of the outcome. This article conceptualizes a view of unfair inequality and introduces a new measure of inequality based on two widely held fairness principles: equality of opportunity and freedom from poverty. It develops a method for decomposing inequality and its trends into an unfair and a fair component. We provide two empirical applications of our measure. First, we analyse the development of inequality in the US from 1969 to 2014 from a fairness perspective. Second, we conduct a corresponding international comparison between the US and 31 European countries in 2010. Our results document that unfair inequality matches the well-documented inequality growth in the US since 1980. This trend is driven by decreases in social mobility, i.e., increasing importance of parental education and occupation for the income of their children. Among the 32 countries of our international comparison, the land of opportunity ranks among the most unfair societies in 2010.

10.1093/restud/rdab101.abstractZh: 关于分配偏好的实证研究表明，人们并不认为不平等本身存在问题，而是会考虑结果的公平性或不公平性。本文提出了一种对不公平不平等的构想，并引入了一种基于两个广泛认可的公平原则的不平等衡量方法：机会平等和免于贫困。我们开发了一种方法，可以将不平等及其趋势分解为不公平和公平两个组成部分。我们提供了两种实证应用案例。首先，从公平的角度分析了1969年至2014年间美国不平等的发展情况。其次，我们在2010年对美国与31个欧洲国家进行了相应的国际比较。我们的研究结果表明，不公平不平等与自1980年以来美国不平等增长的趋势一致。这一趋势是由社会流动性的下降所驱动的，即父母的教育水平和职业对孩子收入的影响日益重要。在我们进行的32个国家的国际比较中，机会之地在2010年属于最不公平的社会之一。

abstract.text: Each year in the US, hundreds of billions of dollars are spent on transportation infrastructure and billions of hours are lost in traffic. We develop a quantitative general equilibrium spatial framework featuring endogenous transportation costs and traffic congestion and apply it to evaluate the welfare impact of transportation infrastructure improvements. Our approach yields analytical expressions for transportation costs between any two locations, the traffic along each link of the transportation network, and the equilibrium distribution of economic activity across the economy, each as a function of the underlying quality of infrastructure and the strength of traffic congestion. We characterize the properties of such an equilibrium and show how the framework can be combined with traffic data to evaluate the impact of improving any segment of the infrastructure network. Applying our framework to both the US highway network and the Seattle road network, we find highly variable returns to investment across different links in the respective transportation networks, highlighting the importance of well-targeted infrastructure investment.

10.1093/restud/rdac001.abstractZh: 在美国，每年有数千亿美元用于交通基础设施的建设，同时也有数十亿小时的时间因交通拥堵而浪费。我们开发了一个定量的一般均衡空间框架，该框架考虑了交通成本与交通拥堵问题，并运用该框架来评估交通基础设施改善对福利的影响。我们的方法能够给出任意两个地点之间的交通成本、交通网络各节点的交通流量以及经济活动中各部分的均衡分布的数学表达式，这些表达式都取决于基础设施的基本质量和交通拥堵的严重程度。我们描述了这种均衡的特性，并展示了如何将这一框架与交通数据相结合，以评估改善基础设施任何部分所带来的影响。将我们的框架应用于美国高速公路网络和西雅图道路网络，我们发现不同交通网络中的不同节点之间的投资回报存在很大差异，这凸显了有针对性地投资基础设施的重要性。

abstract.text: To assign teachers to schools, a modified version of the well-known deferred acceptance mechanism has been proposed in the literature and is used in practice. We show that this mechanism fails to be fair and efficient for both teachers and schools. We identify a class of strategy-proof mechanisms that cannot be improved upon in terms of both efficiency and fairness. Using a rich dataset on teachers’ applications in France, we estimate teachers preferences and perform a counterfactual analysis. The results show that these mechanisms perform much better than the modified version of deferred acceptance. For instance, the number of teachers moving from their positions more than triples under our mechanism.

10.1093/restud/rdac002.abstractZh: 为了将教师分配到各个学校，文献中提出了一种改良版的延迟接受机制，该机制已在实践中得到应用。我们发现，这种机制在公平性和效率方面都未能满足教师和学校的需求。我们发现了一种策略免疫的机制类，这类机制在效率和公平性方面都无法得到改善。通过利用法国教师申请数据的丰富数据集，我们估算了教师的偏好，并进行了反事实分析。结果表明，这些机制的表现远优于改良版的延迟接受机制。例如，在我们的机制下，有教师离职的数量增加了两倍以上。

abstract.text: This article develops and estimates a dynamic model where individuals differ in ability and location preference to evaluate the mechanisms that affect the evolution of immigrants’ careers in conjunction with their re-migration plans. Our analysis highlights a novel form of selective return migration where those who plan to stay longer invest more into skill acquisition, with important implications for the assessment of immigrants’ career paths and the estimation of their earnings profiles. Our study also explains the willingness of immigrants to accept jobs at wages that seem unacceptable to natives. Finally, our model provides important insight for the design of migration policies, showing that policies that initially restrict residence or condition residence on achievement shape not only immigrants’ career profiles through their impact on human capital investment but also determine the selection of arrivals and leavers.

10.1093/restud/rdac003.abstractZh: 本文发展并估算了一个动态模型，该模型考虑了个体在能力和位置偏好上的差异，以评估影响移民职业发展及其再迁移计划的机制。我们的分析揭示了一种新型的选择性返回迁移现象，即那些计划长期留居的人会投入更多资源于技能提升，这对评估移民的职业发展路径和收入状况具有重要意义。我们的研究还解释了移民愿意接受对本地人来说难以接受的工作报酬的原因。最后，我们的模型为迁移政策的设计提供了重要启示，表明最初限制居住或要求以特定成就为条件的政策，不仅会通过影响人力资本投资来塑造移民的职业发展轨迹，还会决定移民的进入和离开选择。

abstract.text: This article documents a new set of stylized facts on how pricing moments depend on product age and emphasizes how this heterogeneity is crucial for the amplification of nominal shocks to the real economy. Exploiting information from a unique panel containing billions of transactions in the US consumer goods sector, we show that our empirical findings are consistent with a narrative in which firms face demand uncertainty and learn through prices. Such a mechanism of active learning from prices can strongly influence an economy’s aggregate price level and can thus be important for assessing the degree of monetary non-neutrality. To quantify this, we build a general equilibrium menu cost model with active learning and exogenous entry that features heterogeneity in pricing moments over the life cycle of products. Under this setup, firms engage in active learning to deal with uncertainty on their demand curves. Firms choose prices not only to maximize static profits but also to create signals to obtain valuable information on their demand. In the calibrated version of our model, the cumulative real effects of a nominal shock are approximately three times as large compared to a standard price-setting model. The main intuition behind this result is that active learning weakens the selection effect. Price changes are mainly determined by forces of active learning and, hence, become more orthogonal to aggregate shocks, which reduces the aggregate price flexibility of the economy.

10.1093/restud/rdac004.abstractZh: 本文记录了关于定价时刻如何依赖于产品生命周期的新一组实证数据，并强调了这种异质性对于名义冲击对实际经济影响的放大作用的重要性。我们利用一个包含数十亿美国消费品行业交易数据的独特面板数据，发现我们的实证结果与一种观点一致，即企业面临需求不确定性，并通过价格来学习如何应对。这种从价格中主动学习的机制可以显著影响经济的总体价格水平，因此对于评估货币的非中性程度具有重要意义。为了量化这一点，我们构建了一个具有主动学习和外部进入机制的一般均衡菜单成本模型，该模型在产品的生命周期内体现了定价时刻的异质性。在这种设定下，企业通过主动学习来应对需求曲线上的不确定性。企业选择价格不仅是为了最大化静态利润，也是为了传递信号，以获取有关其需求的宝贵信息。在我们模型的标准化版本中，名义冲击的累积实际影响大约是一个标准价格设定模型的三倍。这一结果背后的主要直觉是，主动学习削弱了选择效应。价格变动主要由主动学习的力量决定，因此与总体冲击更加正交，这降低了经济的总体价格灵活性。

abstract.text: An increasing number of households installing solar panels and consuming the energy thus produced raises two challenges for regulators: network financing and vertical equity. We propose alternative tariff and subsidy designs for policymakers to incentivize solar panel adoptions and guarantee that network costs are recovered, while trading off efficiency, equity, and welfare motives. We estimate a structural model of energy demand and solar panel adoption, using a unique matched dataset on energy consumption, prices, income, wealth, solar panel installations, and building characteristics for 165,000 households in Switzerland from 2008 to 2014. Our counterfactuals recommend the optimal solar panel installation cost subsidies and two-part energy tariffs to achieve a solar energy target. We show that, relative to installation cost subsidies, relying on marginal prices to incentivize solar panel adoptions is more cost efficient and progressive across the income distribution, but generates a larger aggregate welfare loss.

10.1093/restud/rdac005.abstractZh: 越来越多的家庭安装太阳能板并消耗由此产生的能源，这给监管机构带来了两个挑战：网络融资和垂直公平。我们为政策制定者提出了替代性的收费和补贴方案，以激励家庭安装太阳能板，并确保网络成本得到回收，同时平衡效率、公平和福利目标。我们基于2008至2014年间瑞士165,000户家庭的能源消耗、价格、收入、财富、太阳能板安装情况以及建筑特征等独特匹配数据，构建了一个能源需求和太阳能板安装行为的结构模型。我们的反事实分析建议，为了实现太阳能目标，应设定最优的太阳能板安装成本补贴和两部分组成的能源收费方案。研究表明，与安装成本补贴相比，依靠边际价格来激励家庭安装太阳能板在成本效益上更为高效，且能更好地惠及不同收入群体，但也会造成更大的总体福利损失。

abstract.text: The problem of demand inversion—a crucial step in the estimation of random utility discrete-choice models—is equivalent to the determination of stable outcomes in two-sided matching models. This equivalence applies to random utility models that are not necessarily additive, smooth, nor even invertible. Based on this equivalence, algorithms for the determination of stable matchings provide effective computational methods for estimating these models. For non-invertible models, the identified set of utility vectors is a lattice, and the matching algorithms recover sharp upper and lower bounds on the utilities. Our matching approach facilitates estimation of models that were previously difficult to estimate, such as the pure characteristics model. An empirical application to voting data from the 1999 European Parliament elections illustrates the good performance of our matching-based demand inversion algorithms in practice.

10.1093/restud/rdac006.abstractZh: 需求反转问题——在估计随机效用离散选择模型中的关键步骤——等同于在双边匹配模型中确定稳定结果。这种等价性适用于不一定是可加性、平滑性，甚至不可逆的随机效用模型。基于这种等价性，用于确定稳定匹配的算法为估计这些模型提供了有效的计算方法。对于不可逆模型，所确定的效用向量集合是一个格子结构，匹配算法能够恢复效用的精确上下界。我们的匹配方法有助于估计以前难以估计的模型，例如纯特征模型。通过对1999年欧洲议会选举的投票数据进行实证分析，证明了基于匹配的需求反转算法在实际应用中的良好性能。

abstract.text: In 2008, Volkswagen introduced a new generation of “Clean Diesel” cars and heavily marketed them to environmentally conscious US consumers. Unknown to the public, these cars were anything but clean, emitting pollutants up to 150 times the level of comparable gas-fuelled cars. We study the rollout of these emissions-cheating diesel cars across the United States from 2008 to 2015 as a natural experiment to examine the impact of moderate levels of car pollution on infant and child health in the general population. Using the universe of vehicle registrations, we find that an additional cheating diesel car per 1,000 cars increases $\mathrm{PM_{2.5}}$, $\mathrm{PM_{10}}$, and ozone by 2, 2.2, and 1.3$\%$, respectively, while the low birth weight rate and infant mortality rate increase by 1.9 and 1.7$\%$, respectively. Similar impacts are found for acute asthma attacks in children. These health impacts occur at all pollution levels and across the socioeconomic spectrum.

10.1093/restud/rdac007.abstractZh: 2008年，大众汽车推出了新一代“清洁柴油”汽车，并大力向具有环保意识的美国消费者推广。然而，公众并不清楚这些汽车实际上并不清洁，其排放污染物是同类汽油车水平的150倍。本研究以2008至2015年间这些排放作弊柴油汽车在美国的推广为自然实验，探讨中等程度的汽车污染对普通人群婴儿和儿童健康的影响。通过车辆注册数据，我们发现每1000辆作弊柴油汽车增加2%、2.2%和1.3%的$\mathrm{PM_{2.5}}$、$\mathrm{PM_{10}}$和臭氧浓度，同时低出生体重率和婴儿死亡率分别增加1.9%和1.7%。对于儿童急性哮喘发作也发现了类似的影响。这些健康影响在各种污染水平下以及不同社会经济阶层中均存在。

abstract.text: We study people’s subjective models of the macroeconomy and shed light on their attentional foundations. To do so, we measure beliefs about the effects of macroeconomic shocks on unemployment and inflation, providing respondents with identical information about the parameters of the shocks and previous realizations of macroeconomic variables. Within samples of 6,500 US households and 1,500 experts, beliefs are widely dispersed, even about the directional effects of shocks, and there are large differences in average beliefs between households and experts. Part of this disagreement seems to arise because respondents think of different propagation channels of the shocks, in particular demand- vs. supply-side mechanisms. We provide evidence on the role of associative memory in driving heterogeneity in thoughts and forecasts: contextual cues and prior experiences shape which propagation channels individuals retrieve and thereby which forecasts they make. Our findings offer a new perspective on the widely documented disagreement in macroeconomic expectations.

10.1093/restud/rdac008.abstractZh: 我们研究了人们对宏观经济的主观认知模型，并揭示了其注意力基础。为此，我们测量了受访者对宏观经济冲击对失业和通货膨胀影响的看法，同时向受访者提供了关于冲击参数以及宏观经济变量历史表现的相同信息。在6,500个美国家庭和1,500位专家的样本中，受访者对冲击方向性的看法存在较大差异，且家庭与专家之间的平均看法也存在很大不同。这种分歧部分源于受访者对冲击传播渠道的不同理解，尤其是需求与供给方面的机制差异。我们有证据表明，联想记忆在驱动观点和预测差异中起着重要作用：上下文线索和先前经验决定了个体会参考哪些传播渠道，从而形成不同的预测。我们的发现为广泛存在的宏观经济预期分歧提供了新的视角。

abstract.text: Since the collapse of the Bretton Woods monetary system, the monies of the developed world have been unbacked by any formal promise of convertibility. Yet, inflation has typically undershot, not overshot, central bank targets over the past couple decades. The low, while generally positive, inflation rate has (more arguably) been associated with low output and low growth. In this article, I consider these observations through the lens of a class of representative agent rational expectations models with nominal (price-setting) frictions and the possibility of firm entry/exit. I show that for any level of nominal frictions (no matter how small) and for any monetary policy rule that satisfies a set of weak restrictions, there is a large set of equilibria that exhibit permanently low inflation, low output, and low nominal interest rates. These equilibria can only exhibit positive long-run inflation if growth is low and the specification of nominal frictions (i.e. the Phillips curve) takes an unconventional but nonetheless empirically plausible form.

10.1093/restud/rdac009.abstractZh: 自布雷顿森林体系崩溃以来，发达国家的货币已不再有任何正式的兑换承诺作为支撑。然而，在过去的几十年里，通货膨胀率通常低于央行设定的目标，而非超过目标。虽然较低的通货膨胀率总体上是积极的，但更确切地说，它与低产出和低经济增长有关。在本文中，我通过一类具有名义价格设定摩擦以及企业进入/退出可能性的代表性代理人理性预期模型来探讨这些现象。研究表明，无论名义摩擦的幅度如何微小，只要任何货币政策规则满足一系列弱限制条件，就存在大量能够实现长期低通货膨胀、低产出和低名义利率的均衡状态。这些均衡状态只有在经济增长较低且名义摩擦的设定方式（即菲利普斯曲线）具有非传统但经实证验证的合理形式时，才能表现出正的通货膨胀率。

abstract.text: Should regulators encourage the migration of trade from over-the-counter (OTC) to centralized markets? To address this question, we study a model in which banks make costly decisions to participate in an OTC market, a centralized market, or both markets at the same time. Banks differ in their ability to take large positions, what we call their trading capacity. In equilibrium, intermediate-capacity banks find it optimal to participate in the centralized market. In contrast, low- and high-capacity banks find it optimal to participate in the OTC market, due to an endogenous complementarity. Namely, low-capacity banks receive worse terms of trade than in the centralized market but better risk sharing, thanks to the intermediation services offered by high-capacity banks. High-capacity banks receive worse risk sharing than in the centralized market, but profit from the provision of intermediation services to low-capacity banks. While the social optimum has qualitatively similar participation patterns, it prescribes that more customers migrate to the centralized market, and that more dealers enter the OTC market.

10.1093/restud/rdac010.abstractZh: 监管者是否应该鼓励交易从场外市场转向集中市场？为了回答这个问题，我们研究了一个模型，其中银行需要做出成本较高的决策，来决定是参与场外市场、集中市场，还是同时参与两个市场。不同银行的交易能力各不相同。在均衡状态下，中等交易能力的银行认为参与集中市场是最优选择。相反，低交易能力和高交易能力的银行认为参与场外市场是最优选择，这是由于一种内生性的互补性。具体来说，低交易能力的银行虽然在集中市场中的交易条件较差，但由于高交易能力银行提供的中介服务，他们在风险分担方面可以获得更好的条件。高交易能力的银行虽然在集中市场中的风险分担条件较差，但他们可以通过为低交易能力银行提供中介服务来获得利润。虽然社会最优的参与模式在性质上相似，但这一模式要求更多的客户转向集中市场，同时有更多的交易商进入场外市场。

abstract.text: Facing the same labour demand shock through imports from China, we show that men and women make different labour market and family adjustments that result in significant long-run gender inequality. The gender gap is driven by the female biological clock. Using population registers and matched employer-employee data from Denmark, we document that especially women in their late 30s, towards the end of their biological clock, decide to have a baby as the shock causes displacement. High-earning women in leadership positions and women who need to acquire new human capital are central because their new employment would require particularly high investments that are incompatible with having a newborn in the short time remaining on the biological clock. While children penalize women in the labour market, we show that due to the biological clock an otherwise gender-neutral shock leads to a gender gap in the labour market.

10.1093/restud/rdac012.abstractZh: 面对来自中国的劳动力需求冲击，我们发现男性和女性在劳动力市场和家庭安排上做出了不同的调整，这导致了长期的性别不平等。性别差距是由女性的生物钟所驱动的。通过丹麦的人口登记数据和雇主与员工匹配的数据，我们发现尤其是30多岁的女性，在生物钟即将结束之际，会因为冲击导致的生活变动而决定生育孩子。那些收入较高且处于领导职位的女性，以及需要获取新人力资本的女性，她们的新就业需要特别高的投资，这与在生物钟剩余的时间内拥有新生儿是不相容的。虽然孩子会对女性在劳动力市场产生负面影响，但我们发现，由于生物钟的作用，原本没有性别差异的冲击也导致了劳动力市场的性别差距。

abstract.text: PURPOSE OF REVIEW: The purpose of this review is to evaluate the current recommendations for management of perioperative anaemia in patients undergoing thoracic surgery, present the impact of anaemia on outcomes in this patient population and suggest an algorithm for evaluating and treating anaemia preoperatively. RECENT FINDINGS: Anaemia is a common medical issue noted preoperatively in patients presenting for thoracic surgery and carries significant morbidity. Preoperative anaemia increases the likelihood of receiving a perioperative transfusion, which represents a significant risk factor for morbidity and reduced disease-free survival in lung cancer patients presenting for thoracic surgery. It is also associated with longer hospital lengths of stay and increased risk for reoperation following lung transplantation. An algorithm-based approach to management of anaemia is beneficial and treatment with iron has been shown to reduce transfusions. SUMMARY: Patients undergoing thoracic surgery have a high incidence of preoperative anaemia that increases the risk of transfusion and postoperative morbidity. Preoperative evaluation and tailored treatment based on the underlying cause of anaemia reduces the incidence of anaemia prior to surgery and decreases transfusion rates.

10.1097/aco.0000000000001214.abstractZh: 综述目的：本综述旨在评估目前关于胸外科患者围手术期贫血管理的建议，分析贫血对该患者群体预后的影响，并提出一种术前评估和治疗贫血的算法。最新研究结果表明，贫血是胸外科患者术前常见的医学问题，并会带来显著的发病率。术前贫血会增加围手术期输血的可能性，而输血是肺癌患者胸外科手术中发病率和疾病无生存时间降低的重要风险因素。此外，贫血还与更长的住院时间和肺移植后再次手术的风险增加有关。采用基于算法的贫血管理方法是有益的，而铁剂治疗已被证明可以减少输血需求。总结：接受胸外科手术的患者普遍存在术前贫血现象，这会增加输血风险和术后发病率。通过术前评估并根据贫血的根本原因进行个性化治疗，可以降低手术前的贫血发生率，并减少输血率。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Effective January 1, 2021, US hospitals were required to upload information on their chargemaster prices (database of list prices), discounted cash prices (commonly charged to self-pay patients), and payer-specific negotiated prices. OBJECTIVE: Examine how prices vary and are associated with hospital characteristics, market competition, and hospital quality. DESIGN SETTING AND PARTICIPANTS: This observational study used data on 14 common medical services across 1599 hospitals in 2021. Descriptive and regression analyses were used to study price variation. Analyses adjust for hospital characteristics, market competition and state fixed effects. RESULTS: Ninetieth -to-10th-percentile price markups factors (ratios) range between 3.2 and 11.5 for chargemaster; 6.1 and 19.7 for cash; and 6.6 and 30.0 for negotiated prices. Adjusted regression results indicate that hospitals' cash prices are on average 60% ( P <0.01) higher, and list prices are on average 164% ( P <0.01) higher, than negotiated prices. Systematic pricing differences across hospitals were noted, with urban hospitals having 14% ( P <0.01) lower prices than rural hospitals, teaching hospitals having 3% ( P <0.01) higher prices than nonteaching hospitals, and nonprofit hospitals pricing 9% ( P <0.01), and for-profit hospitals 39% ( P <0.01), higher than government owned hospitals. In addition, hospitals that contract with more insurance plans have higher prices, hospitals in more competitive markets have lower prices, and higher quality hospitals have on average 5% ( P <0.01) lower prices than lower quality hospitals. CONCLUSIONS: Prices all vary considerably across US hospitals. High quality hospitals are associated with lower pricing across all three sets of prices examined. Hospital price transparency may help consumers better identify hospitals that provide both high quality, and low cost, care.

10.1097/mlr.0000000000001761.abstractZh:
背景：自2021年1月1日起，美国医院被要求上传有关其费用清单价格、折扣后的现金价格以及与支付方协商确定的价格的信息。  
目的：研究价格的变化情况及其与医院特征、市场竞争力和医院质量之间的关系。  
研究设计及参与者：本研究采用2021年1599家医院14项常见医疗服务的数据，通过描述性分析和回归分析来研究价格差异。分析过程中考虑了医院特征、市场竞争状况以及州级固定效应。  
结果：费用清单价格的最高与最低价格比率在3.2到11.5之间；现金价格的比率则在6.1到19.7之间；而协商确定的价格比率则在6.6到30.0之间。调整后的回归结果显示，医院的现金价格平均比协商价格高出60%（P<0.01），而费用清单价格则高出164%（P<0.01）。研究发现，不同医院之间存在系统性价格差异：城市医院的价格比农村医院低14%（P<0.01）；教学医院的价格比非教学医院高3%（P<0.01）；非营利医院的价格比公立医院高9%（P<0.01），而营利医院则高出39%（P<0.01）。此外，与更多保险计划合作的医院价格较高，竞争较为激烈的市场中的医院价格较低，而质量较高的医院价格平均比质量较低的医院低5%（P<0.01）。  
结论：美国各医院的价格差异较大。质量较高的医院在三种价格类别中的价格都较低。医院价格透明度可以帮助消费者更好地识别那些能够提供高质量且低成本医疗服务的医院。

abstract.text: Purpose The aim of this paper is to document the impact of competition on managerial practices adopted by small and medium enterprises (SMEs). Design/methodology/approach The paper uses the data provided by the World Bank’s Enterprise Surveys to test the arguments presented in this paper. The data were collected during the period between 2013 and 2014 and the sample consists of firms from Egypt, Jordan, Lebanon, Tunisia and Yemen. Findings The authors show that SMEs with higher exposure to competition are more likely to adopt better managerial practices than SMEs with lower exposure to competition. The authors argue that competition disciplines the managers by exposing firms to the possibility of bankruptcy and/or the loss of market share to competitors. Therefore, these firms are compelled to adopt good managerial practices to protect themselves against negative impact of competition. The results show that positive impact of competition on managerial practices is confined only to the competition that comes from foreign competitors. Local competitors or competitors from informal sector have no significant impact on the adoption of good managerial practices. Originality/value An important contribution of this paper is that it documents how various types of competition affect SME’s decision to adopt better managerial practices. Another important contribution is highlighting of the role played by the competition in shaping the management practices among SMEs in the MENA (Middle East and North Africa) region.

10.1108/jeas-09-2021-0197.abstractZh: 目的  本文旨在记录竞争对中小企业所采取的管理实践的影响。  设计/方法/途径  本文利用世界银行企业调查提供的数据来验证文中提出的观点。数据收集于2013至2014年间，样本包括来自埃及、约旦、黎巴嫩、突尼斯和也门的企業。  研究结果  研究指出，面临更多竞争的中小企业更有可能采取更好的管理实践。作者认为，竞争通过迫使企業面临破产或市场份额丧失的风险，从而约束管理者，因此这些企業不得不采取良好的管理实践以抵御竞争的负面影响。研究结果显示，竞争对管理实践的积极影响仅来自外国竞争对手的竞争，而本地竞争对手或非正式行业中的竞争对手对良好管理实践的采纳没有显著影响。  创新性/价值  本文的重要贡献在于记录了不同类型竞争如何影响中小企业采纳更好管理实践的决策。另一个重要贡献是强调了竞争在塑造中东和北非地区中小企业管理实践中的作用。

abstract.text: There is a prevailing popular belief that expenditure on management by health‐care providers is wasteful, diverts resources from patient care, and distracts medical and nursing staff from getting on with their jobs. There is little existing evidence to support either this narrative or counter‐claims. We explore the relationship between management and public sector hospital performance using a fixed effects empirical econometric specification on a panel data set consisting of all 129 non‐specialist acute National Health Service (NHS) hospitals in England for the financial years 2012/13 to 2018/19. Measures of managerial input and quality of management practice are constructed from NHS Electronic Staff Records and NHS Staff Survey data. Hospital accounts and Hospital Episode Statistics data are used to construct five measures of financial performance and of timely and high‐quality care. We find no evidence of association either between quantity of management and management quality or directly between quantity of management and any of our measures of hospital performance. However, there is some evidence that higher‐quality management is associated with better performance. NHS managers have limited discretion in performing their managerial functions, being tightly circumscribed by official guidance, targets, and other factors outside their control. Given these constraints, our findings are unsurprising.

10.1111/1475-5890.12293.abstractZh: 有一种普遍的看法认为，医疗服务提供者用于管理的支出是浪费的，会分散资源，影响医务人员和护理人员的正常工作。然而，目前几乎没有证据支持这种观点或反驳它。我们利用固定效应计量经济学模型，对英格兰所有129家非专科急性国家卫生服务医院在2012/13至2018/19财年的数据进行了研究，探讨了管理活动与公共部门医院绩效之间的关系。管理投入和管理实践质量的指标是根据国家卫生服务电子员工记录和员工调查数据构建的。医院账目和医院病例统计数据被用来构建五个财务绩效指标以及及时且高质量的护理指标。我们发现，管理活动的数量与管理质量之间，或者管理活动的数量与我们构建的医院绩效指标之间，并没有明显的关联。不过，有一些证据表明，更高质量的管理与更好的绩效相关。国家卫生服务的管理者在执行管理职能时，其自由度有限，受到官方指导、目标以及其他无法控制的因素的影响。鉴于这些限制，我们的研究结果并不令人惊讶。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: To investigate whether accounting for past patient composition in evaluations of the association between public quality reports and patient selectivity changes findings and conclusions. DATA SOURCES: Secondary data analysis of public reports of Assisted Reproductive Technology Clinic success rates between 2011 and 2018. STUDY DESIGN: Two sets of fixed effects models, (1) a standard fixed-effects model (FE) and (2) a dynamic panel model using structural equation modeling estimated with maximum-likelihood (ML-SEM) with one- and two-year lagged patient characteristics, are compared. The outcome variables are patient composition features associated with success rates, including two age categories and eight diagnoses of infertility. Two-year lagged success rates for any live birth and a singleton live birth are central predictor variables. DATA COLLECTION/EXTRACTION METHODS: Clinics with complete records for the 2011-2018 period were included (N = 303). PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: For live birth success rates, the two models show increases in the two-year lagged success rate is associated with a reduction in (1) the transformed percentage of patients with endometriosis (FE: β = -0.006, SE = 0.002, p < 0.01; ML-SEM: β = -0.005, SE = 0.002, p < 0.01) and (2) the percentage of patients with tubal diagnoses (FE: β = -0.090, SE = 0.017, p < 0.001; ML-SEM: β = -0.064, SE = 0.027, p < 0.05). For singleton birth success rates, the models show positive associations between the two-year lagged success rate and the percent of patients over 35 years old (FE: β = 0.219, SE = 0.033, p < 0.001; ML-SEM: β = 0.095, SE = 0.047, p < 0.05). Overall, the FE models show numerous significant associations with the two-year lagged success rate not observed in the ML-SEM models. Thus, the preferred and theoretically appropriate model (ML-SEM) and the more commonly used model (FE) yield different results. CONCLUSIONS: Researchers and policymakers should use models that account for past patient composition when evaluating the associations between quality reports and patient selectivity.

10.1111/1475-6773.13942.abstractZh: 目的：研究在评估公共质量报告与患者选择之间的关联时，是否考虑过去的患者构成会对研究结果和结论产生影响。数据来源：对2011年至2018年间辅助生殖技术诊所成功率的公共报告进行二次数据分析。研究设计：比较了两组固定效应模型：(1)标准固定效应模型，以及(2)使用结构方程建模的动态面板模型，并采用最大似然法进行估计，同时考虑了一年和两年的患者特征滞后变量。结果变量是与成功率相关的患者构成特征，包括两个年龄类别和八种不孕症诊断。两年滞后后的任何活产率和单胎活产率是核心预测变量。数据收集/提取方法：纳入了2011-2018年期间有完整记录的诊所（N = 303）。主要发现：对于活产成功率，两种模型均显示，两年滞后后的成功率与以下两个指标的减少相关：(1)经过转换后的子宫内膜异位症患者的比例（固定效应模型：β = -0.006，SE = 0.002，p < 0.01；结构方程模型：β = -0.005，SE = 0.002，p < 0.01）；(2)输卵管诊断患者的比例（固定效应模型：β = -0.090，SE = 0.017，p < 0.001；结构方程模型：β = -0.064，SE = 0.027，p < 0.05）。对于单胎活产成功率，模型显示两年滞后后的成功率与35岁以上患者的比例之间存在正相关（固定效应模型：β = 0.219，SE = 0.033，p < 0.001；结构方程模型：β = 0.095，SE = 0.047，p < 0.05）。总体而言，固定效应模型显示了许多与两年滞后后的成功率相关的显著关联，而这些关联在结构方程模型中并未观察到。因此，理论上的优选模型（ML-SEM）与更常用的模型（FE）会得出不同的结果。结论：研究人员和政策制定者在评估质量报告与患者选择之间的关联时，应使用能够考虑过去患者构成情况的模型。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: To estimate the effect of wait times on patients' choice of provider and simulate changes in choice of provider due to compliance with VA MISSION Act wait time targets. DATA SOURCES: We use nationwide administrative data (2014-2017) on Veterans who are enrolled in Medicare and the Veterans Health Administration (VHA), the Survey of VHA Enrollees, Area Health Resource Files, and other data provided by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services. STUDY DESIGN: We use an instrumental variables approach to identify the effect of VHA wait times on the proportion of total (Medicare and VHA) services that are paid for by the VHA ("reliance"). We exploit shocks to VHA provider supply to isolate supply-driven changes in wait times and estimate the effect on VHA reliance. We control for market and time fixed effects and local demand factors. DATA COLLECTION/EXTRACTION METHODS: We use monthly aggregated data on 140 markets (groups of counties). VHA reliance is computed among patients aged 65 years or older who are dually enrolled in VHA and Medicare. VHA wait times and reliance are calculated for multiple specialties: cardiology, gastroenterology, orthopedics, urology, dermatology, and ophthalmology/optometry. PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: A 10% increase in the mean wait time (+2.8 days) reduces VHA reliance by 2.3 percentage points (95% CI: 2.3, 2.7), or 7.9% of the sample mean. This implies that meeting the MISSION Act wait time targets may have multi-billion-dollar budgetary impacts. Effects vary across specialties. For example, a 10% increase in the mean wait time for cardiology services (+2.0 days) reduces reliance by 1.8 percentage points (95% CI: 1.6, 2.1), or 6.3% of the sample mean for cardiology services. CONCLUSIONS: Meeting statutory wait time targets may have substantial unforeseen impacts on federal health care spending as patients sort to providers who have lower wait times.

10.1111/1475-6773.13950.abstractZh:
目的：评估等待时间对患者选择医疗服务提供者的影响，并模拟由于遵守《退伍军人事务部医疗保险法》的等待时间目标而导致的医疗服务提供者选择变化。  
数据来源：我们使用2014-2017年的全国行政数据，这些数据涉及在医疗保险和退伍军人健康管理局注册的退伍军人，还包括退伍军人健康管理局注册用户调查、地区健康资源文件，以及医疗保险和医疗补助服务局提供的数据。  
研究设计：我们采用工具变量方法来识别退伍军人健康管理局的等待时间对由该机构支付的总服务比例（“依赖度”）的影响。我们利用退伍军人健康管理局医疗服务提供者供应的冲击，来分离由供应因素驱动的等待时间变化，并估计其对依赖度的影响。我们控制了市场和时间固定效应以及当地需求因素。  
数据收集/提取方法：我们使用每月汇总的数据，涵盖140个市场（县组）。退伍军人健康管理局的依赖度是在65岁或以上的患者中计算的，这些患者同时注册了退伍军人健康管理局和医疗保险。我们为多个专科计算了退伍军人健康管理局的等待时间和依赖度：心脏病学、胃肠病学、骨科、泌尿学、皮肤病学和眼科/验光学。  
主要发现：平均等待时间增加10%（+2.8天）会使退伍军人健康管理局的依赖度降低2.3个百分点（95%置信区间：2.3, 2.7），或占样本平均值的7.9%。这意味着满足《退伍军人事务部医疗保险法》的等待时间目标可能会带来数十亿美元的预算影响。不同专科的影响有所不同。例如，心脏病学服务的平均等待时间增加10%（+2.0天）会使依赖度降低1.8个百分点（95%置信区间：1.6, 2.1），或占心脏病学服务样本平均值的6.3%。结论：达到法定的等待时间目标可能会对联邦医疗保健支出产生重大的、意想不到的影响，因为患者会倾向于选择等待时间更短的医疗服务提供者。

abstract.text: Climate change has increased the frequency and severity of weather-related disasters such as hurricanes, exposure to heat and cold temperatures, flooding events, and wildfires.Between 1980 and 2020, the United States incurred 285 separate billion-dollar weather-related disasters.1 In 2020, there were 22 billion-dollar events, including seven hurricanes, three tornadoes, eight severe weather events, two hail storms, a historic drought, and a wildfire.1 Prior studies have repeatedly demonstrated that exposure to natural disasters has significant effects on the 1.4 million nursing home (NH) residents around the US. 2 Recognizing that the effects of most disasters are local but require the assistance of federal and state agencies, it is imperative that stakeholders assess for vulnerabilities and strengthen their preparedness to respond to all-hazards disasters.2,3 In 2017, the Institute of Healthcare Improvement (IHI) and the John A. Hartford Foundation introduced a framework for evaluating age-friendly healthcare systems based on four evidence-based core elements.4 We believe that this 4M's paradigm (What Matters, Medication, Mentation, and Mobility) provides a foundation upon which to consider a more nuanced approach to NH disaster preparedness.Specifically, this requires the application of the 4M model to all phases of disasters (i.e., prevention, mitigation, preparedness response, and recovery).Research has found that the consistent use of evidencebased strategies and assessment approaches across care settings, as envisioned by the 4Ms framework, improves the quality of outcomes.5 We propose that such an approach has the potential to improve disaster preparedness in NHs.This commentary describes the 4M's paradigm and how it might guide emergency planning and decision making in NHs facing complex disasters.We also propose the addition of a fifth M that is relevant to disaster planning: Marshaling Staff and Resources.

10.1111/1475-6773.14043.abstractZh: 气候变化增加了与天气相关的灾害的频率和严重程度，如飓风、高温和低温暴露、洪水事件以及野火。在1980年至2020年间，美国发生了285起造成数十亿美元损失的天气相关灾害。2020年，发生了22起造成数十亿美元损失的事件，其中包括7次飓风、3次龙卷风、8次严重天气事件、2次冰雹天气、一次历史性干旱以及一次野火。先前的研究多次表明，自然灾害对美国约140万养老院居民产生了重大影响。鉴于大多数灾害的影响都是局部性的，但需要联邦和州政府的协助，因此利益相关者必须评估潜在的脆弱性，并加强应对各种灾害的准备工作。2017年，医疗保健改进研究所（IHI）和约翰·A·哈特福德基金会提出了一个基于四个基于证据的核心要素来评估适合老年人使用的医疗系统的框架。我们认为，这4个要素——需求评估、药物管理、心理支持以及行动便利——为更细致地考虑NH地区的灾难准备提供了基础。具体而言，这要求将4M模型应用于灾难的所有阶段，包括预防、缓解、应对和恢复。研究表明，如4M框架所设想的那样，在各类护理环境中持续采用基于证据的策略和评估方法，可以提高治疗效果。我们建议，这种方法有可能提升NH地区的灾难准备水平。本文还阐述了4M框架如何指导面临复杂灾难的NH地区的应急规划和决策制定，并提出了增加第五个要素的建议：人员与资源的调配。

abstract.text: Although diversion ratios are important inputs to merger evaluation, there is little evidence about how accurately discrete choice models predict diversions. Using a series of natural disasters that unexpectedly closed hospitals, we compare observed post‐disaster diversion ratios to those predicted from pre‐disaster data using standard models of hospital demand. We find that all standard models consistently underpredict large diversions. Both unobserved heterogeneity in preferences over travel and post‐disaster changes to physician practice patterns can explain some of the underprediction of large diversions. We find a significant improvement using models with a random coefficient on distance.

10.1111/1756-2171.12421.abstractZh: 尽管转移比率是合并评估中的重要因素，但关于离散选择模型在预测转移方面的准确性，目前缺乏足够的证据。我们通过一系列意外导致医院关闭的自然灾害事件，将实际观察到的灾后转移比率与使用标准医院需求模型预测的灾后转移比率进行比较。我们发现，所有标准模型都一致地低估了大规模的转移情况。对旅行偏好的未观测异质性和灾后医生执业模式的变化可以解释部分大规模转移被低估的原因。我们发现，使用距离随机系数的模型能够显著改善预测效果。

abstract.text: Clinical labs belong to a mature industry and fulfill a critical function in the health‐care value chain. We examine factors that influence the opportunity, motivation, and ability to learn in clinical labs. We hypothesize that with respect to learning about cost: (i) organizational design, such as the extent of outsourcing can impede the opportunity to learn, (ii) quality focus (measured by mortality rates and length of stay (LOS)) can reduce the motivation to learn, and (iii) related task variety (measured by product‐mix breadth) and information technology investments can enhance the ability to learn. Our empirical tests calibrate learning effects on disaggregate (technical and supervisory hours and cost) and aggregate (salary and total direct cost) cost and time pools. Using longitudinal data from clinical labs in California for the period 1997–2015, we find that clinical labs with greater cumulative output have lower average costs, consistent with learning effects in clinical labs. We also find results consistent with our hypotheses about the contextual factors that influence learning rates in clinical labs. Our findings contribute to a better understanding of learning rates with implications for budgeting, forecasting, and performance measurement. The results highlight that learning can be a crucial source of cost reduction in health‐care settings.

10.1111/1911-3846.12818.abstractZh: 临床实验室属于一个成熟的行业，在医疗保健价值链中发挥着至关重要的作用。我们研究了影响临床实验室学习机会、动机和学习能力的因素。我们假设，在成本方面：(i) 组织设计，例如外包的程度可能会阻碍学习机会；(ii) 质量关注点（通过死亡率和住院时间来衡量）可能会降低学习动机；(iii) 相关任务多样性（通过产品组合广度来衡量）和信息技术投资可以增强学习能力。我们的实证测试对分解后的成本和时间池以及综合成本和时间池的学习效应进行了校准。利用1997年至2015年间加利福尼亚州临床实验室的纵向数据，我们发现累计产出较高的临床实验室平均成本较低，这与临床实验室的学习效应一致。我们还发现了与我们的假设一致的结果，即影响临床实验室学习率的情境因素。我们的发现有助于更好地理解学习率，并对预算编制、预测和绩效评估具有重要意义。结果表明，学习可以成为医疗保健环境中降低成本的关键来源。

abstract.text: The English hospital sector underwent a major restructuring program between 2000 and 2008 to centralize activity in fewer and larger hospitals. The aim of this paper is to evaluate the effects of such consolidations on hospital outputs. As mergers occurred in a staggered way, treatment could start and end at every time and treatment duration varied over the years. As every time is a mix of hospital pre‐treatment, treatment and post‐treatment phases, the canonical difference‐in‐differences assumption of homogeneous policy effects is not only meaningless but also misleading, raising doubts about the appropriateness of the methods previously used in this literature and consequently the accuracy of its results. We instead adopt a new matching and difference‐in‐differences approach, the flexible conditional difference‐in‐differences approach, developed by Dettmann et al. in 2020, more appropriate for causal analysis of treatments characterized by varying start dates and varying treatment duration. Our results suggest that mergers downsize hospital activities, especially the most expensive ones. If the goal of hospital mergers is to gain efficiency by centralization of activity, our findings suggest this restructuring programme is not the most successful policy to pursue. Mergers reduce the scope for competition between hospitals and do not create any incentive for poorly performing hospitals.

10.1111/apce.12374.abstractZh: 英国医院行业在2000年至2008年间实施了一项重大重组计划，旨在将活动集中在数量更少但规模更大的医院中。本文旨在评估这种整合对医院运营效果的影响。由于合并是分阶段进行的，治疗开始和结束的时间各不相同，且治疗持续时间也随时间变化。由于每次治疗都包括治疗前、治疗中和治疗后的阶段，因此采用同质政策效果的规范差异-差异假设不仅毫无意义，而且还会误导研究，从而质疑之前文献中使用的方法的适用性，以及结果的准确性。我们采用了一种新的匹配和差异-差异方法，即Dettmann等人在2020年提出的灵活条件差异-差异方法，该方法更适合分析具有不同开始时间和不同治疗持续时间的治疗情况。我们的研究结果表明，合并会缩小医院的活动规模，尤其是那些成本最高的医院。如果医院合并的目的是通过活动集中化来提高效率，那么我们的研究发现表明，这种重组计划并非最成功的政策选择。合并减少了医院之间的竞争，也没有为表现不佳的医院提供任何激励。

abstract.text: We consider the strategic incentives to invest in an environment where suppliers compete with nonexclusive contracts. When trade is nonexclusive, that is, the buyer relates with many suppliers simultaneously, the buyer's investment affects her outside option when excluding a supplier. The buyer's investment allows for cheaper substitution of the trade loss arising from the excluded supplier. In equilibrium, even though each supplier fully appropriates the investment return it receives in isolation, the buyer wants to invest to gain leverage over competing suppliers. Our model uncovers an essential role of nonexclusive contracts because they promote the buyer to invest.

10.1111/ecin.13074.abstractZh: 我们考虑在供应商通过非独家合同进行竞争的环境中对投资进行战略激励的问题。当交易是非独家的，即买家同时与多个供应商进行交易时，买家的投资会影响其在排除某个供应商后的外部选择。买家的投资使得因被排除的供应商而导致的交易损失可以通过更便宜的替代方案来弥补。在均衡状态下，尽管每个供应商都完全独占其独立获得的投资回报，但买家仍然愿意投资以在竞争供应商中获得优势。我们的模型揭示了非独家合同在促进买家投资方面所扮演的重要角色。

abstract.text: This article develops and estimates a dynamic oligopoly model to study the multilevel adoption of electronic medical records in U.S. hospitals. I find substantial competitive effects in the adoption process, and hospitals of the same adoption level compete more intensely than hospitals of different levels do. Counterfactual experiments suggest that competitive effects prompt hospitals to engage in preemptive adoption and greatly deter the second adopter in a duopoly market. By evaluating the government's subsidy policy enacted in 2009, I find that a policy strategy accounting for market and hospital heterogeneity and competitive effects would have been more effective in stimulating adoption.

10.1111/iere.12586.abstractZh: 本文发展并估算了一个动态寡头垄断模型，用于研究美国医院中电子病历的多层次采用情况。我发现，在采用过程中存在显著的竞争效应，同一采用水平的医院之间的竞争比不同水平的医院更为激烈。反事实实验表明，竞争效应促使医院采取先发采用策略，并显著抑制了双寡头市场中的第二采用者。通过评估2009年实施的政府补贴政策，我发现，如果政策考虑市场与医院的异质性以及竞争效应，将会更有效地促进采用。

abstract.text: This article investigates the challenges of ageing for long‐term care. The analysis proceeds in three steps. In the first step, we estimate the prospective care demand for 30 developed countries based on projected ageing and disabilities among the elderly. In the second step, we outline challenges for care systems with respect to shortages of care workers, increasing skill requirements for care workers, barriers to universal and equitable access to care, and cost containment subject to adequate care quality. In the third step, we identify solutions for these challenges by comparing the care systems of Germany, Israel, Japan, the Republic of Korea and the Netherlands.

10.1111/issr.12307.abstractZh: 本文探讨了老龄化对长期护理带来的挑战。分析分为三个步骤进行。第一步，我们基于预计的老龄化和老年人残疾情况，估算了30个发达国家未来对护理服务的需求。第二步，我们概述了护理体系面临的挑战，包括护理人员的短缺、护理人员技能要求的提高、获得护理服务的障碍以及如何在保证足够护理质量的前提下控制成本。第三步，我们通过比较德国、以色列、日本、韩国和荷兰的护理体系，为这些挑战寻找解决方案。

abstract.text: We used a randomized management consulting intervention with 80 public‐sector healthcare facilities in Nigeria to study the role of information, training, and supervision on the adoption of improved organizational practices. Facilities that received detailed improvement plans and 9 months of implementation support—including regular visits to monitor progress and set intermediate goals related to the plans—showed large, significant short‐term effects on the adoption of practices that were under the responsibility of facility staff. Facilities that received general improvement advice but no implementation support showed no change in practices. Implementation support appears crucial for improvements, especially in contexts without market incentives for the adoption of effective managerial practices.

10.1111/jems.12471.abstractZh: 我们采用随机化的管理咨询干预措施，对尼日利亚的80家公共部门医疗机构进行了研究，探讨信息、培训和监督在促进改进组织实践方面的作用。那些获得了详细改进计划以及为期9个月的实施支持（包括定期访问以监测进展并设定与计划相关的中期目标）的医疗机构，在短期内对由机构员工负责的实践改进取得了显著成效。而仅获得一般改进建议但未获得实施支持的医疗机构，其实践并未发生任何变化。实施支持对于改进工作至关重要，尤其是在缺乏市场激励措施、无法推动有效管理实践采纳的情况下。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Interhospital care fragmentation, when a patient is readmitted to a different hospital than they were originally discharged from, occurs in 20%-25% of readmissions. Mode of transport to the hospital, specifically ambulance use, may be a risk factor for fragmented readmissions. Our study seeks to further understand the relationship between ambulance transport and fragmented readmissions in older adults, a population that is at increased risk for poor outcomes following fragmented readmissions. METHODS: We analyzed inpatient claims from Medicare beneficiaries in 2018 who had a hospital admission for select Hospital Readmission Reduction Program Conditions (acute myocardial infarction, congestive heart failure, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, pneumonia) as well as dehydration, syncope, urinary tract infection, or behavioral issues. We evaluated the associations between ambulance transport and a fragmented readmission using logistic regression models adjusted for demographic, clinical, and hospital characteristics. RESULTS: The study included 1,186,600 30-day readmissions. Of these, 46.8% (n = 555,847) required ambulance transport. In fully adjusted models, taking an ambulance to the readmission hospital increased the odds of a fragmented readmission by 38% (95% CI 1.32, 1.44). When this association was examined by readmission major diagnostic category (MDC), the strongest associations were seen for Factors Influencing Health Status and Other Contacts with Health Services (i.e., rehabilitation, aftercare) (AOR 3.66, 95% CI 3.11, 4.32), Mental Diseases and Disorders (AOR 2.69, 95% CI 2.44, 2.97), and Multiple Significant Trauma (AOR 2.61, 95% CI 1.56, 4.35). When the model was stratified by patient origin, ambulance use remained associated with fragmented readmissions across all locations. CONCLUSIONS: Ambulance use is associated with increased odds of a fragmented readmission, though the strength of the association varies by readmission diagnosis and origin. Patient-, hospital-, and system-level interventions should be developed, implemented, and evaluated to address this modifiable risk factor.

10.1111/jgs.18210.abstractZh:
背景：当患者被重新收治到与最初出院的医院不同的医院时，医院间护理的分散现象占重新入院患者的20%-25%。前往医院的交通方式，特别是救护车的使用，可能是导致护理分散的一个风险因素。本研究旨在进一步了解救护车运输与老年人护理分散之间的关系，因为老年人因护理分散而面临更高的不良后果风险。  

方法：我们分析了2018年医疗保险受益人因特定医院再入院减少计划所列病症（急性心肌梗塞、充血性心力衰竭、慢性阻塞性肺病、肺炎）以及脱水、晕厥、尿路感染或行为问题而住院的病例。我们使用逻辑回归模型，在调整了人口统计学、临床和医院特征的基础上，评估了救护车运输与护理分散之间的关联。  

结果：研究包括1,186,600例30天内的再入院病例。其中，46.8%（n = 555,847）需要救护车运输。在完全调整的模型中，使用救护车前往再入院医院会使护理分散的风险增加38%（95%置信区间1.32, 1.44）。当按再入院的主要诊断类别进行分析时，最强的关联出现在影响健康状况的因素及其他健康服务接触方面（如康复、后续护理）（AOR 3.66, 95%置信区间3.11, 4.32）、精神疾病和障碍（AOR 2.69, 95%置信区间2.44, 2.97）以及多发性严重创伤（AOR 2.61, 95%置信区间1.56, 4.35）。当模型按患者来源分层时，救护车使用仍然与所有地点的护理分散有关。结论：救护车的使用与再入院时医疗服务的碎片化风险增加有关，不过这种关联的强度因再入院的诊断和原因而异。应开发、实施并评估针对患者、医院以及整个医疗系统的干预措施，以应对这一可改变的风险因素。

abstract.text: Health insurance markets face continued challenges with high premiums and limited insurer competition. We describe a unique set of “active purchasing” policies used by Massachusetts' pioneer health insurance exchange to shape the rules of competition and reward lower‐price insurers with additional customers. We provide evidence that these policies significantly influenced insurer pricing. Between 2010 and 2013, over 80% of insurer prices were set exactly at or within 1% of pricing thresholds created by active purchasing policies. A key “limited choice” policy was associated with a 16%–20% reduction in average insurance prices relative to comparison markets in 2012–2014. Insurers achieved these price cuts partly through cost reductions via narrower provider networks and partly through reduced profit margins.

10.1111/jori.12414.abstractZh: 健康保险市场面临着持续的高保费和有限的保险公司竞争问题。我们描述了马萨诸塞州领先的健康保险交易所采用的一系列独特的“主动采购”政策，这些政策用于制定竞争规则，并通过增加客户数量来奖励价格较低的保险公司。我们有证据表明，这些政策显著影响了保险公司的定价。在2010年至2013年间，超过80%的保险公司定价完全按照“主动采购”政策设定的价格阈值进行，或者与阈值相差1%以内。一项关键的“有限选择”政策使得2012年至2014年的平均保险价格比对比市场降低了16%至20%。保险公司实现这些降价效果的部分原因是通过缩小供应商网络来降低成本，部分原因则是通过降低利润率来实现的。

abstract.text: This study examines the effects of social network structure of intermediaries in health care, namely referring physicians, upon the specialty treatment choices of patients in the United States. The social network of a referring physician is identified by the patient‐sharing pattern in Medicare claims data, and the following three measures are employed as key explanatory variables: (1) number of physicians connected (adjusted degree); (2) tightness of the network (clustering coefficient); and (3) influence of individual physicians in the network (eigenvector centrality). The results of discrete‐choice demand models suggest that if patients are referred by a physician who is a more important player in their social networks (i.e. eigenvector centrality is higher), the patient has a higher chance of choosing a surgeon of better quality.

10.1111/obes.12525.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了医疗保健领域中介人员——即转诊医生——的社会网络结构对患者专业治疗选择的影响。通过Medicare索赔数据中的患者共享模式来识别转诊医生的社会网络，并采用以下三个关键解释变量：(1) 连接的医生数量（调整后的度）；(2) 网络的紧密程度（聚类系数）；以及(3) 网络中个体医生的影响力（特征向量中心性）。离散选择需求模型的结果表明，如果患者由在社交网络中地位较高的医生进行转诊（即特征向量中心性较高），患者选择质量更好的外科医生的可能性就会更高。

abstract.text: This paper examines the role of universal healthcare on patient choice and quality of care. Lack of health insurance is a leading contributor to emergency department (ED) visits from the uninsured. Using a natural experiment from Massachusetts, we follow previously uninsured individuals over time—both before and after the implementation of universal healthcare—to study the effects of insurance availability on their healthcare seeking behavior. We find that the availability of health insurance has a significant impact on the type of healthcare sought by the previously uninsured. Specifically, individuals are less likely to continue visiting the ED and instead more likely to choose hospital inpatient and outpatient services. We find that frequent fliers and patients with chronic conditions, who are both known to account for a substantial share of healthcare costs, exhibit heterogeneity in this behavior. Finally, we examine the effect of the policy on quality of care, as measured by short‐term ED revisits. Although the overall revisit rates remain unchanged, frequent ED users and chronic patients experience a decline in short‐term ED revisits. With key features of the Affordable Care Act being frequently criticized for repeal, understanding how these changes influence patient choice and quality of care is significantly policy relevant.

10.1111/poms.13671.abstractZh: 本文探讨了全民医疗保健对患者选择和护理质量的影响。缺乏健康保险是无保险人群前往急诊室就诊的主要原因之一。通过马萨诸塞州的一个自然实验，我们跟踪了之前没有保险的人群在全民医疗保健实施前后的行为变化，以研究保险可用性对其就医行为的影响。研究发现，健康保险的可用性对之前没有保险的人群所寻求的医疗服务类型有显著影响。具体而言，这些人不太可能继续前往急诊室，而更倾向于选择医院住院和门诊服务。我们还发现，频繁就诊的患者以及患有慢性疾病的患者，这两种群体在就医行为上表现出异质性。最后，我们研究了该政策对护理质量的影响，通过短期急诊就诊率的变化来衡量。尽管整体就诊率保持不变，但频繁就诊的患者和慢性病患者在短期内的急诊就诊次数有所减少。鉴于《平价医疗法案》的一些关键条款经常受到废除的批评，了解这些变化如何影响患者选择和护理质量具有重要的政策意义。

abstract.text: Since the outbreak of the COVID‐19 pandemic, the effectiveness of stay‐at‐home orders implemented in many states in the United States has been the subject of ongoing debate. Whereas proponents believe these orders help reduce person‐to‐person contact and therefore the spread of the pandemic, opponents argue these orders are unnecessary and ineffective. In this study, we use eight states that did not implement the orders as a control group and six neighboring states that did implement them as a treatment group to estimate the effectiveness of stay‐at‐home orders. We find that although residents in both groups were staying at home even before the implementation of any order, these orders reduced the number of new COVID‐19 cases by 7.6%. To understand the mechanisms behind these results, we compare the mobility of residents in the control and treatment groups over time. We find stay‐at‐home orders significantly reduced residents' mobility at grocery stores and pharmacies, transit stations, workplaces, and retail and recreation locations. The results of this study are useful to policymakers in conducting cost–benefit analyses of back‐to‐work plans versus stay‐at‐home policies and deciding whether to implement, extend, lift, or reimplement stay‐at‐home orders amid a pandemic such as COVID‐19. Our results are also useful to researchers because we highlight the importance of correcting for potential selection issues. As we illustrate in this study, ignoring potential selection issues would lead to the wrong conclusion that stay‐at‐home orders increase the number of new COVID‐19 cases.

10.1111/poms.13685.abstractZh: 自COVID-19疫情爆发以来，美国许多州实施的居家令的有效性一直备受争议。支持者认为这些措施有助于减少人员接触，从而减缓疫情的蔓延，而反对者则认为这些措施既不必要且效果不佳。本研究以未实施居家令的八个州作为对照组，以实施居家令的六个邻近州作为实验组，来评估居家令的有效性。研究发现，尽管两组居民在居家令实施前就已经保持居家状态，但这些措施使新的COVID-19病例数量减少了7.6%。为了理解这些结果背后的机制，我们比较了两组居民在不同时间段内的活动情况。结果发现，居家令显著减少了居民在杂货店、药店、公交车站、工作场所以及零售和娱乐场所的流动。这项研究的结果对政策制定者来说很有帮助，可以帮助他们进行成本效益分析，以决定在COVID-19等疫情期间是恢复工作还是继续实施居家令。我们的研究结果对研究人员也有帮助，因为我们强调了纠正潜在选择问题的重要性。正如我们在研究中所示，忽略潜在选择问题会导致错误的结论，即居家令会增加新的COVID-19病例数量。

abstract.text: Although scholars agree that public managers' education could affect performance in public organizations, no attempt has been made to synthesize the empirical evidence on this relationship. Consequently, we ask, do public managers with a general management education, such as an MPA, or a specialist education, such as an MD in the context of a hospital, affect different types of performance in public organizations? Based on a preregistered systematic literature review, we find 548 effect sizes from 50 quantitative studies by screening more than 12,000 potentially eligible studies. Our meta‐regression analyses show that specialist managers have a statistically significant small average advantage on field‐specific performance compared to other managers, and that generalist managers have a statistically significant small average advantage on financial performance compared to other managers. Based on these results, we recommend that future research investigate the theoretical linkages between public managers' education and performance in public organizations.

10.1111/puar.13553.abstractZh: 尽管学者们一致认为公共管理者的教育水平可能会影响公共组织的绩效，但至今尚未有人尝试综合研究这一关系的实证证据。因此，我们提出这样一个问题：具有一般管理教育背景的公共管理者，例如拥有公共管理硕士学位的人，或者具有专业教育背景的管理者，例如拥有医学博士学位的人，在公立医院这样的公共组织中，是否会对不同类型的绩效产生影响？通过一项预先注册的系统性文献综述，我们筛选了50项定量研究，共获得了548个效应量，涉及超过12,000项潜在符合条件的研究。我们的元回归分析显示，与一般的公共管理者相比，具有专业教育背景的管理者在特定领域的绩效方面具有统计学上显著的小幅优势；而具有一般管理教育背景的管理者在财务绩效方面也表现出统计学上显著的小幅优势。基于这些结果，我们建议未来的研究应探讨公共管理者的教育水平与公共组织绩效之间的理论联系。

abstract.text: This paper examines existing empirical research regarding the importance of competition and competition policy for variables relevant to macroeconomic outcomes. This research provides evidence on the correlations between competition, competition policy, and macroeconomic outcomes, such as productivity, growth, innovation, employment, and inequality. Competition policy is demonstrated to bring multiple benefits for macroeconomic outcomes in several economic studies. Gains from enhanced competition can essentially be divided into efficiency and redistribution effects. Efficiency gains result from the positive impact of competition on productivity growth, which allows firms and industries to produce more and better products and services at lower cost, whereas redistribution effects are associated with the impact of competition on inequality and employment in the market.

10.11130/jei.2022.37.2.337.abstractZh: 本文探讨了关于竞争与竞争政策对宏观经济结果相关变量重要性的现有实证研究。这些研究提供了竞争、竞争政策与宏观经济结果之间的相关性证据，例如生产力、增长、创新、就业和不平等问题。多项经济研究表明，竞争政策对宏观经济结果具有多重积极影响。通过加强竞争所带来的收益，可以大致分为效率提升和再分配效应。效率提升源于竞争对生产力增长的积极影响，这使得企业和行业能够以更低的成本生产更多、更好的产品和服务；而再分配效应则与竞争对市场中的不平等和就业状况的影响相关。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: To measure and compare mortality outcomes between dually eligible veterans transported by ambulance to a Veterans Affairs hospital and those transported to a non-Veterans Affairs hospital. DESIGN: Retrospective cohort study using data from medical charts and administrative files. SETTING: Emergency visits by ambulance to 140 Veteran Affairs and 2622 non-Veteran Affairs hospitals across 46 US states and the District of Columbia in 2001-18. PARTICIPANTS: National cohort of 583 248 veterans (aged ≥65 years) enrolled in both the Veterans Health Administration and Medicare programs, who resided within 20 miles of at least one Veterans Affairs hospital and at least one non-Veterans Affairs hospital, in areas where ambulances regularly transported patients to both types of hospitals. INTERVENTION: Emergency treatment at a Veterans Affairs hospital. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURE: Deaths in the 30 day period after the ambulance ride. Linear probability models of mortality were used, with adjustment for patients' demographic characteristics, residential zip codes, comorbid conditions, and other variables. RESULTS: 11.67 (11.58 to 11.76)). The mortality advantage associated with Veterans Affairs hospitals was particularly large for patients who were black (-25.8%), were Hispanic (-22.7%), and had received care at the same hospital in the previous year. CONCLUSIONS: These findings indicate that within a month of being treated with emergency care at Veterans Affairs hospitals, dually eligible veterans had substantially lower risk of death than those treated at non-Veterans Affairs hospitals. The nature of this mortality advantage warrants further investigation, as does its generalizability to other types of patients and care. Nonetheless, the finding is relevant to assessments of the merit of policies that encourage private healthcare alternatives for veterans.

10.1136/bmj-2021-068099.abstractZh: 目的：测量并比较被救护车送往退伍军人事务医院与未被送往该医院的双重符合条件退伍军人的死亡结果。设计：基于医疗记录和管理文件数据的回顾性队列研究。环境：2001-18年间，在46个美国州和哥伦比亚特区，由救护车送往140家退伍军人事务医院和2622家非退伍军人事务医院的急诊就诊情况。参与者：全国范围内共有583,248名退伍军人（年龄≥65岁），他们同时参加了退伍军人健康管理局和医疗保险计划，并且居住在距离至少一家退伍军人事务医院和至少一家非退伍军人事务医院20英里以内的地区，这些地区救护车经常将患者送往这两种类型的医院。干预措施：在退伍军人事务医院接受急诊治疗。主要结果测量指标：救护车运送后30天内的死亡人数。使用线性概率模型进行死亡风险分析，并调整了患者的 demographic 特征、居住邮政编码、合并疾病以及其他变量。结果：死亡率为11.67（范围11.58至11.76）。与退伍军人事务医院相关的死亡优势在以下人群中尤为明显：黑人患者（-25.8%）、西班牙裔患者（-22.7%）以及在前一年在同一家医院接受治疗的患者。结论：这些发现表明，在在退伍军人事务医院接受急诊治疗后一个月内，双重符合条件的退伍军人的死亡风险明显低于在非退伍军人事务医院接受治疗的患者。这种死亡优势的性质值得进一步研究，其普遍性也值得探讨，同样适用于其他类型的患者和护理方式。尽管如此，这一发现对于评估鼓励退伍军人选择私人医疗保健政策的效果仍然具有相关性。

abstract.text: Ajay Aggarwal and colleagues argue that relying on patient choice to cut waiting times is oversimplistic and likely to widen inequalities

10.1136/bmj-2022-071967.abstractZh: Ajay Aggarwal及其同事认为，仅依靠患者选择来缩短等待时间是一种过于简单化的做法，这种做法可能会加剧不平等现象。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: Findings regarding the association between delivery volume and maternal health outcomes are mixed, most of which explored their correlation. This study aims to demonstrate the causal effect of delivery volume on severe maternal morbidity (SMM) in China. METHODS: We analysed all women giving birth in the densely populated Sichuan province with 83 million residents in China, during the fourth quarters of each of 4 years (from 2016 to 2019). The routinely collected discharge data, the health institutional annual report data and road network data were used for analysis. The maternal health outcome was measured by SMM. Instrumental variable (IV) methods were applied for estimation, while the surrounding average number of delivery cases per institution was used as the instrument. RESULTS: The study included 4545 institution-years of data from 1456 distinct institutions with delivery services, reflecting 810 049 associated delivery cases. The average SMM rate was approximately 33.08 per 1000 deliveries during 2016 and 2019. More than 86% of delivery services were provided by a third of the institutions with the highest delivery volume (≥143 delivery cases quarterly). In contrast, less than 2% of delivery services were offered by a third of the institutions with the lowest delivery volume (<19 delivery cases quarterly). After adjusting the confounders in the IV-logistic models, the average marginal effect of per 1000 cases in delivery volume was -0.162 (95% CI -0.169 to -0.155), while the adjusted OR of delivery volume was 0.005 (95% CI 0.004 to 0.006). CONCLUSION: Increased delivery volume has great potential to improve maternal health outcomes, while the centralisation of delivery services might facilitate maternal health promotion in China. Our study also provides implications for other developing countries confronted with similar challenges to China.

10.1136/bmjgh-2022-008428.abstractZh:
目的：关于分娩量与孕产妇健康结果之间关系的研究结果并不一致，大多数研究仅探讨了它们之间的相关性。本研究旨在揭示分娩量对中国孕产妇严重发病率的因果效应。  
方法：我们分析了中国四川省所有分娩女性的数据，该省人口密集，有8300万居民。研究时间覆盖2016年至2019年每年的第四季度。分析数据包括常规收集的出院数据、医疗机构的年度报告数据以及道路网络数据。孕产妇健康结果以孕产妇严重发病率来衡量。采用工具变量方法进行估计，以每家机构的平均分娩次数作为工具变量。  
结果：研究共包含1456家提供分娩服务的机构，共计810049例分娩案例。2016年至2019年间，平均每1000例分娩中有约33.08例出现孕产妇严重发病率。超过86%的分娩服务由分娩量最高的三分之一机构提供（每季度≥143例分娩）。相反，不到2%的分娩服务由分娩量最低的三分之一机构提供（每季度<19例分娩）。在调整了混杂因素后，每1000例分娩中分娩量的平均边际效应为-0.162（95%置信区间：-0.169至-0.155），而分娩量的调整后比值比为0.005（95%置信区间：0.004至0.006）。  
结论：增加分娩量具有改善孕产妇健康结果的巨大潜力，而分娩服务的集中化可能有助于促进中国的孕产妇健康。我们的研究也为其他面临类似挑战的发展中国家提供了启示，这些国家与中国有着相似的处境。

abstract.text: The regulated insurance exchanges set up in the Affordable Care Act (ACA) were designed to deliver affordable, efficient health coverage through private insurers. It is crucial to study the complex industrial organization (IO) of these exchanges in order to assess their impacts during the first decade of the ACA and to project their effects going forward. We revisit the inherent market failures in health care markets that necessitate key ACA exchange regulations and investigate whether they have succeeded in their goals of expanding coverage, creating robust marketplaces, providing product variety, and generating innovation in health care delivery. We discuss empirical IO research to date and also highlight shortcomings in the existing research that can be addressed moving forward. We conclude with a discussion of IO research-based policy lessons for the ACA exchanges and, more generally, for managed competition of private insurance in health care.

10.1146/annurev-economics-051420-114714.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》所设立的监管保险交易所旨在通过私人保险公司提供经济实惠且高效的医疗保障。研究这些交易所复杂的产业组织机制至关重要，这有助于评估《平价医疗法案》实施头十年期间的影响，并预测其未来的发展态势。我们重新审视了医疗保健市场中存在的市场失灵问题，这些问题需要《平价医疗法案》中的关键监管措施来解决。同时，我们探讨这些措施在实现扩大覆盖范围、打造健全的市场环境、提供多样化的产品以及促进医疗保健服务创新方面的成效。我们回顾了迄今为止关于产业组织研究的成果，并指出了现有研究中的不足之处，这些不足可以在未来的研究中得到改进。最后，我们讨论了基于产业组织研究的《平价医疗法案》交易所政策启示，以及更广泛地，对私人保险在医疗保健领域中的管理竞争的影响。

abstract.text: Equal access to voting is a core feature of democratic government. Using data from hundreds of thousands of smartphone users, we quantify a racial disparity in voting wait times across a nationwide sample of polling places during the 2016 U.S. presidential election. Relative to entirely white neighborhoods, residents of entirely black neighborhoods waited 29% longer to vote and were 74% more likely to spend more than thirty minutes at their polling place. This disparity holds when comparing predominantly white and black polling places within the same states and counties and survives numerous robustness and placebo tests. We shed light on the mechanism for these results and discuss how geospatial data can be an effective tool to measure and monitor these disparities going forward.

10.1162/rest_a_01012.abstractZh: 平等投票权是民主政府的核心特征之一。我们利用数十万智能手机用户的数据，量化了2016年美国总统选举期间全国范围内投票等待时间的种族差异。与完全由白人组成的社区相比，完全由黑人组成的社区居民等待投票的时间延长了29%，并且在投票站花费的时间也增加了74%。即使在同一州和县内比较以白人和黑人为主的投票站，这种差异仍然存在，并且经过多次稳健性和安慰剂测试后依然成立。我们揭示了这些结果的机制，并讨论了地理空间数据如何成为衡量和监测这些差异的有效工具。

abstract.text: We use variational inference (VI), a technique from the machine learning literature, to estimate a mortality-based Bayesian model of nursing home quality accounting for selection. We demonstrate how one can use VI to quickly and flexibly estimate a high-dimensional economic model with large datasets. Using our facility quality estimates, we examine the correlates of quality and find that public report cards have near-zero correlation. We then show that in contrast to prior literature, higher-quality nursing homes fared better during the pandemic: a one standard deviation increase in quality corresponds to 2.5% fewer COVID-19 cases.

10.1162/rest_a_01449.abstractZh: 我们采用了变分推断这一机器学习领域的技术，来估计一个基于死亡率的贝叶斯模型，该模型能够考虑选择因素的影响，从而评估养老院的服务质量。我们展示了如何利用变分推断快速且灵活地估计高维经济模型，并处理大规模数据集。通过我们的设施质量评估，我们发现公共报告卡与服务质量之间的相关性几乎为零。此外，与以往的研究不同，高质量的养老院在疫情期间表现更好：质量提升一个标准差，对应的COVID-19病例数量就会减少2.5%。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Electronic health records (EHRs) provide researchers with abundant sample sizes, detailed clinical data, and other advantages for performing high-quality observational health research on diverse populations. We review and demonstrate strategies for the design and analysis of cohort studies on neighborhood diversity and health, including evaluation of the effects of race, ethnicity, and neighborhood socioeconomic position on disease prevalence and health outcomes, using localized EHR data. METHODS: Design strategies include integrating and harmonizing EHR data across multiple local health systems and defining the population(s) of interest and cohort extraction procedures for a given analysis based on the goal(s) of the study. Analysis strategies address inferential goals, including the mechanistic study of social risks, statistical adjustment for differences in distributions of social and neighborhood-level characteristics between available EHR data and the underlying local population, and inference on individual neighborhoods. We provide analyses of local variation in mortality rates within Cuyahoga County, Ohio. RESULTS: When the goal of the analysis is to adjust EHR samples to be more representative of local populations, sampling and weighting are effective. Causal mediation analysis can inform effects of racism (through racial residential segregation) on health outcomes. Spatial analysis is appealing for large-scale EHR data as a means for studying heterogeneity among neighborhoods even at a given level of overall neighborhood disadvantage. CONCLUSIONS: The methods described are a starting point for robust EHR-derived cohort analysis of diverse populations. The methods offer opportunities for researchers to pursue detailed analyses of current and historical underlying circumstances of social policy and inequality. Investigators can employ combinations of these methods to achieve greater robustness of results. HIGHLIGHTS: EHR data are an abundant resource for studying neighborhood diversity and health.When using EHR data for these studies, careful consideration of the goals of the study should be considered in determining cohort specifications and analytic approaches.Causal mediation analysis, stratification, and spatial analysis are effective methods for characterizing social mechanisms and heterogeneity across localized populations.

10.1177/0272989x221123569.abstractZh:
背景：电子健康记录为研究人员提供了丰富的样本规模、详细的临床数据以及其他优势，使他们能够对不同人群进行高质量的观察性健康研究。我们回顾并展示了关于社区多样性与健康的队列研究的设计与分析策略，包括利用本地化电子健康记录数据，评估种族、民族以及社区社会经济地位对疾病发病率和健康结果的影响。  
方法：设计策略包括将多个本地卫生系统的电子健康记录数据进行整合与协调，并根据研究目标明确研究对象和队列提取程序。分析策略涉及推理目标，包括对社会风险的机制研究、对电子健康记录数据与当地人口之间社会和社区层面特征差异的统计调整，以及对各个社区的推断分析。我们提供了俄亥俄州库亚霍加县内死亡率局部差异的分析结果。  
结果：当分析的目标是使电子健康记录样本更具代表性时，抽样和加权方法是有效的。因果中介分析可以揭示种族主义（通过种族居住隔离）对健康结果的影响。对于大规模电子健康记录数据而言，空间分析是一种有效的方法，可以研究即使在整体社区劣势相同的情况下，不同社区之间的异质性。  
结论：所描述的方法为基于电子健康记录对不同人群进行稳健的队列分析提供了起点。这些方法为研究人员提供了机会，使他们能够详细分析社会政策和不平等现象在当代及历史背景下的具体情况。研究者可以通过组合使用这些方法来提高研究结果的可靠性。要点：电子健康记录数据是研究社区多样性与健康状况的丰富资源。在使用电子健康记录数据进行研究时，在确定研究样本和分析方法时，应充分考虑研究目标。因果中介分析、分层分析以及空间分析是描述社会机制以及不同地区人口间差异的有效方法。

abstract.text: A small, but growing, body of empirical evidence shows that the material and persistent variation in many aspects of the performance of healthcare organisations can be related to variation in their management practices. This study uses public data on hospital patient mortality outcomes, the Summary Hospital-level Mortality Indicator (SHMI) to extend this programme of research. We assemble a five-year dataset combining SHMI with potential confounding variables for all English NHS non-specialist acute hospital trusts. The large number of providers working within a common system provides a powerful environment for such investigations. We find considerable variation in SHMI between trusts and a high degree of persistence of high- or low performance. This variation is associated with a composite metric for management practices based on the NHS National Staff Survey. We then use a machine learning technique to suggest potential clusters of individual management practices related to patient mortality performance and test some of these using traditional multivariate regression. The results support the hypothesis that such clusters do matter for patient mortality, and so we conclude that any systematic effort at improving patient mortality should consider adopting an optimal cluster of management practices.

10.1177/09514848211068627.abstractZh: 大量且不断增长的实证证据表明，医疗组织在诸多方面的表现差异，与其管理实践的变化密切相关。本研究利用医院患者死亡率数据，通过“医院级死亡率汇总指标”来扩展这一研究项目。我们收集了五年期的数据集，将SHMI与潜在混杂变量相结合，涵盖了所有英格兰NHS的非专科急性医院信托机构。众多机构共同存在于一个体系中，为这类研究提供了有力的环境。我们发现，不同信托机构之间的SHMI存在显著差异，且高或低绩效的持续性很高。这种差异与基于NHS全国员工调查得出的管理实践综合指标相关。随后，我们采用机器学习技术，识别出与患者死亡率表现相关的管理实践群体，并通过传统的多元回归分析对其中一些群体进行了验证。研究结果支持这样的假设：这些群体确实对患者的死亡率有重要影响。因此，任何旨在改善患者死亡率的系统性努力，都应考虑采用最优的管理实践组合。

abstract.text: Background: In 2007, a reform of Swedish primary healthcare began when some regions implemented enhanced patient choice in combination with free establishment for private providers. Although heavily debated, in 2010 it became mandatory for all regions to implement this choice system. Aim: The aim of this article was to review all published research articles related to the primary healthcare choice reform in Sweden, to investigate what has been published about the reform and summarise its first 15 years. Methods: A scoping review was performed to cover the breadth of research on the reform. Searches were made in Scopus, Web of Science and PubMed for articles published between 2007 and 2021, resulting in 217 unique articles. In total, 52 articles were included. Results: The articles were summarised and presented in relation to six overarching themes: arguments about the primary healthcare choice reform; governance and financial reimbursements; choice of provider and use of information; effects on equity and access; effects on quality; and differences between private and public primary healthcare centres. Conclusions: The articles show that the reform has led to an increase in access to primary healthcare, but most studies indicate that the increase is inequitably distributed in terms of socioeconomy and geographical location. The effects on quality are unclear but several studies show that the mechanisms supposed to lead to quality improvements do not work as intended. Furthermore, from a population health perspective, it is time to discuss how such a responsibility can be reintegrated into primary healthcare and function with the choice system.

10.1177/14034948221095365.abstractZh:
背景：2007年，瑞典开始对初级医疗保健进行改革，一些地区实施了增强的患者选择机制，并允许私人医疗服务提供者自由设立诊所。尽管这一改革引发了广泛争议，但在2010年，所有地区都强制要求实施这一选择机制。  
目的：本文旨在回顾所有关于瑞典初级医疗保健选择改革的研究文章，探讨关于该改革的研究成果，并总结其实施以来的15年发展情况。  
方法：通过文献综述的方式，涵盖了关于该改革的所有研究。在Scopus、Web of Science和PubMed数据库中检索2007至2021年间发表的文章，共找到217篇独立文章，最终纳入了52篇。  
结果：文章被归纳并分为六个主题：关于初级医疗保健选择改革的论点；治理与财务报销；医疗服务提供者的选择及信息使用；对公平性和可及性的影响；对质量的影响；以及私立与公立初级医疗保健中心之间的差异。  
结论：研究表明，该改革确实增加了人们对初级医疗保健的获取机会，但大多数研究指出，这种增加在 socio-economic背景和地理位置方面的分布并不均衡。关于质量的影响尚不明确，但多项研究表明，那些被认为能提升质量的机制并未达到预期效果。此外，从人群健康的角度来看，现在需要讨论如何将这种责任重新整合到初级医疗保健中，并与选择机制协同运作。

abstract.text: Ordinal responses can be generated, in a cross-sectional context, by different unobserved classes of population or, in a time-series context, by different latent regimes. We introduce a new command, swopit, that fits a mixture of ordered probit models with exogenous or endogenous switching between two latent classes (regimes). Switching is endogenous if unobservables in the classassignment model are correlated with unobservables in the outcome models. We provide a battery of postestimation commands; assess via Monte Carlo experiments the finite-sample performance of the maximum likelihood estimator of the parameters, probabilities, and their standard errors (both the asymptotic and bootstrap ones); and apply the new command to model the monetary policy interest rates.

10.1177/1536867x221124516.abstractZh: 在横截面分析中，序数响应可以通过不同未观测的人群类别产生；在时间序列分析中，序数响应可以通过不同的潜在状态产生。我们引入了一个新的命令“swopit”，用于拟合具有外生或内生切换的两种潜在类别的有序Probit模型。如果类别分配模型中的未观测变量与结果模型中的未观测变量相关，则这种切换被视为内生切换。我们提供了一系列后估计命令；通过蒙特卡洛实验评估参数、概率及其标准误差的有限样本性能（包括渐近方法和自助法）；并将新命令应用于货币政策利率的建模。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Although management is important in healthcare, low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) have little experience measuring the competence of hospital management. While improving hospital management is the main focus of hospital reform in China, few studies have empirically documented the baseline situation to inform policy design. METHODS: We assessed the management practices of county-level hospitals in Guizhou in southwest China during 2015. We used the Development World Management Survey (D-WMS) instrument to interview 273 managers in 139 hospitals. We scored the management practices of the sampled hospitals, overall and in four dimensions (operations, monitoring, targets, personnel management) and three processes (implementation, usage, monitoring). We then converted the scores to the WMS scale and compared these with data from two other LMICs and seven high-income countries (HICs). RESULTS: On a scale of 1 ('worst practice') to 5 ('best practice'), the mean (SD) hospital D-WMS scores were 2.57 (0.46) overall; 2.71 (0.48), 2.64 (0.58), 2.40 (0.64), and 2.56 (0.40) for operation, monitoring, target, and personnel, respectively; and 2.43 (0.48), 2.62 (0.48), and 2.66 (0.47) for implementation, usage, and monitoring, respectively. After conversion to WMS scores, China ranked seventh of 10 countries, after six HICs and higher than one HIC and two other LMICs (Brazil and India). China ranked higher than the two LMICs in each of the four dimensional scores. CONCLUSIONS: Chinese county-level hospitals should improve their low quality of management by prioritizing target-setting and process implementation, particularly in personnel management. Meanwhile, modern management training should be given to most clinical managers.

10.1186/s12913-021-07396-y.abstractZh:
背景：尽管管理在医疗保健领域非常重要，但低收入和中等收入国家在衡量医院管理能力的方面经验有限。在中国，改善医院管理是医院改革的主要目标，但很少有研究通过实证数据来了解现状，以便为政策设计提供依据。  
方法：我们于2015年对中国西南地区贵州省县级医院的管理实践进行了评估。我们使用“发展世界管理调查”工具，对139家医院的273名管理者进行了访谈。我们对样本医院的管理实践进行了评分，涵盖了四个维度（运营、监控、目标设定、人事管理）和三个流程（实施、使用、监控）。随后，我们将这些评分转换为WMS指数，并与另外两个中等收入国家和七个高收入国家的数据进行了比较。  
结果：在1（最差）到5（最佳）的评分范围内，贵州省县级医院的平均WMS指数为2.57（标准差0.46）；运营、监控、目标设定和人事管理的平均指数分别为2.71（标准差0.48）、2.64（标准差0.58）、2.40（标准差0.64）和2.56（标准差0.40）；实施、使用和监控的平均指数分别为2.43（标准差0.48）、2.62（标准差0.48）和2.66（标准差0.47）。转换为WMS指数后，中国的排名在10个国家中位列第七，仅次于六个高收入国家，高于一个高收入国家和另外两个中等收入国家（巴西和印度）。在四个维度的评分中，中国的表现均优于这两个中等收入国家。  
结论：中国县级医院应通过优先实施目标设定和流程管理来提升管理水平，特别是在人事管理方面。同时，应为大多数临床管理者提供现代管理培训。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Studies of the hospital volume-outcome relationship have highlighted that a greater volume activity improves patient outcomes. While this finding has been known for years, most studies to date have failed to delve into what underlies this relationship. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to shed light on the basis of the hospital volume effect on patient outcomes by comparing treatment modalities for epithelial ovarian carcinoma patients. DATA: An exhaustive dataset of 355 patients in first-line treatment for Epithelial Ovarian Carcinoma (EOC) in 2012 in three regions of France was used. These regions account for 15% of the metropolitan French population. METHODS: In the presence of endogeneity induced by a reverse causality between hospital volume and patient outcomes, we used an instrumental variable approach. Hospital volume of activity was instrumented by the distance from patients' homes to their hospital, the population density, and the median net income of patient municipalities. RESULTS: Based on our parameter estimates, we found that the rate of complete tumor resection would increase by 15.5 percentage points with centralized care, and by 8.3 percentage points if treatment decisions were coordinated by high-volume centers compared to decentralized care. CONCLUSION: As volume alone is an imperfect correlate of quality, policy-makers need to know what volume is a proxy for in order to devise volume-based policies.

10.1186/s12913-021-07449-2.abstractZh: 背景：关于医院规模与患者治疗效果关系的研究表明，更大的医疗规模有助于改善患者预后。尽管这一发现早已为人所知，但迄今为止大多数研究并未深入探讨这种关系背后的机制。目的：本研究旨在通过比较上皮性卵巢癌患者的治疗方式，来揭示医院规模对治疗效果的影响。数据：本研究使用了2012年法国三个地区355名上皮性卵巢癌患者的详尽数据。这些地区占法国大都市人口的15%。方法：由于医院规模与患者治疗效果之间存在反向因果关系，导致内生性问题，我们采用了工具变量法。医院规模通过患者居住地与医院之间的距离、人口密度以及患者所在市镇的中位净收入作为工具变量进行衡量。结果：根据我们的参数估计，我们发现，在集中式护理下，完全肿瘤切除率将增加15.5个百分点；而在高规模中心协调治疗决策的情况下，这一比例将增加8.3个百分点。结论：由于规模本身并非质量的完美指标，政策制定者需要了解哪些规模指标能够反映质量，才能制定基于规模的政策。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: The impact of ambulance diversion on potentially diverted patients, particularly racial/ethnic minority patients, is largely unknown. Treating Massachusetts' 2009 ambulance diversion ban as a natural experiment, we examined if the ban was associated with increased concordance in Emergency Medical Services (EMS) patients of different race/ethnicity being transported to the same emergency department (ED). METHODS: We obtained Medicare Fee for Service claims records (2007-2012) for enrollees aged 66 and older. We stratified the country into patient zip codes and identified zip codes with sizable (non-Hispanic) White, (non-Hispanic) Black and Hispanic enrollees. For a stratified random sample of enrollees from all diverse zip codes in Massachusetts and 18 selected comparison states, we identified EMS transports to an ED. In each zip code, we identified the most frequent ED destination of White EMS-transported patients ("reference ED"). Our main outcome was a dichotomous indicator of patient EMS transport to the reference ED, and secondary outcome was transport to an ED serving lower-income patients ("safety-net ED"). Using a difference-in-differences regression specification, we contrasted the pre- to post-ban changes in each outcome in Massachusetts with the corresponding change in the comparison states. RESULTS: Our study cohort of 744,791 enrollees from 3331 zip codes experienced 361,006 EMS transports. At baseline, the proportion transported to the reference ED was higher among White patients in Massachusetts and comparison states (67.2 and 60.9%) than among Black (43.6 and 46.2%) and Hispanic (62.5 and 52.7%) patients. Massachusetts ambulance diversion ban was associated with a decreased proportion transported to the reference ED among White (- 2.7 percentage point; 95% CI, - 4.5 to - 1.0) and Black (- 4.1 percentage point; 95% CI, - 6.2 to - 1.9) patients and no change among Hispanic patients. The ban was associated with an increase in likelihood of transport to a safety-net ED among Hispanic patients (3.0 percentage points, 95% CI, 0.3 to 5.7) and a decreased likelihood among White patients (1.2 percentage points, 95% CI, - 2.3 to - 0.2). CONCLUSION: Massachusetts ambulance diversion ban was associated with a reduction in the proportion of White and Black EMS patients being transported to the most frequent ED destination for White patients, highlighting the role of non-proximity factors in EMS transport destination.

10.1186/s12913-022-08358-8.abstractZh:
背景：救护车转送对可能被转送的患者，尤其是少数族裔患者的影响尚不清楚。我们将马萨诸塞州2009年实施的救护车转送禁令视为一个自然实验，研究该禁令是否导致不同种族/族裔的急诊医疗服务患者被送往同一急诊科的情况增加。  
方法：我们获取了2007至2012年间66岁及以上参保者的医疗保险服务费用记录。将全国划分为不同的邮政编码区域，并识别出拥有大量非西班牙裔白人、非西班牙裔黑人和西班牙裔参保者的邮政编码区域。从马萨诸塞州和18个对照州的各个邮政编码区域中，选取了分层随机样本，识别出被送往急诊科的急诊医疗服务案例。在每个邮政编码区域，我们确定了白人患者最常前往的急诊科（“参考急诊科”）。我们的主要结果是患者被送往参考急诊科的二元指标，次要结果是被送往为低收入患者服务的急诊科（“安全网急诊科”）。通过差异-差异回归模型，我们比较了马萨诸塞州在禁令实施前后的各项结果变化与对照州相应的变化。  
结果：我们的研究样本包括来自3331个邮政编码区域的744,791名参保者，共发生了361,006次急诊医疗服务转送。在基线时，被送往参考急诊科的白人患者比例在马萨诸塞州和对照州分别高于黑人（43.6%和46.2%）和西班牙裔患者（62.5%和52.7%）。马萨诸塞州的救护车分流禁令与白人患者被送往参考急诊室的比例下降有关（下降2.7个百分点；95%置信区间，从-4.5到-1.0），黑人患者则下降4.1个百分点（95%置信区间，从-6.2到-1.9），而西班牙裔患者的情况没有变化。该禁令还导致西班牙裔患者被送往安全网络急诊室的可能性增加3.0个百分点（95%置信区间，从0.3到5.7），而白人患者则减少1.2个百分点（95%置信区间，从-2.3到-0.2）。结论：马萨诸塞州的救护车分流禁令导致白人和黑人急救人员被送往白人患者最常使用的急诊室的比例下降，这凸显了非地理位置因素在急救运输目的地选择中的重要性。

abstract.text: CONTEXT: To what extent does pharmaceutical revenue growth depend on new medicines versus increasing prices for existing medicines? Moreover, does using list prices, as is commonly done, instead of prices net of confidential rebates offered by manufacturers, which are harder to observe, change the relative importance of the sources of revenue growth? METHODS: This study uses data from SSR Health LLC to address these research questions using decomposition methods that analyze list prices, prices net of rebates, and sales for branded pharmaceutical products sold primarily through retail pharmacies. FINDINGS: From 2009 to 2019, retail pharmaceutical revenue growth was primarily driven by new products rather than by price increases on existing products. Failing to account for confidential rebates creates a more prominent role for price increases in explaining revenue growth, because list price inflation during this period was 10.9%, whereas net price inflation was 3.3%. CONCLUSIONS: Policies that restrict price growth on existing medicines likely need to be coupled with policies that reduce launch prices to have a meaningful long-term impact on pharmaceutical revenue growth. Using pharmaceutical list prices is often an inadequate approximation for net prices because the role of rebates has increased and varies by drug class.

10.1215/03616878-10041079.abstractZh: 背景：药品收入的增长在多大程度上取决于新药的推出，而不是现有药品价格的上涨？此外，是否使用通常采用的标价，而不是制造商提供的难以观察到的不含保密回扣的价格，会改变收入增长来源的相对重要性？方法：本研究使用SSR Health LLC的数据，通过分解方法分析主要通过零售药店销售的品牌药品的价格、不含回扣的价格以及销售额，以解答这些问题。研究结果：从2009年到2019年，零售药品收入的增长主要得益于新产品的推出，而非现有药品价格的上涨。如果不考虑保密回扣，价格上涨在解释收入增长方面的作用会更为显著，因为在此期间标价的通货膨胀率为10.9%，而净价格通货膨胀率仅为3.3%。结论：限制现有药品价格上涨的政策，可能需要与降低上市价格的政策相结合，才能对药品收入增长产生有意义的长期影响。使用药品标价通常不足以近似净价格，因为回扣的作用已经增加，并且因药品类别而异。

abstract.text: I discuss the recent literature that has led to new interest in the idea of monopsonistic wage setting. Building on advances in search theory and in models of differentiated products, researchers have used a number of different strategies to identify the elasticity of firm-specific labor supply.
