A growing consensus is that firms have some wage-setting power, though many questions remain about the sources of that power. (JEL B21, D21, D24, D43, J22, J31, J42)

10.1257/aer.112.4.1075.abstractZh: 我讨论了最近的相关文献，这些文献重新激发了人们对垄断买方定价机制的兴趣。基于搜索理论的发展和差异化产品模型的进步，研究人员采用了多种不同的策略来研究企业特定劳动力供给的弹性。越来越多的共识认为，企业确实具有一定的定价能力，尽管关于这种能力的来源仍有许多疑问。（JEL B21, D21, D24, D43, J22, J31, J42）

abstract.text: I briefly review the emergence of “ design-based” research methods in labor economics in the 1980s and early 1990s. These methods were seen as a partial solution to the problems of credible inference identified by Ashenfelter (1974), Leamer (1978), Hendry (1980), and others. Designed-based studies typically use a simplified one-equation model of the outcome of interest—in contrast to model-based studies that specify a data generating process for all factors determining the outcome. I discuss some of the strengths and weaknesses of the design-based approach and the value of such research in the field. (JEL C20, J01, J24, J31, J38, J51, J53)

10.1257/aer.112.6.1773.abstractZh: 我简要回顾了20世纪80年代和90年代初劳动经济学中“基于设计”的研究方法的出现。这些方法被视为解决Ashenfelter（1974年）、Leamer（1978年）、Hendry（1980年）等人所指出的问题的一种部分解决方案。基于设计的实证研究通常使用一个简化的单方程模型来描述所关注的结果，这与基于模型的实证研究不同，后者会为决定结果的各个因素指定一个数据生成过程。我讨论了基于设计的方法的一些优点和缺点，以及这类研究在该领域的价值。（JEL C20, J01, J24, J31, J38, J51, J53）

abstract.text: This paper documents that the earnings cost of job loss is concentrated among workers who find reemployment in lower-skill occupations, and that the cost and incidence of such occupation displacement is higher for workers who lose their job during a recession. I propose a model where hiring is endogenously more selective during recessions, leading some unemployed workers to optimally search for reemployment in lower-skill jobs. The model accounts for existing estimates of the size and cyclicality of the present value cost of job loss, and the cost of entering the labor market during a recession. (JEL E24, E32, J23, J24, J31, J63, J64)

10.1257/aer.20160449.abstractZh: 本文指出，失业带来的收入损失主要集中在使用较低技能的职业重新就业的员工身上，而在经济衰退期间失业的员工的这种职业转型所付出的成本和影响更为显著。我们提出了一个模型，该模型认为在经济衰退期间，招聘行为会变得更加挑剔，导致一些失业员工更倾向于寻找低技能岗位的重新就业机会。该模型考虑了现有关于失业损失现值大小及其周期性变化的估计数据，以及经济衰退期间进入劳动力市场的成本。（JEL E24, E32, J23, J24, J31, J63, J64）

abstract.text: This paper examines how employer- and worker-specific productivity shocks transmit to earnings and employment. We develop an equilibrium search model and characterize the optimal contract offered by firms. Risk-neutral firms provide partial insurance against shocks to risk-averse workers and offer contingent contracts, where payments are backloaded in good times and frontloaded in bad times. The model is estimated on matched employer-employee data from Sweden. Firms absorb persistent worker and firm shocks, with respective passthrough values of 26 and 10 percent. We evaluate the effects of redistributive policies and find that 30 percent of government insurance is undone by crowding out firm insurance. (JEL D86, H23, J24, J31, J41, J62)

10.1257/aer.20161622.abstractZh: 本文探讨了雇主和工人特定的生产率冲击如何传递至收入与就业状况。我们构建了一个均衡搜索模型，并描述了企业提供的最优契约形式。风险中性的企业为风险厌恶的工人提供了部分保险，并提供了条件性契约，其中支付在良好时期后置，在糟糕时期前置。该模型基于瑞典的匹配雇主-雇员数据进行了估计。企业能够吸收持续的工人和企业冲击，相应的传递比例分别为26%和10%。我们评估了再分配政策的效果，发现30%的政府保险被企业保险所抵消。（JEL D86, H23, J24, J31, J41, J62）

abstract.text: We study how political turnover in mayoral elections in Brazil affects public service provision by local governments. Exploiting a regression discontinuity design for close elections, we find that municipalities with a new party in office experience upheavals in the municipal bureaucracy: new personnel are appointed across multiple service sectors, and at both managerial and non-managerial levels. In education, the increase in the replacement rate of personnel in schools controlled by the municipal government is accompanied by test scores that are 0.05–0.08 standard deviations lower. In contrast, turnover of the mayor’s party does not impact local (non-municipal) schools. These findings suggest that political turnover can adversely affect the quality of public services when the bureaucracy is not shielded from the political process. (JEL D72, D73, H75, H76, J45, O17)

10.1257/aer.20171867.abstractZh: 我们研究了巴西市长选举中的政治换届如何影响地方政府的公共服务提供。通过采用回归不连续设计来研究竞争激烈的选举，我们发现，由新政党担任公职的市镇会出现市政官僚体系中的动荡：多个服务部门会任命新人员，且这些新人员同时出现在管理层和非管理层的职位上。在教育领域，由市政府管理的学校中，人员更换率的增加伴随着测试成绩下降0.05至0.08个标准差。相比之下，市长所属政党的换届并未对地方（非市政）学校产生影响。这些发现表明，当官僚体系不受政治过程影响时，政治换届可能会对公共服务的质量产生不利影响。（JEL D72, D73, H75, H76, J45, O17）

abstract.text: We develop a model of political competition with endogenous turnout and endogenous platforms. Parties trade off incentivizing their supporters to vote and discouraging the supporters of the competing party from voting. We show that the latter objective is particularly pronounced for a party with an edge in the political race. Thus, an increase in political support for a party may lead to the adoption of policies favoring its opponents so as to asymmetrically demobilize them. We study the implications for the political economy of redistributive taxation. Equilibrium tax policy is typically aligned with the interest of voters who are demobilized. (JEL D63, D72, H23, H24)

10.1257/aer.20171927.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个政治竞争模型，其中投票率和竞选纲领都是内生变量。各政党在激励支持者投票与阻止竞争对手的支持者投票之间进行权衡。我们发现，对于在政治竞争中具有优势的政党来说，后一个目标尤为明显。因此，一个政党获得的政治支持增加可能会导致其采取有利于对手的政策，从而不对称地削弱对手的力量。我们研究了再分配税收政策对政治经济的影响。均衡的税收政策通常与被削弱的选民的利益相一致。（JEL D63, D72, H23, H24）

abstract.text: This paper evaluates changes in electricity generation costs caused by the introduction of market mechanisms to determine production in the United States. I use the staggered transition to markets from 1999 to 2012 to estimate the causal impact of liberalization using a differences-in-difference design on a comprehensive hourly panel of electricity demand, generators’ costs, capacities, and output. I find that markets reduce production costs by 5 percent by reallocating production: gains from trade across service areas increase by 55 percent based on a 25 percent increase in traded electricity, and costs from using uneconomical units fall 16 percent. (JEL L51, L94, L98, Q41, Q48)

10.1257/aer.20172034.abstractZh: 本文评估了通过引入市场机制来确定美国电力生产方式所带来的电力生产成本变化。我采用1999年至2012年的分阶段市场过渡模型，通过差异差分设计来估算自由化的因果影响，研究内容包括电力需求的综合小时数据、发电成本、产能以及产量。研究发现，市场通过重新分配生产活动，使生产成本降低了5%。根据25%的电力交易增加，不同服务区域之间的贸易收益增加了55%，而使用不经济发电单元的成本则下降了16%。（JEL L51, L94, L98, Q41, Q48）

abstract.text: How do social interactions shape collective action, and how are they mediated by networked information technologies? We answer these questions studying the Temperance Crusade, a wave of anti-liquor protest activity spreading across 29 states between 1873 and 1874. Relying on exogenous variation in network links generated by railroad accidents, we provide causal evidence of social interactions driving the diffusion of the movement, mediated by rail and telegraph information about neighboring activity. Local newspaper coverage of the crusade was a key channel mediating these effects. Using an event-study methodology, we find strong complementarities between rail and telegraph networks in driving the movement’s spread. (JEL D83, J16, L92, L96, N31, N41, N71)

10.1257/aer.20180124.abstractZh: 社会互动如何塑造集体行动，它们又是如何通过网络信息技术进行中介的？我们通过研究“禁酒运动”来回答这些问题。这场反酒精抗议活动在1873年至1874年间蔓延至29个州。基于由铁路事故引发的网络链接的外生变化，我们提供了社会互动推动该运动扩散的因果证据，这些互动通过铁路和电报信息来传递关于邻近活动的资讯。当地报纸对这场运动的报道是中介这些效应的关键渠道。采用事件研究方法，我们发现铁路和电报网络在推动运动扩散方面存在强烈的互补性。（JEL D83, J16, L92, L96, N31, N41, N71）

abstract.text: We study the welfare effects of enabling peer supply through Airbnb in the accommodation industry. We present a model of competition between flexible and dedicated sellers (peer hosts and hotels) who provide differentiated products. We estimate this model using data from major US cities and quantify the welfare effects of Airbnb on travelers, hosts, and hotels. The welfare gains are concentrated in specific locations (New York) and times (New Year’s Eve) when hotel capacity is constrained. This occurs because peer hosts are responsive to market conditions, expand supply as hotels fill up, and keep hotel prices down as a result. (JEL L11, L83, L86, L88, Z31)

10.1257/aer.20180260.abstractZh: 我们研究了通过Airbnb在住宿行业中实现同行供应对福利的影响。我们构建了一个模型，模拟灵活卖家和专业卖家（同行房东和酒店）之间的竞争，他们提供差异化的产品。我们使用美国主要城市的数据对模型进行了估计，并量化了Airbnb对旅行者、房东和酒店带来的福利影响。这些福利收益集中在特定地点（如纽约）和时段（如新年夜），此时酒店容量有限。这种现象的发生是因为同行房东能够灵活应对市场状况，在酒店满员时增加供应，从而保持酒店价格较低。（JEL L11, L83, L86, L88, Z31）

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the role of rising income inequality in explaining observed growth in college tuition. We develop a competitive model of the college market, in which college quality depends on instructional expenditure and the average ability of admitted students. An innovative feature of our model is that it allows for a continuous distribution of college quality. We find that observed increases in US income inequality can explain more than half of the observed rise in average net tuition since 1990 and that rising income inequality has also depressed college attendance. (JEL D31, I22, I23, I24)

10.1257/aer.20181027.abstractZh: 本文评估了收入不平等加剧在解释大学学费增长中的作用。我们构建了一个大学市场的竞争模型，其中大学质量取决于教学投入以及录取学生的平均能力。我们模型的一个创新之处在于，它允许大学质量呈现连续分布。研究发现，美国收入不平等的加剧可以解释自1990年以来平均净学费增长的一半以上，同时收入不平等的加剧也降低了大学入学率。（JEL D31, I22, I23, I24）

abstract.text: We posit that autocrats introduce local elections when their bureaucratic capacity is low. Local elections exploit citizens’ informational advantage in keeping local officials accountable, but they also weaken vertical control. As bureaucratic capacity increases, the autocrat limits the role of elected bodies to regain vertical control. We argue that these insights can explain the introduction of village elections in rural China and the subsequent erosion of village autonomy years later. We construct a novel dataset to document political reforms, policy outcomes, and de facto power for almost four decades. We find that the introduction of elections improves popular policies and weakens unpopular ones. Increases in regional government resources lead to loss of village autonomy, but less so in remote villages. These patterns are consistent with an organizational view of local elections within autocracies. (JEL D72, D73, D83, O17, O18, P25, P26)

10.1257/aer.20181249.abstractZh: 我们认为，当专制者的官僚能力较低时，会引入地方选举。地方选举利用了公民在监督地方官员方面的信息优势，但同时也削弱了垂直控制。随着官僚能力的提升，专制者会限制民选机构的角色，以重新获得垂直控制。我们认为，这些见解可以解释中国农村地区地方选举的引入，以及随后几年农村自治权的削弱。我们构建了一个新颖的数据集，记录了近四十年的政治改革、政策结果以及实际权力分配情况。我们发现，选举的引入有助于改善民众所支持的政策，而削弱了不受欢迎的政策。区域政府资源的增加会导致农村自治权的丧失，但在偏远地区这种影响较小。这些模式与专制体制下地方选举的组织性特征相一致。（JEL D72, D73, D83, O17, O18, P25, P26）

abstract.text: Increases in the minimum wage can substantially reduce earnings inequality. To demonstrate this, we combine administrative and survey data with an equilibrium model of the Brazilian labor market. We find that a 128 percent increase in the real minimum wage in Brazil between 1996 and 2018 had far-reaching spillover effects on wages higher up in the distribution. The increased minimum wage accounts for 45 percent of a large fall in earnings inequality over this period. At the same time, the effects of the minimum wage on employment and output are muted by reallocation of workers toward more productive firms.. (JEL D31, E23, E24, J31, J38, O15)

10.1257/aer.20181506.abstractZh: 提高最低工资可以显著减少收入不平等。为了证明这一点，我们结合了行政数据和调查数据，并运用巴西劳动力市场的均衡模型进行分析。研究发现，1996年至2018年间，巴西实际最低工资提高了128%，这对收入分配较高的群体产生了深远的影响。在此期间，收入不平等的大幅下降中有45%是由于最低工资的提高所致。同时，最低工资对就业和产出的影响被工人向更高效企业重新分配所抵消。（JEL D31, E23, E24, J31, J38, O15）

abstract.text: What explains the central role of the dollar in world trade? Will the US currency retain its dominant status in the future? This paper develops a quantitative general equilibrium framework with endogenous currency choice that can address these questions. Complementarities in price setting and input-output linkages across firms generate complementarities in currency choice making exporters coordinate on the same currency of invoicing. The dollar is more likely to play this role because of the large size of the US economy, a widespread peg to the dollar, and the history dependence in currency choice. Calibrated using the world input-output tables and exchange rate moments, the model can successfully replicate the key empirical facts about the use of currencies at the global level, across countries, and over time. According to the counterfactual analysis, the peg to the dollar in other economies ensures that the US currency is unlikely to lose its global status because of the falling US share in the world economy, but can be replaced by the renminbi in case of a negative shock in the US economy. If the peg is abandoned, the world is likely to move to a new equilibrium with multiple regional currencies. (JEL D21, E31, E42, F14, F31, F33)

10.1257/aer.20181550.abstractZh: 是什么解释了美元在世界贸易中的核心地位？美国货币在未来是否仍会保持其主导地位？本文提出了一个包含内生货币选择的定量一般均衡框架，以解答这些问题。价格设定和企業間的投入產出聯系中的互补性，促成了货币選擇上的互补性，使得出口商會選擇相同的貿易貨幣。由於美國經濟規模龐大、美元被廣泛用作貨幣基準，以及歷史上的貨幣選擇依賴性，美元更有可能扮演這一角色。通過世界投入產出表和匯率矩陣進行校准，該模型能夠成功複制關於全球範圍內、各國之間以及時間變化中貨幣使用的關鍵實證事實。根據反事實分析，其他經濟體與美元掛鉤可以確保美國貨幣不會因美國在世界經濟中的份額下降而失去其全球地位，但在美國經濟出現負面衝擊時，人民幣有可能取而代之。如果放棄美元掛鉤，世界可能會進入一個多種區域貨幣共存的新的均衡狀態。（JEL D21, E31, E42, F14, F31, F33）

abstract.text: Two-year community colleges enroll nearly half of all first-time undergraduates in the United States, but to ambiguous effect: low persistence rates and the potential for diverting students from four-year institutions cast ambiguity over two-year colleges’ contributions to upward mobility. This paper develops a new instrumental variables approach to identifying causal effects along multiple treatment margins, and applies it to linked education and earnings registries to disentangle the net impacts of two-year college access into two competing causal margins: significant value added for two-year entrants who otherwise would not have attended college, but negative impacts on students diverted from immediate four-year entry. (JEL I23, I26, I28, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.20181756.abstractZh: 两年制社区学院招收了美国近一半的首次本科学生，但其效果尚不明确：低的学习持续率以及可能使学生偏离四年制大学，使得人们对两年制学院对提升社会流动性的贡献存在疑虑。本文提出了一种新的工具变量方法，用于识别多个处理边界上的因果效应，并将其应用于教育与收入登记系统，以区分两年制学院入学对两个竞争因果边界的净影响：对原本不会上大学的学生而言，两年制学院带来了显著的价值增加；而对于那些被引导离开直接四年制大学的学生来说，则产生了负面影响。（JEL I23, I26, I28, J24, J31）

abstract.text: We exploit a policy designed to randomly allocate roommates in a large South African university to investigate whether interracial interaction affects stereotypes, attitudes and performance. Using implicit association tests, we find that living with a roommate of a different race reduces White students' negative stereotypes towards Black students and increases interracial friendships. Interaction also affects academic outcomes: Black students improve their GPA, pass more exams and have lower dropout rates. This effect is not driven by roommate's ability. (JEL D91, I23, J15, O12)

10.1257/aer.20181805.abstractZh: 我们利用一项旨在随机分配南非某大学宿舍室友的政策，来研究不同种族之间的互动是否会影响刻板印象、态度以及学业表现。通过隐性联想测试发现，与不同种族的室友同住能够减少白人学生对黑人的负面刻板印象，并增加不同种族之间的友谊。这种互动还影响学业成果：黑人学生的平均绩点提高，通过考试的比例增加，辍学率也降低。这种效应并非由室友的能力所驱动。（JEL D91, I23, J15, O12）

abstract.text: Expanding credit access in developing contexts could help some households while harming others. Microcredit studies show different effects at different quantiles of household profit, including some negative effects; yet these findings also differ across studies. I develop new Bayesian hierarchical models to aggregate the evidence on these distributional effects for mixture-type outcomes such as household profit. Applying them to microcredit, I find a precise zero effect from the fifth to seventy-fifth quantiles, and uncertain yet large effects on the upper tails, particularly for households with business experience. These quantile estimates are more reliable than averages because the data are fat tailed. (JEL G21, G51, L25, O16, P34)

10.1257/aer.20181811.abstractZh: 在发展中国家扩大信贷渠道可能会帮助一些家庭，但同时也会对另一些家庭产生负面影响。关于微型信贷的研究表明，不同家庭利润分位数下会产生不同的影响，其中一些影响是负面的；不过这些研究结果在不同研究中也存在差异。我开发了新的贝叶斯层次模型，以汇总关于这些分布效应的证据，适用于像家庭利润这样的混合型结果。将这些模型应用于微型信贷研究后，我发现从第五分位数到第七十五分位数，信贷渠道对家庭利润的影响为零，而在较高分位数上，影响则不确定但较大，尤其是对于那些有商业经验的家庭。这些分位数估计比平均值更为可靠，因为数据具有厚尾特性。（JEL G21, G51, L25, O16, P34）

abstract.text: We investigate the heterogeneous boom and bust patterns across countries that emerge as a result of global shocks. Our analysis sheds light on the emergence of core and periphery countries, and the joint determination of the depth of recessions and tightness of credit across countries. The model implies that interest rates are similar across core and periphery countries in booms, with larger credit and output growth in periphery countries. However, a common global shock that leads to a credit crunch across the globe gives rise to a sharper spike in interest rates and a deeper recession in periphery countries, while a credit flight to the core alleviates the adverse consequences in these countries. (JEL E21, E32, E43, E44, F44, G01, G15)

10.1257/aer.20181830.abstractZh: 我们研究了由于全球冲击而出现的各国之间异质性的繁荣与萧条模式。我们的分析揭示了核心国家与边缘国家之间的区别，以及各国经济衰退深度与信贷紧缩程度的共同决定因素。该模型表明，在繁荣时期，核心国家与边缘国家的利率相似，但边缘国家的信贷和产出增长更为显著。然而，一次全球性的冲击导致全球范围内的信贷紧缩，这会使边缘国家的利率急剧上升，经济衰退更为严重，而信贷向核心国家的流动则有助于缓解这些国家的负面后果。（JEL E21, E32, E43, E44, F44, G01, G15）

abstract.text: This paper studies employer incentives in designing health insurance provider networks and whether observed offerings reflect preferences that are aligned with employees. I estimate a model of supply and demand where I endogenize employer health plan offerings with respect to hospital and physician networks. I find that employers “overprovide” broad networks by overweighting the preferences of certain employees, specifically older workers and those in regions with less provider competition, over the preferences of the average employee household. Shifting employers toward offering different provider networks in different geographic markets could yield substantial gains to surplus, with minimal distributional or selection effects. (JEL G22, G28, I13, J32, M52)

10.1257/aer.20181917.abstractZh: 本文研究了雇主在设计健康保险提供商网络时的激励因素，以及所观察到的产品是否反映了与员工一致的偏好。我构建了一个供需模型，将雇主提供的健康保险计划与医院和医生网络联系起来进行内生化处理。研究发现，雇主在提供广泛网络时，更倾向于满足某些员工的偏好，特别是年龄较大的员工以及那些医生竞争较少地区的员工，而忽视了普通员工家庭的偏好。如果雇主在不同地理市场提供不同的提供商网络，可能会带来显著的收益，同时带来的分配或选择效应很小。（JEL G22, G28, I13, J32, M52）

abstract.text: Workers' compensation insurance, which provides no-fault coverage for work-related injuries, is mandatory in nearly all states. We use administrative data from a unique market without a coverage mandate to estimate the demand for workers' compensation insurance, leveraging regulatory premium updates for identification. We find that a 1 percent increase in premiums leads to approximately a 0.3 percent decline in coverage. Drawing upon these estimates and data on costs, we examine potential justifications for government intervention to increase coverage. This analysis suggests that several forms of market failure-such as adverse selection, market power, and externalities-may not justify a mandate in this setting.

10.1257/aer.20190261.abstractZh: 工人赔偿保险为与工作相关的伤害提供无过错保障，几乎在所有州都是强制性的。我们利用一个没有强制保险规定的独特市场的行政数据，来估算工人赔偿保险的需求，并通过监管保费更新来识别相关信息。研究发现，保费增加1%会导致保险覆盖率下降约0.3%。基于这些估算数据和成本数据，我们探讨了政府干预以增加保险覆盖率的潜在理由。分析表明，诸如逆向选择、市场力量和外部性等多种市场失灵现象，可能不足以证明在这种情况下实施强制保险的理由。

abstract.text: We show how offshore profit shifting by US multinational enterprises affects several key measures of the US economy. Profits shifted out of the United States grew rapidly from the mid-1990s to 2010 and have since waned. From 1982–2016, on average, 38 percent of income attributed to US direct investment abroad is reattributable to the United States. We find that adjusting for profit shifting shrinks the trade deficit, decreases the return on US foreign direct investment abroad, boosts productivity growth rates in the late 1990s and early 2000s, and lowers labor’s share of income. (JEL E23, E25, F14, F23, H25, H87, L25)

10.1257/aer.20190285.abstractZh: 我们展示了美国跨国企业进行的离岸利润转移如何影响美国经济的几个关键指标。从20世纪90年代中期到2010年，从美国境外转移的利润迅速增加，此后则有所减少。在1982年至2016年间，平均有38%归因于美国海外直接投资的收入可以重新归属于美国。我们发现，调整利润转移后，贸易赤字会缩小，美国海外直接投资的回报率会下降，1990年代末和2000年代初的生产率增长率会上升，同时劳动力收入份额也会降低。（JEL E23, E25, F14, F23, H25, H87, L25）

abstract.text: Public recognition is frequently used to motivate desirable behavior, yet its welfare effects—such as costs of shame or gains from pride— are rarely measured. We develop a portable empirical methodology for measuring and monetizing social image utility, and we deploy it in experiments on exercise and charitable behavior. In all experiments, public recognition motivates desirable behavior but creates highly unequal image payoffs. High-performing individuals enjoy significant utility gains, while low-performing individuals incur significant utility losses. We estimate structural models of social signaling, and we use the models to explore the social efficiency of public recognition policies. (JEL C93, D64, D82, D91)

10.1257/aer.20190433.abstractZh: 公共认可常被用作激励人们采取理想行为的手段，然而其带来的福利效应——如羞耻的成本或自豪带来的收益——却很少被测量。我们开发了一种可移植的实证方法，用于衡量和货币化社会形象效用，并在关于锻炼和慈善行为的实验中应用了这一方法。在所有实验中，公共认可都能激励人们采取理想行为，但带来的社会形象收益却极不均匀。表现优异的个体能够获得显著的效用收益，而表现不佳的个体则面临显著的效用损失。我们通过构建社会信号传递的结构模型，并利用这些模型来探讨公共认可政策的社会效率。（JEL C93, D64, D82, D91）

abstract.text: We formulate a model of social interactions and misinferences by agents who neglect assortativity in their society, mistakenly believing that they interact with a representative sample of the population. A key component of our approach is the interplay between this bias and agents’ strategic incentives. We highlight a mechanism through which assortativity neglect, combined with strategic complementarities in agents’ behavior, drives up action dispersion in society (e.g., socioeconomic disparities in education investment). We also suggest that the combination of assortativity neglect and strategic incentives may be relevant in understanding empirically documented misperceptions of income inequality and political attitude polarization. (JEL C78, D11, D31, D72, D82, D91)

10.1257/aer.20190486.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个关于社会互动与误判的模型，该模型描述了那些在社交关系中忽视群体同质性、错误地认为自己与人口代表性样本进行互动的个体的行为。我们研究的核心在于这种偏见与个体策略性动机之间的相互作用。我们指出，忽视群体同质性以及个体行为中的策略性互补性，共同导致了社会中的行为分散现象（例如，教育投资方面的社会经济差异）。我们还认为，忽视群体同质性与策略性动机的结合，可能有助于解释那些关于收入不平等和政治态度两极分化误判的实证研究结果。（JEL C78, D11, D31, D72, D82, D91）

abstract.text: This study argues that economic vulnerability causes citizens to participate in clientelism, a phenomenon with various pernicious consequences. To examine how reduced vulnerability affects citizens’ participation in clientelism, we employ two exogenous shocks to vulnerability. First, we designed a randomized control trial to reduce household vulnerability: our development intervention constructed residential water cisterns in drought-prone areas of Brazil. Second, we exploit rainfall shocks. We find that reducing vulnerability significantly decreases requests for private goods from politicians, especially among citizens likely to be in clientelist relationships. Moreover, reducing vulnerability decreases votes for incumbent mayors, who typically have more resources for clientelism. (JEL D72, H41, I38, O12, O17, Q54)

10.1257/aer.20190565.abstractZh: 本研究认为，经济脆弱性会导致公民参与裙带关系现象，这一现象具有多种有害后果。为了探讨经济脆弱性的降低如何影响公民参与裙带关系的行为，我们采用了两种外部冲击来研究脆弱性对公民参与裙带关系的影响。首先，我们设计了一项随机对照试验，以减少家庭的脆弱性：我们的发展干预措施在巴西干旱地区建造了住宅用水蓄水池。其次，我们利用了降雨冲击。研究发现，降低脆弱性显著减少了公民向政治家提出私人商品需求的频率，尤其是在那些可能处于裙带关系中的公民中。此外，降低脆弱性还减少了现任市长的选票，因为这些市长通常拥有更多的资源用于裙带关系。（JEL D72, H41, I38, O12, O17, Q54）

abstract.text: A long-standing puzzle is how overconfidence can persist in settings characterized by repeated feedback. This paper studies managers who participate repeatedly in a high-powered tournament incentive system, learning relative performance each time. Using reduced form and structural methods we find that (i) managers make over-confident predictions about future performance; (ii) managers have overly positive memories of past performance; (iii) the two phenomena are linked at an individual level. Our results are consistent with models of motivated beliefs in which individuals are motivated to distort memories of feedback and preserve unrealistic expectations. (JEL D82, D83, J33, L25, L81, M52, M54)

10.1257/aer.20190668.abstractZh: 一个长期存在的谜题是，在具有重复反馈的环境中，过度自信如何能够持续存在。本文研究的是那些反复参与高权力激励系统的管理者，他们每次都会了解相对表现。通过简化形式和结构方法分析，我们发现：(i)管理者对未来表现做出了过度自信的预测；(ii)管理者对过去的表现有过于积极的记忆；(iii)这两种现象在个体层面上是相互关联的。我们的研究结果与那些认为个体有动机扭曲反馈记忆并保持不切实际的期望的模型一致。(JEL D82, D83, J33, L25, L81, M52, M54)

abstract.text: We quantify the importance of imperfect competition in the US labor market by estimating the size of labor market rents earned by American firms and workers. We construct a matched employer-employee panel dataset by combining the universe of US business and worker tax records for the period 2001–2015. Using this panel data, we identify and estimate an equilibrium model of the labor market with two-sided heterogeneity where workers view firms as imperfect substitutes because of heterogeneous preferences over nonwage job characteristics. The model allows us to draw inference about imperfect competition, worker sorting, compensating differentials, and rent sharing. (JEL D24, H24, H25, J22, J24, J31, J42)

10.1257/aer.20190790.abstractZh: 我们通过估算美国企业和工人所赚取的市场租金规模，来量化美国劳动力市场中不完全竞争的重要性。我们结合2001至2015年期间美国的商业和工人税务记录，构建了一个匹配的雇主-雇员面板数据集。利用这一面板数据，我们识别并估计了一个具有双向异质性的劳动力市场均衡模型，其中工人将企业视为不完全替代品，因为他们对非工资工作特征有着不同的偏好。该模型使我们能够推断出关于不完全竞争、工人排序、补偿差异和租金共享的信息。（JEL D24, H24, H25, J22, J24, J31, J42）

abstract.text: Many price indices must be constructed without quantity data at the elementary level. The paper shows that for some consumer goods in the United States and other countries, one can approximate expenditure shares using weights derived from the retail distribution of sellers. These weights are based on the share of outlets selling an item, or the share of outlets adjusted by the total number of items sold in each. Relative to using no weights, the paper finds that using such imputed weights substantially reduces bias in the frequency of price changes, in annual inflation, and in price comparisons across countries. (JEL E31, L11, L81, O11, O14)

10.1257/aer.20190896.abstractZh: 许多价格指数在基础层面必须在没有数量数据的情况下构建。本文指出，对于美国和其他国家的某些消费品，可以使用基于零售商零售分布得出的权重来近似计算支出份额。这些权重基于销售某种商品的零售店的比例，或者根据每种商品销售总量进行调整后的零售店比例。与不使用权重相比，本文发现使用这种估算的权重可以显著减少价格变化频率、年度通货膨胀以及国家间价格比较的偏差。（JEL E31, L11, L81, O11, O14）

abstract.text: We design three field experiments to estimate how workers' social preferences toward their employer motivates their work effort. We vary the pay rates offered to workers, the return to the employer, and employer generosity demonstrated via unexpected gifts. Workers exert effort even without private incentives, but their effort is insensitive to the return to the employer. This is consistent with “warm glow” but not pure altruism. The gifts have no effect on productivity, but engender extra work. This difference is explained partly by the finding that extra work is much more responsive to incentives than is productivity. (JEL C93, J24, J28, J33, M52)

10.1257/aer.20190920.abstractZh: 我们设计了三项实地实验，以评估工人对其雇主的社会偏好如何激发他们的工作积极性。我们改变了提供给工人的薪酬水平、雇主的回报，以及雇主通过意外礼物展现的慷慨程度。即使没有私人激励，工人也会付出努力，但他们的努力对雇主的回报并不敏感。这与“温暖感”相符，但并非纯粹的利他主义。这些礼物对生产力没有影响，但会促使工人承担额外的工作。这种差异部分可以解释为，额外的工作对激励的反应要比生产力更为敏感。（JEL C93, J24, J28, J33, M52）

abstract.text: In a field experiment that constructs a randomized credit limit shock, participants borrow to spend 11 cents on the dollar in the first quarter and 28 cents by the third year. Effects extend to those far from the limit, those who had the new limits as available credit, and those with a liquid asset buffer. In the short-run, flexible and installment contracts are used in tandem, with unconstrained using installments more. Long-run borrowing is predominantly using installments. Near limits, participants borrow when credit expands but save out of constraints when limits are tight. Findings support a buffer-stock interpretation emphasizing precautionary saving. (JEL C93, E21, G21, G51, O12, O16)

10.1257/aer.20191178.abstractZh: 在一项构建随机信用额度冲击的实地实验中，参与者在第一季度借款花费11美分，到第三年则花费28美分。这一效应不仅适用于那些接近信用额度的人，也适用于那些拥有新设定信用额度的人，以及那些拥有流动资产缓冲的人。短期内，灵活的分期付款合同被同时使用，其中无限制的情况下更多使用分期付款。长期来看，借款主要使用分期付款方式。在接近信用额度的阶段，参与者在信用额度扩大时借款，而在额度紧张时则出于约束而储蓄。研究结果支持一种强调预防性储蓄的缓冲-库存解释。（JEL C93, E21, G21, G51, O12, O16）

abstract.text: How does rural-urban migration shape urban production in developing countries? We use longitudinal data on Chinese manufacturing firms between 2000 and 2006, and exploit exogenous variation in rural-urban migration induced by agricultural income shocks for identification. We find that, when immigration increases, manufacturing production becomes more labor intensive and productivity declines. We investigate the reorganization of production using patent applications and product information. We show that rural-urban migration induces both labor-oriented technological change and the adoption of labor intensive product varieties. (JEL D24, L23, L60, O33, P25, P31, R23)

10.1257/aer.20191234.abstractZh: 农村-城市迁移如何塑造发展中国家的城市生产？我们使用了2000至2006年间中国制造企业的纵向数据，并利用农业收入冲击引起的农村-城市迁移的外生变化来进行研究。我们发现，当移民数量增加时，制造业生产变得更加劳动密集型，生产率下降。我们通过专利申请和产品信息来研究生产的重组。我们发现，农村-城市迁移既促进了以劳动密集型产品为特点的技术变革，也促进了劳动密集型产品的采用。（JEL D24, L23, L60, O33, P25, P31, R23）

abstract.text: This paper studies how the impact of monetary policy depends on the distribution of savings from refinancing mortgages. We show that the efficacy of monetary policy is state dependent, varying in a systematic way with the pool of potential savings from refinancing. We construct a quantitative dynamic life-cycle model that accounts for our findings and use it to study how the response of consumption to a change in mortgage rates depends on the distribution of savings from refinancing. These effects are strongly state dependent. We also use the model to study the impact of a long period of low interest rates on the potency of monetary policy. We find that this potency is substantially reduced both during the period and for a substantial amount of time after interest rates renormalize. (JEL D15, E21, E43, E52, G21, G51, R31)

10.1257/aer.20191244.abstractZh: 本文研究了货币政策的影响如何取决于再融资抵押贷款储蓄的分配。我们发现，货币政策的有效性依赖于状态，并且会随着再融资潜在储蓄池的变化而系统性地变化。我们构建了一个定量动态生命周期模型，以解释我们的发现，并利用该模型研究消费对抵押贷款利率变化的反应如何取决于再融资储蓄的分配。这些效应具有很强的状态依赖性。我们还利用该模型研究长期低利率对货币政策效力的影响。我们发现，在利率重新调整期间以及之后相当长的一段时间内，货币政策的效力都显著下降。（JEL D15, E21, E43, E52, G21, G51, R31）

abstract.text: Low liquidity and a high marginal propensity to consume are tightly linked. This paper analyzes this link in the context of income tax withholding and refunds. A theory of rational cash management with income uncertainty endogenizes the relationship between illiquidity and the marginal propensity to consume, and can explain the finding that households tend to spend tax refunds as if they valued liquidity, yet do not act to increase liquidity by reducing their withholding. The theory is supported by individual-level evidence based on financial account records, including a positive correlation between the size of tax refunds and the marginal propensity to consume out of those refunds. (JEL E21, G51, H24, H31)

10.1257/aer.20191385.abstractZh: 低流动性与高边际消费倾向之间存在着紧密的联系。本文在所得税预扣与退税的背景下分析了这种联系。一种基于收入不确定性的理性现金管理理论，能够解释为什么家庭倾向于将退税用于消费，仿佛这些退税具有流动性价值，但却不会通过减少预扣额来增加流动性。这一理论得到了基于财务账户记录的个体层面证据的支持，其中包括退税金额与这些退税产生的边际消费倾向之间存在正相关关系。（JEL E21, G51, H24, H31）

abstract.text: We develop, estimate, and test a tractable general equilibrium model of oligopsony with differentiated jobs and concentrated labor markets. We estimate key model parameters by matching new evidence on the relationship between firms’ local labor market share and their employment and wage responses to state corporate tax changes. The model quantitatively replicates quasi-experimental evidence on imperfect productivity-wage pass-through and strategic wage setting of dominant employers. Relative to the efficient allocation, welfare losses from labor market power are 7.6 percent, while output is 20.9 percent lower. Lastly, declining local concentration added 4 percentage points to labor’s share of income between 1977 and 2013. (JEL E25, H71, J24, J31, J42, R23)

10.1257/aer.20191521.abstractZh: 我们开发、估计并测试了一个具有差异化职位和集中式劳动力市场的寡头买方的一般均衡模型。我们通过将新证据与企业在本地劳动力市场中的份额以及它们对州企业税变化的就业和工资反应进行匹配，来估计模型的关键参数。该模型定量地复制了关于不完全生产率-工资传递以及主导雇主的战略性工资设定的准实验证据。与有效分配相比，劳动力市场的权力导致的福利损失为7.6%，而产出则降低了20.9%。最后，从1977年到2013年，劳动力收入份额增加了4个百分点。（JEL E25, H71, J24, J31, J42, R23）

abstract.text: This paper builds a new microdatabase that covers 100 countries at all income levels and long-run time series in the United States (1870–2010) and Mexico ( 1960–2010) to document how the modern tax system arises over development. I establish a new set of stylized facts, which show that the income tax exemption threshold decreases in the income distribution as a country develops, tracking growth in the employee share of employment that occurs gradually further down the income distribution. Additional evidence supports the interpretation that the rise in third-party covered income through increases in employee share drives expansions of the income tax base over development. (JEL D31, H23, H24, H71, J22, J23, N40)

10.1257/aer.20191528.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个新的微观数据库，涵盖了100个国家的所有收入水平，以及美国（1870–2010年）和墨西哥（1960–2010年）的长期时间序列数据，以记录现代税收制度是如何随着经济发展而演变的。我们提出了一组新的典型事实，这些事实表明，随着国家的经济发展，所得税免税门槛在收入分配中的比重逐渐降低，同时员工占就业的比例也随着收入分配的向下移动而逐渐增加。额外的证据支持这样的解释：通过增加员工占就业的比例，第三方覆盖的收入增加推动了税收基础的扩大。（JEL D31, H23, H24, H71, J22, J23, N40）

abstract.text: We quantify reference dependence and loss aversion in the housing market using rich Danish administrative data. Our structural model includes loss aversion, reference dependence, financial constraints, and a sale decision, and matches key nonparametric moments, including a “hockey stick” in listing prices with nominal gains, and bunching at zero realized nominal gains. Households derive substantial utility from gains over the original house purchase price; losses affect households roughly 2.5 times more than gains. The model helps explain the positive correlation between aggregate house prices and turnover, but cannot explain visible attenuation in reference dependence when households are more financially constrained. (JEL D12, D91, G51, R21, R31)

10.1257/aer.20191766.abstractZh: 我们利用丰富的丹麦行政数据来量化住房市场中的参照依赖性和损失厌恶现象。我们的结构模型包含了损失厌恶、参照依赖性、财务约束以及出售决策等因素，并匹配了关键的非参数矩，包括 Listing 价格中的“曲棍球棒”形态与名义收益的关系，以及在实现零名义收益时的聚集现象。家庭从高于原始购房价格的收益中获得显著效用；损失对家庭的影响大约是收益影响的2.5倍。该模型有助于解释整体房价与 turnover之间的正相关性，但无法解释当家庭面临更严重的财务约束时，参照依赖性出现的明显减弱现象。（JEL D12, D91, G51, R21, R31）

abstract.text: We present a news-based measure of adverse geopolitical events and associated risks. The geopolitical risk (GPR) index spikes around the two world wars, at the beginning of the Korean War, during the Cuban Missile Crisis, and after 9/11. Higher geopolitical risk foreshadows lower investment and employment and is associated with higher disaster probability and larger downside risks. The adverse consequences of the GPR index are driven by both the threat and the realization of adverse geopolitical events. We complement our aggregate measures with industry- and firm-level indicators of geopolitical risk. Investment drops more in industries that are exposed to aggregate geopolitical risk. Higher firm-level geopolitical risk is associated with lower firm-level investment. (JEL C43, E32, F51, F52, G31, H56, N40)

10.1257/aer.20191823.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于新闻的负面地缘政治事件及其相关风险的衡量方法。地缘政治风险指数在两次世界大战期间、朝鲜战争初期、古巴导弹危机以及9/11事件后出现峰值。较高的地缘政治风险预示着较低的投资和就业，并伴随着更高的灾难概率和更大的下行风险。地缘政治风险指数的负面后果由负面地缘政治事件的威胁及其实际发生所驱动。我们通过行业和企业层面的指标来补充我们的综合衡量方法。面临综合地缘政治风险的行业，其投资下降幅度更大。较高的企业级地缘政治风险与较低的企业投资水平相关。（JEL C43, E32, F51, F52, G31, H56, N40）

abstract.text: I study how the relative efficiency of high- and low-skill labor varies across countries. Using microdata for countries at different stages of development, I document that differences in relative quantities and wages are consistent with high-skill workers being relatively more productive in rich countries. I exploit variation in the skill premia of foreign-educated migrants to discriminate between two possible drivers of this pattern: cross-country differences in the skill bias of technology and in the relative human capital of skilled labor. I find that the former is quantitatively more important, and discuss the implications of this result for development accounting. (JEL I26, J24, J31, J61, L16, O15)

10.1257/aer.20191852.abstractZh: 我研究高技能和低技能劳动力在不同国家的相对效率差异。通过利用不同发展阶段国家的微观数据，我发现相对数量和工资的差异与高技能工人在富裕国家中相对更高的生产率相一致。我利用外国教育背景移民的技能溢价差异来区分这一模式的两个可能驱动因素：技术技能偏见以及熟练劳动力的相对人力资本差异。我发现前者在数量上更为重要，并讨论了这一结果对发展会计学的影响。（JEL I26, J24, J31, J61, L16, O15）

abstract.text: This paper shows that racial composition shocks during the Great Migration (1940–1970) reduced the gains from growing up in the northern United States for Black families and can explain 27 percent of the region’s racial upward mobility gap today. I identify northern Black share increases by interacting pre-1940 Black migrants’ location choices with predicted southern county out-migration. Locational changes, not negative selection of families, explain lower upward mobility, with persistent segregation and increased crime and policing as plausible mechanisms. The case of the Great Migration provides a more nuanced view of moving to opportunity when destination reactions are taken into account. (JEL H75, H76, J15, J62, K42, N32, R23)

10.1257/aer.20200002.abstractZh: 本文指出，在“大迁徙”时期（1940–1970年），种族构成的冲击减少了黑人家庭在美国北部地区成长所带来的收益，这一因素可以解释当前该地区种族向上流动差距的27%。我通过分析1940年之前黑人移民的地理位置选择，以及南方地区的向外迁移趋势，来探讨北部地区黑人比例上升的原因。研究发现，地理位置的变化而非家庭的负面选择导致了较低的向上流动能力，而持续的种族隔离以及犯罪率和警力增加被认为是导致这一问题的合理机制。“大迁徙”案例为在考虑目的地反应的情况下，如何获得机会提供了更为细致的分析。（JEL H75, H76, J15, J62, K42, N32, R23）

abstract.text: This paper quantifies employer market power in US manufacturing and how it has changed over time. Using administrative data, we estimate plant-level markdowns—the ratio between a plant’s marginal revenue product of labor and its wage. We find most manufacturing plants operate in a monopsonistic environment, with an average markdown of 1.53, implying a worker earning only 65 cents on the marginal dollar generated. To investigate long-term trends for the entire sector, we propose a novel, theoretically grounded measure for the aggregate markdown. We find that it decreased between the late 1970s and the early 2000s, but has been sharply increasing since. (JEL J24, J31, J38, J42, L13, L60)

10.1257/aer.20200025.abstractZh: 本文量化了美国制造业中的雇主市场力量及其随时间的变化情况。通过利用行政数据，我们估算了工厂层面的降价率——即工厂劳动力的边际收入产品与其工资之间的比率。我们发现，大多数制造工厂处于垄断买方市场环境中，平均降价率为1.53，这意味着工人只能从每美元边际收入中获得65美分的收益。为了研究整个行业的长期趋势，我们提出了一种基于理论的新衡量方法，用于计算总体降价率。研究发现，从20世纪70年代末到21世纪初，总体降价率有所下降，但此后急剧上升。（JEL J24, J31, J38, J42, L13, L60）

abstract.text: This paper considers the use of instruments to identify and estimate private and social returns to education within a model of employer learning. What an instrument identifies depends on whether it is hidden from, or transparent (i.e., observed ) to, the employers. A hidden instrument identifies private returns to education, and a transparent instrument identifies social returns to education. We use variation in compulsory schooling laws across noncentral and central municipalities in Norway to, respectively, construct hidden and transparent instruments. We estimate a private return of 7.9 percent, of which 70 percent is due to increased productivity and the remaining 30 percent is due to signaling. (JEL D82, H75, I26, I28, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.20200146.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在雇主学习模型中，使用工具变量来识别并估算教育的私人回报与社会回报的方法。工具变量能否被识别取决于其是否对雇主是隐藏的，还是透明的（即被观察到）。隐藏的工具变量能够识别教育的私人回报，而透明的工具变量则能够识别教育的社会回报。我们利用挪威非中心城市与中心城市之间义务教育法律的不同情况，分别构建了隐藏工具变量和透明工具变量。我们估算出教育的私人回报为7.9%，其中70%归因于生产力的提升，其余30%则归因于信号传递的作用。（JEL D82, H75, I26, I28, J24, J31）

abstract.text: I study how an organization should manage a project of uncertain scope, when it is advised by a privately informed expert who prefers to prolong his employment. The optimal long-term contract combines a deadline for project completion and incentive payments which decline as the deadline approaches. When the firm can additionally learn about the project's state from output, the optimal deadline exhibits variable sensitivity to output, with a hard deadline at the outset of the project and increasingly soft deadlines as the project's performance declines. (JEL D21, D82, D86, G31, J33, M52, M54)

10.1257/aer.20200212.abstractZh: 我研究了一个组织如何管理不确定范围的项目，此时该组织由一位消息灵通的专家提供建议，这位专家更倾向于延长自己的雇佣期。最优的长期合同结合了项目完成的截止日期和随着截止日期临近而减少的激励支付。当企业还能通过项目产出来了解项目的状态时，最优的截止日期对产出表现出不同的敏感性：在项目初期采用严格的截止日期，随着项目表现下降，截止日期逐渐变得宽松。（JEL D21, D82, D86, G31, J33, M52, M54）

abstract.text: A childhood intervention to improve the social skills and self-control of at-risk kindergarten boys in the 1980s had positive impacts over the life course: higher trust and self-control as adolescents; increased social group membership, education, and reduced criminality as young adults; and increased marriage and employment as adults. Using administrative data, we find this intervention increased average yearly employment income by about 20 percent and decreased average yearly social transfers by almost 40 percent. We estimate that $1 invested in this program around age 8 yields about $11 in benefits by age 39, with an internal rate of return of around 17 percent. (JEL I21, I26, I28, J13, J24, J31, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20200224.abstractZh: 在20世纪80年代，一项针对高风险幼儿园男孩的童年干预措施在他们的整个生命周期中产生了积极影响：青少年时期，这些男孩的信任感和自我控制能力有所提升；成年后，他们加入社会群体的程度增加，接受教育的机会增多，犯罪率降低；成年后，他们的结婚率和就业率也有所提高。通过行政数据分析，我们发现这项干预措施使平均每年的就业收入增加了约20%，而平均每年的社会转移支出减少了近40%。我们估计，在8岁左右投入1美元，到39岁时可以获得约11美元的好处，内部回报率约为17%。（JEL I21, I26, I28, J13, J24, J31, Z13）

abstract.text: Laboratory evidence shows that when people have to argue for a given position, they persuade themselves about the position’s factual and moral superiority. Such self-persuasion limits the potential of communication to resolve conflict and reduce polarization. We test for this phenomenon in a field setting, at international debating competitions that randomly assign experienced and motivated debaters to argue one side of a topical motion. We find self-persuasion in factual beliefs and confidence in one’s position. Effect sizes are smaller than in the laboratory, but robust to a one-hour exchange of arguments and a tenfold increase in incentives for accuracy. (JEL C93, D12, D72, D83, D91, I23)

10.1257/aer.20200372.abstractZh: 实验室证据表明，当人们必须为某个立场进行辩论时，他们会自我说服，认为该立场在事实和道德上更为优越。这种自我说服限制了沟通在解决冲突和减少两极分化方面的潜力。我们在实际场景中测试了这一现象，即在国际辩论比赛中，将经验丰富且积极性高的辩手随机分配到某一立场进行辩论。我们发现，在事实信念和对自己立场的信任方面存在自我说服现象。虽然效应量比实验室中的要小，但这一效应在经过一小时的交锋后仍然保持稳定，并且随着激励因素增加十倍时，效应量仍然显著。（JEL C93, D12, D72, D83, D91, I23）

abstract.text: We present a model featuring risk-averse investors with heterogeneous beliefs. Individuals who are correct in hindsight—whether through luck or judgment—get rich, so sentiment is bullish following good news and bearish following bad news. Sentiment makes extreme outcomes far more important for pricing and has asymmetric effects on left- and right-skewed assets. Investors take speculative positions that can conflict with their fundamental views. Moderate investors are contrarian: they trade against excess volatility created by extremists. All investors view speculation as socially costly; but they also think it is in their self-interest, and the market can collapse entirely if speculation is banned. (JEL D81, D83, G11, G12, G41)

10.1257/aer.20200505.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，该模型以风险厌恶型投资者和具有不同信念的投资者为特点。那些事后判断正确的个体——无论是因为运气还是判断力——都会变得富有，因此好消息会带来乐观的情绪，而坏消息则会导致悲观的情绪。情绪使得极端结果对定价的影响更加重要，并且对左偏和右偏资产产生不对称的影响。投资者会采取与他们的基本观点相矛盾的投机行为。稳健的投资者倾向于逆向操作：他们通过交易来抵消极端行为造成的过度波动。所有投资者都认为投机行为具有社会成本；但他们也认为这符合他们的自身利益，如果禁止投机行为，市场可能会完全崩溃。（JEL D81, D83, G11, G12, G41）

abstract.text: This paper aims to improve the practical applicability of the classic theory of incentive contracts under moral hazard. We establish conditions under which the information provided by an A/B test of incentive contracts is sufficient for answering the question of how best to improve a status quo incentive contract, given a priori knowledge of the agent’s monetary preferences. We assess the empirical relevance of this result using data from DellaVigna and Pope’s (2018) study of a variety of incentive contracts. Finally, we discuss how our framework can be extended to incorporate additional considerations beyond those in the classic theory. (JEL D82, D86, D91)

10.1257/aer.20200732.abstractZh: 本文旨在提高经典激励契约理论在道德风险情境下的实际应用性。我们建立了条件，根据这些条件，通过A/B测试激励契约所提供的信息，足以回答在事先了解代理人的货币偏好的情况下，如何最好地改进现状激励契约的问题。我们利用DellaVigna和Pope在2018年对多种激励契约的研究数据，评估了这一结果的实证相关性。最后，我们讨论了如何扩展我们的框架，以纳入经典理论之外的一些额外考虑因素。（JEL D82, D86, D91）

abstract.text: We examine a new dataset of public procurement laws, practice, and outcomes in 187 countries. We measure regulation as restrictions on the discretion of the procuring entities. We find that laws and practice are highly correlated with each other across countries, and better practice is correlated with better outcomes, but laws themselves are not correlated with outcomes. A closer look shows that stricter laws correlate with improved outcomes, but only in countries with low public sector capacity. We present a model of procurement in which both regulatory rules and public sector capacity determine procurement outcomes. In the model, regulation is effective in countries with low public sector capacity, but not in countries with high capacity because it inhibits the socially optimal exercise of discretion to exclude low quality bidders. (JEL D73, H11, H57, K12, K42, O17)

10.1257/aer.20200738.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个包含187个国家公共采购法律、实践及结果的新数据集。我们将监管定义为对采购实体自由裁量权的限制。研究发现，各国之间的法律与实践高度相关，更好的实践往往带来更好的结果，但法律本身与结果并无直接关联。进一步分析发现，更严格的法律在公共部门能力较低的国家中能带来更好的结果。我们提出了一个采购模型，其中监管规则与公共部门能力共同决定了采购结果。该模型表明，在公共部门能力较低的国家，监管是有效的，但在公共部门能力较高的国家，监管反而抑制了社会最优的裁量权行使，从而排除了低质量投标者。（JEL D73, H11, H57, K12, K42, O17）

abstract.text: Identifying high-growth microentrepreneurs in low-income countries remains a challenge due to a scarcity of verifiable information. With a cash grant experiment in India we demonstrate that community knowledge can help target high-growth microentrepreneurs; while the average marginal return to capital in our sample is 9.4 percent per month, microentrepreneurs reported in the top third of the community are estimated to have marginal returns to capital between 24 percent and 30 percent per month. Further we find evidence that community members distort their predictions when they can influence the distribution of resources. Finally, we demonstrate that simple mechanisms can realign incentives for truthful reporting. (JEL D82, G21, I38, L25, L26, O12, O16)

10.1257/aer.20200751.abstractZh: 在低收入国家中识别高成长型微企业家仍然是一个挑战，因为可验证的信息十分匮乏。我们在印度进行了一项现金补助实验，发现社区知识可以帮助筛选出高成长型微企业家；而样本中的资本平均边际回报率为每月9.4%，但社区中排名前三的微企业家报告的资本边际回报率估计在每月24%至30%之间。此外，我们发现当社区成员能够影响资源分配时，他们会扭曲自己的预测。最后，我们证明了简单的机制可以重新调整激励措施，促使人们如实报告。（JEL D82, G21, I38, L25, L26, O12, O16）

abstract.text: In this paper, we conduct a structural analysis of multi-attribute auctions of contracts with a general allocation rule when private information is multidimensional. Upon modeling bidders’ contract value that accounts for their endogenous ex post actions, we nonparametrically identify bidders’ private information from their bids and estimate their joint distribution. Analyzing cash-royalty auctions of Louisiana oil leases, we find government revenue worse and development rates no better than in a cash auction with a fixed royalty in view of adverse selection and moral hazard. Our findings revise conventional wisdom on the optimality of multi-attribute auctions. (JEL D44, D82, D86, H82, Q35)

10.1257/aer.20200864.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们对具有一般分配规则的多属性合同拍卖进行了结构分析，其中私人信息具有多维度特征。在建模投标者的合同价值时，我们考虑了他们基于内生后验行为的决策，并通过非参数方法从投标中识别出投标者的私人信息，并估计了它们的联合分布。通过对路易斯安那州石油租赁的现金-特许权使用费拍卖进行分析，我们发现，在逆向选择和道德风险的情况下，政府收入状况更差，开发率也没有固定特许权使用费现金拍卖那么好。我们的发现修正了关于多属性拍卖最优性的传统观点。（JEL D44, D82, D86, H82, Q35）

abstract.text: We study the emergence of urban self-governance in the late medieval period. We focus on England after the Norman Conquest of 1066, building a novel comprehensive dataset of 554 medieval towns. During the Commercial Revolution (twelfth to thirteenth centuries), many merchant towns obtained Farm Grants: the right of self-governed tax collection and law enforcement. Self-governance, in turn, was a stepping stone for parliamentary representation: Farm Grant towns were much more likely to be summoned directly to the medieval English Parliament than otherwise similar towns. We also show that self-governed towns strengthened the role of Parliament and shaped national institutions over the subsequent centuries. (JEL D02, D72, D73, K11, K34, N43, N93)

10.1257/aer.20200885.abstractZh: 我们研究了中世纪晚期城市自治的兴起。研究重点为1066年诺曼征服后的英格兰，构建了一个包含554个中世纪城镇的综合性数据集。在商业革命时期（12至13世纪），许多商镇获得了“农场特许权”：即自主征收税款和执法的权利。而自治则成为议会代表制的基石：拥有农场特许权的城镇比其他类似城镇更有可能被直接召集到中世纪英格兰议会。我们还发现，自治城镇加强了议会的地位，并在随后的几个世纪中塑造了国家制度。（JEL D02, D72, D73, K11, K34, N43, N93）

abstract.text: We assess South African workseekers’ skills and disseminate the assessment results to explore how limited information affects firm and workseeker behavior. Giving workseekers assessment results that they can credibly share with firms increases workseekers’ employment and earnings and better aligns their skills, beliefs and search strategies. Giving workseekers assessment results that they cannot easily share with firms has similar effects on beliefs and search, but smaller effects on employment and earnings. Giving assessment results only to firms shifts interview decisions. These findings show that getting credible skill information to the right agents can improve outcomes in the labor market. (JEL J22, J23, J24, J31, J41, J64, O15)

10.1257/aer.20200961.abstractZh: 我们评估了南非求职者的技能，并将评估结果传播出去，以探讨有限的信息如何影响企业和求职者的行为。向求职者提供他们能够可信地分享给企业的评估结果，能够提升求职者的就业率和收入，并使他们自己的技能、信念和求职策略更加匹配。而向求职者提供他们难以轻易分享给企业的评估结果，虽然对求职者的信念和求职策略有类似的影响，但对就业率和收入的影响则较小。仅向企业提供评估结果则会导致面试决策发生偏移。这些发现表明，将可信的技能信息传递给正确的对象，可以改善劳动力市场的状况。（JEL J22, J23, J24, J31, J41, J64, O15）

abstract.text: We analyze the effects of Mafia infiltration in the legal economy. Combining information from investigative records with panel data on firms’ governance and balance sheets, we build an indicator of infiltration in firms located in an area with no tradition of Mafia. We show that Mafia targets young and less efficient firms and that infiltration generates a significant rise in firms’ revenues, with no proportionate growth in production inputs and a deterioration of the firm’s financial situation leading to market exit. These findings are consistent with a story of predatory behavior in which infiltration is used for money laundering or rent extraction. (JEL D22, G32, G34, K42, L25)

10.1257/aer.20201015.abstractZh: 我们分析了黑手党对合法经济领域的渗透效应。通过结合调查记录中的信息以及关于企业治理和资产负债表的面板数据，我们构建了一个指标，用于衡量没有黑手党传统的地区内企业的渗透情况。我们发现，黑手党倾向于针对年轻且效率较低的企业，而渗透行为会导致企业收入显著上升，但生产投入的增长并不相应，企业的财务状况也会恶化，最终导致企业退出市场。这些发现与一种掠夺性行为的理论相符，即黑手党利用渗透行为进行洗钱或榨取租金。（JEL D22, G32, G34, K42, L25）

abstract.text: We study bargaining over contingent contracts in problems where private information becomes public or verifiable when the time comes to implement the agreement. We suggest a simple, two-stage game that incorporates important aspects of bargaining. We characterize equilibria in which parties always reach agreement, and study their limits as bargaining frictions vanish. Under mild regularity conditions, we show all interim-efficient limits belong to Myerson’s (1984) axiomatic solution. Furthermore, all limits must be interim efficient if equilibrium beliefs satisfy no-signaling-what-you-don’ t-know. Results extend to other bargaining protocols. (JEL C78, D82, D83, D86)

10.1257/aer.20201026.abstractZh: 我们研究了在私人信息在达成协议时变得公开或可验证的情境下，关于条件性合同的讨价还价行为。我们提出了一个简单的两阶段博弈模型，该模型包含了讨价还价的重要方面。我们描述了各方始终能够达成协议的均衡状态，并研究了随着讨价还价摩擦消失后这些均衡的极限情况。在温和的规则条件下，我们证明了所有中间效率的均衡都属于Myerson（1984年）的公理解。此外，如果均衡信念满足“不信号-你不知道”的条件，那么所有均衡都必须是中间高效的。这些结果也适用于其他讨价还价协议。（JEL C78, D82, D83, D86）

abstract.text: Concentration-based thresholds for horizontal mergers, such as those in the US Horizontal Merger Guidelines, play a central role in merger analysis but their basis remains unclear. We show that there is both a theoretical and an empirical basis for focusing solely on the change in concentration, and ignoring its level, in screening mergers for whether their unilateral price effects will harm consumers. We also argue that current threshold levels likely are too lax, unless one expects efficiency gains of 5 percent or greater, or other factors such as entry and product repositioning to significantly constrain the exercise of market power postmerger. (JEL D43, G34, G38, K21, L13, L41)

10.1257/aer.20201038.abstractZh: 基于集中度阈值的横向合并标准，如美国的《横向合并指南》中所规定的标准，在合并分析中起着核心作用，但其依据仍不明确。我们指出，在筛选合并是否会对消费者造成不利影响时，仅关注集中度的变化而忽略其具体水平，既有理论依据，也有实证依据。我们还认为，目前的阈值水平可能过于宽松，除非预期合并后的效率提升达到5%或更高，或者存在其他因素如进入壁垒和产品重新定位能够显著限制合并后市场力量的行使。（JEL D43, G34, G38, K21, L13, L41）

abstract.text: Motivated by the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic, we present a theory of Keynesian supply shocks: shocks that reduce potential output in a sector of the economy, but that, by reducing demand in other sectors, ultimately push aggregate activity below potential. A Keynesian supply shock is more likely when the elasticity of substitution between sectors is relatively low, the intertemporal elasticity of substitution is relatively high, and markets are incomplete. Fiscal policy can display a smaller multiplier, but the insurance benefit of fiscal transfers can be enhanced. Firm exits and job destruction can amplify and propagate the shock. (JEL D52, E23, E24, E32, E62, I12, I18)

10.1257/aer.20201063.abstractZh: 受COVID-19大流行的影响，我们提出了一种凯恩斯主义供给冲击的理论：这种冲击会降低经济某一部门的潜在产出，但通过减少其他部门的需求，最终使整体经济活动低于潜在水平。当各部门之间的替代弹性相对较低、跨时段的替代弹性较高且市场不完善时，发生凯恩斯主义供给冲击的可能性更大。财政政策虽然能产生的乘数效应较小，但财政转移带来的保障作用可以得到增强。企业退出和就业破坏可能会放大并传播这种冲击。（JEL D52, E23, E24, E32, E62, I12, I18）

abstract.text: We study the welfare effects of offering choice over coverage levels-"vertical choice"-in regulated health insurance markets. We emphasize that heterogeneity in efficient coverage level is not sufficient to motivate choice. When premiums cannot reflect individuals' costs, it may not be in consumers' best interest to select their efficient coverage level. We show that vertical choice is efficient only if consumers with higher willingness-to-pay have a higher efficient level of coverage. We investigate this condition empirically and find that as long as a minimum coverage level can be enforced, the welfare gains from vertical choice are either zero or economically small.

10.1257/aer.20201073.abstractZh: 我们研究了在受监管的医疗保险市场中，提供选择而非覆盖水平——即“垂直选择”所带来的福利效应。我们强调，仅存在效率不同的覆盖水平并不足以激发选择行为。当保费无法反映个人的成本时，消费者选择其效率最高的覆盖水平可能并不符合自身利益。我们指出，只有当支付意愿较高的消费者拥有更高效率的覆盖水平时，垂直选择才具有效率。我们通过实证研究验证了这一条件，发现只要能够强制执行最低覆盖水平，垂直选择带来的福利收益要么为零，要么在经济上微不足道。

abstract.text: We provide an incomplete information bargaining framework that captures the effects of differential bargaining power in markets with multiple buyers and multiple suppliers. The market is modeled as a mechanism that maximizes the expected weighted welfare of the firms, subject to the constraints of incentive compatibility, individual rationality, and no deficit. We show that, in this model, there is no basis for the presumption that vertical integration increases equally weighted social surplus, while it is possible that horizontal mergers that appropriately change bargaining weights increase social surplus. Moreover, efficient bargaining implies that in equilibrium noncontractible investments are efficient. (JEL C78, D82, D83, G34, K21, L22, L40)

10.1257/aer.20201092.abstractZh: 我们提供了一个不完整的信息谈判框架，用于捕捉在具有多个买家和多个供应商的市场中，不同谈判力量所带来的影响。该市场被建模为一个机制，旨在最大化企业的预期加权福利，同时遵循激励相容性、个体理性以及无赤字等约束条件。我们表明，在这个模型中，没有理由认为垂直整合会同等增加社会总收益，而横向合并通过适当调整谈判权重，有可能增加社会总收益。此外，有效的谈判意味着在均衡状态下，不可协商的投资也是有效的。（JEL C78, D82, D83, G34, K21, L22, L40）

abstract.text: Information plays a crucial role in mechanism design problems. A potential complication is that buyers may be inattentive, and so their information may endogenously and flexibly depend on the offered mechanism. I show that it is without loss of generality to consider contour mechanisms, which comprise triplets of allocation probabilities, prices, and beliefs, and are uniquely determined by a single such point. The mechanism design problem then reduces to Bayesian persuasion along the optimal contour. This reduction has significant implications for both the implementation of the optimal mechanism and the revenues that can be achieved. (JEL C11, D11, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20201098.abstractZh: 信息在机制设计问题中起着至关重要的作用。一个潜在的复杂情况是，购买者可能不够注意，因此他们的信息可能会内生地、灵活地依赖于所提供的机制。我证明了，考虑轮廓机制是毫无普遍性的，轮廓机制由分配概率、价格和信念的三元组组成，并且由单个这样的点唯一确定。因此，机制设计问题可以简化为沿着最优轮廓进行贝叶斯说服。这种简化对于实现最优机制和所能获得的收益都有重要的意义。（JEL C11, D11, D82, D83）

abstract.text: This paper introduces a stylized model to capture distinctive features of waiting list allocation mechanisms. First, agents choose among items with associated expected wait times. Waiting times serve a similar role to that of monetary prices in directing agents' choices and rationing items. Second, the expected wait for an item is endogenously determined and randomly fluctuates over time. We evaluate welfare under these endogenously determined waiting times and find that waiting time fluctuations lead to misallocation and welfare loss. A simple randomized assignment policy can reduce misallocation and increase welfare. (JEL C78, D61, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20201111.abstractZh: 本文介绍了一个简化的模型，用于捕捉等待列表分配机制的独特特征。首先，代理人会在具有相关预期等待时间的选项之间进行选择。等待时间的作用类似于货币价格，用于指导代理人的选择并分配物品。其次，某项物品的预期等待时间是内生决定的，并且会随时间随机波动。我们评估了在这种内生决定的等待时间下的福利状况，发现等待时间的波动会导致资源分配不当和福利损失。一个简单的随机分配政策可以减少这种分配不当现象，并提高福利水平。（JEL C78, D61, D82, D83）

abstract.text: This paper evaluates an intervention in India that engaged adolescent girls and boys in classroom discussions about gender equality for two years, aiming to reduce their support for societal norms that restrict women's and girls' opportunities. Using a randomized controlled trial, we find that the program made attitudes more supportive of gender equality by 0.18 standard deviations, or, equivalently, converted 16 percent of regressive attitudes. When we resurveyed study participants two years after the intervention had ended, the effects had persisted. The program also led to more gender-equal self-reported behavior, and we find weak evidence that it affected two revealed-preference measures. (JEL D63, D91, I21, J13, J16, 012)

10.1257/aer.20201112.abstractZh: 本文评估了印度一项针对青少年女孩和男孩的干预措施，该措施通过课堂讨论促进性别平等，持续了两年，旨在减少他们对限制妇女和女孩机会的社会规范的支持。通过随机对照试验，我们发现该计划使人们对性别平等的态度增加了0.18个标准差，相当于转变了16%的逆向态度。在干预结束后两年再次对参与者进行调查时，这些效果仍然持续存在。该计划还促进了更平等的性别自我报告行为，但我们发现其影响两个揭示偏好指标的证据较弱。（JEL D63, D91, I21, J13, J16, 012）

abstract.text: We document that nearly half of the global decline in agricultural employment was driven by new cohorts entering the labor market. A new dataset of policy reforms supports an interpretation of these cohort effects as human capital. Using a model of frictional labor reallocation, we conclude that human capital growth led to a sharp decline in the agricultural labor supply, accounting, at fixed prices, for 40 percent of the decrease in agricultural employment. This aggregate effect is halved in general equilibrium and it reflects the role of human capital as both a mediating factor and an independent driver of labor reallocation. (JEL J22, J24, J43, L16, O13, O14, Q10)

10.1257/aer.20201157.abstractZh: 我们指出，全球农业就业减少的近一半是由新进入劳动力市场的群体所推动的。一项新的政策改革数据集支持将这种群体效应解释为人力资本的影响。通过摩擦性劳动力重新分配模型，我们得出结论：人力资本的增长导致了农业劳动力供应的急剧下降，在固定价格下，这一因素占农业就业减少的40%。这种总体效应在一般均衡中减半，这表明人力资本既作为中介因素，也作为劳动力重新分配的独立驱动因素发挥作用。（JEL J22, J24, J43, L16, O13, O14, Q10）

abstract.text: This paper investigates the trade-offs between local elites and state agents as tax collectors in low-capacity states. We study a randomized policy experiment assigning neighborhoods of a large Congolese city to property tax collection by city chiefs or state agents. Chief collection raised tax compliance by 3.2 percentage points, increasing revenue by 44 percent. Chiefs collected more bribes but did not undermine tax morale or trust in government. Results from a hybrid treatment arm in which state agents consulted with chiefs before collection suggest that chief collectors achieved higher compliance by using local information to more efficiently target households with high payment propensities, rather than by being more effective at persuading households to pay conditional on having visited them. (JEL D73, D83, H24, H26, H71, O12, O17)

10.1257/aer.20201159.abstractZh: 本文研究了低能力国家中地方精英与税收官员之间的权衡关系。我们研究了一项随机政策实验，该实验将刚果某大城市的各个社区分配给由城市官员或国家官员负责征收房产税。由城市官员负责征收房产税使税收遵从度提高了3.2个百分点，税收收入增加了44%。城市官员收取了更多的贿赂，但并未破坏税收遵从性或对政府的信任。在一项混合处理组中，国家官员在征收前与城市官员进行协商，结果表明，城市官员通过利用当地信息更有效地针对有高支付倾向的家庭来提升税收遵从度，而不是通过更有效地说服家庭在访问后支付税款来提升遵从度。（JEL D73, D83, H24, H26, H71, O12, O17）

abstract.text: We study supply and demand shocks in a disaggregated model with multiple sectors, multiple factors, input-output linkages, downward nominal wage rigidities, credit-constraints, and a zero lower bound. We use the model to understand how the COVID-19 crisis, an omnibus supply and demand shock, affects output, unemployment, and inflation, and leads to the coexistence of tight and slack labor markets. We show that negative sectoral supply shocks are stagflationary, whereas negative demand shocks are deflationary, even though both can cause Keynesian unemployment. Furthermore, complementarities in production amplify Keynesian spillovers from supply shocks but mitigate them for demand shocks. This means that complementarities reduce the effectiveness of aggregate demand stimulus. In a stylized quantitative model of the United States, we find supply and demand shocks each explain about one-half of the reduction in real GDP from February to May 2020. Although there was as much as 6 percent Keynesian unemployment, this was concentrated in certain markets. Hence, aggregate demand stimulus is one quarter as effective as in a typical recession where all labor markets are slack. (JEL E12, E23, E24, E31, E32, E62, I12)

10.1257/aer.20201229.abstractZh: 我们在一个包含多个部门、多个因素、投入产出联系、名义工资向下刚性、信贷约束以及零下限的分解模型中研究供需冲击。我们利用该模型来理解COVID-19危机这一综合性的供需冲击如何影响产出、失业和通货膨胀，并导致劳动力市场出现紧张与松弛并存的情况。我们发现，负面的部门性供给冲击会导致滞胀，而负面的需求冲击则会导致通缩，尽管这两种情况都可能引发凯恩斯式失业。此外，生产的互补性会放大供给冲击对经济的凯恩斯式溢出效应，但对需求冲击的溢出效应则有所缓解。这意味着互补性会降低总需求刺激措施的效果。在一个针对美国的典型量化模型中，我们发现供需冲击分别解释了2020年2月至5月实际GDP下降约一半的原因。尽管出现了高达6%的凯恩斯式失业，但这一情况主要集中在某些市场领域。因此，总需求刺激措施的效果仅为典型衰退时期的一半，而典型衰退中所有劳动力市场都处于松弛状态。（JEL E12, E23, E24, E31, E32, E62, I12）

abstract.text: Subjective beliefs are crucial for economic inference, yet behavior can challenge the elicitation. We propose that belief elicitation should be incentive compatible not only theoretically but also in a de facto behavioral sense. To demonstrate, we show that the binarized scoring rule, a state-of-the-art elicitation, violates two weak conditions for behavioral incentive compatibility: (i) within the elicitation, information on the incentives increases deviations from truthful reporting; and (ii) in a pure choice over the set of incentives, most deviate from the theorized maximizer. Moreover, we document that deviations are systematic and center-biased, and that the elicited beliefs substantially distort inference. (JEL D83, D91)

10.1257/aer.20201248.abstractZh: 主观信念对于经济推断至关重要，然而行为可能会挑战这种信念的引出过程。我们提出，信念的引出不仅应该在理论上符合激励相容原则，在实际行为中也应当如此。为了证明这一点，我们展示了一种先进的引出方法——二元评分规则，它违反了行为激励相容性的两个弱条件：(i) 在引出过程中，关于激励的信息会加剧偏离真实报告的情况；(ii) 在纯粹的选择过程中，大多数人的选择会偏离理论上的最优解。此外，我们还发现这种偏离是系统性的，并且存在中心偏见，而引出的信念也会显著扭曲经济推断的结果。(JEL D83, D91)

abstract.text: This paper assesses the effects of capital gains taxes on investment in the Republic of Korea (hereafter, Korea), where capital gains tax rates vary at the firm level by firm size. Following a reform in 2014, firms with a tax cut increased investment by 34 log points and issued more equity by 9 cents per dollar of lagged revenue, relative to unaffected firms. Additionally, the effects were larger for firms that appeared more cash constrained or went public after the reform. Taken together, these findings are consistent with the “traditional view” predicting that lower payout taxes spur equity-financed investment by increasing marginal returns on investment. (JEL D25, G31, G32, H25, H32, L25)

10.1257/aer.20201272.abstractZh: 本文评估了资本利得税对韩国投资的影响，韩国的资本利得税率因企业规模而异。根据2014年的改革，享受减税政策的企业投资增加了34个对数点，每美元滞后收入对应的股权发行量增加了9美分。此外，对于那些在改革后面临更多资金限制或选择上市的企业，这种影响更为显著。总体而言，这些发现与“传统观点”一致，即较低的支付税会通过提高投资的边际回报来促进股权融资投资。（JEL D25, G31, G32, H25, H32, L25）

abstract.text: This paper examines the effects of the abandonment of China’s Grand Canal—the world’s largest and oldest artificial waterway—which served as a disruption to regional trade access. Using an original dataset covering 575 counties over 262 years, we show that the canal’s abandonment contributed to the social turmoil that engulfed North China in the nineteenth century. Counties along the canal experienced an additional 117 percent increase in rebelliousness after the canal’s closure relative to their non-canal counterparts. Our findings highlight the important role that continued access to trade routes plays in reducing conflict. (JEL D74, N75, N95, O18, O22, R12, R42)

10.1257/aer.20201283.abstractZh: 本文探讨了中国大运河的废弃对区域贸易通道的影响。大运河是世界上最大、最古老的人工水道，其废弃导致了区域贸易通道的中断。通过一项涵盖575个县、时间跨度达262年的原始数据集，我们发现大运河的废弃加剧了19世纪华北地区的社会动荡。大运河沿线地区的叛乱率比非大运河地区高出117%。我们的研究强调了持续保持贸易通道的重要性，这对于减少冲突具有关键作用。（JEL D74, N75, N95, O18, O22, R12, R42）

abstract.text: This paper examines race and police use of force using data on 1.6 million 911 calls in two cities, neither of which allows for discretion in officer dispatch. Results indicate White officers increase force much more than minority officers when dispatched to more minority neighborhoods. Estimates indicate Black (Hispanic) civilians are 55 (75) percent more likely to experience any force, and five times as likely to experience a police shooting, compared to if White officers scaled up force similarly to minority officers. Additionally, 14 percent of White officers use excess force in Black neighborhoods relative to our statistical benchmark. (JEL H76, J15, K42, R23)

10.1257/aer.20201292.abstractZh: 本文通过分析两个城市160万起911报警电话的数据，探讨了种族与警察使用武力的问题。这两个城市均不允许警察在调度过程中有自由裁量权。研究结果表明，当警察被派往少数族裔社区时，白人警察使用武力的频率远高于少数族裔警察。估计数据显示，与白人警察以与少数族裔警察相似的方式使用武力相比，黑人（西班牙裔）平民遭遇武力行为的可能性高出55%（75%），并且遭遇警察枪击的可能性是白人警察的五倍。此外，有14%的白人警察在黑人社区使用过度武力，这一比例超过了我们的统计基准。（JEL H76, J15, K42, R23）

abstract.text: Health insurers increasingly compete on their networks of medical providers. Using data from Massachusetts’s insurance exchange, I find substantial adverse selection against plans covering the most prestigious and expensive “star” hospitals. I highlight a theoretically distinct selection channel: consumers loyal to star hospitals incur high spending, conditional on their medical state, because they use these hospitals’ expensive care. This implies heterogeneity in consumers’ incremental costs of gaining access to star hospitals, posing a challenge for standard selection policies. Along with selection on unobserved sickness, I find this creates strong incentives to exclude star hospitals, even with risk adjustment in place. (JEL D82, G22, H75, I11, I13, I18)

10.1257/aer.20201453.abstractZh: 健康保险公司越来越多地通过其医疗提供者网络进行竞争。利用马萨诸塞州保险交易所的数据，我发现对于覆盖最著名、最昂贵的“明星”医院的计划来说，存在严重的逆向选择问题。我指出了一个理论上的独特选择渠道：对明星医院有忠诚度的消费者，由于使用这些医院的昂贵医疗服务，其支出会相对较高。这意味着消费者获得访问明星医院的额外成本存在差异，这对标准的选择政策提出了挑战。除了基于未观察到的疾病状况的选择之外，我还发现这会产生强烈的动机，促使保险公司排除明星医院，即使已经实施了风险调整措施。（JEL D82, G22, H75, I11, I13, I18）

abstract.text: This paper develops a satellite account for the US health sector and measures productivity growth in health care for the elderly population between 1999 and 2012. We measure the change in medical spending and health outcomes for a comprehensive set of 80 conditions. Medical care has positive productivity growth over the time period, with aggregate productivity growth of 1.5% per year. However, there is significant heterogeneity in productivity growth. Care for cardiovascular disease has had very high productivity growth. In contrast, care for people with musculoskeletal conditions has been costly but has not led to improved outcomes.

10.1257/aer.20201480.abstractZh: 本文为美国医疗部门开发了一个辅助核算体系，并测量了1999年至2012年间针对老年人口的医疗保健领域的生产率增长。我们针对80种综合状况，测量了医疗支出和健康结果的变化。在这段时间内，医疗保健领域实现了积极的生产率增长，年均增长率为1.5%。然而，生产率增长存在显著的异质性。针对心血管疾病的护理实现了非常高的生产率增长。相比之下，针对肌肉骨骼疾病的护理虽然成本较高，但并未带来更好的健康结果。

abstract.text: Recent research shows prices are insensitive to local demand conditions because national chains charge geographically uniform prices. We examine the price response to local cost shocks, including 68 excise tax changes, 76 sales tax changes, and other geographically based cost differences, using data on 35,151 retail stores in 96 multi-state chains. We find local cost shocks are passed through to local prices, with no spillovers to unaffected stores in otherwise affected chains, and at similar rates for national and local chains. Firms adjust local prices according to local cost changes, suggesting retailers respond asymmetrically to local cost and demand shocks. (JEL D22, D40, H22, H25, H71, L10, L81)

10.1257/aer.20201524.abstractZh: 近期研究表明，价格对当地需求状况并不敏感，因为全国连锁店会收取地理上统一的价格。我们研究了价格对当地成本冲击的响应，包括68次消费税调整、76次销售税调整以及其他基于地理的成本差异，使用的是96个多州连锁店的35,151家零售店的数据。我们发现，当地成本冲击会传递到当地价格上，但其他受影响连锁店中的未受影响店铺则不会受到波及，且全国连锁店和当地连锁店的反应速度相似。企业会根据当地成本的变化调整价格，这表明零售商对当地成本和需求冲击的反应是不对称的。（JEL D22, D40, H22, H25, H71, L10, L81）

abstract.text: The challenge for stabilization policy presented by the COVID-19 pandemic stems above all from disruption of the circular flow of payments, resulting in a failure of what Keynes (1936) calls “effective demand.” As a consequence, economic activity in many sectors can be inefficiently low, and interest-rate policy cannot eliminate the distortions—not because of a limit on the extent to which interest rates can be reduced, but because interest-rate reductions fail to stimulate demand of the right sorts. Fiscal transfers are instead well suited to addressing the fundamental problem, and can under certain circumstances achieve a first-best allocation of resources. (JEL E23, E32, E43, E52, E62, E63, H63)

10.1257/aer.20201529.abstractZh: COVID-19大流行带来的稳定政策挑战主要源于支付循环的破坏，导致凯恩斯在1936年所提到的“有效需求”出现缺失。因此，许多领域的经济活动可能效率低下，而利率政策无法消除这些扭曲——并非因为利率降低的幅度有限，而是因为利率降低未能刺激正确的需求类型。相比之下，财政转移支付更适合解决这一根本问题，并在某些情况下能够实现资源的最佳分配。（JEL E23, E32, E43, E52, E62, E63, H63）

abstract.text: This paper shows how deportation policies can backfire by disseminating not only ideas between countries but also criminal networks, spreading gangs, in this case, across El Salvador, and spurring migration back to the United States. In 1996, the US Illegal Immigration Responsibility Act increased the number of criminal deportations. In particular, the members of large Salvadoran gangs developed in Los Angeles were sent back to El Salvador. Using variation in criminal deportations over time and across cohorts, combined with geographical variation in US gangs’ location, I find that these deportations led to an increase in homicide rates and gang activity, as well as an increase in gang recruitment and migration of children. (JEL J15, J18, K37, K42, O17)

10.1257/aer.20201540.abstractZh: 本文揭示了驱逐政策如何产生反效果，不仅在国家之间传播思想，还促进了犯罪网络的扩散，尤其是在萨尔瓦多境内，并引发了回流到美国的移民现象。1996年，美国《非法移民责任法案》增加了刑事驱逐的数量。特别是，在洛杉矶发展起来的大型萨尔瓦多犯罪团伙的成员被遣返回萨尔瓦多。通过对比不同时期和不同群体之间的刑事驱逐情况，并结合美国犯罪团伙的地理位置差异，我发现这些驱逐行为导致了谋杀率上升、团伙活动增加，以及团伙招募和儿童迁移现象的增加。（JEL J15, J18, K37, K42, O17）

abstract.text: Using a laboratory experiment, we identify whether decision-makers consider it a mistake to violate canonical choice axioms. To do this, we incentivize subjects to report axioms they want their decisions to satisfy. Then, subjects make lottery choices which might conflict with their axiom preferences. In instances of conflict, we give subjects the opportunity to re-evaluate their decisions. We find that many individuals want to follow canonical axioms and revise their choices to be consistent with the axioms. In a shorter online experiment, we show correlations of mistakes with response times and measures of cognition. (JEL C91, D12, D44, D91)

10.1257/aer.20201550.abstractZh: 通过实验室实验，我们研究了决策者是否认为违反规范选择公理是一种错误。为此，我们激励受试者报告他们希望自己的决策满足的公理。然后，受试者会做出可能与他们的公理偏好相冲突的彩票选择。在冲突出现的情况下，我们给予受试者重新评估其决策的机会。我们发现，许多个体希望遵循规范公理，并调整自己的选择以符合这些公理。在一项较短的在线实验中，我们还研究了错误与反应时间及认知水平之间的关联。（JEL C91, D12, D44, D91）

abstract.text: Human capital can depreciate if skills are unused. But estimating human capital depreciation is challenging, as worker skills are difficult to measure and less productive workers are more likely to spend time in nonemployment. We overcome these challenges with new administrative data on teachers’ assignments and their students’ outcomes, and quasi-random variation from the teacher assignment process in Greece. We find significant losses to output, as a one-year increase in time without formal employment lowers students’ test scores by 0.05 standard deviations. Using a simple production model, we estimate a skill depreciation rate of 4.3 percent and experience returns of 6.8 percent. (JEL I21, J24, J45, J64, J65)

10.1257/aer.20201571.abstractZh: 如果技能未被利用，人力资本可能会贬值。然而，估算人力资本贬值是一项挑战，因为工人的技能难以衡量，而且生产力较低的工人更有可能在非就业状态下度过时间。我们通过教师分配情况及其学生成绩的新行政数据，以及希腊教师分配过程中的准随机变化，克服了这些挑战。我们发现，由于非正规就业时间的增加一年会导致学生测试成绩下降0.05个标准差，从而导致了显著的产出损失。利用一个简单的生产模型，我们估算出技能贬值的率为4.3%，而经验回报率为6.8%。（JEL I21, J24, J45, J64, J65）

abstract.text: In many models, economic growth is driven by people discovering new ideas. These models typically assume either a constant or growing population. However, in high income countries today, fertility is already below its replacement rate: women are having fewer than two children on average. It is a distinct possibility that global population will decline rather than stabilize in the long run. In standard models, this has profound implications: rather than continued exponential growth, living standards stagnate for a population that vanishes. Moreover, even the optimal allocation can get trapped in this outcome if there are delays in implementing optimal policy. (JEL I12, J11, J13, O41)

10.1257/aer.20201605.abstractZh: 在许多模型中，经济增长是由人们发现新想法所推动的。这些模型通常假设人口数量保持不变或持续增长。然而，在当今的高收入国家，生育率已经低于人口替代率：女性平均生育的孩子数量少于两个。从长远来看，全球人口可能会下降，而不是保持稳定。在标准模型中，这一情况具有深远的影响：对于逐渐减少的人口来说，生活水平将停滞不前，而非继续呈指数增长。此外，即使是最优的政策分配，如果实施政策的延迟，也可能导致这种结果。（JEL I12, J11, J13, O41）

abstract.text: We develop new quasi-experimental tools to measure disparate impact, regardless of its source, in the context of bail decisions. We show that omitted variables bias in pretrial release rate comparisons can be purged by using the quasi-random assignment of judges to estimate average pretrial misconduct risk by race. We find that two-thirds of the release rate disparity between white and Black defendants in New York City is due to the disparate impact of release decisions. We then develop a hierarchical marginal treatment effect model to study the drivers of disparate impact, finding evidence of both racial bias and statistical discrimination.

10.1257/aer.20201653.abstractZh: 我们开发了新的准实验工具，用于衡量 bail 决策背景下不同来源的影响。我们发现，通过采用准随机分配法官的方式，可以消除在预审判释放率比较中出现的遗漏变量偏差。研究发现，纽约市白人与黑人被告之间的释放率差异中有三分之二是由于释放决策的差异化影响造成的。随后，我们建立了一个分层边际处理效应模型，以研究这种差异化影响的驱动因素，并发现了种族偏见和统计歧视的证据。

abstract.text: We measure the overall influence of contextual versus individual factors (e.g., voting rules and media as opposed to race and education) on voter behavior, and explore underlying mechanisms. Using a US-wide voter-level panel, 2008–2018, we examine voters who relocate across state and county lines, tracking changes in registration, turnout, and party affiliation to estimate location and individual fixed effects in a value-added model. Location explains 37 percent of the cross-state variation in turnout (to 63 percent for individual characteristics) and an only slightly smaller share of variation in party affiliation. Place effects are larger for young and White voters. (JEL D12, D72, I20, J15, L82, R23)

10.1257/aer.20201660.abstractZh: 我们测量了情境因素与个体因素（例如，投票规则与媒体因素与种族和教育因素相比）对选民行为的总体影响，并探讨其背后的机制。通过利用2008至2018年美国范围内的选民数据，我们研究了在州和县之间迁移的选民，追踪他们的登记情况、投票率以及党派归属的变化，以在增值模型中估算地点和个体固定效应。地点因素解释了州间投票率差异的37%（剩余63%由个体特征解释），而党派归属差异的解释比例则略低。对于年轻和白人选民来说，地点效应更为显著。（JEL D12, D72, I20, J15, L82, R23）

abstract.text: Disadvantaged students perform differentially worse when randomly given a financially salient mathematics exam. For students with socioeconomic indicators below the national median, a 10 percentage point increase in the share of monetary themed questions depresses exam performance by 0.026 standard deviations, about 6 percent of their performance gap. Using question-level data, I confirm the role of financial salience by comparing performance on monetary and highly similar non-monetary questions. Leveraging the randomized ordering of questions, I identify an effect on subsequent questions, providing evidence that the attention capture effects of poverty affect policy relevant outcomes outside of experimental settings. (JEL G53, I21, I24, I32, J13, O15)

10.1257/aer.20201661.abstractZh: 贫困学生在随机接受一项财务相关的数学考试时，表现会明显下降。对于社会经济指标低于全国中位数的学生来说，货币相关问题的比例增加10个百分点，会导致考试成绩下降0.026个标准差，这大约相当于他们成绩差距的6%。通过问题层面的数据，我通过比较货币相关问题和高度相似的非货币问题的表现，证实了财务相关性的作用。利用问题的随机排序，我发现了对后续问题的影响，这提供了证据，表明贫困对注意力的捕获效应会影响实验设置之外的政策相关结果。（JEL G53, I21, I24, I32, J13, O15）

abstract.text: This paper combines a data-rich environment with a machine learning algorithm to provide new estimates of time-varying systematic expectational errors (“belief distortions”) embedded in survey responses. We find sizable distortions even for professional forecasters, with all respondent-types overweighting the implicit judgmental component of their forecasts relative to what can be learned from publicly available information. Forecasts of inflation and GDP growth oscillate between optimism and pessimism by large margins, with belief distortions evolving dynamically in response to cyclical shocks. The results suggest that artificial intelligence algorithms can be productively deployed to correct errors in human judgment and improve predictive accuracy. (JEL C45, D83, E23, E27, E31, E32, E37)

10.1257/aer.20201713.abstractZh: 本文结合数据丰富的环境与机器学习算法，提出了对调查回应中随时间变化的系统性预期误差（“信念扭曲”）的新估计。我们发现，即使是专业预测者，也会对预测的隐含判断成分产生较大的高估，而这一高估程度超过了从公开信息中获得的结论。通货膨胀和GDP增长的预测在乐观与悲观之间波动幅度较大，信念扭曲会随着周期性冲击而动态变化。研究结果表明，人工智能算法可以有效地用于纠正人类判断中的错误，并提高预测准确性。（JEL C45, D83, E23, E27, E31, E32, E37）

abstract.text: We study bargaining with divisibility and interdependent values. A buyer and a seller trade a divisible good. The seller is privately informed about its quality, which can be high or low. Gains from trade are positive and decreasing in quantity. The buyer makes offers over time. Divisibility introduces a new channel of competition between the buyer’s present and future selves. The buyer’s temptation to split the purchases of the high-quality good is detrimental to him. As bargaining frictions vanish and the good becomes arbitrarily divisible, the high-quality good is traded smoothly over time and the buyer’s payoff shrinks to zero. (JEL C78, D82, L15)

10.1257/aer.20201718.abstractZh: 我们研究了可分割性与相互依赖价值下的讨价还价行为。一位买家和一位卖家交易一种可分割的商品。卖家对其质量有私人信息了解，质量可以是高或低。交易带来的收益是正值，并且随着数量的增加而减少。买家会随时间不断提出报价。可分割性引入了一种新的竞争渠道，即买家现在的自我与未来的自我之间的竞争。买家试图分割高质量商品的购买行为对他来说是有害的。随着讨价还价的摩擦消失，商品变得可以任意分割，高质量商品会随时间平稳地交易，而买家的收益则逐渐降为零。（JEL C78, D82, L15）

abstract.text: How does market concentration affect the potency of monetary policy? To address this question we embed a dynamic oligopolistic game into a general-equilibrium macroeconomic model. We provide a sufficient-statistic formula for the response to monetary shocks involving demand elasticities, concentration and markups. We discipline our model with evidence on pass-through and find that higher concentration amplifies nonneutrality and stickiness. We isolate strategic effects from oligopoly by comparing our model to one with naive firms.
