We derive an exact Phillips curve featuring novel higher-order terms, but show that a standard New Keynesian one recalibrated with higher stickiness provides an excellent approximation. (JEL D43, E12, E21, E31, E43, E51, E52)

10.1257/aer.20201739.abstractZh: 市场集中度如何影响货币政策的效力？为了回答这个问题，我们将一个动态寡头博弈模型嵌入到一个一般均衡宏观经济模型中。我们提供了一个关于货币冲击响应的充分统计量公式，该公式考虑了需求弹性、市场集中度以及价格加成等因素。通过实证分析，我们发现较高的市场集中度会增强货币政策的非中性效应和粘性效应。通过将我们的模型与单纯寡头博弈模型进行比较，我们分离出战略效应。我们还推导出了一个精确的菲利普斯曲线，其中包含一些新的高阶项，但结果表明，一个经过重新校准的标准新凯恩斯主义菲利普斯曲线，在考虑到较高的粘性效应后，可以很好地近似这一曲线。（JEL D43, E12, E21, E31, E43, E51, E52）

abstract.text: This paper studies, theoretically and experimentally, the effects of overconfidence and fake news on information aggregation and the quality of democratic choice in a common-interest setting. We theoretically show that overconfidence exacerbates the adverse effects of widespread misinformation (i.e., fake news). We then analyze richer models that allow for partisanship, targeted misinformation intended to sway public opinion, and news signals correlated across voters (due to media ownership concentration or censorship). In our experiment, overconfidence severely undermines information aggregation, suggesting that the effect of overconfidence can be much more pronounced at the collective than at the individual level. (JEL C91, D12, D72, D82, D83, L82)

10.1257/aer.20201844.abstractZh: 本文从理论和实验的角度，研究了过度自信和虚假新闻对信息聚合以及民主决策质量的影响。理论上，我们表明过度自信会加剧广泛传播的错误信息（即虚假新闻）带来的负面影响。随后，我们分析了包含党派偏见、旨在影响公众舆论的定向错误信息，以及由于媒体所有权集中或审查制度导致选民间存在相关的新闻信号的更复杂模型。在我们的实验中，过度自信严重削弱了信息聚合的效果，这表明过度自信的影响在集体层面比在个体层面更为显著。（JEL C91, D12, D72, D82, D83, L82）

abstract.text: In randomized controlled trials, treatment is often assigned by stratified randomization. I show that among all stratified randomization schemes that treat all units with probability one half, a certain matched-pair design achieves the maximum statistical precision for estimating the average treatment effect. In an important special case, the optimal design pairs units according to the baseline outcome. In a simulation study based on datasets from ten randomized controlled trials, this design lowers the standard error for the estimator of the average treatment effect by 10 percent on average, and by up to 34 percent, relative to the original designs. (JEL C13, C21)

10.1257/aer.20201856.abstractZh: 在随机对照试验中，治疗通常通过分层随机化来分配。我证明了，在所有以一半概率处理所有单位的分层随机化方案中，某种配对设计能够实现估计平均治疗效果的最大统计精度。在一个重要的特殊情况下，最优设计是根据基线结果来配对单位。基于十个随机对照试验的数据集进行的模拟研究表明，这种设计平均可以将平均治疗效果估计值的标准误差降低10%，相对于原始设计，甚至可降低34%。（JEL C13, C21）

abstract.text: I evaluate randomly varied neighborhood exposure to information campaigns regarding either executive performance, or increases in executive power, prior to a Turkish referendum on weakening checks and balances on the executive. The campaigns increased voter polarization over the referendum, and subsequently changed party affiliation in national and local elections over the next two years, leading to partisan polarization. My results suggest that, when voters disagree on whether increasing executive power is a good policy, more information can increase voter polarization. Finally, I conclude that because potential polarization is often ignored, the impact of information campaigns on civil society is underestimated. (JEL D72, D83, O17)

10.1257/aer.20201892.abstractZh: 我评估了在土耳其关于削弱对行政权力的制衡措施的公投之前，关于行政人员表现或行政权力增加的宣传活动的随机变化对社区的影响。这些宣传活动加剧了公投期间的选民两极分化，并在接下来的两年里改变了国家和地方选举中的党派归属，导致党派之间的对立更加严重。我的研究结果表明，当选民在是否认为增强行政权力是良好政策的问题上存在分歧时，更多的信息可能会加剧选民的两极分化。最后，我得出结论，由于潜在的极化现象常常被忽视，宣传活动对公民社会的影响被低估了。（JEL D72, D83, O17）

abstract.text: We examine how strategic buyer behavior affects equilibrium outcomes in a model of dynamic price competition where sellers benefit from learning-by-doing by allowing each buyer to expect to capture a share of future buyer surplus. Many equilibria that exist when buyers consider only their immediate payoffs are eliminated when buyers expect to capture even a modest share of future surplus, and the equilibria that survive are those where long-run market competition is more likely to be preserved. Our results are relevant for antitrust policy and our approach may be useful for future analyses of dynamic competition. (JEL C73, D21, D43, D83, K21, L13, L40)

10.1257/aer.20202016.abstractZh: 我们研究了在动态价格竞争模型中，战略性买家行为如何影响均衡结果。在这种模型中，卖家通过让每个买家预期能够获取未来买家剩余收益的一部分而受益。当买家仅考虑自身即时收益时，存在许多均衡状态；但当买家预期能够获取未来剩余收益的一部分时，这些均衡状态被消除，而存活下来的均衡状态则是长期市场竞争更有可能得到维护的状态。我们的研究结果对于反垄断政策具有参考价值，我们的方法也可能有助于未来对动态竞争的分析。（JEL C73, D21, D43, D83, K21, L13, L40）

abstract.text: Factor market failures can limit adoption of profitable technologies. We leverage a plot-level spatial regression discontinuity design in the context of irrigation use by farmers provided free access to water. Using irrigation boosts profits by 43–62 percent. Yet, farmers only irrigate 30 percent of plots because of labor costs. We demonstrate inefficient irrigation use, by showing farmers irrigating one plot reduce their irrigation use on other plots. This inefficiency is largest for smaller households and wealthier households, suggesting labor market frictions constrain use of irrigation. (JEL D24, O13, Q12, Q15, Q16)

10.1257/aer.20210059.abstractZh: 要素市场失灵可能会限制盈利技术的采用。我们在农民使用灌溉水的背景下，采用了地块级别的空间回归不连续设计。研究表明，灌溉使利润增加了43%至62%。然而，由于劳动力成本的原因，农民只灌溉了30%的地块。我们发现，农民在灌溉一个地块后，会减少对其他地块的灌溉。这种低效现象在较小家庭和较富裕的家庭中更为明显，这表明劳动力市场的摩擦限制了灌溉的使用。（JEL D24, O13, Q12, Q15, Q16）

abstract.text: This paper studies competition between firms when consumers observe a private signal of their preferences over products. Within the class of signal structures that induce pure-strategy pricing equilibria, we derive signal structures that are optimal for firms and those that are optimal for consumers. The firm-optimal policy amplifies underlying product differentiation, thereby relaxing competition, while ensuring consumers purchase their preferred product, thereby maximizing total welfare. The consumer-optimal policy dampens differentiation, which intensifies competition, but induces some consumers to buy their less preferred product. Our analysis sheds light on the limits to competition when the information possessed by consumers can be designed flexibly. (JEL D11, D21, D43, D82, D83, L13)

10.1257/aer.20210083.abstractZh: 本文研究了当消费者能够观察到企业关于产品的私人偏好信号时，企业之间的竞争情况。在那些能够诱导纯策略定价均衡的信号结构类别中，我们推导出了对企业而言最优的信号结构，以及对消费者而言最优的信号结构。对企业而言最优的策略会增强产品的差异化，从而减轻竞争压力，同时确保消费者购买他们更青睐的产品，从而最大化整体福利。对消费者而言最优的策略则会减弱差异化，这会加剧竞争，但也会促使一些消费者购买他们不太青睐的产品。我们的分析揭示了当消费者所拥有的信息可以灵活设计时，竞争的局限性。（JEL D11, D21, D43, D82, D83, L13）

abstract.text: Smallholder farming in many developing countries is characterized by low productivity and low-quality output. Low quality limits the price farmers can command and their potential income. We conduct a series of experiments among maize farmers in Uganda to shed light on the barriers to quality upgrading and to study its potential. We find that the causal return to quality is zero. Providing access to a market where quality is paid a market premium led to an increase in farm productivity and income from farming. Our findings reveal the importance of demand-side constraints in limiting rural income and productivity growth. (JEL C93, L14, L15, L22, O13, Q12, Q13)

10.1257/aer.20210122.abstractZh: 许多发展中国家的小农户农业以低生产力和低质量的产品为特点。低质量限制了农民可以获得的价格和潜在收入。我们在乌干达对玉米农民进行了一系列实验，以揭示提高产品质量的障碍并研究其潜力。我们发现，提高产品质量的因果回报为零。提供一个能够让高质量产品获得市场溢价的市场，能够提升农业生产的效率和农民收入。我们的研究结果揭示了需求方面的限制因素在限制农村收入和生产力增长方面的重要性。（JEL C93, L14, L15, L22, O13, Q12, Q13）

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic model of political competition between two groups that differ in their subjective model of the data generating process for a common outcome. One group has a simpler model than the other group as they ignore some relevant policy variables. We show that policy cycles must arise and that simple world views—which can be interpreted as populist world views—imply extreme policy choices. Periods in which those with a more complex model govern increase the specification error of the simpler world view, leading the latter to overestimate the positive impact of a few extreme policy actions. (JEL D72, D83, K42)

10.1257/aer.20210154.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个动态模型，用于描述两个群体之间的政治竞争，这两个群体在数据生成过程的主观模型上存在差异，但最终目标相同。其中一个群体的模型比另一个群体更简单，因为他们忽略了一些相关的政策变量。我们表明，政策周期必然会出现，而简单的世界观——可以被解释为民粹主义世界观——会导致极端的政策选择。那些拥有更复杂模型的群体执政的时期，会增加简单世界观的指定误差，导致后者高估了少数极端政策行为的积极影响。（JEL D72, D83, K42）

abstract.text: We model the production of complex goods in a large supply network. Each firm sources several essential inputs through relationships with other firms. Individual supply relationships are at risk of idiosyncratic failure, which threatens to disrupt production. To protect against this, firms multisource inputs and strategically invest to make relationships stronger, trading off the cost of investment against the benefits of increased robustness. A supply network is called fragile if aggregate output is very sensitive to small aggregate shocks. We show that supply networks of intermediate productivity are fragile in equilibrium, even though this is always inefficient. The endogenous configuration of supply networks provides a new channel for the powerful amplification of shocks. (JEL D21, G31, L14)

10.1257/aer.20210220.abstractZh: 我们模拟了在大型供应网络中复杂商品的生产过程。每个企业通过与其他企业的合作来获取多种关键投入品。个体供应关系存在因特性差异而失效的风险，这可能会破坏生产秩序。为了防范这种情况，企业会多渠道获取投入品，并战略性地投资以加强合作关系，从而在投资成本与增强的稳健性之间做出权衡。如果总产出对微小的外部冲击非常敏感，那么这种供应网络就被认为是脆弱的。我们指出，尽管这种策略总是效率较低的，但具有中间生产能力的供应网络在均衡状态下确实会显得脆弱。供应网络的内生配置为冲击的放大提供了新的途径。（JEL D21, G31, L14）

abstract.text: Stable matchings in school choice needn’t be Pareto efficient and can leave thousands of students worse off than necessary. Call a matching μ priority-neutral if no matching can make any student whose priority is violated by μ better off without violating the priority of some student who is made worse off. Call a matching priority-efficient if it is priority-neutral and Pareto efficient. We show that there is a unique priority-efficient matching and that it dominates every priority-neutral matching and every stable matching. Moreover, truth-telling is a maxmin optimal strategy for every student in the mechanism that selects the priority-efficient matching. (JEL C78, I21, I28)

10.1257/aer.20210240.abstractZh: 学校选择中的稳定匹配不一定具有帕累托效率，可能会让数千名学生处于比必要更糟糕的境地。如果一个匹配无法使任何被μ违反优先级的 학생 变得更好，同时又不违反某个被更糟的 student 的优先级，则称该匹配为优先中性匹配。如果一个匹配既是优先中性又是帕累托有效的，则称其为优先高效匹配。我们证明了存在一个唯一的优先高效匹配，并且该匹配优于所有优先中性匹配和所有稳定匹配。此外，对于机制中的每个学生来说，说实话是一种最大最小最优策略，可以选出优先高效的匹配。（JEL C78, I21, I28）

abstract.text: We build a model in which the Fed and the market disagree about future aggregate demand. The market anticipates monetary policy “mistakes,” which affect current demand and induce the Fed to partially accommodate the market’s view. The Fed expects to implement its view gradually. Announcements that reveal an unexpected change in the Fed’s belief provide a microfoundation for monetary policy shocks. Tantrum shocks arise when the market misinterprets the Fed’s belief and overreacts to its announcement. Uncertainty about tantrums motivates further gradualism and communication. Finally, disagreements affect the market’s expected inflation and induce a policy trade-off similar to “ cost-push” shocks. (JEL D83, E12, E31, E43, E44, E52, E58)

10.1257/aer.20210271.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个模型，其中美联储和市场对未来的总需求存在分歧。市场预期货币政策会“出错”，这将影响当前的需求，并促使美联储部分采纳市场的观点。美联储预计会逐步实施其观点。美联储关于政策立场的意外变化公告为货币政策冲击提供了微观基础。当市场误解美联储的观点并对其公告反应过度时，就会出现“情绪冲击”。对情绪冲击的不确定性促使进一步的渐进式调整和沟通。最终，分歧会影响市场对通胀的预期，并引发类似于“成本推动”冲击的政策权衡。（JEL D83, E12, E31, E43, E44, E52, E58）

abstract.text: We examine methods for evaluating interventions designed to improve decision-making quality when people misunderstand the consequences of their choices. In an experiment involving financial education, conventional outcome metrics (financial literacy and directional behavioral responses) imply that two interventions are equally beneficial even though only one reduces the average severity of errors. We trace these failures to violations of the assumptions embedded in the conventional metrics. We propose a simple, intuitive, and broadly applicable outcome metric that properly differentiates between the interventions, and is robustly interpretable as a measure of welfare loss from misunderstanding consequences even when additional biases distort choices. (JEL D83, D91, G51, G53)

10.1257/aer.20210290.abstractZh: 我们研究了评估干预措施的方法，这些干预措施旨在改善人们在误解自身选择后果时的决策质量。在一项涉及金融教育的实验中，传统的成果指标（如金融素养和定向行为反应）表明，尽管只有一种干预措施能够降低错误的平均严重程度，但两种干预措施的效果相当。我们指出这些失败源于对传统指标假设的违反。我们提出了一种简单、直观且广泛适用的成果指标，该指标能够准确区分不同干预措施的效果，并且即使存在其他偏见影响决策，该指标仍能稳健地反映因误解后果而导致的福利损失。（JEL D83, D91, G51, G53）

abstract.text: This paper investigates the 2013 threefold increase in the French dividend tax rate. Using administrative data covering the universe of firms from 2008 to 2017 and a quasi-experimental setting, we find that firms swiftly cut dividend payments and used this tax-induced increase in liquidity to invest more. Heterogeneity analyses show that firms with high demand and returns on capital responded most while no group of firms cut their investment. Our results reject models in which higher dividend taxes increase the cost of capital and show that the tax-induced increase in liquidity relaxes credit constraints, which can reduce capital misallocation. (JEL D22, G31, G35, H25, H32)

10.1257/aer.20210369.abstractZh: 本文研究了2013年法国股息税率的三倍增长现象。通过利用2008至2017年间所有公司的行政数据，并采用准实验方法进行分析，我们发现公司迅速减少了股息支付，并利用这一因税收而增加的流动性进行更多投资。异质性分析表明，那些对资本需求和回报有较高要求的公司反应最为强烈，而没有任何一类公司减少了投资。我们的研究结果否定了高股息税会增加资本成本的模型，并表明税收带来的流动性增加可以缓解信贷约束，从而减少资本错配现象。（JEL D22, G31, G35, H25, H32）

abstract.text: We describe a methodology for making counterfactual predictions in settings where the information held by strategic agents and the distribution of payoff-relevant states of the world are unknown. The analyst observes behavior assumed to be rationalized by a Bayesian model, in which agents maximize expected utility, given partial and differential information about the state. A counterfactual prediction is desired about behavior in another strategic setting, under the hypothesis that the distribution of the state and agents’ information about the state are held fixed. When the data and the desired counterfactual prediction pertain to environments with finitely many states, players, and actions, the counterfactual prediction is described by finitely many linear inequalities, even though the latent parameter, the information structure, is infinite dimensional. (JEL D44, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20210496.abstractZh: 我们描述了一种在战略主体所持有的信息以及与收益相关的状态分布未知的情况下进行反事实预测的方法论。分析师观察被假设为由贝叶斯模型所解释的行为，其中主体在获得部分信息和关于状态的差异信息的情况下最大化期望效用。在假设状态和主体关于状态的信息分布保持不变的情况下，需要一种关于另一种战略环境下行为的反事实预测。当数据和所需的反事实预测适用于具有有限数量的状态、参与者和行动的环境时，尽管潜在参数和信息结构是无限维的，反事实预测仍然可以用有限数量的线性不等式来描述。（JEL D44, D82, D83）

abstract.text: In 2020 the Environmental Protection Agency narrowed the definition of “waters of the United States,” significantly limiting wetland protection under the Clean Water Act. Current policy debates center on the uncertainty around wetland benefits. We estimate the value of wet-lands for flood mitigation across the United States using detailed flood claims and land use data. We find the average hectare of wetland lost between 2001 and 2016 cost society $1,840 annually, and over $8,000 in developed areas. We document significant spatial heterogeneity in wetland benefits, with implications for flood insurance policy and the 50 percent of “isolated ” wetlands at risk of losing federal protection. (JEL K32, Q24, Q25, Q53, Q58)

10.1257/aer.20210497.abstractZh: 2020年，环境保护署对“美国水域”的定义进行了调整，这显著限制了《清洁水法》下对湿地的保护。当前的政策讨论集中在湿地效益的不确定性上。我们利用详细的洪水索赔数据和土地利用数据，估算了美国各地湿地在防洪方面的价值。研究发现，2001年至2016年间，每公顷湿地丧失导致社会每年损失1,840美元，在发达地区这一数字超过8,000美元。我们观察到湿地效益存在显著的空间差异，这对洪水保险政策以及那些面临失去联邦保护风险的50%的“孤立”湿地具有重要意义。（JEL K32, Q24, Q25, Q53, Q58）

abstract.text: A data broker sells market segmentations to a producer with private cost who sells a product to a unit mass of consumers. This paper characterizes the revenue-maximizing mechanisms for the data broker. Every optimal mechanism induces quasi-perfect price discrimination. All the consumers with values above a cost-dependent cutoff buy by paying their values while the rest of consumers do not buy. The characterization implies that market outcomes remain unchanged even if the data broker becomes more powerful—either by gaining the ability to sell access to consumers or by becoming a retailer who purchases the product and sells to the consumers exclusively. (JEL D42, D82, D83, L81, M31)

10.1257/aer.20210616.abstractZh: 一名数据经纪人向一个拥有私人成本的生产商出售市场细分信息，而该生产商再将产品销售给一定数量消费者。本文描述了数据经纪人实现收益最大化的机制。每个最优机制都导致了近乎完美的价格歧视。所有价值高于成本依赖阈值的消费者都会按其价值支付购买产品，而其余消费者则不会购买。这一描述表明，即使数据经纪人变得更强大——比如获得了向消费者出售访问权限的能力，或者成为了专门购买产品并直接销售给消费者的零售商——市场结果仍然不会发生变化。（JEL D42, D82, D83, L81, M31）

abstract.text: Two players bargain over a single indivisible good and a transfer, with one-sided incomplete information about preferences. Both players can offer arbitrary mechanisms to determine the allocation. We show that there is a unique perfect Bayesian equilibrium outcome. In the equilibrium, one of the players proposes a menu that is optimal for the uninformed player among all menus, such that each type of the informed player receives at least her payoff under complete information. The optimal menu can be implemented with at most three allocations. Under a natural assumption on the uninformed player’s beliefs, the optimal menu coincides with the Myerson’s neutral solution to the bargaining problem in this environment. (JEL C78, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20210626.abstractZh: 两位参与者就一件不可分割的商品进行谈判，同时涉及一项转移，且双方对偏好信息存在单方面不完整的了解。两位参与者都可以提出任意的机制来确定分配方案。我们证明了存在一个唯一的完美贝叶斯均衡结果。在均衡状态下，其中一位参与者提出的菜单对所有不知情的参与者来说都是最优的，这样每位知情参与者在完全信息下至少能获得其预期收益。最优菜单可以通过最多三种分配方案来实现。在关于不知情参与者信念的自然假设下，最优菜单与迈尔森在该环境下对谈判问题的中性解决方案是一致的。（JEL C78, D82, D83）

abstract.text: We quantify the magnitude of R&D spillovers created by grants to small firms from the US Department of Energy. Our empirical strategy leverages variation due to state-specific matching policies, and we develop a new approach to measuring both geographic and technological spillovers that does not rely on an observable paper trail. Our estimates suggest that for every patent produced by grant recipients, three more are produced by others who benefit from spillovers. Sixty percent of these spillovers occur within the United States, and many of them occur in technological areas substantially different from those targeted by the grants. (JEL H81, L25, O33, O34, Q40)

10.1257/aer.20210678.abstractZh: 我们量化了美国能源部对小型企业资助所产生的研发溢出效应的规模。我们的实证策略利用了因州级匹配政策而产生的差异，并提出了一种衡量地理和技术溢出效应的新方法，该方法不依赖于可观察到的文献记录。我们的估计表明，对于每一项由受资助者产生的专利，还有三项专利是由受益于溢出效应的其他企业产生的。其中60%的溢出效应发生在美国境内，而且许多溢出效应发生在与资助目标截然不同的技术领域中。（JEL H81, L25, O33, O34, Q40）

abstract.text: We study an energy efficient charcoal cookstove in an experiment with 1,000 households in Nairobi. We estimate a 39 percent reduction in charcoal spending, which matches engineering estimates, generating a 295 percent annual return. Despite fuel savings of $237 over the stove’s two-year lifespan—and $295 in emissions reductions—households are only willing to pay $12. Drawing attention to energy savings does not increase demand. However, a loan more than doubles willingness to pay: credit constraints prevent adoption of privately optimal technologies. Energy efficient technologies could drive sustainable development by slowing greenhouse emissions while saving households money. (JEL D12, D91, G51, O12, O13, O32, Q54)

10.1257/aer.20210766.abstractZh: 我们在一个涉及内罗毕1000户家庭的实验中，研究了一种节能的木炭炉灶。我们估计，使用这种炉灶后，木炭支出减少了39%，这一结果与工程学上的估计相符，同时每年可带来295%的经济效益。尽管在炉灶使用的两年期间，燃料成本节省了237美元，排放也减少了295美元，但每户家庭愿意支付的费用仅为12美元。仅仅强调能源节约并不能增加需求。然而，贷款使得支付意愿增加了一倍多：信贷限制阻碍了私人最优技术的采用。节能技术可以通过减缓温室气体排放来推动可持续发展，同时还能为家庭节省资金。（JEL D12, D91, G51, O12, O13, O32, Q54）

abstract.text: Can information and communication technologies help citizens monitor their elections? We analyze a large-scale field experiment designed to answer this question in Colombia. We leveraged Facebook advertisements sent to over 4 million potential voters to encourage citizen reporting of electoral irregularities. We also cross-randomized whether candidates were informed about the campaign in a subset of municipalities. Total reports, and evidence-backed ones, experienced a large increase. Across a wide array of measures, electoral irregularities decreased. Finally, the reporting campaign reduced the vote share of candidates dependent on irregularities. This light-touch intervention is more cost-effective than monitoring efforts traditionally used by policymakers. (JEL C93, D12, D72, D83, O17)

10.1257/aer.20210778.abstractZh: 信息和通信技术能否帮助公民监督选举？我们分析了在哥伦比亚进行的一项大规模实地实验，旨在回答这个问题。我们利用Facebook向超过400万潜在选民发送广告，鼓励公民报告选举中的违规行为。我们还随机分配了部分市镇，让候选人对竞选活动有所了解。报告数量，尤其是有证据支持的报告数量，大幅增加。从各种指标来看，选举中的违规行为有所减少。最后，这种报告活动降低了依赖违规行为来获取选票的候选人的得票率。这种轻触式干预措施比政策制定者传统使用的监督手段更具成本效益。（JEL C93, D12, D72, D83, O17）

abstract.text: We provide evidence that industries' supply curves are convex. To guide our empirical analysis, we develop a model in which capacity constraints at the firm level generate supply curves that are convex in logs at the industry level. The industry's capacity utilization rate is a sufficient statistic for the supply elasticity. Using data on capacity utilization and three different instruments, we estimate the supply curve and find robust evidence for an economically sizable degree of convexity. The nonlinearity we identify has several macroeconomic implications, including that responses to shocks are state dependent and that the Phillips curve is convex. (JEL D21, E22, E23, E32, E62, L60)

10.1257/aer.20210811.abstractZh: 我们提供了证据，证明各行业的供给曲线是凸形的。为了指导我们的实证分析，我们建立了一个模型，在该模型中，企业层面的产能限制导致行业层面的供给曲线在对数上呈凸形。行业的产能利用率是供给弹性的一个充分统计量。利用产能利用率数据以及三种不同的工具，我们估计了供给曲线，并发现了经济上有意义的凸性程度。我们识别出的非线性现象具有多种宏观经济意义，包括对冲击的响应取决于状态，以及菲利普斯曲线呈凸形。（JEL D21, E22, E23, E32, E62, L60）

abstract.text: Many have argued that digital technologies such as smartphones and social media are addictive. We develop an economic model of digital addiction and estimate it using a randomized experiment. Temporary incentives to reduce social media use have persistent effects, suggesting social media are habit forming. Allowing people to set limits on their future screen time substantially reduces use, suggesting self-control problems. Additional evidence suggests people are inattentive to habit formation and partially unaware of self-control problems. Looking at these facts through the lens of our model suggests that self-control problems cause 31 percent of social media use. (JEL D12, D61, D90, D91, I31, L86, O33)

10.1257/aer.20210867.abstractZh: 许多人认为，智能手机和社交媒体等数字技术具有成瘾性。我们建立了一个关于数字成瘾的经济模型，并通过随机实验对其进行了估算。暂时减少社交媒体使用的激励措施会产生持久的影响，这表明社交媒体具有习惯形成的作用。允许人们设定未来屏幕使用时间的限制可以显著减少使用频率，这表明存在自我控制问题。额外的证据表明，人们在习惯形成方面不够注意，并且部分不了解自我控制问题。从我们的模型角度来看，自我控制问题导致了31%的社交媒体使用行为。（JEL D12, D61, D90, D91, I31, L86, O33）

abstract.text: We relate two main representations of the cost of acquiring information: a cost that depends on the experiment performed, as in statistical decision theory, and a cost that depends on the distribution of posterior beliefs, as in applications of rational inattention. We show that in many cases of interest, posterior-based costs are inconsistent with a primitive model of costly experimentation. The inconsistency is at the core of known limits to the application of rational inattention in games and, more broadly, in equilibrium analyses where beliefs are endogenous; we show that an experiment-based approach helps to understand and overcome these difficulties. (JEL D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20210879.abstractZh: 我们将获取信息的成本分为两种主要表现形式：一种取决于所进行的实验，如统计决策理论中所描述的；另一种取决于后验信念的分布，如理性忽视应用中所描述的。我们指出，在许多实际情况下，基于后验的成本与 costly experimentation 的原始模型并不一致。这种不一致性是理性忽视在博弈中应用以及更广泛的均衡分析中的已知限制的核心问题；我们表明，基于实验的方法有助于理解和克服这些困难。（JEL D82, D83）

abstract.text: In a model with multiple Pareto-ranked equilibria, we show that the set of equilibria shrinks if we allow trade in assets that pay based on the realization of a sunspot acting as an equilibrium-selection device. When the probability of a low-output outcome is high, the desire to insure against it leads the poor to promise large transfers to the rich in the high-output state. The rich then lose the incentive to exert the effort needed to sustain the high output. Thus the opening of financial markets may destroy the high equilibrium. (JEL D51, D53, D82, E44, G12, G14, G21)

10.1257/aer.20210972.abstractZh: 在一个包含多个帕累托均衡的模型中，我们展示了如果允许基于太阳黑子现象的发生来进行资产交易，均衡集合将会缩小。当低产出结果发生的概率较高时，人们为了避免这种结果而倾向于向富人承诺大量转移。这样一来，富人就会失去维持高产出所需的努力。因此，金融市场的开放可能会破坏这些高均衡状态。（JEL D51, D53, D82, E44, G12, G14, G21）

abstract.text: In the single-IV model, researchers commonly rely on t-ratio-based inference, even though the literature has quantified its potentially severe large-sample distortions. Building on Stock and Yogo (2005), we introduce the tF critical value function, leading to a standard error adjustment that is a smooth function of the first-stage F-statistic. For one-quarter of specifications in 61 AER papers, corrected standard errors are at least 49 and 136 percent larger than conventional 2SLS standard errors at the 5 percent and 1 percent significance levels, respectively. tF confidence intervals have shorter expected length than those of Anderson and Rubin (1949), whenever both are bounded. (JEL C13, C26)

10.1257/aer.20211063.abstractZh: 在单IV模型中，研究人员通常依赖基于t比率的推断方法，尽管相关文献已经量化了其可能产生的严重大样本偏差。在Stock和Yogo（2005）的研究基础上，我们引入了tF临界值函数，从而实现了一种标准误差的调整方法，该调整方法是第一阶段F统计量的平滑函数。在61篇AER论文中，校正后的标准误差在5%和1%显著性水平下，分别比传统的2SLS标准误差大49%和136%。只要Anderson和Rubin（1949）的置信区间受到边界限制，tF置信区间的预期长度则比Anderson和Rubin的置信区间更短。（JEL C13, C26）

abstract.text: This paper identifies an upside of the separation of ownership and control, typically the source of inefficiencies in the theory of the firm. Because insiders obtain private information by exercising control, the separation of ownership and control leads to a separation of ownership and information. We show that this separation is necessary for efficient trade in the market for corporate control. The analysis reveals how strategic communication between inside and outside shareholders facilitates takeovers by eliciting external bidders’ private information. Our results call into question mandatory disclosure requirements during takeovers. (JEL D21, D82, G32, G34)

10.1257/aer.20211069.abstractZh: 本文指出了所有权与控制权的分离所带来的积极效应，这通常是企业理论中存在效率问题的根源。由于内部人士通过行使控制权获取私人信息，所有权与控制的分离导致了所有权与信息的分离。我们表明，这种分离对于企业控制市场的有效交易是必要的。分析显示，内部股东与外部股东之间的战略沟通有助于吸引外部竞购者，从而获取其私人信息。我们的研究结果对收购过程中的强制性披露要求提出了质疑。（JEL D21, D82, G32, G34）

abstract.text: Does variation in how religious festivals are celebrated have economic consequences? We study the economic impacts of the timing of Catholic patron saint day festivals in Mexico. For causal identification, we exploit cross-locality variation in festival dates and in the timing of agricultural seasons. We estimate the impact of “ agriculturally coinciding” festivals (those coinciding with peak planting or harvest months) on long-run economic development of localities. Agriculturally coinciding festivals lead to lower household income and worse development outcomes overall. These negative effects are likely due to lower agricultural productivity, which inhibits structural transformation out of agriculture. Agriculturally coinciding festivals may nonetheless persist because they also lead to higher religiosity and social capital. (JEL O12, O13, O18, 043, Q12, Z12, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20211094.abstractZh: 宗教节日的庆祝方式差异是否会产生经济影响？我们研究了墨西哥天主教圣徒节庆祝时间对经济的影响。为了进行因果识别，我们利用了节日日期以及农业季节时间上的跨地区差异。我们估算了“与农业季节同步”的节日（那些与种植或收获高峰期重合的节日）对当地长期经济发展的影响。与农业季节同步的节日会导致家庭收入降低，整体发展状况恶化。这些负面效应可能是由于农业生产力下降，从而阻碍了农业领域的结构转型。不过，这些与农业季节同步的节日仍可能持续存在，因为它们还能提升宗教虔诚度和社会资本。（JEL O12, O13, O18, 043, Q12, Z12, Z13）

abstract.text: We investigate the susceptibility of democracies to demagogues, studying tensions between representatives who guard voters’ long-run interests and demagogues who cater to voters’ short-run desires. Parties propose consumption and investment. Voters base choices on current-period consumption and valence shocks. Younger/poorer economies and economically disadvantaged voters are attracted to the demagogue’s disinvestment policies, forcing farsighted representatives to mimic them. This electoral competition can destroy democracy: if capital falls below a critical level, a death spiral ensues with capital stocks falling thereafter. We identify when economic development mitigates this risk and characterize how the death-spiral risk declines as capital grows large. (JEL D72, E21, E22, E32)

10.1257/aer.20211125.abstractZh: 我们研究了民主国家对煽动者的易感性，探讨了保护选民长期利益的代表与迎合选民短期欲望的煽动者之间的紧张关系。政党提出消费和投资政策。选民的选择基于当前时期的消费和价值冲击。年轻且贫困的经济体以及经济地位较低的选民更容易被煽动者的去投资政策所吸引，迫使有远见的代表效仿这些政策。这种选举竞争可能会破坏民主制度：当资本水平降至临界值以下时，就会引发资本存量下降的死亡螺旋。我们确定了经济发展如何减轻这种风险，并描述了随着资本规模扩大，死亡螺旋风险如何降低。（JEL D72, E21, E22, E32）

abstract.text: We study a dynamic stopping game between a principal and an agent. The principal gradually learns about the agent's private type from a noisy performance measure that can be manipulated by the agent via a costly and hidden action. We fully characterize the unique Markov equilibrium of this game. We find that terminations/market crashes are often preceded by a spike in manipulation intensity and (expected) performance. Moreover, due to endogenous signal manipulation, too much transparency can inhibit learning and harm the principal. As the players get arbitrarily patient, the principal elicits no useful information from the observed signal. (JEL C73, D82, D83, G24, M13)

10.1257/aer.20211158.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个由主体和代理人参与的动态停止博弈。主体通过代理人可以操纵的、成本高昂且隐蔽的行为，逐渐了解代理人的私人类型。我们完全描述了该博弈的独特马尔可夫均衡。我们发现，市场崩溃往往伴随着操纵强度的激增以及（预期）表现的下降。此外，由于信号操纵的内生性，过多的透明度可能会阻碍学习并损害主体的利益。随着玩家变得异常耐心，主体从观察到的信号中无法获得有用的信息。（JEL C73, D82, D83, G24, M13）

abstract.text: We provide quasi-experimental estimates of the impact of social media on mental health by leveraging a unique natural experiment: the staggered introduction of Facebook across US colleges. Our analysis couples data on student mental health around the years of Facebook’s expansion with a generalized difference-in-differences empirical strategy. We find that the rollout of Facebook at a college had a negative impact on student mental health. It also increased the likelihood with which students reported experiencing impairments to academic performance due to poor mental health. Additional evidence on mechanisms suggests the results are due to Facebook fostering unfavorable social comparisons. (JEL D91, I12, I23, L82)

10.1257/aer.20211218.abstractZh: 我们通过利用一个独特的自然实验来提供关于社交媒体对心理健康影响的准实验性估计：在美国各大学分阶段引入Facebook。我们的分析将Facebook推广期间学生的心理健康数据，与广义差异比较实证策略相结合。我们发现，在大学中引入Facebook会对学生的心理健康产生负面影响，并且还会增加学生因心理健康问题而学业表现受损的可能性。进一步的机制性证据表明，这一结果是由于Facebook促进了不利的社会比较所致。（JEL D91, I12, I23, L82）

abstract.text: We document that international migrants concentrate more in expensive cities—the more so, the lower the prices in their origin countries are—and consume less locally than comparable natives. We rationalize this empirical evidence by introducing a quantitative spatial equilibrium model, in which a part of immigrants’ income goes toward consumption in their origin countries. Using counter-factual simulations, we show that, due to this novel consumption channel, immigrants move economic activity toward expensive, high-productivity locations. This leads to a more efficient spatial allocation of labor and, as a result, increases the aggregate output and welfare of natives. (JEL F24, J15, J31, J61, R23)

10.1257/aer.20211241.abstractZh: 我们研究发现，国际移民更倾向于聚集在价格较高的城市——这些城市的物价水平越低，移民的集中程度越高——并且他们在当地的消费水平低于同地区的本地居民。我们通过引入一个定量空间均衡模型来解释这一现象，该模型认为部分移民的收入被用于其在原籍国的消费。通过反事实模拟，我们发现由于这种新的消费渠道，移民将经济活动转移到价格较高、生产效率较高的地区。这促进了劳动力的更高效空间分配，从而提高了本地居民的总产出和福利水平。（JEL F24, J15, J31, J61, R23）

abstract.text: We provide testable conditions under which the cost of acquiring information is given by the expected reduction of a measure of uncertainty (e.g., entropy). The assumption, under the name of posterior separability, is nearly universal in the literature of rational inattention; yet, a testable characterization has been lacking. In applications to experimental data, we indicate situations in which posterior separability is—and is not—a compelling assumption for the cost of information; we propose a generalization to address some of its shortcomings. We also show how to identify and estimate nonparametrically the cost of information from observable choice behavior. (JEL C91, D11, D12, D81, D91)

10.1257/aer.20211252.abstractZh: 我们提出了可检验的条件，在这些条件下，获取信息的成本可以通过不确定性度量（例如熵）的预期减少来表示。这一假设在理性忽视的文献中几乎具有普遍性；然而，关于这一假设的可检验性描述一直缺乏。在实验数据的应用中，我们指出了后验可分性在信息成本问题上的适用情况以及不适用情况；我们提出了一种概括性方法来解决其中的一些不足。我们还展示了如何通过观察性选择行为来非参数地识别和估计信息的成本。（JEL C91, D11, D12, D81, D91）

abstract.text: A regulator faces a stream of agents engaged in crimes with stochastic returns. The regulator designs an amnesty program, committing to a time path of punishments for criminals who report their crimes. In an optimal program, time variation in the returns from crime can generate time variation in the generosity of amnesty. I construct an optimal time path and show that it exhibits amnesty cycles. Amnesty becomes increasingly generous over time until it hits a bound, after which the cycle resets. Agents engaged in high return crime report at the end of each cycle, while agents engaged in low return crime report always. (JEL D82, D86, K42)

10.1257/aer.20211428.abstractZh: 一位监管者面临着一群从事具有随机回报的犯罪的代理人。监管者设计了一个赦免计划，承诺对举报犯罪的罪犯实施一系列惩罚。在一个最优计划中，犯罪带来的回报随时间变化，从而可以影响赦免的慷慨程度。我构建了一个最优的时间路径，并表明该路径会呈现出赦免的周期性变化。随着时间的推移，赦免的慷慨程度会逐渐增加，直到达到一个上限，之后周期会重新开始。从事高回报犯罪的代理人会在每个周期结束时报告，而从事低回报犯罪的代理人则始终在报告。（JEL D82, D86, K42）

abstract.text: Employment may be important to well-being for reasons beyond its role as an income source. This paper presents a causal estimate of the psychosocial value of employment in refugee camps in Bangladesh. We involve 745 individuals in a field experiment with three arms: a control arm, a weekly cash arm, and an employment arm of equal value. Employment raises psychosocial well-being substantially more than cash alone, and 66 percent of the employed are willing to forgo cash payments to continue working temporarily for free. Despite material poverty, those in our context both experience and recognize a nonmonetary, psychosocial value to employment. (JEL C93, D91, I31, J15, J22, O15)

10.1257/aer.20211616.abstractZh: 就业对幸福感的重要性可能不仅仅在于它作为收入来源的作用。本文对孟加拉国难民营中就业的心理社会价值进行了因果估计。我们在一个包含三个实验组的实地实验中招募了745名参与者：对照组、每周现金支付组以及价值相等的就业组。与仅依赖现金支付相比，就业显著提升了心理社会幸福感。有66%的就业者愿意放弃现金支付，以暂时免费继续工作。尽管面临物质贫困，但参与者们都意识到就业具有非金钱性的心理社会价值。（JEL C93, D91, I31, J15, J22, O15）

abstract.text: While privatization of state-owned enterprises (SOEs) remains a popular policy tool in many countries, the impacts on workers are unclear. This paper studies the case of Brazil, which implemented a large privatization program in the 1990s. Following privatization, incumbent workers in privatized SOEs suffer a wage decline of roughly 25 percent relative to a matched control group. Additionally, private sector firms that are connected to privatized SOEs by labor mobility also reduce wages. A summary calculation suggests that privatization decreased the formal sector wage by 3 percent, with about two-thirds of this effect due to the indirect impact on private sector workers. (JEL J31, J62, L32, L33, O14, O15)

10.1257/app.20190428.abstractZh: 虽然国有企业私有化在许多国家仍是一种受欢迎的政策工具，但其对工人的影响尚不明确。本文研究了巴西的案例，该国在1990年代实施了大规模的私有化计划。私有化后，私有化后的国有企业中现有的工人工资相比对照组下降了约25%。此外，与私有化后的国有企业存在劳动流动联系的私营部门企业也降低了工人的工资。综合计算表明，私有化使正规部门的工资下降了3%，其中约三分之二的下降效果是由于对私营部门工人的间接影响所致。（JEL J31, J62, L32, L33, O14, O15）

abstract.text: This paper estimates the impact of daily weather on worker productivity by using household survey data to study interviewers. Using data from over 9,000 Demographic and Health Surveys interviewers in 46 countries, I find that interviewers complete 13.6 percent fewer interviews per hour on the hottest and most humid days. Workers maintain the same total output by starting earlier in the day and spending more time on each interview at the expense of spending more hours in the field with the same total pay. In addition, interviewers become differentially less productive on tasks that are less easily monitored. (JEL C83, J22, J24, J81, O12, Q54)

10.1257/app.20200547.abstractZh: 本文通过家庭调查数据来研究采访员的工作效率，以评估日常天气对工人生产力的影响。基于46个国家超过9,000名人口与健康调查采访员的数据，我发现采访员在最热和最潮湿的日子里，每小时完成的采访次数减少了13.6%。工人通过提前开始工作并增加每次采访的时间，来保持相同的总产出，而同时他们需要在现场工作的时间保持不变，且薪酬不变。此外，采访员在那些难以监控的任务上的效率也会有所不同。（JEL C83, J22, J24, J81, O12, Q54）

abstract.text: We use practice variation across physicians to uncover the role of medical care in causing opioid dependence. Using health records of 2 million US veterans with emergency department visits, we find that quasi-random assignment to a top (versus bottom) decile prescribing provider significantly increases subsequent opioid use and misuse rates. Instrumental variable results show that opioid prescription receipt leads to a 20 percent increase in the probability of long-term prescription opioid use and sizable increases in the development of opioid use disorder and opioid overdose mortality. We find suggestive evidence of transition into illicit opioids due to prescription opioid exposure. (JEL I11, I12, I18)

10.1257/app.20210048.abstractZh: 我们通过分析医生之间的实践差异，来探究医疗护理在导致阿片类药物依赖中的作用。利用200万美国退伍军人的健康记录数据，我们发现将患者随机分配到处方阿片类药物水平较高的医生群体或较低群体，会显著增加后续阿片类药物的使用和滥用率。工具变量分析显示，获得阿片类药物处方记录会使长期使用处方阿片类药物的概率增加20%，同时也会增加阿片类药物使用障碍的发生率和阿片类药物过量死亡的风险。我们发现有证据表明，由于处方阿片类药物的影响，患者可能会转向使用非法阿片类药物。（JEL I11, I12, I18）

abstract.text: We study the life cycle of a firm that produces a good of unknown quality. The firm manages its quality by investing while consumers learn via public breakthroughs; if the firm fails to generate such breakthroughs, its revenue falls and it eventually exits. Optimal investment depends on the firm’s reputation (the market’s belief about its quality) and self-esteem (the firm’s own belief about its quality), and is single-peaked in the time since a breakthrough. We derive predictions about the distribution of revenue and propose a method to decompose the impact of policy changes into investment and selection effects. (JEL D11, D21, D25, D83, G31, L15)

10.1257/mic.20190376.abstractZh: 我们研究了一家生产质量未知的产品的公司的生命周期。该公司通过投资来管理其质量，而消费者则通过公开突破来获取信息；如果公司未能实现这样的突破，其收入就会下降，最终公司会退出市场。最优投资取决于公司的声誉（市场对其质量的看法）和自身声誉（公司对自己质量的看法），并且在突破发生后的时间内呈单峰分布。我们提出了关于收入分布的预测，并提出了一种方法，将政策变化的影响分解为投资效应和选择效应。（JEL D11, D21, D25, D83, G31, L15）

abstract.text: This paper estimates the impact of hospital crowding on medical treatment decisions and patient health outcomes. Exploiting pseudorandom variation in emergency admissions, I find that a one-standard-deviation admission shock increases the unplanned readmission rate by 4.1 percent. Nonparametric and heterogeneity analyses suggest that “quicker and sicker” discharges contribute to the additional readmissions. The crowding impacts are larger in hospital departments with fewer beds, sicker patients, and stronger incentives to admit nonemergency patients. (JEL H51, I11, I12, I18)

10.1257/pol.20180672.abstractZh: 本文估计了医院拥挤对医疗决策和患者健康结果的影响。通过利用急诊入院的伪随机变化，我发现一次标准差的入院冲击会使非计划再入院率增加4.1%。非参数分析和异质性分析表明，“更快且病情更严重的”出院情况会导致更多的再入院。在床位较少、患者病情更重以及有更强动机收治非急诊患者的医院科室中，拥挤的影响更为显著。（JEL H51, I11, I12, I18）

abstract.text: We study two mechanisms used by public health insurance programs for rationing health care: outsourcing to private managed care plans and quantity limits for prescription drugs. Leveraging a natural experiment in Texas’s Medicaid program, we find that the shift to managed care and the relaxation of a strict drug cap increased access to high-value drugs and outpatient services and reduced avoidable hospitalizations. Program costs increased significantly, indicating a trade-off between cost and quality. We provide suggestive evidence attributing the reduction in hospitalizations to the relaxation of the drug cap and much of the spending increase to the shift to managed care. (JEL G22, H75, I13, I18, I38)

10.1257/pol.20190628.abstractZh: 我们研究了公共健康保险计划用于分配医疗服务的两种机制：外包给私人管理式护理计划以及处方药的数量限制。通过利用德克萨斯州医疗补助计划中的自然实验，我们发现转向管理式护理以及放宽严格的药品价格上限，增加了对高价值药品和门诊服务的获取，并减少了可避免的住院情况。项目成本显著增加，表明在成本与质量之间存在权衡。我们有证据表明，住院率的降低主要归因于药品价格上限的放宽，而大部分支出增加则归因于转向管理式护理。（JEL G22, H75, I13, I18, I38）

abstract.text: Mandatory disclosure policies are implemented broadly despite sparse evidence that they improve market outcomes. We study the effects of requiring home sellers to provide buyers with certified audits of residential energy efficiency. Using similar nearby homes as a comparison group, we find that this requirement increases price premiums for energy efficiency and encourages energy-saving investments. We additionally present evidence highlighting the market failure—incomplete information by both buyers and sellers—that prevents widespread voluntary disclosure of energy efficiency in housing transactions. Our findings support that disclosure policies can improve market outcomes in settings with symmetrically incomplete information. (JEL D83, K32, L98, Q41, Q48, R31)

10.1257/pol.20200539.abstractZh: 尽管几乎没有证据表明强制性披露政策能改善市场结果，但这一政策仍被广泛实施。我们研究了要求房屋卖家向买家提供经认证的住宅能源效率审计的效果。以附近的类似房屋作为对照组，我们发现这一要求提高了能源效率的溢价，并促进了节能投资。我们还提供了证据，表明买卖双方的信息不完全是导致房屋交易中缺乏自愿披露能源效率的原因。我们的研究结果支持在信息不对称的情况下，披露政策能够改善市场结果。（JEL D83, K32, L98, Q41, Q48, R31）

abstract.text: Practice- and Policy-Oriented Abstract Understanding how IT investments help organizations to build and sustain reputation is of particular relevance for healthcare practitioners and policy makers because patients are often unable to assess the quality of care, relying instead on the reputation of health service providers in the media, such as newspapers. As information intermediaries, journalists detect, aggregate, and translate the weaker signals for quality, such as state-of-the-art IT, that a hospital emanates. Our analysis of 152 hospital organizations in England, complemented by interviews with healthcare journalists, shows that journalists write less negatively about hospitals when healthcare organizations’ IT equipment investments are high. This implies that investments in IT equipment can buffer hospitals from negative press, thereby helping them to gain and maintain a strong reputation in the media. Practitioners and policy makers may incorporate the reputational effect of IT when making investment decisions and further amplify such IT investment through press releases, corporate reports, and media interactions.

10.1287/isre.2021.1021.abstractZh: 以实践与政策为导向的摘要分析表明，了解信息技术投资如何帮助组织建立并维持声誉，对于医疗保健从业者和政策制定者来说尤为重要。因为患者往往无法评估医疗服务的质量，而是依赖于媒体上报道的医疗服务提供商的声誉。作为信息中介，记者能够发现、汇总并解读医院所发出的关于质量方面的微弱信号，比如最先进的信息技术。我们对英格兰152家医院组织的分析，结合与医疗记者的访谈，发现当医疗机构在信息技术设备上的投资较高时，记者对医院的负面报道就会减少。这意味着，对信息技术设备的投资可以缓冲医院的负面新闻影响，从而帮助它们在媒体上获得并保持良好的声誉。从业者和政策制定者在做出投资决策时，可以考虑信息技术带来的声誉效应，并通过新闻发布、企业报告以及媒体互动等方式进一步放大这种投资效果。

abstract.text: This paper develops a model that captures which contracts are signed and on what terms in a market with a network of firms.

10.1287/mksc.2021.1331.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个模型，用于描述在具有企业网络的市场中，哪些合同被签订以及签订的条件。

abstract.text: This paper studies the prevalence of potential anticompetitive effects of vertical mergers using a novel data set on U.S. and international buyer-seller relationships and across a large range of industries. We find that relationships are more likely to break when suppliers vertically integrate with one of the buyers’ competitors than when they vertically integrate with an unrelated firm. This relationship holds for both domestic and cross-border mergers and for domestic and international relationships. It also holds when instrumenting mergers using exogenous downward pressure on the supplier’s stock prices, suggesting that reverse causality is unlikely to explain the result. In contrast, the relationship vanishes when using rumored or announced but not completed integration events. Firms experience a substantial drop in sales when one of their suppliers integrates with one of their competitors. This sales drop is mitigated if the firm has alternative suppliers in place. These findings are consistent with anticompetitive effects of vertical mergers, such as vertical foreclosure, rising input costs for rivals, or self-foreclosure. This paper was accepted by Joshua Gans, business strategy. Funding: This work was supported by a Banque de France/Sciences Po Partnership. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4363 .

10.1287/mnsc.2022.4363.abstractZh: 本文研究了垂直合并可能产生的反竞争效应，使用了关于美国和国际买卖关系以及多个行业的数据集。我们发现，当供应商与买方中的竞争对手进行垂直整合时，关系更有可能破裂，而与非相关企业进行垂直整合时则不会如此。这一关系适用于国内和跨境合并，也适用于国内和国际关系。此外，当使用对供应商股票价格的外生向下压力来模拟合并时，这一关系仍然存在，这表明反向因果关系不太可能解释这一结果。相反，当使用传闻或已宣布但尚未完成的整合事件时，这一关系消失。当企业的某个供应商与竞争对手进行整合时，企业的销售额会大幅下降。如果企业有替代供应商，这种销售额下降的影响就会减轻。这些发现与垂直合并的反竞争效应一致，例如垂直封锁、竞争对手的投入成本上升或自我封锁。本文由Joshua Gans负责商业战略领域的研究。资金支持：本项工作得到了法国银行/巴黎高等师范学院的合作支持。补充材料：数据文件和在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4363获取。

abstract.text: We study healthcare operations of emergency departments (EDs) by examining the practice styles and skills of ED physicians. Our data include all residents of Montreal, Canada, with an initial ED visit in Montreal during a nine-month period. For each visit, our data record the initial treating hospital, ED physician, ED billed expenditures, and all interactions with the health system within the subsequent 90 days. Physicians in Montreal rotate across shifts between simple and difficult cases, implying a quasi-random assignment of patients to physicians within an ED. We consider three medical conditions that present frequently in the ED and for which mistreatment may have dramatic consequences—angina, appendicitis, and transient ischemic attacks—jointly examining diagnostic and disposition skills. To control for variation in diagnosis, our sample for each condition consists of patients with a broader set of symptoms and signs potentially indicative of the condition. Separately by condition, we regress healthcare usage and cost measures on indicators for physicians to estimate the skill and practice style of each physician. We then evaluate the variation across physicians in their practice style and skills and the correlations between different measures of skill and practice style. We find significant variation across physicians in their practice styles and skills. We also find that physicians with costly practice styles often have worse outcomes in terms of more ED revisits and more hospitalizations. Finally, the practice styles and skills of physicians correlate positively across the three conditions that we consider. This paper was accepted by Jayashankar Swaminathan, operations management. Funding: Gowrisankaran acknowledges funding from the Center for Management Innovations in Healthcare at the University of Arizona. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4544 .

10.1287/mnsc.2022.4544.abstractZh: 我们通过对急诊科医生的实践风格和技能进行研究，来探讨急诊科的医疗运作情况。我们的数据涵盖了加拿大蒙特利尔所有在九个月内首次就诊于急诊科的居民。对于每次就诊，我们的数据记录了最初治疗的医院、急诊科医生、急诊科医疗费用，以及随后90天内与医疗系统的所有互动。蒙特利尔的医生会在简单和复杂的病例之间轮班工作，这意味着患者会被随机分配给不同的医生。我们重点关注了急诊科中常见的三种疾病，这些疾病的误诊可能会带来严重的后果——心绞痛、阑尾炎和短暂性脑缺血发作——同时考察了诊断和处理技能。为了控制诊断差异的影响，每种疾病的样本都包含了具有更广泛症状的患者，这些症状可能表明患者患有相应的疾病。我们分别针对每种疾病，通过医生的指标来回归分析医疗使用情况和成本指标，以评估每位医生的技能和实践风格。然后，我们评估了不同医生在实践风格和技能上的差异，以及不同技能和实践风格指标之间的相关性。我们发现，不同医生在实践风格和技能上存在显著差异。我们还发现，具有较高成本实践风格的医生，其急诊再次就诊和住院的情况往往更糟糕。最后，我们考虑的三种疾病中，医生的实践风格和技能之间存在正相关关系。这篇论文已被Jayashankar Swaminathan的运营管理领域接受。资金支持：Gowrisankaran感谢亚利桑那大学医疗管理创新中心的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据可访问于https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4544。

abstract.text: We study the effects of grade nondisclosure (GND) policies implemented within master of business administration (MBA) programs at highly ranked business schools. GND precludes students from disclosing their grades and grade point averages (GPAs) to employers. In the labor market, we find that GND weakens the positive relation between GPA and employer desirability. During the MBA program, we find that GND reduces students’ academic effort for a given course by approximately 4.9% relative to comparable students not subject to the policy. Consistent with our model, in which abilities are potentially correlated and students can substitute effort toward other activities in order to signal GPA-focused abilities, students participate in more extracurricular activities and enroll in more difficult courses under GND. Finally, we show that students’ tenure with their first employers after graduation decreases under GND. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4816 .

10.1287/mnsc.2023.4816.abstractZh: 我们研究了在顶尖商学院的工商管理硕士（MBA）课程中实施的成绩保密政策的影响。该政策禁止学生向雇主透露他们的成绩和平均绩点。在劳动力市场上，我们发现成绩保密政策削弱了平均绩点与雇主吸引力之间的正相关关系。在MBA课程期间，我们发现与未受该政策约束的学生相比，成绩保密政策使学生在某一课程上的学术努力减少了约4.9%。与我们的模型一致，该模型认为能力可能存在相关性，学生可以通过在其他活动上投入更多努力来替代对平均绩点的追求，因此成绩保密政策下，学生会参与更多的课外活动，并选择难度更高的课程。最后，我们指出，在成绩保密政策下，学生毕业后与第一雇主的在职时间会缩短。本文已被Suraj Srinivasan的会计学论文接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据可访问于https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4816。

abstract.text: Problem definition: We consider the quality competition between two hospitals under the plan of one insurer. The insurer aims to maximize the overall achievable quality in the system by selecting either the fee-for-service (FFS) or the bundled payment (BP) scheme to compensate each hospital. The demand, the costs, and the probability of successfully treating patients depend on a hospital’s chosen quality. Under such a setting, we use game theoretic models to study the choice of insurer and the impact of payment schemes on the equilibrium qualities of hospitals. Our models seek answers to the following questions. Is BP (FFS) payment scheme always associated with high (low) equilibrium quality? What factors affect the equilibrium qualities of competing hospitals and the choice of the insurer and how? Academic/practical relevance: Competing hospitals under same or different payment models from an insurer is rather common for healthcare delivery in the United States. However, there is a lack of understanding about the impact of payment schemes on quality outcomes from both the hospital’s and the insurer’s perspective. To the best of our knowledge, ours is the first paper to incorporate competition and the insurer’s perspective to study the impact of different payment models on quality. Methodology: Game theory, equilibrium analysis. Results: We show that BP (FFS) is not always associated with high (low) equilibrium quality and that the equilibrium qualities of the two hospitals are strategic complements. We characterize when the insurer might assign the BP to both hospitals, the FFS to both hospitals, or the BP to one and the FFS to the other hospital. Managerial implications: Our findings provide prescriptive guidelines to an insurer choosing payment models. We also show that a specific quality outcome is achievable not by choosing any payment model but by a careful design of its parameters. Our numerical studies show that hospital readmission reduction initiatives are most effective when run in conjunction with cost reduction initiatives.

10.1287/msom.2021.1039.abstractZh: 问题定义：我们考虑在一家保险公司的计划下，两家医院之间的质量竞争。保险公司旨在通过选择按服务收费模式或捆绑支付模式来最大化系统整体的质量水平。患者的需求、成本和成功治疗的概率取决于医院所选择的质量模式。在这种环境下，我们使用博弈论模型来研究保险公司的选择以及支付模式对医院均衡质量的影响。我们的模型旨在回答以下问题：捆绑支付模式（按服务收费模式）是否总是与高（低）均衡质量相关？哪些因素会影响竞争医院之间的均衡质量以及保险公司的选择？学术/实践意义：在美国的医疗服务中，竞争医院在相同的或不同的支付模式下是相当常见的现象。然而，关于支付模式对医院和保险公司质量结果的影响，目前缺乏深入的研究。据我们所知，我们的论文是首次将竞争和保险公司的视角结合起来，研究不同支付模式对质量的影响。研究方法：博弈论、均衡分析。研究结果：我们发现，捆绑支付模式（按服务收费模式）并不总是与高（低）均衡质量相关，而且两家医院的均衡质量是战略互补的。我们分析了保险公司可能将捆绑支付模式分配给两家医院、将按服务收费模式分配给两家医院，或者将捆绑支付模式分配给一家医院、将按服务收费模式分配给另一家医院的情况。管理启示：我们的发现为选择支付模式的保险公司提供了指导性的建议。我们还表明，特定的质量改善目标并非通过选择任何支付模式来实现，而是通过精心设计相关参数才能达成。我们的数值研究显示，减少医院再入院率的举措在与成本削减措施结合实施时最为有效。

abstract.text: Problem definition: This paper analyzes a market design problem in Medicare Advantage (MA), the largest risk-adjusted capitation payment program in the U.S. healthcare market. Evidence exists that the current MA capitation payment program unintentionally incentivizes health plans to cherry pick profitable patient types, which is referred to as “risk selection”. However, the root causes of the risk selection are not comprehensively understood, which we study in this paper. Academic / Practical Relevance: The existing literature primarily attributes the observed risk selection in MA market to data limitations and low explanatory power (e.g. low R2) of the current risk adjustment design. As a result, the current understanding and expectation are that risk selection would gradually disappear over time with increased availability of big data. However, if informationally imperfect risk adjustment is not the only cause of risk selection, big data would provide false assurance to key stakeholders, which we investigate in this paper. Given that risk-adjusted capitation payment models have been increasingly adopted by payers in the U.S., our study would be of primary interest to payers, providers and policy makers in the healthcare market. Results: This paper shows that big data alone cannot cure risk selection in the MA capitation program. In particular, we show that even if the current MA risk adjustment design became informationally perfect (e.g. R2 = 1), health plans would still have incentives to conduct risk selection, as imperfect risk adjustment is not the only cause of risk selection in the MA market. More specifically, we show that incentives would continue to persist for risk selection in the age of big data through strategically subsidizing some subgroups of patients using capitation payments collected from other subgroups, which we call “risk selection induced by cross subsidization.” We further propose a simple mechanism to address this risk selection problem induced by cross subsidization in MA. Methodology: We construct a game-theoretical model to derive the MA capitation rates under informationally perfect risk adjustment, and show that these capitation rates cannot eliminate risk selection in MA. Managerial Implications: To eliminate risk selection, payers should modify their current capitation mechanisms to take into account the cross subsidization incentives, as proposed in this paper. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/msom.2022.1127 .

10.1287/msom.2022.1127.abstractZh:
问题定义：本文分析了美国医疗保健市场中最大的风险调整按件付费计划——Medicare Advantage（MA）中的市场设计问题。有证据表明，当前的MA按件付费计划无意中激励了健康计划选择盈利性较高的患者类型，这种现象被称为“风险选择”。然而，风险选择的根本原因尚未得到全面理解，本文对此进行了研究。

学术/实践意义：现有文献主要将MA市场中观察到的风险选择归因于数据限制和当前风险调整设计的解释力较低（例如R2值较低）。因此，目前认为随着大数据的日益丰富，风险选择会逐渐消失。然而，如果信息不完全的风险调整并非风险选择的唯一原因，那么大数据可能会给相关方带来错误的保证。鉴于美国各支付方越来越多地采用风险调整按件付费模式，本研究对医疗保健市场的支付方、医疗服务提供者和政策制定者具有重大参考价值。

研究结果：本文表明，仅靠大数据无法解决MA按件付费计划中的风险选择问题。具体而言，即使当前的MA风险调整设计变得信息完美（例如R2=1），健康计划仍会有动机进行风险选择，因为不完美的风险调整并非MA市场中风险选择的唯一原因。更具体地说，我们表明，在大数据时代，通过利用从其他子群体收集到的定额支付，对某些子群体进行战略性补贴，仍然会持续存在风险选择的动机，我们将其称为“由交叉补贴引发的风险选择”。我们进一步提出了一种简单的机制，以解决由交叉补贴引发的风险选择问题。方法论：我们构建了一个博弈论模型，以推导在信息完美风险调整下的MA定额支付率，并表明这些定额支付率无法消除MA中的风险选择。管理启示：为了消除风险选择，支付方应修改当前的定额支付机制，以考虑交叉补贴的动机，正如本文所提出的那样。补充材料：在线附录可访问https://doi.org/10.1287/msom.2022.1127。

abstract.text: Patient demand for emergency medical services has never been greater. In the United States, as fewer people access medical care through a primary care provider, more people access care through the hospital emergency department (ED). Unlike other types of queuing systems, however, the ED allows physicians discretion in whom they serve. That is, ED queues do not operate solely under a policy of “first-come, first-served, by severity.” Therefore, we wanted to know: “What leads physicians to select which patients, and how many patients, they will treat?” We explore how familiarity between peer physicians affects patient selection and the chosen multitasking level, a process more commonly known in the ED as “patient pick-up.” We find greater familiarity leads to an increase in patient pick-up rate, observed multitasking, and shorter patient wait time, with no identifiable negative impact to patient processing time or length of stay.

10.1287/opre.2022.2350.abstractZh: 对紧急医疗服务的需求从未如此强烈。在美国，随着越来越多的人通过初级医疗服务机构获得医疗照顾，更多的人则通过医院急诊部门获得服务。然而，与其他类型的排队系统不同，急诊部门允许医生自行决定为哪些患者提供治疗。也就是说，急诊部门的排队系统并不遵循“先来先服务、按病情严重程度排序”的原则。因此，我们想知道：“是什么促使医生选择要治疗哪些患者，以及要治疗多少患者？”我们探讨了同行医生之间的熟悉程度如何影响患者选择以及他们选择的多任务处理水平，这一过程在急诊部门通常被称为“患者接洽”。我们发现，更高的熟悉程度会导致患者接洽率的增加、观察到的多任务处理现象，以及患者等待时间的缩短，且不会对患者处理时间或住院时间产生明显的负面影响。

abstract.text: The role of insurance institutions in the economic network is no longer only that of a loss compensator, but also of a risk transfer intermediary and supervisor of payer. In this process, insurance institutions gradually established their status as credit centre. Numerous theoretical studies and practices show that with the development of society, insurance has increasingly become an important factor and even one of the driving forces for economic development. Insurance reflects its value and status in many ways, whether it is the basic social security function or the indispensable importance of ensuring the smooth operation of business. It is worth noting that in recent years, the reform of the medical system has aroused the attention to the phenomenon of "narrow network", which is just for further study of insurance institutions (companies, institutions) and economic individuals (natural persons, The interaction between institutions) provides an opportunity. This paper strives to summarize and reflect the frontiers and dynamics of insurance network research in recent years, and expects to lead to the focus and direction of future insurance research at one time, and expects to provide new ideas and new paths.

10.14738/assrj.93.12019.abstractZh: 保险机构在经济网络中的角色不再仅仅是损失补偿者，还承担着风险转移中介和支付方监督者的职能。在这个过程中，保险机构逐渐确立了其作为信用中心的地位。大量的理论研究和实践表明，随着社会的发展，保险已成为经济发展的重要因素，甚至成为推动经济发展的动力之一。保险在多个方面体现了其价值和地位，无论是基本的社会保障功能，还是确保商业顺利运作的不可或缺性。值得注意的是，近年来医疗体系改革引起了人们对“狭窄网络”现象的关注，这为进一步研究保险机构（公司、机构）与经济个体（自然人、经济主体）之间的互动提供了机会。本文旨在总结并反映近年来保险网络研究的前沿动态，期望为未来保险研究的重点和方向提供新的思路与路径。

abstract.text: This dissertation consists of three chapters that examine contracting problems in two-sided matching models. The first chapter studies use of syndication contracts in the venture capital matching market, and the resulting impact on portfolio company outcomes. A novel empirical model is developed to account for endogeneity issues due to matching between venture capitalists (VCs) and companies as well as the simultaneous causality bias coming from contract choice. The estimates show that unobserved company heterogeneity can lead to biased company outcome estimates, which can change over time due to changes in preferences over unobserved company characteristics. The second chapter, joint with Kaniska Dam and Konstantinos Serfes, explores the effect of incentives on choice of organizational structure, and the implications for the output distribution in two-sided matching model. A novel condition guaranteeing positive assortative matching (PAM) is derived for two-sided matching models with non-smooth bargaining frontiers. In the model, the choice between integrating and remaining separate results in a non-differentiable bargaining frontier and produces equilibria in which some matched pairs integrate, and others do not integrate. These equilibria produce drastically different output distributions and provide researchers with predictions that can be tested empirically. The final chapter considers a principal-agent model in which the agent can choose and exclusive contract with a single principal, or a non-exclusive contract with two principals at the cost of additional effort. The two-sided matching model shows that the endogenous outside option absent in a standard principal-agent model is necessary in order to generate certain equilibrium contract patterns. Finally, the model shows that changes in the costliness of additional effort by the agents has a non-monotonic impact of agent utility.

10.17918/00001200.abstractZh: 本论文包含三个章节，分别探讨了双边匹配模型中的契约问题。第一章研究了在风险投资匹配市场中采用联合契约的情况，以及这对投资组合公司结果的影响。为了应对由于风险投资家与公司之间的匹配所带来的内生性问题，以及契约选择带来的同时因果关系偏差，本文开发了一个新颖的实证模型。模型估计表明，未观察到的公司异质性可能导致公司结果估计出现偏差，这种偏差会随着时间的推移因对未观察到的公司特征偏好变化而变化。第二章与Kaniska Dam和Konstantinos Serfes合作，探讨了激励对组织结构选择的影响，以及这对双边匹配模型中的产出分布的影响。本文为具有非光滑谈判边界的双边匹配模型推导出一个保证正向选择性匹配的新条件。在模型中，整合与保持分离之间的选择导致了一个不可微的谈判边界，从而产生一些配对双方整合而其他配对双方不整合的均衡。这些均衡产生了截然不同的产出分布，并为研究人员提供了可以实证验证的预测。最后一章考虑了一个主体-代理人模型，其中代理人可以选择与单一主体签订排他性契约，或者以额外的努力为代价与两个主体签订非排他性契约。双边匹配模型表明，为了产生某些均衡契约模式，标准主体-代理人模型中缺失的内生外部选项是必要的。最后，该模型表明，代理人额外努力的成本变化对代理人效用的影响是非单调的。

abstract.text: The economic crisis that followed the financial crisis that began in the United States of America in 2008 quickly spread to the whole world, leaving structural problems in several countries unveiled, particularly in those that, due to successive deficits and high external indebtedness, were in a more fragile situation. In the Portuguese case, external assistance was needed, made available in exchange for structural reforms and the abrupt, and severe reduction in public expenditure. The applied austerity had repercussions throughout society, but the public sector felt the weight of the used measures concretely, with health services being no exception. The shock waves caused by public expenditure containment policies were particularly felt in the Azores, an ultra peripheral region marked by geographical discontinuity. These are significant asymmetries at various levels from island to island and across several sectors. The public sector is the primary employer. This paper focuses on understanding if the Portuguese Economic and Financial Assistance Program, implemented between 2011 and 2014, affected the employability and dynamics of the labour market of new graduate nurses in the Autonomous Region of the Azores. This quantitative study used descriptive, inferential, and correlation statistics to establish relations with a statistical value between the sample's employability dimensions and the Portuguese Economic and Financial Assistance Program. From the analysis carried out, the study revealed that the restrictions imposed due to the external assistance program led to an increase in precariousness among new graduate nurses and, among other conclusions, a strong contraction in the capacity of hiring nurses by the public health services. As a limitation to the study, there is the need to emphasise that data on unemployment reflected the reality when the questionnaire was applied (May 2019), and the fact that the study did not explore the reasons underlying the unemployment rate found among the participants (although residual).

10.19044/esj.2022.v18n5p49.abstractZh: 2008年始于美国的金融危机引发的经济危机迅速蔓延至全球，导致多个国家的结构性问题暴露无遗，尤其是那些因连续赤字和高额外债而处于更脆弱状态的地区。在葡萄牙，需要外部援助，这种援助以实施结构性改革和大幅削减公共支出为条件。紧缩政策对整个社会产生了影响，但公共部门切实感受到了这些措施带来的压力，医疗服务行业也不例外。由于公共支出控制政策造成的冲击在亚速尔群岛表现得尤为明显，该地区是一个地理上不连续的超边缘地区。这些不对称性在各个岛屿和多个行业中都存在。公共部门是主要的雇主。本文旨在探讨2011年至2014年间实施的葡萄牙经济和财政援助计划是否影响了亚速尔群岛自治地区新毕业护士的就业能力和劳动力市场动态。这项定量研究采用了描述性、推断性和相关性统计方法，以建立样本就业能力指标与葡萄牙经济和财政援助计划之间的统计关系。分析结果显示，由于外部援助计划而实施的限制措施导致新毕业护士的就业不稳定现象增加，并且公共医疗服务机构招聘护士的能力也显著下降。作为研究的局限性，需要强调的是，失业数据反映了2019年5月问卷调查时的实际情况。此外，该研究并未探讨参与者中失业率的背后原因（尽管存在残余影响）。

abstract.text: There is widespread and unexplained variation in the outcomes of similar patients across place and providers in all developed health systems. This paper provides new evidence on the role senior doctors play in determining patient outcomes. I exploit within-hospital quasi-random assignment of patients to senior doctors following a heart attack to estimate the effectiveness of individual doctors, and to estimate returns to experience for these doctors. 28% of doctors work in multiple hospitals over a 13 year period, enabling the separate identification of doctor effects from hospital effects or observable patient characteristics. I find that a standard deviation increase in doctor quality reduces mortality rates over the next year by 3.6 percentage points, or 25% of mean mortality. There are relatively modest returns to specific experience, with mortality reductions from a standard deviation increase in the physician's 3-year caseload equivalent to around 6% of a standard deviation in permanent doctor quality. Estimating the effectiveness of each physician when treating patients with specific diagnoses, I analyse potential mortality reductions from reallocating doctors across patients. I find that mortality could be reduced by 8% by reassigning doctors within-hospital to patients on the basis of their comparative ability to treat each patient type. These results suggest that substantial improvements in patient outcomes could be achieved by reallocating existing senior staff resources.

10.1920/wp.ifs.2022.3022.abstractZh: 在所有发达医疗系统中，相似患者在不同地区和治疗医生处的结果存在广泛且无法解释的差异。本文提供了关于资深医生在决定患者预后方面所起作用的新证据。我利用医院内部对心脏病发作患者进行随机分配至资深医生治疗的方法，来评估个别医生的效果，并估算这些医生经验带来的回报。在13年的时间里，有28%的医生在多个医院工作，这使得我们可以分别识别出医生效应与医院效应或可观察的患者特征之间的差异。我发现，医生质量的标准差增加会使死亡率在接下来的一年中降低3.6个百分点，即平均死亡率的25%。特定经验的回报相对有限，医生3年病例数的标准差增加所带来的死亡率降低幅度约为医生永久质量标准差的6%。在评估每位医生针对特定诊断患者治疗效果的同时，我还分析了重新分配医生到不同患者处可能带来的潜在死亡率降低效果。我发现，通过根据医生治疗不同类型患者的相对能力在院内重新分配医生，可以将死亡率降低8%。这些结果表明，通过重新分配现有的资深人员资源，可以显著改善患者的预后。

abstract.text: Variation in technology adoption is a key driver of differences in productivity. Previous studies sought to explain variations in technology adoption by heterogeneity in profitability, costs of adoption, or other factors. Less is known about how adoption is affected by bias in the perceived skill to implement the technology. We develop a Bayesian framework in which the use of the technology depends on perceived skill, while the outcomes from using it depend on actual skill. We study the determinants of adoption in the case of implantable cardiac defibrillators (ICDs) for which we document large differences across hospitals in the rate of adoption between 2002-2006, and a strong reversal from 2006-2013. We find that perception bias explains two-thirds of the cross-hospital variation in ICD use. A dynamic version of the model with learning about bias predicts accurately the subsequent decline in ICD use between 2006-2013. These results suggest an important role for misperception in explaining the wide variation in the adoption of new technologies.

10.1920/wp.ifs.2022.3322.abstractZh: 技术采纳的变化是生产力差异的关键驱动因素。以往的研究试图通过盈利能力的异质性、采纳成本或其他因素来解释技术采纳的变化。但对于采纳行为如何受到对技术实施能力的感知偏差的影响，目前了解较少。我们建立了一个贝叶斯框架，在该框架中，技术的使用取决于感知能力，而使用技术的结果则取决于实际能力。我们研究了植入式心脏除颤器（ICD）的采纳决定因素，在2002-2006年间，不同医院之间的采纳率存在巨大差异，而在2006-2013年间则出现了明显的逆转。我们发现，感知偏差解释了医院间ICD使用差异的三分之二。该模型的动态版本通过了解偏差来准确预测2006-2013年间ICD使用量的下降。这些结果表明，误解在解释新技术采纳的广泛差异中起着重要作用。

abstract.text: Objetivo: Identificar e caracterizar os estabelecimentos geridos por Organizações Sociais de Saúde (OSSs) no Brasil. Métodos: A identificação desses estabelecimentos foi realizada mediante quatro procedimentos de busca por meio de pesquisa primária nos sítios das secretarias de saúde dos estados e dos municípios e consulta nos sítios das OSS e na Pesquisa de Informações Básicas Municipais do Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE), em 2018. Foi realizada uma análise descritiva dos estabelecimentos geridos por OSS comparando com as Administrações Diretas (ADs) segundo indicadores hospitalares. Resultados: Os estabelecimentos geridos por OSSs estão concentrados principalmente no Sudeste e no Sul do país, e 69% desses estabelecimentos são geridos por 20 OSSs. As OSSs estão mais presentes em hospitais-dia, seguidos de prontos atendimentos e de hospitais. A caracterização dos hospitais mostrou que aqueles administrados por OSSs apresentam melhor desempenho; contudo as diferenças diminuem à medida que se aumenta o porte do serviço. Os hospitais de maior porte apresentaram melhor desempenho em relação aos demais e é onde está concentrada a maior proporção de OSSs entre os hospitais. Conclusão: Este é o primeiro trabalho que faz uma identificação das OSSs em nível nacional. Essa listagem das OSSs é um instrumento importante de planejamento, monitoramento e organização da estrutura de oferta de serviços no Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS). Os resultados encontrados demonstram a necessidade de organização de uma base de dados administrativa que permita um acompanhamento do desempenho dos estabelecimentos no tempo.

10.21115/jbes.v14.n1.(supl.1):15-30.abstractZh: 目标：识别并描述巴西由社会健康组织管理的医疗机构。方法：通过四种搜索程序来识别这些医疗机构，包括对各州和市卫生部门网站的初步调查，以及查阅巴西地理与统计研究所（IBGE）的市级基础信息调查数据。对由社会组织管理的医疗机构进行了描述性分析，并与直接管理的医疗机构进行了比较，依据医院指标进行评估。结果：由社会组织管理的医疗机构主要集中在全国的东南部和南部地区，其中69%的医疗机构由20个社会组织管理。社会组织管理的医疗机构在日间医院中最为常见，其次是急救中心和医院。对医院的分析表明，由社会组织管理的医院表现更好；不过，随着服务规模的扩大，这种差异逐渐减小。规模较大的医院在各项指标上表现更好，并且社会组织管理的医院比例也更高。结论：这是首次在全国范围内对社会组织管理医疗机构进行识别的工作。这种医疗机构的列表是规划、监控和组织统一卫生体系服务结构的重要工具。研究结果表明，有必要建立一个行政数据库，以便能够随时间跟踪医疗机构的表现。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of hospital monthly acute myocardial infarction volume on hospital quality for hospitals in New York State between 2005 and 2015. In this paper, hospital quality is measured by risk adjusted mortality rates (RAMRs) for patients with acute myocardial infarction. This gives us a large data set and risk adjustment is performed using machine learning. We use a novel instrument, the volume of all shock and of trauma patients admitted to the hospital in a month. We find a positive return to volume, as volume increases RAMRs decrease. Using a variety of specifications, we find increasing volume by ten patients per month reduces RAMR by one to two percentage points.

10.2139/ssrn.3961565.abstractZh: 我们估算了2005年至2015年间纽约州医院每月急性心肌梗塞病例数量对医院质量的影响。在本文中，医院质量通过急性心肌梗塞患者的风险调整死亡率来衡量。这为我们提供了大量数据，并且使用机器学习技术进行了风险调整。我们采用了一种新颖的指标，即一个月内所有休克患者和创伤患者入院的总数量。我们发现，随着入院数量的增加，风险调整死亡率会下降，这表明入院数量与医院质量之间存在正相关关系。通过多种模型分析，我们发现每月增加10例入院数量，可以使风险调整死亡率降低1到2个百分点。

abstract.text: Transparency about the quality of goods and services offered by firms improves consumers' decisions; however, it can also change how firms compete for consumers. We study a mandate requiring dialysis facilities to publicly disclose their quality. We find that the regulation led to fewer referrals to low-quality incumbents, and new facilities disproportionately entered low-quality markets. Using a structural model of patients' demand for dialysis, we show that the majority of entry stems from demand changes driven by transparency. This resulting competition improves patient care, reducing hospitalizations and mortality. Our study highlights how transparency can foster competition and improve healthcare quality.

10.2139/ssrn.3963418.abstractZh: 企业所提供的商品和服务的质量透明度能够改善消费者的决策；然而，它也可能改变企业之间的竞争方式。我们研究了一项要求透析机构公开披露其质量的规定。研究发现，这一规定导致客户更倾向于选择质量较差的现有机构，而新设立的机构则更多地进入质量较差的市场。通过构建患者透析需求的结构模型，我们发现大多数新机构的进入是由透明度带来的需求变化所驱动的。这种竞争机制提升了患者的护理水平，减少了住院率和死亡率。我们的研究强调了透明度如何促进竞争并提升医疗质量。

abstract.text: Standard labor market models assume that workers hold accurate beliefs about the external wage distribution, and hence their outside options with other employers. We test this assumption by comparing German workers’ beliefs about outside options with objective benchmarks. First, we find that workers wrongly anchor their beliefs about outside options on their current wage: workers that would experience a 10% wage change if switching to their outside option only expect a 1% change. Second, workers in low-paying firms underestimate wages elsewhere. Third, in response to information about the wages of similar workers, respondents correct their beliefs about their outside options and change their job search and wage negotiation intentions. Finally, we analyze the consequences of anchoring in a simple equilibrium model. In the model, anchored beliefs keep overly pessimistic workers stuck in low-wage jobs, which gives rise to monopsony power and labor market segmentation.

10.2139/ssrn.3998796.abstractZh: 标准劳动力市场模型假设工人对外部工资分布有准确的认知，因此他们对其他雇主的替代选择也有准确的了解。我们通过比较德国工人对替代选择的认知与客观基准，来检验这一假设。首先，我们发现工人将替代选择的认知错误地锚定在当前工资上：如果转换到替代选择，工资会变化10%，而工人实际上预期的变化仅为1%。其次，低薪企业的工人低估了其他地方的工资水平。第三，当得知类似工人的工资信息时，受访者会修正他们对替代选择的认知，并改变求职和工资谈判的意图。最后，我们在一个简单的均衡模型中分析了锚定认知的后果。在该模型中，锚定认知使得过于悲观的工人无法摆脱低薪工作，从而导致垄断力量出现以及劳动力市场分割。

abstract.text: Primary care physicians have a central role in medicine, yet little is known about their influence on healthcare utilization. Using a model that includes both patient fixed effects and physician fixed effects, I find that differences in primary care physician practice styles explain 1.5% of the variation in utilization within healthcare markets as measured by spending, and patients who involuntarily switch physicians incur $390-$610 in additional spending around these switches. With these results, I construct counterfactuals and find that policies that reallocate patients across primary care physicians may be counterproductive due to modest long-run savings and substantial short-run switching costs.

10.2139/ssrn.4030445.abstractZh: 初级保健医生在医学领域发挥着核心作用，然而关于他们对医疗利用的影响，我们知之甚少。通过采用包含患者固定效应和医生固定效应的模型，我发现初级保健医生的工作风格差异可以解释医疗市场中医疗利用变化的1.5%。此外，患者非自愿更换医生时，会导致额外的支出，大约为390至610美元。基于这些结果，我构建了反事实情景，发现将患者重新分配到不同初级保健医生处可能适得其反，因为长期来看节省的经费有限，而短期内患者的更换成本却很高。

abstract.text: The impact of elite education is widely debated, with mixed empirical evidence. Utilizing the discontinuity in enrollment probability around the enrollment thresholds in the high school entrance exam in China, this study estimates the heterogeneous effect of elite high schools on college entrance exam performance across students with different levels of academic preparedness. The results show that only academically well-prepared students benefit from attending elite high schools, while less-prepared students may perform worse than their counterparts in regular schools. Peer effects partially explain the heterogeneous effect. These findings suggest that allocating more elite high school seats to well-prepared students could enhance the overall academic returns to elite education.

10.2139/ssrn.4038574.abstractZh: 精英教育的影响存在广泛争议，相关的实证证据也并不一致。本研究利用中国高中入学考试报名门槛附近报名概率的不连续性，估算了精英高中对不同学术准备程度的学生在高考成绩上的异质影响。研究结果表明，只有学术准备充分的学生才能从就读精英高中中受益，而学术准备不足的学生可能会比普通学校的学生表现更差。同伴效应在一定程度上解释了这种异质影响。这些发现表明，为学术准备充分的学生提供更多精英高中入学机会，可能会提升精英教育的整体学术回报。

abstract.text: In government-sponsored health insurance, subsidy design affects market outcomes. First, holding premiums fixed, subsidies determine insurance uptake and average cost. Insurers then respond to these changes, adjusting premiums. Combining data from the first four years of the California ACA marketplace with a model of insurance demand, cost, and insurers’ competition, I quantify the impact of alternative subsidy designs on premiums, enrollment, costs, public spending, and consumer surplus. Younger individuals are more price sensitive and cheaper to cover. Increasing subsidies to this group would make all buyers better off, increase market participation, and lower average costs and average subsidies.

10.2139/ssrn.4068039.abstractZh: 在政府资助的医疗保险中，补贴设计会影响市场结果。首先，在保费固定的情况下，补贴决定了保险覆盖率和平均成本。随后，保险公司会根据这些变化调整保费。通过结合加州ACA市场前四年的数据以及保险需求、成本和保险公司竞争模型，我量化了不同补贴设计对保费、参保率、成本、公共支出和消费者剩余的影响。年轻人群对价格更为敏感，因此补贴对他们来说成本更低。增加对这一群体的补贴将使所有消费者受益，提高市场参与度，并降低平均成本和平均补贴水平。

abstract.text: How can insurance design mitigate risk as opposed to just claims? We use novel sensor data to track drivers’ handheld phone use behavior (“HPU”), a generalization of text-and-drive in the smartphone age, and demonstrate how a behavior-based insurance contract can prevent accidents. Based on a prior experiment conducted, we develop a structural model to distinguish inattention, risk aversion, and the price elasticity of HPU. This facilitates counterfactual simulations of the “first-best” auto insurance contract with full insurance and a direct price on HPU (Holmstrom 1979). The contract features a 40-cent average charge per mile of HPU. A 62-cent charge can resolve additional externalities on traffic congestion and injuries.

10.2139/ssrn.4102446.abstractZh: 保险设计如何能够减轻风险，而不仅仅是处理索赔？我们利用新型传感器数据来追踪驾驶员的手机使用行为（“HPU”），这是智能手机时代“文本与驾驶”概念的延伸。我们展示了基于行为的保险合同如何能够预防事故。基于之前进行的实验，我们建立了一个结构模型，以区分注意力分散、风险规避以及HPU的价格弹性。这有助于对“最优”汽车保险合同的反事实模拟，其中包括全额保险以及直接对HPU收取费用（Holmstrom 1979）。该保险合同的特点是，每英里HPU的平均收费为40美分。如果收取62美分的费用，就可以解决交通拥堵和伤害等额外问题。

abstract.text: We investigate the relationship among staff engagement, job complementarities and labour supply in the hospital sector, where excessive turnover of the clinical staff (doctors and nurses) can be detrimental for quality of care. We exploit a unique and rich panel dataset constructed by combining employee-level payroll and survey records from the universe of English NHS hospitals. System-GMM estimates remove the endogeneity bias due to reverse causality, revealing nurses' elasticities of retention with respect to engagement of 0.1 and 0.85, and doctors' elasticities of retention with respect to nurses' retention of 0.16 and 0.2, respectively within the hospital and the NHS. Estimates of unconditional quantile regressions confirm these findings, with nurses' engagement-elasticities as large as 1.4 for providers with low retention. Higher engagement is also beneficial to reduce staff absences. Our work is informative on the role played by staff engagement and labour supply complementarities in the workforce planning and management of large organizations.

10.2139/ssrn.4114685.abstractZh: 我们研究了医院部门中员工参与度、工作互补性以及劳动力供应之间的关系。临床人员（医生和护士）的过度流动可能会对护理质量产生负面影响。我们利用了一个独特的、包含丰富数据的面板数据集，该数据集结合了英格兰国家医疗服务体系医院员工的工资记录和调查数据。系统广义矩估计消除了由于反向因果关系导致的内生性偏差，结果显示护士的保留弹性与员工参与度呈正相关，分别为0.1和0.85；而医生则对护士的保留弹性呈正相关，分别为0.16和0.2，这种关系既存在于医院内部，也存在于整个国家医疗服务体系内。无条件分位数回归的估计结果进一步证实了这些发现，对于保留率较低的医护人员来说，员工参与度的弹性高达1.4。较高的员工参与度还有助于减少员工缺勤情况。我们的研究揭示了员工参与度和劳动力供应互补性在大型组织的人力资源管理中的重要作用。

abstract.text: Further Education colleges are a key way in which 16-19 year olds acquire skills in the UK (much like US Community Colleges), especially those from low income backgrounds. Yet, little is known about what could improve performance in these institutions. We design and conduct the world's first management practices survey in these colleges (based on the World Management Survey) and match this to administrative longitudinal data on over 40,000 students. Value added regressions with rich controls suggest that structured management matters for educational outcomes (e.g. upper secondary qualifications), especially for students from low-income backgrounds. In a hypothetical scenario where a learner is moved from a college at the 10th percentile of management practices to the 90th, this would be associated with 8% higher probability of achieving a good high school qualification, which is nearly half of the educational gap between those from poor and non-poor backgrounds. Hence, improving management practices may be an important channel for reducing inequalities.

10.2139/ssrn.4114788.abstractZh: 继续教育学院是16-19岁青少年在英国获取技能的重要途径（类似于美国的社区学院），尤其是来自低收入背景的青少年。然而，关于如何提升这些机构的教学效果，我们知之甚少。我们设计并开展了世界上首次针对这些学院的管理实践调查（基于《世界管理调查》），并将调查结果与超过40,000名学生的行政纵向数据进行了对比。经过包含丰富控制变量的回归分析后，我们发现结构化的管理对教育成果有积极影响，尤其是对来自低收入背景的学生而言。在一个假设情景中，如果一名学生从管理实践水平处于第10百分位的学院转到第90百分位的学院，其获得良好高中毕业资格的概率将提高8%，这一比例几乎相当于贫困与非贫困背景学生之间教育差距的一半。因此，改善管理实践可能是减少不平等的重要途径。

abstract.text: This paper investigates challenges of aging for long-term care. Our analysis proceeds in three steps. In the first step, we estimate the prospective care demand for 30 developed countries based on projected aging and disabilities among the elderly. In the second step, we outline challenges for care systems with respect to shortages of care workers, increasing skill requirements for care workers, barriers to universal and equitable access to care, and cost containment subject to adequate care quality. In the third step, we identify solutions for these challenges by comparing the care systems of Germany, Israel, Japan, the Netherlands, and South Korea.

10.2139/ssrn.4114804.abstractZh: 本文探讨了长期护理领域面临的老龄化挑战。我们的分析分为三个步骤进行。第一步，我们基于老年人老龄化和残疾问题的预测，估算了30个发达国家的未来护理需求。第二步，我们概述了护理体系面临的挑战，包括护理人员的短缺、护理人员技能要求的提高、获得护理服务的障碍以及如何在保证足够护理质量的前提下控制成本。第三步，我们通过比较德国、以色列、日本、荷兰和韩国的护理体系，为这些挑战提出了解决方案。
