Our results represent, to the best of our knowledge, the largest set of online public health interventions analyzed to date.

10.3386/w30273.abstractZh: 公共卫生机构越来越多地利用社交媒体广告活动来实现公共卫生目标。在本文中，我们评估了约4000万美元的社交媒体广告效果，这些广告在Facebook和Instagram上开展并进行了实验性测试，旨在提高疫苗推广第一年的疫苗接种率。我们样本中的819项随机实验由174个不同的公共卫生机构实施，以15种语言向21亿人传播信息。我们发现，这些广告活动平均能够影响用户的自我认知——在基线状态下，意见的变化接近1%，每影响一人所需的成本约为3.41美元。结合从观察数据中得出的调查结果与疫苗接种率之间的关系估计，每额外增加一剂疫苗的成本约为5.68美元。此外，还有证据表明，这些广告活动在影响用户获取疫苗的知识方面尤为有效。据我们所知，这些结果代表了迄今为止分析的最大规模的在线公共卫生干预措施。

abstract.text: There has been a revival of warfare and threats of interstate war in recent years as the number of countries engaged in armed conflict surged dramatically, reaching levels unprecedented since the end of the Cold War. This is happening at a time when the global burden of mental health illness is also on the rise. We examine the causal impact of early life exposure to warfare on long–term mental health, using novel data on the amount of bombs dropped in German cities by Allied Air Forces during World War II (WWII) and the German Socio-economic Panel. Our identification strategy leverages a generalized difference-in-differences design, exploiting the plausibly exogenous variation in the bombing intensity experienced by the former West German cities during the war as a quasi-experiment. We find that cohorts younger than age five at the onset of WWII or those born during the war are in significantly worse mental health later in life when they are between the ages of the late 50s and 70s. Specifically, an increase of one standard deviation in the bombing intensity experienced during WWII is associated with about a 10 percent decline in an individual’s long–term standardized mental health score. This effect is equivalent to a 16.2 percent increase in the likelihood of being diagnosed with clinical depression. Our investigation suggests that mechanisms such as the destruction of healthcare infrastructure, the increased burden on the healthcare system, and wealth losses during WWII exacerbate the adverse impact of bombing exposure on long–term mental health. Conversely, war relief funds transferred to municipalities following the war have a mitigating impact. Our findings are robust to numerous empirical checks and specifications. With the mental health impact of childhood exposure to warfare persisting well into the late stages of life, the global burden of mental illness may be aggravated for many years to come. Our findings imply that prioritizing children and a long–term horizon in public health planning and response may be critical to mitigating the adverse mental health consequences of exposure to armed conflict.

10.3386/w30284.abstractZh: 近年来，由于参与武装冲突的国家数量急剧增加，战争和威胁邻国战争的事件再次兴起，这一数量达到了冷战结束以来的前所未有的水平。与此同时，全球心理健康问题的负担也在上升。我们利用二战期间盟军空军在德国城市投下的炸弹数量的新数据，以及德国社会经济面板数据，来研究早期生活经历战争对长期心理健康的影响。我们的研究采用了一种广义的差异-差异设计，利用战争期间前西德城市所经历的轰炸强度的变化作为准实验数据。研究发现，二战开始时年龄小于五岁的群体，或在战争期间出生的个体，在50多岁到70多岁的年龄阶段，其心理健康状况明显较差。具体来说，二战期间轰炸强度增加一个标准差，会导致个体长期标准化心理健康评分下降约10%。这一效应相当于临床抑郁症诊断概率增加16.2%。我们的研究表明，战争摧毁医疗基础设施、加重医疗系统负担以及战争期间的财富损失等因素，加剧了轰炸经历对长期心理健康的不利影响。相反，战后分配给各城市的战争救济资金则起到了缓解作用。我们的研究结果经多次实证检验和参数调整后得到验证。由于儿童时期经历战争对心理健康的影响会持续至生命的后期阶段，全球精神疾病负担在未来许多年可能会进一步加重。我们的研究结果表明，在公共卫生规划和应对措施中优先考虑儿童问题以及长期的发展前景，对于减轻武装冲突对心理健康造成的负面影响至关重要。

abstract.text: Of the 45.7 million current smokers in the U.S. age 12 and over, more than 18.5 million usually smoke menthol cigarettes. The Food and Drug Administration recently proposed a tobacco product standard that would prohibit menthol as a characterizing flavor in cigarettes. The FDA concludes that the prohibition of menthol in cigarettes is appropriate for public health, meeting the criterion established by the 2009 Tobacco Control Act. In this paper we explore whether there are internality-based market failures that provide an applied welfare economics rationale to prohibit menthol. Our empirical approach provides descriptive evidence from the 2018-2019 Tobacco Use Supplement to the Current Population Survey on how menthol use is associated with smokers’ market demand along multiple intensive and extensive margins. We also use direct measures of smoking-related misinformation and internalities, and stated preference data, from a 2021 Cornell Online Survey. We acknowledge that the associations we document in observational data might reflect bias due to self-selection into menthol use. We discuss several lines of evidence about whether self-selection into menthol use might be mainly quasi-random. We leave it to reader whether there is convincing evidence that differential levels of internality-based market failures are a sufficient justification for the proposed prohibition of menthol cigarettes.

10.3386/w30286.abstractZh: 在美国，12岁及以上的现役吸烟者达4570万，其中超过1850万人通常吸食薄荷烟。美国食品药品监督管理局最近提出了一项烟草产品标准，禁止在香烟中使用薄荷作为特色口味。FDA认为，禁止在香烟中使用薄荷符合公共卫生要求，符合2009年《烟草控制法案》设定的标准。本文探讨了是否存在基于内部性的市场失灵，为禁止薄荷烟提供了应用福利经济学的理由。我们的实证方法基于2018-2019年《当前人口调查》中关于薄荷烟使用与吸烟者市场需求关系的描述性数据，从多个密集型和扩展型边际角度进行分析。我们还使用了2021年康奈尔在线调查中的直接测量数据，包括与吸烟相关的错误信息以及内部性数据。我们承认，在观察性数据中发现的关联可能反映了因自我选择而进入薄荷烟使用群体的偏差。我们讨论了关于自我选择是否主要是准随机性的几条证据。至于是否存在令人信服的证据表明，不同水平的基于内部性的市场失灵是禁止薄荷烟的充分理由，这留给读者去判断。

abstract.text: We examine the short- and long-term effects of expanded Medicaid pregnancy coverage to undocumented immigrants using a novel dataset linking California birth records to Census surveys and administrative records. We implement a mothers’ fixed effects design that compares changes in sibling outcomes across mothers with different likelihood of having undocumented status. We find the policy increased insurance and prenatal care among likely undocumented immigrant women and improved pregnancy outcomes. Later in life, our results suggest that their children may be more likely to enroll in post-secondary education and receive less public support.

10.3386/w30299.abstractZh: 我们研究了扩大医疗补助妊娠覆盖范围对无证移民的短期和长期影响，使用了一种将加州出生记录与人口普查数据和行政记录联系起来的新型数据集。我们采用了母亲固定效应设计，比较了不同可能性持有无证身份的母亲在兄弟姐妹结果方面的变化。我们发现，该政策增加了可能持有无证身份的移民妇女的保险和产前护理，并改善了妊娠结果。从后期来看，我们的研究结果表明，这些妇女的孩子可能更有可能接受高等教育，并且获得的公共支持较少。

abstract.text: Since the spring of 2021, nearly 700 colleges and universities in the U.S. have mandated that their students become vaccinated against the COVID-19 virus. We leverage rich data on colleges’ vaccination policies and semester start dates, along with a variety of county-level public health outcomes, to provide the first estimates of the effects of these mandates on the communities surrounding four-year, residential colleges. In event study specifications, we find that, over the first 13 weeks of the fall 2021 semester, college vaccine mandates reduced new COVID-19 cases by 339 per 100,000 county residents and new deaths by 5.4 per 100,000 residents, with an estimated value of lives saved between $9.7 million and $27.4 million per 100,000 residents. These figures suggest that the mandates reduced total US COVID-19 deaths in autumn 2021 by approximately 5%.

10.3386/w30303.abstractZh: 自2021年春季以来，美国近700所大学要求学生接种新冠疫苗。我们利用关于大学疫苗接种政策和学期开始日期的丰富数据，以及各县级公共卫生数据，首次估算了这些强制要求对四所住宿大学周边社区的影响。通过事件研究分析，我们发现，在2021年秋季学期的前13周内，大学疫苗强制要求使每10万名县居民的新冠病例数减少了339例，新死亡人数减少了5.4例。估计每10万名县居民因此挽救的生命数在970万到2740万美元之间。这些数字表明，这些强制要求在2021年秋季使美国的总新冠死亡人数减少了约5%。

abstract.text: We develop and estimate a life-cycle model in a rational addiction framework where youth choose to smoke, attend school, work part-time, and consume while facing borrowing constraints. The model features multiple channels for studying the reciprocal causal effects of addiction and education. Variations in endowments and cigarette prices are sources of identification. We show that education causally reduces smoking. A counterfactual experiment finds that in absence of cigarettes, college attendance rises by three percentage points in the population. A practical alternative of 40% additional excise tax achieves similar results. Impacts vary substantially across persons of different cognitive and non-cognitive abilities.

10.3386/w30304.abstractZh: 我们在一个理性成瘾框架下开发并估计了一个生命周期模型，其中年轻人面临借款限制，选择吸烟、上学、兼职工作以及消费。该模型通过多种渠道研究成瘾与教育之间的相互因果效应。禀赋差异和香烟价格的变化是模型识别的来源。我们发现教育能够因果性地减少吸烟行为。一项反事实实验表明，在没有香烟的情况下，人群中的大学入学率将提高三个百分点。征收40%的额外消费税也能达到类似的效果。不同认知和非认知能力的人所受的影响差异显著。

abstract.text: We randomized mobile money transfers to a sample of low-income Ghanaians during the COVID-19 pandemic. Treated households received eight transfers that sum to roughly one month’s income, while control households only received one transfer. The mere announcement of upcoming transfers has null effects. Once disbursed, transfers increase contemporaneous food expenditure by 8% and income by 20%, but do not affect psychological well-being. Over 40% of the transfers are spent on food. We find suggestive evidence that transfers increased social distancing. The positive effect on income does not persist to two years after the last transfer, and surprisingly, two-year effects on consumption and psychological well-being are negative. Together, we learn that pandemic-era cash transfers can support households economically without diminishing adherence to public health protocols, though with null or negative long-term effects.

10.3386/w30309.abstractZh: 在COVID-19疫情期间，我们对一些加纳低收入家庭进行了移动货币转账的随机分配实验。实验组家庭每月收到大约一个月收入的八次转账，而对照组家庭则只收到一次转账。仅仅宣布即将进行的转账对家庭行为没有显著影响。转账完成后，家庭同期食品支出增加了8%，收入增加了20%，但并未影响心理幸福感。超过40%的转账资金被用于购买食品。我们发现，转账行为确实促进了社交隔离。然而，对收入的积极影响在最后一次转账后的两年内并未持续，令人惊讶的是，对消费和心理幸福感的影响却是负面的。总的来说，我们得出结论：在疫情期间进行的现金转账可以在不降低公众健康遵守程度的情况下，为家庭提供经济支持，尽管其长期影响可能是零或负面的。

abstract.text: We investigate women’s fertility, labor and marriage market responses to a health innovation that led to reductions in mortality from treatable causes, and especially large declines in child mortality. We find delayed childbearing, with lower intensive and extensive margin fertility, a decline in the chances of ever having married, increased labor force participation and an improvement in occupational status. Our results provide the first evidence that improvements in child survival allow women to start fertility later and invest more in the labor market. We present a new theory of fertility that incorporates dynamic choices and reconciles our findings with existing models of behavior.

10.3386/w30316.abstractZh: 我们研究了女性生育能力、劳动参与情况以及婚姻市场对一项健康创新的反应。这一创新导致可治疗疾病的死亡率下降，尤其是儿童死亡率大幅下降。研究发现，女性推迟生育时间，生育强度和范围都有所降低；结婚的可能性下降，劳动参与率上升，职业地位也有所改善。我们的研究结果首次证明，儿童生存状况的改善使女性能够推迟生育时间，并在劳动力市场中投入更多资源。我们提出了一种新的生育理论，该理论考虑了动态选择因素，并使我们发现的结论与现有行为模型相契合。

abstract.text: Quality regulation attempts to ensure quality and foster competition by reducing vertical differentiation, but it may also have adverse effects on market structure. We study this trade-off in the context of pharmaceutical bioequivalence, which is the primary quality standard for generic drugs. Exploiting the introduction of bioequivalence in Chile, we find that stronger regulation decreased the number of drugs in the market by 21 percent and increased average paid prices by 13 percent. We estimate a model of drug entry, certification, and demand to study the role of drug quality, aversion to generics, and certification costs in shaping the equilibrium effects of quality regulation. We find that quality regulation increased demand for generic drugs by resolving asymmetric information and reducing aversion against unbranded generics, which induced entry of high-quality drugs in place of low-quality drugs. Consumer welfare increased despite higher prices and a lower number of firms. We compare minimum quality standards to quality disclosure and other designs of quality regulation.

10.3386/w30325.abstractZh: 质量监管试图通过减少垂直差异化来确保质量并促进竞争，但这也可能对市场结构产生不利影响。我们在药品生物等效性的背景下研究了这一权衡问题，生物等效性是仿制药的主要质量标准。通过利用智利引入生物等效性的契机，我们发现更严格的监管使市场上的药品数量减少了21%，同时平均支付价格上升了13%。我们通过建立药品进入、认证和需求的模型，来研究药品质量、对仿制药的厌恶以及认证成本在塑造质量监管均衡效应中的作用。研究发现，质量监管通过解决信息不对称问题并减少对手牌仿制药的厌恶感，增加了对仿制药的需求，从而促使高质量药品替代低质量药品进入市场。尽管价格上升且企业数量减少，消费者的福利却得到了提升。我们还将最低质量标准与质量披露以及其他形式的质量监管措施进行了比较。

abstract.text: The mental health of the elderly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) is a largely neglected subject, both by policy and research. We combine data from the health and retirement family of surveys in seven LMICs (plus the US) to document that depressive symptoms among those aged 55 and above are more prevalent in those countries and increase sharply with age. Depressive symptoms in one survey wave are associated with a greater decline in functional abilities and higher probability of death in the next wave. Using data from a panel survey we conducted in Tamil Nadu with a focus on elderly living alone, we document that social isolation, poverty, and health challenges are three of the leading correlates of depression. We discuss potential policy interventions in these three domains, including some results from our randomized control trials in the Tamil Nadu sample.

10.3386/w30330.abstractZh: 低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）老年人的心理健康是一个被政策和研究严重忽视的课题。我们整合了七个LMICs（包括美国）的健康和退休家庭调查数据，发现55岁及以上人群的抑郁症状在这些国家更为普遍，并且随着年龄的增长而急剧增加。在某一调查阶段，抑郁症状与功能能力的显著下降以及更高的死亡风险相关。通过我们在泰米尔纳德邦进行的一项针对独居老年人的面板调查，我们发现社会孤立、贫困和健康问题是导致抑郁的三个主要因素。我们讨论了这三个领域的潜在政策干预措施，包括我们在泰米尔纳德邦样本中的随机对照试验的一些结果。

abstract.text: In 2021, the Biden Administration issued mandates requiring COVID-19 vaccinations for U.S. federal employees and contractors and for some healthcare and private sector workers. Although these mandates have been subject to legal challenges and some have been halted or delayed, rigorous appraisal of their benefits and costs accompanied neither the decision to implement them nor the efforts to terminate them. This paper aims to help fill that gap. We estimate the direct costs and health-related benefits that would have accrued if these vaccination requirements had been implemented as intended. Compared with the vaccination rates observed in January 2022, we find that the mandates could have led to 15 million additional vaccinated individuals, increasing the overall proportion of the fully vaccinated U.S. population to 68%. The associated net benefits depend on the evolution of the pandemic from the time of mandate enactment—information unavailable ex ante to analysts or policymakers. In scenarios involving the emergence of a novel, more transmissible variant, against which vaccination and previous infection offer moderate protection, the estimated net benefits reach more than $16,000 per additional vaccinated individual, with more than 20,000 total deaths averted in total. In scenarios involving a fading pandemic, existing vaccination-acquired or infection-acquired immunity provides sufficient protection, and the mandates’ benefits are unlikely to exceed their costs. Thus, mandates may be most useful when the consequences of inaction are catastrophic. However, we do not compare the effects of mandates with alternative policies for increasing vaccination rates or promoting other protective measures, which may receive stronger public support and be less likely to be overturned by litigation.

10.3386/w30339.abstractZh: 2021年，拜登政府发布了要求美国联邦雇员、承包商以及一些医疗保健和私营部门员工接种COVID-19疫苗的命令。尽管这些命令面临法律挑战，部分命令被暂停或推迟，但在实施这些命令以及终止这些命令的过程中，对其利弊的严格评估并未同时进行。本文旨在填补这一空白。我们估算了如果这些疫苗接种要求按原计划实施，将会产生的直接成本和健康相关利益。与2022年1月的疫苗接种率相比，我们发现这些命令可能导致额外1500万人接种疫苗，使美国完全接种疫苗的人口比例上升至68%。相关的净利益取决于命令实施时的疫情发展情况——这些信息在事前无法由分析师或政策制定者获得。在出现新的、更具传染性的变异毒株的情况下，疫苗和先前感染可以提供适度的保护，估计每个额外接种疫苗的人的净利益超过16,000美元，同时总共避免了超过20,000人死亡。在疫情逐渐消退的情况下，现有的疫苗或感染获得的免疫力可以提供足够的保护，这些命令的好处不太可能超过其成本。因此，当不采取行动会导致灾难性后果时，这些命令可能最为有效。然而，我们并未将这些命令的效果与增加疫苗接种率或推广其他保护措施等其他政策进行比较，因为这些政策可能获得更强的公众支持，也不太可能被诉讼推翻。

abstract.text: Variation in technology adoption is a key driver of differences in productivity. Previous studies sought to explain variations in technology adoption by heterogeneity in profitability, costs of adoption, or other factors. Less is known about how adoption is affected by bias in the perceived skill to implement the technology. We develop a Bayesian framework in which the use of the technology depends on perceived skill, while the outcomes from using it depend on actual skill. We study the determinants of adoption in the case of implantable cardiac defibrillators (ICDs) for which we document large differences across hospitals in the rate of adoption between 2002-2006, and a strong reversal from 2006-2013. We find that perception bias explains two-thirds of the cross-hospital variation in ICD use. A dynamic version of the model with learning about bias predicts accurately the subsequent decline in ICD use between 2006-2013. These results suggest an important role for misperception in explaining the wide variation in the adoption of new technologies.

10.3386/w30345.abstractZh: 技术采纳的变化是生产力差异的关键驱动因素。以往的研究试图通过盈利能力的异质性、采纳成本或其他因素来解释技术采纳的变化。但对于采纳行为如何受到对技术实施能力的感知偏差的影响，目前了解较少。我们建立了一个贝叶斯框架，在该框架中，技术的使用取决于感知能力，而使用技术的结果则取决于实际能力。我们研究了植入式心脏除颤器（ICD）的采纳决定因素，在2002-2006年间，不同医院之间的采纳率存在巨大差异，而在2006-2013年间则出现了明显的逆转。我们发现，感知偏差解释了医院间ICD使用差异的三分之二。该模型的动态版本通过了解偏差来准确预测2006-2013年间ICD使用量的下降。这些结果表明，误解在解释新技术采纳的广泛差异中起着重要作用。

abstract.text: How do people form beliefs about novel risks, with which they have little or no experience? A 2020 US survey of beliefs about the lethality of Covid reveals that the elderly underestimate, and the young overestimate, their own risks, and that people with more health adversities are more pessimistic, even for others. A model in which people selectively recall frequent and similar past experiences, including from other domains, and use them to imagine (simulate) the novel risk, explains our findings. An experience increases perceived risk if it makes that risk easier to imagine, but decreases it by interfering with recall of experiences that fuel imagination. The model yields new predictions on how non-Covid experiences shape beliefs about Covid, for which we find empirical support. These findings cannot be explained by conventional experience effects, and highlight memory mechanisms shaping which experiences are recalled and how they are used to form beliefs.

10.3386/w30353.abstractZh: 人们是如何形成对陌生风险的认知的，即使他们几乎没有或完全没有相关经验？2020年一项关于人们对新冠致命性的认知的调查显示，老年人低估了自己的风险，而年轻人则高估了自己的风险。此外，那些面临更多健康问题的群体，即使是对他人，也表现得更为悲观。这一发现可以通过一个模型来解释：人们会选择性地回忆那些频繁且相似的过去经历，包括来自其他领域的经历，并利用这些经历来想象（模拟）新的风险。如果某种经历使得该风险更容易被想象，那么它就会增加感知到的风险；而如果这种经历干扰了那些有助于想象的记忆，那么它就会降低感知到的风险。该模型还提出了关于非新冠经历如何塑造人们对新冠认知的新预测，这些预测得到了实证支持。这些发现无法用传统的经验效应来解释，凸显了记忆机制在决定哪些经历被回忆以及这些经历如何被用来形成认知中的作用。

abstract.text: This study investigates the mechanisms affecting sleep choice and explores whether commitment devices and monetary incentives can be used to promote healthier sleep habits. To this end, we conducted a field experiment with college students, providing them incentives to sleep and collecting data from wearable activity trackers, surveys, and time-use diaries. Monetary incentives were effective in increasing sleep duration with some evidence of persistence after the incentive was removed. We uncover evidence of demand for commitment. Our results are consistent with partially sophisticated time-inconsistent preferences and overconfidence, and have implications for the effectiveness of information interventions on sleep choice.

10.3386/w30375.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了影响睡眠选择的机制，并探索了是否可以利用承诺装置和经济激励来促进更健康的睡眠习惯。为此，我们对大学生进行了实地实验，为他们提供睡眠激励，并通过可穿戴活动追踪器、调查和时间使用日记收集数据。经济激励在延长睡眠时长方面有效，且在激励取消后仍有持续效果。我们发现存在对承诺的需求。我们的研究结果与部分复杂的非一致偏好和过度自信有关，并对信息干预对睡眠选择的影响具有启示意义。

abstract.text: We document how deepening resource scarcity results in rationing on the basis of race in a high-stakes setting: health care. Using detailed, time-stamped data on 107,000 inpatient admissions to a large health system, we find that in-hospital mortality increases for Black, but not White, patients as hospitals reach capacity. These findings are not explained by differential patient selection. We identify rationing by wait times as a mechanism, documenting that sicker Black patients wait longer for care than healthier White patients at almost all capacity levels. Text analysis of unstructured clinical notes reveals rationing of provider effort as another mechanism.

10.3386/w30380.abstractZh: 我们记录了在医疗这一高风险领域，资源短缺加剧导致基于种族的配给现象。通过详细且带有时间戳的数据，我们对一家大型医疗系统的107,000例住院病例进行了分析，发现当医院达到容量上限时，黑人的住院死亡率会上升，而白人患者则不会。这些现象并非由不同的患者选择所解释。我们发现，通过等待时间进行配给是其中的一种机制，实证研究表明，在几乎所有容量上限下，病情较重的黑人患者等待治疗的时间都比健康状况较好的白人患者更长。对非结构化临床记录的文本分析还揭示了另一种机制，即医疗服务提供者的工作时间的配给。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effects of privatizing social health insurance. We exploit a natural experiment in Medicaid, wherein nearly 100,000 enrollees were randomly assigned between a publicly-operated fee-for-service system and private managed care. Managed care reduced costs by 5.6% via cost-effective substitutions within prescription drugs and via lower prices for outpatient services. We present evidence that pharmacy utilization management was the key mechanism reducing overuse and encouraging substitution to lower-cost drugs without decreasing quality. In contrast, privatizing medical benefits led to only modest savings and was associated with decreased healthcare quality and consumer satisfaction.

10.3386/w30390.abstractZh: 本文探讨了社会医疗保险私有化的影响。我们利用了一项关于医疗补助的天然实验数据，其中近10万名参保者被随机分配到公共运营的付费服务系统和私人管理式医疗服务体系之间。管理式医疗服务通过药物成本的有效替代以及降低门诊服务价格，使成本降低了5.6%。我们的研究结果表明，药房利用管理是减少过度用药并促进替代低成本药物的关键机制，同时并未降低医疗质量。相比之下，医疗福利的私有化仅带来了适度的成本节约，并且与医疗质量下降和消费者满意度降低相关。

abstract.text: Substantial funding is provided to the healthcare systems of low-income countries. However, an important challenge is to ensure that this funding be used efficiently. This challenge is complicated by the fact that a large share of healthcare services in low-income countries is provided by non-profit health centers that often lack i) effective governance structures and ii) organizational know-how and adequate training. In this paper, we argue that the bundling of performance-based incentives with auditing and feedback (A&F) is a potential way to overcome these obstacles. First, the combination of feedback and performance-based incentives—that is, feedback joint with incentives to act on this feedback and achieve specific health outcomes—helps address the knowledge gap that may otherwise undermine performance-based incentives. Second, coupling feedback with auditing helps ensure that the information underlying the feedback is reliable—a prerequisite for effective feedback. To examine the effectiveness of this bundle, we use data from a randomized governance program conducted in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Within the program, a set of health centers were randomly assigned to a “governance treatment” that consisted of performance-based incentives combined with A&F, while others were not. Consistent with our prediction, we find that the governance treatment led to i) higher operating efficiency and ii) improvements in health outcomes. Furthermore, we find that funding is not a substitute for the governance treatment—health centers that only receive funding increase their scale, but do not show improvements in operating efficiency nor health outcomes.

10.3386/w30391.abstractZh: 低收入国家的医疗系统获得了大量资金支持。然而，一个重要的挑战是如何确保这些资金得到有效使用。这一挑战因以下因素而变得更加复杂：在低收入国家，大部分医疗服务由非营利性医疗中心提供，而这些中心往往缺乏有效的治理结构、组织能力以及适当的培训。在本文中，我们认为将基于绩效的激励措施与审计和反馈相结合是一种克服这些障碍的潜在方法。首先，反馈与基于绩效的激励措施相结合——即结合反馈以及根据反馈采取行动以实现特定健康目标的激励措施——有助于弥补可能削弱基于绩效激励措施效果的知识差距。其次，将反馈与审计相结合有助于确保反馈所依据的信息是可靠的——这是有效反馈的前提条件。为了检验这种组合措施的有效性，我们采用了在刚果民主共和国开展的一项随机治理计划的数据。在该计划中，一部分医疗中心被随机分配接受“治理处理”，该处理包括基于绩效的激励措施与审计和反馈的结合，而其他医疗中心则没有接受这种处理。与我们的预测一致，我们发现治理处理措施使得医疗中心的运营效率提高，健康结果也有所改善。此外，我们发现资金并不能替代治理处理措施——仅获得资金的医疗中心虽然规模有所扩大，但在运营效率或健康结果方面并未得到改善。

abstract.text: This study investigates effects of welfare reform in the U.S., a major policy shift that increased employment of low-income mothers and reliance on their own earnings instead of cash assistance through the welfare system, on the quality of the home environments they provide for their preschool-age children. Using empirical methods designed to identify plausibly causal effects, we estimate effects of welfare reform on validated survey and observational measures of maternal behaviors that support children’s cognitive skills and emotional adjustment and material goods that parents purchase to stimulate their children’s skill development. The results suggest that welfare reform did not affect the amount of time and material resources mothers devoted to cognitively stimulating activities with their young children but was significantly associated with approximately 0.3–0.4 standard deviation lower scores on provision of emotional support, with stronger effects for mothers with low human capital. The findings provide evidence that maternal work incentives as implemented by welfare reform came at a cost to children in the form of lower quality parenting and underscore the importance of considering quality, and not just quantity, in assessing the effects of maternal work incentive policies on parenting and children’s home environments.

10.3386/w30407.abstractZh: 本研究调查了美国福利改革的影响，这一重大政策转变增加了低收入母亲的就业机会，并使她们更依赖自己的收入，而非通过福利系统获得现金援助。我们采用旨在识别合理因果效应的实证方法，评估福利改革对母亲行为的有效调查与观察指标的影响，这些指标有助于促进儿童的认知能力和情绪调节能力，以及父母为激发孩子技能发展而购买的物资。研究结果表明，福利改革并未影响母亲与幼儿进行认知刺激活动的时间及物质资源投入，但显著降低了提供情感支持方面的表现，其影响程度约为0.3至0.4个标准差。对于人力资本较低的母亲来说，这种影响更为明显。研究结果表明，福利改革所实施的母亲工作激励措施，以较低的育儿质量为代价，并强调了在评估母亲工作激励政策对育儿及儿童家庭环境的影响时，需要考虑质量而非数量的重要性。

abstract.text: This paper uses birth records from California and mothers who move to quantify the absolute and relative importance of birth location in early-life health. Using a model that includes mother and location fixed effects, we find that moving from a below- to an above-median birth weight location leads to a 19-gram increase in average birth weight. These causal place effects explain 16 percent of geographic variation in birth weight, with family-specific factors accounting for the remaining 84 percent. Place effects are more influential for children of non-college-educated mothers, and are most strongly correlated with local levels of pollution. The improvement in birth weight from moving to a higher-quality area compares favorably to policies that target maternal health, and could have a small, lasting effect on long-run outcomes.

10.3386/w30424.abstractZh: 本文利用加利福尼亚州的出生记录以及母亲迁移数据，量化了出生地对早期健康的影响程度。通过包含母亲和出生地固定效应的模型分析，我们发现从低于中位出生体重的地区迁移到高于中位出生体重的地区，平均出生体重会增加19克。这些因果性地区效应解释了出生体重地理变异的16%，而家庭特定因素则占剩余的84%。对于非大学教育背景的母亲所生的孩子来说，地区效应更为显著，并且与当地污染水平有最强的相关性。从质量更高的地区迁移所带来的出生体重改善，与针对母亲健康的政策相比具有优势，并且可能对长期结果产生较小但持久的影响。

abstract.text: Specialty hospitals tend to negotiate higher commercial insurance payments, even for relatively routine procedures with comparable clinical quality across hospital types. How specialty hospitals can maintain such a price premium remains an open question. In this paper, we examine a potential (horizontal) differentiation effect in which patients perceive specialty hospitals as sufficiently distinct from other hospitals, so that specialty hospitals effectively compete in a separate market from general acute care hospitals. We estimate this effect in the context of routine pediatric procedures offered by both specialty children’s hospitals as well as general acute care hospitals, and we find strong empirical evidence of a differentiation effect in which specialty children’s hospitals appear largely immune to competitive forces from non-children’s hospitals.

10.3386/w30425.abstractZh: 专科医院往往能够协商出更高的商业保险费用，即使对于具有相似临床质量的常规手术也是如此。然而，专科医院如何维持这样的价格优势仍然是一个未解之谜。在本文中，我们探讨了一种潜在的（横向）差异化效应，即患者认为专科医院与其他医院存在显著差异，因此专科医院能够在与普通急性护理医院不同的市场中进行竞争。我们在儿科常规手术这一背景下进行了实证研究，发现专科医院在非儿科医院的竞争压力下表现出较强的差异化优势。

abstract.text: Safe and effective vaccines have vastly reduced the lethality of the COVID-19 pandemic worldwide, but disparities exist in vaccine take-up. Although the out-of-pocket price is set to zero in the U.S., time (information gathering, signing up, transportation and waiting) and misinformation costs still apply. To understand the extent to which geographic access impacts COVID-19 vaccination take-up rates and COVID-19 health outcomes, we leverage exogenous, pre-existing variation in locations of retail pharmacies participating the U.S. federal government’s vaccine distribution program through which over 40% of US vaccine doses were administered. We use unique data on nearly all COVID-19 vaccine administrations in 2021. We find that the presence of a participating retail pharmacy vaccination site in a county leads to an approximately 26% increase in the per-capita number of doses administered, possibly indicating that proximity and familiarity play a substantial role in vaccine take-up decisions. Increases in county-level per capita participating retail pharmacies lead to an increase in COVID-19 vaccination rates and a decline in the number of new COVID-19 cases, hospitalizations, and deaths, with substantial heterogeneity based on county rurality, political leanings, income, and race composition. The relationship we estimate suggests that averting one COVID-19 case, hospitalization, and death requires approximately 25, 200, and 1,500 county-level vaccine total doses, respectively. These results imply a 9,500% to 22,500% economic return on the full costs of COVID-19 vaccination. Overall, our findings add to understanding vaccine take-up decisions for the design of COVID era and other public health interventions.

10.3386/w30429.abstractZh: 安全有效的疫苗已大幅降低了全球COVID-19大流行的致死率，但疫苗接种率的差异仍然存在。尽管美国的自付费用预计将为零，但时间成本（信息收集、注册、交通和等待）以及错误信息的影响仍然存在。为了了解地理因素对COVID-19疫苗接种率和健康结果的影响，我们利用了美国联邦政府疫苗分发计划中的零售药店位置的预先存在的差异，通过该计划，超过40%的美国疫苗剂量得到了接种。我们使用了2021年几乎所有COVID-19疫苗接种的独特数据。我们发现，一个县的零售药店疫苗接种点的存在会导致人均接种剂量增加约26%，这可能表明距离和熟悉度在疫苗接种决策中起着重要作用。县级零售药店数量的增加导致COVID-19疫苗接种率上升，同时新病例数、住院数和死亡数下降，这种差异基于县的农村化程度、政治倾向、收入和种族构成。我们估计的关系表明，避免一例COVID-19病例、住院和死亡分别需要约25,200剂和1,500剂县级疫苗。这些结果意味着，COVID-19疫苗接种的全部成本带来了9,500%到22,500%的经济回报。总体而言，我们的发现有助于理解疫苗接种决策，为COVID时代及其他公共卫生干预措施的设计提供参考。

abstract.text: We show that Covid-19 illnesses persistently reduce labor supply. Using an event study, we estimate that workers with week-long Covid-19 work absences are 7 percentage points less likely to be in the labor force one year later compared to otherwise-similar workers who do not miss a week of work for health reasons. Our estimates suggest Covid-19 illnesses have reduced the U.S. labor force by approximately 500,000 people (0.2 percent of adults) and imply an average forgone earnings per Covid-19 absence of at least $9,000, about 90 percent of which reflects lost labor supply beyond the initial absence week.

10.3386/w30435.abstractZh: 我们指出，新冠疫情导致劳动力供应持续减少。通过事件研究法分析，我们发现，那些因新冠病假一周的工人，一年后进入劳动力市场的可能性比因健康原因未缺勤一周的类似工人低7个百分点。我们的估计表明，新冠疫情使美国劳动力减少了约50万人（占成年人的0.2%），并且每次因新冠病假缺勤，平均损失的收入至少为9,000美元，其中约90%的损失源于病假结束后的劳动力供应减少。

abstract.text: Does using prescription drugs off-label increase disability and medical expenditure? This paper uses a unique dataset to evaluate off-label vs. on-label drug use in the US non-institutionalized population. Patients using drugs off-label have on average $515 higher medical expenditure and work-loss cost. Pharmaceutical innovation has direct and indirect effects on off-label drug use. Market size is indicative of the fraction of treatments used off-label. Our findings have implications for regulation and welfare. We address endogeneity issues by demonstrating that patients with higher disease severity do not experience higher off-label uses and by controlling for unobserved individual and condition effects.

10.3386/w30440.abstractZh: 使用非标签药物是否会增加残疾率和医疗支出？本文利用独特的数据集，评估了美国非机构化人群中非标签与标签药物的使用情况。使用非标签药物的患者平均医疗支出和工作损失成本高出515美元。药物创新对非标签药物的使用有直接和间接的影响。市场规模可以反映非标签药物的使用比例。我们的研究结果对监管和福利政策具有启示意义。我们通过证明病情较重的患者并不会出现更高的非标签药物使用情况，并通过控制未观察到的个体和疾病效应，解决了内生性问题。

abstract.text: This paper documents a longitudinal crisis of midlife among the inhabitants of rich nations. Yet middle-aged citizens in our data sets are close to their peak earnings, have typically experienced little or no illness, reside in some of the safest countries in the world, and live in the most prosperous era in human history. This is paradoxical and troubling. The finding is consistent, however, with the prediction – one little-known to economists – of Elliott Jaques (1965). Our analysis does not rest on elementary cross-sectional analysis. Instead the paper uses panel and through-time data on, in total, approximately 500,000 individuals. It checks that the key results are not due to cohort effects. Nor do we rely on simple life-satisfaction measures. The paper shows that there are approximately quadratic hill-shaped patterns in data on midlife suicide, sleeping problems, alcohol dependence, concentration difficulties, memory problems, intense job strain, disabling headaches, suicidal feelings, and extreme depression. We believe the seriousness of this societal problem has not been grasped by the affluent world’s policy-makers.

10.3386/w30442.abstractZh: 本文记录了富裕国家中人中中年危机的持续性现象。然而，我们的数据集中中年公民的收入已接近巅峰，通常很少或从未患病，居住在世界上最安全的国家之一，并生活在人类历史上最繁荣的时代。这一情况显得矛盾且令人担忧。不过，这一发现与Elliott Jaques在1965年提出的预测一致——这一预测经济学家们并不熟悉。我们的分析并非基于简单的横截面研究，而是使用了关于约50万人的面板数据和时间序列数据。我们的研究确认，关键结果并非由队列效应所导致。我们也没有依赖简单的生活满意度指标。研究表明，中年自杀、睡眠问题、酒精依赖、注意力困难、记忆问题、工作压力、致残性头痛、自杀情绪以及极端抑郁等数据呈现出近似二次方曲线型的变化模式。我们认为，富裕世界的政策制定者尚未充分认识到这一社会问题的严重性。

abstract.text: The Bureau of Labor Statistics' Prescription Drug Consumer Price Index (CPI-Rx) has been the focus of considerable controversy in recent years. The CPI-Rx limits its sampling frame to transactions in retail outpatient outlets, and excludes prescription pharmaceuticals dispensed in hospitals, physician/clinic outpatient facilities, and nursing homes. Thus the CPI-Rx overlooks the increasingly important specialty pharmaceuticals dispensed in hospitals, outpatient clinics, and physician offices, whose transactions are instead captured in the overall hospital or professional services component of the medical CPI. Specialty drugs now account for 55% of all U.S. drug spending, double the amount of a decade earlier. To the extent specialty drug growth differs from that of traditional pharmaceuticals, the CPI-Rx could provide an inaccurate measure of overall drug price inflation. Using data from the IBM MarketScan database for the years 2010-2019 and IQVIA-designated specialty drugs, we estimate that by not sampling specialty drugs in non-retail settings, the CPI-Rx has understated overall U.S. prescription drug price inflation by just under 75 basis points annually. We discuss implications for health care policy, and suggest the BLS examine the feasibility of publishing an overall pharmaceutical price index incorporating both traditional and specialty pharmaceuticals dispensed in retail and non-retail settings.

10.3386/w30448.abstractZh: 美国劳工统计局的处方药消费者价格指数（CPI-Rx）近年来引发了大量争议。该指数仅涵盖零售门诊处的交易情况，而排除了在医院、医生诊所和养老院配发的处方药。因此，CPI-Rx未能反映在医院、门诊诊所和医生办公室配发的专业药品的重要性，这些药品的交易情况则被纳入了医疗CPI的整体医院或专业服务部分。目前，专业药品占美国药品总支出的55%，是十年前的两倍。如果专业药品的增长与传统药品的增长有所不同，那么CPI-Rx可能会提供一个不准确的整体药品价格通胀指标。利用IBM MarketScan数据库2010-2019年的数据以及IQVIA指定的专业药品数据，我们估计，由于CPI-Rx未涵盖非零售环境中的专业药品交易，导致整体美国处方药价格通胀被低估了约75个基点。我们讨论了这一发现对医疗政策的影响，并建议劳工统计局考虑是否有可能发布一个涵盖零售和非零售环境中传统及专业药品的价格指数。

abstract.text: We review select literature on racial and ethnic disparities in retirement outcomes in the United States and the impact of outreach on such outcomes. First, there are significant disparities in retirement outcomes, reflecting a long history of racism and structural barriers. Second, there is comparatively little work on the differential impact of retirement outreach across race and ethnicity. Future work should consider designing interventions that cater to the needs of specific demographic groups, for example, by embracing the fact that Blacks, Hispanics, and Whites acquire retirement information from different sources. Future work should incorporate behavioral insights, particularly from prior interventions, and innovate on methodologies for data collection, linking, and analysis.

10.3386/w30456.abstractZh: 我们回顾了关于美国种族和族裔在退休结果上的差异以及退休推广对这些结果影响的相关文献。首先，退休结果存在显著差异，这反映了长期的种族主义现象和结构性障碍。其次，关于退休推广对不同种族和族裔群体的影响的研究相对较少。未来的研究应考虑设计针对特定人群需求的干预措施，例如，考虑到黑人、西班牙裔和白人获取退休信息的来源不同。未来的研究还应结合行为学上的见解，尤其是从以往干预措施中获得的经验，并创新数据收集、链接和分析的方法论。

abstract.text: Medical journals have adhered to a reporting practice that seriously limits the usefulness of published trial findings. Medical decision makers commonly observe many patient covariates and seek to use this information to personalize treatment choices. Yet standard summaries of trial findings only partition subjects into broad subgroups, typically into binary categories. Given this reporting practice, we study the problem of inference on long mean treatment outcomes E[y(t)|x], where t is a treatment, y(t) is a treatment outcome, and the covariate vector x has length K, each component being a binary variable. The available data are estimates of {E[y(t)|xk = 0], E[y(t)|xk = 1], P(xk)}, k = 1, . . . , K reported in journal articles. We show that reported trial findings partially identify {E[y(t)|x], P(x)}. Illustrative computations demonstrate that the summaries of trial findings in journal articles may imply only wide bounds on long mean outcomes. One can realistically tighten inferences if one can combine reported trial findings with credible assumptions having identifying power, such as bounded-variation assumptions.

10.3386/w30461.abstractZh: 医学期刊遵循一种报告惯例，这严重限制了已发表试验结果的实用性。医学决策者通常会观察许多患者协变量，并试图利用这些信息来个性化治疗方案。然而，标准的试验结果摘要仅将受试者划分为广泛的子组，通常分为二元类别。鉴于这种报告惯例，我们研究了关于长期平均治疗结果E[y(t)|x]的推断问题，其中t是一种治疗，y(t)是一种治疗结果，协变量向量x的长度为K，每个分量都是二元变量。现有数据是期刊文章中报告的{E[y(t)|xk = 0], E[y(t)|xk = 1], P(xk)}的估计值。我们表明，报告的试验结果部分地识别了{E[y(t)|x], P(x)}。示例计算表明，期刊文章中报告的试验结果摘要可能仅对长期平均结果给出宽泛的界限。如果能够将报告的试验结果与具有识别能力的可信假设相结合，就可以更现实地加强推断的可靠性，例如有界变异假设。

abstract.text: We investigate the role of person- and place-specific factors in the opioid epidemic by developing and estimating a dynamic model of risky prescription opioid use. We estimate the model using the relationship between cross-state migration and risky use among adults receiving federal disability insurance from 2006 to 2015. Event studies suggest that moving to a state with a 3.5 percentage point higher rate of risky use (roughly the difference between the 20th and 80th percentile states) increases the probability of risky use by 1.0 percentage point on-impact, followed by an additional increase of 0.30 percentage points per subsequent year. Model estimates imply large place effects in both the likelihood of transitioning to addiction and the availability of prescription opioids. A one standard deviation reduction in all place effects would have reduced risky use by two-thirds over our study period. Reductions in place effects on addiction have a larger cumulative effect than analogous reductions in place effects on availability. However, their relative efficacy is reversed in the first few years, suggesting a temporal tradeoff among policy options.

10.3386/w30471.abstractZh: 我们研究了个人和地点特定因素在阿片类药物流行中的作用，通过开发并估计一个关于风险性阿片类药物使用的动态模型。我们使用2006至2015年间接受联邦残疾保险的成年人跨州迁移与风险性使用之间的关系来估计该模型。事件研究表明，迁移到风险性使用率高出3.5个百分点的州（大约相当于第20百分位和第80百分位州之间的差异），会使风险性使用的概率在迁移后增加1.0个百分点，随后每年又增加0.30个百分点。模型估计显示，地点因素在转向成瘾的可能性以及阿片类药物的可获得性方面都有显著的影响。如果所有地点因素的影响减少一个标准差，则在我们研究期间风险性使用将减少三分之二。对成瘾的影响减少的累积效应比对阿片类药物可获得性影响的减少更为显著。然而，在最初几年，这两种影响的相对效果是相反的，这表明政策选择之间存在时间上的权衡。

abstract.text: How do people compare bundles of social-distancing behaviors? During the COVID pandemic, we showed 676 online respondents in the US, UK, and Israel 30 pairs of brief videos of acquaintances meeting. We asked them to indicate which in each pair depicted greater risk of COVID infection. Their choices imply that on average respondents considered talking 14 minutes longer to be as risky as standing 1 foot closer, being indoors as standing 3 feet closer, and removing a properly worn mask by either party as standing 4–5 feet closer. We explore subpopulations and perceived nonlinear and interacted effects of combined behaviors.

10.3386/w30493.abstractZh: 人们如何比较各种社交距离行为？在COVID疫情期间，我们在美国、英国和以色列对676名在线受访者展示了30对熟人见面的简短视频。我们要求他们指出每对视频中哪一方表现出更高的新冠感染风险。他们的选择表明，平均而言，受访者认为交谈时间延长14分钟与站近1英尺、待在室内与站近3英尺、以及双方都摘下面罩与站近4-5英尺具有相同的风险。我们进一步探讨了不同子群体以及这些行为组合所带来的非线性及交互效应。

abstract.text: Political affiliation has emerged as a potential risk factor for COVID-19, amid evidence that Republican-leaning counties have had higher COVID-19 death rates than Democrat- leaning counties and evidence of a link between political party affiliation and vaccination views. This study constructs an individual-level dataset with political affiliation and excess death rates during the COVID-19 pandemic via a linkage of 2017 voter registration in Ohio and Florida to mortality data from 2018 to 2021. We estimate substantially higher excess death rates for registered Republicans when compared to registered Democrats, with almost all of the difference concentrated in the period after vaccines were widely available in our study states. Overall, the excess death rate for Republicans was 5.4 percentage points (pp), or 76%, higher than the excess death rate for Democrats. Post- vaccines, the excess death rate gap between Republicans and Democrats widened from 1.6 pp (22% of the Democrat excess death rate) to 10.4 pp (153% of the Democrat excess death rate). The gap in excess death rates between Republicans and Democrats is concentrated in counties with low vaccination rates and only materializes after vaccines became widely available.

10.3386/w30512.abstractZh: 政治党派归属已成为COVID-19的一个潜在风险因素，有证据表明，倾向于共和党的县比倾向于民主党的县有更高的COVID-19死亡率，同时也有证据表明政治党派归属与疫苗接种观念之间存在关联。本研究通过连接2017年俄亥俄州和佛罗里达州的选民登记数据以及2018至2021年的死亡数据，构建了一个包含政治党派归属和超额死亡率的个体级数据集。研究发现，与登记为民主党的选民相比，登记为共和党的人的超额死亡率明显更高，这一差异几乎全部集中在疫苗广泛普及之后的时期。总体而言，共和党的超额死亡率比民主党高出5.4个百分点，即76%。在疫苗普及之后，共和党和民主党之间的超额死亡率差距从1.6个百分点（占民主党超额死亡率的22%）扩大到10.4个百分点（占民主党超额死亡率的153%）。共和党和民主党之间的超额死亡率差距主要出现在疫苗接种率较低的县，并且这一差距仅在疫苗广泛普及之后才显现出来。

abstract.text: Intensive agriculture and deep plowing resulted in top-soil erosion and dust storms during the 1930s. These effects have been shown to affect agricultural income and land values that persisted for years. Given the growing literature on the relevance of in-utero and early-life exposures, it is surprising that studies focusing on links between the Dust Bowl and later-life health find inconclusive and mixed results. This paper re-evaluates this literature and studies the long-term effects of in-utero and early-life exposure to top-soil erosion caused by the Dust Bowl of the 1930s on old-age longevity. Specifically, we employ Social Security Administration death records linked with the full-count 1940 census and implement event studies and difference-in-difference designs to compare the longevity of individuals in high/medium versus low top-soil erosion counties post-1930 versus pre-1930. We find intent-to-treat reductions in longevity of about 0.9 months for those born in high erosion counties post-1930. We show that these effects are not an artifact of preexisting trends in longevity. Additional analyses suggest the effects are more pronounced among children raised in farm households, females, and those with lower maternal education. We also provide suggestive evidence that reductions in adulthood income are a likely mechanism channel.

10.3386/w30531.abstractZh: 在20世纪30年代，集约化农业与深翻作业导致了表土侵蚀和沙尘暴的频发。这些影响被证明会持续多年，对农业收入和土地价值产生负面影响。鉴于关于子宫内和早期生活经历对健康的潜在影响的研究日益增多，令人惊讶的是，那些研究沙尘暴与后期健康之间关系的研究结果却并不一致。本文重新评估了这些文献，并研究了20世纪30年代沙尘暴引发的表土侵蚀对老年人寿命的长期影响。具体而言，我们利用了与1940年人口普查相关的社会保障管理局死亡记录，采用事件研究和差异差异设计方法来比较1930年后与1930年前表土侵蚀程度高/中/低的地区的居民寿命。研究发现，1930年后出生在表土侵蚀程度高的地区的人，其寿命减少了约0.9个月。我们表明，这些影响并非预先存在的寿命趋势的副产品。进一步分析表明，这种影响在出生于农业家庭的孩子、女性以及母亲教育水平较低的人群中更为明显。我们还提供了一些线索，表明成年后的收入减少可能是导致寿命缩短的机制之一。

abstract.text: We study how pre-pandemic inequalities in America influenced social distancing over the course of the COVID-19 pandemic. Richer counties tended to see more protective mobility responses in the initial (pre-pharmaceutical) phase, but less protective responses later. Near linearity of this income effect implies that inequality between counties contributed very little to overall mobility reductions. By contrast, higher within-county inequality and/or poverty measures came with substantially larger attenuations to non-residential mobility at given average incomes. There were also significant effects of the county’s racial and age composition. Standard epidemiological covariates of contact rates were also relevant, controlling for the socioeconomic factors.

10.3386/w30540.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国疫情前的不平等现象如何影响了COVID-19大流行期间的社会隔离措施。在初期阶段（药物出现之前），富裕地区的居民表现出更多的保护性行动，但后期这种保护性行动有所减少。这种收入效应的近似线性表明，不同县之间的不平等对整体行动减少的影响很小。相比之下，县内较高的不平等程度和/或贫困指标会导致非住宅性行动显著减少，尤其是在给定平均收入的情况下。此外，县的种族和年龄构成也产生了显著影响。在控制社会经济因素后，标准的流行病学相关变量，如接触率，也显示出重要性。

abstract.text: We analyze a multidimensional screening model in which a principal offers a menu of quality-price pairs to a consumer with multiple dimensions of private information and a quasilinear utility function. We derive necessary conditions for optimality, and use them to provide insight into optimal exclusion, positive trade, and screening. We then recast the problem in terms of incremental quality levels and prices, the so-called demand-profile approach (DPA). Under DPA, the problem decouples across increments and can be solved one at a time. We provide novel conditions under which DPA recovers the solution to the full problem exactly or approximately, and which make the necessary conditions sufficient for optimality: essentially, valuations must be sufficiently correlated across quality increments. Applied to empirical estimates of demand for health insurance, we show that DPA is approximately valid, and we apply it to understand equilibrium outcomes in a monopoly insurance market.

10.3386/w30542.abstractZh: 我们分析了一个多维筛选模型，在该模型中，一个主体向消费者提供一系列质量-价格组合，消费者拥有多维度私人信息，并且具有准线性效用函数。我们推导了最优性的必要条件，并利用这些条件来探讨最优排除、正向交易和筛选问题。随后，我们将问题重新表述为增量质量水平与价格之间的关系，即所谓的需求-质量剖面法（DPA）。在DPA框架下，问题可以逐部分解决。我们提出了一些新的条件，这些条件使得DPA能够精确或近似地恢复完整问题的解，并且使这些必要条件成为最优性的充分条件：本质上，不同质量增量的估值必须足够相关。通过对健康保险需求的实证估计应用DPA方法，我们发现该方法在近似意义上是有效的，并且我们将其应用于理解垄断保险市场中的均衡结果。

abstract.text: In a randomized controlled trial (RCT) conducted in three waves over 2.5 years and involving nearly 700 customer-service representatives (CSRs) from a Canadian government service agency, we studied how providing CSRs with repeated performance feedback, with or without peer comparison, affected their subsequent organ donor registration rates. The feedback resulted in a 25% increase in daily signups compared to otherwise equivalent encouragements and reminders. Adding benchmark information about peer performance did not amplify or diminish this effect. We observed increased registration rates for both high and low performers. A post-intervention survey indicates that CSRs in all conditions found the information included in the treatments helpful and motivating and that signing up organ donors makes their job more meaningful. We also found suggestive evidence that performance feedback with benchmark information was the most motivating and created the least pressure to perform.

10.3386/w30547.abstractZh: 在一项为期2.5年、分三阶段进行的随机对照试验中，来自一家加拿大政府服务机构的近700名客户服务代表参与了研究。我们探讨了向客户服务代表提供重复绩效反馈（无论是否包含同伴比较）对其后续器官捐赠登记率的影响。结果显示，与单纯的鼓励或提醒相比，提供重复绩效反馈能使每日的登记率增加25%。添加关于同伴绩效的基准信息并未增强或减弱这一效果。我们发现，无论是表现优异还是表现不佳的客户服务代表，其登记率都有所提高。事后调查表明，所有条件下的客户服务代表都认为所提供的信息具有帮助性和激励性，并且登记器官捐赠者会使他们的工作更有意义。我们还发现了一些证据，表明包含基准信息的绩效反馈最具激励作用，同时也最小化了执行任务的压力。

abstract.text: We estimate direct and indirect vaccine effectiveness, and assess how far the infection-reducing externality extends from the vaccinated, a key input to policy decisions. Our empirical strategy uses nearly universal microdata from a single state and relies on the six-month delay between 12- and 11 year-old COVID vaccine eligibility. Vaccination reduces cases by 80 percent, the direct effect. This protection spills over to close contacts, producing a household-level indirect effect about half as large as the direct effect. However, indirect effects do not extend to schoolmates. Our results highlight vaccine reach as an important aspect of policy towards infectious disease.

10.3386/w30550.abstractZh: 我们估算了疫苗的直接和间接有效性，并评估了减少感染的外部效应在多大程度上能够扩展到接种疫苗的人群，这是制定政策决策的关键依据。我们的实证策略使用了来自一个州的几乎普遍存在的微观数据，并基于12岁和11岁人群接种COVID疫苗资格之间的六个月间隔。疫苗接种使病例减少了80%，这是直接效果。这种保护作用还扩展到了密切接触者，产生了大约相当于直接效果一半的家庭级间接效果。然而，间接效果并不扩展到同学之间。我们的研究结果强调了疫苗覆盖率是应对传染病政策中的一个重要方面。

abstract.text: The contraction in health care consumption at the start of the pandemic provides insight into central economic questions of waste and productivity in the U.S. health care system. Using linked mortality and Electronic Medical Records, we compare people who had outpatient appointments scheduled for dates in 30 day periods immediately before and after the Covid-19 emergency declaration. Appointment cancellation rates were 77% higher for people with appointments in the shutdown period. Intent to treat estimates imply that having a scheduled appointment date right after the emergency declaration increased one-year mortality rates by 4 deaths per 10,000. Instrumental variable estimates suggest that a cancelled appointment increased one-year mortality by 29.7 deaths per 10,000 among compliers, implying that a 10% increase in health care appointments reduces mortality rates by 2.9%. The mortality effects are rooted in two mechanisms: a complier sub-population with high marginal benefits from care, and a cascade of delayed or missed follow-up care that lasted for about 3 months. Healthcare spending accounted for 19.7% of U.S. GDP in 2021, and controlling health spending is a major policy objective. Our results quantify health tradeoffs from cutting every-day non-emergency visits, illustrating the importance of cost-control efforts that differentiate between medical care with the largest and smallest benefits for patient health.

10.3386/w30553.abstractZh: 疫情初期医疗消费的减少为我们理解美国医疗体系中的浪费与生产效率问题提供了重要线索。通过关联死亡率数据和电子病历，我们比较了在新冠疫情紧急状态宣布前后30天内预约门诊的患者情况。在封锁期间，预约取消率高出77%。意向治疗估计表明，在紧急状态宣布后立即预约门诊，会使一年内的死亡率增加4例/10,000人。工具变量估计显示，对于遵守规定的人群来说，取消预约会使一年内的死亡率增加29.7例/10,000人，这意味着医疗预约数量增加10%，可使死亡率降低2.9%。这些死亡率变化源于两种机制：一部分遵守规定的人群从医疗服务中获得了较高的边际收益，以及大约持续3个月的延迟或错过后续护理的情况。2021年，医疗支出占美国GDP的19.7%，因此控制医疗支出是重要的政策目标。我们的研究结果量化了减少日常非紧急就诊所带来的健康权衡，强调了区分对病人健康效益最大和最小的医疗服务的成本控制措施的重要性。

abstract.text: Although pollution is widespread, there is little evidence about how it might harm children’s long run outcomes. Using the detailed, geocoded data that follows national representative cohorts of children born to the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth respondents over time, I compare siblings who were gestating before versus after a Toxic Release Inventory site opened or closed within one mile of their home. I find that children who were exposed prenatally to industrial pollution have lower wages, are more likely to be in poverty as adults, have fewer years of completed education, and are less likely to graduate high school.

10.3386/w30559.abstractZh: 尽管污染现象普遍存在，但关于污染如何损害儿童长期发展的研究结果却很少。我利用国家纵向调查对象所生的儿童的详细地理编码数据，比较了那些在有毒物质排放点位于其住所一英里范围内时怀孕的兄弟姐妹。研究发现，在孕期暴露于工业污染环境中的儿童，其工资较低，成年后陷入贫困的可能性更大，完成的教育年限更少，高中毕业的可能性也更低。

abstract.text: While Covid-19 vaccines were developed and deployed with unprecedented speed, their widespread introduction could have been accelerated—saving millions of lives and trillions of dollars—had more vaccine capacity been available prior to the pandemic. Combining estimates of the frequency and intensity of pandemics with estimates of mortality, economic-output, and human-capital losses from pandemics of varying severities, we calculate that the present value of global social losses from the stream of future pandemics can be expected to be nearly $18 trillion—over $700 billion each year going forward. According to our model, a program spending $60 billion up front to expand production capacity and supply-chain inputs for vaccines and $5 billion annually thereafter would be sufficient to ensure production capacity to vaccinate 70% of the global population against a new virus within six months. The program would generate an expected net present value (NPV) gain of more than $500 billion over the status quo of delaying investment until a pandemic arrives. A program undertaken by the United States alone would generate an expected NPV gain of over $60 billion.

10.3386/w30565.abstractZh: 虽然新冠疫苗的开发与部署速度空前迅速，但如果在大流行之前就有更多的疫苗产能，那么全球大流行的广泛传播本可以加速，从而挽救数百万人的生命并节省数万亿美元。通过结合对大流行频率和强度的估计，以及不同严重程度的大流行所导致的死亡人数、经济产出和人力资本损失的数据，我们计算出未来大流行带来的全球社会损失现值接近18万亿美元，每年额外损失超过7000亿美元。根据我们的模型，如果美国政府提前投入600亿美元用于扩大疫苗的生产能力和供应链投入，并在此后每年投入50亿美元，那么就能在六个月内为全球70%的人口提供针对新病毒的疫苗。与推迟投资直到大流行发生相比，这一计划将带来超过5000亿美元的净现值收益。仅美国一国实施此类计划，预计将带来超过600亿美元的净现值收益。

abstract.text: We use natality microdata covering the universe of U.S. births for 2015-2021 and California births from 2015 through February 2023 to examine childbearing responses to the COVID-19 pandemic. We find that 60% of the 2020 decline in U.S. fertility rates was driven by sharp reductions in births to foreign-born mothers although births to this group comprised only 22% of all U.S. births in 2019. This decline started in January 2020. In contrast, the COVID-19 recession resulted in an overall “baby bump” among U.S.-born mothers which marked the first reversal in declining fertility rates since the Great Recession. Births to U.S.-born mothers fell by 31,000 in 2020 relative to a pre-pandemic trend but increased by 71,000 in 2021. The data for California suggest that U.S. births remained elevated through February 2023. The baby bump was most pronounced for first births and women under age 25, suggesting that the pandemic led some women to start families earlier. Above age 25, the baby bump was most pronounced for women ages 30-34 and women with a college education. The 2021-2022 baby bump is especially remarkable given the large declines in fertility rates that would have been projected by standard statistical models.

10.3386/w30569.abstractZh: 我们使用涵盖2015-2021年美国所有出生案例以及2015年至2023年2月加利福尼亚州出生案例的出生数据，来研究生育行为对COVID-19大流行的反应。研究发现，2020年美国生育率下降的60%是由外国出生母亲所生的婴儿数量急剧减少所驱动的，尽管在2019年，这一群体仅占美国所有出生案例的22%。这一下降始于2020年1月。相比之下，COVID-19经济衰退导致美国出生母亲所生的婴儿数量有所增加，这标志着自大衰退以来生育率首次出现回升。2020年，美国出生母亲所生的婴儿数量减少了31,000人，而2021年则增加了71,000人。加利福尼亚州的数据表明，截至2023年2月，美国出生数量仍然较高。这种“婴儿激增”现象在首次生育且年龄小于25岁的女性中最为明显，这表明疫情促使一些女性更早开始组建家庭。在25岁以上的女性中，这种现象在30-34岁以及拥有大学教育背景的女性中最为明显。2021-2022年的婴儿激增尤其引人注目，因为按照标准统计模型预计，生育率本应大幅下降。

abstract.text: A rich literature shows that early life conditions shape later life outcomes, including health and migration events. However, analyses of geographic disparities in mortality outcomes focus almost exclusively on contemporaneously measured geographic place (e.g., state of residence at death), thereby potentially conflating the role of early life conditions, migration patterns, and effects of destinations. We use the newly available Mortality Disparities in American Communities (MDAC) dataset, which links respondents in the 2008 ACS to official death records and estimate consequential differences by method of aggregation; the mean absolute deviation of the difference in life expectancy at age 50 measured by state of birth versus state of residence is 0.58 (0.50) years for men and 0.40 (0.29) years for women. These differences are also spatially clustered, and we show that regional inequality in life expectancy is higher based on life expectancies by state of birth, implying that interstate migration mitigates baseline geographical inequality in mortality outcomes. Finally, we assess how state-specific features of in-migration, out-migration, and non-migration together shape measures of mortality disparities by state (of residence), further demonstrating the difficulty of clearly interpreting these widely used measures.

10.3386/w30572.abstractZh: 大量文献表明，早年生活条件会影响后期的生活结果，包括健康状况和迁移行为。然而，对死亡率差异的地理分析几乎完全集中在同时测量的地理位置上（例如，死亡时的居住州），这可能会混淆早年生活条件、迁移模式以及目的地影响的作用。我们使用了新近可用的《美国社区死亡率差异》数据集，该数据集将2008年美国人口普查局的受访者与官方死亡记录进行关联，并通过不同的聚合方法估算差异；结果显示，50岁时预期寿命的差异中，按出生州与居住州相比，男性为0.58（0.50）年，女性为0.40（0.29）年。这些差异在空间上也是聚集的，我们发现，基于出生州的预期寿命，地区间的不平等程度更高，这表明跨州迁移有助于缓解死亡率结果的地理不平等。最后，我们评估了州内移民、移民和非移民行为如何共同影响按居住州划分的死亡率差异，进一步表明这些被广泛使用的衡量指标存在难以清晰解释的问题。

abstract.text: This article examines the consequences and causes of low enrollment of Black patients in clinical trials. We develop a simple model of similarity-based extrapolation that predicts that evidence is more relevant for decision-making by physicians and patients when it is more representative of the group that is being treated. This generates the key result that the perceived benefit of a medicine for a group depends not only on the average benefit from a trial, but also on the share of patients from that group who were enrolled in the trial. In survey experiments, we find that physicians who care for Black patients are more willing to prescribe drugs tested in representative samples, an effect substantial enough to close observed gaps in the prescribing rates of new medicines. Black patients update more on drug efficacy when the sample that the drug is tested on is more representative, reducing Black-White patient gaps in beliefs about whether the drug will work as described. Despite these benefits of representative data, our framework and evidence suggest that those who have benefited more from past medical breakthroughs are less costly to enroll in the present, leading to persistence in who is represented in the evidence base.

10.3386/w30575.abstractZh: 本文探讨了黑人患者在临床试验中参与率较低的原因和后果。我们建立了一个基于相似性的简单模型，预测当证据更能代表所治疗群体时，医生和患者的决策会更加依赖这些证据。这一模型得出的关键结论是，一种药物对某群体的实际疗效不仅取决于试验的平均疗效，还取决于该群体中有多少患者参与了试验。在调查实验中，我们发现照顾黑人患者的医生更愿意开在具有代表性的样本中进行测试的药物，这种效应足以缩小新药物处方率的差距。当药物测试的样本更具代表性时，黑人患者对于药物疗效的了解也会更加充分，从而缩小了关于药物是否如预期那样有效的信念上的差距。尽管代表性数据带来了这些好处，但我们的模型和证据表明，那些从过去的医学突破中获益更多的人，在当前的临床试验中参与的成本更低，这导致在证据基础中代表的人群持续保持不变。

abstract.text: Following decades of increasing child access to public health insurance, pre-pandemic enrollments fell in many states after 2016 and the number of uninsured children increased. This study provides the first national, quantitative assessment of the role of administrative burdens in driving this drop in child health insurance coverage. In addition, we identify the demographic groups of children who were most affected. We show that regulations that increased administrative burdens placed on families reduced public health insurance coverage by a mean of 5.9% within six months following the implementation of these changes. Declines were largest for Hispanic children, children with non-citizen parents, and children whose parents reported that they did not speak English well. These reductions were separate from and in addition to enrollment declines among Hispanic children following the announcement of a new public charge rule in Sept. 2018.

10.3386/w30580.abstractZh: 在数十年来儿童获得公共健康保险的机会不断增加之后，疫情前的参保人数在2016年后在许多州有所下降，无保险的儿童数量也有所增加。本研究首次进行了全国性的定量评估，探讨行政负担在导致儿童健康保险覆盖率下降中的作用。此外，我们还确定了受影响最严重的儿童群体。研究表明，增加家庭行政负担的法规在实施这些变更后的六个月内，使公共健康保险覆盖率平均减少了5.9%。西班牙裔儿童、非公民父母的孩子以及父母报告英语水平不佳的儿童，其保险覆盖率下降幅度最大。这些下降与2018年9月新公共负担规则公布后西班牙裔儿童参保人数下降的情况不同，且是独立于该现象发生的。

abstract.text: We investigate whether Donald Trump's "Chinese Virus" tweets contributed to the rise of anti-Asian incidents. We find that the number of incidents spiked following Trump’s initial “Chinese Virus” tweets and the subsequent dramatic rise in internet search activity for the phrase. Difference-in-differences and event-study analyses leveraging spatial variation indicate that this spike in anti-Asian incidents was significantly more pronounced in counties that supported Donald Trump in the 2016 presidential election relative to those that supported Hillary Clinton. We estimate that anti-Asian incidents spiked by 4000 percent in Trump-supporting counties, over and above the spike observed in Clinton-supporting counties.

10.3386/w30588.abstractZh: 我们调查了唐纳德·特朗普的“中国病毒”推文是否促成了反亚裔事件的增多。研究发现，在特朗普首次发布“中国病毒”推文后，反亚裔事件的数量急剧上升，同时相关短语的互联网搜索量也显著增加。通过差异-差异分析和事件研究分析，结合空间差异因素，我们发现，在2016年总统选举中支持特朗普的县，反亚裔事件的增加幅度明显高于支持希拉里·克林顿的县。我们估计，在支持特朗普的县，反亚裔事件的数量增加了4000%，这一增长超过了在支持希拉里·克林顿的县所观察到的增长幅度。

abstract.text: We review the literature on financial intermediation in the process by which new medical therapeutics are financed, developed, and delivered. We discuss the contributing factors that lead to a key finding in the literature—underinvestment in biomedical R&D—and focus on the role that banks and other intermediaries can play in financing biomedical R&D and potentially closing this funding gap. We conclude with a discussion of the role of financial intermediation in the delivery of healthcare to patients.

10.3386/w30594.abstractZh: 我们回顾了关于金融中介在资助、开发及提供新型医疗疗法过程中的相关文献。我们讨论了导致文献中一个关键发现——生物医学研发投资不足的因素，并重点关注银行及其他中介机构在资助生物医学研发方面可以发挥的作用，以及它们如何可能弥补这一资金缺口。最后，我们讨论了金融中介在为患者提供医疗服务中的作用。

abstract.text: We examine differences in the prescribing of psychiatric medications to low-income and higher-income children in the Canadian province of Ontario using rich administrative data that includes diagnosis codes and physician identifiers. Our most striking finding is that conditional on diagnosis and medical history, low-income children are more likely to be prescribed antipsychotics and benzodiazepines than higher-income children who see the same doctors. These are drugs with potentially dangerous side effects that ideally should be prescribed to children only under narrowly proscribed circumstances. Low-income children are also less likely to be prescribed SSRIs, the first-line treatment for depression and anxiety conditional on diagnosis. Hence, socioeconomic differences in the prescribing of psychotropic medications to children persist even in the context of universal public health insurance and universal drug coverage.

10.3386/w30595.abstractZh: 我们研究了加拿大安大略省低收入和高收入儿童在精神药物处方上的差异，使用的是包含诊断代码和医生识别信息的丰富行政数据。我们发现，在相同的诊断和病史条件下，低收入儿童被开具抗精神病药和苯二氮卓类药物的可能性高于同样看同一位医生的高收入儿童。这些药物可能存在危险的副作用，理想情况下只应在严格规定的条件下才应用于儿童。此外，在相同的诊断条件下，低收入儿童被开具SSRIs的可能性也较低，而SSRIs是治疗和缓解抑郁和焦虑症状的一线药物。因此，即使在全民公共健康保险和全民药物覆盖的背景下，儿童精神药物处方的社会经济差异仍然存在。

abstract.text: Much of the increase in the prevalence of overweight and obesity has been in developing countries with a history of famines and malnutrition. Prior research has pointed to the association between overweight and famine exposure during developmental ages as one of several explanations and has hypothesized that ancestral famine exposure may play a role. Data limitations have prevented researchers from investigating the multigenerational effects of famine shocks on descendant overweight. This paper examines overweight among adult grandsons of grandfathers exposed to starvation during developmental ages. I study grandsons born to grandfathers who served in the Union Army during the US Civil War (1861-5) where some grandfathers experienced severe net malnutrition because they were POWs during times of extreme hardship. I find that male-line but not female-line grandsons of grandfathers who experienced a severe captivity during their growing years faced a 21% increase in mean overweight and a 2% increase in mean BMI compared to grandsons of non-POWs. This increase was mediated by fathers’ and to a lesser extent own in-utero conditions, as proxied by season of birth, suggesting a dynamic process of inheritance. Male-line grandsons descended from grandfathers who experienced a harsh captivity faced a 22-28% greater risk of dying every year after age 45 relative to grandsons descended from non-POWs, with overweight accounting for 9-14% of the excess risk.

10.3386/w30599.abstractZh: 超重和肥胖的患病率增加主要发生在那些有饥荒和营养不良历史的发展中国家。先前的研究指出，发育阶段遭遇饥荒与超重之间存在关联，并假设祖先经历的饥荒可能起到了作用。但由于数据限制，研究人员无法研究饥荒冲击对后代超重的影响。本文研究了在发育阶段遭遇饥饿的祖父的成年孙子们的超重情况。我研究了在美南北战争期间（1861-5年）服役的祖父所生的孙子们，其中一些祖父因在极端困难时期作为战俘而遭受了严重的净营养不良。我发现，在成长过程中遭遇严重囚禁的祖父所生的男性孙子们的超重率比非战俘祖父所生的孙子们高出21%，BMI则高出2%。这种增加受到父亲状况的影响，而在较小程度上也受到自身在子宫内的状况影响，这可以通过出生季节来间接反映，这表明了一种动态的遗传过程。在成长过程中遭遇严重囚禁的祖父所生的男性孙子们，在45岁以后每年死亡的风险比非战俘祖父所生的孙子们高出22-28%，而超重则占这种额外风险的9-14%。

abstract.text: A long-standing economic question is how protection against harm from insurance or other harm reducing interventions leads to potentially offsetting behavior changes (ex-ante moral hazard). Immunization is a type of insurance, as individuals incur an upfront cost when they get vaccinated, but it protects individuals if they are exposed to a vaccine preventable disease. In this study, we empirically evaluate the ex-ante moral hazard effects of COVID-19 vaccines. First, exploiting the discontinuity in vaccination rates at age 65 due to early eligibility of older population, we compared vaccination rates and risk mitigation behavior between those just above and just below 65 years of age. We find no evidence of decrease in risk mitigating behavior among the 65 years old and older population. Second, leveraging state-level variation in the timing of when people in different age groups became eligible for vaccination, we estimate that COVID-19 vaccination has no effect on risk mitigating behaviors in adult population. Our findings imply minimal moral hazard effects of COVID-19 vaccines in the short-term.

10.3386/w30602.abstractZh: 一个长期存在的经济问题是：通过保险或其他减少伤害的措施来防范伤害，是否会引发可能相互抵消的行为变化（即事前道德风险）。免疫接种是一种保险形式，因为个人在接种疫苗时会付出前期成本，但如果他们感染了可通过疫苗预防的疾病，这种疫苗还能为他们提供保护。在这项研究中，我们实证评估了COVID-19疫苗的事前道德风险效应。首先，由于老年人群较早获得接种资格，我们在65岁人群附近的年龄段比较了疫苗接种率与风险缓解行为。我们发现，65岁及以上人群的风险缓解行为并未减少。其次，通过利用不同年龄段人群获得接种资格的时间差异，我们估计COVID-19疫苗接种对成人群体的风险缓解行为没有影响。我们的研究结果表明，COVID-19疫苗在短期内产生的道德风险效应很小。

abstract.text: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming production across all sectors of the economy, with the potential to both complement and substitute for traditional labor inputs. Healthcare is no exception. Dozens of recent academic studies demonstrate that AI can contribute to the healthcare value chain, by improving both diagnostic accuracy and treatment recommendations. In these ways, AI may wither complement or substitute for physicians. We argue that AI represents the culmination of decades of efforts to enhance medical decision making. Using an historical lens that considers long-standing institutional features of healthcare markets, we identify numerous obstacles to the implementation of AI in medical care, and identify which specialties are most at risk for substitution by AI.

10.3386/w30607.abstractZh: 人工智能正在改变经济各个领域的生产方式，具有补充和替代传统劳动力投入的潜力。医疗保健行业也不例外。数十项最新学术研究表明，人工智能可以通过提高诊断准确性和治疗建议来为医疗保健价值链做出贡献。在这方面，人工智能可能会补充或替代医生的工作。我们认为，人工智能代表了数十年来提升医疗决策能力的努力的成果。通过从历史的角度审视医疗保健市场的长期制度特征，我们发现了人工智能在医疗领域应用中的诸多障碍，并指出了哪些专业领域最有可能被人工智能所替代。

abstract.text: This paper studies the productivity of nurse practitioners (NPs) and physicians, two professions performing overlapping tasks but with starkly different backgrounds, training, and pay. Using quasi-experimental variation in patient assignment to NPs versus physicians in Veterans Health Administration emergency departments, we find that, on average, NPs use more resources and exhibit a higher 30-day preventable hospitalization rate than physicians. However, the NP-physician performance difference varies by case complexity and severity. Importantly, even larger productivity variation exists within each profession, leading to substantial overlap between the productivity distributions of the two professions; NPs outperform physicians in 38 percent of random pairs.

10.3386/w30608.abstractZh: 本文研究了护士执业者（NPs）和医生这两种从事相似任务但背景、培训及薪酬差异显著的职业的生产力情况。通过 Veterans Health Administration 急诊部门对患者分配使用护士与医生的准实验性研究，我们发现平均而言，护士使用更多的资源，并且30天可预防的住院率高于医生。然而，护士与医生之间的生产力差异因病例复杂性和严重程度的不同而有所变化。重要的是，每个职业内部也存在更大的生产力差异，导致两个职业的生产力分布存在显著重叠；在38%的随机配对中，护士的表现优于医生。

abstract.text: Increases in youth vaping rates and concerns of a new generation of nicotine addicts recently prompted an increase in the federal minimum legal purchase age (MLPA) for tobacco products, including e-cigarettes, to 21 years. This study presents the first regression discontinuity evidence on the effectiveness of e-cigarette MLPA laws. Using data on 12th graders from Monitoring the Future, we obtain robust evidence that federal and state age-18 MLPAs decreased underage e-cigarette use by 15–20% and frequent use by 20–40%. These findings suggest that the age-21 federal MLPA could meaningfully reduce e-cigarette use among 18–20-year-olds.

10.3386/w30614.abstractZh: 青少年使用电子烟的比例上升，以及新一代尼古丁成瘾者的出现，促使联邦对包括电子香烟在内的烟草产品的法定购买年龄提高至21岁。本研究首次通过回归 discontinuity 方法探讨了电子烟法定购买年龄政策的有效性。根据《未来监测》对12年级学生的数据，我们发现联邦和州规定的18岁法定购买年龄政策使未成年人使用电子烟的比例减少了15-20%，频繁使用电子烟的比例减少了20-40%。这些发现表明，21岁的联邦法定购买年龄政策能够显著减少18-20岁青少年使用电子烟的行为。

abstract.text: Medicare has increased the use of performance pay incentives for hospitals, with the goal of increasing care coordination across providers, reducing market frictions, and ultimately to improve quality of care. This paper provides new empirical evidence by using novel operations and claims data from a large, independent home health care firm with the Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program (HRRP) penalty on hospitals providing identifying variation. We find that the penalty incentive to reduce re-hospitalizations passed through from hospitals to the firm at least for some types of patients, since it provided more care inputs for heart disease patients discharged from hospitals at greater penalty risk and that contributed more patients to the firm. This evidence suggests that HRRP helped increase coordination between hospitals and home health firms without formal integration. Greater home health effort does not appear to have led to lower patient readmissions.

10.3386/w30615.abstractZh: Medicare增加了对医院的绩效奖励措施的使用，目的是提高各提供方之间的护理协调，减少市场摩擦，最终提升护理质量。本文通过一家大型独立家庭健康护理公司的新型运营和索赔数据，提供了新的实证证据。该公司在医院再住院率降低计划中有惩罚措施，旨在减少医院之间的差异。我们发现，这种惩罚激励措施至少对某些类型的患者有效，因为它为那些面临更高惩罚风险的心脏病患者提供了更多的护理支持，并且这些患者也更多地为该公司带来了患者资源。这些证据表明，HRRP有助于在没有正式整合的情况下，提高医院与家庭健康护理公司之间的协调。然而，更多的家庭健康护理努力似乎并没有导致患者再住院率的降低。

abstract.text: COVID-19 vaccines are widely available in wealthy countries, yet many people remain unvaccinated. Understanding the effectiveness -- or lack thereof -- of popular vaccination campaign strategies is therefore critical. In this paper, we report results from two studies that tested strategies central to current vaccination outreach: (1) direct communication by health professionals addressing questions about vaccination and (2) efforts to motivate individuals to promote vaccination within their social networks. Near the peak of the Omicron wave, doctor- and nurse-produced videos were disseminated to 17.8 million Facebook users in the US and 11.5 million in France. In both countries, we cannot reject the null of no effect of any of the interventions on any of the outcome variables (first doses - US and France, second doses and boosters - US). We can reject very small effects on first doses during the interventions in both countries (0.16pp - US, 0.021pp - France). In contrast with similar campaigns earlier in the pandemic to encourage health-preserving behaviors, messaging at this stage of the pandemic -- whether aimed at the unvaccinated or those tasked with encouraging others -- did not change vaccination decisions.

10.3386/w30618.abstractZh: 在富裕国家，COVID-19疫苗已经广泛普及，但仍有许多人未接种疫苗。因此，了解当前疫苗接种推广策略的有效性或无效性至关重要。本文报告了两项研究的结果，这两项研究测试了当前疫苗接种推广的核心策略：(1) 由卫生专业人员直接沟通，解答有关疫苗接种的问题；(2) 努力激励个人在其社交网络中推广疫苗接种。在奥密克戎疫情高峰期间，由医生和护士制作的视频被传播给美国的1780万用户和法国的1150万用户。在这两个国家，我们无法拒绝任何干预措施对结果变量无影响的零假设（美国和法国的第一剂接种、美国的第二剂接种和加强剂接种）。在这两个国家，我们可以拒绝第一剂接种方面非常小的效果（美国为0.16个百分点，法国为0.021个百分点）。与疫情早期旨在鼓励健康行为的类似活动相比，在疫情这一阶段的消息传递——无论针对未接种疫苗的人还是负责鼓励他人的人——并没有改变人们的疫苗接种决定。

abstract.text: We derive the optimal funding mechanism to incentivize development and production of vaccines against diseases with epidemic potential. In the model, suppliers' costs are private information and investments are noncontractible, precluding cost-reimbursement contracts, requiring fixed-price contracts conditioned on delivery of a successful product. The high failure risk for individual vaccines calls for incentivizing multiple entrants, accomplished by the optimal mechanism, a (w+1)-price reverse Vickrey auction with reserve. Our analysis determines the optimal number of entrants and required funding level. Based on a distribution of supplier costs estimated from survey data, we simulate the optimal mechanism's performance in scenarios ranging from a small outbreak, causing harm in the millions of dollars, to the Covid-19 pandemic, causing harm in the trillions. We assess which mechanism features contribute most to its optimality.

10.3386/w30619.abstractZh: 我们推导出了激励疫苗开发和生产的最佳融资机制，以应对具有流行风险的疾病。在模型中，供应商的成本是私人信息，且投资不可协商，这排除了成本补偿合同的可能性，因此需要使用基于成功产品交付的固定价格合同。由于个别疫苗的高失败风险，需要激励多个参与者，而这一机制是通过一个带有储备的(w+1)价格反向Vickrey拍卖来实现的。我们的分析确定了最佳参与者的数量和所需的融资水平。基于从调查数据中估算出的供应商成本分布，我们模拟了该机制在从小规模疫情（造成数百万美元的损失）到新冠疫情（造成数万亿美元的损失）等各种情景下的表现。我们评估了哪些机制特征对其最优性贡献最大。

abstract.text: As millions of soldiers deployed to Iraq or Afghanistan between 2001 and 2021, Veteran Affairs Disability Compensation payments quadrupled and the veteran suicide rate rose rapidly. We estimate causal effects of combat deployments on soldiers’ well-being. To eliminate non-random selection into deployment, we leverage quasi-random assignment of newly recruited soldiers to units on staggered deployment cycles. Deployments increase injuries, combat deaths, and disability compensation, but we find limited evidence that they affect suicide, deaths of despair, financial health, incarceration, or education. More dangerous deployments have similarly limited effects. Our estimates suggest that deployment cannot explain either the recent rise in disability payments, which is more likely driven by policy changes, or the surge in noncombat deaths, which is better explained by shifts in observable characteristics of soldiers.

10.3386/w30622.abstractZh: 在2001年至2021年间，数百万士兵被部署到伊拉克或阿富汗。在此期间，退伍军人事务部发放的残疾补偿金增加了四倍，而退伍军人自杀率也迅速上升。我们估算了战斗部署对士兵福祉的因果效应。为了排除非随机性选择对部署的影响，我们采用准随机分配的方式，将新招募的士兵分配到不同部署周期中的不同部队。部署确实增加了受伤、战斗死亡和残疾补偿的情况，但我们发现这些因素对自杀、绝望死亡、财务状况、监禁或教育的影响有限。更危险的部署情况也显示出类似有限的影响。我们的估计表明，部署并不能解释最近残疾补偿金的增加，这更可能是由于政策变化所致；同样，非战斗死亡的激增也可以更好地用士兵的可观测特征变化来解释。

abstract.text: We conduct the first-ever large-scale study of the relationship between air pollution and suicide using detailed cause of death data from all death certificates in the U.S. between 2003 and 2010. Using wind direction as an instrument for daily pollution exposure, we find that a 1 μg/m3 increase in daily PM2.5 is associated with a 0.49% increase in daily suicides and 0.171 more suicide-related hospitalizations (a 50% increase). Estimates using 2SLS are larger and more robust, suggesting a bias towards zero arising from measurement error. Event study estimates further illustrate that contemporaneous pollution exposure matters more than exposure to pollution in previous weeks.

10.3386/w30626.abstractZh: 我们进行了首次大规模研究，探讨空气污染与自杀之间的关系，使用了2003年至2010年间美国所有死亡证明中的详细死因数据。通过风向作为每日污染暴露的指标，我们发现，每日PM2.5浓度每增加1微克/立方米，每日自杀率会增加0.49%，自杀相关的住院治疗次数也会增加0.171次（即增加50%）。使用2SLS方法得出的估计结果更为可靠，表明由于测量误差的存在，存在向零倾斜的偏差。事件研究的结果进一步表明，与之前几周的污染暴露相比，当前的污染暴露更为重要。

abstract.text: This paper introduces a newly digitized, open-access version of the Food and Drug Administration’s “Orange Book”—a linkage between approved small-molecule drugs and the patents that protect them. The Orange Book also reports any applicable regulatory exclusivity that prevents competitive entry. We summarize the Orange Book’s coverage and discuss the opportunities and challenges associated with using these data for research. Empirical validations against various administrative datasets suggest that Orange Book records are, largely, complete and accurate. We conclude with a specific use case—calculating legal exclusivity periods for drugs—to highlight the types of choices that researchers must make when using this resource.

10.3386/w30628.abstractZh: 本文介绍了食品药品监督管理局新推出的数字化、开放获取版本的“橙皮书”——该文件将批准的小分子药物与其所保护的专利进行关联。橙皮书还记录了任何适用的监管独占权，这些独占权会阻碍竞争进入市场。我们总结了橙皮书的覆盖范围，并讨论了利用这些数据进行研究所面临的机遇与挑战。针对各种行政数据集进行的实证验证表明，橙皮书的记录在大部分情况下是完整且准确的。最后，我们通过一个具体案例——计算药物的法律独占期——来强调研究人员在使用这一资源时必须做出的选择。

abstract.text: In 2015, for the first time in nearly forty years, the rate of motor vehicle fatalities for Black Americans exceeded that of white Americans. By 2020, the gap in death rates stood at 34%, accounting for approximately 4,000 excess deaths between 2014 and 2020. This disproportionate increase occurred in nearly all states, in rural as well as urban areas, and was shared by drivers of all ages and genders. We consider a variety of potential explanations for the emerging race gap including race-specific changes in time spent driving, the circumstances of driving, the quality of medical care for crash victims, decreases in other types of mortality, changes in policing, and risky driving behaviors such as speeding, driving without a seat belt and driving while intoxicated. We can rule out many of these factors as important contributors to the race gap, but find evidence for two of them. The first is opportunity: Relative to white Americans, Black Americans are spending more time in vehicles than they have in the past. Changes in time spent driving, while modest, likely explain an important share of the emergent race gap. The second is a relative increase in drug use, manifested by a quadrupling of the rate of overdose deaths among Black Americans after 2014. Increased drug use appears to have resulted in a concomitant increase in fatal crashes involving drivers under the influence of drugs. Finally, we consider whether the emerging race gap is explained by the so-called "Ferguson effect," the idea that police officers have pulled back from enforcement activity in recent years. On the one hand, traffic stops made by police officers do appear to have declined after 2014. However, the decline in traffic stops does not appear to be race-specific and there is little evidence of a broad increase in risky driving behaviors like speeding and driving without a seat belt.

10.3386/w30636.abstractZh: 2015年，近四十年以来首次出现黑人美国人的机动车死亡人数超过白人美国人的情况。到2020年，死亡率差距达到了34%，2014年至2020年间，黑人美国人因此多死了约4,000人。这种不成比例的增势几乎出现在所有州，无论是农村还是城市地区，且所有年龄和性别的驾驶员都受到影响。我们考虑了多种可能解释这一种族差距的因素，包括驾驶时间的差异、驾驶环境、事故受害者的医疗护理质量、其他类型死亡率的下降、警务措施的变化以及诸如超速驾驶、不系安全带驾驶和酒后驾车等危险驾驶行为。我们可以排除许多这些因素作为种族差距的重要成因，但发现了其中两个因素的证据。第一个是机会：与白人美国人相比，黑人美国人花费在车辆上的时间比过去更多。虽然驾驶时间的增加幅度不大，但很可能解释了种族差距的一个重要部分。第二个因素是药物使用的相对增加，表现为2014年后黑人美国人药物过量死亡的比例增加了四倍。药物使用的增加似乎导致了药物影响下驾驶员的致命事故数量的增加。最后，我们考虑了所谓的“弗格森效应”是否解释了这一种族差距，即近年来警察的执法活动有所减少。一方面，警察进行的交通拦截确实在2014年后有所减少。然而，交通中断的减少似乎并非特定于某一种族，也没有证据表明诸如超速行驶和不系安全带等危险驾驶行为有普遍增加。

abstract.text: For those who follow health and technology news, it is difficult to go more than a few days without reading about a compelling new application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to health care. AI has myriad applications in medicine and its adjacent industries, with AI-driven tools already in use in basic science, translational medicine, and numerous corners of health care delivery, including administrative work, diagnosis, and treatment. In diagnosis and treatment, a large and growing number of AI tools meet the statutory definition of a medical device or that of an in-vitro diagnostic. Those that do are subject to regulation by local authorities, resulting in both practical and strategic implications for manufacturers, along with a more complex set of innovation incentives. This chapter presents background on medical device regulation—especially as it relates to software products—and quantitatively describes the emergence of AI among FDA-regulated products. The empirical section of this chapter explores characteristics of AI-supported/driven medical devices (“AI devices”) in the United States. It presents data on their origins (by firm type and country), their safety profiles (as measured by associated adverse events and recalls), and concludes with a discussion of the implications of regulation for innovation incentives in medical AI.

10.3386/w30639.abstractZh: 对于关注健康与科技新闻的人士来说，很难连续几天不读到关于人工智能在医疗保健领域的新应用报道。人工智能在医学及其相关行业中有着广泛的应用，由人工智能驱动的工具已经应用于基础科学、转化医学以及医疗保健服务的多个环节，包括行政工作、诊断和治疗等。在诊断和治疗方面，越来越多的人工智能工具符合医疗器械或体外诊断设备的法定定义。这些工具需要接受当地当局的监管，这对制造商来说既具有实际意义，也带来了战略上的影响，同时还需要应对更为复杂的创新激励措施。本章介绍了医疗器械监管的相关背景，特别是与软件产品相关的监管内容，并定量描述了人工智能在FDA监管产品中的出现情况。本章的实证部分探讨了美国人工智能支持/驱动的医疗设备的特点，提供了关于这些设备的来源（按公司和国家分类）、安全性数据（通过相关不良事件和召回事件来衡量）的信息，最后讨论了监管对医疗人工智能创新激励措施的影响。

abstract.text: Using newly digitized U.S. city-level data on hospitals, we explore how pandemics alter preferences for healthcare.
