We find that cities with higher levels of mortality during the Great Influenza of 1918-1919 subsequently expanded hospital capacity by more than cities experiencing less influenza mortality: cities in the top half of the mortality distribution increased their count of hospitals by 8-10 percent in the years after the pandemic. This effect persisted to 1960 and was driven by increases in non-governmental hospitals. Growth responded most in richer cities, exacerbating existing inequalities in access to healthcare. We do not find evidence that government-run hospitals or other types of city-level spending related to healthcare responded to pandemic intensity, suggesting that large health shocks do not necessarily lead to increased public provision of health services.

10.3386/w30643.abstractZh: 我们利用新数字化后的美国城市级医院数据，探讨了大流行病如何改变人们对医疗保健的偏好。研究发现，在1918-1919年大流感期间，死亡率较高的城市在疫情过后增加了医院数量，其增幅超过那些流感死亡率较低的城市：在死亡率分布的前半部分，这些城市的医院数量在疫情后的几年内增加了8-10%。这种效应一直持续到1960年，并且主要是由非政府医院的扩张所推动的。这种增长在富裕城市中最为明显，进一步加剧了医疗保健获取方面的现有不平等现象。我们没有发现政府运营的医院或其他类型的城市级医疗保健支出对大流行病强度有反应，这表明大规模的健康冲击并不一定会导致公共医疗保健服务的增加。

abstract.text: We use linked survey and administrative data to document and decompose the striking differences across demographic groups in both economic and health impacts of the first year of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States. The impacts of the pandemic on all-cause mortality and on employment were concentrated in the same racial, ethnic, and education groups, with non-White individuals and those without a college degree experiencing higher excess all-cause mortality as well as a greater employment loss. Observable differences in living arrangements and the nature of work – which likely affected exposure to the virus and to economic contractions – can explain 15 percent of the Hispanic-White difference in excess mortality, almost one-quarter of the non- Hispanic Black-White difference, and almost half of the difference between those with and without a Bachelor’s degree; they can also explain 35 to 40 percent of the differences in economic damages between these groups. These findings underscore the importance of non-medical factors in contributing to the disparate impacts of public health shocks.

10.3386/w30658.abstractZh: 我们利用关联的调查数据和行政数据，来记录和分解美国COVID-19大流行第一年对经济和健康影响的显著差异，这些差异在不同人口群体间存在。大流行对全因死亡率和就业的影响主要集中在相同的种族、民族和教育水平群体上，非白人个体以及没有大学学位的人经历了更高的全因死亡率和更大的就业损失。可观察到的居住安排和工作性质的差异——这些差异可能影响了病毒暴露和经济衰退的风险——可以解释西班牙裔与白人之间超额死亡率差异的15%，非西班牙裔黑人与白人之间差异的近四分之一，以及拥有学士学位与没有学士学位的人之间差异的近一半；这些差异还可以解释这些群体之间经济损失差异的35%到40%。这些发现强调了非医学因素在导致公共卫生冲击不同影响方面的重要性。

abstract.text: We explore how access to modern hospitals and medicine affects mortality by leveraging efforts of The Duke Endowment to modernize hospitals in the early-twentieth century. The Endowment helped communities build and expand hospitals, obtain state-of-the-art medical technology, attract qualified medical personnel, and refine management practices. We find that Duke support increased the size and quality of the medical sector, fostering growth in not-for-profit hospitals and high-quality physicians. Duke funding reduced both infant mortality - with larger effects for Black infants than White infants - and long-run mortality. Finally, we find that communities aided by Duke benefited more from medical innovations.

10.3386/w30663.abstractZh: 我们探讨了获得现代医院和医疗服务的机会如何影响死亡率，通过利用杜克捐赠基金在20世纪初对医院进行现代化改造的举措来实现这一目标。该基金帮助社区建设并扩展医院，获取最先进的医疗技术，吸引合格的医疗人员，并改进管理实践。我们发现，杜克捐赠基金的支持增加了医疗领域的规模和质量，促进了非营利性医院和高质量医生的增长。杜克的资金减少了婴儿死亡率——对黑人婴儿的影响比对白人婴儿更大——同时也降低了长期死亡率。最后，我们发现，受益于杜克捐赠基金的社区从医疗创新中获益更多。

abstract.text: Medical technologies can target care to patients identified through screening, raising questions of how broadly to screen for potential use. We explore this empirically in the context of a non-invasive prenatal screening, cfDNA, which is used to target a more costly invasive test that elevates miscarriage risk. Using Swedish administrative data on prenatal choices for pregnancies conceived between 2011 and 2019 – a period in which Swedish regions began providing coverage for the new screening – we document that coverage of cfDNA substantially increases cfDNA screening and reduces invasive testing. To assess the impact of counterfactual targeting of cfDNA coverage, we develop and estimate a stylized model of prenatal choices. We find that narrow targeting of cfDNA coverage can improve outcomes and reduce costs, while broader coverage also improves outcomes but with increased costs. These findings point to the potential gains from well-designed targeting of screening, but at the same time highlight the importance of the targeting design.

10.3386/w30669.abstractZh: 医疗技术可以针对通过筛查确定的患者提供护理，但这引发了关于筛查范围应如何确定的问题。我们在非侵入性产前筛查——cfDNA筛查的背景下对此进行了实证研究。cfDNA筛查旨在替代成本更高的侵入性检查，后者会增加流产的风险。利用瑞典2011至2019年间怀孕的产前选择相关行政数据，我们发现cfDNA筛查的覆盖率显著提高，同时减少了侵入性检查的需求。为了评估针对cfDNA筛查覆盖率的反事实影响，我们建立并估计了一个简化的产前选择模型。研究发现，有针对性地扩大cfDNA筛查的覆盖率可以改善结果并降低成本，而更广泛的筛查覆盖虽然也能改善结果，但会增加成本。这些发现表明，精心设计的筛查目标设计能够带来潜在收益，但同时也强调了目标设计的重要性。

abstract.text: Teenage drinking is a major public health concern, generating social costs of over $28 billion per year, including substantial external costs associated with alcohol-related traffic fatalities. At the same time, the high rate of electronic nicotine delivery systems (ENDS) use among teenagers has been deemed “an epidemic” by the U.S. Surgeon General, with state and local policymakers turning to e-cigarette taxes as a popular policy tool to curb nicotine vaping. This study is the first to explore the spillover effects of e-cigarette taxes on teenage drinking and alcohol-related traffic fatalities. We find that a one-dollar increase in e-cigarette taxes is associated with a 1 to 2 percentage-point reduction in the probability of binge drinking among teenagers and a 5 to 10 percent reduction in traffic fatalities involving teenagers driving under the influence of alcohol. Together, these results suggest the presence of alcohol-related health benefits from e-cigarette taxation.

10.3386/w30670.abstractZh: 青少年饮酒是一个重大的公共卫生问题，每年造成的社会成本超过280亿美元，其中包括与酒精相关的交通事故死亡所带来的巨大外部成本。与此同时，美国卫生局局长将青少年使用电子尼古丁输送系统的高比例视为“一种流行病”，各州和地方政府也将电子烟税作为遏制尼古丁吸入的常用政策工具。本研究首次探讨了电子烟税对青少年饮酒和酒精相关交通事故死亡的影响。我们发现，电子烟税增加1美元，青少年酗酒的概率会下降1到2个百分点，涉及青少年酒后驾驶的交通事故死亡人数则会减少5到10%。这些结果共同表明，对电子烟征税能够带来与酒精相关的健康益处。

abstract.text: Exploiting a natural experiment and an innovative survey design, we study the causal impact of armed conflict exposure (ACE) on the sociopolitical attitudes and behaviors of the average male randomly picked from the population. Contrary to the arguments that war fosters cooperation, we find little evidence of social or political participation in exposed individuals. Instead, we document compelling evidence that ACE promotes opposition to peaceful means of conflict resolution, animosity towards minorities, and adherence to right-wing ideology. Further analyses show war-driven grievances, the normalization of violence in everyday life, and changes in conservative norms and preferences as the transmitting pathways.

10.3386/w30674.abstractZh: 通过利用一项自然实验和创新的调查设计，我们研究了武装冲突暴露对从人群中随机选取的普通男性社会政治态度与行为的影响。与认为战争促进合作的论点相反，我们发现暴露于武装冲突的个体在社交或政治参与方面几乎没有表现出积极迹象。相反，我们发现武装冲突暴露确实促进了对和平冲突解决方式的反对、对少数群体的敌意，以及右翼意识形态的认同。进一步的分析表明，战争引发的不满、日常生活中暴力行为的常态化，以及保守主义规范和偏好方面的变化，都是导致这些影响的传递途径。

abstract.text: Understanding cognitive health, its decline, and the investments that shape its age profile in later life are important in an aging society, and yet, estimating the cognitive health production function is complicated by non-random mortality and sample attrition. I study this dynamic selection problem in the context of education, race, and cigarette smoking, characteristics thought to affect the level, but not slope, of cognitive decline. I develop a general framework that involves estimation of a system of dynamic equations consistent with the Grossman (1972) model. Exploiting exciting longitudinal data from the National Health and Aging Trends Study (NHATS), I find substantially wider gaps in cognitive health by these characteristics relative to cross-sectional comparisons, in some cases by 100%. Furthermore, these gaps grow in age, which suggests that the bias generated by dynamic selection is not constant. The implication of these results is that theories of cognitive decline need to accommodate differential rates of change -- rather than just differences in levels -- in cognitive health by education and race. Connecting theory and empirical work offers an important tool for economists studying health investment and health in older populations.

10.3386/w30679.abstractZh: 在老龄化社会中，了解认知健康、其衰退以及影响晚年认知健康特征的投资因素具有重要意义。然而，由于非随机的死亡率和样本流失，估计认知健康的生成函数变得复杂。我在教育、种族和吸烟等特征背景下研究这一动态选择问题，这些特征被认为会影响认知衰退的水平，而非斜率。我开发了一个通用框架，该框架涉及对与Grossman（1972年）模型一致的动态方程系统进行估计。利用美国国家健康与老龄化趋势研究提供的令人兴奋的纵向数据，我发现这些特征导致的认知健康差距比横断面比较时更为明显，在某些情况下甚至相差100%。此外，这些差距随着年龄的增长而扩大，这表明动态选择产生的偏差并非恒定不变。这些结果表明，认知衰退的理论需要考虑到变化速率的差异——而不仅仅是教育水平和种族导致的认知健康水平的差异。将理论与实证工作相结合，为研究健康投资及老年人口健康的经济学家提供了重要的工具。

abstract.text: We conducted a large-scale field experiment to calibrate phone messaging to its potential of overcoming behavioral barriers to maternal care uptake in the countryside of a developing country, where a significant share of women forgoes life-saving maternity-related care even when within reach. The high-arching goal of our intervention is to test if and to what extent filling out insufficient domain knowledge (i.e., childbearing-related health literacy) generates responsiveness to nudges for adopting maternal care among the rural poor of Pakistan. We find that informational nudges sent in a random order using the appropriate medium of communication, voice messages, during pregnancy significantly improve care-seeking behaviors, measured by antenatal care, postpartum checkup, and postnatal visits, through improved literacy. Importantly, we document that high-frequency voice calls timed to gestational age substantially increase the efficacy of informational nudges, including boosting facility deliveries, once domain knowledge is built and nudgeability established. Nevertheless, small financial incentives trump the productivity of informational voice calls in both improving health literacy and boosting care uptake, likely due to participants equating the intrinsic value of the intended behavioral change to the size of the monetary reward. These results are scalable to a large number of populations across developing nations.

10.3386/w30680.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项大规模实地实验，旨在评估电话信息传递在克服发展中国家农村地区母亲护理接受行为障碍方面的潜力。在这些地区，相当一部分妇女即使能够获得救命的产科护理，也会选择放弃。我们干预的主要目标是测试：是否以及何种程度上，提供关于生育相关健康知识的信息提示，能够促使巴基斯坦农村贫困群体采取母亲护理行为。研究发现，通过适当的沟通方式（如语音信息）在孕期随机发送信息提示，能够显著改善护理行为，包括产前护理、产后检查和产后随访等。重要的是，我们发现，在建立相关领域知识并确立提示效果后，高频语音通话能够大大提高信息提示的效果，包括促进分娩服务的发展。然而，在提高健康知识水平和促进护理接受方面，较小的经济激励措施更为有效，这可能是因为参与者将预期的行为改变所带来的内在价值与金钱奖励的大小相挂钩。这些结果可以推广到发展中国家的大量人群。

abstract.text: The benefits and costs of resource extraction are currently being hotly debated in the case of unconventional natural gas development (commonly known as “fracking"). Colorado provides a unique research environment to study the health impacts of conventional and unconventional forms of oil and gas development (OGD) given its long history of conventional OGD and recent expansion of unconventional OGD. I utilize detailed vital statistics and the mother's residential address to define proximity to drilling activity. Using a difference-in-differences model that compares mothers residing within 1 km to mothers residing 1 - 5 km of a well (before and during/after drilling), I find that proximity to wells before birth increases adverse birth outcomes and pregnancy-related complications. I find impacts on the extensive and intensive margins and across well types. I also present results suggesting no impacts on fertility or mobility. These results are robust to multiple specifications and suggest that policies to mitigate against the risks of living near OGD may be warranted.

10.3386/w30684.abstractZh: 关于非常规天然气开发（通常称为“压裂”）的资源和开采收益与成本问题，目前正引发激烈讨论。科罗拉多州因其悠久的常规天然气开发历史以及近期非常规天然气开发的扩展，为研究常规和非常规石油天然气开发对健康的影響提供了独特的研究环境。我利用详细的人口统计数据和母亲的居住地址来界定与钻探活动的距离。通过差异-差异模型，比较了居住在井周围1公里内的母亲与居住在井周围1至5公里内的母亲在钻探前后的情况，我发现，出生前与井的距离过近会增加不良出生结果和妊娠相关并发症的风险。我发现这种影响不仅存在于广泛和密集的钻探区域，也存在于不同类型的井中。此外，研究结果还表明，这种影响对生育能力和活动能力没有显著影响。这些结果在多种假设条件下都是稳健的，表明采取政策来减轻居住在天然气开发区域的风险可能是必要的。

abstract.text: We use linked administrative data on the universe of California births to provide novel evidence on economic inequality in infant and maternal health. Infants and mothers at the top of the income distribution have worse birth and morbidity outcomes than their lowest-income counterparts, but are nevertheless the least likely to die in the year following birth. Racial disparities swamp these income disparities, with no racial convergence in health outcomes as income rises. A comparison with Sweden shows that infant and maternal health is worse in California at virtually all income levels.

10.3386/w30693.abstractZh: 我们利用加州出生人口的关联行政数据，为婴儿和母亲健康方面的经济不平等问题提供了新的证据。收入分布最高的婴儿和母亲在出生和发病率方面表现较差，但他们出生后一年内死亡的可能性却最低。种族差异掩盖了收入差异的影响，随着收入的增加，不同种族之间的健康结果并没有趋同。与瑞典的比较表明，在加州，几乎所有收入水平的婴儿和母亲健康状况都较差。

abstract.text: The use of race measures in clinical prediction models and algorithms has become a highly contentious issue, driven by concerns that inclusion of race as a covariate exacerbates and perpetuates long-standing disparities in quality of health care provided to racial and ethnic minority patients. We seek to inform and ground this debate by evaluating the inclusion of race—even if imperfectly measured—in probabilistic predictions of illness that aim to inform clinical decision making. First, adopting a utilitarian framework to formalize social welfare, our analysis reveals that patients of all races are better off when clinical decisions are jointly guided by patient race and other observable covariates. In this sense, race is not a particularly special covariate: any covariate with predictive power (i.e., one that changes conditional probabilities of illness) should be used to optimize clinical decisions. We then extend the model to a two-period setting where prevention activities that address systemic drivers of disease are relevant and find that the same basic conclusions emerge. Finally, we discuss formal non-utilitarian concepts of fairness and disparity-aversion that have been proposed to guide societal allocation of health care resources.

10.3386/w30700.abstractZh: 在临床预测模型和算法中使用种族指标已成为一个极具争议的话题，这一争议源于人们担心将种族作为协变量会加剧并延续长期以来种族和族裔少数群体患者在医疗服务质量方面的不平等现象。我们试图通过评估在旨在指导临床决策的疾病概率预测中是否应包含种族因素——即使这种测量并不完美——来为这一争论提供信息和支持。首先，采用功利主义框架来形式化社会福利，我们的分析表明，当临床决策同时考虑患者的种族和其他可观测的协变量时，所有种族的患者都会受益。从这个意义上说，种族并不是一个特别特殊的协变量：任何具有预测能力的协变量（即能够改变疾病发生条件的协变量）都应该被用来优化临床决策。随后，我们将模型扩展到两期设定中，发现针对疾病系统驱动因素的预防活动是相关的，并且得出相同的基本结论。最后，我们讨论了旨在指导社会医疗资源分配的形式化非功利主义公平和差异厌恶概念。

abstract.text: Regulators of new products confront a tradeoff between speeding a new product to market and collecting additional product quality information. The FDA’s Breakthrough Therapy Designation (BTD) provides an opportunity to understand if a regulator can use new policy to innovate around this tradeoff—i.e., whether it improved regulator productivity by allowing products to come to market more quickly without compromising quality. We find that the BTD program shortened clinical development times by 23 percent and did not impact the ex post safety profile of drugs with the designation. In exploring mechanisms, we find that the BTD program had the greatest impact on less experienced firms and was associated with reduced BTD clinical trial design complexity. The results suggest that targeted regulatory innovation can shorten R&D periods without compromising the quality of new products.

10.3386/w30712.abstractZh: 新产品监管者面临着将新产品快速推向市场与收集更多产品质量信息之间的权衡。美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的突破性疗法认定（BTD）为理解监管者是否可以通过新的政策来应对这一权衡提供了机会——即，是否通过允许产品更快上市而不影响质量来提高监管效率。我们发现，BTD计划将临床开发时间缩短了23%，并且并未影响获得该认定的药物的后期安全性。在探讨其机制时，我们发现BTD计划对经验较少的公司影响最大，并且与BTD临床试验设计的复杂性降低有关。结果表明，有针对性的监管创新可以在不降低新产品质量的前提下缩短研发周期。

abstract.text: Air pollution can adversely affect physiological and cognitive performance. This study estimates the causal effect of increased nitrogen dioxide (NO2), a primary air pollutant, on construction work accidents, a significant factor related to labor market productivity losses. Using data from all construction sites and pollution monitoring stations in Israel, we find a strong and significant effect on accidents, with a 377% (138%) increase on high (moderate) NO2 pollution days compared to clean air levels. Our mechanism analysis suggests the effect is exacerbated under cognitive strain or worker fatigue. A cost-benefit analysis, supported by a nonparametric estimation, examines subsidizing site closures on highly polluted days.

10.3386/w30715.abstractZh: 空气污染会对生理和认知表现产生不利影响。本研究估计了主要空气污染物二氧化氮（NO2）浓度增加对建筑作业事故的影响，而建筑作业事故与劳动力市场生产力损失密切相关。通过以色列所有建筑工地和污染监测站的数据分析，我们发现高（中等）浓度二氧化氮污染天气与清洁空气水平相比，会导致事故增加377%（138%）。我们的机制分析表明，在认知压力或工人疲劳的情况下，这种影响会进一步加剧。基于非参数估计的成本效益分析，探讨了在污染严重的日子里对建筑工地进行关闭的补贴问题。

abstract.text: Health plans for the poor increasingly limit access to specialty hospitals. We investigate the role of adverse selection in generating this equilibrium among private plans in Medicaid. Studying a network change, we find that covering a top cancer hospital causes severe adverse selection, increasing demand for a plan by 50% among enrollees with cancer versus no impact for others. Medicaid’s fixed insurer payments make offsetting this selection, and the contract distortions it induces, challenging, requiring either infeasibly high payment rates or near-perfect risk adjustment. By contrast, a small explicit bonus for covering the hospital is sufficient to make coverage profitable.

10.3386/w30719.abstractZh: 针对贫困群体的健康计划越来越限制他们访问专科医院的机会。我们研究了逆向选择在这一过程中所起的作用，尤其是在医疗补助计划中，私人保险公司之间的竞争导致了这种均衡状态。通过研究网络变化，我们发现覆盖顶级癌症医院会导致严重的逆向选择，使得患有癌症的参保者对该计划的需求增加50%，而其他人群则不受影响。医疗补助计划中的固定保险支付机制使得这种逆向选择得以抵消，而合同中的扭曲现象则使得风险调整变得具有挑战性，需要极高的支付率或近乎完美的风险调整才能维持。相比之下，对覆盖特定医院提供少量显性奖励就足以使覆盖服务变得盈利。

abstract.text: Dependent variables that are non-negative, follow right-skewed distributions, and have large probability mass at zero arise often in empirical economics. Two classes of models that transform the dependent variable y — the natural logarithm of y plus a constant and the inverse hyperbolic sine — have been widely used in empirical work. We show that these two classes of models share several features that raise concerns about their application. The concerns are particularly prominent when dependent variables are frequently observed at zero, which in many instances is the main motivation for using them in the first place. The crux of the concern is that these models have an extra parameter that is generally not determined by theory but whose values have enormous consequences for point estimates. As these parameters go to extreme values estimated marginal effects on outcomes' natural scales approach those of either an untransformed linear regression or a normed linear probability model. Across a wide variety of simulated data, two-part models yield correct marginal effects, as do OLS on the untransformed y and Poisson regression. If researchers care about estimating marginal effects, we recommend using these simpler models that do not rely on transformations.

10.3386/w30735.abstractZh: 在实证经济学中，经常会出现一些因变量是非负的、遵循右偏分布，并且在零点处具有较大概率质量的变量。两类模型被广泛用于实证研究中：一种是因变量y的自然对数加上一个常数，另一种是反双曲正弦函数。我们指出，这两类模型具有一些共同特征，这些特征引发了对其应用的担忧。当因变量经常出现在零点时，这种担忧尤为突出，而这种情况在许多情况下正是使用这些模型的主要动机。问题的关键在于，这些模型存在一个额外的参数，该参数通常不由理论确定，但其数值对点估计结果有着巨大的影响。当这些参数达到极端值时，对结果的自然尺度影响的边际效应接近于未转换线性回归或标准化线性概率模型的边际效应。在多种模拟数据中，两部分模型能够得出正确的边际效应，而未转换的y的OLS回归和泊松回归也能做到这一点。如果研究人员关心估计边际效应，我们建议使用这些不依赖转换的简单模型。

abstract.text: We study the impact of paid family leave (PFL) policies on individuals’ labor market and mental health-related responses to their spouses’ and children’s health shocks using data from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey and event-study models. We find that PFL access improves job continuity among wives of individuals who are hospitalized or have surgery. Additionally, while PFL access does not affect the wives’ self-reported mental health, it reduces their use of mental health-related medication. We find no effects of PFL on parents of children who experience health shocks, suggesting that this policy is less fitting for this group of caregivers.

10.3386/w30739.abstractZh: 我们研究了带薪家庭休假政策对个体劳动力市场以及他们对配偶和子女健康冲击的心理反应的影响，研究数据来自医疗支出面板调查和事件研究模型。我们发现，对于住院或接受手术的个人来说，带薪家庭休假政策的实施有助于提升妻子的工作连续性。此外，虽然带薪家庭休假政策并未影响妻子的自我报告心理健康状况，但减少了她们使用与心理健康相关的药物的情况。我们发现，带薪家庭休假政策对经历健康冲击的儿童的父母没有显著影响，这表明该政策不太适合这一群体中的照顾者。

abstract.text: We use public finance sufficient statistic approaches to characterize the welfare effects of “nudges,” such as simplified information and warning labels, in markets with taxes and endogenous prices. While many studies focus on average effects, we show that welfare also depends on how the nudge affects the variance of choice distortions, and average effects become irrelevant with zero pass-through or optimal taxes. We implement the framework with experiments evaluating automotive fuel economy labels and sugary drink health labels. Labels decrease purchases of low-fuel economy cars and sugary drinks but may decrease welfare, because they increase the variance of choice distortions.

10.3386/w30740.abstractZh: 我们采用公共财政充分统计量方法，来描述在存在税收和内生价格的市场中，诸如简化信息提示和警示标签等“助推措施”对福利影响的特性。虽然许多研究关注平均效应，但我们指出，福利还取决于这种助推措施如何影响选择扭曲的方差，而当传递效应为零或存在最优税收时，平均效应就变得无关紧要了。我们通过实验来实施这一框架，评估汽车燃油经济性标签和含糖饮料健康标签的效果。这些标签减少了低燃油经济性汽车和含糖饮料的购买，但可能会降低福利，因为它们增加了选择扭曲的方差。

abstract.text: We develop a theoretical framework to analyze the effects of immigration on native job amenities, focusing on work schedules. Immigrants have a comparative advantage in production at, and lower disamenity cost for nighttime work, which leads them to disproportionately choose nighttime employment. Because day and night tasks are imperfect substitutes, the relative price of day tasks increases as their supply becomes relatively more scarce. We provide empirical support for our theory. Native workers in local labor markets that experienced higher rates of immigration are more likely to work day shifts and receive a lower compensating differential for nighttime work.

10.3386/w30742.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个理论框架，用于分析移民对本地工作便利性的影响，重点关注工作时间安排。移民在生产方面具有比较优势，且夜间工作的不适感较低，这使他们更倾向于选择夜间就业。由于白天和夜间的任务并非完全替代品，随着白天任务的供应相对稀缺，其相对价格会上升。我们的理论得到了实证数据的支持。在本地劳动力市场中，移民比例较高的本地工人更可能从事白天班次的工作，并且夜间工作的补偿差异也较小。

abstract.text: Clinical trials following the “gold standard” of random assignment frequently use independent lotteries to allocate patients to treatment and control arms. However, independent assignment can generate treatment and control arms that are unbalanced (i.e. treatment and control populations with significantly different demographics), which reduces power. Other assignment methods such as matched pair designs ensure balance across arms while maintaining randomization and permitting inference. This paper seeks to measure the cost of imbalance with respect to gender in a sample of roughly 2000 clinical studies. We document significant imbalance: 25% of experiments have at least 26% more men in one treatment arm than in the other. In addition, clinical trials with greater imbalance have more dispersed treatment effects, indicating that imbalance reduces the informativeness of experiments. A simple structural model suggests that for a typical experiment, using a balanced random design could deliver informativeness gains equivalent to increasing the sample size by 18%.

10.3386/w30745.abstractZh: 在遵循“黄金标准”的随机分配进行的临床试验中，通常会使用独立抽签法将患者分配到治疗组和对照组。然而，独立分配可能导致治疗组和对照组在人口统计学特征上出现不平衡，这会降低研究的统计效力。其他分配方法，如配对设计，可以在保持随机性的同时确保各组的平衡，并允许进行统计推断。本文旨在评估在大约2000项临床试验中，性别不平衡所带来的成本。我们发现存在显著的不平衡现象：25%的实验中，某一治疗组的男性人数比另一组多出至少26%。此外，不平衡程度较高的临床试验中，治疗效果的分布更为分散，这表明不平衡会降低实验的统计信息量。一个简单的结构模型表明，对于典型的实验来说，采用平衡随机设计可以带来相当于增加18%样本量的统计信息增益。

abstract.text: Combining data on around four million respondents from the Gallup World Poll and the US Daily Tracker Poll we rank 164 countries, the 50 states of the United States and the District of Colombia on eight wellbeing measures. These are four positive affect measures - life satisfaction, enjoyment, smiling and being well-rested – and four negative affect variables – pain, sadness, anger and worry. Pooling the data for 2008-2017 we find country and state rankings differ markedly depending on whether they are ranked using positive or negative affect measures. The United States ranks lower on negative than positive affect, that is, its country wellbeing ranking looks worse using negative affect than it does when using positive affect. Combining rankings on all eight measures into a summary ranking index for 215 geographical locations we find that nine of the top ten and 16 of the top 20 ranked are US states. Only one US state ranks outside the top 100 – West Virginia (101). Iraq ranks lowest - just below South Sudan. Country-level rankings on the summary wellbeing index differ sharply from those reported in the World Happiness Index and are more comparable to those obtained with the Human Development Index.

10.3386/w30759.abstractZh: 通过整合盖洛普世界民意调查和美国每日追踪调查中约四百万受访者的数据，我们对164个国家、美国50个州以及哥伦比亚特区在八个福祉指标上的表现进行了排名。这八个指标包括四个积极情感指标——生活满意度、愉悦感、微笑次数以及休息充足程度——以及四个消极情感变量——痛苦、悲伤、愤怒和担忧。通过对2008至2017年的数据进行分析，我们发现不同国家和地区在采用积极或消极情感指标进行排名时，其排名存在显著差异。美国的消极情感指标排名低于积极情感指标，也就是说，使用消极情感指标时，美国的整体福祉状况看起来更差。将这八个指标的综合排名汇总成一个总结性排名指数，我们发现前十位中有九个州是美国州，前二十名中有十六个州也是美国州。只有一个美国州未能进入前一百名——西弗吉尼亚州（第101位）。伊拉克的排名最低，仅低于南苏丹。这些国家层面的综合福祉指数排名与《世界幸福指数》中的排名存在明显差异，但与人类发展指数得出的排名更为接近。

abstract.text: Stable housing is critical for health, employment, education, and other social outcomes. Evictions reflect a form of housing instability that is experienced by millions of Americans each year. Inadequately treated psychiatric disorders have the potential to influence evictions in several ways. For example, these disorders may impede labor market performance and thus the ability to pay rent, or increase the likelihood of risky and/or nuisance behaviors that can lead to a lease violation. We estimate the effect of local access to psychiatric treatment on eviction rates. We combine data on the number of psychiatric treatment centers that offer outpatient and residential care within a county with eviction rates in a two-way fixed-effects framework. Our findings imply that ten additional psychiatric treatment centers in a county lead to a reduction of 2.1% in the eviction rate.

10.3386/w30766.abstractZh: 稳定的住房对健康、就业、教育及其他社会成果至关重要。驱逐行为反映了数百万美国人每年所经历的住房不稳定状况。处理不当的精神疾病可能会以多种方式影响驱逐行为。例如，这些疾病可能会阻碍劳动力市场的表现，从而影响支付租金的能力，或者增加危险和/或令人困扰的行为，导致租赁协议被违反。我们估计了当地获得精神治疗服务的机会对驱逐率的影响。我们结合了一个县内提供门诊和住院治疗的心理治疗中心数量的数据，并在双向固定效应框架中分析了驱逐率。我们的研究结果表明，一个县每增加十个心理治疗中心，驱逐率就会降低2.1%。

abstract.text: One explanation for insufficient use of primary care in the U.S. is a lack of trust between patients and providers – particularly along racial lines. We assess the role of racial concordance between patients and medical providers in driving use of preventive care and the implications for patient outcomes. We use unique data from the Military Health System, where we observe providers as patients so that we can identify their race, and where moves across bases change exposure to provider race. We consider patients with four chronic, deadly, but ultimately manageable illnesses, where the relationship with the provider may have the most direct and important impact on health. We find striking evidence that racial concordance leads to improved maintenance of preventive care – and ultimately lower patient mortality. Pooling across these diseases, we estimate that a one-standard deviation increase in the share of providers who are Black leads to a 15% relative decline in Black mortality among those with these manageable illnesses. Our results further suggest that between 55 and 69% of this mortality impact arises through improved medication use and adherence, with other aspects of the provider-patient relationship accounting for the residual.

10.3386/w30767.abstractZh: 美国初级医疗使用不足的一个解释是患者与医疗服务提供者之间的信任缺失——尤其是在种族层面上。我们评估了患者与医疗提供者之间的种族一致性在促进预防性医疗使用中的作用，以及这对患者结果的影响。我们利用了军事医疗系统的独特数据，通过这种数据，我们可以观察到医疗服务提供者的种族特征，并了解他们在不同基地之间的变化如何影响他们对种族的感知。我们选择了四种慢性但致命且最终可控制的疾病作为研究对象，因为这些疾病与医疗服务提供者之间的关系可能对患者的健康产生最直接和最重要的影响。我们发现，种族一致性确实有助于改善预防性医疗的维持，从而降低患者的死亡率。综合这些疾病的数据，我们估计，如果提供者的黑人比例增加一个标准差，那么患有这些可控制疾病且为黑人的患者死亡率将下降15%。我们的结果进一步表明，这种死亡率降低的影响中，有55%到69%是通过改善药物使用和依从性实现的，而其余部分则归因于医疗服务提供者与患者之间的关系。

abstract.text: In this paper, we test whether the Affordable Care Act Medicaid expansions are associated with in-hospital maternal morbidity. The ACA expansions may have affected maternal morbidity by increasing pre-conception access to health care, and by improving the quality of delivery care through enhancing hospitals’ financial positions. We use difference-in-difference models in conjunction with event studies. Data come from individual-level birth certificates and state-level hospital discharge data. The results show little evidence that the expansions are associated with overall maternal morbidity or indicators of specific adverse events including eclampsia, ruptured uterus, and unplanned hysterectomy. The results are consistent with prior research showing that the ACA Medicaid expansions are not statistically associated with pre-pregnancy health or maternal health during pregnancy. Our results add to this story and find little evidence of improvements in maternal health upon delivery.

10.3386/w30770.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了《平价医疗法案》的医疗补助扩展是否与医院内孕产妇发病率有关。该法案的扩展可能通过增加孕前医疗保健的获取机会，以及通过改善医院的财务状况来提高分娩护理的质量，从而影响了孕产妇的发病率。我们采用了差异-差异模型并结合事件研究的方法进行分析。数据来源于个人层面的出生证明和州级医院出院数据。研究结果显示，这些扩展与总体孕产妇发病率或特定不良事件的指标（包括子痫、子宫破裂和计划外子宫切除术）之间几乎没有关联。研究结果与先前的研究一致，即《平价医疗法案》的医疗补助扩展与孕前健康或孕期孕产妇健康之间没有统计学上的关联。我们的研究结果进一步证实了这一点，并发现分娩后孕产妇健康的改善迹象甚微。

abstract.text: A growing body of evidence indicates that poor health early in life can leave lasting scars on adult health and economic outcomes. While much of this literature focuses on childhood experiences, mechanisms generating these lasting effects – recurrence of illness and interruption of human capital accumulation – are not limited to childhood. In this study, we examine how an episode of depression experienced in early adulthood affects subsequent labor market outcomes. We find that, at age 50, people who had met diagnostic criteria for depression when surveyed at ages 27-35 earn 10% lower hourly wages (conditional on occupation) and work 120-180 fewer hours annually, together generating 24% lower annual wage incomes. A portion of this income penalty (21-39%) occurs because depression is often a chronic condition, recurring later in life. But a substantial share (25-55%) occurs because depression in early adulthood disrupts human capital accumulation, by reducing work experience and by influencing selection into occupations with skill distributions that offer lower potential for wage growth. These lingering effects of early depression reinforce the importance of early and multifaceted intervention to address depression and its follow-on effects in the workplace.

10.3386/w30776.abstractZh: 越来越多的证据表明，生命早期的健康问题会对成年后的健康和经济状况产生长期影响。虽然许多研究集中在童年经历上，但导致这些长期影响的机制——如疾病的复发和人力资本积累的中断——并不仅限于童年时期。本研究探讨了成年早期经历抑郁如何影响后续的劳动力市场结果。研究发现，在50岁时，那些在27至35岁时被诊断为抑郁的人，其每小时工资会低10%（以职业为准），每年工作时间会减少120至180小时，从而导致年收入降低24%。这部分收入损失的原因之一是抑郁通常是一种慢性疾病，会在以后的生活中反复出现。但更重要的原因是，成年早期的抑郁会破坏人力资本积累，通过减少工作经验以及影响职业选择，使得从事的职业的技能分布不利于工资增长。这些早期抑郁的持久影响凸显了早期进行多方面干预以解决抑郁及其对工作场所的影响的重要性。

abstract.text: We study the effects of competition by state-owned firms, leveraging the decentralized entry of public pharmacies to local markets in Chile. Public pharmacies sell the same drugs at a third of private pharmacy prices, because of stronger upstream bargaining and market power in the private sector, but are of lower quality. Public pharmacies induced market segmentation and price increases in the private sector, which benefited the switchers to the public option but harmed the stayers. The countrywide entry of public pharmacies would reduce yearly consumer drug expenditure by 1.5 percent.

10.3386/w30779.abstractZh: 我们研究了国有企业的竞争效应，通过利用公共药店在智利本地市场的分散式进入来进行分析。由于私营部门在上游谈判和市场中的更强势力，公共药店以三分之一的私营药店价格出售相同的药品，但质量较低。公共药店导致了市场的分割和价格的上涨，这有利于转向公共选择方案的用户，但损害了那些继续留在私营部门的人。全国范围内公共药店的进入将使年度消费者药品支出减少1.5%。

abstract.text: Are application hassles, or “ordeals,” an effective way to limit public program enrollment? We provide new evidence by studying (removal of) an auto-enrollment policy for health insurance, adding an extra step to enroll. This minor ordeal has a major impact, reducing enrollment by 33% and differentially excluding young, healthy, and economically disadvantaged people. Using a simple model, we show that adverse selection – a classic feature of insurance markets – undermines ordeals’ standard rationale of excluding low-value individuals, since they are also low-cost and may not be inefficient. Our analysis illustrates why ordeals targeting is unlikely to work well in selection markets.

10.3386/w30781.abstractZh: 申请手续或“苦难”是否是限制公共项目注册的有效方式？我们通过研究一项取消自动注册政策的健康保险政策，为这一研究提供了新的证据。这项简单的“苦难”措施产生了重大影响，使注册人数减少了33%，并且不同群体受到了不同的影响，尤其是年轻、健康以及经济条件较差的人群。利用一个简单的模型，我们表明，逆向选择——保险市场的一个典型特征——削弱了“苦难”措施排除低价值个体的标准理由，因为这些人往往也是低成本用户，且可能并不低效。我们的分析说明了为什么针对选择的“苦难”措施不太可能有效。

abstract.text: Over 2009-2019 the seemingly inexorable rise in health care’s share of GDP markedly slowed, both in the US and elsewhere. To address whether this slowdown represents a reduced steady-state growth rate or just a temporary pause we specify and estimate a decomposition of health care spending growth. The post-2009 slowdown was importantly influenced by four factors. Population aging increased health care’s share of GDP, but three other factors more than offset the effect of aging: a temporary income effect stemming from the Great Recession; slowing relative medical price inflation; and a possibly longer lasting slowdown in the nature of technological change to increase the rate of cost-saving innovation. Looking forward, the post-2009 moderation in the role of technological change as a driver of growth, if sustained, implies a reduction of 0.8 percentage points in health care spending growth; a sizeable decline in the context of the 2.0 percentage point differential in growth between health care spending and GDP in the 1970 to 2019 period.

10.3386/w30782.abstractZh: 在2009年至2019年期间，医疗保健在GDP中的占比似乎并未持续上升，这一趋势在美国及其他国家都有所减缓。为了判断这种减缓是否意味着增长率的下降，还是仅仅是一个暂时的停顿，我们进行了医疗保健支出增长的分解分析。2009年后的增速放缓主要受到四个因素的影响：人口老龄化增加了医疗保健在GDP中的占比，但其他三个因素的作用超过了老龄化带来的影响：一次性的经济衰退带来的收入效应；相对医疗价格通胀的放缓；以及技术变革性质的长期放缓，这导致创新以降低成本的速度有所降低。展望未来，如果2009年后的技术变革作为增长驱动力的作用持续减弱，那么医疗保健支出的增长率将下降0.8个百分点；在1970年至2019年间，医疗保健支出与GDP的增长率相差2.0个百分点的情况下，这一下降幅度将相当显著。

abstract.text: There is much debate about the effects of pharmaceutical direct to consumer advertising (DTCA) on health care use. In this paper, we inform this debate by examining the effects of DTCA on office visits, as well as treatment courses resulting from those visits, for five common chronic conditions (hypertension, hyperlipidemia, diabetes, depression, and osteoporosis). In particular, we examine whether office visits result in use of drug therapy and/or continued office visits over time. We test these questions by combining data on pharmaceutical advertising from Nielsen with claims data from 40 large national employers, covering 18 million person-years. We analyze a non-elderly population by exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in advertising exposure across areas due to the implementation of Medicare prescription drug coverage which led to larger increases in advertising in areas with high elderly share of population compared to low elderly share areas. We find that advertising increases the number of office visits for the non-elderly for the advertised condition. We also find substantial spillovers -- a large share of the increased office visits from advertising are associated with use of non-advertised generic drugs or do not result in use of any drugs. Finally, we find that the increase in office visits due to DTCA is associated with continued engagement with a physician through multiple consecutive follow up visits over time.

10.3386/w30791.abstractZh: 关于药品直接面向消费者广告对医疗使用的影响，目前存在许多争论。在本文中，我们通过研究药品直接面向消费者广告对五种常见慢性病（高血压、高脂血症、糖尿病、抑郁症和骨质疏松症）的门诊就诊情况以及由此引发的后续治疗过程，来探讨这一问题的影响。我们特别考察了门诊就诊是否导致了药物治疗的使用，以及是否导致了后续门诊就诊的持续。我们通过结合Nielsen提供的药品广告数据和40个大型国家雇主的索赔数据来测试这些问题，这些数据涵盖了1800万个人年。我们分析了非老年人群体，并利用Medicare处方药覆盖政策实施导致的地区间广告暴露差异，发现老年人口比例较高的地区广告投放量比老年人口比例较低的地区更多。我们发现，广告增加了非老年人群体因所宣传疾病而进行的门诊就诊次数。我们还发现，广告带来的门诊就诊增加中有很大一部分与未宣传药物的通用药物的使用有关，或者根本没有使用任何药物。最后，我们发现，由于药品直接面向消费者广告导致的门诊就诊增加，与医生后续多次就诊的持续联系有关。

abstract.text: Almost one third of women worldwide report some form of physical or sexual violence by a partner in their lifetime, yet little is known about the mental health and well-being effects for either victims or their children. We study the costs associated with domestic violence (DV) in the context of Norway, where we can link offenders to victims and their children over time. Our difference-in-differences framework uses those who will be victimized in the future as controls. We find that a DV report involving the police is associated with large changes in the home environment, including marital dissolution and a corresponding decline in financial resources. A DV report increases mental health visits by 35% for victims and by 19% for their children in the year of the event, effects which taper off over time for the victim, but not for children. Victims also experience more doctor visits, lower employment, reduced earnings and a higher use of disability insurance while their children are more likely to receive child protective services and commit a crime. Using a complementary RD design, we find that a DV report results in declines both in children’s test scores and completion of the first year of high school.

10.3386/w30792.abstractZh: 全球近三分之一的女性在生命中曾遭受过伴侣的肢体或性暴力，然而关于这种暴力对受害者及其子女的心理健康和福祉影响的研究却很少。我们研究了挪威背景下家庭暴力带来的成本，在那里我们可以将施暴者与受害者及其子女联系起来进行长期研究。我们的差异-差异框架以未来可能成为受害者的个体作为对照组。研究发现，涉及警方的家庭暴力报告会导致家庭环境发生重大变化，包括婚姻破裂和相应财务资源的减少。在事件发生当年，家庭暴力报告会使受害者的心理健康就诊次数增加35%，子女则增加19%。这些影响随时间逐渐减弱，但子女的影响则持续存在。受害者还会经历更多的医生就诊、就业率下降、收入减少以及残疾保险使用率上升，而子女则更有可能接受儿童保护服务或犯罪。通过补充性的差异-差异设计，我们发现家庭暴力报告还会导致儿童考试成绩下降以及高中一年级辍学率上升。

abstract.text: This study explores the effect of in-person schooling on youth suicide. We document three key findings. First, using data from the National Vital Statistics System from 1990-2019, we document the historical association between teen suicides and the school calendar. We show that suicides among 12-to-18-year-olds are highest during months of the school year and lowest during summer months (June through August) and also establish that areas with schools starting in early August experience increases in teen suicides in August, while areas with schools starting in September don’t see youth suicides rise until September. Second, we show that this seasonal pattern dramatically changed in 2020. Teen suicides plummeted in March 2020, when the COVID-19 pandemic began in the U.S. and remained low throughout the summer before rising in Fall 2020 when many K-12 schools returned to in-person instruction. Third, using county-level variation in school reopenings in Fall 2020 and Spring 2021—proxied by anonymized SafeGraph smartphone data on elementary and secondary school foot traffic—we find that returning from online to in-person schooling was associated with a 12-to-18 percent increase teen suicides. This result is robust to controls for seasonal effects and general lockdown effects (proxied by restaurant and bar foot traffic), and survives falsification tests using suicides among young adults ages 19-to-25. Auxiliary analyses using Google Trends queries and the Youth Risk Behavior Survey suggests that bullying victimization may be an important mechanism.

10.3386/w30795.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了面对面教学对青少年自杀的影响。我们发现了三个关键发现。首先，通过1990年至2019年国民生命统计系统的数据，我们发现了青少年自杀与学校日历之间的历史关联。结果显示，12至18岁的青少年自杀率在学年期间最高，而在夏季（6月至8月）则最低。此外，我们还发现，那些学校在8月初开始上课的地区，8月份青少年自杀率会上升，而9月开学地区的青少年自杀率则不会在9月之前上升。其次，2020年这种季节性模式发生了显著变化。2020年3月，随着COVID-19疫情在美国爆发，青少年自杀率大幅下降，整个夏季自杀率保持较低水平，直到2020年秋季许多K-12学校恢复面对面教学，自杀率才再次上升。第三，通过2020年秋季和2021年春季学校重新开学的县级差异——利用SafeGraph智能手机数据对小学和中学的步行流量进行匿名化处理——我们发现，从在线教学转为面对面教学会导致青少年自杀率增加12%至18%。这一结果在控制了季节效应和整体封锁效应后仍然成立，并且在使用19至25岁年轻人的自杀数据进行的虚假测试中也得到了验证。使用Google趋势查询和青少年风险行为调查进行的辅助分析表明，欺凌行为可能是导致青少年自杀的一个重要因素。

abstract.text: We show that sugar-rich diet early in life has large adverse effects on the health and economic well-being of adults more than fifty years later. Excessive sugar intake early in life led to higher prevalence of chronic inflammation, diabetes, elevated cholesterol and arthritis. It also decreased post-secondary schooling, having a skilled occupation, and accumulating above median wealth. We identified elevated sugar consumption across lifespan as a likely pathway of impact. Exploiting the end of the post-WWII rationing of sugar and sweets in 1953 in the United Kingdom, we used a regression discontinuity design to identify these effects.

10.3386/w30799.abstractZh: 我们表明，生命早期摄入大量糖分会对成年人五十多年后的健康和经济状况产生巨大负面影响。生命早期过量摄入糖分会导致慢性炎症、糖尿病、高胆固醇和关节炎的患病率上升。此外，这还会降低接受高等教育的可能性、获得熟练职业的机会，以及积累超过中位数财富的能力。我们发现，整个生命周期中糖分摄入量的增加可能是导致这些影响的途径之一。为了研究这一问题，我们利用了1953年英国结束对糖和甜食配给制度这一契机，采用回归不连续设计方法来分析这些影响。

abstract.text: During the past fifteen years, more than 30% of US coal plants have had at least one coal-fired generator close. We utilize this natural experiment to estimate the effect of coal plant exposure on mortality and house values. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that, despite the fact that most of this coal generation is replaced with natural gas generation, individuals in counties whose population centroid is within 30 miles of a plant that closes at least one coal-fired unit experience large health effects following shutdown. While these health improvements appear to capitalize into housing values, they only do so for homes within 15 miles of the plant and only when the retirement is complete rather than partial. Taken together, these results underscore the importance of subjective perceptions in shaping market-mediated price effects with far-reaching implications for the literature.

10.3386/w30801.abstractZh: 在过去的十五年里，美国有超过30%的燃煤电厂至少有一个燃煤发电机停机。我们利用这一自然实验来估计燃煤电厂关闭对死亡率和房屋价值的影响。通过差异-差异设计，我们发现，尽管大部分燃煤发电已被天然气发电取代，但在那些人口中心距离至少有一个燃煤机组停机的电厂30英里范围内的县，个体居民在电厂关闭后出现了严重的健康影响。虽然这些健康改善似乎对房屋价值有所贡献，但这一影响仅限于距离电厂15英里以内的房屋，并且只有在电厂关闭完全而非部分时才会显现。综合这些结果，强调了主观感知在塑造市场中介价格效应中的重要性，这对相关文献具有深远的影响。

abstract.text: In 2001, Germany abolished public occupational disability insurance (ODI)—the second tier of public DI—for post-1960 cohorts. First, overall DI inflows decreased by a third in the long run. Second, representative data show at best modest increases in private ODI take-up in an individual risk-rated market without guaranteed issue. Third, an equilibrium model featuring interactions between the safety net, the first tier of public DI, and the private market illustrates that coverage denials and weak insurance demand due to complementary social insurance produce modest private ODI take-up with steep gradients by income and health. Finally, we simulate complementary reforms.

10.3386/w30812.abstractZh: 2001年，德国取消了针对1960年后出生人群的公共职业残疾保险（ODI）——这是公共残疾保险的第二层保障。首先，从长期来看，公共残疾保险的参保人数减少了三分之一。其次，代表性数据显示，在没有保障性发行的个体风险评级市场中，私人职业残疾保险的参与率仅有所提升。第三，一个包含安全网、公共残疾保险的第一层保障以及私人市场相互作用的均衡模型表明，由于社会保险的补充作用，保险拒保和保险需求不足导致私人职业残疾保险的参与率随着收入和健康状况的恶化而急剧下降。最后，我们模拟了相应的改革措施。

abstract.text: Despite nearly 70 percent of the American public supporting legalization of recreational marijuana, opponents argue that increased marijuana use may diminish motivation, impede cognitive function, and harm health, each of which could adversely affect adults’ economic wellbeing. This study is the first to explore the impacts of recreational marijuana laws (RMLs) on employment and wages. Difference-in-differences estimates show little evidence that RMLs adversely affect labor market outcomes among most working-age individuals. Rather, our estimates show that RML adoption is associated with an increase in agricultural employment, consistent with the opening of a new licit market. A causal interpretation of our findings is supported by (1) event-study analyses using dynamic difference-in-differences estimates designed to expunge bias due to heterogeneous and dynamic treatment effects, and (2) alternative policy estimates generated using a synthetic control design.

10.3386/w30813.abstractZh: 尽管近70%的美国人支持将娱乐性大麻合法化，但反对者认为，大麻使用量的增加可能会降低动机、妨碍认知功能并损害健康，而这些因素都可能对成年人的经济福祉产生不利影响。本研究首次探讨了娱乐性大麻法律对就业和工资的影响。差异-差异估计显示，大多数劳动年龄人口并未受到娱乐性大麻法律的负面影响。相反，我们的估计表明，采用娱乐性大麻法律与农业就业的增加有关，这与开辟一个新的合法市场是一致的。我们的发现得到了以下两个方面的支持：(1)使用动态差异-差异估计进行的事件研究分析，旨在消除由于异质性和动态处理效应导致的偏差；(2)使用合成控制设计生成的替代政策估计。

abstract.text: We examine friendships and study partnerships among university students over several years. At the aggregate level, connections increase over time, but homophily on gender and ethnicity is relatively constant across time, university residences, and different network layers. At the individual level, homophilous tendencies are persistent across time and network layers. Furthermore, we see assortativity in homophilous tendencies. There is weaker, albeit significant, homophily over malleable characteristics---risk preferences, altruism, study habits, and so on. We find little evidence of assimilation over those characteristics. We also document the nuanced impact of network connections on changes in Grade Point Average.

10.3386/w30815.abstractZh: 我们研究了多年间大学生之间的友谊和合作关系。从整体来看，人际关系随着时间的推移而增强，但性别和种族上的同质性在不同时间、不同大学宿舍以及不同网络层次上相对稳定。在个体层面，同质性倾向在不同时间和网络层次上仍然存在。此外，我们发现同质性倾向存在某种关联性。对于具有可塑性特征的人群，如风险偏好、利他主义、学习习惯等，虽然同质性较弱，但仍然显著。我们发现这些特征上几乎没有同化现象的证据。我们还记录了网络联系对成绩平均变化的影响，这种影响具有复杂性。

abstract.text: The number of patients in a hospital is a direct indicator of patients' choice of hospital, which is a complex process affected by many factors. Based on the national medical system and patients' preference for high-grade hospitals in China, this study establishes a three-dimensional differential equation model for calculating the time variation of the number of visits to three grades of hospitals. We performed a qualitative analysis of the system. We carried out a subsequent numerical simulation to analyze the impact on the system when the rate of leapfrog treatment and the maximum capacity of doctors and treatments changed. The results show that the sustainability of China's three levels of hospitals mainly depends on the level of hospital development. The strength of comprehensive health improvement at specific levels is the key to increasing the service efficiency of medical resources.

10.3389/fpubh.2022.760143.abstractZh: 医院的患者数量直接反映了患者选择医院的行为，这一过程受到许多因素的复杂影响。基于中国的国家医疗体系以及患者对高级医院的偏好，本研究建立了一个三维微分方程模型，用于计算三级医院就诊次数的时间变化。我们对该系统进行了定性分析，并进行了数值模拟，以分析跳跃式治疗率以及医生和治疗方法的最大容量变化对系统的影响。研究结果表明，中国三级医院的可持续性主要取决于医院的发展水平。在特定水平上，综合健康改善能力的强弱是提高医疗资源服务效率的关键。

abstract.text: Contribui para o debate sobre a consolidação de instituições econômicas eficientes no Brasil, que fomentem a produtividade dos agentes e acelerem a acumulação de riqueza no país, devolvendo ao Estado as capacidades financeiras e regulatórias necessárias para fazer frente às demandas crescentes de uma sociedade pujante e diversa. Para esse objetivo, não pretende ser inédito ou revolucionário em suas ideias; visa-se consolidar um conjunto de proposições inspiradas tanto nas melhores práticas de políticas públicas consagradas na literatura e na experiência internacional, quanto, sobretudo, nas lições do próprio aprendizado brasileiro – com suas peculiaridades e contradições, mas, também, com seu otimismo e sua criatividade.

10.38116/978-65-5635-061-5/capitulo1.abstractZh: 本文旨在推动关于在巴西建立高效经济机构的讨论，这些机构能够促进经济主体的生产力，加速国家财富的积累，同时使国家重新具备应对日益多样化且繁荣社会所提出的新要求的财务和监管能力。为了实现这一目标，本文并不试图提出全新的或革命性的理念；而是旨在整合一系列基于国内外最佳实践以及巴西自身的经验所提出的建议——这些建议既包含巴西特有的特点和矛盾，也体现了巴西的乐观精神和创造力。

abstract.text: Este documento contribui para o debate sobre a consolidação de instituições econômicas eficientes no Brasil, que fomentem a produtividade dos agentes e acelerem a acumulação de riqueza no País, devolvendo ao Estado as capacidades financeiras e regulatórias necessárias para fazer frente às demandas crescentes de uma sociedade pujante e diversa. Para esse objetivo, não pretende ser inédito ou revolucionário em suas ideias, mas, antes, consolidar um conjunto de proposições inspiradas nas melhores práticas de políticas públicas consagradas na literatura e na experiência internacional. E, em primeiro lugar, nas lições do próprio aprendizado brasileiro – com suas peculiaridades e contradições, mas, também com seu otimismo e criatividade.

10.38116/9786556350615.abstractZh: 本文旨在推动关于在巴西建立高效经济机构的讨论，这些机构能够促进经济主体的生产力，加速国家财富的积累，同时使国家重新具备应对日益多样化且繁荣社会所提出的新要求的财务和监管能力。为了实现这一目标，本文并不试图提出全新的或革命性的理念，而是基于国际文献和实践中最优秀的公共政策实践，提出一系列建议。首先，本文借鉴了巴西自身的经验——尽管存在独特性和矛盾性，但巴西也具备乐观精神和创造力。

abstract.text: Trade liberalization changes the volatility of returns by reducing the negative correlation between local prices and productivity shocks. In this paper, we explore these second‐moment effects of trade. Using forty years of agricultural micro‐data from India, we show that falling trade costs due to expansions of the Indian highway network reduced the responsiveness of local prices to local yields but increased the responsiveness of local prices to yields elsewhere. In response, farmers shifted their production toward crops with less volatile yields, especially so for those with poor access to risk mitigating technologies such as banks. We then characterize how volatility affects farmers' crop allocation using a portfolio choice framework where returns are determined in general equilibrium by a many‐location, many‐good Ricardian trade model with flexible trade costs. Finally, we structurally estimate the model—recovering farmers' risk‐return preferences from the gradient of the mean‐variance frontier at their observed crop choices—to quantify the second‐moment effects of trade. The simultaneous expansion of both the highway and rural bank networks increased the mean and the variance of farmer real income, with the first‐moment effect dominating such that expected welfare rose 4.4%. But had rural bank access remained unchanged, welfare gains would have been only half as great, as risk mitigating technologies allowed farmers to take advantage of higher‐risk higher‐return allocations.

10.3982/ecta14411.abstractZh: 贸易自由化通过减少当地价格与生产率冲击之间的负相关性，改变了收益的波动性。在本文中，我们探讨了贸易的这些第二 Moment 效应。利用印度四十年的农业微观数据，我们发现，由于印度公路网络的扩展，贸易成本的降低降低了当地价格对当地产量的响应性，但提高了当地价格对其他地区产量的响应性。作为回应，农民将生产转向产量波动较小的作物，尤其是那些难以获得风险缓解技术（如银行服务）的农民。接着，我们使用投资组合选择框架来研究波动性如何影响农民对作物的分配，其中收益由具有多地点、多商品的Ricardian贸易模型在一般均衡中确定，且贸易成本具有灵活性。最后，我们通过结构性估计模型来量化贸易的第二 Moment 效应——从农民在观察到的作物选择下的均值-方差前沿的梯度中恢复他们的风险-回报偏好。公路和农村银行网络的同时扩展提高了农民实际收入的平均值和方差，第一 Moment 效应占主导地位，使得预期福利增加了4.4%。但如果农村银行服务保持不变，福利收益将只有一半，因为风险缓解技术使农民能够利用更高风险、更高回报的分配。

abstract.text: We study discrete panel data methods where unobserved heterogeneity is revealed in a first step, in environments where population heterogeneity is not discrete. We focus on two‐step grouped fixed‐effects (GFE) estimators, where individuals are first classified into groups using kmeans clustering, and the model is then estimated allowing for group‐specific heterogeneity. Our framework relies on two key properties: heterogeneity is a function—possibly nonlinear and time‐varying—of a low‐dimensional continuous latent type, and informative moments are available for classification. We illustrate the method in a model of wages and labor market participation, and in a probit model with time‐varying heterogeneity. We derive asymptotic expansions of two‐step GFE estimators as the number of groups grows with the two dimensions of the panel. We propose a data‐driven rule for the number of groups, and discuss bias reduction and inference.

10.3982/ecta15238.abstractZh: 我们研究了离散面板数据方法，其中未观测到的异质性在第一步中得以揭示，这些环境中的群体异质性并非离散的。我们重点关注两步分组固定效应（GFE）估计器，即首先使用kmeans聚类将个体分类为不同的组，然后估计模型时考虑组间异质性。我们的框架基于两个关键特性：异质性是低维连续潜在变量的函数——可能是非线性的且随时间变化——并且分类时存在信息性矩。我们在工资和劳动力市场参与模型以及一个具有时间变化异质性的probit模型中展示了该方法的应用。我们推导了随着组数增加，两步GFE估计器的渐近展开式，这些展开式与面板的两个维度相关。我们提出了一种基于数据的组数规则，并讨论了偏差减少和推断问题。

abstract.text: We study the optimal design of corporate taxation and R&D policies as a dynamic mechanism design problem with spillovers. Firms have heterogeneous research productivity, and that research productivity is private information. There are non‐internalized technological spillovers across firms, but the asymmetric information prevents the government from correcting them in the first best way. We highlight that key parameters for the optimal policies are (i) the relative complementarities between observable R&D investments, unobservable R&D inputs, and firm research productivity, (ii) the dispersion and persistence of firms' research productivities, and (iii) the magnitude of technological spillovers across firms. We estimate our model using firm‐level data matched to patent data and quantify the optimal policies. In the data, high research productivity firms get disproportionately higher returns to R&D investments than lower productivity firms. Very simple innovation policies, such as linear corporate taxes combined with a nonlinear R&D subsidy—which provides lower marginal subsidies at higher R&D levels—can do almost as well as the unrestricted optimal policies. Our formulas and theoretical and numerical methods are more broadly applicable to the provision of firm incentives in dynamic settings with asymmetric information and spillovers, and to firm taxation more generally.

10.3982/ecta15445.abstractZh: 我们研究企业税收和研发政策的最优设计，将其视为一个具有溢出效应的动态机制设计问题。企业的研发生产力存在异质性，而这一生产力是私人信息。企业之间存在非内部化的技术溢出效应，但由于信息不对称，政府无法以最优方式对这些效应进行纠正。我们指出，最优政策的关键参数包括：(i) 可观测的研发投资、不可观测的研发投入与企业研发生产力之间的相对互补性；(ii) 企业研发生产力的分散性和持久性；(iii) 企业间技术溢出效应的大小。我们采用与专利数据相匹配的企业层面数据来估计模型，并量化最优政策。数据显示，高研发生产力的企业从研发投资中获得的回报远高于低生产力企业。非常简单的创新政策，例如线性企业税收与非线性研发补贴相结合——在较高的研发水平下提供较低的边际补贴——几乎可以达到不受限制的最优政策的效果。我们的公式以及理论和数值方法，在具有信息不对称和溢出效应的动态环境中，对提供企业激励措施以及企业税收问题具有更广泛的应用价值。

abstract.text: This paper develops a model of Bayesian learning from online reviews and investigates the conditions for learning the quality of a product and the speed of learning under different rating systems. A rating system provides information about reviews left by previous customers. observe the ratings of a product and decide whether to purchase and review it. We study learning dynamics under two classes of rating systems: full history , where customers see the full history of reviews, and summary statistics , where the platform reports some summary statistics of past reviews. In both cases, learning dynamics are complicated by a selection effect —the types of users who purchase the good, and thus their overall satisfaction and reviews depend on the information available at the time of purchase. We provide conditions for complete learning and characterize and compare its speed under full history and summary statistics. We also show that providing more information does not always lead to faster learning, but strictly finer rating systems do.

10.3982/ecta15847.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个基于贝叶斯学习的在线评论模型，并研究了在不同评分系统下学习产品质量及学习速度的条件。评分系统提供了以往顾客留下的评论信息，用户通过观察产品的评分来决定是否购买并进行评价。我们研究了两种评分系统下的学习动态：一种是完整历史系统，用户可以看到所有评论的历史记录；另一种是摘要统计系统，平台会提供过去评论的一些摘要统计信息。在这两种情况下，学习动态都受到选择效应的影响——购买产品的用户类型以及他们的整体满意度和评论取决于购买时可用的信息。我们提出了完全学习的条件，并描述了在完整历史系统和摘要统计系统下学习速度的差异。此外，我们还指出，提供更多信息并不总是能加快学习速度，而更精细的评分系统确实能实现这一点。

abstract.text: The agent is modeled as a current self that optimally incurs a cognitive cost of empathizing with future selves. The model unifies well‐known experimental and empirical findings in intertemporal choice and enriches the multiple selves model with a notion of self‐control. The defining feature of the model is magnitude‐decreasing impatience: greater patience toward larger rewards. Two behavioral definitions of magnitude‐decreasing impatience are provided and the model is characterized under each of them.

10.3982/ecta16050.abstractZh: 该代理被建模为一个“当前自我”，其最优行为是为未来的自我付出认知成本。该模型整合了关于跨时期选择的知名实验和实证研究结果，并通过“自我控制”的概念丰富了多自我模型。该模型的一个关键特征是“幅度递减的急躁”：对更大奖励表现出更大的耐心。文中提供了两种关于“幅度递减的急躁”的行为定义，并分别描述了在该两种定义下该模型的特点。

abstract.text: Airfares fluctuate due to demand shocks and intertemporal variation in willingness to pay. I estimate a model of dynamic airline pricing accounting for both sources of price adjustments using flight‐level data. I use the model estimates to evaluate the welfare effects of dynamic airline pricing. Relative to uniform pricing, dynamic pricing benefits early‐arriving, leisure consumers at the expense of late‐arriving, business travelers. Although dynamic pricing ensures seat availability for business travelers, these consumers are then charged higher prices. When aggregated over markets, welfare is higher under dynamic pricing than under uniform pricing. The direction of the welfare effect at the market level depends on whether dynamic price adjustments are mainly driven by demand shocks or by changes in the overall demand elasticity.

10.3982/ecta16180.abstractZh: 机票价格会因需求冲击和支付意愿的时间差异而波动。我建立了一个动态航空公司定价模型，该模型考虑了这两种价格调整因素，并使用了航班级别数据。我利用模型估计结果来评估动态航空公司定价的福利效应。与统一定价相比，动态定价使提前到达的休闲消费者受益，而牺牲了晚到商务旅客的利益。尽管动态定价确保了商务旅客的座位可用性，但这些消费者的支付价格却更高。从整体市场来看，动态定价下的福利水平高于统一定价。市场层面的福利效应方向取决于动态价格调整主要是由需求冲击驱动，还是由整体需求弹性的变化所驱动。

abstract.text: We show that demanding team incentives to be robust to nonquantifiable uncertainty about the game played by the agents leads to contracts that align the agents' interests. Such contracts have a natural interpretation as team‐based compensation. Under budget balance they reduce to linear contracts, thus identifying profit‐sharing, or equity, as an optimal contract absent a sink or a source of funds. A linear contract also gives the best profit guarantee to an outside residual claimant. These contracts still suffer from the free‐rider problem, but a positive guarantee obtains if and only if the technology known to the contract designer is sufficiently productive.

10.3982/ecta16280.abstractZh: 我们指出，要求团队激励措施能够抵御关于代理人所参与游戏的不可量化不确定性，这会导致合同能够协调代理人的利益。这样的合同自然可以被理解为基于团队的补偿机制。在预算平衡的情况下，这些合同可以简化为线性合同，从而将利润分享或股权视为一种最优合同，除非存在资金池或资金来源。线性合同还能为外部剩余索赔者提供最佳的利润保障。这些合同仍然存在搭便车问题，但只有当合同设计者所了解的技术具有足够的高产性时，才能获得积极的保障。

abstract.text: Many economic and causal parameters depend on nonparametric or high dimensional first steps. We give a general construction of locally robust/orthogonal moment functions for GMM, where first steps have no effect, locally, on average moment functions. Using these orthogonal moments reduces model selection and regularization bias, as is important in many applications, especially for machine learning first steps. Also, associated standard errors are robust to misspecification when there is the same number of moment functions as parameters of interest. We use these orthogonal moments and cross‐fitting to construct debiased machine learning estimators of functions of high dimensional conditional quantiles and of dynamic discrete choice parameters with high dimensional state variables. We show that additional first steps needed for the orthogonal moment functions have no effect, globally, on average orthogonal moment functions. We give a general approach to estimating those additional first steps. We characterize double robustness and give a variety of new doubly robust moment functions. We give general and simple regularity conditions for asymptotic theory.

10.3982/ecta16294.abstractZh: 许多经济与因果参数依赖于非参数性或高维的初始步骤。我们提出了一种用于广义矩估计的局部稳健/正交矩函数的通用构造方法，其中初始步骤在局部上不会对平均矩函数产生影响。使用这些正交矩可以减少模型选择偏差和正则化偏差，这在许多应用中非常重要，尤其是在机器学习初始步骤方面。此外，当矩函数的数量与感兴趣的参数数量相同时，相关标准误差对误设具有鲁棒性。我们利用这些正交矩和交叉拟合来构建无偏差的机器学习估计器，用于估计高维条件分位数函数以及具有高维状态变量的动态离散选择参数。我们证明，用于正交矩函数的额外初始步骤在全局上不会对平均正交矩函数产生影响。我们提供了一种估计这些额外初始步骤的通用方法。我们还描述了双重稳健性，并提出了多种新的双重稳健矩函数。我们为渐近理论提供了通用且简单的正则性条件。

abstract.text: We study the optimal design of tests with manipulable inputs. Tests take a unidimensional state of the world as input and output, an informative signal to guide a receiver's approve or reject decision. The receiver wishes to only approve states that comply with her baseline standard. An agent with a preference for approval can covertly falsify the state of the world at a cost. We characterize receiver‐optimal tests and show they rely on productive falsification by compliant states. They work by setting a more stringent operational standard, and granting noncompliant states a positive approval probability to deter them from falsifying to the standard. We also study how falsification‐detection technologies improve optimal tests. They allow the designer to build an implicit cost of falsification into the test, in the form of signal devaluations. Exploiting this channel requires enriching the signal space.

10.3982/ecta16346.abstractZh: 我们研究了具有可操控输入的最优测试设计。这些测试以一维的世界状态作为输入和输出，并提供一个信息信号来指导接收者做出批准或拒绝的决策。接收者只希望批准符合其基准标准的状态。具有批准偏好的代理可以秘密地以一定成本伪造世界状态。我们描述了接收者最优测试的特点，并表明这些测试依赖于对合规状态的积极伪造。它们通过设定更严格的操作标准，并赋予不合规状态一定的批准概率来阻止其伪造数据。我们还研究了伪造检测技术如何改进最优测试。这些技术允许设计者在测试中引入一种隐性伪造成本，即信号贬值。利用这一机制需要丰富信号空间。

abstract.text: We study the problem of aggregating private information in elections with two or more alternatives for a large family of scoring rules. We introduce a feasibility condition, the linear refinement condition , that characterizes when information can be aggregated asymptotically as the electorate grows large: there must exist a utility function, linear in distributions over signals, sharing the same top alternative as the primitive utility function. Our results complement the existing work where strong assumptions are imposed on the environment, and caution against potential false positives when too much structure is imposed.

10.3982/ecta16376.abstractZh: 我们研究了在选举中聚合私人信息的问题，其中存在两个或更多备选方案，适用于一系列评分规则。我们引入了一个可行性条件，即线性细化条件，用于判断在选民数量增加的情况下，信息是否可以渐进地聚合：必须存在一个效用函数，该函数对信号分布呈线性关系，并且与原始效用函数共享同一个最高备选方案。我们的研究结果补充了现有研究，这些研究对环境提出了严格的假设，并提醒人们避免在施加过多结构时可能出现的误判。

abstract.text: We study the competitive provision and endogenous acquisition of political information. Our main result identifies a natural equilibrium channel through which a more competitive market decreases the efficiency of policy outcomes. A critical insight we put forward is that competition among information providers leads to informational specialization: firms provide relatively less information on issues that are of common interest and relatively more information on issues on which agents' preferences are heterogeneous. This enables agents to acquire information about different aspects of the policy, specifically, those that are particularly important to them. This leads to an increase in social disagreement, which has negative welfare implications. We establish that, in large enough societies, competition makes every agent worse off by decreasing the utility that she derives from the policy outcome. Furthermore, we show that this decline cannot be compensated by the decrease in prices resulting from competition.

10.3982/ecta16417.abstractZh: 我们研究了政治信息的竞争性提供与内生性获取机制。我们的主要发现指出，竞争性的市场会降低政策结果的效率。我们提出的一个关键见解是，信息提供者的竞争会导致信息的专业化：企业在共同关注的问题上提供较少的信息，而在代理人偏好差异较大的问题上则提供较多信息。这使得代理人能够获取关于政策不同方面的信息，尤其是对他们来说特别重要的信息。这导致了社会分歧的增加，从而带来负面的福利影响。我们证明，在足够大的社会中，竞争会使每个代理人的状况恶化，因为政策结果带来的效用降低。此外，我们还表明，这种下降无法通过竞争导致的价格下降来弥补。

abstract.text: We evaluate and partially challenge the household leverage view of the Great Recession. In the data, employment and consumption declined more in U.S. states where household debt declined more. We study a model of a monetary union composed of many regions in which liquidity constraints shape the response of employment and consumption to changes in debt. We estimate the model with Bayesian methods combining state and aggregate data. Changes in household credit explain 40% of the differential rise and fall of employment across states, but a small fraction of the aggregate employment decline in 2007–2010. Nevertheless, since household deleveraging was gradual, credit shocks greatly slowed the recovery.

10.3982/ecta16455.abstractZh: 我们评估并部分质疑了关于大衰退的家庭杠杆观点。数据显示，在美国那些家庭债务减少较多的州，就业和消费下降幅度更大。我们研究了一个由多个地区组成的货币联盟模型，其中流动性限制影响了就业和消费对债务变化的反应。我们使用贝叶斯方法结合州级数据和总体数据来估计该模型。家庭信贷的变化解释了各州就业差异的40%，但仅占2007-2010年间总体就业下降的很小一部分。尽管如此，由于家庭去杠杆化是渐进的，信贷冲击大大减缓了经济复苏的速度。

abstract.text: We use household‐level panel data from China and a quantitative framework to document the extent and consequences of factor misallocation in agriculture. We find that there are substantial within‐village frictions in both the land and capital markets linked to land institutions in rural China that disproportionately constrain the more productive farmers. These frictions reduce aggregate agricultural productivity by affecting two key margins: (1) the allocation of resources across farmers (misallocation) and (2) the allocation of workers across sectors, in particular the type of farmers who operate in agriculture (selection). Selection substantially amplifies the productivity effect of distortionary policies by affecting occupational choices that worsen average ability in agriculture.

10.3982/ecta16598.abstractZh: 我们采用了来自中国的家庭层面面板数据，并运用定量框架来研究农业领域要素错配的程度和后果。研究发现，在中国农村，土地市场和资本市场都存在显著的村内摩擦，这些摩擦与土地制度有关，严重限制了那些生产力较高的农民的发展。这些摩擦通过影响两个关键领域，降低了农业的总生产力：(1)农民之间的资源分配（错配）；(2)劳动力在不同行业的分配，尤其是从事农业生产的农民的选择。选择效应显著放大了扭曲性政策对生产力的负面影响，因为它影响了职业选择，从而恶化了农业的平均能力。

abstract.text: We develop a tractable model of banks' liquidity management with an over‐the‐counter interbank market to study the credit channel of monetary policy. Deposits circulate randomly across banks and must be settled with reserves. We show how monetary policy affects the banking system by altering the trade‐off between profiting from lending and incurring greater liquidity risk. We present two applications of the theory, one involving the connection between the implementation of monetary policy and the pass‐through to lending rates, and another considering a quantitative decomposition behind the collapse in bank lending during the 2008 financial crisis. Our analysis underscores the importance of liquidity frictions and the functioning of interbank markets for the conduct of monetary policy.

10.3982/ecta16599.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个适用于银行流动性管理的模型，该模型以场外银行间市场为研究对象，以研究货币政策的信贷渠道效应。存款在银行之间随机流动，并且必须以准备金进行结算。我们展示了货币政策如何通过改变银行从贷款中获利的权衡关系，从而影响整个银行系统。我们提出了该理论的两个应用案例：一个涉及货币政策实施与贷款利率传递之间的关系；另一个则探讨了2008年金融危机期间银行贷款减少背后的量化原因。我们的分析强调了流动性摩擦以及银行间市场运作对货币政策实施的重要性。

abstract.text: The analysis of dynamic games hinges on assumptions about players' actions and beliefs at information sets that are not expected to be reached during game play. Under the standard notion of sequential rationality, these assumptions cannot be tested on the basis of observed, on‐path behavior. This paper introduces a novel optimality criterion, structural rationality , which addresses this concern. In any dynamic game, structural rationality implies weak sequential rationality (Reny (1992)). If players are structurally rational, assumptions about on‐path and off‐path beliefs concerning off‐path actions can be tested via suitable “side bets.” Structural rationality also provides a theoretical rationale for the use of a novel version of the strategy method (Selten (1967)) in experiments.

10.3982/ecta16666.abstractZh: 动态博弈的分析依赖于关于玩家在博弈过程中不会达到的信息集上的行为和信念的假设。根据标准的序贯理性概念，这些假设无法基于观察到的路径行为来检验。本文提出了一种新颖的最优性标准——结构理性，以解决这一问题。在任何动态博弈中，结构理性意味着弱序贯理性（Reny, 1992）。如果玩家具有结构理性，那么关于路径内和路径外信念的假设可以通过适当的“边注”来检验。结构理性还为在实验中使用策略方法的新型版本提供了理论依据（Selten, 1967）。

abstract.text: We develop a tool akin to the revelation principle for dynamic mechanism‐selection games in which the designer can only commit to short‐term mechanisms. We identify a canonical class of mechanisms rich enough to replicate the outcomes of any equilibrium in a mechanism‐selection game between an uninformed designer and a privately informed agent. A cornerstone of our methodology is the idea that a mechanism should encode not only the rules that determine the allocation, but also the information the designer obtains from the interaction with the agent. Therefore, how much the designer learns, which is the key tension in design with limited commitment, becomes an explicit part of the design. Our result simplifies the search for the designer‐optimal outcome by reducing the agent's behavior to a series of participation, truth telling, and Bayes' plausibility constraints the mechanisms must satisfy.

10.3982/ecta16846.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种类似于“揭示原则”的工具，用于动态机制选择游戏。在这种游戏中，设计者只能承诺采用短期机制。我们确定了一个典型的机制类别，这些机制足够丰富，能够复制无信息设计者与私人知情代理人之间任何均衡结果。我们方法论的一个核心思想是，一个机制不仅应包含决定分配的规则，还应包含设计者从与代理人互动中获得的 정보。因此，设计者学到的信息量——这是有限承诺下设计中的关键矛盾点——成为设计的一个明确组成部分。我们的结果简化了寻找设计者最优结果的流程，通过将代理人的行为简化为一系列参与、真相告知以及机制必须满足的贝叶斯合理性约束，从而简化了这一过程。

abstract.text: We study a fiscal policy model in which the government is present‐biased towards public spending. Society chooses a fiscal rule to trade off the benefit of committing the government to not overspend against the benefit of granting it flexibility to react to privately observed shocks to the value of spending. Unlike prior work, we examine rules under limited enforcement: the government has full policy discretion and can only be incentivized to comply with a rule via the use of penalties which are joint and bounded. We show that optimal incentives must be bang‐bang. Moreover, under a distributional condition, the optimal rule is a maximally enforced deficit limit, triggering the maximum feasible penalty whenever violated. Violation optimally occurs under high enough shocks if and only if available penalties are weak and such shocks are relatively unlikely. We derive comparative statics showing how rules should be calibrated to features of the environment.

10.3982/ecta16962.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个财政政策模型，其中政府倾向于偏向公共支出。社会选择一个财政规则，以权衡将政府约束在不过度支出的好处与给予其灵活性以应对私人观察到的支出价值冲击的好处。与以往的研究不同，我们考察了在有限执行情况下的规则：政府拥有完全的政策自由裁量权，只能通过联合且有上限的处罚措施来激励其遵守规则。我们表明，最优激励必须是“砰砰”式的。此外，在分配条件下，最优规则是一个最大化的赤字限制，一旦违反就会触发最大可行的处罚。只有在可用的处罚措施较弱且此类冲击相对不太可能发生时，违规行为才会在足够大的冲击下发生。我们推导出了比较静态分析，展示了如何根据环境特征来校准规则。

abstract.text: We study the design of approval rules when costly experimentation must be delegated to an agent with misaligned preferences. When the agent has the option to end experimentation, we show that in contrast to standard stopping problems, the optimal approval rule must be history‐dependent. We characterize the optimal rule and show the approval threshold moves downward over the course of experimentation. We find that private information may qualitatively change the optimal mechanism: an agent can choose a fast‐track option in the form of an initially depressed approval threshold. On expiry of the fast track, the threshold jumps up, introducing more stringent standards. Our results provide a theoretical foundation for both the loosening of approval standards on longer experimentation paths and fast‐track mechanisms.

10.3982/ecta17021.abstractZh: 我们研究了在昂贵的实验必须委托给偏好不准确的代理人时，审批规则的设计问题。当代理人有选择终止实验的选项时，我们发现与标准的终止问题不同，最优的审批规则必须依赖于历史信息。我们描述了最优规则的特点，并展示了审批阈值在实验过程中会下降。我们发现，私人信息可能会改变最优机制的本质：代理人可以选择一个快速通道选项，即最初降低审批阈值。在快速通道结束后，审批阈值会上升，引入更严格的标准。我们的研究结果为长期实验过程中审批标准的放宽以及快速通道机制提供了理论依据。

abstract.text: This paper provides evidence that exposure to illegal labor markets during childhood leads to the formation of industry‐specific human capital at an early age, putting children on a criminal life path. Using the timing of U.S. antidrug policies, I show that when the return to illegal activities increases in coca suitable areas in Peru, parents increase the use of child labor for coca farming, putting children on a criminal life path. Using administrative records, I show that affected children are about 30% more likely to be incarcerated for violent and drug‐related crimes as adults. No effect in criminality is found for individuals that grow up working in places where the coca produced goes primarily to the legal sector, suggesting that it is the accumulation of human capital specific to the illegal industry that fosters criminal careers. However, the rollout of a conditional cash transfer program that encourages schooling mitigates the effects of exposure to illegal industries, providing further evidence on the mechanisms.

10.3982/ecta17082.abstractZh: 本文提供了证据，表明童年时期接触非法劳动力市场会导致儿童在早期形成特定行业的人力资本，从而使其走上犯罪道路。通过研究美国禁毒政策的实施时间，我发现当秘鲁某些地区可卡因种植带来的收益增加时，父母会更多地使用童工从事可卡因种植，从而使儿童走上犯罪道路。根据行政记录，受影响的儿童成年后因暴力及毒品相关犯罪而被监禁的可能性高出约30%。而那些在可卡因主要供应给合法行业的地方长大的个体，则没有表现出犯罪倾向，这表明是特定于非法行业的人力资本积累促成了犯罪生涯。然而，一项鼓励儿童接受教育的有条件现金转移计划的实施，能够减轻接触非法行业的负面影响，进一步证明了相关机制的存在。

abstract.text: Many schools in large urban districts have more applicants than seats. Centralized school assignment algorithms ration seats at over‐subscribed schools using randomly assigned lottery numbers, non‐lottery tie‐breakers like test scores, or both. The New York City public high school match illustrates the latter, using test scores and other criteria to rank applicants at the city's screened schools, combined with lottery tie‐breaking at the rest. We show how to identify causal effects of school attendance in such settings. Our approach generalizes regression discontinuity methods to allow for multiple treatments and multiple running variables, some of which are randomly assigned. The key to this generalization is a local propensity score that quantifies the school assignment probabilities induced by lottery and non‐lottery tie‐breakers. The utility of the local propensity score is demonstrated in an assessment of the predictive value of New York City's school report cards. Schools that earn the highest report card grade indeed improve SAT math scores and increase graduation rates, though by much less than OLS estimates suggest. Selection bias in OLS estimates of grade effects is egregious for screened schools.

10.3982/ecta17125.abstractZh: 许多大型城市区的学校申请人数多于招生名额。集中式的学校分配算法通过随机分配的抽签号码，或者结合使用非抽签的替代标准（如考试成绩）来分配名额给申请人数超过招生名额的学校。纽约市公立高中的匹配机制就采用了后一种方法，它利用考试成绩和其他标准对申请者进行排名，并在剩余学校中通过抽签来打破排名的平局。我们展示了如何在这种环境下识别学校就读的因果效应。我们的方法将回归不连续法扩展为允许多种处理方式和多个运行变量，其中一些变量是随机分配的。这种扩展的关键在于使用局部倾向得分，它量化了由抽签和非抽签替代标准引起的学校分配概率。在评估纽约市学校报告卡的预测价值时，我们证明了局部倾向得分的实用性。获得最高等级报告卡的学校确实提升了SAT数学成绩和毕业率，不过提升幅度远小于OLS估计所显示的。对于筛选过的学校来说，OLS估计中的选择偏差问题非常严重。

abstract.text: We document a novel bidding pattern observed in procurement auctions from Japan: winning bids tend to be isolated, and there is a missing mass of close losing bids. This pattern is suspicious in the following sense: its extreme forms are inconsistent with competitive behavior under arbitrary information structures. Building on this observation, we develop systematic tests of competitive behavior in procurement auctions that allow for general information structures as well as nonstationary unobserved heterogeneity. We provide an empirical exploration of our tests, and show they can help identify other suspicious patterns in the data.

10.3982/ecta17155.abstractZh: 我们记录了在日本采购拍卖中观察到的一种新颖的竞标模式：中标竞标往往较为孤立，而大量接近落标的竞标则缺失。这种模式令人怀疑，因为其极端形式与在任意信息结构下的竞争行为不符。基于这一观察，我们开发了系统性的测试方法来评估采购拍卖中的竞争行为，这些测试能够适用于一般的信息结构以及非平稳的未观测异质性。我们对这些测试进行了实证探索，并表明它们有助于识别数据中的其他可疑模式。

abstract.text: This paper considers maximum likelihood (ML) estimation in a large class of models with hidden Markov regimes. We investigate consistency of the ML estimator and local asymptotic normality for the models under general conditions, which allow for autoregressive dynamics in the observable process, Markov regime sequences with covariate‐dependent transition matrices, and possible model misspecification. A Monte Carlo study examines the finite‐sample properties of the ML estimator in correctly specified and misspecified models. An empirical application is also discussed.

10.3982/ecta17249.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在具有隐藏马尔可夫机制的大量模型中的最大似然估计方法。我们研究了在一般条件下，最大似然估计量的一致性以及模型的局部渐近正态性。这些条件包括可观测过程中的自回归动态、具有协变量依赖的转移矩阵的马尔可夫机制序列，以及可能的模型误设定情况。通过蒙特卡洛方法，我们研究了在正确设定和误设定模型下，最大似然估计量的有限样本性质。此外，本文还讨论了一个实证应用案例。

abstract.text: We formulate a generalization of the traditional medium‐of‐exchange function of money in contexts where there is imperfect competition in the intermediation of credit, settlement, or payment services used to conduct transactions. We find that the option to settle transactions with money strengthens the stance of sellers of goods and services in relation to intermediaries, and show this mechanism is operative even for sellers who never exercise the option to sell for money. These latent money demand considerations imply that in general, in contrast to current conventional wisdom in policy‐oriented research in monetary economics, monetary policy can remain effective through medium‐of‐exchange transmission channels—even in highly developed credit economies where the share of monetary transactions is negligible.

10.3982/ecta17319.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种对传统货币交换媒介功能的概括性描述，适用于信用中介、结算或支付服务存在不完全竞争的情况。我们发现，使用货币进行结算的选择能够增强商品和服务销售者在与中介之间的地位，并且这种机制即使对于那些从未行使货币销售选择的企业来说也是有效的。这些潜在的货币需求考虑意味着，与当前货币经济学政策导向研究中的普遍观点不同，货币政策仍然可以通过交换媒介的传递渠道发挥作用——即使是在信用发达、货币交易比例微不足道的经济体中也是如此。

abstract.text: We propose an analytical method to analyze the propagation of an aggregate shock in a broad class of sticky‐price models. The method is based on the eigenvalue‐eigenfunction representation of the dynamics of the cross‐sectional distribution of firms' desired adjustments. A key novelty is that we can approximate the whole profile of the impulse response for any moment of interest in response to an aggregate shock (any displacement of the invariant distribution). We present several applications for an economy with low inflation and idiosyncratic shocks. We show that the shape of the impulse response of the canonical menu cost model is fully encoded by a single parameter, just like the Calvo model, although the shapes are very different. A model with a quadratic hazard function, arguably a good fit to the micro data on price setting, yields an impulse response that is close to the canonical menu cost model.

10.3982/ecta17348.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种分析方法，用于分析在广泛的一类粘性价格模型中，整体冲击的传播过程。该方法基于企业期望调整的横截面分布动态的特征值-特征函数表示法。我们的一个关键创新在于，我们可以近似地得到对任何感兴趣时刻的整体冲击响应曲线（即不变分布的任何位移）。我们为低通胀和特异性冲击的经济体展示了该方法的几个应用案例。结果表明，规范菜单成本模型的冲击响应形状可以通过一个单一参数完全描述，这与Calvo模型类似，尽管两者的形状差异很大。一个具有二次风险函数的模型，被认为很好地拟合了价格设定的微观数据，其冲击响应与规范菜单成本模型非常接近。

abstract.text: We study a class of models of moral hazard in which a principal contracts with a counterparty, which may have its own internal organizational structure. The principal has non‐Bayesian uncertainty as to what actions might be taken in response to the contract, and wishes to maximize her worst‐case payoff. We identify conditions on the counterparty's possible responses to any given contract that imply that a linear contract solves this maxmin problem. In conjunction with a Richness property motivated by much previous literature, we identify a Responsiveness property that is sufficient—and, in an appropriate sense, also necessary—to ensure that linear contracts are optimal. We illustrate by contrasting several possible models of contracting in hierarchies. The analysis demonstrates how one can distill key features of contracting models that allow their findings to be carried beyond the bilateral setting.

10.3982/ecta17386.abstractZh: 我们研究了一类道德风险模型，其中一方与可能拥有自身内部组织结构的另一方签订合同。对于合同响应可能采取的行动，一方存在非贝叶斯不确定性，并希望最大化其最坏情况下的收益。我们确定了对方对特定合同可能响应的条件，这些条件表明线性合同可以解决这个最大最小问题。结合大量先前文献所提出的丰富性属性，我们还发现了一个响应性属性，该属性是确保线性合同最优的充分条件——在适当的意义上也是必要条件。我们通过对比几种可能的层级契约模型来说明这一点。分析表明，可以提炼出契约模型的关键特征，使其发现能够超越双边契约的框架得到应用。

abstract.text: This study provides a new theoretical result that a decline in the long‐term interest rate can trigger a stronger investment response by market leaders relative to market followers, thereby leading to more concentrated markets, higher profits, and lower aggregate productivity growth. This strategic effect of lower interest rates on market concentration implies that aggregate productivity growth declines as the interest rate approaches zero. The framework is relevant for antitrust policy in a low interest rate environment, and it provides a unified explanation for rising market concentration and falling productivity growth as interest rates in the economy have fallen to extremely low levels.
