10.3982/ecta17408.abstractZh: 本研究提出了一个新的理论结果：长期利率的下降可以促使市场领导者对市场追随者产生更强的投资反应，从而导致市场更加集中、利润增加以及整体生产率增长下降。较低利率对市场集中度的这种战略效应意味着，随着利率接近零，整体生产率增长会下降。这一框架对于低利率环境下的反垄断政策具有相关性，并为市场集中度上升以及生产率增长下降提供了统一的解释，尤其是在经济中的利率降至极低水平时。

abstract.text: We study the role of global financial intermediaries in international lending. We construct a model of the world economy, in which heterogeneous borrowers issue risky securities purchased by financial intermediaries. Aggregate shocks transmit internationally through financial intermediaries' net worth. The strength of this transmission is governed by the degree of frictions intermediaries face in financing their risky investments. We provide direct empirical evidence on this mechanism showing that around Lehman Brothers' bankruptcy, emerging‐market bonds held by more distressed global banks experienced larger price contractions. A quantitative analysis of the model shows that global financial intermediaries play a relevant role in driving borrowing‐cost and consumption fluctuations in emerging‐market economies, during both debt crises and regular business cycles. The portfolio of financial intermediaries and the distribution of bond holdings in the world economy are key to determine aggregate dynamics.

10.3982/ecta17433.abstractZh: 我们研究了全球金融中介在国际贷款中的作用。我们构建了一个世界经济模型，在该模型中，不同性质的借款人发行风险证券，这些证券由金融中介购买。整体冲击通过金融中介的净资产在国际间传递。这种传递的强度受到金融中介在融资风险投资过程中所面临的摩擦程度的影响。我们提供了关于这一机制的直接实证证据，显示在雷曼兄弟破产期间，那些由更多陷入困境的全球银行持有的新兴市场债券出现了更大的价格收缩。对该模型的定量分析表明，在全球金融危机和正常商业周期期间，全球金融中介在驱动新兴市场经济的借贷成本和消费波动方面发挥着重要作用。金融中介的投资组合以及全球经济中债券持有量的分布，是确定整体动态的关键因素。

abstract.text: We study the educational choices of children of immigrants in a tracked school system. We first show that immigrants in Italy enroll disproportionately into vocational high schools, as opposed to technical and academically‐oriented ones, compared to natives of similar ability. The gap is greater for male students and it mirrors an analogous differential in grade retention. We then estimate the impact of a large‐scale, randomized intervention providing tutoring and career counseling to high‐ability immigrant students. Male treated students increase their probability of enrolling into the high track to the same level of natives, also closing the gap in grade retention. There are no significant effects on immigrant girls, who exhibit similar choices and performance as native ones in absence of the intervention. Increases in academic motivation and changes in teachers' recommendation regarding high school choice explain a sizable portion of the effect. Finally, we find positive spillovers on immigrant classmates of treated students, while there is no effect on native classmates.

10.3982/ecta17458.abstractZh: 我们研究了在跟踪式学校系统中，移民子女的教育选择。首先，我们发现与具有相似能力的本地学生相比，意大利的移民更倾向于进入职业高中，而非技术类或学术导向型高中。这种差异在男性学生中更为明显，并且与留级率的差异相呼应。随后，我们评估了一项大规模随机干预措施的影响，该措施为高能力的移民学生提供辅导和职业咨询。接受干预的男性学生进入高轨道高中的概率与本地学生相当，留级率的差异也得到了缩小。然而，对移民女孩来说，这种干预并没有显著效果，因为在没有干预的情况下，她们的选择和表现与本地学生相似。学术动机的提高以及教师对高中选择的建议变化，解释了这一效果的一部分。最后，我们发现接受干预的学生的移民同学受到了积极影响，而对本地同学则没有这种影响。

abstract.text: We propose a class of multiple‐prior representations of preferences under ambiguity, where the belief the decision‐maker (DM) uses to evaluate an uncertain prospect is the outcome of a game played by two conflicting forces, Pessimism and Optimism. The model does not restrict the sign of the DM's ambiguity attitude, and we show that it provides a unified framework through which to characterize different degrees of ambiguity aversion, and to represent the co‐existence of negative and positive ambiguity attitudes within individuals as documented in experiments. We prove that our baseline representation, dual‐self expected utility (DSEU) , yields a novel representation of the class of invariant biseparable preferences (Ghirardato, Maccheroni, and Marinacci (2004)), which drops uncertainty aversion from maxmin expected utility (Gilboa and Schmeidler (1989)), while extensions of DSEU allow for more general departures from independence. We also provide foundations for a generalization of prior‐by‐prior belief updating to our model.

10.3982/ecta17502.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种在不确定性下的多先验偏好表示类，其中决策者用来评估不确定前景的信念是两种相互冲突的力量——悲观主义和乐观主义之间博弈的结果。该模型不限制决策者不确定性态度的符号，并且我们证明了它提供了一个统一的框架，可以用来描述不同程度的不确定性厌恶，以及实验中记录的个体内部负面和正面不确定性态度的共存。我们证明，我们的基础表示——双重自我期望效用（DSEU）——提供了一种新的表示方式，用于描述不变的双分离偏好类（Ghirardato、Maccheroni和Marinacci，2004年），这种方式将不确定性厌恶从最大最小期望效用（Gilboa和Schmeidler，1989年）中分离出来，而DSEU的扩展则允许更一般的独立性偏离。我们还为将先验信念更新方法推广到我们的模型提供了基础。

abstract.text: We introduce the Realized moMents of Disjoint Increments (ReMeDI) paradigm to measure microstructure noise (the deviation of the observed asset prices from the fundamental values caused by market imperfections). We propose consistent estimators of arbitrary moments of the microstructure noise process based on high‐frequency data, where the noise process could be serially dependent, endogenous, and nonstationary. We characterize the limit distributions of the proposed estimators and construct confidence intervals under infill asymptotics. Our simulation and empirical studies show that the ReMeDI approach is very effective to measure the scale and the serial dependence of microstructure noise. Moreover, the estimators are quite robust to model specifications, sample sizes, and data frequencies.

10.3982/ecta17505.abstractZh: 我们提出了“实现的不同时增项”（ReMeDI）范式，用于衡量微观结构噪声（即由于市场缺陷导致的观测资产价格与基本价值的偏差）。我们提出了基于高频数据的微观结构噪声过程任意阶矩的一致估计量，其中噪声过程可能是序列相关的、内生的且非平稳的。我们描述了所提出估计量的极限分布，并在填充渐近条件下构建了置信区间。我们的模拟和实证研究表明，ReMeDI方法在衡量微观结构噪声的规模和序列相关性方面非常有效。此外，这些估计量对模型规格、样本大小和数据频率的变动具有相当的鲁棒性。

abstract.text: We propose and implement a new method to estimate treatment effects in settings where individuals need to be in a certain state (e.g., unemployment) to be eligible for a treatment, treatments may commence at different points in time, and the outcome of interest is realized after the individual left the initial state. An example concerns the effect of training on earnings in subsequent employment. Any evaluation needs to take into account that some of those who are not trained at a certain time in unemployment will leave unemployment before training while others will be trained later. We are interested in effects of the treatment at a certain elapsed duration compared to “no treatment at any subsequent duration.” We prove identification under unconfoundedness and propose inverse probability weighting estimators. A key feature is that weights given to outcome observations of nontreated depend on the remaining time in the initial state. We study effects of a training program for unemployed workers in Sweden. Estimates are positive and sizeable, exceeding those obtained with common static methods. This calls for a reappraisal of training as a tool to bring unemployed back to work.

10.3982/ecta17522.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新方法，用于估计在以下情况下的处理效应：个体需要处于某种状态（例如失业）才有资格接受处理；处理可能在不同的时间点开始；感兴趣的成果是在个体离开初始状态之后实现的。一个例子是培训对后续就业收入的影响。任何评估都需要考虑到，那些在失业期间没有接受培训的人可能会在培训开始之前就离开失业状态，而其他人则会在之后接受培训。我们感兴趣的是，与“在任何后续时间都不接受处理”相比，经过一定时间后接受处理的效应。我们证明了在无混杂条件下可以进行识别，并提出了逆概率加权估计器。一个关键特点是，给予未接受处理个体结果观测值的权重取决于他们在初始状态中剩余的时间。我们研究了瑞典失业工人培训计划的效果。估计结果呈正相关且幅度较大，超过了使用常见静态方法获得的结果。这要求重新评估培训作为帮助失业者重返工作岗位的工具的作用。

abstract.text: More than two decades ago, a well‐known study on heart attack treatments provided evidence suggesting that, when appropriately adjusted for quality, medical care prices were actually declining (Cutler, McClellan, Newhouse, and Remler (1998)). Our paper revisits this subject by leveraging estimates from more than 8000 cost‐effectiveness studies across a broad range of conditions and treatments. We find large quality‐adjusted price declines associated with treatment innovations. To incorporate these quality‐adjusted indexes into an aggregate measure of inflation, we combine an unadjusted medical‐care price index, quality‐adjusted price indexes from treatment innovations, and proxies for the diffusion rate of new technologies. In contrast to official statistics that suggest medical care prices increased by 0.53 percent per year relative to economy‐wide inflation from 2000 to 2017, we find that quality‐adjusted medical care prices declined by 1.33 percent per year over the same period.

10.3982/ecta17635.abstractZh: 二十多年前，一项关于心脏病治疗方法的知名研究指出，当适当调整质量因素后，医疗服务的价格实际上在下降（Cutler、McClellan、Newhouse和Remler，1998年）。我们的论文通过利用超过8000项关于各种治疗方法的成本效益研究的估计数据，重新审视了这一主题。我们发现，治疗方法的创新带来了显著的质量调整后价格下降。为了将这些质量调整后的指数纳入整体通货膨胀指标中，我们结合了未调整的医疗服务价格指数、治疗方法创新带来的质量调整后价格指数，以及新技术扩散率的替代指标。与官方统计数据表明2000年至2017年间医疗服务价格每年相对于整体通货膨胀率上升了0.53%不同，我们发现质量调整后的医疗服务价格在同一时期每年下降了1.33%。

abstract.text: I study a dynamic model in which a decision‐maker (DM) acquires information about the payoffs of different alternatives prior to making a decision. The model's key feature is the flexibility of information: the DM can choose any dynamic signal process as an information source, subject to a flow cost that depends on the informativeness of the signal. Under the optimal policy, the DM acquires a signal that arrives according to a Poisson process . The optimal Poisson signal confirms the DM's prior belief and is sufficiently precise to warrant immediate action. Over time, given the absence of the arrival of a Poisson signal, the DM continues seeking an increasingly precise but less frequent Poisson signal.

10.3982/ecta17787.abstractZh: 我研究了一个动态模型，在该模型中，决策者在做出决策之前会获取关于不同备选方案的收益信息。该模型的一个关键特点是信息的灵活性：决策者可以选择任何动态信号过程作为信息来源，但这一过程需要承担与信号信息量相关的流动成本。在最优策略下，决策者获取的信号遵循泊松过程。最优的泊松信号能够确认决策者的先验信念，并且其精确度足以促使决策者立即采取行动。随着时间的推移，由于不再有泊松信号的到达，决策者会继续寻求越来越精确但频率较低的泊松信号。

abstract.text: Sanctioned by its constitution, India is home to the world's most comprehensive affirmative action program, where historically discriminated groups are protected with vertical reservations implemented as “set asides,” and other disadvantaged groups are protected with horizontal reservations implemented as “minimum guarantees.” A mechanism mandated by the Supreme Court in 1995 suffers from important anomalies, triggering countless litigations in India. Foretelling a recent reform correcting the flawed mechanism, we propose the 2SMG mechanism that resolves all anomalies, and characterize it with desiderata reflecting laws of India. Subsequently rediscovered with a high court judgment and enforced in Gujarat, 2SMG is also endorsed by Saurav Yadav v. State of UP (2020) , in a Supreme Court ruling that rescinded the flawed mechanism. While not explicitly enforced, 2SMG is indirectly enforced for an important subclass of applications in India, because no other mechanism satisfies the new mandates of the Supreme Court.

10.3982/ecta17788.abstractZh: 根据宪法规定，印度拥有世界上最全面的平权行动计划。该计划通过“预留名额”制度保护历史上受歧视的群体，同时通过“最低保障”制度保护其他弱势群体。然而，1995年最高法院规定的这一机制存在重要缺陷，引发了印度的无数诉讼。为了纠正这一缺陷，我们提出了2SMG机制，该机制能够解决所有缺陷问题，并符合印度的法律要求。后来，在高等法院的一项裁决中，2SMG机制得到了重新确认并在古吉拉特邦得到实施。在最高法院撤销该有缺陷的机制后，2SMG机制也得到了认可。虽然2SMG机制并未被明确实施，但由于没有其他机制能够满足最高法院的新要求，该机制在印度某些特定情况下仍被间接实施。

abstract.text: This paper studies causal inference in randomized experiments under network interference. Commonly used models of interference posit that treatments assigned to alters beyond a certain network distance from the ego have no effect on the ego's response. However, this assumption is violated in common models of social interactions. We propose a substantially weaker model of “approximate neighborhood interference” (ANI) under which treatments assigned to alters further from the ego have a smaller, but potentially nonzero, effect on the ego's response. We formally verify that ANI holds for well‐known models of social interactions. Under ANI, restrictions on the network topology, and asymptotics under which the network size increases, we prove that standard inverse‐probability weighting estimators consistently estimate useful exposure effects and are approximately normal. For inference, we consider a network HAC variance estimator. Under a finite population model, we show that the estimator is biased but that the bias can be interpreted as the variance of unit‐level exposure effects. This generalizes Neyman's well‐known result on conservative variance estimation to settings with interference.

10.3982/ecta17841.abstractZh: 本文研究了在网络干扰下随机实验中的因果推断问题。常见的干扰模型认为，分配给与自我距离超过一定网络距离的他人身上的处理措施，对自我的反应没有影响。然而，在常见的社会互动模型中，这一假设被打破了。我们提出了一种相对较弱的“近似邻域干扰”模型，根据该模型，分配给距离自我更远的他人身上的处理措施，虽然影响较小，但可能仍然有非零的影响。我们正式验证了该模型适用于已知的社会互动模型。在近似邻域干扰模型下，通过对网络拓扑的限制以及网络规模增长的渐近分析，我们证明了标准逆概率加权估计量能够一致地估计出有用的暴露效应，并且这些估计量近似呈正态分布。在推断方面，我们考虑了一种网络HAC方差估计量。在有限总体模型下，我们证明了该估计量存在偏差，但这种偏差可以被解释为单位级别暴露效应的方差。这一结果将Neyman关于保守方差估计的著名结果推广到了存在干扰的情况。

abstract.text: We consider nonparametric estimation of a mixed discrete‐continuous distribution under anisotropic smoothness conditions and a possibly increasing number of support points for the discrete part of the distribution. For these settings, we derive lower bounds on the estimation rates. Next, we consider a nonparametric mixture of normals model that uses continuous latent variables for the discrete part of the observations. We show that the posterior in this model contracts at rates that are equal to the derived lower bounds up to a log factor. Thus, Bayesian mixture of normals models can be used for (up to a log factor) optimal adaptive estimation of mixed discrete‐continuous distributions. The proposed model demonstrates excellent performance in simulations mimicking the first stage in the estimation of structural discrete choice models.

10.3982/ecta17884.abstractZh: 我们考虑在各向异性平滑条件下，对混合离散-连续分布进行非参数估计的问题，同时考虑离散部分支持点的数量可能呈递增趋势。针对这些情形，我们推导出了估计速率的下界。接下来，我们考虑一个使用连续潜在变量来表示观测值离散部分的非参数混合正态模型。我们证明，该模型中的后验分布以等于推导出的下界速率收缩，只是会有一个对数因子的影响。因此，贝叶斯混合正态模型可以用于（直到对数因子为止）混合离散-连续分布的最优自适应估计。所提出的模型在模拟结构离散选择模型的第一阶段中表现出优异的性能。

abstract.text: We demonstrate that characterizing the minimal dimension of the term structure of interest rates is more challenging than currently appreciated. The highly structured polynomial patterns of the factor loadings, which are widely reported and discussed in the literature, reflect local correlations of smooth curves across maturities. We derive analytical expressions for the loadings of cross‐sectionally dependent processes that tend to favor a much lower dimension than the true dimension of the underlying factor space. Numerical examples illustrate the significant economic costs of erroneously committing to a parsimoniously parameterized factor space that is informed by standard metrics of goodness‐of‐fit. Our results apply to other assets with a finite maturity structure.

10.3982/ecta17943.abstractZh: 我们证明，确定利率期限结构的最小维度比目前认为的更具挑战性。文献中广泛报道和讨论的因子载荷的高度结构化多项式模式，反映了不同到期日的平滑曲线的局部相关性。我们推导出了对于横截面依赖过程的载荷的解析表达式，这些过程倾向于使得实际的最小维度远低于潜在因子空间的真实维度。数值示例表明，错误地采用基于标准拟合优度指标的简约化参数化因子空间会带来显著的经济成本。我们的结果适用于其他具有有限到期结构资产。

abstract.text: How large economic stimuli generate individual and aggregate responses is a central question in economics, but has not been studied experimentally. We provided one‐time cash transfers of about USD 1000 to over 10,500 poor households across 653 randomized villages in rural Kenya. The implied fiscal shock was over 15 percent of local GDP. We find large impacts on consumption and assets for recipients. Importantly, we document large positive spillovers on non‐recipient households and firms, and minimal price inflation. We estimate a local transfer multiplier of 2.5. We interpret welfare implications through the lens of a simple household optimization framework.

10.3982/ecta17945.abstractZh: 经济刺激措施如何引发个体和整体的反应，是经济学中的一个核心问题，但此前尚未通过实验进行研究。我们在肯尼亚农村653个随机分配的村庄中，向超过10,500户贫困家庭提供了约1000美元的一次性现金转移。这一财政冲击占当地GDP的15%以上。我们发现，这种转移支付对受助者的消费和资产产生了显著影响。重要的是，我们还发现这种政策对非受助家庭和企业产生了显著的积极影响，同时价格通胀幅度很小。我们估计了当地转移支付的有效乘数约为2.5。我们通过一个简单的家庭优化框架来解释这种政策对福利的影响。

abstract.text: This paper integrates the classic theory of firm boundaries, through span of control or taste for variety, into a model of the labor market with random matching and on‐the‐job search. Firms choose when to enter and exit, whether to create vacancies or destroy jobs in response to shocks, and Bertrand‐compete to hire and retain workers. Tractability is obtained by proving that, under a parsimonious set of assumptions, all worker and firm decisions are characterized by their joint surplus, which in turn only depends on firm productivity and size. The job ladder in marginal surplus that emerges in equilibrium determines net poaching patterns by firm characteristics that are in line with the data. As frictions vanish, the model converges to a standard competitive model of firm dynamics. The combination of firm dynamics and search frictions allows the model to: (i) quantify the misallocation cost of frictions; (ii) replicate elusive life‐cycle growth profiles of superstar firms; and (iii) make sense of the failure of the job ladder around the Great Recession as a result of the collapse of firm entry.

10.3982/ecta17955.abstractZh: 本文将经典的 firm boundaries 理论，通过控制范围或追求多样性，融入了一个具有随机匹配和在职搜索的劳动力市场模型。企业选择何时进入和退出市场，是否因冲击而创造职位或裁撤岗位，以及通过 Bertrand 竞争来招聘和留住员工。通过一系列简约的假设，证明了所有员工和企业的决策都可以通过它们的联合 surplus 来表征，而这一 surplus 仅取决于企业的生产效率和规模。在均衡状态下出现的边际 surplus 中的职位等级，决定了企业特征对净挖人行为的控制，这与实际数据相符。随着摩擦的消失，该模型逐渐收敛到标准的企业动态竞争模型。企业动态与搜索摩擦的结合使得模型能够：(i) 量化摩擦带来的资源配置错误；(ii) 再现超级企业难以捉摸的生命周期增长模式；(iii) 解释大衰退期间职位等级崩溃的原因，即企业进入市场的门槛下降。

abstract.text: This article contains new tools for studying the shape of the stationary distribution of sizes in a dynamic economic system in which units experience random multiplicative shocks and are occasionally reset. Each unit has a Markov‐switching type, which influences their growth rate and reset probability. We show that the size distribution has a Pareto upper tail, with exponent equal to the unique positive solution to an equation involving the spectral radius of a certain matrix‐valued function. Under a nonlattice condition on growth rates, an eigenvector associated with the Pareto exponent provides the distribution of types in the upper tail of the size distribution.

10.3982/ecta17984.abstractZh: 本文提出了新的工具，用于研究在动态经济系统中单位经历随机乘法冲击并偶尔被重置的情况下，大小稳定分布的形态。每个单位都具有马尔可夫切换类型，这会影响它们的增长率和重置概率。我们证明，大小分布具有帕累托上尾部分，其指数等于某个矩阵值函数的谱半径相关方程的唯一正解。在增长率满足非格点条件的情况下，与帕累托指数相关的特征向量能够描述大小分布上尾部分的类型分布。

abstract.text: Virtually all theories of economic growth predict a positive relationship between population size and productivity. In this paper, I study a particular historical episode to provide direct evidence for the empirical relevance of such scale effects. In the aftermath of the Second World War, 8 million ethnic Germans were expelled from their domiciles in Eastern Europe and transferred to West Germany. This inflow increased the German population by almost 20%. Using variation across counties, I show that the settlement of refugees had large and persistent effects on the size of the local population, manufacturing employment, and income per capita. These findings are quantitatively consistent with an idea‐based model of spatial growth if population mobility is subject to frictions and productivity spillovers occur locally. The estimated model implies that the refugee settlement increased aggregate income per capita by about 12% after 25 years and triggered a process of industrialization in rural areas.

10.3982/ecta18002.abstractZh: 几乎所有经济增长理论都预测，人口规模与生产力之间存在正相关关系。在本文中，我研究了一个特定的历史事件，以直接证明这种规模效应在现实中的相关性。第二次世界大战后，800万德国裔居民被驱逐出东欧的家园，迁移到西德。这一人口流入使德国人口增加了近20%。通过对比不同地区的差异，我发现难民的安置对当地人口规模、制造业就业以及人均收入产生了显著且持久的影响。这些发现与基于模型的空间增长理论在定量上是一致的，前提是人口流动受到摩擦的阻碍，且生产力溢出效应在局部发生。根据估计的模型，难民安置在25年后使人均总收入增加了约12%，并引发了农村地区的工业化进程。

abstract.text: Smooth ambiguity preferences (Klibanoff, Marinacci, and Mukerji (2005)) describe a decision maker who evaluates each act f according to the twofold expectation V ( f ) = ∫ P ϕ ( ∫ Ω u ( f ) d p ) d μ ( p ) defined by a utility function u , an ambiguity index ϕ , and a belief μ over a set P of probabilities. We provide an axiomatic foundation for the representation, taking as a primitive a preference over Anscombe–Aumann acts. We study a special case where P is a subjective statistical model that is point identified, that is, the decision maker believes that the true law p ∈ P can be recovered empirically. Our main axiom is a joint weakening of Savage's sure‐thing principle and Anscombe–Aumann's mixture independence. In addition, we show that the parameters of the representation can be uniquely recovered from preferences, thereby making operational the separation between ambiguity attitude and perception, a hallmark feature of the smooth ambiguity representation.

10.3982/ecta18009.abstractZh: 平滑模糊偏好（Klibanoff、Marinacci和Mukerji，2005年）描述了一种决策者，该决策者根据以下双重期望V(f) = ∫ Pϕ(∫Ωu(f)dp) dμ(p)来评估每个行动f，其中效用函数u、模糊指数ϕ以及关于概率集P的信念μ都是定义的一部分。我们为这种表示方式提供了一个公理基础，以偏好作为基本元素，针对Anscombe–Aumann行动进行描述。我们研究了一个特殊情况，即P是一个主观统计模型，并且该模型是点识别的，也就是说，决策者认为真实的法则p∈P可以通过经验来推断。我们的主要公理是Savage的“确定原则”和Anscombe–Aumann的“混合独立性”原则的联合弱化。此外，我们还展示了可以从偏好中唯一地恢复表示的参数，从而实现了模糊态度与感知之间的分离，这是平滑模糊表示的一个显著特征。

abstract.text: In the U.S., large firms now account for a greater share of economic activity, new firms are being created at slower rates, and workers are receiving a smaller share of GDP. Changes in population growth provide a unified quantitative explanation. A decrease in population growth lowers firm entry rates, shifting the firm‐age distribution toward older firms. Firm aging accounts for (i) the concentration of employment in large firms, (ii) and trends in average firm size and exit rates, key determinants of firm entry rates. Feedback effects from firm demographics generate two‐thirds of the effect. Prior to the decrease, entry rates rose steadily reflecting the earlier baby boom. The glut of firms due to the baby boom lead to rich transitional dynamics within the feedback effects, accounting for more than half the total change. Baby boom induced changes in the firm‐age distribution provide a driving force for the post‐WWII rise and fall in the aggregate labor share. Ignoring changes in population growth attributes all the long run decline in entry rates to a decrease in firm exit rates, which in reality have been only one‐third as large.

10.3982/ecta18012.abstractZh: 在美国，大型企业在经济活动中的占比越来越大，新企业的创建速度放缓，而工人所获得的GDP份额则减少。人口结构的变化为这一现象提供了统一的定量解释。人口增长放缓导致企业进入市场的门槛降低，从而使企业年龄分布向更老的企业倾斜。企业老龄化现象解释了以下现象：(i) 就业集中在大型企业中；(ii) 企业平均规模的变化以及退出率的变化，这些都是决定企业进入门槛的关键因素。企业人口统计数据的反馈效应贡献了三分之二的影响。在人口增长放缓之前，企业进入市场的门槛稳步上升，这反映了早期婴儿潮的影响。由于婴儿潮导致的企业过剩，反馈效应内部出现了丰富的过渡性动态，这解释了总变化的一半以上。婴儿潮引起的企业年龄分布变化是二战后劳动力分享增减的驱动力之一。忽略人口结构的变化，将所有长期下降的进入门槛归因于企业退出率的下降，但实际上这一因素的影响仅占总变化的三分之一。

abstract.text: We study the transmission of monetary policy through risk premia in a heterogeneous agent New Keynesian environment. Heterogeneity in households' marginal propensity to take risk (MPR) summarizes differences in portfolio choice on the margin. An unexpected reduction in the nominal interest rate redistributes to households with high MPRs, lowering risk premia and amplifying the stimulus to the real economy. Quantitatively, this mechanism rationalizes the role of news about future excess returns in driving the stock market response to monetary policy shocks and amplifies their real effects by 1.3–1.4 times.

10.3982/ecta18014.abstractZh: 我们研究了在异质型新凯恩斯主义环境中，货币政策通过风险溢价传递的机制。家庭承担风险的边际倾向的异质性，反映了他们在投资组合选择上的差异。名义利率的意外下降会使得风险倾向较高的家庭受益，从而降低风险溢价，并增强对实际经济的刺激效果。从数量上看，这一机制解释了未来超额收益的消息如何驱动股市对货币政策冲击的反应，并使其实际影响增强1.3至1.4倍。

abstract.text: We study the selection of Fellows of the Econometric Society, using a new data set of publications and citations for over 40,000 actively publishing economists since the early 1900s. Conditional on achievement, we document a large negative gap in the probability that women were selected as Fellows in the 1933–1979 period. This gap became positive (though not statistically significant) from 1980 to 2010, and in the past decade has become large and highly significant, with over a 100% increase in the probability of selection for female authors relative to males with similar publications and citations. The positive boost affects highly qualified female candidates (in the top 10% of authors) with no effect for the bottom 90%. Using nomination data for the past 30 years, we find a key proximate role for the Society's Nominating Committee in this shift. Since 2012, the Committee has had an explicit mandate to nominate highly qualified women, and its nominees enjoy above‐average election success (controlling for achievement). Looking beyond gender, we document similar shifts in the premium for geographic diversity: in the mid‐2000s, both the Fellows and the Nominating Committee became significantly more likely to nominate and elect candidates from outside the United States. Finally, we examine gender gaps in several other major awards for U.S. economists. We show that the gaps in the probability of selection of new fellows of the American Academy of Arts and Sciences and the National Academy of Sciences closely parallel those of the Econometric Society, with historically negative penalties for women turning to positive premiums in recent years.

10.3982/ecta18027.abstractZh: 我们研究了计量经济学会院士的选拔过程，使用了自20世纪初以来超过40,000位活跃发表经济学论文的学者的出版物和引用数据。在成就条件相同的情况下，我们发现1933年至1979年期间，女性被选为院士的概率存在显著负差距。从1980年到2010年，这一差距变为正值（尽管统计上不显著），而在过去十年中，这一差距变得非常大且显著，女性作者被选为院士的概率比具有类似出版物和引用量的男性作者高出100%以上。这种正向提升对高素质的女性候选人（排名前10%的作者）有显著影响，而对排名后90%的候选人则没有效果。通过过去30年的提名数据，我们发现学会提名委员会在这一转变中起到了关键作用。自2012年以来，委员会有明确的任务去提名高素质的女性候选人，其提名者获得了高于平均水平的当选成功率（控制了成就因素后）。除了性别因素外，我们还发现地理多样性方面的溢价也发生了类似的变化：在21世纪中期，无论是院士还是提名委员会，都更倾向于提名和选举来自美国以外的候选人。最后，我们考察了美国经济学学者在其他主要奖项中的性别差距。我们发现，美国艺术与科学院和国家科学院新院士的选拔概率差距与计量经济学会的差距非常相似，历史上对女性的负面惩罚在近年来转变为正向溢价。

abstract.text: We study optimal control problems in the multivariate linear‐quadratic‐Gaussian framework under rational inattention. We propose a three‐step procedure to solve this problem using semidefinite programming and derive the optimal signal structure without strong prior restrictions. We analyze both the transition dynamics of the optimal posterior covariance matrix and its steady state. We characterize the optimal information structure for some special cases and develop numerical algorithms for general cases. Applying our methods to solve three multivariate economic models, we obtain some results qualitatively different from the literature.

10.3982/ecta18086.abstractZh: 我们研究了在理性忽略假设下的多变量线性-二次-高斯框架中的最优控制问题。我们提出了一种三步法，利用半定规划来解决这个问题，并推导出在无明显先验限制条件下的最优信号结构。我们分析了最优后验协方差矩阵的过渡动态及其稳态情况。对于某些特殊情况，我们描述了最优信息结构，并为一般情况开发了数值算法。将我们的方法应用于三个多变量经济模型，我们得到了一些与文献中结果有质的差异的结果。

abstract.text: How can one determine whether a treatment, such as the introduction of a social program or trade shock, alters agents' incentives to form links in a network? This paper proposes analogs of a two‐sample Kolmogorov–Smirnov test, widely used in the literature to test the null hypothesis of no treatment effects, for network data. It first specifies a testing problem in which the null hypothesis is that two networks are drawn from the same random graph model. It then describes two randomization tests based on the magnitude of the difference between the networks' adjacency matrices as measured by the 2 → 2 and ∞ → 1 operator norms. Power properties of the tests are examined analytically, in simulation, and through two real‐world applications. A key finding is that the test based on the ∞ → 1 norm can be much more powerful for the kinds of sparse and degree‐heterogeneous networks common in economics.

10.3982/ecta18093.abstractZh: 如何判断某种干预措施，例如引入社会计划或贸易冲击，是否会改变个体在网络中建立联系的动力？本文提出了一种针对网络数据的双样本Kolmogorov–Smirnov检验的类似方法，该检验在文献中常用于检验无干预效应的零假设。首先，本文定义了一个测试问题，其中零假设是两个网络来自同一个随机图模型。接着，描述了两种基于网络邻接矩阵差异大小的随机化检验方法，这些差异通过2 → 2和∞ → 1算子范数来衡量。通过理论分析和模拟实验，以及两个实际应用场景的验证，本文考察了这些检验的功效特性。研究发现，基于∞ → 1算子范数的检验对于经济学中常见的稀疏和度异质网络来说，其功效要更高。

abstract.text: I prove an envelope theorem with a converse: the envelope formula is equivalent to a first‐order condition. Like Milgrom and Segal's (2002) envelope theorem, my result requires no structure on the choice set. I use the converse envelope theorem to extend to general outcomes and preferences the canonical result in mechanism design that any increasing allocation is implementable, and apply this to selling information.

10.3982/ecta18119.abstractZh: 我证明了一种逆向的包络定理：包络公式等价于一个一阶条件。与Milgrom和Segal在2002年提出的包络定理类似，我的结果不需要对选择集进行任何结构化处理。我利用这一逆向包络定理，将机制设计中的经典结论推广到一般的结果和偏好情况，即任何递增的分配都是可以实施的，并将这一结论应用于信息的出售。

abstract.text: Facing several decisions, people may consider each one in isolation or integrate them into a single optimization problem. Isolation and integration may yield different choices, for instance, if uncertainty is involved, and only one randomly selected decision is implemented. We investigate whether the random incentive system in experiments that measure ambiguity aversion provides a hedge against ambiguity, making ambiguity‐averse subjects who integrate behave as if they were ambiguity neutral. Our results suggest that about half of the ambiguity averse subjects integrated their choices in the experiment into a single problem, whereas the other half isolated. Our design further enables us to disentangle properties of the integrating subjects' preferences over compound objects induced by the random incentive system and the choice problems in the experiment.

10.3982/ecta18137.abstractZh: 在面对多个决策时，人们可能会单独考虑每个决策，或将它们整合成一个优化问题。如果涉及不确定性，单独考虑和整合并可能产生不同的选择，只有随机选择一个决策来实施。我们研究了在测量模糊厌恶的实验中的随机激励系统是否提供了一种对冲模糊性的方法，使得具有模糊厌恶的受试者通过整合他们的选择后，表现得好像他们对模糊性无厌恶。我们的结果表明，大约一半的模糊厌恶受试者将他们的选择在实验中整合成一个单一问题，而另一半则单独考虑。我们的设计还使我们能够区分由随机激励系统引发的整合受试者的偏好属性以及实验中选择问题的特性。

abstract.text: In this paper, we argue that a large class of recursive contracts can be studied by means of the conventional Negishi method. A planner is responsible for prescribing current actions along with a distribution of future utility values to all agents, so as to maximize their weighted sum of utilities. Under convexity, the method yields the exact efficient frontier. Otherwise, the implementation requires contracts be contingent on publicly observable random signals uncorrelated to fundamentals. We also provide operational first‐order conditions for the characterization of efficient contracts. Finally, we compare extensively our approach with the dual method established in the literature.

10.3982/ecta18310.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们认为可以通过传统的Negishi方法研究一大类递归合同。规划者负责为所有代理人指定当前行动以及未来效用值的分布，以最大化他们的效用总和。在凸性条件下，该方法能够得出精确的有效前沿。否则，实施该方法的合同需要依赖于与基本面无关的公共可观测随机信号。我们还为有效合同的表征提供了操作上的一阶条件。最后，我们将我们的方法与文献中建立的双重方法进行了广泛的比较。

abstract.text: An agent has access to multiple information sources, each modeled as a Brownian motion whose drift provides information about a different component of an unknown Gaussian state. Information is acquired continuously—where the agent chooses both which sources to sample from, and also how to allocate attention across them—until an endogenously chosen time, at which point a decision is taken. We demonstrate conditions on the agent's prior belief under which it is possible to exactly characterize the optimal information acquisition strategy. We then apply this characterization to derive new results regarding: (1) endogenous information acquisition for binary choice, (2) the dynamic consequences of attention manipulation, and (3) strategic information provision by biased news sources.

10.3982/ecta18324.abstractZh: 一个智能体可以访问多个信息源，每个信息源都被建模为布朗运动，其漂移提供了关于未知高斯状态不同组成部分的信息。信息被持续获取——智能体不仅要选择从哪些信息源获取信息，还要决定如何分配注意力——直到一个由自身选定的时间点，此时会做出决策。我们证明了智能体在先验信念下的条件，在这些条件下，可以精确描述最优的信息获取策略。然后，我们将这一描述应用于推导新的结果，包括：(1) 二元选择下的内生信息获取，(2) 注意力操控的动态后果，以及 (3) 有偏新闻源提供的战略信息。

abstract.text: This paper investigates whether the range of an attribute's outcomes in the choice set alters its relative importance. I derive distinguishing predictions of two prominent theories of range‐dependent attribute weighting: the focusing model of Kőszegi and Szeidl (2013) and the relative thinking model of Bushong, Rabin, and Schwartzstein (2021). I test these predictions in a laboratory experiment in which I vary the prices of high‐ and low‐quality variants of multiple products. The data provide clear evidence of choice‐set dependence consistent with relative thinking: price increases that expand the range of prices in the choice set lead to more purchases. Structural estimates imply economically meaningful effect sizes: the average participant was willing to pay around 17% more when a seemingly irrelevant option is added to their choice set.

10.3982/ecta18412.abstractZh: 本文探讨了选择集中某个属性结果的范围变化是否会影响其相对重要性。我推导出了两种关于依赖范围属性的加权理论的预测结果：Kőszegi和Szeidl在2013年提出的聚焦模型，以及Bushong、Rabin和Schwartzstein在2021年提出的相对思维模型。我在一项实验室实验中测试了这些预测，实验中我改变了多种产品的高质量和低质量版本的价格。数据清楚地表明了与相对思维一致的选择集依赖性：价格范围的扩大会导致更多的购买行为。结构估计表明，这种效应具有经济意义上的意义：当选择集中增加一个看似无关的选项时，平均参与者愿意支付大约17%的额外费用。

abstract.text: This paper shows that robust inference under weak identification is important to the evaluation of many influential macro asset pricing models, including (time‐varying) rare‐disaster risk models and long‐run risk models. Building on recent developments in the conditional inference literature, we provide a novel conditional specification test by simulating the critical value conditional on a sufficient statistic. This sufficient statistic can be intuitively interpreted as a measure capturing the macroeconomic information decoupled from the underlying content of asset pricing theories. Macro‐finance decoupling is an effective way to improve the power of the specification test when asset pricing theories are difficult to refute because of a severe imbalance in the information content about the key model parameters between macroeconomic moment restrictions and asset pricing cross‐equation restrictions. We apply the proposed conditional specification test to the evaluation of a time‐varying rare‐disaster risk model and the construction of robust model uncertainty sets.

10.3982/ecta18506.abstractZh: 本文指出，在弱识别条件下进行稳健推断对于评估许多有影响力的宏观资产定价模型至关重要，包括（时间变化的）罕见灾难风险模型和长期风险模型。基于条件推断领域的最新进展，我们提出了一种新颖的条件规格测试方法，通过模拟基于充分统计量的临界值来进行测试。这个充分统计量可以直观地被解释为衡量与资产定价理论基础内容无关的宏观经济信息的指标。宏观金融分离是一种有效的方法，可以在资产定价理论难以被反驳时提高规格测试的效力，因为关于关键模型参数的信息内容在宏观经济矩限制和资产定价交叉方程限制之间存在严重的不平衡。我们将所提出的条件规格测试应用于时间变化的罕见灾难风险模型的评估，以及稳健模型不确定性集的构建。

abstract.text: Many causal and structural effects depend on regressions. Examples include policy effects, average derivatives, regression decompositions, average treatment effects, causal mediation, and parameters of economic structural models. The regressions may be high‐dimensional, making machine learning useful. Plugging machine learners into identifying equations can lead to poor inference due to bias from regularization and/or model selection. This paper gives automatic debiasing for linear and nonlinear functions of regressions. The debiasing is automatic in using Lasso and the function of interest without the full form of the bias correction. The debiasing can be applied to any regression learner, including neural nets, random forests, Lasso, boosting, and other high‐dimensional methods. In addition to providing the bias correction, we give standard errors that are robust to misspecification, convergence rates for the bias correction, and primitive conditions for asymptotic inference for estimators of a variety of estimators of structural and causal effects. The automatic debiased machine learning is used to estimate the average treatment effect on the treated for the NSW job training data and to estimate demand elasticities from Nielsen scanner data while allowing preferences to be correlated with prices and income.

10.3982/ecta18515.abstractZh: 许多因果效应和结构效应依赖于回归分析。例如政策效应、平均导数、回归分解、平均处理效应、因果中介以及经济结构模型的参数。这些回归分析可能具有高维特性，这使得机器学习变得非常有用。然而，将机器学习算法应用于识别方程时，可能会因正则化或模型选择的偏差而导致推断效果不佳。本文提出了一种针对回归分析的线性和非线性函数的自动去偏方法。该去偏过程在利用Lasso算法时具有自动性，无需使用完整的偏差校正公式。该方法可应用于任何回归学习算法，包括神经网络、随机森林、Lasso、提升算法以及其他高维方法。除了提供偏差校正外，我们还提供了对误设定具有鲁棒性的标准误差、偏差校正的收敛速率，以及多种结构和因果效应估计量的渐近推断基本条件。通过这种自动去偏的机器学习方法，可以估计新南威尔士州就业培训数据中的平均处理效应，并基于Nielsen扫描仪数据估计需求弹性，同时允许偏好与价格和收入相关联。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effect of terrorism financing and recruitment on attacks. I exploit a Sharia‐compliant institution in Pakistan, which induces unintended and quasi‐experimental variation in the funding of terrorist groups through their religious affiliation. The results indicate that higher terrorism financing, in a given location and period, generate more attacks in the same location and period. Financing exhibits a complementarity in producing attacks with terrorist recruitment, measured through data from Jihadist‐friendly online fora and machine learning. A higher supply of terror is responsible for the increase in attacks and is identified by studying groups with different affiliations operating in multiple cities. These findings are consistent with terrorist organizations facing financial frictions to their internal capital market.

10.3982/ecta18530.abstractZh: 本文研究了恐怖主义融资和招募对袭击的影响。本文以巴基斯坦一家符合伊斯兰教法的机构为研究对象，通过研究其宗教归属对恐怖组织资金供应的影响，发现在特定时间和地点，更多的恐怖主义融资会引发更多的袭击。通过研究支持圣战分子的在线论坛和机器学习数据，发现融资与恐怖组织招募之间存在互补关系。更多的恐怖活动供应是导致袭击增加的原因，这一点通过研究在不同城市运作的具有不同宗教归属的恐怖组织得以验证。这些发现与恐怖组织面临内部资金市场的财务障碍这一事实相符。

abstract.text: Discrete location, occupation, skill, and hours choices of workers underpin their incomes. This paper analyzes the optimal taxation of discrete income‐generating choice. It derives optimal tax equations and Pareto test inequalities for mixed logit choice environments that can accommodate discrete and unstructured choice sets, rich preference heterogeneity, and complex aggregate cross‐substitution patterns between choices. These equations explicitly connect optimal taxes to societal redistributive goals and private substitution behavior, with the latter encoded as a substitution matrix that describes cross‐sensitivities of choice distributions to tax‐induced utility variation. In repeated mixed logit settings, the substitution matrix is exactly the Markov matrix of shock‐induced agent transitions across choices. We describe implications of this equivalence for evaluation of prevailing tax designs and the structural estimation of optimal policy mixed logit models. We apply our results to two salient examples: spatial taxation and taxation of couples.

10.3982/ecta18542.abstractZh: 工人的离散位置选择、职业选择、技能以及工作时间选择是其收入的基础。本文分析了离散收入生成选择的最优税收问题。我们推导出了适用于混合逻辑斯蒂选择环境的最优税收方程和帕累托测试不等式，该环境可以容纳离散且无结构的选择集、丰富的偏好异质性，以及选择之间复杂的综合替代模式。这些方程明确地将最优税收与社会再分配目标以及私人替代行为联系起来，后者被编码为一个替代矩阵，描述了选择分布对税收引起的效用变化的敏感性。在重复的混合逻辑斯蒂设定中，替代矩阵正是由冲击引起的代理人在不同选择之间的转换所构成的马尔可夫矩阵。我们描述了这种等价性对评估现行税收设计以及构建最优政策混合逻辑斯蒂模型结构估计的影响。我们将我们的结果应用于两个典型的例子：空间税收和对夫妻的税收。

abstract.text: We develop a unique survey that focuses on the job search behavior of individuals regardless of their labor force status and field it annually starting in 2013. We use our survey to study the relationship between search effort and outcomes for the employed and non‐employed. Three important facts stand out: (1) on‐the‐job search is pervasive, and is more intense at the lower rungs of the job ladder; (2) the employed are at least three times more effective than the unemployed in job search; and (3) the employed receive better job offers than the unemployed. We set up a general equilibrium model of on‐the‐job search with endogenous search effort, calibrate it to fit our new facts, and find that the search effort of the employed is highly elastic. We show that search effort substantially amplifies labor market responses to productivity shocks over the business cycle.

10.3982/ecta18582.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项独特的调查，重点关注个人的求职行为，无论其劳动力状况如何，并自2013年起每年进行此项调查。我们利用该调查来研究求职努力与就业和非就业者结果之间的关系。有三个重要发现：(1)在职求职现象普遍存在，且在职位等级较低时更为激烈；(2)就业者在求职方面的效率至少是失业者的三倍；(3)就业者获得的职位机会比失业者更多。我们建立了一个包含内生求职努力的一般均衡模型，并对其进行校准以符合我们的新发现，结果发现就业者的求职努力具有高度弹性。我们表明，求职努力显著增强了劳动力市场对周期性生产率冲击的响应。

abstract.text: We theoretically analyze the problem of testing for p ‐hacking based on distributions of p ‐values across multiple studies. We provide general results for when such distributions have testable restrictions (are non‐increasing) under the null of no p ‐hacking. We find novel additional testable restrictions for p ‐values based on t ‐tests. Specifically, the shape of the power functions results in both complete monotonicity as well as bounds on the distribution of p ‐values. These testable restrictions result in more powerful tests for the null hypothesis of no p ‐hacking. When there is also publication bias, our tests are joint tests for p ‐hacking and publication bias. A reanalysis of two prominent data sets shows the usefulness of our new tests.

10.3982/ecta18583.abstractZh: 我们基于多项研究中p值的分布，从理论上分析了检测p值操纵问题的方法。我们提出了在不存在p值操纵的零假设下，当这些分布具有可检验的限制（即非递增）时的一般性结论。我们还发现了基于t检验的p值的新可检验限制。具体来说，功效函数的形状不仅导致了完全的单调性，还为p值的分布提供了界限。这些可检验的限制使得对不存在p值操纵的零假设的检验更为有力。当存在发表偏见时，我们的检验可以同时检测p值操纵和发表偏见。对两个著名数据集的重新分析表明，我们的新检验具有实用性。

abstract.text: We study the role of commitment in communication and its interactions with rules, which determine whether information is verifiable. Our framework nests models of cheap talk, information disclosure, and Bayesian persuasion. It predicts that commitment has opposite effects on information transmission under the two alternative rules. We leverage these contrasting forces to experimentally establish that subjects react to commitment in line with the main qualitative implications of the theory. Quantitatively, not all subjects behave as predicted. We show that a form of commitment blindness leads some senders to overcommunicate when information is verifiable and undercommunicate when it is not. This generates an unpredicted gap in information transmission across the two rules, suggesting a novel role for verifiable information in practice.

10.3982/ecta18585.abstractZh: 我们研究了承诺在沟通中的作用及其与规则之间的相互作用，这些规则决定了信息是否可以被验证。我们的框架整合了廉价传播、信息披露和贝叶斯说服的模型。研究表明，在两种不同的规则下，承诺对信息传输产生相反的影响。我们利用这些相反的力量，通过实验验证：受试者对承诺的反应符合理论的主要定性结论。从定量角度来看，并非所有受试者的行为都符合预期。我们发现，一种形式的承诺盲性导致一些发送者在信息可验证时过度传播信息，而在信息不可验证时则传播不足。这导致两种规则之间的信息传输出现了意想不到的差距，从而揭示了可验证信息在实践中的新作用。

abstract.text: We construct an endogenous growth model with random interactions where firms are subject to distortions. The TFP distribution evolves endogenously as firms seek to upgrade their technology over time either by innovating or by imitating other firms. We use the model to quantify the effects of misallocation on TFP growth in emerging economies. We structurally estimate the stationary state of the dynamic model targeting moments of the empirical distribution of R&D and TFP growth in China during the period 2007–2012. The estimated model fits the Chinese data well. We compare the estimates with those obtained using data for Taiwan and perform counterfactuals to study the effect of alternative policies. R&D misallocation has a large effect on TFP growth.

10.3982/ecta18586.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个具有随机互动的内生增长模型，其中企业受到各种扭曲的影响。随着企业不断寻求技术升级，无论是通过创新还是模仿其他企业，技术效率分布会内生性地演变。我们利用该模型来量化资源配置不当对新兴经济体技术效率增长的影响。我们针对2007至2012年期间中国研发和技术效率增长的实证分布，对动态模型的稳态进行了结构性估计。估计的模型与中国数据非常吻合。我们将这些估计结果与台湾的数据进行比较，并通过反事实分析来研究不同政策的影响。研发资源的配置不当对技术效率增长有显著的影响。

abstract.text: If experiment A is Blackwell more informative than experiment B , it is always possible that A and B are induced by signals A′ and B′ such that A′ is a refinement of B′, that is, A′ entails observing B′ plus some additional information. We first show that this result does not extend beyond pairs of experiments: There exist collections of experiments that cannot be induced by a collection of signals so that whenever two experiments are Blackwell ordered, the associated signals are refinement ordered. In other words, sometimes it is impossible for more informed agents to know everything that less informed agents know. More broadly, define an information hierarchy to be a partially ordered set that ranks experiments in terms of informativeness. Is it the case that for any choice of experiments indexed on the hierarchy such that higher experiments are Blackwell more informative, there are signals that induce these experiments with higher signals being refinements of lower signals? We show that the answer is affirmative if and only if the undirected graph of the information hierarchy is a forest.

10.3982/ecta18589.abstractZh: 如果实验A在Blackwell信息量上比实验B更丰富，那么A和B可能都是由信号A′和B′引导的，其中A′是B′的改进，即A′包含了观察B′以及一些额外的信息。我们首先证明这一结果并不适用于实验对之外的情况：存在一些实验集合，它们无法由一组信号引导，因此每当两个实验按照Blackwell顺序排序时，相关的信号也是改进排序的。换句话说，有时更了解情况的代理人无法知道所有了解较少的代理人所知道的信息。更广泛地说，可以将信息层次结构定义为一个部分有序集合，用于根据信息量对实验进行排序。那么，对于任意在层次结构上索引的实验选择，如果较高层次的实验在Blackwell信息量上更丰富，那么是否存在一些信号能够引导这些实验，其中较高层次的信号是较低层次的信号的改进？我们证明，这一问题的答案是肯定的，当且仅当信息层次结构的无向图是一个森林时。

abstract.text: We construct robust empirical Bayes confidence intervals (EBCIs) in a normal means problem. The intervals are centered at the usual linear empirical Bayes estimator, but use a critical value accounting for shrinkage. Parametric EBCIs that assume a normal distribution for the means (Morris (1983b)) may substantially undercover when this assumption is violated. In contrast, our EBCIs control coverage regardless of the means distribution, while remaining close in length to the parametric EBCIs when the means are indeed Gaussian. If the means are treated as fixed, our EBCIs have an average coverage guarantee: the coverage probability is at least 1 − α on average across the n EBCIs for each of the means. Our empirical application considers the effects of U.S. neighborhoods on intergenerational mobility.

10.3982/ecta18597.abstractZh: 我们构建了在正态分布均值问题中的稳健经验贝叶斯置信区间。这些区间以通常的经验贝叶斯估计量为中心，但采用了考虑收缩效应的临界值。假设均值服从正态分布的参数型经验贝叶斯置信区间（如Morris (1983b)所提出的）在假设被违反时可能会显著低估真实值。相比之下，我们的经验贝叶斯置信区间能够不受均值分布的影响而保持覆盖度，并且在均值确实为高斯分布时，其长度与参数型经验贝叶斯置信区间相近。如果将均值视为固定值，我们的经验贝叶斯置信区间具有平均覆盖度保证：对于每个均值，n个置信区间的平均覆盖概率至少为1 − α。我们的实证研究考虑了美国各社区对代际流动性的影响。

abstract.text: I study the effect of labor market imperfections on the labor share in a tractable model that emphasizes the interaction between productivity dispersion and firm competition for workers. I calibrate the model using administrative data covering the universe of firms in Canada from 2000 to 2015. As in the data, most firms have a high labor share, yet the aggregate labor share is low due to the disproportionate effect of a small fraction of large, highly productive firms. I find that a rise in the dispersion of firm productivity causes the aggregate labor share to decline in favor of firm profits. The mechanism is that productivity dispersion effectively shields high‐productivity firms from wage competition. Regression evidence from cross‐country and cross‐industry data supports both the model prediction and mechanism.

10.3982/ecta18612.abstractZh: 我研究劳动力市场不完善对劳动力份额的影响，采用了一个易于处理的模型，该模型强调了生产力分散性与企业竞争对劳动力的相互作用。我使用2000至2015年间加拿大所有企业的行政数据对模型进行了校准。根据数据，大多数企业的劳动力份额较高，但由于少数高生产力大企业的巨大影响，总体劳动力份额却较低。我发现，企业生产力分散性的增加会导致总体劳动力份额下降，从而有利于企业利润。其机制在于，生产力分散性有效地保护了高生产力企业免受工资竞争的影响。来自不同国家和地区、不同行业的回归分析结果支持了模型的预测和机制。

abstract.text: This paper studies the optimal conduct of monetary policy in a multisector economy in which firms buy and sell intermediate goods over a production network. We first provide a necessary and sufficient condition for the monetary policy's ability to implement flexible‐price equilibria in the presence of nominal rigidities and show that, generically, no monetary policy can implement the first‐best allocation. We then characterize the optimal policy in terms of the economy's production network and the extent and nature of nominal rigidities. Our characterization result yields general principles for the optimal conduct of monetary policy in the presence of input‐output linkages: it establishes that optimal policy stabilizes a price index with greater weights assigned to larger, stickier, and more upstream industries, as well as industries with less sticky upstream suppliers but stickier downstream customers. In a calibrated version of the model, we find that implementing the optimal policy can result in quantitatively meaningful welfare gains.

10.3982/ecta18627.abstractZh: 本文研究了在多部门经济中，企业通过生产网络买卖中间商品时，货币政策的最优实施问题。我们首先提出了货币政策在存在名义刚性条件下实现灵活价格均衡的必要充分条件，并表明通常情况下，任何货币政策都无法实现最优配置。随后，我们根据经济体的生产网络以及名义刚性的程度和性质，对最优政策进行了描述性分析。我们的研究结果为在存在投入产出联系的情况下，货币政策的最优实施提供了一般性原则：最优政策会稳定一个价格指数，其中较大、更难以变动且位于上游的行业的权重会更大，而上游供应商变动性较小但下游客户变动性较大的行业则权重较小。在模型的一个校准版本中，我们发现实施最优政策可以带来具有实际意义的福利收益。

abstract.text: This paper studies optimal decision rules, including estimators and tests, for weakly identified GMM models. We derive the limit experiment for weakly identified GMM, and propose a theoretically‐motivated class of priors which give rise to quasi‐Bayes decision rules as a limiting case. Together with results in the previous literature, this establishes desirable properties for the quasi‐Bayes approach regardless of model identification status, and we recommend quasi‐Bayes for settings where identification is a concern. We further propose weighted average power‐optimal identification‐robust frequentist tests and confidence sets, and prove a Bernstein‐von Mises‐type result for the quasi‐Bayes posterior under weak identification.

10.3982/ecta18678.abstractZh: 本文研究了弱识别的GMM模型的最优决策规则，包括估计量和检验方法。我们推导了弱识别GMM的极限实验，并提出了一种理论上的先验分布类，这些先验分布在极限情况下产生准贝叶斯决策规则。结合先前文献中的结果，我们证明了准贝叶斯方法在模型识别状态不同的情况下仍具有理想的性质，并建议在识别是一个问题的情境下使用准贝叶斯方法。此外，我们还提出了加权平均功率最优的、对模型识别鲁棒性的频率论检验和置信集，并证明了在弱识别条件下准贝叶斯后验的Bernstein-von Mises型结果。

abstract.text: Nudge interventions have quickly expanded from academic studies to larger implementation in so‐called Nudge Units in governments. This provides an opportunity to compare interventions in research studies, versus at scale. We assemble a unique data set of 126 RCTs covering 23 million individuals, including all trials run by two of the largest Nudge Units in the United States. We compare these trials to a sample of nudge trials in academic journals from two recent meta‐analyses. In the Academic Journals papers, the average impact of a nudge is very large—an 8.7 percentage point take‐up effect, which is a 33.4% increase over the average control. In the Nudge Units sample, the average impact is still sizable and highly statistically significant, but smaller at 1.4 percentage points, an 8.0% increase. We document three dimensions which can account for the difference between these two estimates: (i) statistical power of the trials; (ii) characteristics of the interventions, such as topic area and behavioral channel; and (iii) selective publication. A meta‐analysis model incorporating these dimensions indicates that selective publication in the Academic Journals sample, exacerbated by low statistical power, explains about 70 percent of the difference in effect sizes between the two samples. Different nudge characteristics account for most of the residual difference.

10.3982/ecta18709.abstractZh: “助推”干预措施已经从学术研究中迅速扩展到政府中的所谓“助推单位”的实际实施中。这为比较研究中的干预措施与大规模实施中的干预措施提供了机会。我们收集了一个独特的数据集，包含126项随机对照试验，涉及2300万个体，其中包括美国两个最大的“助推单位”所进行的所有试验。我们将这些试验与两项近期元分析中的学术期刊中的“助推”试验样本进行了比较。在学术期刊论文中，“助推”的平均影响非常大——达到了8.7个百分点的采纳效果，比平均对照组增加了33.4%。在“助推单位”的样本中，平均影响仍然相当大且统计上显著，但仅为1.4个百分点，增加了8.0%。我们发现有三个因素可以解释这两种估计结果之间的差异：(i) 试验的统计能力；(ii) 干预措施的特点，如主题领域和行为渠道；(iii) 选择性发表。一个包含这些因素的元分析模型表明，学术期刊样本中的选择性发表，加上较低的统计能力，解释了两种样本之间效应大小差异的约70%。不同的“助推”特征则解释了剩余的差异。

abstract.text: Many firms in developing countries could be too small to adopt modern technology embodied in expensive production machines. This paper shows that rental market interactions allow these small firms to increase their effective scale and mechanize production. We conduct a survey of manufacturing firms in Uganda, which uncovers an active rental market for large machines between small firms in informal clusters. We then build an equilibrium model of firm behavior and estimate it with our data. We find that the rental market is quantitatively important for mechanization and productivity since it provides a workaround for other market imperfections that keep firms small. The rental market also shapes the effectiveness of development policies to foster mechanization, such as subsidies to purchase machines. Overall, our results point to the importance of taking into account firm‐to‐firm interactions within informal clusters to understand technology adoption in low income countries: focusing on the small scale of firms in isolation might be misleading.

10.3982/ecta18773.abstractZh: 许多发展中国家的企业规模可能太小，无法采用包含昂贵生产设备的现代技术。本文表明，租赁市场的互动使得这些小型企业能够扩大其生产规模并实现机械化生产。我们对乌干达的制造企业进行调查，发现小型企业在非正式集群中存在着活跃的机器租赁市场。随后，我们构建了一个企业行为均衡模型，并用数据对其进行验证。研究发现，租赁市场对机械化生产和提高生产力具有重要作用，因为它可以弥补其他市场缺陷，从而帮助小型企业扩大规模。此外，租赁市场还影响着发展政策的实施效果，例如购买机器的补贴政策。总体而言，我们的研究结果强调了在理解低收入国家技术采纳问题时，需要考虑企业之间的互动关系的重要性。孤立地关注小型企业可能是一种误导。

abstract.text: We study firm responses to a large‐scale change in apprenticeship regulation in Colombia. The reform requires firms to train, setting apprentice quotas that vary discontinuously in firm size. We document strong heterogeneity in responses across sectors, where firms in sectors with high skill requirements tend to avoid training apprentices, while firms in low‐skill sectors seek apprentices. Guided by these reduced‐form findings, we structurally estimate firms' training costs. Especially in high‐skill sectors, many firms face large training costs, limiting their willingness to train apprentices. Yet, we find substantial overall benefits of expanding apprenticeship training, in particular when the supply of trained workers increases in general equilibrium. Finally, we show that counterfactual policies taking into account heterogeneity across sectors can deliver similar benefits from training while inducing less distortions in the firm‐size distribution and in the allocation of resources across sectors.

10.3982/ecta18911.abstractZh: 我们研究了哥伦比亚学徒制度大规模变革对企业的影响。该改革要求企业培训学徒，并设定与企业规模相关的不连续学徒配额。我们发现不同行业之间的反应存在显著异质性：技能要求较高的行业倾向于避免培训学徒，而技能要求较低的行业则更倾向于寻求学徒。基于这些初步研究结果，我们进一步结构性地估算了企业的培训成本。特别是在技能要求较高的行业，许多企业面临较高的培训成本，这限制了它们培训学徒的意愿。然而，我们发现扩大学徒培训总体上能够带来显著的好处，尤其是在总体均衡中受过培训的工人供应增加的情况下。最后，我们表明，考虑到不同行业异质性的反事实政策，可以在减少企业规模分布和资源分配扭曲的同时，实现类似的培训效益。

abstract.text: We explore patterns of price competition in an oligopoly where consumers vary in the set of firms they consider for their purchase and buy from the lowest‐priced firm they consider. We study a pattern of consideration, termed “symmetric interactions,” that generalizes models used in existing work (duopoly, symmetric firms, and firms with independent reach). Within this class, equilibrium profits are proportional to a firm's reach, firms with a larger reach set higher average prices, and a reduction in the number of firms (either by exit or by merger) harms consumers. However, increased competition (either by entry or by increased consumer awareness) does not always benefit consumers. We go on to study patterns of consideration with asymmetric interactions. In situations with disjoint reach and with nested reach, we find equilibria in which price competition is “duopolistic”: only two firms compete within each price range. We characterize the contrasting equilibrium patterns of price competition for all patterns of consideration in the three‐firm case.

10.3982/ecta18937.abstractZh: 我们研究了寡头垄断中的价格竞争模式，在这种模式下，消费者在考虑购买的公司选择上存在差异，他们会从价格最低的公司购买商品。我们研究了一种被称为“对称互动”的考虑模式，这种模式可以推广到现有研究中的模型（如双寡头垄断、对称企业以及具有独立覆盖范围的企業）。在这一类别中，均衡利润与企业的覆盖范围成正比，覆盖范围较大的企业会设定更高的平均价格，而企业数量的减少（无论是通过退出还是合并）都会对消费者造成伤害。然而，增加的竞争（无论是通过新进入者还是提高消费者意识）并不总是对消费者有利。我们进一步研究了具有不对称互动的考虑模式。在覆盖范围不重叠且存在嵌套覆盖范围的情况下，我们发现价格竞争呈现“双寡头”特征：每个价格区间内只有两家企业竞争。我们描述了在三家企业情况下的所有考虑模式下的价格竞争的不同均衡模式。

abstract.text: We investigate the impact of job loss on crime and the mitigating role of unemployment benefits, exploiting detailed individual‐level data linking employment careers, criminal records, and welfare registries for the universe of male workers in Brazil. The probability of committing crimes increases on average by 23% for workers displaced by mass layoffs, and by slightly less for their cohabiting sons. Using causal forests, we show that the effect is entirely driven by young and low‐tenure workers, while there is no heterogeneity by education and income. Regression discontinuity estimates indicate that unemployment benefit eligibility completely offsets potential crime increases upon job loss, but this effect vanishes completely immediately after benefit expiration. Our findings point to liquidity constraints and psychological stress as the main drivers of criminal behavior upon job loss, while substitution between time on the job and leisure does not seem to play an important role.

10.3982/ecta18984.abstractZh: 我们研究了失业对犯罪的影响，以及失业救济金在缓解犯罪中的作用。通过利用详细的数据，这些数据将就业经历、犯罪记录与福利登记信息联系起来，研究巴西男性工人的情况。研究发现，因大规模裁员而失业的工人犯罪概率平均增加23%，而与其同居的儿子则增加幅度略低。通过因果森林分析，我们发现这种影响主要出现在年轻且任期较短的工人身上，而教育和收入方面的差异并未影响这一结果。回归连续性估计表明，失业救济金的资格完全抵消了失业带来的犯罪风险增加，但这一效应在救济金终止后立即消失。我们的研究指出，流动性限制和心理压力是失业后犯罪行为的主要驱动因素，而工作时间和休闲时间的替代作用似乎并不重要。

abstract.text: United States households' consumption expenditures and car purchases collapsed during the Great Recession and more so than income changes would have predicted. Using CEX data, we show that both the extensive and the intensive car spending margins contracted sharply in the Great Recession. We also document significant cross‐cohort differences in the impact of the Great Recession including a stronger reduction in car spending by younger cohorts. We draw inference on the sources of the Great Recession by investigating which shocks can explain household choices in a 60 period life‐cycle model with idiosyncratic and aggregate shocks fitted to aggregate and life‐cycle moments. We find that the Great Recession was caused by a combination of large aggregate income and wealth shocks, while cross‐cohort adjustment patterns imply a role for life‐cycle income profile shocks. We also find a role for car loan premia shocks in accounting for car spending and car loans.

10.3982/ecta19037.abstractZh: 在大衰退期间，美国家庭的消费支出和汽车购买量出现了显著下降，其程度超过了收入变化的预期。通过消费支出数据，我们发现大衰退期间无论是广义汽车消费还是狭义汽车消费都出现了大幅收缩。我们还发现不同年龄群体在大衰退影响上的差异显著，年轻群体的汽车消费支出减少幅度更大。我们通过构建一个包含个体冲击和总体冲击的60期生命周期模型来推断大衰退的成因，该模型能够解释家庭在生命周期中的选择行为。研究发现，大衰退是由大规模的总体收入和财富冲击共同导致的，而不同年龄群体的调整模式则表明生命周期中的收入状况冲击也起到了作用。此外，我们还发现汽车贷款保费冲击在解释汽车消费和汽车贷款方面也发挥了重要作用。

abstract.text: We propose a robust solution concept for Bayesian persuasion that accounts for the Sender's concern that her Bayesian belief about the environment—which we call the conjecture —may be false. Specifically, the Sender is uncertain about the exogenous sources of information the Receivers may learn from, and about strategy selection. She first identifies all information policies that yield the largest payoff in the “worst‐case scenario,” that is, when Nature provides information and coordinates the Receivers' play to minimize the Sender's payoff. Then she uses the conjecture to pick the optimal policy among the worst‐case optimal ones. We characterize properties of robust solutions, identify conditions under which robustness requires separation of certain states, and qualify in what sense robustness calls for more information disclosure than standard Bayesian persuasion. Finally, we discuss how some of the results in the Bayesian persuasion literature change once robustness is accounted for, and develop a few new applications.

10.3982/ecta19107.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种针对贝叶斯说服的稳健解决方案概念，该概念考虑了发送者对她对环境的贝叶斯信念——我们称之为“猜想”——可能是错误的这一担忧。具体来说，发送者对接收者可能从中获取的信息来源以及策略选择都不确定。她首先识别出在“最坏情况”下能带来最大收益的所有的信息策略，即当自然提供信息并协调接收者的行动以最小化发送者的收益时。然后，她利用猜想来选择在最坏情况下的最优策略。我们描述了稳健解决方案的特性，确定了在何种条件下需要分离某些状态以实现稳健性，并明确了稳健性要求比标准贝叶斯说服更公开更多信息。最后，我们讨论了在考虑了稳健性之后，贝叶斯说服文献中的一些结果如何发生变化，并开发了一些新的应用。

abstract.text: This paper provides a general analysis of signaling under double‐crossing preferences with a continuum of types. There are natural economic environments where the indifference curves of two types cross twice, such that the celebrated single‐crossing property fails to hold. Equilibrium exhibits a threshold type below which types choose actions that are fully revealing and above which they pool in a pairwise fashion, with a gap separating the actions chosen by these two sets of types. The resulting signaling action is quasi‐concave in type. We also provide an algorithm to establish equilibrium existence by construction.

10.3982/ecta19210.abstractZh: 本文对具有连续类型双交叉偏好下的信号传递进行了总体分析。在某些自然经济环境中，两种类型的无差异曲线会两次交叉，导致著名的单交叉特性不再成立。均衡状态下，存在一个阈值类型，低于该阈值类型的个体会采取完全揭示性的行动，而高于该阈值的个体则会以成对方式联合行动，这两组行动之间存在着差异。由此产生的信号传递行为在类型上呈现准凹性。我们还提供了一种通过构造方法来确定均衡存在的算法。

abstract.text: This paper studies the impacts of managers in the administrative public sector using novel Italian administrative data containing an output‐based measure of productivity. Exploiting the rotation of managers across sites, I find that a one standard deviation increase in managerial talent raises office productivity by 10%. These gains are driven primarily by the exit of older workers who retire when more productive managers take over. I use these estimates to evaluate the optimal allocation of managers to offices. I find that assigning better managers to the largest and most productive offices would increase output by at least 6.9%.

10.3982/ecta19244.abstractZh: 本文研究了行政公共部门管理者的影响，使用了包含基于产出生产率指标的意大利行政数据。通过分析管理者在不同机构之间的流动情况，我发现管理人才水平提高一个标准差，办公场所的生产率会提升10%。这些提升主要源于较老的员工退休，而更有生产力的管理者则接替他们的职位。利用这些估计结果，我们评估了管理者在机构间的最佳分配方案。研究发现，将更优秀的管理者分配到规模最大、生产力最高的机构中，能够至少提高6.9%的产量。

abstract.text: This paper presents finite‐sample efficiency bounds for the core econometric problem of estimation of linear regression coefficients. We show that the classical Gauss–Markov theorem can be restated omitting the unnatural restriction to linear estimators, without adding any extra conditions. Our results are lower bounds on the variances of unbiased estimators. These lower bounds correspond to the variances of the the least squares estimator and the generalized least squares estimator, depending on the assumption on the error covariances. These results show that we can drop the label “linear estimator” from the pedagogy of the Gauss–Markov theorem. Instead of referring to these estimators as BLUE, they can legitimately be called BUE (best unbiased estimators).

10.3982/ecta19255.abstractZh: 本文提出了线性回归系数估计这一核心计量经济学问题的有限样本效率界限。我们证明，经典的Gauss–Markov定理可以重新表述，无需对线性估计量施加不自然的限制，同时也不需增加任何额外条件。我们的结果是对无偏估计量方差的下界限制。这些下界对应于最小二乘估计量和广义最小二乘估计量的方差，具体取决于误差协方差的假设。这些结果表明，我们可以将Gauss–Markov定理中的“线性估计量”这一标签去掉。这些估计量可以合理地被称为BUE（最佳无偏估计量），而不是BLUE。

abstract.text: The benefits of new technologies accrue not only to high‐skilled labor but also to owners of capital in the form of higher capital incomes. This increases inequality. To make this argument, we develop a tractable theory that links technology to the distribution of income and wealth—and not just that of wages—and use it to study the distributional effects of automation. We isolate a new theoretical mechanism: automation increases inequality by raising returns to wealth. The flip side of such return movements is that automation can lead to stagnant wages and, therefore, stagnant incomes at the bottom of the distribution. We use a multiasset model extension to confront differing empirical trends in returns to productive and safe assets and show that the relevant return measures have increased over time. Automation can account for part of the observed trends in income and wealth inequality.

10.3982/ecta19417.abstractZh: 新技术的好处不仅惠及高技能劳动力，也惠及资本所有者，表现为更高的资本收入。这加剧了不平等现象。为了论证这一点，我们构建了一个可行的理论框架，将技术与收入和财富分配联系起来——而不仅仅是工资分配。我们利用该理论来研究自动化的分配效应。我们发现了一个新的理论机制：自动化通过提高财富回报率来加剧不平等。然而，这种回报变化也可能导致工资停滞，进而使收入分配底层的人群收入停滞。我们通过多资产模型扩展来研究生产型资产和安全型资产的回报差异，发现相关回报指标随时间有所上升。自动化可以解释部分观察到的收入和财富不平等趋势。

abstract.text: We propose a method for constructing confidence intervals that account for many forms of spatial correlation. The interval has the familiar “estimator plus and minus a standard error times a critical value” form, but we propose new methods for constructing the standard error and the critical value. The standard error is constructed using population principal components from a given “worst‐case” spatial correlation model. The critical value is chosen to ensure coverage in a benchmark parametric model for the spatial correlations. The method is shown to control coverage in finite sample Gaussian settings in a restricted but nonparametric class of models and in large samples whenever the spatial correlation is weak, that is, with average pairwise correlations that vanish as the sample size gets large. We also provide results on the efficiency of the method.

10.3982/ecta19465.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种构建置信区间的方法，该方法能够考虑多种形式的空间相关性。该置信区间采用常见的“估计值加上和减去标准误差乘以临界值”的形式，但我们提出了新的方法来构建标准误差和临界值。标准误差是通过给定“最坏情况”空间相关模型中的总体主成分来构建的。临界值的选择旨在确保在空间相关性的基准参数模型中能够覆盖到所有情况。该方法在有限样本高斯环境下，以及在空间相关性较弱的大样本中，被证明能够控制覆盖范围，这里的空间相关性较弱是指平均成对相关性随着样本量的增加而趋于消失。我们还提供了关于该方法效率的结果。

abstract.text: This paper studies the role of private sector companies in the development of local amenities. We use evidence from one of the largest multinationals of the 20th century: the United Fruit Company (UFCo). The firm was given a large land concession in Costa Rica—one of the so‐called “Banana Republics”—from 1899 to 1984. Using administrative census data with census‐block geo‐references from 1973 to 2011, we implement a geographic regression discontinuity design that exploits a land assignment that is orthogonal to our outcomes of interest. We find that the firm had a positive and persistent effect on living standards. Company documents explain that a key concern at the time was to attract and maintain a sizable workforce, which induced the firm to invest heavily in local amenities—like the development of education and health infrastructure—that can account for our result. Consistent with this mechanism, we show, empirically and through a proposed model, that the firm's investment efforts increase with worker mobility.

10.3982/ecta19514.abstractZh: 本文研究了私营企业在当地设施发展中的作用。我们选取了20世纪最大的跨国公司之一——联合水果公司（UFCo）作为研究对象。该公司在1899年至1984年间获得了哥斯达黎加的一片大土地特许权，属于所谓的“香蕉共和国”之一。我们利用1973年至2011年的行政人口普查数据，并结合地理参照信息，采用了一种地理回归不连续设计方法，以分析土地分配与我们所关注的结果之间的关系。研究发现，该企业对生活水平产生了积极且持续的影响。公司文件显示，当时公司的首要任务是吸引并维持大量员工，因此公司大量投资于当地设施的建设，如教育和卫生基础设施的开发，这些举措可以解释我们的研究结果。与这一机制一致的是，我们通过实证分析和模型分析发现，公司的投资力度随着员工流动性的增加而增加。

abstract.text: The public debate over disability insurance has centered on concerns about individuals without severe health conditions receiving benefits. We go beyond health risk alone to quantify the overall insurance value of U.S. disability programs, including value from insuring nonhealth risk. We find that disability recipients, especially those with less‐severe health conditions, are much more likely to have experienced a wide variety of nonhealth shocks than nonrecipients. Selection into disability receipt on the basis of nonhealth shocks is so strong among individuals with less‐severe health conditions that by many measures less‐severe recipients are worse off than more‐severe recipients. As a result, under baseline assumptions, benefits to less‐severe recipients have an annual surplus value (insurance benefit less efficiency cost) over cost‐equivalent tax cuts of $7700 per recipient, about three‐fourths that of benefits to more‐severe recipients ($9900). Insurance against nonhealth risk accounts for about one‐half of the value of U.S. disability programs.

10.3982/ecta19668.abstractZh: 关于残疾保险的公共讨论主要集中在没有严重健康状况的个体能否获得福利的问题上。我们不仅关注健康风险，还试图量化美国残疾保险计划的整体价值，包括非健康风险方面的价值。我们发现，特别是那些健康状况不太严重的残疾受益人，比非受益人更有可能经历过各种非健康冲击。对于健康状况不太严重的个体来说，基于非健康冲击来选择是否获得残疾保险的情况非常普遍，以至于在许多指标上，健康状况不太严重的受益人的状况比健康状况更严重的受益人更差。因此，在基本假设下，对于健康状况不太严重的受益人来说，每年的福利价值（即保险收益减去效率成本）比同等成本的减税方案高出7700美元，约为健康状况更严重受益人的福利价值（9900美元）的三到四倍。针对非健康风险的保险约占美国残疾保险计划总价值的二分之一。

abstract.text: The operation of markets and of politics are in practice deeply intertwined. Political decisions set the rules of the game for market competition and, conversely, market competitors participate in and influence political decisions. We develop an integrated model to capture the circularity between the two domains. We show that a positive feedback loop emerges such that market power begets political power, and political power begets market power, but that this feedback loop is bounded. With too much market power, the balance between politics and markets itself becomes lopsided and this drives a wedge between the interests of a policymaker and the dominant firm. Although such a wedge would seem pro‐competitive, we show how it can exacerbate the static and dynamic inefficiency of market outcomes. More generally, our model demonstrates that intuitions about market competition can be upended when competition is intermediated by a strategic policymaker.

10.3982/ecta19775.abstractZh: 市场运作与政治活动在实践中紧密交织。政治决策为市场竞争设定了规则，而市场竞争反过来又影响政治决策。我们构建了一个综合模型，以捕捉这两个领域之间的循环关系。我们发现，市场力量会催生政治权力，而政治权力又会增强市场力量，但这种反馈循环是有边界的。当市场力量过大时，政治与市场的平衡会失衡，这会加剧政策制定者与主导企业之间的利益分歧。虽然这种分歧看似有利于竞争，但实际上它会加剧市场结果的静态和动态低效。更普遍地说，我们的模型表明，当竞争由具有战略意图的政策制定者来引导时，关于市场竞争的直觉可能会被颠覆。

abstract.text: I study a regression model in which one covariate is an unknown function of a latent driver of link formation in a network. Rather than specify and fit a parametric network formation model, I introduce a new method based on matching pairs of agents with similar columns of the squared adjacency matrix, the ij th entry of which contains the number of other agents linked to both agents i and j . The intuition behind this approach is that for a large class of network formation models the columns of the squared adjacency matrix characterize all of the identifiable information about individual linking behavior. In this paper, I describe the model, formalize this intuition, and provide consistent estimators for the parameters of the regression model.

10.3982/ecta19794.abstractZh: 我研究了一个回归模型，其中一个协变量是网络链接形成中一个潜在驱动因素的未知函数。与其指定并拟合一个参数化的网络形成模型，我引入了一种新方法，该方法基于将具有相似列的代理对进行匹配，其中ij项包含了与代理i和j都相连的其它代理的数量。这种方法背后的直觉是，对于大多数网络形成模型来说，平方邻接矩阵的列能够表征所有关于个体链接行为的可识别信息。在本文中，我描述了该模型，形式化了这一直觉，并提供了回归模型参数的一致估计量。

abstract.text: We document that between 50% and 70% of changes in the U.S. wage structure over the last four decades are accounted for by relative wage declines of worker groups specialized in routine tasks in industries experiencing rapid automation. We develop a conceptual framework where tasks across industries are allocated to different types of labor and capital. Automation technologies expand the set of tasks performed by capital, displacing certain worker groups from jobs for which they have comparative advantage. This framework yields a simple equation linking wage changes of a demographic group to the task displacement it experiences. We report robust evidence in favor of this relationship and show that regression models incorporating task displacement explain much of the changes in education wage differentials between 1980 and 2016. The negative relationship between wage changes and task displacement is unaffected when we control for changes in market power, deunionization, and other forms of capital deepening and technology unrelated to automation. We also propose a methodology for evaluating the full general equilibrium effects of automation, which incorporate induced changes in industry composition and ripple effects due to task reallocation across different groups. Our quantitative evaluation explains how major changes in wage inequality can go hand‐in‐hand with modest productivity gains.

10.3982/ecta19815.abstractZh: 我们研究发现，在过去四十年中，美国工资结构的变化中，有50%到70%是由于从事常规任务的工人群体相对工资的下降所导致的，这些行业正经历着快速的自动化进程。我们提出了一个概念框架，将不同行业的任务分配给不同类型的劳动力和资本。自动化技术扩大了资本执行的任务范围，使得某些工人群体失去了具有比较优势的工作岗位。这一框架提供了一个简单的方程，将某个人口群体的工资变化与其所经历的任务位移联系起来。我们提供了有力的证据支持这种关系，并表明，包含任务位移的回归模型能够解释1980年至2016年间教育工资差异的变化。当我们控制市场力量变化、工会解散以及其他形式的资本深化和技术发展等与自动化无关的因素时，工资变化与任务位移之间的负相关关系仍然成立。我们还提出了一种评估自动化对整体均衡影响的分析方法，该方法考虑了行业构成的诱导变化以及不同群体之间任务重新分配所带来的连锁效应。我们的定量评估表明，工资不平等的重大变化可以与适度的生产率提升同时发生。

abstract.text: The view that empirical strategies in economics should be transparent and credible now goes almost without saying. By revealing for whom particular instrumental variables (IV) estimates are valid, the local average treatment effects (LATE) framework helped make this so. This lecture uses empirical examples, mostly involving effects of charter and exam school attendance, to illustrate the value of the LATE framework for causal inference. LATE distinguishes independence conditions satisfied by random assignment from more controversial exclusion restrictions. A surprising exclusion restriction is shown to explain why enrollment at Chicago exam schools reduces student achievement. I also make two broader points: IV exclusion restrictions formalize commitment to clear and consistent explanations of reduced‐form causal effects; the credibility revolution in applied econometrics owes at least as much to compelling empirical analyses as to methodological insights.

10.3982/ecta20640.abstractZh: 现在，经济学中的实证策略应当透明且可信的观点几乎已成为共识。通过揭示特定工具变量估计值适用于哪些对象，局部平均处理效应框架为这一理念的实现提供了支持。本次讲座通过涉及特许学校及考试学校入学影响的实证案例，阐述了LATE框架在因果推断中的价值。LATE区分了随机分配所满足的独立性条件与更具争议性的排除限制。一个令人惊讶的排除限制被证明可以解释为何芝加哥的考试学校入学会降低学生的学业成绩。我还提出了两个更广泛的观点：工具变量排除限制体现了对清晰且一致解释简化形式因果效应的承诺；应用计量经济学领域可信度的革命，至少同样得益于令人信服的实证分析，而非单纯的方法论见解。

abstract.text: This essay describes the evolution and recent convergence of two methodological approaches to causal inference. The first one, in statistics, started with the analysis and design of randomized experiments. The second, in econometrics, focused on settings with economic agents making optimal choices. I argue that the local average treatment effects framework facilitated the recent convergence by making key assumptions transparent and intelligible to scholars in many fields. Looking ahead, I discuss recent developments in causal inference that combine the same transparency and relevance.

10.3982/ecta21204.abstractZh: 本文描述了两种因果推断方法论的演变与近期趋同。第一种方法论在统计学中，始于随机实验的分析与设计。第二种方法论在计量经济学中，专注于经济主体做出最优选择的情境。我认为，局部平均处理效应框架通过使关键假设对多个领域的学者来说既透明又易于理解，促进了这种趋同。展望未来，我将讨论那些结合了相同透明度和相关性的因果推断方法的最新发展。
